  to authenticated

ledger.name: staff_cancellation_reason_visibility
statements:
-- ============================================================================
-- 운영자 전액 취소를 구매자 단순 변심과 구분해 남기고 보여준다
-- (2026-10-12 브라우저 QA QA-4·QA-10, ADR-0018)
--
-- 20261013110200은 운영자 전액 취소 요청의 reason_type을 'change_of_mind'로 적었다.
-- reason_type은 구매자의 청약철회 사유(단순 변심 7일·하자 3개월, 반송비 부담 주체)를
-- 가르는 값이라, 운영자가 품절·테스트 결제 정리로 연 취소가 클레임 목록·상세·주문
-- 패널·사유 필터·통계에 전부 "단순 변심"으로 나왔다. 운영 사유는 '요청 내용' 문자열에만
-- 있었다.
--
-- 이 migration은:
--   1. reason_type에 'staff'(운영자 전액 취소)를 더하고, 발원이 staff인 요청만 그 값을
--      갖게 묶는다. 이미 만들어진 운영자 요청을 바로잡는다.
--   2. 운영자 전액 취소 시작 RPC가 'staff'로 적게 한다.
--   3. 운영 읽기 RPC(클레임 목록·상세·주문 통합검색·클레임 통계)가 운영 사유 코드를
--      함께 싣고, 클레임 목록 사유 필터가 운영 사유로 거를 수 있게 한다.
--   4. 주문 통합검색이 최근 요청의 정합화 오류 코드(last_error_code)를 함께 싣는다.
--      주문 패널의 재시도 결과·취소 요청 영역에서 원인 코드를 볼 수 있어야 런북의
--      코드별 조치를 따를 수 있다(QA-10).
--
-- 구매자 직접 신청(request_order_claim)은 계속 change_of_mind·defect만 받는다.
-- 'staff'는 구매자 컬럼 grant로 읽히지만 "운영자가 시작한 취소"라는 사실은 구매자 알림이
-- 이미 알린다. 운영 사유 코드·메모·처리자는 계속 구매자 grant 밖이다.
--
-- 재정의 함수는 최신 정의를 복사해 위 차이만 넣었다:
--   admin_start_order_cancellation ← 20261013110200:99
--   admin_search_order_claims       ← 20260820090000:17
--   admin_search_orders             ← 20260910062025:10
--   admin_order_claim_detail        ← 20260910083942:197 (wrapper)
--   admin_claims_report             ← 20260818160000:223
-- ============================================================================

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. reason_type 'staff'
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.order_cancellation_requests
  drop constraint order_cancellation_requests_reason_type_check

-- 값 정정만 하는 backfill이다. 운영 행위가 아니므로 updated_at을 움직이지 않는다
-- (20260909001505의 metadata backfill과 같은 방식).
alter table public.order_cancellation_requests disable trigger trg_order_cancellation_requests_updated

update public.order_cancellation_requests
set reason_type = 'staff'
where origin = 'staff'
  and reason_type is distinct from 'staff'
alter table public.order_cancellation_requests enable trigger trg_order_cancellation_requests_updated

alter table public.order_cancellation_requests
  add constraint order_cancellation_requests_reason_type_check
  check (reason_type in ('change_of_mind', 'defect', 'staff'))

-- 운영자 전액 취소 사유는 운영자 발원 요청에만 있고, 운영자 발원 요청은 늘 그 값이다.
alter table public.order_cancellation_requests
  add constraint order_cancellation_requests_staff_reason_type
  check ((origin = 'staff') = (reason_type = 'staff'))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. 운영자 전액 취소 시작 — reason_type = 'staff'
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_start_order_cancellation(
  p_order_id uuid,
  p_reason_code text,
  p_note text,
  p_warehouse_stop_confirmed boolean
)
returns uuid
language plpgsql
volatile
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_note text := nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_note, '')), '');
  v_request_id uuid;
  v_exported_count integer;
  v_payment_count integer;
  v_reason_label text;
  v_notice text;
begin
  if v_actor is null or not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_reason_code is null
    or p_reason_code not in ('out_of_stock', 'customer_request', 'test_payment_cleanup', 'other')
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_staff_cancellation_reason';
  end if;

  if (v_note is not null and (
        char_length(v_note) > 500
        or pg_catalog.translate(v_note, E'\n\r\t', '') ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
      ))
    or (p_reason_code = 'other' and (v_note is null or char_length(v_note) < 5))
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_staff_cancellation_note';
  end if;

  -- 공통 잠금 순서: order → shipments → request → attempts → payments.
  select order_record.*
  into v_order
  from public.orders as order_record
  where order_record.id = p_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise no_data_found using message = 'order_not_found';
  end if;

  perform shipment.id
  from public.order_shipments as shipment
  where shipment.order_id = p_order_id
  order by shipment.id
  for update;

  if v_order.status not in ('paid', 'confirmed')
    or v_order.shipped_at is not null
    or v_order.delivered_at is not null
    or v_order.done_at is not null
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'order_not_staff_cancelable';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_shipments as shipment
    where shipment.order_id = p_order_id
      and (
        shipment.status not in ('ready', 'canceled')
        or shipment.shipped_at is not null
        or shipment.delivered_at is not null
      )
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'shipment_already_dispatched';
  end if;

  select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer
  into v_exported_count
  from public.order_shipments as shipment
  where shipment.order_id = p_order_id
    and shipment.status = 'ready'
    and shipment.exported_at is not null;

  if v_exported_count > 0 and p_warehouse_stop_confirmed is distinct from true then
    raise check_violation using message = 'warehouse_stop_confirmation_required';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = p_order_id
      and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_claims as claim
    where claim.order_id = p_order_id
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'order_claim_in_progress';
  end if;

  perform attempt.id
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  where attempt.purpose = 'order'
    and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by attempt.id
  for update;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state in ('prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review')
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'payment_reconciliation_required';
  end if;

  perform payment.id
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by payment.id
  for update;

  /*
   * 이 경로가 결제사 취소까지 닫을 수 있는 결제만 받는다.
   *
   * 토스 결제는 서버 오케스트레이터가 전액 취소를 발행하고 fresh 조회로 검증한다.
   * Korpay(취소 API 없음)와 무통장(계좌 송금 종결 미구현, #279·#280·#281)은 이
   * 경로로 열면 결제확인필요에 영구히 갇히므로 시작 자체를 거절한다.
   */
  select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer
  into v_payment_count
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    and payment.status <> 'failed';

  if v_payment_count = 0 or exists (
    select 1
    from public.payments as payment
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status <> 'failed'
      and (
        payment.provider <> 'toss'
        or payment.status <> 'paid'
        or nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(payment.payment_key), '') is null
      )
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'staff_cancellation_toss_only';
  end if;

  v_reason_label := case p_reason_code
    when 'out_of_stock' then '품절·출고 불가'
    when 'customer_request' then '고객 요청(CS 접수)'
    when 'test_payment_cleanup' then '테스트 결제 정리'
    else '기타'
  end;

  insert into public.order_cancellation_requests (
    order_id,
    requested_by,
    reason,
    reason_type,
    claim_type,
    stage,
    origin,
    staff_reason_code,
    staff_note,
    initiated_by,
    warehouse_stop_confirmed,
    decided_by,
    decided_at,
    provider_started_at
  )
  values (
    p_order_id,
    v_order.user_id,
    '운영자 전액 취소 · ' || v_reason_label,
    'staff',
    'cancel',
    'processing',
    'staff',
    p_reason_code,
    v_note,
    v_actor,
    v_exported_count > 0,
    v_actor,
    pg_catalog.now(),
    pg_catalog.now()
  )
  returning id into v_request_id;

  insert into public.order_cancellation_claims (order_id, requested_by, previous_status)
  values (p_order_id, v_order.user_id, v_order.status)
  on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.refunds (payment_id, amount, reason, status, cancellation_request_id)
  select
    payment.id,
    payment.amount,
    '운영자 전액 취소 · ' || v_reason_label,
    'requested',
    v_request_id
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    and payment.status = 'paid'
  on conflict (payment_id) do update
  set
    cancellation_request_id = excluded.cancellation_request_id,
    reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
    status = case when public.refunds.status = 'done' then 'done' else 'requested' end;

  insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
  values (
    v_actor,
    'admin.order.staff_cancellation_started',
    'order:' || p_order_id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'claimId', v_request_id,
      'claimType', 'cancel',
      'to', 'processing',
      'reasonCode', p_reason_code,
      'note', v_note,
      'previousOrderStatus', v_order.status::text,
      'exportedShipmentCount', v_exported_count,
      'warehouseStopConfirmed', v_exported_count > 0,
      'paymentCount', v_payment_count
    )
  );

  v_notice := case p_reason_code
    when 'out_of_stock' then '판매자 사정(품절·출고 불가)으로 주문 전체를 취소하고 결제 금액 전액을 환불합니다.'
    when 'customer_request' then '요청하신 주문 취소를 접수해 주문 전체를 취소하고 결제 금액 전액을 환불합니다.'
    when 'test_payment_cleanup' then '테스트 결제로 만들어진 주문이라 주문 전체를 취소하고 결제를 취소합니다.'
    else '주문 전체를 취소하고 결제 금액 전액을 환불합니다. 자세한 사유는 고객센터로 문의해주세요.'
  end;

  perform private.notify_order_claim(
    v_request_id,
    'staff_cancel_started',
    '주문 취소를 진행해요',
    v_notice
  );

  return v_request_id;
end;
$function$

revoke all on function public.admin_start_order_cancellation(uuid, text, text, boolean)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

grant execute on function public.admin_start_order_cancellation(uuid, text, text, boolean)
  to authenticated

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. 클레임 목록 — 운영 사유 코드와 사유 필터
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 반환 테이블이 바뀌어 drop 후 재생성한다. 인자 시그니처는 그대로다.
drop function if exists public.admin_search_order_claims(
  text, text, text, date, date, text, integer, integer
)

create function public.admin_search_order_claims(
  p_claim_type text default null,
  p_stage text default null,
  p_reason_type text default null,
  p_from date default null,
  p_to date default null,
  p_query text default null,
  p_limit integer default 20,
  p_offset integer default 0
)
returns table (
  id uuid,
  reference bigint,
  order_id uuid,
  claim_type text,
  stage text,
  reason_type text,
  staff_reason_code text,
  buyer_id uuid,
  buyer_name text,
  buyer_email text,
  order_status public.order_status,
  order_total bigint,
  requested_at timestamptz,
  collected_at timestamptz,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  refund_method text,
  handler_name text,
  total_count bigint
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
  v_stages text[];
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_claim_type is not null and p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type filter';
  end if;
  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim date range';
  end if;
  if v_query is not null and length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'claim search query too long';
  end if;
  -- 사유 필터: 구매자 사유(change_of_mind·defect), 운영자 전액 취소 전체(staff),
  -- 운영자 전액 취소의 사유 하나(staff:<사유 코드>). 모르는 값은 빈 목록이 아니라 거절한다.
  if p_reason_type is not null and p_reason_type not in (
    'change_of_mind', 'defect', 'staff',
    'staff:out_of_stock', 'staff:customer_request', 'staff:test_payment_cleanup', 'staff:other'
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim reason filter';
  end if;

  -- 'open'은 단계 하나가 아니라 "아직 끝나지 않은 것 전부"다. 화면이 이 집합을
  -- 직접 나열하면 단계를 하나 더할 때 목록에서만 조용히 빠진다.
  if p_stage = 'open' then
    v_stages := array[
      'requested', 'in_review', 'collecting', 'collected',
      'on_hold', 'processing', 'needs_review'
    ];
  elsif p_stage is not null then
    v_stages := array[p_stage];
  end if;

  return query
  select
    request.id,
    request.reference,
    request.order_id,
    request.claim_type,
    request.stage,
    request.reason_type,
    request.staff_reason_code,
    orders.user_id as buyer_id,
    profile.nickname as buyer_name,
    profile.email as buyer_email,
    orders.status as order_status,
    orders.total as order_total,
    request.requested_at,
    request.collected_at,
    request.completed_at,
    refund.method as refund_method,
    handler.nickname as handler_name,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  join public.orders as orders on orders.id = request.order_id
  join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
  left join public.profiles as handler on handler.id = request.decided_by
  left join lateral (
    select payment_refund.method
    from public.refunds as payment_refund
    join public.payments as payment on payment.id = payment_refund.payment_id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = request.order_id
    order by payment_refund.created_at desc, payment_refund.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as refund on true
  where (p_claim_type is null or request.claim_type = p_claim_type)
    and (v_stages is null or request.stage = any(v_stages))
    and (
      p_reason_type is null
      or (p_reason_type not like 'staff:%' and request.reason_type = p_reason_type)
      or (
        p_reason_type like 'staff:%'
        and request.reason_type = 'staff'
        and request.staff_reason_code = substr(p_reason_type, 7)
      )
    )
    and (
      p_from is null
      or request.requested_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or request.requested_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      v_query is null
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(request.order_id::text)) > 0
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(request.reference::text)) > 0
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.email, ''))) > 0
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.nickname, ''))) > 0
    )
  order by request.requested_at desc, request.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$$

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. 주문 통합검색 — 최근 요청의 운영 사유 코드와 정합화 오류 코드
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 반환 테이블이 바뀌어 drop 후 재생성한다. 인자 시그니처는 그대로다.
drop function if exists public.admin_search_orders(
  text, date, date, text, integer, integer, timestamptz, text
)

create function public.admin_search_orders(
  p_status text default null,
  p_from date default null,
  p_to date default null,
  p_query text default null,
  p_limit integer default 20,
  p_offset integer default 0,
  p_confirmed_before timestamptz default null,
  p_field text default 'all'
)
returns table (
  id uuid,
  user_id uuid,
  buyer_name text,
  buyer_email text,
  status public.order_status,
  total bigint,
  address jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz,
  shipping_carrier text,
  tracking_number text,
  confirmed_at timestamptz,
  shipped_at timestamptz,
  delivered_at timestamptz,
  done_at timestamptz,
  cancellation_request_id uuid,
  cancellation_request_status text,
  cancellation_reason_type text,
  cancellation_requested_at timestamptz,
  cancellation_decided_at timestamptz,
  cancellation_decision_note text,
  cancellation_claim_type text,
  cancellation_stage text,
  cancellation_staff_reason_code text,
  cancellation_last_error_code text,
  total_count bigint
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_field text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_field), ''), 'all');
  -- 운송장 입력은 저장 시 하이픈·공백을 제거한다. 고객이 택배사에서
  -- 복사한 표기(1234-5678)를 그대로 붙여도 같은 배송 건을 찾게 한다.
  v_tracking_query text := nullif(
    regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_query, '')), '[[:space:]-]', '', 'g'),
    ''
  );
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_status is not null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(enum_range(null::public.order_status)) as allowed(value)
      where allowed.value::text = p_status
    )
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order status filter';
  end if;

  if v_field not in ('all', 'order', 'nickname', 'email', 'recipient', 'tracking') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order search field';
  end if;

  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order date range';
  end if;

  if v_query is not null and length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'order search query too long';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    orders.id,
    orders.user_id,
    profile.nickname as buyer_name,
    profile.email as buyer_email,
    orders.status,
    orders.total,
    orders.address,
    orders.created_at,
    orders.updated_at,
    (select max(s.carrier)
     from public.order_shipments as s
     where s.order_id = orders.id
     having count(*) = 1),
    (select max(s.tracking_number)
     from public.order_shipments as s
     where s.order_id = orders.id
     having count(*) = 1),
    orders.confirmed_at,
    orders.shipped_at,
    orders.delivered_at,
    orders.done_at,
    cancellation.id as cancellation_request_id,
    cancellation.status as cancellation_request_status,
    cancellation.reason_type as cancellation_reason_type,
    cancellation.requested_at as cancellation_requested_at,
    cancellation.decided_at as cancellation_decided_at,
    cancellation.decision_note as cancellation_decision_note,
    cancellation.claim_type as cancellation_claim_type,
    cancellation.stage as cancellation_stage,
    cancellation.staff_reason_code as cancellation_staff_reason_code,
    cancellation.last_error_code as cancellation_last_error_code,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.orders as orders
  join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
  left join lateral (
    select
      request.id,
      request.status,
      request.reason_type,
      request.requested_at,
      request.decided_at,
      request.decision_note,
      request.claim_type,
      request.stage,
      request.staff_reason_code,
      request.last_error_code
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = orders.id
    order by request.requested_at desc, request.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as cancellation on true
  where (p_status is null or orders.status::text = p_status)
    and (
      p_from is null
      or orders.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or orders.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    -- 발주확인 기록이 없는 주문은 지연 목록에 넣지 않는다.
    and (p_confirmed_before is null or orders.confirmed_at < p_confirmed_before)
    and (
      v_query is null
      or (
        v_field = 'all'
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(orders.id::text)) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.email, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(orders.address ->> 'recipientName', ''))) > 0
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.order_shipments as shipment
            where shipment.order_id = orders.id
              and position(v_tracking_query in lower(coalesce(shipment.tracking_number, ''))) > 0
          )
        )
      )
      or (v_field = 'order' and position(lower(v_query) in lower(orders.id::text)) > 0)
      or (v_field = 'nickname' and position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.nickname, ''))) > 0)
      or (v_field = 'email' and position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.email, ''))) > 0)
      or (v_field = 'recipient' and position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(orders.address ->> 'recipientName', ''))) > 0)
      or (
        v_field = 'tracking'
        and v_tracking_query is not null
        and exists (
          select 1
          from public.order_shipments as shipment
          where shipment.order_id = orders.id
            and position(v_tracking_query in lower(coalesce(shipment.tracking_number, ''))) > 0
        )
      )
    )
  order by orders.created_at desc, orders.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$$
revoke all on function public.admin_order_claim_detail(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_order_claim_detail(uuid) to authenticated

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. 클레임 통계 — 운영자 전액 취소를 운영 사유별로
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.admin_claims_report(
  p_from timestamptz,
  p_to timestamptz
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $function$
declare
  v_order_count bigint;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to <= p_from then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_report_range';
  end if;

  select count(*)
  into v_order_count
  from public.orders
  where orders.status = any (private.revenue_order_statuses())
    and orders.created_at >= p_from
    and orders.created_at < p_to;

  with scoped as (
    select
      request.id,
      request.claim_type,
      request.reason_type,
      request.staff_reason_code,
      request.stage,
      request.requested_at,
      request.completed_at
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.requested_at >= p_from
      and request.requested_at < p_to
  ),
  by_type as (
    select
      scoped.claim_type,
      count(*) as total,
      count(*) filter (where scoped.stage = 'completed') as completed,
      count(*) filter (where scoped.stage = 'rejected') as rejected,
      count(*) filter (where scoped.stage not in ('completed', 'rejected')) as open_count
    from scoped
    group by scoped.claim_type
  ),
  -- 운영자 전액 취소는 운영 사유별로 나눈다. 구매자 사유 행의 staff_reason_code는
  -- 항상 null이라 기존 묶음은 그대로다.
  by_reason as (
    select
      scoped.claim_type,
      scoped.reason_type,
      scoped.staff_reason_code,
      count(*) as total
    from scoped
    group by scoped.claim_type, scoped.reason_type, scoped.staff_reason_code
  ),
  -- 환급 소요시간은 접수(requested_at)부터 환불 완료(completed_at)까지다.
  -- 배송·반품 정책이 약속한 "반환받은 날부터 3영업일"과 기산점이 다르므로
  -- 화면에서 SLA 준수율이라고 부르지 않고 접수→완료 소요로 적는다.
  refund_speed as (
    select
      count(*) as completed_count,
      avg(extract(epoch from (refund.completed_at - scoped.requested_at)) / 3600.0) as avg_hours,
      count(*) filter (
        where refund.completed_at - scoped.requested_at <= interval '72 hours'
      ) as within_72h
    from public.refunds as refund
    join scoped on scoped.id = refund.cancellation_request_id
    -- refunds.status는 'requested|done|failed'다. 'completed'는 클레임 stage의
    -- 값이라 여기서 쓰면 항상 0건이 된다.
    where refund.status = 'done'
      and refund.completed_at is not null
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'orderCount', v_order_count,
    'claimCount', coalesce((select sum(by_type.total) from by_type), 0),
    'byType', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'claimType', by_type.claim_type,
          'total', by_type.total,
          'completed', by_type.completed,
          'rejected', by_type.rejected,
          'open', by_type.open_count,
          -- 분모가 0이면 비율이 아니라 null이다. 0%로 적으면 "클레임이 없다"로
          -- 읽히지만 실제로는 "판매가 없었다"이다.
          'ratePerMille', case
            when v_order_count = 0 then null
            else round((by_type.total::numeric / v_order_count) * 1000, 1)
          end
        )
        order by by_type.total desc, by_type.claim_type
      )
      from by_type
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'byReason', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'claimType', by_reason.claim_type,
          'reasonType', by_reason.reason_type,
          'staffReasonCode', by_reason.staff_reason_code,
          'total', by_reason.total
        )
        order by by_reason.claim_type, by_reason.total desc, by_reason.reason_type,
          by_reason.staff_reason_code nulls first
      )
      from by_reason
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'refunds', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'completedCount', refund_speed.completed_count,
        'averageHours', case
          when refund_speed.avg_hours is null then null
          else round(refund_speed.avg_hours::numeric, 1)
        end,
        'within72h', refund_speed.within_72h
      )
      from refund_speed
    )
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

revoke all on function public.admin_claims_report(timestamptz, timestamptz)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

grant execute on function public.admin_claims_report(timestamptz, timestamptz)
  to authenticated

ledger.name: expire_sweep_claim_completion_notice
statements:
-- ============================================================================
-- 결제 기한 sweep이 닫은 구매자 취소 요청을 구매자에게 알린다 (2026-10-12 브라우저 QA QA-7)
--
-- 결제가 끝나기 전(prepared·confirming) 접수된 취소 요청은 requested로 남고, 구매자는
-- "요청을 접수했습니다. 담당자가 확인한 뒤 진행 상황을 알려드립니다."를 받는다. 결제
-- 기한이 지나 expire_stale_checkouts가 그 요청을 completed로, 주문을 canceled로 닫아도
-- 알림을 보내지 않았다. 구매자 화면은 그동안 "담당자가 검토 중"이었고 실제로는 담당자
-- 없이 닫혔다.
--
-- 이제 sweep은 요청을 닫는 같은 임계 구역에서 결제 없는 종결을 감사 로그
-- (system.order.cancellation_completed, finalizer의 결제 없는 종결과 같은 action)에
-- 남기고 구매자에게 "주문이 취소됐어요"를 보낸다. 문구는 닫힌 이유(결제 기한 만료·
-- 승인 거절·결제 취소)를 단정할 수 있는 만큼만 말한다. 재고·쿠폰·적립금 반환은
-- 종전처럼 finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence가 한다.
--
-- 티켓 분기는 finalize_ticket_cancellation_request가 종결을 맡으므로 바꾸지 않는다.
--
-- 함수 본문은 최신 정의를 복사해 위 차이만 넣었다:
--   expire_stale_checkouts ← 20261013110100:517
-- ============================================================================

create or replace function public.expire_stale_checkouts()
returns integer
language plpgsql
volatile
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $function$
declare
  v_count integer := 0;
  v_can_expire boolean;
  v_expired_prepared_transitioned boolean;
  v_cancel_reason text;
  v_request_id uuid;
  v_request_outcome text;
  r record;
  v_request record;
  v_attempt public.payment_attempts%rowtype;
begin
  for r in
    select orders.id
    from public.orders
    where orders.status = 'pending'
      and orders.expires_at is not null
      and orders.expires_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.payments as payment
        where payment.purpose = 'order'
          and payment.ref_id = orders.id
          and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid')
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
        where request.order_id = orders.id
          and request.status in ('processing', 'needs_review')
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        where attempt.purpose = 'order'
          and attempt.ref_id = orders.id
          and attempt.state in ('confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved')
      )
    order by orders.expires_at
    limit 200
    for update of orders skip locked
  loop
    v_can_expire := true;
    v_expired_prepared_transitioned := false;
    v_cancel_reason := '결제 시간 만료 자동 취소';
    v_request_id := null;
    v_request_outcome := null;

    -- The baseline partial unique index guarantees one attempt per goods
    -- order. Locking it only after the order matches claim/finalize exactly.
    select attempt.*
    into v_attempt
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = r.id
    for update;

    if found then
      if v_attempt.state = 'prepared' then
        if v_attempt.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() then
          v_can_expire := false;
        else
          update public.payment_attempts as attempt
          set
            state = 'canceled',
            claim_token = null,
            claim_expires_at = null
          where attempt.id = v_attempt.id
            and attempt.state = 'prepared'
            and attempt.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
          returning true into v_expired_prepared_transitioned;

          if not coalesce(v_expired_prepared_transitioned, false) then
            v_can_expire := false;
          end if;
        end if;
      elsif v_attempt.state in (
        'confirming',
        'unknown',
        'needs_review',
        'approved'
      ) then
        -- Defensive recheck after locking: a callback may have won after the
        -- candidate snapshot but before this transaction acquired the order.
        v_can_expire := false;
      end if;
    end if;

    if not v_can_expire then
      continue;
    end if;

    -- A user can request cancellation while the provider action is still
    -- valid. That request intentionally holds inventory until the attempt TTL
    -- proves the provider can no longer claim it. Lock and finish that durable
    -- request in this same transaction; the compatibility cancel_order wrapper
    -- correctly rejects active requests and therefore is used only when none
    -- exists.
    select request.id, request.reason
    into v_request
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = r.id
      and request.status = 'requested'
    order by request.requested_at desc, request.id desc
    limit 1
    for update;

    if found then
      -- A durable request is provider-sensitive evidence. Close it only when
      -- this exact order→attempt critical section proved the action TTL and
      -- performed prepared→canceled itself, or when the locked attempt already
      -- ended without capture (declined/canceled, no payment row, no non-failed
      -- ledger). The latter used to continue forever: a request accepted while
      -- the provider confirm was in flight stayed requested after a decline and
      -- held stock, coupons and store credit indefinitely (2026-10-12 audit).
      -- An absent attempt or a legacy failed-ledger order is still not proof.
      if not v_expired_prepared_transitioned
        and not (
          v_attempt.id is not null
          and v_attempt.state in ('declined', 'canceled')
          and v_attempt.payment_id is null
          and not exists (
            select 1
            from public.payments as payment
            where payment.purpose = 'order'
              and payment.ref_id = r.id
              and payment.status <> 'failed'
          )
        )
      then
        continue;
      end if;

      v_request_id := v_request.id;
      v_cancel_reason := v_request.reason;
      -- 구매자 알림 문구를 가르는 결과. 이 임계 구역이 만료를 증명했으면 결제창이
      -- 결제 기한까지 끝나지 않은 것이고, 아니면 잠근 attempt가 결제 없이 끝난 것이다.
      v_request_outcome := case
        when v_expired_prepared_transitioned then 'expired'
        else v_attempt.state::text
      end;
    end if;

    if v_request_id is null then
      perform public.cancel_order(r.id, v_cancel_reason);
    else
      perform public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(
        r.id,
        v_cancel_reason,
        array[]::text[]
      );

      update public.order_cancellation_requests as request
      set
        status = 'completed',
        completed_at = pg_catalog.now(),
        updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
      where request.id = v_request_id
        and request.status = 'requested';

      -- 구매자는 "담당자가 확인한 뒤 진행 상황을 알려드립니다"를 받은 채 기다리고
      -- 있었다. 담당자 없이 sweep이 닫았으므로 결과를 직접 알리고, 같은 결과를
      -- finalizer의 결제 없는 종결과 같은 감사 행으로 남긴다(2026-10-12 QA-7).
      insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
      values (
        null,
        'system.order.cancellation_completed',
        'order:' || r.id::text,
        pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
          'requestId', v_request_id,
          'to', 'completed',
          'refundCount', 0,
          'attemptOutcome', v_request_outcome,
          'trigger', 'checkout_expiry_sweep',
          'actor', 'system'
        )
      );

      perform private.notify_order_claim(
        v_request_id,
        'completed',
        '주문이 취소됐어요',
        case v_request_outcome
          when 'expired' then '결제 기한까지 결제가 완료되지 않아 결제 없이 주문을 취소했습니다.'
          when 'declined' then '결제가 승인되지 않아 결제 없이 주문을 취소했습니다.'
          else '결제가 취소되어 주문을 취소했습니다.'
        end
      );
    end if;

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;

  -- Ticket checkout follows the same lock order and attempt-TTL proof. A
  -- durable cancellation request is completed only when this critical section
  -- itself transitions its expired prepared attempt to canceled.
  for r in
    select ticket_orders.id
    from public.ticket_orders
    where ticket_orders.status = 'pending'
      and ticket_orders.expires_at is not null
      and ticket_orders.expires_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.payments as payment
        where payment.purpose = 'ticket'
          and payment.ref_id = ticket_orders.id
          and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid')
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
        where request.ticket_order_id = ticket_orders.id
          and request.status in ('processing', 'needs_review')
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        where attempt.purpose = 'ticket'
          and attempt.ref_id = ticket_orders.id
          and attempt.state in ('confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved')
      )
    order by ticket_orders.expires_at
    limit 200
    for update of ticket_orders skip locked
  loop
    v_can_expire := true;
    v_expired_prepared_transitioned := false;
    v_request_id := null;

    select attempt.*
    into v_attempt
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'ticket'
      and attempt.ref_id = r.id
    for update;

    if found then
      if v_attempt.state = 'prepared' then
        if v_attempt.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() then
          v_can_expire := false;
        else
          update public.payment_attempts as attempt
          set
            state = 'canceled',
            claim_token = null,
            claim_expires_at = null
          where attempt.id = v_attempt.id
            and attempt.state = 'prepared'
            and attempt.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
          returning true into v_expired_prepared_transitioned;

          if not coalesce(v_expired_prepared_transitioned, false) then
            v_can_expire := false;
          end if;
        end if;
      elsif v_attempt.state in (
        'confirming',
        'unknown',
        'needs_review',
        'approved'
      ) then
        v_can_expire := false;
      end if;
    end if;

    if not v_can_expire then
      continue;
    end if;

    select request.id, request.requested_by
    into v_request
    from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.ticket_order_id = r.id
      and request.status = 'requested'
    order by request.requested_at desc, request.id desc
    limit 1
    for update;

    if found then
      if not v_expired_prepared_transitioned then
        continue;
      end if;

      v_request_id := v_request.id;
    end if;

    if v_request_id is null then
      perform public.refund_ticket_order(r.id, '결제 시간 만료 자동 취소');
    else
      perform public.finalize_ticket_cancellation_request(
        v_request_id,
        v_request.requested_by
      );
    end if;

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end;
$function$

revoke all on function public.expire_stale_checkouts()
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

grant execute on function public.expire_stale_checkouts()
  to service_role

ledger.name: request_claim_expired_prepared_cancellation
statements:
-- ============================================================================
-- 결제 유효 시간이 지난 결제 대기 주문은 고객 취소로 바로 닫는다
-- (2026-10-12 브라우저 QA QA-1 · R2-1)
--
-- 1. 만료된 결제 준비 시도(QA-1)
--    결제창을 연 뒤 결제 유효 시간(payment_attempts.expires_at)이 지난 결제 대기
--    주문을 구매자가 취소하면 request_order_claim은 그 prepared 시도를 미해결로 세어
--    요청을 requested로 남겼다. 실제로는 담당자 없이 결제 기한 + 5분 sweep
--    (expire_stale_checkouts)이 닫았고, 그동안 재고·쿠폰·적립금이 묶였다.
--
--    이제 이미 잡은 order → shipments → attempt 잠금 아래에서, 결제 원장이 없는
--    결제 대기 주문의 취소라면 만료된 prepared 시도를 sweep·
--    reconcile_expired_prepared_goods_cancellation과 같은 규칙으로 canceled로 닫고
--    결제 없는 즉시 종결(finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence →
--    'completed')로 보낸다. 감사 로그는 구매자 actor의
--    order.prepared_goods_cancellation_completed(outcome expired_no_capture)다.
--
--    근거: claim_goods_payment_attempt(최신 20260901120000:648)는 prepared 시도의
--    expires_at <= clock_timestamp()를 잠금 전·후 두 번 goods_payment_attempt_expired로
--    거절하고, 이미 canceled인 시도는 terminal로 돌려준다. 앱(goods-checkout.ts)은
--    claimed일 때만 gateway.confirm을 부른다. 토스는 인증을 마친 결제(IN_PROGRESS)도
--    승인 API를 부르지 않으면 매입하지 않고 유효 시간 뒤 EXPIRED로 닫는다(토스 코어 API
--    Payment.status, 웹훅 이벤트 PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED: "결제 인증이 유효한 10분 안에
--    결제 승인 API를 호출하지 않으면 EXPIRED"). 그래서 만료된 prepared 시도에는
--    잡힌 돈이 없다.
--
--    경합: claim과 이 함수는 모두 주문 행을 먼저 잠근다. claim이 먼저 잡으면 시도는
--    confirming이 되어 이 함수가 건드리지 않는다(종전처럼 requested). 이 함수가 먼저
--    닫으면 잠금을 기다린 claim은 시도를 다시 읽어 canceled(terminal)를 돌려주고
--    승인 API를 부르지 않는다.
--
-- 2. 결제 대기 주문의 취소 접수 알림(R2-1)
--    결제가 끝나기 전 접수된 취소 요청의 알림을 "담당자가 확인한 뒤"에서 시도 상태별로
--    실제로 닫히는 길(결제 기한 자동 취소·결제 승인 결과 확인)로 바꾼다. 반품·교환과
--    결제완료 주문의 하자 취소처럼 담당자가 검토하는 요청은 종전 문구를 쓴다.
--
-- 함수 본문은 최신 정의를 복사해 위 차이만 넣었다:
--   request_order_claim ← 20260909001505:63
-- ============================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_order_claim(p_order_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_claim_type text, p_reason text, p_reason_type text, p_bank_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_holder text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_status public.order_status;
  v_delivered_at timestamptz;
  v_claim_id uuid;
  v_has_unresolved_attempt boolean;
  v_masked_account text;
  v_masked_holder text;
  v_payment_count integer;
  v_expired_prepared_attempt_id uuid;
  v_attempt_state public.payment_attempt_state;
begin
  if p_claim_type is null or p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type';
  end if;
  if p_reason_type is null or p_reason_type not in ('change_of_mind', 'defect') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason type';
  end if;
  if p_reason is null
    or btrim(p_reason) <> p_reason
    or length(p_reason) not between 1 and 200
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason';
  end if;

  -- Common intake/dispatch lock order: order → shipments → payment attempts/payments.
  select orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.delivered_at
  into v_user_id, v_status, v_delivered_at
  from public.orders
  where orders.id = p_order_id
  for update;

  if not found or p_user_id is null or v_user_id is distinct from p_user_id then
    return 'not_found';
  end if;

  perform s.id from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=p_order_id order by s.id for update;

  perform attempt.id
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  where attempt.purpose = 'order'
    and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by attempt.id
  for update;

  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state in (
        'prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved'
      )
  )
  into v_has_unresolved_attempt;

  if v_status = 'canceled' then
    return 'already_canceled';
  end if;

  -- 반품·교환은 물리적 회수를 전제한다. 배송이 끝나기 전에는 회수할 물건이
  -- Customer cancellation is available only before order confirmation.
  if p_claim_type in ('return', 'exchange') then
    if not private.order_all_items_delivered(p_order_id) then
      return 'not_claimable';
    end if;
  elsif not private.order_cancel_eligible(p_order_id) then
    return 'not_cancelable';
  end if;

  -- 교환도 청약철회 기한을 준용한다(변심 7일 · 하자 3개월). 판정의 진실원은
  -- 계속 order_withdrawal_deadline_passed 하나다.
  if public.order_withdrawal_deadline_passed(v_delivered_at, p_reason_type, now()) then
    return 'deadline_expired';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = p_order_id
      and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  ) then
    return 'already_requested';
  end if;

  -- status는 적지 않는다. 투영은 private.order_claim_status_for_stage 하나가 만든다.
  insert into public.order_cancellation_requests (
    order_id,
    requested_by,
    reason,
    reason_type,
    claim_type,
    stage
  )
  values (
    p_order_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_reason,
    p_reason_type,
    p_claim_type,
    'requested'
  )
  returning id into v_claim_id;

  /*
   * 환불계좌는 무통장 환불의 유일한 경로이고 카드 fallback의 안전망이다.
   * 세 칸이 모두 있을 때만 저장한다 — 반쪽 계좌는 송금에 쓸 수 없다.
   *
   * 교환에는 저장하지 않는다. 교환의 종결은 재출고이고 어떤 경로로도 돈이
   * 돌아가지 않으므로 계좌를 받을 목적 자체가 없다. 화면은 반품에만 폼을
   * 보이지만 API로는 실어 보낼 수 있으므로 접수 함수가 거른다. 취소·반품은
   * 결제사 취소가 막혔을 때 송금이 유일한 경로라 계속 받고, 보관 기간은
   * 종결 stage에서 seal_order_claim_refund_account가 잡는다.
   */
  if p_claim_type <> 'exchange'
    and p_bank_name is not null
    and p_account_number is not null
    and p_account_holder is not null
  then
    v_masked_account := public.mask_refund_account_number(p_account_number);
    v_masked_holder := public.mask_refund_account_holder(p_account_holder);

    insert into private.claim_refund_accounts (
      claim_id,
      bank_name,
      account_number,
      account_holder,
      masked_account,
      masked_holder
    )
    values (
      v_claim_id,
      btrim(p_bank_name),
      p_account_number,
      btrim(p_account_holder),
      btrim(p_bank_name) || ' ' || v_masked_account,
      v_masked_holder
    );
  end if;

  /*
   * 결제 유효 시간이 이미 지난 결제 준비(prepared) 시도는 미해결이 아니다
   * (2026-10-12 브라우저 QA QA-1).
   *
   * 위에서 잡은 order → shipments → attempt 잠금 아래에서만 판정한다. 만료된
   * prepared 시도는 claim_goods_payment_attempt가 잠금 전·후 두 번 모두
   * goods_payment_attempt_expired로 거절하므로, 늦게 도착한 결제 완료 리디렉트가
   * 있어도 서버는 승인 API를 부르지 않는다. 토스는 인증을 마친 결제(IN_PROGRESS)도
   * 승인 API를 부르지 않으면 매입하지 않고 EXPIRED로 닫는다(코어 API Payment.status,
   * 웹훅 이벤트 PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED). Korpay도 confirm 호출 전에는 승인하지 않는다.
   *
   * 그래서 결제 원장이 없는 결제 대기 주문의 취소라면 그 시도를 expire_stale_checkouts·
   * reconcile_expired_prepared_goods_cancellation과 같은 규칙(prepared → canceled,
   * claim 토큰 제거, 만료 재확인을 갱신 조건에 둔다)으로 닫고 아래 즉시 종결로
   * 보낸다. 지금까지는 만료 여부와 상관없이 prepared를 미해결로 세어 요청을
   * requested로 남겼고, 재고·쿠폰·적립금이 결제 기한 + 5분 sweep까지 묶였다.
   *
   * 유효 시간이 남은 prepared, confirming·unknown·needs_review·approved는 종전처럼
   * 미해결이다. 결제 원장이 하나라도 있으면(실패 행 포함) 시도를 건드리지 않는다 —
   * 즉시 종결 조건과 같아야 시도만 닫히고 요청이 남는 중간 상태가 생기지 않는다.
   * 굿즈 주문의 시도는 하나다(payment_attempts_one_goods_order_idx).
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'pending'
    and v_has_unresolved_attempt
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    )
  then
    update public.payment_attempts as attempt
    set
      state = 'canceled',
      claim_token = null,
      claim_expires_at = null
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state = 'prepared'
      and attempt.expires_at is not null
      and attempt.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    returning attempt.id into v_expired_prepared_attempt_id;

    if v_expired_prepared_attempt_id is not null then
      select exists (
        select 1
        from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        where attempt.purpose = 'order'
          and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
          and attempt.state in (
            'prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved'
          )
      )
      into v_has_unresolved_attempt;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- 결제 이력이 없는 pending 주문은 예전처럼 즉시 종결한다.
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'pending'
    and not v_has_unresolved_attempt
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    )
  then
    perform public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(
      p_order_id,
      p_reason,
      array[]::text[]
    );

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'completed',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    -- 위에서 닫은 만료 시도는 reconcile_expired_prepared_goods_cancellation과 같은
    -- 결과 어휘로 남긴다. actor는 취소를 누른 구매자다.
    if v_expired_prepared_attempt_id is not null then
      insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
      values (
        p_user_id,
        'order.prepared_goods_cancellation_completed',
        'order:' || p_order_id::text,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'attemptId', v_expired_prepared_attempt_id,
          'requestId', v_claim_id,
          'outcome', 'expired_no_capture',
          'trigger', 'customer_cancel_request'
        )
      );
    end if;

    return 'completed';
  end if;

  /*
   * 자동 승인 — paid(발주확인 전) 변심 취소.
   *
   * 아직 발주확인도 하지 않은 주문의 변심 취소를 사람이 판단할 이유가 없다.
   * 스마트스토어와 같은 경계다. confirmed부터는 발송 준비가 시작됐으므로
   * 운영자 판단으로 남긴다.
   *
   * 승인의 실질(durable claim + 환불 intent)은 admin_decide_order_cancellation의
   * 승인 분기와 같다. decided_by는 null로 남긴다 — 사람이 누른 적이 없다.
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'paid'
    and p_reason_type = 'change_of_mind'
  then
    insert into public.order_cancellation_claims (
      order_id,
      requested_by,
      previous_status
    )
    values (p_order_id, p_user_id, v_status)
    on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

    insert into public.refunds (
      payment_id,
      amount,
      reason,
      status,
      cancellation_request_id
    )
    select
      payment.id,
      payment.amount,
      p_reason,
      case when refund.status = 'done' then 'done' else 'requested' end,
      v_claim_id
    from public.payments as payment
    left join public.refunds as refund on refund.payment_id = payment.id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded')
    on conflict (payment_id) do update
    set
      cancellation_request_id = excluded.cancellation_request_id,
      reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
      status = case
        when public.refunds.status = 'done' then 'done'
        else 'requested'
      end;

    select count(*)::integer
    into v_payment_count
    from public.payments as payment
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded');

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'processing',
      decided_at = now(),
      provider_started_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
    values (
      p_user_id,
      'order.claim_auto_approved',
      'order:' || p_order_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'claimId', v_claim_id,
        'claimType', 'cancel',
        'from', 'requested',
        'to', 'processing',
        'previousOrderStatus', v_status::text,
        'reasonType', p_reason_type,
        'paymentCount', v_payment_count
      )
    );

    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      v_claim_id,
      'auto_approved',
      '취소 요청이 접수됐어요',
      '발송 전 주문이라 자동으로 승인됐습니다. 결제 취소 처리를 시작합니다.'
    );

    return 'auto_approved';
  end if;

  /*
   * 결제가 끝나기 전(결제 대기 주문)의 취소는 담당자가 아니라 결제 결과가 닫는다
   * (2026-10-12 브라우저 QA R2-1). 접수 알림이 "담당자가 확인한 뒤"라고 하면 주문
   * 상세(OrderCancellation)의 "결제 결과를 확인한 뒤 주문 취소를 마무리합니다"와
   * 어긋나고 일어나지 않을 일을 기다리게 한다. 시도 상태별로 실제로 닫히는 길만
   * 말한다:
   *   prepared   — 활성 요청이 있으면 claim이 거절하므로 결제가 더 진행되지 않고,
   *                결제 기한 sweep이 결제 없이 닫는다(알림 20261013110400).
   *   confirming — finalizer가 승인이면 자동 승인 후 토스 취소, 거절·이탈이면 결제
   *                없이 종결하고 알린다(20261013110100).
   *   그 밖      — 결과 불명·확인 필요는 결제 복구 확인이 닫는다.
   * 반품·교환과 결제완료 주문의 하자 취소처럼 담당자 검토가 실제로 필요한 요청은
   * 종전 문구를 쓴다.
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel' and v_status = 'pending' then
    select attempt.state
    into v_attempt_state
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
    order by attempt.id
    limit 1;

    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      v_claim_id,
      'requested',
      '취소 요청이 접수됐어요',
      case v_attempt_state
        when 'prepared' then
          '결제가 끝나지 않은 주문이라 결제 기한이 지나면 결제 없이 자동으로 취소되고 알림을 보내드려요.'
        when 'confirming' then
          '결제 승인 결과를 확인한 뒤 주문 취소를 마무리합니다. 승인됐다면 결제를 취소하고, 승인되지 않았다면 결제 없이 취소한 뒤 알림을 보내드려요.'
        else
          '결제 결과를 확인한 뒤 주문 취소를 마무리하고 진행 상황을 알려드립니다.'
      end
    );

    return 'requested';
  end if;

  perform private.notify_order_claim(
    v_claim_id,
    'requested',
    '클레임 요청이 접수됐어요',
    '요청을 접수했습니다. 담당자가 확인한 뒤 진행 상황을 알려드립니다.'
  );

  return 'requested';
end;
$function$
revoke all on function public.request_order_claim(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,text,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.request_order_claim(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,text,text,text) to service_role

ledger.name: admin_sales_console_search
statements:
-- Smartstore-style sales worklists. Read-only search extensions preserve all
-- existing order/claim/shipment mutation contracts and legacy RPC signatures.
-- Date filtering uses stored business events, never payment row insertion time.
create function private.admin_sales_order_date(p_order public.orders,p_basis text)
returns timestamptz language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select case p_basis
  when 'ordered' then (p_order).created_at
  when 'confirmed' then (p_order).confirmed_at
  when 'shipped' then (p_order).shipped_at
  when 'delivered' then (p_order).delivered_at
  when 'settled' then (p_order).done_at
  when 'paid' then (
   select min(coalesce(
    (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
    (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b
      where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=(p_order).id and a.provider='bank_transfer')
   )) from public.payment_attempts a join public.payments payment on payment.id=a.payment_id
    where a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=(p_order).id and payment.purpose='order'
      and payment.ref_id=(p_order).id and a.amount=payment.amount
  ) end;
$$
revoke all on function private.admin_sales_order_date(public.orders,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.admin_validate_sales_search(p_field text,p_date_field text,p_sort text,p_payment_method text,p_from date,p_to date,p_query text)
returns void language plpgsql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
begin
 if p_field is null or p_field not in ('all','order','nickname','email','recipient','tracking','phone','product')
  or p_date_field is null or p_date_field not in ('ordered','paid','confirmed','shipped','delivered','settled')
  or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('newest','oldest','amount_high','amount_low')
  or (p_payment_method is not null and p_payment_method not in ('card','bank_transfer'))
  or (p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from>p_to) or char_length(p_query)>100 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_sales_search';
 end if;
end $$
revoke all on function private.admin_validate_sales_search(text,text,text,text,date,date,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.admin_sales_order_matches(p_order public.orders,p_from date,p_to date,p_query text,p_field text,p_date_field text,p_payment_method text)
returns boolean language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select (p_payment_method is null or (p_order).payment_method::text=p_payment_method)
  and (p_from is null or private.admin_sales_order_date(p_order,p_date_field)>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
  and (p_to is null or private.admin_sales_order_date(p_order,p_date_field)<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
  and (p_query is null
   or (p_field in ('all','order') and position(lower(p_query) in lower((p_order).id::text))>0)
   or (p_field in ('all','nickname') and exists(select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id=(p_order).user_id and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0))
   or (p_field in ('all','email') and exists(select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id=(p_order).user_id and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0))
   or (p_field in ('all','recipient') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce((p_order).address->>'recipientName','')))>0)
   or (p_field in ('all','phone') and position(nullif(regexp_replace(p_query,'[[:space:]-]','','g'),'') in regexp_replace(coalesce((p_order).address->>'phone',''),'[[:space:]-]','','g'))>0)
   or (p_field in ('all','tracking') and exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=(p_order).id
     and position(nullif(regexp_replace(lower(p_query),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),'') in lower(coalesce(s.tracking_number,'')))>0))
   or (p_field in ('all','product') and exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=(p_order).id
     and (position(lower(p_query) in lower(i.good_name_snapshot))>0
       or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(i.variant_name_snapshot,'')))>0
       or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(i.variant_code_snapshot,'')))>0)))
  );
$$
revoke all on function private.admin_sales_order_matches(public.orders,date,date,text,text,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function public.admin_search_orders_console(
  p_status text default null,
  p_from date default null,
  p_to date default null,
  p_query text default null,
  p_limit integer default 20,
  p_offset integer default 0,
  p_confirmed_before timestamptz default null,
  p_field text default 'all',
  p_date_field text default 'ordered',
  p_sort text default 'newest',
  p_payment_method text default null
)
returns table (
  id uuid,
  user_id uuid,
  buyer_name text,
  buyer_email text,
  status public.order_status,
  total bigint,
  address jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz,
  shipping_carrier text,
  tracking_number text,
  confirmed_at timestamptz,
  shipped_at timestamptz,
  delivered_at timestamptz,
  done_at timestamptz,
  cancellation_request_id uuid,
  cancellation_request_status text,
  cancellation_reason_type text,
  cancellation_requested_at timestamptz,
  cancellation_decided_at timestamptz,
  cancellation_decision_note text,
  cancellation_claim_type text,
  cancellation_stage text,
  cancellation_staff_reason_code text, cancellation_last_error_code text,
  total_count bigint
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_field text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_field), ''), 'all');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_status is not null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(enum_range(null::public.order_status)) as allowed(value)
      where allowed.value::text = p_status
    )
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order status filter';
  end if;

  perform private.admin_validate_sales_search(v_field,p_date_field,p_sort,p_payment_method,p_from,p_to,v_query);

  if v_field not in ('all', 'order', 'nickname', 'email', 'recipient', 'tracking','phone','product') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order search field';
  end if;

  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order date range';
  end if;

  if v_query is not null and length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'order search query too long';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    orders.id,
    orders.user_id,
    profile.nickname as buyer_name,
    profile.email as buyer_email,
    orders.status,
    orders.total,
    orders.address,
    orders.created_at,
    orders.updated_at,
    (select max(s.carrier)
     from public.order_shipments as s
     where s.order_id = orders.id
     having count(*) = 1),
    (select max(s.tracking_number)
     from public.order_shipments as s
     where s.order_id = orders.id
     having count(*) = 1),
    orders.confirmed_at,
    orders.shipped_at,
    orders.delivered_at,
    orders.done_at,
    cancellation.id as cancellation_request_id,
    cancellation.status as cancellation_request_status,
    cancellation.reason_type as cancellation_reason_type,
    cancellation.requested_at as cancellation_requested_at,
    cancellation.decided_at as cancellation_decided_at,
    cancellation.decision_note as cancellation_decision_note,
    cancellation.claim_type as cancellation_claim_type,
    cancellation.stage as cancellation_stage,
    cancellation.staff_reason_code as cancellation_staff_reason_code,
    cancellation.last_error_code as cancellation_last_error_code,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.orders as orders
  join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
  left join lateral (
    select
      request.id,
      request.status,
      request.reason_type,
      request.requested_at,
      request.decided_at,
      request.decision_note,
      request.claim_type,
      request.stage,
      request.staff_reason_code,
      request.last_error_code
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = orders.id
    order by request.requested_at desc, request.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as cancellation on true
  where (p_status is null or orders.status::text = p_status)
    and private.admin_sales_order_matches(orders,p_from,p_to,v_query,v_field,p_date_field,p_payment_method)
    and (p_confirmed_before is null or orders.confirmed_at < p_confirmed_before)
  order by
    case when p_sort='amount_high' then orders.total end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='amount_low' then orders.total end asc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='oldest' then private.admin_sales_order_date(orders,p_date_field) end asc nulls last,
    case when p_sort<>'oldest' then private.admin_sales_order_date(orders,p_date_field) end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='oldest' then orders.id end asc,
    orders.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$$
revoke all on function public.admin_sales_order_counts(date,date,text,text,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_sales_order_counts(date,date,text,text,text,text) to authenticated

create function private.admin_sales_claim_date(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests,p_basis text)
returns timestamptz language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select case p_basis when 'requested' then (p_claim).requested_at when 'collected' then (p_claim).collected_at when 'completed' then (p_claim).completed_at end;
$$
revoke all on function private.admin_sales_claim_date(public.order_cancellation_requests,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.admin_sales_claim_matches(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests,p_reason_type text,p_from date,p_to date,p_query text,p_field text,p_date_field text)
returns boolean language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select (p_reason_type is null or (p_reason_type not like 'staff:%' and (p_claim).reason_type=p_reason_type)
  or(p_reason_type like 'staff:%' and (p_claim).reason_type='staff' and (p_claim).staff_reason_code=substr(p_reason_type,7)))
  and (p_from is null or private.admin_sales_claim_date(p_claim,p_date_field)>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
  and (p_to is null or private.admin_sales_claim_date(p_claim,p_date_field)<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
  and (p_query is null
   or (p_field in ('all','order') and (position(lower(p_query) in lower((p_claim).order_id::text))>0 or position(lower(p_query) in (p_claim).reference::text)>0))
   or exists(select 1 from public.orders o join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id where o.id=(p_claim).order_id
    and ((p_field in ('all','buyer') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','email') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0))));
$$
revoke all on function private.admin_sales_claim_matches(public.order_cancellation_requests,text,date,date,text,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function public.admin_search_order_claims_console(
  p_claim_type text default null,
  p_stage text default null,
  p_reason_type text default null,
  p_from date default null,
  p_to date default null,
  p_query text default null,
  p_limit integer default 20,
  p_offset integer default 0,
  p_field text default 'all',
  p_date_field text default 'requested',
  p_sort text default 'newest'
)
returns table (
  id uuid,
  reference bigint,
  order_id uuid,
  claim_type text,
  stage text,
  reason_type text,
  staff_reason_code text,
  buyer_id uuid,
  buyer_name text,
  buyer_email text,
  order_status public.order_status,
  order_total bigint,
  requested_at timestamptz,
  collected_at timestamptz,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  refund_method text,
  handler_name text,
  total_count bigint
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
  v_stages text[];
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_claim_type is not null and p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type filter';
  end if;
  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim date range';
  end if;
  if v_query is not null and length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'claim search query too long';
  end if;

  if p_field is null or p_field not in ('all','order','buyer','email')
    or p_date_field is null or p_date_field not in ('requested','collected','completed')
    or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('newest','oldest','amount_high','amount_low') then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_claim_search';
  end if;

  -- 'open'은 단계 하나가 아니라 "아직 끝나지 않은 것 전부"다. 화면이 이 집합을
  -- 직접 나열하면 단계를 하나 더할 때 목록에서만 조용히 빠진다.
  if p_stage = 'open' then
    v_stages := array[
      'requested', 'in_review', 'collecting', 'collected',
      'on_hold', 'processing', 'needs_review'
    ];
  elsif p_stage is not null then
    v_stages := array[p_stage];
  end if;

  if p_reason_type is not null and p_reason_type not in('change_of_mind','defect','staff',
    'staff:out_of_stock','staff:customer_request','staff:test_payment_cleanup','staff:other') then
    raise check_violation using message='invalid claim reason filter';
  end if;
  return query
  select
    request.id,
    request.reference,
    request.order_id,
    request.claim_type,
    request.stage,
    request.reason_type,
    request.staff_reason_code,
    orders.user_id as buyer_id,
    profile.nickname as buyer_name,
    profile.email as buyer_email,
    orders.status as order_status,
    orders.total as order_total,
    request.requested_at,
    request.collected_at,
    request.completed_at,
    refund.method as refund_method,
    handler.nickname as handler_name,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  join public.orders as orders on orders.id = request.order_id
  join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
  left join public.profiles as handler on handler.id = request.decided_by
  left join lateral (
    select payment_refund.method
    from public.refunds as payment_refund
    join public.payments as payment on payment.id = payment_refund.payment_id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = request.order_id
    order by payment_refund.created_at desc, payment_refund.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as refund on true
  where (p_claim_type is null or request.claim_type = p_claim_type)
    and (v_stages is null or request.stage = any(v_stages))
    and private.admin_sales_claim_matches(request,p_reason_type,p_from,p_to,v_query,p_field,p_date_field)
  order by
    case when p_sort='amount_high' then orders.total end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='amount_low' then orders.total end asc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='oldest' then private.admin_sales_claim_date(request,p_date_field) end asc nulls last,
    case when p_sort<>'oldest' then private.admin_sales_claim_date(request,p_date_field) end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='oldest' then request.id end asc,
    request.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$$
revoke all on function public.admin_order_claim_stage_counts_console(text,text,date,date,text,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_order_claim_stage_counts_console(text,text,date,date,text,text,text) to authenticated

create function public.admin_unpaid_bank_transfer_orders_console(
  p_query text default null,
  p_limit integer default 50,
  p_offset integer default 0,
  p_state text default null,
  p_sort text default 'oldest'
)
returns table (
  order_id uuid,
  buyer_name text,
  buyer_id uuid,
  recipient_name text,
  total bigint,
  created_at timestamptz,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  extended_at timestamptz,
  deposit_code text,
  item_summary text,
  attempt_state public.payment_attempt_state,
  total_count bigint
)
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $function$
declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 200);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if (p_state is not null and p_state not in ('prepared','confirming','needs_review','unknown','missing'))
    or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('newest','oldest','amount_high','amount_low') or char_length(v_query)>100 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_unpaid_search';
  end if;
  return query
  with candidate as (
    select
      orders.id,
      orders.user_id,
      orders.total,
      orders.created_at,
      orders.expires_at,
      orders.bank_transfer_extended_at,
      private.bank_transfer_deposit_code(orders.id) as code,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(profile.nickname), ''), 'fan_' || left(orders.user_id::text, 6))
        as buyer,
      -- 안내한 입금자명은 수령인 + 주문코드다. 주소 전체가 아니라 이 한 칸만
      -- 나간다 — 대조에 필요한 것이 그것뿐이다.
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(orders.address ->> 'recipientName'), ''), '') as recipient,
      (
        select attempt.state
        from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        where attempt.purpose = 'order'
          and attempt.ref_id = orders.id
      ) as attempt_state,
      (
        select string_agg(
          item.good_name_snapshot || ' × ' || item.qty::text,
          ', '
          order by item.good_name_snapshot
        )
        from public.order_items as item
        where item.order_id = orders.id
      ) as items
    from public.orders
    left join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
    where orders.status = 'pending'
      and orders.payment_method = 'bank_transfer'
  ),
  filtered as (
    select *
    from candidate
    where (v_query is null
      or candidate.code = upper(v_query)
      or candidate.id::text = lower(v_query)
      or candidate.buyer ilike '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_query, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%')
      and (p_state is null or (p_state='missing' and candidate.attempt_state is null) or candidate.attempt_state::text=p_state)
  )
  select
    filtered.id,
    filtered.buyer,
    filtered.user_id,
    filtered.recipient,
    filtered.total,
    filtered.created_at,
    filtered.expires_at,
    filtered.bank_transfer_extended_at,
    filtered.code,
    coalesce(filtered.items, ''),
    filtered.attempt_state,
    count(*) over ()
  from filtered
  order by
    case when p_sort='amount_high' then filtered.total end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='amount_low' then filtered.total end asc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='newest' then filtered.expires_at end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort<>'newest' then filtered.expires_at end asc nulls last,
    filtered.created_at,filtered.id
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$function$
revoke all on function public.admin_unpaid_bank_transfer_orders_console(text,integer,integer,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_unpaid_bank_transfer_orders_console(text,integer,integer,text,text) to authenticated

create function public.admin_search_shipments_console(p_tab text,p_origin_id uuid default null,p_query text default null,
 p_from date default null,p_to date default null,p_limit integer default 100,p_offset integer default 0,
 p_field text default 'all',p_date_field text default 'ordered',p_method text default null,p_payment_method text default null,p_sort text default 'oldest')
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb;needle text:=nullif(btrim(p_query),'');
begin
 if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.is_staff() then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff required';end if;
 if p_tab is null or p_tab not in ('new','ready','delayed','transit','delivered') or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 1000 or p_offset is null or p_offset<0
   or length(needle)>100 or (p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from>p_to) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipment_search';end if;
 if p_field is null or p_field not in ('all','order','shipment','buyer','recipient','tracking','product')
   or p_date_field is null or p_date_field not in ('ordered','paid','confirmed','shipped','delivered')
   or (p_method is not null and p_method not in ('parcel','quick','pickup'))
   or (p_payment_method is not null and p_payment_method not in ('card','bank_transfer'))
   or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('newest','oldest','amount_high','amount_low') then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipment_search';end if;
 with matched as materialized (
  select s.*,basis.search_at,o.user_id,o.created_at order_created_at,o.confirmed_at,o.total,o.status order_status,
   coalesce(nullif(p.nickname,''),'fan_'||left(o.user_id::text,6)) buyer_name,o.address->>'recipientName' recipient_name,
   o.payment_method,coalesce((select change.reason from private.order_shipment_promise_changes change where change.shipment_id=s.id order by change.created_at desc,change.id limit 1),delay.reason) delay_reason,
   coalesce(s.expected_ship_date,delay.expected_ship_date) delay_expected_date,
   o.status='paid' and s.status='ready' is_new,
   o.status in ('confirmed','shipping') and s.status='ready' is_ready,
   o.status in ('confirmed','shipping') and s.status='ready' and case when s.original_expected_ship_date is not null
     then s.expected_ship_date<(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
     else o.confirmed_at<now()-interval '3 days' end is_delayed,
   o.status<>'canceled' and s.status='shipping' is_transit,
   o.status<>'canceled' and s.status='delivered' is_delivered
  from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
  left join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id left join public.order_dispatch_delays delay on delay.order_id=o.id
  cross join lateral (select case p_date_field when 'shipped' then s.shipped_at when 'delivered' then s.delivered_at
   else private.admin_sales_order_date(o,p_date_field) end search_at) basis
  where (p_origin_id is null or s.origin_id=p_origin_id)
    and (p_method is null or s.delivery_method=p_method)
    and (p_payment_method is null or o.payment_method::text=p_payment_method)
    and (p_from is null or basis.search_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    and (p_to is null or basis.search_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    and (needle is null
      or (p_field in ('all','shipment') and position(lower(needle) in s.id::text)>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','order') and position(lower(needle) in o.id::text)>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','buyer') and (position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0 or position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0))
      or (p_field in ('all','recipient') and position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(o.address->>'recipientName','')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','tracking') and position(nullif(regexp_replace(lower(needle),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),'') in lower(coalesce(s.tracking_number,'')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','product') and exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id
        where link.shipment_id=s.id and (position(lower(needle) in lower(i.good_name_snapshot))>0 or position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(i.variant_name_snapshot,'')))>0))))
 ), filtered as materialized (
  select * from matched where case p_tab when 'new' then is_new when 'ready' then is_ready when 'delayed' then is_delayed when 'transit' then is_transit else is_delivered end
 ), ranked as (
 select *,row_number() over(order by
  case when p_sort='amount_high' then total end desc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='amount_low' then total end asc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='oldest' then search_at end asc nulls last,
  case when p_sort<>'oldest' then search_at end desc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='oldest' then id end asc,id desc) display_order from filtered
 ), page as (select * from ranked order by display_order limit p_limit offset p_offset), output as (
 select page.*,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'name',i.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',i.variant_name_snapshot,'qty',link.qty) order by i.id)
  from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id where link.shipment_id=page.id),'[]') items from page
 ) select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from filtered),'counts',(select jsonb_build_object(
   'new',count(*) filter(where is_new),'ready',count(*) filter(where is_ready),'delayed',count(*) filter(where is_delayed),
   'transit',count(*) filter(where is_transit),'delivered',count(*) filter(where is_delivered)) from matched),
   'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'orderId',order_id,'originId',origin_id,'originName',origin_name_snapshot,
    'status',status,'createdAt',order_created_at,'confirmedAt',confirmed_at,'buyerName',buyer_name,'recipientName',recipient_name,
    'total',total,'paymentMethod',payment_method,'shippingFee',shipping_fee,'carrier',carrier,'trackingNumber',tracking_number,
    'shippedAt',shipped_at,'deliveredAt',delivered_at,'exportedAt',exported_at,'updatedAt',updated_at,
    'delayReason',delay_reason,'expectedShipDate',delay_expected_date,'originalExpectedShipDate',original_expected_ship_date,
    'preorderReady',private.shipment_preorder_allocation_ready(id),'items',items,'delivery',private.shipment_delivery_summary(id)) order by display_order) from output),'[]')) into result;
 return result;
end $$
