create function public.admin_store_analytics_report(p_from date,p_to date,p_dimension text default 'channel',p_key text default null,
 p_compare text default 'previous',p_grain text default 'day',p_query text default '',p_page integer default 1,p_page_size integer default 20)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare compare_from date;compare_to date;result jsonb;at_time timestamptz:=statement_timestamp();
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('stats.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from>p_to or p_to-p_from>=60 or p_to>(at_time at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
  or p_dimension is null or p_dimension not in ('channel','page','good','ip','category','link')
  or(p_key is not null and(length(p_key) not between 1 and 200 or p_key~'[[:cntrl:]]'))
  or p_compare is null or p_compare not in ('previous','year','none') or p_grain is null or p_grain not in ('day','week','month')
  or p_query is null or length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 100000
  or p_page_size is null or p_page_size not in (20,10000) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='analytics_invalid_filter';end if;
 if p_compare='previous' then compare_to:=p_from-1;compare_from:=p_from-(p_to-p_from+1);
 elsif p_compare='year' then compare_from:=(p_from-interval '1 year')::date;compare_to:=(p_to-interval '1 year')::date;end if;
 with periods as(select 'current'::text period,p_from date_from,p_to date_to
  union all select 'comparison',compare_from,compare_to where compare_from is not null),
 coverage_days as materialized(select p.period,d.day::date,private.store_analytics_day_coverage(d.day::date,at_time) coverage
  from periods p cross join lateral generate_series(p.date_from::timestamp,p.date_to::timestamp,interval '1 day') d(day)),
 period_coverage as(select period,count(*)::integer days,
  count(*) filter(where coverage->>'state'='observed')::integer observed_days,
  count(*) filter(where coverage->>'state' in ('collecting','partial'))::integer partial_days,
  count(*) filter(where coverage->>'state' in ('unmeasured','paused','expired','future'))::integer missing_days,
  count(*) filter(where(coverage->>'archived')::boolean)::integer archived_days,
  coalesce(sum((coverage->>'observedMinutes')::integer),0)::integer observed_minutes,
  coalesce(sum((coverage->>'expectedMinutes')::integer),0)::integer expected_minutes,
  max((coverage->>'observedUntil')::timestamptz) observed_until
  from coverage_days group by period),
 facts as materialized(select p.period,r.* from periods p cross join lateral private.store_analytics_period_rows(p.date_from,p.date_to) r),
 summary as(select p.period,private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(r.page_views)::bigint,sum(r.product_views)::bigint,sum(r.sessions)::bigint,
  sum(r.link_landings)::bigint,sum(r.orders)::bigint,sum(r.converted_sessions)::bigint,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.gross_amount),0)::bigint end,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount),0)::bigint end,
  count(r.day)>0 or c.observed_days=c.days) metrics
  from periods p join period_coverage c on c.period=p.period left join facts r on r.period=p.period
   and r.dimension=case when p_key is null then 'total' else p_dimension end and r.key=coalesce(p_key,'all')
  group by p.period,c.observed_days,c.days),
 bucket_coverage as(select period,date_trunc(p_grain,day::timestamp)::date bucket,
  bool_and(coverage->>'state'='observed') complete,bool_or((coverage->>'archived')::boolean) archived,
  array_agg(distinct coverage->>'state') states from coverage_days group by period,bucket),
 trend as(select c.period,c.bucket,c.states,c.archived,private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(r.page_views)::bigint,sum(r.product_views)::bigint,sum(r.sessions)::bigint,
  sum(r.link_landings)::bigint,sum(r.orders)::bigint,sum(r.converted_sessions)::bigint,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.gross_amount),0)::bigint end,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount),0)::bigint end,
  count(r.day)>0 or c.complete) metrics
  from bucket_coverage c left join facts r on r.period=c.period and date_trunc(p_grain,r.day::timestamp)::date=c.bucket
   and r.dimension=case when p_key is null then 'total' else p_dimension end and r.key=coalesce(p_key,'all')
  group by c.period,c.bucket,c.states,c.archived,c.complete),
 detail_keys as(select distinct key from facts where dimension=p_dimension
  union select id::text from private.marketing_links where p_dimension='link'),
 details as(select k.key,private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension,k.key) label,
  private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(f.page_views) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   sum(f.product_views) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,sum(f.sessions) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   sum(f.link_landings) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,sum(f.orders) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   sum(f.converted_sessions) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.gross_amount) filter(where f.period='current'),0)::bigint end,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.refund_amount) filter(where f.period='current'),0)::bigint end,
   count(f.day) filter(where f.period='current')>0 or(select observed_days=days from period_coverage where period='current')) metrics,
  case when compare_from is not null then private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(f.page_views) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   sum(f.product_views) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,sum(f.sessions) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   sum(f.link_landings) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,sum(f.orders) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   sum(f.converted_sessions) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.gross_amount) filter(where f.period='comparison'),0)::bigint end,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.refund_amount) filter(where f.period='comparison'),0)::bigint end,
   count(f.day) filter(where f.period='comparison')>0 or(select observed_days=days from period_coverage where period='comparison')) end comparison,
  bool_or(f.archived) archived,max(f.observed_until) observed_until
  from detail_keys k left join facts f on f.key=k.key and f.dimension=p_dimension
  where (p_key is null or k.key=p_key) and (btrim(p_query)='' or strpos(lower(private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension,k.key)),lower(btrim(p_query)))>0 or strpos(k.key,lower(btrim(p_query)))>0)
  group by k.key),
 detail_page as(select * from details order by(metrics->>'sessions')::bigint desc nulls last,label,key limit p_page_size offset(p_page-1)*p_page_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'comparisonFrom',compare_from,'comparisonTo',compare_to,
  'dimension',p_dimension,'selectedKey',p_key,'selectedLabel',case when p_key is not null then private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension,p_key) end,
  'summary',(select metrics from summary where period='current'),'comparison',(select metrics from summary where period='comparison'),
  'coverage',(select to_jsonb(c)-'period' from period_coverage c where period='current'),
  'comparisonCoverage',(select to_jsonb(c)-'period' from period_coverage c where period='comparison'),
  'trend',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',bucket,'metrics',metrics,'states',states,'archived',archived) order by bucket) from trend where period='current'),'[]'),
  'comparisonTrend',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',bucket,'metrics',metrics,'states',states,'archived',archived) order by bucket) from trend where period='comparison'),'[]'),
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',key,'label',label,'metrics',metrics,'comparison',comparison,'archived',coalesce(archived,false),'observedUntil',observed_until)
   order by(metrics->>'sessions')::bigint desc nulls last,label,key) from detail_page),'[]'),'total',(select count(*) from details),
  'collection',(select jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'startedAt',activated_at,'noticeVersion',notice_version,
   'lastHeartbeatAt',(select max(observed_at) from private.store_analytics_health),'rawRetentionDays',90,'aggregateRetentionMonths',13,
   'retentionBacklog',(select count(*) from private.store_analytics_sessions where created_at<(((at_time at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date-89)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')))
   from private.store_analytics_settings where id),'observedAt',at_time,'advertisingCost',null,'roas',null)
 into result;
 return result;
end $$

ledger.name: order_claim_withdrawal
statements:
-- A customer's withdrawal closes the request, never the order or its payment.
-- Keep the legacy rejected status projection while distinguishing its terminal stage.
alter table public.order_cancellation_requests
 add column claim_revision integer not null default 0 check(claim_revision>=0),
 add column withdrawn_at timestamptz
alter table public.order_cancellation_requests drop constraint order_cancellation_requests_stage_check

alter table public.order_cancellation_requests add constraint order_cancellation_requests_stage_check
 check(stage in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected','on_hold','processing','needs_review','completed','rejected','withdrawn'))
alter table public.order_cancellation_requests drop constraint order_cancellation_requests_stage_projection_check

alter table public.order_cancellation_requests add constraint order_cancellation_requests_stage_projection_check
 check(case stage when 'processing' then status='processing' when 'needs_review' then status='needs_review'
 when 'completed' then status='completed' when 'rejected' then status='rejected' when 'withdrawn' then status='rejected' else status='requested' end)

alter table public.order_cancellation_requests add constraint order_claim_withdrawn_time_check
 check((stage='withdrawn')=(withdrawn_at is not null))

create or replace function private.order_claim_status_for_stage(p_stage text) returns text
language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select case p_stage when 'processing' then 'processing' when 'needs_review' then 'needs_review'
 when 'completed' then 'completed' when 'rejected' then 'rejected' when 'withdrawn' then 'rejected' else 'requested' end;
$$

 order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id) on delete cascade, actor_id uuid not null,
 actor_kind text not null check(actor_kind in('customer','operator')), expected_revision integer not null,
 reason text not null check(char_length(reason) between 2 and 500), from_stage text not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create function private.order_claim_withdrawal_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests) returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case
  when p_claim.stage='withdrawn' then 'claim_already_withdrawn'
  when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then coalesce(p_claim.held_from,'requested') else p_claim.stage end) not in('requested','in_review','collecting') then 'claim_withdrawal_started'
  when p_claim.collected_at is not null or p_claim.reshipped_at is not null
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_collections where claim_id=p_claim.id and collected_at is not null)
   or exists(select 1 from private.seller_order_claim_intakes intake cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(intake.payload->'collections') item
    where intake.claim_id=p_claim.id and item->>'method'='customer_sent') then 'claim_withdrawal_collection_started'
  when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
   or exists(select 1 from public.refunds refund join public.payments payment on payment.id=refund.payment_id where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
   or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_withdrawal_finance_started'
  else null end;
$$

-- Keep withdrawn requests out of the open/rejected statistics.

create or replace function public.admin_claims_report(
  p_from timestamptz,
  p_to timestamptz
)
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $function$
declare
  v_order_count bigint;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('stats.read',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to <= p_from then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_report_range';
  end if;

  select count(*)
  into v_order_count
  from public.orders
  where orders.status = any (private.revenue_order_statuses())
    and orders.created_at >= p_from
    and orders.created_at < p_to;

  with scoped as (
    select
      request.id,
      request.claim_type,
      request.reason_type,
      request.staff_reason_code,
      request.stage,
      request.requested_at,
      request.completed_at
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.requested_at >= p_from
      and request.requested_at < p_to
  ),
  by_type as (
    select
      scoped.claim_type,
      count(*) as total,
      count(*) filter (where scoped.stage = 'completed') as completed,
      count(*) filter (where scoped.stage = 'rejected') as rejected,
      count(*) filter (where scoped.stage = 'withdrawn') as withdrawn,
      count(*) filter (where scoped.stage not in ('completed', 'rejected', 'withdrawn')) as open_count
    from scoped
    group by scoped.claim_type
  ),
  -- 운영자 전액 취소는 운영 사유별로 나눈다. 구매자 사유 행의 staff_reason_code는
  -- 항상 null이라 기존 묶음은 그대로다.
  by_reason as (
    select
      scoped.claim_type,
      scoped.reason_type,
      scoped.staff_reason_code,
      count(*) as total
    from scoped
    group by scoped.claim_type, scoped.reason_type, scoped.staff_reason_code
  ),
  -- 환급 소요시간은 접수(requested_at)부터 환불 완료(completed_at)까지다.
  -- 배송·반품 정책이 약속한 "반환받은 날부터 3영업일"과 기산점이 다르므로
  -- 화면에서 SLA 준수율이라고 부르지 않고 접수→완료 소요로 적는다.
  refund_speed as (
    select
      count(*) as completed_count,
      avg(extract(epoch from (refund.completed_at - scoped.requested_at)) / 3600.0) as avg_hours,
      count(*) filter (
        where refund.completed_at - scoped.requested_at <= interval '72 hours'
      ) as within_72h
    from public.refunds as refund
    join scoped on scoped.id = refund.cancellation_request_id
    -- refunds.status는 'requested|done|failed'다. 'completed'는 클레임 stage의
    -- 값이라 여기서 쓰면 항상 0건이 된다.
    where refund.status = 'done'
      and refund.completed_at is not null
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'orderCount', v_order_count,
    'claimCount', coalesce((select sum(by_type.total) from by_type), 0),
    'byType', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'claimType', by_type.claim_type,
          'total', by_type.total,
          'completed', by_type.completed,
          'rejected', by_type.rejected,
          'withdrawn', by_type.withdrawn,
          'open', by_type.open_count,
          -- 분모가 0이면 비율이 아니라 null이다. 0%로 적으면 "클레임이 없다"로
          -- 읽히지만 실제로는 "판매가 없었다"이다.
          'ratePerMille', case
            when v_order_count = 0 then null
            else round((by_type.total::numeric / v_order_count) * 1000, 1)
          end
        )
        order by by_type.total desc, by_type.claim_type
      )
      from by_type
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'byReason', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'claimType', by_reason.claim_type,
          'reasonType', by_reason.reason_type,
          'staffReasonCode', by_reason.staff_reason_code,
          'total', by_reason.total
        )
        order by by_reason.claim_type, by_reason.total desc, by_reason.reason_type,
          by_reason.staff_reason_code nulls first
      )
      from by_reason
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'refunds', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'completedCount', refund_speed.completed_count,
        'averageHours', case
          when refund_speed.avg_hours is null then null
          else round(refund_speed.avg_hours::numeric, 1)
        end,
        'within72h', refund_speed.within_72h
      )
      from refund_speed
    )
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

-- Search the same localized channel/page labels that operators see.
create or replace function private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension text,p_key text) returns text
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select case p_dimension
  when 'total' then '전체'
  when 'channel' then concat(
   case split_part(p_key,'/',1) when 'direct' then '직접·출처 미확인' when 'search' then '검색' when 'social' then '소셜'
    when 'email' then '이메일' when 'paid' then '유료 캠페인 표기' when 'referral' then '기타 외부' when 'internal' then '스토어 내부' else '기타' end,
   ' · ',case split_part(p_key,'/',2) when 'none' then '출처 없음' when 'google' then 'Google' when 'naver' then '네이버'
    when 'bing' then 'Bing' when 'daum' then '다음' when 'instagram' then 'Instagram' when 'facebook' then 'Facebook'
    when 'youtube' then 'YouTube' when 'kakao' then '카카오' when 'x' then 'X' when 'threads' then 'Threads'
    when 'email' then '이메일' when 'icons' then 'ICONS' else '기타' end,
   case split_part(p_key,'/',3) when 'cpc' then ' / CPC' when 'paid_social' then ' / 유료 소셜' else '' end)
  when 'page' then case p_key when 'home' then '스토어 홈' when 'shop' then '상품 목록' when 'good' then '상품 상세'
   when 'stories' then '쇼핑스토리 목록' when 'story' then '쇼핑스토리' when 'ip' then 'IP'
   when 'events' then '이벤트 목록' when 'event' then '이벤트 상세' else p_key end
  when 'good' then coalesce((select name from public.goods where id=p_key),'보관된 상품')
  when 'ip' then coalesce((select title from public.ips where id=p_key),'보관된 IP')
  when 'category' then coalesce((select name from public.catalog_categories where id::text=p_key),'보관된 카테고리')
  when 'link' then coalesce((select coalesce(g.name,s.title,c.name,l.original_title) from private.marketing_links l
   left join public.goods g on g.id=l.good_id left join public.shopping_stories s on s.id=l.story_id
   left join public.catalog_categories c on c.id=l.category_id where l.id::text=p_key),'보관된 링크')
  else p_key end;
$$

-- Financial facts come only from the existing service-finalized ledger. No
-- callback, client event or guessed order timestamp can create a conversion.
create or replace function private.store_analytics_paid_orders(p_from timestamptz,p_until timestamptz)
returns table(order_id uuid,session_id uuid,bound_at timestamptz,channel text,source text,medium text,link_id uuid,page_kind text,
 paid_at timestamptz,gross_amount bigint,refund_amount bigint)
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select b.order_id,b.session_id,b.bound_at,b.channel,b.source,b.medium,b.link_id,b.page_kind,
  proof.confirmed_at,p.amount,coalesce((select sum(r.amount) from public.refunds r where r.payment_id=p.id and r.status='done'),0)::bigint
 from private.store_analytics_order_bindings b join private.store_analytics_sessions s on s.id=b.session_id and s.revoked_at is null
 join public.orders o on o.id=b.order_id
 join public.payment_attempts a on a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id and a.user_id=o.user_id and a.state in ('approved','canceled')
 join public.payments p on p.id=a.payment_id and p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.user_id=o.user_id
  and p.provider=a.provider and p.amount=a.amount and p.amount=o.total and p.amount>0 and p.status in ('paid','canceled','refunded')
 join lateral(select min(coalesce(e.approved_at,e.recorded_at)) as confirmed_at from private.payment_provider_evidence e
  where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id and e.evidence_kind='confirm_approved') proof on proof.confirmed_at>=b.bound_at and proof.confirmed_at<b.bound_at+interval '7 days'
 where s.created_at>=p_from and s.created_at<p_until and ((a.provider in ('toss','korpay') and o.payment_method='card')
   or(a.provider='bank_transfer' and o.payment_method='bank_transfer'
    and exists(select 1 from public.bank_transfer_confirmations confirmation where confirmation.order_id=o.id and confirmation.attempt_id=a.id)));
$$

 from_type text not null check(from_type in('return','exchange')),
 to_type text not null check(to_type in('return','exchange') and to_type<>from_type),
 agreement text not null check(char_length(agreement) between 2 and 500),

create function private.order_claim_type_change_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests) returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case
 when p_claim.claim_type not in('return','exchange') then 'claim_conversion_type_unavailable'
 when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then coalesce(p_claim.held_from,'requested') else p_claim.stage end)
  not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected') then 'claim_conversion_stage_unavailable'
 when p_claim.reshipped_at is not null or p_claim.reship_tracking_number is not null
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipment_items where claim_id=p_claim.id) then 'claim_conversion_reshipped'
 when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_conversion_finance_started'
 else null end;
$$

create function public.service_cancel_goods_media_upload(p_actor_id uuid,p_id uuid) returns boolean
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
 if p_actor_id is null then return false;end if;
 -- A verifier may finish its Storage upload after an expired processing lease
 -- was already cleaned. Re-open that same owned claim for another cleanup.
 -- This is used only after a confirmed rejection, never an unknown receipt.
 update private.goods_media_assets set status='rejected',expires_at=clock_timestamp(),cleanup_claimed_at=null,cleanup_completed_at=null where id=p_id and actor_id=p_actor_id and status in('pending','processing','verified','rejected','cleanup','cleaned')
  and not exists(select 1 from private.goods_media_bindings b where b.video_asset_id=p_id or b.shortclip_asset_id=p_id);
 return found;
end $$

-- supply. Public browsing stays available; only new purchase entry points close.

 add column sale_period_revision integer not null default 0 check(sale_period_revision>=0),

  (sale_starts_at is null and sale_ends_at is null)
  or (sale_starts_at is not null and sale_ends_at is not null and isfinite(sale_starts_at)
   and isfinite(sale_ends_at) and sale_starts_at<sale_ends_at))

create function private.goods_sale_period_json(good public.goods,p_at timestamptz) returns jsonb
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('startsAt',good.sale_starts_at,'endsAt',good.sale_ends_at,
  'state',case when good.sale_starts_at is null then 'unlimited' when p_at<good.sale_starts_at then 'scheduled'
   when p_at>=good.sale_ends_at then 'ended' else 'open' end,
  'calculatedAt',p_at,'nextChangeAt',case when p_at<good.sale_starts_at then good.sale_starts_at
   when p_at<good.sale_ends_at then good.sale_ends_at else null end);
$$
revoke all on function private.goods_sale_period_json(public.goods,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$

 from public.goods current_good join public.ips ip on ip.id=current_good.ip_id
 where current_good.id=good.id and current_good.published_at is not null and current_good.archived_at is null
  and current_good.sale_restriction='none' and ip.published_at is not null and ip.archived_at is null;
$$

create function private.assert_order_goods_sale_period(p_order_id uuid) returns void
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare current_at timestamptz;begin
 -- Lock every product before sampling one common instant. An earlier product
 -- can expire naturally while this transaction waits for a later product lock.
 perform g.id from public.goods g where exists(select 1 from public.order_items i
  where i.order_id=p_order_id and i.good_id=g.id) order by g.id for share;
 current_at:=clock_timestamp();
 if exists(select 1 from public.order_items i join public.goods g on g.id=i.good_id
  where i.order_id=p_order_id and g.sale_starts_at is not null
   and (current_at<g.sale_starts_at or current_at>=g.sale_ends_at)) then
  raise check_violation using message='goods_sale_not_open';end if;
end $$

-- Read-only PG reconciliation. No checkout, refund, inventory, or bank state
-- is changed. Two complete scans must agree before a snapshot is published.
create table private.pg_settlement_imports (
 id uuid primary key default extensions.gen_random_uuid(), operation_id uuid not null unique, actor_id uuid not null,
 provider text not null default 'toss' check(provider='toss'), mode text not null check(mode in('test','live')),
 scope_hash text not null check(scope_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), mid text not null,
 date_type text not null check(date_type in('soldDate','paidOutDate')), start_date date not null,end_date date not null,
 state text not null default 'collecting' check(state in('collecting','verifying','complete','failed')),
 scan integer not null default 1 check(scan in(1,2)), next_page integer not null default 1 check(next_page between 1 and 21),
 record_count integer not null default 0 check(record_count between 0 and 20000), source_count integer not null default 0 check(source_count between 0 and 40000),
 claim_id uuid, lease_until timestamptz,error_code text,
 started_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),completed_at timestamptz,
 check(end_date between start_date and start_date+30),check((claim_id is null)=(lease_until is null)),
 check((state='complete')=(completed_at is not null)),check(char_length(mid) between 1 and 14)
)
create index pg_settlement_imports_query_idx on private.pg_settlement_imports(mode,date_type,start_date,end_date,completed_at desc) where state='complete'

create table private.pg_settlement_pages (
 import_id uuid not null references private.pg_settlement_imports(id),scan integer not null,page integer not null,
 claim_id uuid not null unique,source_count integer not null,record_count integer not null,
 source_hash text not null,records_hash text not null,input_hash text not null,terminal boolean not null,
 collected_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),primary key(import_id,scan,page)
)

create table private.pg_settlement_source_keys (
 import_id uuid not null references private.pg_settlement_imports(id),scan integer not null,transaction_key text not null,
 primary key(import_id,scan,transaction_key)
)

create table private.pg_settlement_records (
 id uuid primary key default extensions.gen_random_uuid(),import_id uuid not null references private.pg_settlement_imports(id),
 transaction_key text not null,record jsonb not null,record_hash text not null,verified boolean not null default false,
 kind text not null check(kind in('approval','cancel')),currency text not null,sold_date date not null,paid_out_date date not null,
 match_state text not null default 'unlinked' check(match_state in('matched','unlinked','mismatch')),
 match_reason text not null default 'payment_not_found',purpose text,reference_id uuid,order_number text,
 unique(import_id,transaction_key)
)

ledger.name: shipment_delay_notice_filter
statements:
-- Read-only delivery-result filters; transmission/retry contracts stay intact.
-- Latest requested notice per shipment: a newer preview is not a customer notice.
create index order_delay_notice_targets_shipments_gin on private.order_delay_notice_targets using gin(shipment_ids)

create function private.shipment_delay_notice_summary(p_shipment_id uuid)
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 with latest as (
  select n.id,n.requested_at,t.in_app_status,t.email_status,i.state provider_state
  from private.order_delay_notice_targets t
  join private.order_delay_notices n on n.id=t.notice_id and n.requested_at is not null
  join public.order_shipments s on s.id=p_shipment_id and s.order_id=t.order_id
  left join private.email_intents i on i.id=t.email_intent_id
  where t.shipment_ids @> array[p_shipment_id]
  order by n.requested_at desc,n.id desc,t.id desc limit 1
 ), effective as (
  select *,case when provider_state in ('accepted','sent','delivered','delayed') then 'sent'
   when provider_state in ('bounced','complained','failed') then 'failed'
   when provider_state='suppressed' then 'suppressed'
   when provider_state in ('unknown','needs_review') then 'unknown'
   when provider_state='queued' then 'queued'
   when provider_state='dispatching' then 'processing' else email_status end effective_email
  from latest
 ) select coalesce((select jsonb_build_object(
  'status',case when in_app_status='sent' and effective_email='sent' then 'sent'
    when effective_email='unknown' then 'unknown'
    when in_app_status='sent' and effective_email in ('failed','suppressed') then 'partial_failed'
    when effective_email in ('prepared','queued','processing') then 'pending' else 'unknown' end,
  'noticeId',id,'requestedAt',requested_at,'inAppStatus',in_app_status,
  'emailStatus',effective_email,'emailProviderState',provider_state) from effective),
  jsonb_build_object('status','not_sent','noticeId',null,'requestedAt',null,'inAppStatus',null,'emailStatus',null,'emailProviderState',null));
$$
revoke all on function private.shipment_delay_notice_summary(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function public.admin_search_shipments_notice_console(p_tab text,p_origin_id uuid default null,p_query text default null,
 p_from date default null,p_to date default null,p_limit integer default 100,p_offset integer default 0,
 p_field text default 'all',p_date_field text default 'ordered',p_method text default null,p_payment_method text default null,p_sort text default 'oldest',p_delay_notice_status text default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb;needle text:=nullif(btrim(p_query),'');
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_tab is null or p_tab not in ('new','ready','delayed','transit','delivered') or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 1000 or p_offset is null or p_offset<0
   or length(needle)>100 or (p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from>p_to) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipment_search';end if;
 if (p_delay_notice_status is not null and p_delay_notice_status not in ('sent','partial_failed','pending','unknown','not_sent'))
   or p_field is null or p_field not in ('all','order','shipment','buyer','recipient','tracking','product')
   or p_date_field is null or p_date_field not in ('ordered','paid','confirmed','shipped','delivered')
   or (p_method is not null and p_method not in ('parcel','quick','pickup'))
   or (p_payment_method is not null and p_payment_method not in ('card','bank_transfer'))
   or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('newest','oldest','amount_high','amount_low') then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipment_search';end if;
 with matched as materialized (
  select s.*,private.shipment_delay_notice_summary(s.id) delay_notice_summary,basis.search_at,o.user_id,o.created_at order_created_at,o.confirmed_at,o.total,o.status order_status,
   coalesce(nullif(p.nickname,''),'fan_'||left(o.user_id::text,6)) buyer_name,o.address->>'recipientName' recipient_name,
   o.payment_method,coalesce((select change.reason from private.order_shipment_promise_changes change where change.shipment_id=s.id order by change.created_at desc,change.id limit 1),delay.reason) delay_reason,
   coalesce(s.expected_ship_date,delay.expected_ship_date) delay_expected_date,
   o.status='paid' and s.status='ready' is_new,
   o.status in ('confirmed','shipping') and s.status='ready' is_ready,
   o.status in ('confirmed','shipping') and s.status='ready' and case when s.original_expected_ship_date is not null
     then s.expected_ship_date<(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
     else o.confirmed_at<now()-interval '3 days' end is_delayed,
   o.status<>'canceled' and s.status='shipping' is_transit,
   o.status<>'canceled' and s.status='delivered' is_delivered
  from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
  left join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id left join public.order_dispatch_delays delay on delay.order_id=o.id
  cross join lateral (select case p_date_field when 'shipped' then s.shipped_at when 'delivered' then s.delivered_at
   else private.admin_sales_order_date(o,p_date_field) end search_at) basis
  where (p_origin_id is null or s.origin_id=p_origin_id)
    and (p_method is null or s.delivery_method=p_method)
    and (p_payment_method is null or o.payment_method::text=p_payment_method)
    and (p_from is null or basis.search_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    and (p_to is null or basis.search_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    and (needle is null
      or (p_field in ('all','shipment') and position(lower(needle) in s.id::text)>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','order') and position(lower(needle) in o.id::text)>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','buyer') and (position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0 or position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0))
      or (p_field in ('all','recipient') and position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(o.address->>'recipientName','')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','tracking') and position(nullif(regexp_replace(lower(needle),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),'') in lower(coalesce(s.tracking_number,'')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','product') and exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id
        where link.shipment_id=s.id and (position(lower(needle) in lower(i.good_name_snapshot))>0 or position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(i.variant_name_snapshot,'')))>0))))
 ), notice_matched as materialized (
  select * from matched where p_delay_notice_status is null or delay_notice_summary->>'status'=p_delay_notice_status
 ), filtered as materialized (
  select * from notice_matched where case p_tab when 'new' then is_new when 'ready' then is_ready when 'delayed' then is_delayed when 'transit' then is_transit else is_delivered end
 ), ranked as (
 select *,row_number() over(order by
  case when p_sort='amount_high' then total end desc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='amount_low' then total end asc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='oldest' then search_at end asc nulls last,
  case when p_sort<>'oldest' then search_at end desc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='oldest' then id end asc,id desc) display_order from filtered
 ), page as (select * from ranked order by display_order limit p_limit offset p_offset), output as (
 select page.*,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'name',i.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',i.variant_name_snapshot,'qty',link.qty) order by i.id)
  from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id where link.shipment_id=page.id),'[]') items from page
 ) select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from filtered),'counts',(select jsonb_build_object(
   'new',count(*) filter(where is_new),'ready',count(*) filter(where is_ready),'delayed',count(*) filter(where is_delayed),
   'transit',count(*) filter(where is_transit),'delivered',count(*) filter(where is_delivered)) from notice_matched),
   'delayNoticeFingerprint',(select encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'notice',delay_notice_summary) order by id)::text,'[]'),'sha256'),'hex') from filtered),
   'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'orderId',order_id,'originId',origin_id,'originName',origin_name_snapshot,
    'status',status,'createdAt',order_created_at,'confirmedAt',confirmed_at,'buyerName',buyer_name,'recipientName',recipient_name,
    'total',total,'paymentMethod',payment_method,'shippingFee',shipping_fee,'carrier',carrier,'trackingNumber',tracking_number,
    'shippedAt',shipped_at,'deliveredAt',delivered_at,'exportedAt',exported_at,'updatedAt',updated_at,
    'delayReason',delay_reason,'expectedShipDate',delay_expected_date,'originalExpectedShipDate',original_expected_ship_date,
    'preorderReady',private.shipment_preorder_allocation_ready(id),'delayNotice',delay_notice_summary,'items',private.with_order_item_custom_inputs(items),'delivery',private.shipment_delivery_summary(id)) order by display_order) from output),'[]')) into result;
 return result;
end $$
revoke all on function public.admin_search_shipments_notice_console(text,uuid,text,date,date,integer,integer,text,text,text,text,text,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_search_shipments_notice_console(text,uuid,text,date,date,integer,integer,text,text,text,text,text,text) to authenticated

select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_search_shipments_notice_console(text,uuid,text,date,date,integer,integer,text,text,text,text,text,text)'::regprocedure,'sales.manage','read',false)

-- Read-only worklist gaps: preserve order/payment/claim mutation contracts.
-- The paid date is the existing provider approval or bank-confirmation event.
create or replace function private.admin_sales_claim_date(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests,p_basis text)
returns timestamptz language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select case p_basis
  when 'requested' then (p_claim).requested_at
  when 'collected' then (p_claim).collected_at
  when 'completed' then (p_claim).completed_at
  when 'paid' then (select private.admin_sales_order_date(o,'paid') from public.orders o where o.id=(p_claim).order_id)
 end;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_order_claims_console(p_claim_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_stage text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_reason_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_field text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_date_field text DEFAULT 'requested'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, reference bigint, order_id uuid, claim_type text, stage text, reason_type text, staff_reason_code text, buyer_id uuid, buyer_name text, buyer_email text, order_status order_status, order_total bigint, requested_at timestamp with time zone, collected_at timestamp with time zone, completed_at timestamp with time zone, refund_method text, handler_name text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
  v_stages text[];
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_claim_type is not null and p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type filter';
  end if;
  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim date range';
  end if;
  if v_query is not null and length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'claim search query too long';
  end if;

  if p_field is null or p_field not in ('all','order','buyer','email')
    or p_date_field is null or p_date_field not in ('requested','paid','collected','completed')
    or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('newest','oldest','amount_high','amount_low') then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_claim_search';
  end if;

  -- 'open'은 단계 하나가 아니라 "아직 끝나지 않은 것 전부"다. 화면이 이 집합을
  -- 직접 나열하면 단계를 하나 더할 때 목록에서만 조용히 빠진다.
  if p_stage = 'open' then
    v_stages := array[
      'requested', 'in_review', 'collecting', 'collected',
      'on_hold', 'processing', 'needs_review'
    ];
  elsif p_stage is not null then
    v_stages := array[p_stage];
  end if;

  if p_reason_type is not null and p_reason_type not in('change_of_mind','defect','staff',
    'staff:out_of_stock','staff:customer_request','staff:test_payment_cleanup','staff:other') then
    raise check_violation using message='invalid claim reason filter';
  end if;
  return query
  select
    request.id,
    request.reference,
    request.order_id,
    request.claim_type,
    request.stage,
    request.reason_type,
    request.staff_reason_code,
    orders.user_id as buyer_id,
    profile.nickname as buyer_name,
    profile.email as buyer_email,
    orders.status as order_status,
    orders.total as order_total,
    request.requested_at,
    request.collected_at,
    request.completed_at,
    refund.method as refund_method,
    handler.nickname as handler_name,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  join public.orders as orders on orders.id = request.order_id
  join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
  left join public.profiles as handler on handler.id = request.decided_by
  left join lateral (
    select payment_refund.method
    from public.refunds as payment_refund
    join public.payments as payment on payment.id = payment_refund.payment_id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = request.order_id
    order by payment_refund.created_at desc, payment_refund.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as refund on true
  where (p_claim_type is null or request.claim_type = p_claim_type)
    and (v_stages is null or request.stage = any(v_stages))
    and private.admin_sales_claim_matches(request,p_reason_type,p_from,p_to,v_query,p_field,p_date_field)
  order by
    case when p_sort='amount_high' then orders.total end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='amount_low' then orders.total end asc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='oldest' then private.admin_sales_claim_date(request,p_date_field) end asc nulls last,
    case when p_sort<>'oldest' then private.admin_sales_claim_date(request,p_date_field) end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='oldest' then request.id end asc,
    request.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$function$

-- Keep the historical date-only collector unchanged for existing callers.
create function private.collect_settled_export_for_search(p_from date,p_to date,p_query text,p_date_field text,p_field text)
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 with selected as materialized (
  select o.* from public.orders o join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id
  where o.status='done'
   and private.admin_sales_order_matches(o,p_from,p_to,p_query,p_field,p_date_field,null)
  order by o.created_at desc,o.id desc limit 1001
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',1,'capturedAt',statement_timestamp(),'orders',coalesce(jsonb_agg(
  jsonb_build_object(
   'id',o.id,'createdAt',o.created_at,'doneAt',o.done_at,'total',o.total,'shippingFee',o.shipping_fee,
   'couponDiscount',o.discount_total,'storeCredits',o.store_credit_total,
   'coupon',(
    select jsonb_build_object('code',r.coupon_code,'discountAmount',r.discount_amount,'eligibleSubtotal',r.eligible_subtotal,'terms',r.terms_snapshot)
    from public.coupon_redemptions r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status='applied'
   ),
   'payments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',payment.id,'amount',payment.amount,'status',payment.status,'provider',payment.provider,
    'approvedAt',approval.approved_at,
    'timeSource',case when approval.approved_at is null then null when payment.provider='bank_transfer' then 'bank_confirmation' else 'provider_approval' end
   ) order by payment.id)
    from public.payments payment left join lateral (
     select coalesce(
      (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
      (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id and a.provider='bank_transfer')
     ) as approved_at
     from public.payment_attempts a where a.payment_id=payment.id and a.purpose='order'
      and a.ref_id=o.id and a.state='approved' and a.amount=payment.amount
    ) approval on true
    where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=o.id and payment.status in('paid','refunded')),'[]'),
   'shipments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',s.id,'trackingNumber',s.tracking_number,'shippingFee',s.shipping_fee,'status',s.status
   ) order by s.id) from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id),'[]'),
   'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',item.id,'goodId',item.good_id,'variantId',item.variant_id,'goodName',item.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',item.variant_name_snapshot,
    'qty',item.qty,'unitPrice',item.unit_price,'regularUnitPrice',item.regular_unit_price_snapshot,
    'shipmentId',assignment.shipment_id,
    'erpCode',identity.erp_code,'erpName',identity.erp_name,'barcode',identity.barcode,'erpCapturedAt',identity.captured_at
   ) order by assignment.shipment_id nulls last,item.id)
    from public.order_items item left join public.order_shipment_items assignment on assignment.order_item_id=item.id and assignment.order_id=o.id
    left join private.order_item_external_identity_snapshots identity on identity.order_item_id=item.id
    where item.order_id=o.id),'[]')
  ) order by o.created_at desc,o.id desc),'[]')) from selected o;
$$

-- Extend existing claim worklist reads; preserve order-wide processing.

create or replace function private.admin_sales_claim_matches(
 p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests,p_reason_type text,p_from date,p_to date,
 p_query text,p_field text,p_date_field text
) returns boolean language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select (p_reason_type is null or (p_reason_type not like 'staff:%' and (p_claim).reason_type=p_reason_type)
  or(p_reason_type like 'staff:%' and (p_claim).reason_type='staff' and (p_claim).staff_reason_code=substr(p_reason_type,7)))
  and (p_from is null or private.admin_sales_claim_date(p_claim,p_date_field)>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
  and (p_to is null or private.admin_sales_claim_date(p_claim,p_date_field)<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
  and (p_query is null
   or (p_field in ('all','order') and (position(lower(p_query) in lower((p_claim).order_id::text))>0
     or position(lower(p_query) in (p_claim).reference::text)>0))
   or exists(select 1 from public.orders o join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id where o.id=(p_claim).order_id
    and ((p_field in ('all','buyer') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','email') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','recipient') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(o.address->>'recipientName','')))>0)))
   -- IDs use literal, case-insensitive contains like the existing order/item list.
   -- A matching item selects its whole claim; multiple matches never duplicate it.
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=(p_claim).order_id
    and ((p_field in ('all','item') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(i.id::text))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','product') and position(lower(p_query) in lower(i.good_id))>0))));
$$

statements:
-- Validated in a disposable clone and independently reviewed before local application.
-- Payment-time goods cohorts are separate from the existing customer dashboard.
create function private.admin_customer_purchase_payment_times()
returns table(order_id uuid,paid_at timestamptz)
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 -- Set-based equivalent of admin_sales_order_date(order,'paid'). Keep the
 -- inner provider MIN, per-attempt bank fallback and outer MIN in that order.
 -- Current payment/order status is intentionally absent: refunds retain history.
 -- The matching fields stay inside CASE: filtering three correlated join keys
 -- made the planner estimate one match and repeatedly aggregate all evidence.
 with provider_times as materialized (
  select evidence.payment_attempt_id,min(evidence.approved_at) approved_at
  from private.payment_provider_evidence evidence group by evidence.payment_attempt_id
 )
 select attempt.ref_id,min(case
  when payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=attempt.ref_id and payment.amount=attempt.amount
   then coalesce(provider.approved_at,bank.confirmed_at)
  end)
 from public.payment_attempts attempt join public.payments payment on payment.id=attempt.payment_id
 left join provider_times provider on provider.payment_attempt_id=attempt.id
 left join public.bank_transfer_confirmations bank on bank.attempt_id=attempt.id
  and bank.order_id=attempt.ref_id and attempt.provider='bank_transfer'
 where attempt.purpose='order'
 group by attempt.ref_id;
$$
alter function private.admin_customer_purchase_payment_times() owner to postgres
revoke all on function private.admin_customer_purchase_payment_times() from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function public.admin_customer_purchase_report(
 p_grain text,p_from date,p_to date,p_compare_from date default null,p_compare_to date default null
)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare
 today_kst date:=(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date;
 current_period_start date;
 trend_last_start date;
 trend_step interval;
 selected_range record;
 result jsonb;
begin
 perform private.require_operator_capability('stats.read',false);
 if p_grain is null or p_grain not in ('week','month') or p_from is null or p_to is null
  or (p_compare_from is null)<>(p_compare_to is null) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_purchase_range';
 end if;
 current_period_start:=date_trunc(p_grain,today_kst::timestamp)::date;
 for selected_range in
  select p_from as range_from,p_to as range_to
  union all select p_compare_from,p_compare_to where p_compare_from is not null
 loop
  if not isfinite(selected_range.range_from) or not isfinite(selected_range.range_to)
   or selected_range.range_from<date '2010-01-01' or selected_range.range_from>selected_range.range_to
   or selected_range.range_to>=current_period_start then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_purchase_range';
  end if;
  if selected_range.range_to-selected_range.range_from+1>366
   or selected_range.range_from<>date_trunc(p_grain,selected_range.range_from::timestamp)::date
   or selected_range.range_to+1<>date_trunc(p_grain,(selected_range.range_to+1)::timestamp)::date then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_purchase_range';
  end if;
 end loop;

 -- Input validation ensures the inclusive end completes the selected grain.
 -- Weeks show 13 complete Monday-Sunday weeks; months show 13 calendar months.
 trend_last_start:=date_trunc(p_grain,p_to::timestamp)::date;
 trend_step:=case when p_grain='week' then interval '1 week' else interval '1 month' end;

 with periods as materialized (
  select 'current'::text period_kind,0 period_order,p_from range_from,p_to range_to
  union all select 'comparison',1,p_compare_from,p_compare_to where p_compare_from is not null
  union all select 'trend',2+series.n,
   (trend_last_start+(series.n-12)*trend_step)::date,
   (trend_last_start+(series.n-11)*trend_step-interval '1 day')::date
  from generate_series(0,12) series(n)
 ), bounds as (
  select (min(range_from)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')-interval '4320 hours' earliest_history,
   ((max(range_to)+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') latest_end from periods
 ), order_dates as materialized (
  -- Reuse the provider approval/bank confirmation contract. Do not infer the
  -- event from orders.created_at, payments.created_at, or a current status.
  select purchase.id,purchase.user_id,purchase.status,purchase.created_at,
   purchase.total,purchase.shipping_fee,purchase.discount_total,purchase.store_credit_total,
   payment_time.paid_at
  from public.orders purchase
  left join private.admin_customer_purchase_payment_times() payment_time on payment_time.order_id=purchase.id
 ), ordered_events as materialized (
  select purchase.*,
   lag(purchase.paid_at) over(partition by purchase.user_id order by purchase.paid_at,purchase.id) previous_paid_at
  from order_dates purchase cross join bounds
  where purchase.paid_at>=bounds.earliest_history and purchase.paid_at<bounds.latest_end
 ), classified as materialized (
  select purchase.*,
   case when previous_paid_at>=paid_at-interval '4320 hours' then 'repeat' else 'new' end customer_group,
   item.subtotal,
   item.subtotal is null
    or purchase.discount_total>item.subtotal
    or purchase.store_credit_total>item.subtotal-purchase.discount_total
    or purchase.total::numeric is distinct from item.subtotal+purchase.shipping_fee-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total
    as monetary_issue
  from ordered_events purchase
  left join lateral (
   select sum(line.qty::numeric*line.unit_price::numeric) subtotal
   from public.order_items line where line.order_id=purchase.id
  ) item on true
 ), groups(group_key,group_order) as (values ('all'::text,0),('new',1),('repeat',2)),
 metrics as materialized (
  select period.period_kind,period.period_order,period.range_from,period.range_to,
   category.group_key,category.group_order,
   count(distinct purchase.user_id) customer_count,count(purchase.id) order_count,
   count(purchase.id) filter(where purchase.monetary_issue) monetary_issue_count,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.subtotal),0) item_subtotal,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.discount_total),0) coupon_amount,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.store_credit_total),0) credit_amount,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.subtotal-purchase.discount_total),0) product_sales_amount,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.subtotal-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total),0) cash_product_amount
  from periods period cross join groups category
  left join classified purchase on purchase.paid_at>=period.range_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
   and purchase.paid_at<(period.range_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
   and (category.group_key='all' or category.group_key=purchase.customer_group)
  group by period.period_kind,period.period_order,period.range_from,period.range_to,category.group_key,category.group_order
 ), period_results as (
  select metric.period_kind,metric.period_order,
   jsonb_build_object('from',metric.range_from,'to',metric.range_to,
    'unknownPaidAtCount',(
     select count(*) from order_dates unknown_order
     where unknown_order.paid_at is null
      and unknown_order.created_at>=metric.range_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
      and unknown_order.created_at<(metric.range_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
      and (unknown_order.status=any(private.revenue_order_statuses()) or exists(
       select 1 from public.payments payment where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=unknown_order.id
        and payment.status in ('paid','refunded')
      ))
    ),
    'rows',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'group',metric.group_key,'customerCount',metric.customer_count,'orderCount',metric.order_count,
     'monetaryIssueOrderCount',metric.monetary_issue_count,
     'itemSubtotal',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.item_subtotal end,
     'couponAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.coupon_amount end,
     'storeCreditAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.credit_amount end,
     'productSalesAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.product_sales_amount end,
     'cashProductAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.cash_product_amount end,
     'averagePerCustomer',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 and metric.customer_count>0
      then round(metric.product_sales_amount/metric.customer_count,2) end
    ) order by metric.group_order)) payload
  from metrics metric
  group by metric.period_kind,metric.period_order,metric.range_from,metric.range_to
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'current',(select payload from period_results where period_kind='current'),
  'comparison',(select payload from period_results where period_kind='comparison'),
  'trend',(select jsonb_agg(payload order by period_order) from period_results where period_kind='trend')
 ) into result;

 -- JSON numbers consumed by JavaScript must not silently round integer money.
 if exists(
  select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(result->'current',result->'comparison')||(result->'trend')) period(value)
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(period.value->'rows') row_value(value)
  cross join lateral jsonb_each(row_value.value) amount(key,value)
  where amount.key in ('itemSubtotal','couponAmount','storeCreditAmount','productSalesAmount','cashProductAmount')
   and jsonb_typeof(amount.value)='number' and (amount.value::text)::numeric>9007199254740991
 ) then raise numeric_value_out_of_range using message='customer_purchase_amount_out_of_range';end if;
 return result;
end $$
alter function public.admin_customer_purchase_report(text,date,date,date,date) owner to postgres
revoke all on function public.admin_customer_purchase_report(text,date,date,date,date) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

  select (min(range_from)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')-interval '4320 hours' earliest_history,
   ((max(range_to)+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') latest_end from periods
 ), order_dates as materialized (
  -- Reuse the provider approval/bank confirmation contract. Do not infer the
  -- event from orders.created_at, payments.created_at, or a current status.
  select purchase.id,purchase.user_id,purchase.status,purchase.created_at,
   purchase.total,purchase.shipping_fee,purchase.discount_total,purchase.store_credit_total,
   payment_time.paid_at
  from public.orders purchase
  left join private.admin_customer_purchase_payment_times() payment_time on payment_time.order_id=purchase.id
 ), ordered_events as materialized (
  select purchase.*,
   lag(purchase.paid_at) over(partition by purchase.user_id order by purchase.paid_at,purchase.id) previous_paid_at
  from order_dates purchase cross join bounds
  where purchase.paid_at>=bounds.earliest_history and purchase.paid_at<bounds.latest_end
 ), classified as materialized (
  select purchase.*,
   case when previous_paid_at>=paid_at-interval '4320 hours' then 'repeat' else 'new' end customer_group,
   item.subtotal,
   item.subtotal is null
    or purchase.discount_total>item.subtotal
    or purchase.store_credit_total>item.subtotal-purchase.discount_total
    or purchase.total::numeric is distinct from item.subtotal+purchase.shipping_fee-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total
    as monetary_issue
  from ordered_events purchase
  left join lateral (
   select sum(line.qty::numeric*line.unit_price::numeric) subtotal
   from public.order_items line where line.order_id=purchase.id
  ) item on true
 ), groups(group_key,group_order) as (values ('all'::text,0),('new',1),('repeat',2)),
 metrics as materialized (
  select period.period_kind,period.period_order,period.range_from,period.range_to,
   category.group_key,category.group_order,
   count(distinct purchase.user_id) customer_count,count(purchase.id) order_count,
   count(purchase.id) filter(where purchase.monetary_issue) monetary_issue_count,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.subtotal),0) item_subtotal,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.discount_total),0) coupon_amount,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.store_credit_total),0) credit_amount,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.subtotal-purchase.discount_total),0) product_sales_amount,
   coalesce(sum(purchase.subtotal-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total),0) cash_product_amount
  from periods period cross join groups category
  left join classified purchase on purchase.paid_at>=period.range_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
   and purchase.paid_at<(period.range_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
   and (category.group_key='all' or category.group_key=purchase.customer_group)
  group by period.period_kind,period.period_order,period.range_from,period.range_to,category.group_key,category.group_order
 ), period_results as (
  select metric.period_kind,metric.period_order,
   jsonb_build_object('from',metric.range_from,'to',metric.range_to,
    'unknownPaidAtCount',(
     select count(*) from order_dates unknown_order
     where unknown_order.paid_at is null
      and unknown_order.created_at>=metric.range_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
      and unknown_order.created_at<(metric.range_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
      and (unknown_order.status=any(private.revenue_order_statuses()) or exists(
       select 1 from public.payments payment where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=unknown_order.id
        and payment.status in ('paid','refunded')
      ))
    ),
    'rows',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'group',metric.group_key,'customerCount',metric.customer_count,'orderCount',metric.order_count,
     'monetaryIssueOrderCount',metric.monetary_issue_count,
     'itemSubtotal',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.item_subtotal end,
     'couponAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.coupon_amount end,
     'storeCreditAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.credit_amount end,
     'productSalesAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.product_sales_amount end,
     'cashProductAmount',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 then metric.cash_product_amount end,
     'averagePerCustomer',case when metric.monetary_issue_count=0 and metric.customer_count>0
      then round(metric.product_sales_amount/metric.customer_count,2) end
    ) order by metric.group_order)) payload
  from metrics metric
  group by metric.period_kind,metric.period_order,metric.range_from,metric.range_to
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'current',(select payload from period_results where period_kind='current'),
  'comparison',(select payload from period_results where period_kind='comparison'),
  'trend',(select jsonb_agg(payload order by period_order) from period_results where period_kind='trend')
 ) into result;

 -- JSON numbers consumed by JavaScript must not silently round integer money.
 if exists(
  select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(jsonb_build_array(result->'current',result->'comparison')||(result->'trend')) period(value)
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(period.value->'rows') row_value(value)
  cross join lateral jsonb_each(row_value.value) amount(key,value)
  where amount.key in ('itemSubtotal','couponAmount','storeCreditAmount','productSalesAmount','cashProductAmount')
   and jsonb_typeof(amount.value)='number' and (amount.value::text)::numeric>9007199254740991
 ) then raise numeric_value_out_of_range using message='customer_purchase_amount_out_of_range';end if;
 return result;
end $$

 result_revision integer not null,
 from_reason_type text not null check(from_reason_type in('change_of_mind','defect')),
 from_reason text not null,
 to_reason_type text not null check(to_reason_type in('change_of_mind','defect')),
 to_reason text not null check(char_length(to_reason) between 1 and 200 and to_reason!~'[[:cntrl:]]'),

create function private.order_claim_reason_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests) returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case
 when p_claim.claim_type<>'exchange' then 'claim_reason_type_unavailable'
 when p_claim.stage='on_hold' and p_claim.held_from is null then 'claim_reason_stage_unavailable'
 when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then p_claim.held_from else p_claim.stage end)
  not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected') then 'claim_reason_stage_unavailable'
 when p_claim.reshipped_at is not null or p_claim.reship_tracking_number is not null
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipment_items where claim_id=p_claim.id) then 'claim_reason_reshipped'
 when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_reason_finance_started'
 else null end;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_claim_reason_blocker(public.order_cancellation_requests) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$

  'revision',expected_revision,'resultRevision',result_revision,'fromReasonType',from_reason_type,'fromReason',from_reason,
  'toReasonType',to_reason_type,'toReason',to_reason,'agreement',agreement,'feeReviewed',fee_reviewed,
  'changed',changed,'stage',from_stage,'requestedAt',requested_at,'createdAt',created_at)
 from private.order_claim_reason_operations where id=p_operation_id and actor_id=p_actor;
$$

-- Only effective importance reaches PDP clients. Future importance boundaries
-- still refresh a page that currently contains only ordinary announcements.
create or replace function public.get_good_announcements(p_good_id text) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 with eligible as materialized (
  select n.*,n.important and (n.important_starts_at is null or n.important_starts_at<=statement_timestamp())
    and (n.important_ends_at is null or n.important_ends_at>statement_timestamp()) as effective_important,
   greatest(n.starts_at,n.important_starts_at) as importance_starts,least(n.ends_at,n.important_ends_at) as importance_ends
  from public.goods_announcements n where n.enabled
   and exists(select 1 from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id where g.id=p_good_id
    and g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none' and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null)
   and (n.all_goods or exists(select 1 from public.goods_announcement_goods links where links.announcement_id=n.id and links.good_id=p_good_id))
 ) select jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'title',title,'body',body,'format',body_format,

ledger.name: home_review_best_priority
statements:
-- Home representative reviews prefer currently eligible selected BEST reviews.
-- Change only the representative review of an already eligible home product.
-- The ordinary aggregate stays SECURITY INVOKER with its existing public shape.

do $contract$
begin
  -- These read predicates are mirrored below because an existing local database
  -- has mixed helper owners. Do not widen helper ACLs or normalize their owners.
  if (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='private.review_event_purchase_eligible(uuid,uuid,text)'::regprocedure)
       is distinct from '7dd4b2594b429843867c0ce0b19aabf3'
    or (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='private.review_event_review_fingerprint(public.reviews)'::regprocedure)
       is distinct from 'cd3fd66480d98957eb4276f26c336678'
    or (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='private.review_best_problem(public.reviews)'::regprocedure)
       is distinct from 'e11fd5d6ad4cbb0aa52898b29af041c7'
    or (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='public.get_home_review_candidates(text[])'::regprocedure)
       is distinct from 'af86d13d11f872f6158c920335630ae1'
  then raise exception 'home_review_best_source_contract_changed'; end if;
end $contract$

-- A bounded, deliberately public projection. It returns only the same review
-- fields already displayed on home cards, never selection state or private IDs.
-- No account advisory lock, actor authorization, PDP toggle/minimum or sampling:
-- this is public content reading, not a selection write or the PDP gallery.
create function public.get_home_best_review_candidates(p_good_ids text[])
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if p_good_ids is null or cardinality(p_good_ids) not between 1 and 200
    or array_ndims(p_good_ids) is distinct from 1
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_home_review_goods'; end if;
  if array_position(p_good_ids,null) is not null
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_good_ids) id where id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_home_review_goods'; end if;

  with eligible as materialized (
    select g.id from public.goods g
    join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id
    where g.id=any(p_good_ids) and g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null
      and g.sale_restriction='none' and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'goodId',g.id,
    'representative',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'rating',r.rating,'body',r.body,
      'authorName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),'팬'),'createdAt',r.created_at)
  ) order by g.id),'[]'::jsonb) into result
  from eligible g
  cross join lateral (
    select r.id,r.user_id,r.rating,r.body,r.created_at
    from private.review_best_selections selection
    join public.reviews r on r.id=selection.review_id
    where r.good_id=g.id and r.status='visible'
      and selection.selected and selection.invalidated_at is null
      and selection.review_fingerprint=md5(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',r.id,'body',r.body,'rating',r.rating,'images',r.image_paths,'status',r.status)::text)
      and exists(select 1 from public.profiles author where author.id=r.user_id and author.suspended_at is null)
      and not exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences fence where fence.subject_user_id=r.user_id)
      -- Read-only equivalent of review_event_purchase_eligible in this statement
      -- snapshot. The dependency guard above prevents silently copying a changed
      -- purchase/fingerprint contract. Future changes must update both readers.
      and exists(
        select 1 from public.orders o
        where o.id=r.order_id and o.user_id=r.user_id and o.status in ('delivered','done') and o.delivered_at is not null
          and exists(select 1 from public.order_items item where item.order_id=o.id and item.good_id=r.good_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests claim
            where claim.order_id=o.id and claim.claim_type in ('cancel','return')
              and (claim.status='completed' or claim.stage='completed'))
          and exists(
            select 1 from public.payments payment
            join public.payment_attempts attempt on attempt.payment_id=payment.id
              and attempt.purpose='order' and attempt.ref_id=o.id and attempt.user_id=o.user_id
              and attempt.provider=payment.provider and attempt.amount=payment.amount and attempt.state='approved'
            where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=o.id and payment.user_id=o.user_id
              and payment.amount=o.total and payment.status='paid'
              and (exists(select 1 from private.payment_provider_evidence evidence
                where evidence.payment_attempt_id=attempt.id and evidence.approved_at is not null)
                or attempt.provider='bank_transfer' and exists(select 1 from public.bank_transfer_confirmations confirmation
                  where confirmation.attempt_id=attempt.id and confirmation.order_id=o.id))
          )
      )
    order by r.rating desc,r.created_at desc,r.id
    limit 1
  ) r
  left join public.public_profiles p on p.id=r.user_id;
  return result;
end $$
revoke all on function public.get_home_best_review_candidates(text[]) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.get_home_best_review_candidates(text[]) to anon,authenticated

comment on function public.get_home_best_review_candidates(text[]) is
  'At most one currently eligible selected BEST review per requested public good (1..200 IDs). Rating/date/ID order; no private selection metadata, account locks, PDP toggle, three-review minimum, random selection, reward, or product-rank change.'

create or replace function public.get_home_review_candidates(p_good_ids text[])
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if p_good_ids is null or cardinality(p_good_ids) not between 1 and 200
    or array_position(p_good_ids,null) is not null
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_good_ids) id where id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_home_review_goods'; end if;
  with bounds as (
    select date_trunc('day',statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as today
  ), eligible as (
    select g.id from public.goods g where g.id=any(p_good_ids)
      and g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none'
      and exists(select 1 from public.ips ip where ip.id=g.ip_id and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null)
  ), statistics as (
    select r.good_id,round(avg(r.rating)::numeric,2) rating_average,count(*) review_count,
      max(r.created_at) filter(where r.created_at>=bounds.today-interval '7 days' and r.created_at<bounds.today) as recent_review_at
    from public.reviews r join eligible g on g.id=r.good_id cross join bounds
    where r.status='visible' group by r.good_id
  ), best as materialized (
    select chosen.* from jsonb_to_recordset(public.get_home_best_review_candidates(p_good_ids))
      as chosen("goodId" text,representative jsonb)
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'goodId',s.good_id,'ratingAverage',s.rating_average,'reviewCount',s.review_count,'recentReviewAt',s.recent_review_at,
    'representative',coalesce(best.representative,jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'rating',r.rating,'body',r.body,
      'authorName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),'팬'),'createdAt',r.created_at))
  ) order by s.good_id),'[]'::jsonb) into result
  from statistics s
  cross join lateral (
    select id,user_id,rating,body,created_at from public.reviews r
    where r.good_id=s.good_id and r.status='visible'
    order by r.rating desc,r.created_at desc,r.id limit 1
  ) r
  left join public.public_profiles p on p.id=r.user_id
  left join best on best."goodId"=s.good_id;
  return result;
end $$

-- Existing aggregate owner/ACL/RLS mode are preserved by CREATE OR REPLACE.
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('public.get_home_best_review_candidates(text[])'::regprocedure)
notify pgrst,'reload schema'

create function private.category_display_category(p_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 with recursive lineage as (
  select c.id,c.parent_id,c.archived_at,1 as hops from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=p_id
  union all select p.id,p.parent_id,p.archived_at,l.hops+1 from public.catalog_categories p join lineage l on p.id=l.parent_id where l.hops<4
 ) select jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'name',c.name,'parentId',c.parent_id,'depth',c.depth,'sortOrder',c.sort_order,
  'publicEnabled',coalesce((select customer_enabled from public.category_activation_control where id='catalog'),false)
    and not exists(select 1 from lineage where archived_at is not null)
    and exists(select 1 from lineage where parent_id is null))
 from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=p_id and c.archived_at is null;

  'categoryIds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(s.source_category_id order by s.position) from private.category_display_sources s where s.category_id=c.category_id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'goodIds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(g.good_id order by g.position) from private.category_display_goods g where g.category_id=c.category_id and g.slot='main'),'[]'::jsonb),
  'banner',c.banner,'video',jsonb_build_object('enabled',c.video_enabled,'goodId',c.video_good_id),
  'recommendations',c.recommendations||jsonb_build_object('goodIds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(g.good_id order by g.position) from private.category_display_goods g where g.category_id=c.category_id and g.slot='recommend'),'[]'::jsonb)))

  union select c.id from public.catalog_categories c join selected_categories p on c.parent_id=p.id where c.archived_at is null
 ), manual as (select value id,ordinality-1 ordinal_position from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_values->'goodIds') with ordinality)

-- Personal body templates: owner-scoped text and reusable formatting.
-- Personal reusable text/format templates. Images and document metadata are not
-- template properties; every application also uses its destination sanitizer.
create function private.body_template_valid_html(p_html text)
returns boolean language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select p_html is not null and char_length(p_html) between 1 and 30000
  and p_html !~* '<[[:space:]]*/?[[:space:]]*(img|picture|source|video|audio|iframe|object|embed|svg|math|script|style|link|meta|base|template|input)([[:space:]/>]|$)'
  and length(btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(p_html,'<[^>]*>',' ','g'),
    '( |&#0*160;|&#x0*a0;)','','gi'),E' \t\n\r\f\v'||chr(160)))>0;
$$

ledger.name: goods_transaction_terms
