-- Immutable versioned volume-discount and delivery terms.
-- Runtime defaults OFF; active terms require the shared checkout runtime.
create table private.goods_transaction_runtime (
 singleton boolean primary key default true check(singleton),
 enabled boolean not null default false
)
insert into private.goods_transaction_runtime(singleton) values(true)

create function private.transaction_json_keys(p_value jsonb,p_keys text[]) returns boolean
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' and p_value ?& p_keys and p_value-p_keys='{}'::jsonb,false);
$$

create function private.transaction_draft_valid(p_value jsonb,p_keys text[]) returns boolean
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' and p_value-p_keys='{}'::jsonb
  and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(case when jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' then p_value else '{}'::jsonb end) e
   where jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string' or char_length(e.value#>>'{}')>128 or (e.value#>>'{}')~'[[:cntrl:]]'),false);
$$

create function private.goods_volume_input_valid(p_value jsonb) returns boolean
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(private.transaction_json_keys(p_value,array['status','terms','draftValues'])
  and p_value->>'status' in ('draft','active','disabled')
  and (private.goods_volume_terms_valid(p_value->'terms') or (p_value->'terms'='null'::jsonb and p_value->>'status'<>'active'))
  and private.transaction_draft_valid(p_value->'draftValues',array['condition','threshold','discountKind','discountValue','startsAt','endsAt']),false);
$$

create function private.goods_delivery_input_valid(p_value jsonb) returns boolean
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(private.transaction_json_keys(p_value,array['status','paymentMode','quantityTerms','draftValues'])
  and p_value->>'status' in ('draft','active','disabled') and p_value->>'paymentMode' in ('prepaid','collect','buyer_choice')
  and (p_value->'quantityTerms'='null'::jsonb or private.goods_delivery_quantity_terms_valid(p_value->'quantityTerms'))
  and private.transaction_draft_valid(p_value->'draftValues',array['kind','baseFee','interval','firstLimit','secondLimit','extra1','extra2','paymentMode']),false);
$$

create table private.goods_volume_discount_versions (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),good_id text not null references public.goods(id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
 revision integer not null check(revision>0),status text not null check(status in ('draft','active','disabled')),
 terms jsonb,draft_values jsonb not null default '{}',created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 created_by uuid not null references auth.users(id),unique(id,good_id),unique(good_id,revision),
 check(private.goods_volume_input_valid(jsonb_build_object('status',status,'terms',terms,'draftValues',draft_values)))
)

create table private.goods_delivery_versions (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),good_id text not null references public.goods(id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
 revision integer not null check(revision>0),status text not null check(status in ('draft','active','disabled')),
 payment_mode text not null check(payment_mode in ('prepaid','collect','buyer_choice')),quantity_terms jsonb,
 draft_values jsonb not null default '{}',created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),created_by uuid not null references auth.users(id),
 unique(id,good_id),unique(good_id,revision),
 check(private.goods_delivery_input_valid(jsonb_build_object('status',status,'paymentMode',payment_mode,'quantityTerms',quantity_terms,'draftValues',draft_values)))
)

create table private.goods_transaction_configs (
 good_id text primary key references public.goods(id) on update cascade on delete restrict,
 revision integer not null default 0 check(revision>=0),volume_version_id uuid,delivery_version_id uuid,
 updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_by uuid not null references auth.users(id),
 foreign key(volume_version_id,good_id) references private.goods_volume_discount_versions(id,good_id) on update cascade,
 foreign key(delivery_version_id,good_id) references private.goods_delivery_versions(id,good_id) on update cascade
)

create table private.shipping_collect_contract_versions (
 id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),origin_id uuid not null references public.fulfillment_origins(id),revision integer not null check(revision>0),
 status text not null check(status in ('draft','active','disabled')),contract_values jsonb not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 created_by uuid not null references auth.users(id),unique(id,origin_id),unique(origin_id,revision)
)

create table private.shipping_collect_contracts (
 origin_id uuid primary key references public.fulfillment_origins(id),revision integer not null check(revision>0),version_id uuid not null,
 foreign key(version_id,origin_id) references private.shipping_collect_contract_versions(id,origin_id)
)

create function private.guard_goods_transaction_version() returns trigger
language plpgsql security invoker set search_path='' as $$begin
 -- A catalog ID rename propagates through FK identities without rewriting any
 -- price/contract term. All other version updates and deletion are forbidden.
 if tg_op='UPDATE' and (to_jsonb(new)-'good_id')=(to_jsonb(old)-'good_id') then return new;end if;
 raise check_violation using message='transaction_terms_immutable';
end $$

create trigger immutable_goods_volume_version before update or delete on private.goods_volume_discount_versions
 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_transaction_version()

create trigger immutable_goods_delivery_version before update or delete on private.goods_delivery_versions
 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_transaction_version()

create trigger immutable_shipping_collect_contract before update or delete on private.shipping_collect_contract_versions
 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_transaction_version()

create function private.goods_transaction_terms_document(p_good_id text) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,'revision',coalesce(c.revision,0),'goodUpdatedAt',g.updated_at,
  'volume',case when v.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',v.id,'goodId',v.good_id,'revision',v.revision,'status',v.status,'terms',v.terms,'draftValues',v.draft_values) end,
  'delivery',case when d.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'goodId',d.good_id,'revision',d.revision,'status',d.status,
   'paymentMode',d.payment_mode,'quantityTerms',d.quantity_terms,'draftValues',d.draft_values) end)
 from public.goods g left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=g.id
 left join private.goods_volume_discount_versions v on v.id=c.volume_version_id
 left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id where g.id=p_good_id;
$$

create function private.shipping_collect_contract_input_valid(p_values jsonb,p_status text) returns boolean
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(p_status in ('draft','active','disabled')
  and private.transaction_json_keys(p_values,array['collectorName','collectionMethod','refundContact','customerInstructions','contractReference','dispatchMappingReference','receiptReference','disputeContact'])
  and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(case when jsonb_typeof(p_values)='object' then p_values else '{}'::jsonb end) e
   where jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string' or (e.value#>>'{}')<>btrim(e.value#>>'{}') or (e.value#>>'{}')~'[[:cntrl:]]'
    or char_length(e.value#>>'{}')>case when e.key='customerInstructions' then 500 when e.key='collectorName' then 100 else 200 end
    or (p_status='active' and char_length(e.value#>>'{}')=0)),false);
$$

alter table private.shipping_collect_contract_versions add constraint shipping_collect_contract_values_valid
 check(private.shipping_collect_contract_input_valid(contract_values,status))

create function private.shipping_collect_contract_document(p_origin_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('originId',o.id,'revision',coalesce(c.revision,0),'versionId',v.id,'status',coalesce(v.status,'disabled'),
  'values',coalesce(v.contract_values,jsonb_build_object('collectorName','','collectionMethod','','refundContact','','customerInstructions','','contractReference','','dispatchMappingReference','','receiptReference','','disputeContact','')))
 from public.fulfillment_origins o left join private.shipping_collect_contracts c on c.origin_id=o.id
 left join private.shipping_collect_contract_versions v on v.id=c.version_id where o.id=p_origin_id;
$$

-- New transactions require the runtime gate; successful receipts remain replayable.
alter table public.orders
 add column calculation_version integer not null default 1 check(calculation_version in(1,2)),
 add column volume_discount_total bigint not null default 0 check(volume_discount_total>=0),
 add column shipping_collect_total bigint not null default 0 check(shipping_collect_total>=0)

alter table public.order_items
 add column volume_unit_discount bigint not null default 0 check(volume_unit_discount>=0 and volume_unit_discount<=unit_price),
 add column volume_discount_total bigint not null default 0 check(volume_discount_total>=0),
 add column volume_discount_snapshot jsonb

create index goods_transaction_quotes_expiry on private.goods_transaction_quotes(expires_at)

create table private.shipping_charge_components (

 payment_mode text not null check(payment_mode in('prepaid','collect')),base_fee bigint not null check(base_fee>=0),

)

 shipment_id uuid primary key references public.order_shipments(id),order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id),amount bigint not null check(amount>0),

 revision integer not null default 1 check(revision>0),contract_snapshot jsonb not null,updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)
create index shipping_collect_obligations_order on private.shipping_collect_obligations(order_id)

create table private.shipping_collect_events (
 operation_id uuid primary key,shipment_id uuid not null references private.shipping_collect_obligations(shipment_id),

)
create index shipping_collect_events_shipment on private.shipping_collect_events(shipment_id,created_at,operation_id)

 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_transaction_version()

create function private.normalize_goods_transaction_choices(p_choices jsonb,p_selection jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_choices) is distinct from 'object' or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_choices) e
  where jsonb_typeof(e.value) is distinct from 'string' or (e.value#>>'{}') not in('prepaid','collect')
   or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_selection) r where r->>'goodId'=e.key)) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_delivery_choices';end if;
 return p_choices;
end $$

create function private.assert_goods_transaction_actor(p_actor uuid) returns void
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if p_actor is null or private.is_account_write_fenced(p_actor) or not exists(
  select 1 from public.profiles profile join auth.users auth_user on auth_user.id=profile.id where profile.id=p_actor
   and profile.suspended_at is null and nullif(btrim(coalesce(profile.email,auth_user.email)),'') is not null
   and nullif(btrim(profile.nickname),'') is not null and profile.birth_date is not null and profile.birth_date<=current_date
   and profile.onboarded_at is not null and profile.consents->>'terms'='true' and profile.consents->>'privacy'='true') then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='transaction_actor_unavailable';end if;
end $$

create function private.assert_goods_transaction_runtime() returns void
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$declare active boolean;begin
 -- Catalog parents precede this shared runtime lock, matching policy writers.
 -- A toggle UPDATE takes the conflicting row lock; successful receipt replay
 -- never calls this new-transaction gate.
 select enabled into active from private.goods_transaction_runtime where singleton for share;
 if not coalesce(active,false) then raise sqlstate 'PT409' using message='transaction_runtime_disabled';end if;
end $$

create or replace function private.evaluate_coupon_target_lines(p_user_coupon_id uuid,p_user_id uuid,p_lines jsonb,p_order_id uuid default null,
 out o_reason text,out o_discount bigint,out o_coupon_code text,out o_eligible_subtotal bigint,out o_terms_snapshot jsonb)
returns record language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select * from private.evaluate_coupon_target_lines_at(p_user_coupon_id,p_user_id,p_lines,p_order_id,statement_timestamp());
$$

create function private.goods_transaction_calculation_contract(p_calculation jsonb) returns jsonb
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select (p_calculation-'display')||jsonb_build_object('display',(p_calculation->'display')-array['calculatedAt','nextChangeAt','storeCreditMaximum']);
$$

create function private.goods_transaction_public_shipping(p_source_kind text,p_raw_groups jsonb) returns jsonb
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(case when p_source_kind='gift' then jsonb_build_object('calculationVersion',2,'originId',value->'originId',
  'originName',value->'originName','totalFee',value->'totalFee','prepaidFee',value->'prepaidFee','collectFee',value->'collectFee','fullFee',value->'fullFee',
  'components',value->'components','collector',value->'collector')
 else value-array['collectContractSnapshot','collectContractId','deliveryTerms'] end order by value->>'originId'),'[]')
 from jsonb_array_elements(p_raw_groups);
$$

create function private.goods_transaction_request_digest(p_salt uuid,p_source jsonb,p_selection jsonb,p_address jsonb,p_quote_id uuid,p_method public.order_payment_method)
returns text language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(p_salt,p_source,p_selection,p_address,p_quote_id,p_method)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
$$

create function private.goods_transaction_snapshot_matches(p_order_id uuid,p_total bigint,p_shipping_fee bigint) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders purchase where purchase.id=p_order_id and purchase.calculation_version=2
  and purchase.total=p_total and purchase.shipping_fee=p_shipping_fee
  and exists(select 1 from private.order_goods_transactions where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select count(*)>0 and bool_and(item.volume_discount_total=item.qty::numeric*item.volume_unit_discount)
   and sum(item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price)-sum(item.volume_discount_total)+purchase.shipping_fee-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total=purchase.total
   and sum(item.volume_discount_total)=purchase.volume_discount_total
   and bool_and(item.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation
    where reservation.order_item_id=item.id and reservation.order_id=item.order_id and reservation.policy_id=item.preorder_policy_id
     and reservation.qty=item.qty and reservation.state in('reserved','allocated')))
   from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_items item left join private.order_price_allocations a on a.order_item_id=item.id
   where item.order_id=purchase.id and (a.order_item_id is null or a.order_id<>purchase.id or a.subtotal<>item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price
    or a.volume_discount<>item.volume_discount_total))
  and (select sum(a.coupon_discount)=purchase.discount_total and sum(a.store_credit_discount)=purchase.store_credit_total
   and sum(a.paid_goods_total)+purchase.shipping_fee=purchase.total from private.order_price_allocations a where a.order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select coalesce(sum(s.shipping_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_fee and coalesce(sum(s.shipping_collect_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_collect_total
   from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id and not exists(
   select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c where c.shipment_id=s.id group by c.shipment_id
    having sum(case when c.payment_mode='prepaid' then c.total_fee else 0 end)=s.shipping_fee
     and sum(case when c.payment_mode='collect' then c.total_fee else 0 end)=s.shipping_collect_fee))
  and not exists(select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c join public.order_shipments s on s.id=c.shipment_id
   where c.order_id=purchase.id and (s.order_id<>purchase.id or s.origin_id<>c.origin_id or not exists(
    select 1 from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id and item.good_id=c.good_id and item.origin_id_snapshot=c.origin_id)))
  and (select count(*) from private.shipping_charge_components where order_id=purchase.id)=
   (select count(distinct good_id) from public.order_items where order_id=purchase.id));
$$

create or replace function private.goods_order_snapshot_matches(p_order_id uuid,p_total bigint,p_shipping_fee bigint) returns boolean
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select case when (select calculation_version from public.orders where id=p_order_id)=2
  then private.goods_transaction_snapshot_matches(p_order_id,p_total,p_shipping_fee)
  else private.goods_order_snapshot_matches_v1(p_order_id,p_total,p_shipping_fee) end;
$$
create trigger order_item_transaction_terms_guard before insert on public.order_items for each row execute function private.guard_order_transaction_terms()

create function private.goods_cart_transaction_source(p_actor uuid,p_selection jsonb) returns jsonb
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('kind','cart','id',p_actor,'revision',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_selection::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'));
$$

create function public.get_goods_transaction_runtime_enabled() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce((select enabled from private.goods_transaction_runtime where singleton),false);
$$

create function public.get_goods_transaction_offers(p_good_ids text[]) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 if p_good_ids is null or cardinality(p_good_ids)>1000 or array_position(p_good_ids,null) is not null
  or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_good_ids) id where char_length(id) not between 1 and 200 or id<>btrim(id) or id~'[[:cntrl:]]') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_transaction_offer_ids';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,
  'volume',case when v.status='active' then jsonb_build_object('id',v.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',v.revision,'status',v.status,'terms',v.terms,'draftValues','{}'::jsonb) end,
  'delivery',case when d.status='active' then jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',d.revision,'status',d.status,
   'paymentMode',d.payment_mode,'quantityTerms',d.quantity_terms,'draftValues','{}'::jsonb) end,
  'collectReady',coalesce(contract.status='active' and origin.is_active,false),
  'collector',case when contract.status='active' and origin.is_active then jsonb_build_object('name',contract.contract_values->>'collectorName',
   'method',contract.contract_values->>'collectionMethod','refundContact',contract.contract_values->>'refundContact','instructions',contract.contract_values->>'customerInstructions') end)
  order by g.id),'[]') into result from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id
  left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=g.id left join private.goods_volume_discount_versions v on v.id=c.volume_version_id
  left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id left join public.fulfillment_origins origin on origin.id=g.origin_id
  left join private.shipping_collect_contracts collector on collector.origin_id=origin.id
  left join private.shipping_collect_contract_versions contract on contract.id=collector.version_id
 where g.id=any(p_good_ids) and g.published_at is not null and g.archived_at is null and g.sale_restriction='none'
  and ip.published_at is not null and ip.archived_at is null;
 return result;
end $$

ledger.name: gift_order_domain
statements:
-- Gift source and delivery ownership; no raw recipient address enters public rows.
begin

create table private.gift_runtime (
 singleton boolean primary key default true check(singleton),enabled boolean not null default false,
 privacy_ready boolean not null default false
)
insert into private.gift_runtime(singleton) values(true)

create table private.gift_intents (
 id uuid primary key,sender_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,
 recipient_id uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,
 state text not null default 'awaiting_acceptance' check(state in('awaiting_acceptance','accepted','ordered','declined','expired','canceled')),
 revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),message text not null default '' check(char_length(message)<=300 and message!~'[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]'),
 sender_label text not null,recipient_label text,expires_at timestamptz not null,
 accepted_at timestamptz,closed_at timestamptz,order_id uuid unique references public.orders(id) on delete restrict,
 ordered_source_revision text,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check((order_id is null)=(ordered_source_revision is null)),check(state<>'ordered' or order_id is not null),
 check(state not in('accepted','ordered') or recipient_id is not null)
)
create index gift_intents_sender on private.gift_intents(sender_id,created_at desc,id)
create index gift_intents_recipient on private.gift_intents(recipient_id,created_at desc,id)

create table private.gift_items (
 gift_id uuid not null references private.gift_intents(id) on delete cascade,position integer not null check(position between 0 and 99),
 good_id text not null,variant_id uuid not null,qty integer not null check(qty>0),input_revision bigint not null check(input_revision>=0),
 input_values jsonb not null,item_display jsonb not null,
 primary key(gift_id,position),foreign key(variant_id,good_id) references public.goods_variants(id,good_id) on update cascade on delete restrict
)

create table private.gift_recipient_addresses (
 gift_id uuid primary key references private.gift_intents(id) on delete cascade,recipient_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,
 revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),address jsonb not null,updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create table private.gift_link_tokens (
 token_hash text primary key check(token_hash~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),gift_id uuid not null references private.gift_intents(id) on delete cascade,
 generation bigint not null check(generation>0),expires_at timestamptz not null,revoked_at timestamptz,consumed_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),unique(gift_id,generation)
)

create table private.gift_claim_sessions (
 session_hash text primary key check(session_hash~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),token_hash text not null references private.gift_link_tokens(token_hash) on delete cascade,
 expires_at timestamptz not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)
create index gift_claim_sessions_token on private.gift_claim_sessions(token_hash,expires_at)

create table private.gift_operations (
 id uuid primary key,actor_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,gift_id uuid not null references private.gift_intents(id) on delete restrict,
 kind text not null,request_hash text not null check(request_hash~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),revision bigint not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create table private.order_delivery_private_snapshots (
 order_id uuid primary key references public.orders(id) on delete restrict,gift_id uuid not null unique references private.gift_intents(id) on delete restrict,
 recipient_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,address jsonb not null,address_revision integer not null default 0,
 gift_address_revision bigint not null,source_revision text not null,shipping_evidence jsonb not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create function private.gift_require_actor(p_actor uuid,p_new_write boolean default true) returns void
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if p_actor is null or not exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=p_actor) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='gift_auth_required';end if;
 if p_new_write and not exists(select 1 from public.profiles p join auth.users u on u.id=p.id where p.id=p_actor
  and p.suspended_at is null and not private.is_account_write_fenced(p.id) and p.onboarded_at is not null
  and nullif(btrim(coalesce(p.email,u.email)),'') is not null and nullif(btrim(p.nickname),'') is not null
  and p.birth_date is not null and p.birth_date<=current_date and p.consents->>'terms'='true' and p.consents->>'privacy'='true') then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='gift_account_unavailable';end if;
end $$

create function private.gift_source(p_gift private.gift_intents) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('kind','gift','id',p_gift.id,'revision',coalesce(p_gift.ordered_source_revision,p_gift.revision::text||':'||
  encode(extensions.digest(coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(i.good_id,i.variant_id) order by i.position)::text from private.gift_items i where i.gift_id=p_gift.id),'[]'),'sha256'),'hex')));
$$

create function private.gift_selection(p_id uuid) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId',i.good_id,'variantId',i.variant_id,'qty',i.qty,'inputRevision',i.input_revision,'inputValues',i.input_values) order by i.position),'[]')
 from private.gift_items i where i.gift_id=p_id;
$$

create function private.gift_item_identity_changed() returns trigger language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if tg_op='UPDATE' and (to_jsonb(new)-'good_id')=(to_jsonb(old)-'good_id') then
  -- Identity-only FK cascades change the private source fingerprint without
  -- taking a gift row lock behind the catalog writer's goods lock.
  return new;
 end if;raise check_violation using message='gift_selection_immutable';
end $$
create trigger gift_item_identity before update on private.gift_items for each row execute function private.gift_item_identity_changed()

create function private.gift_operation_result(p_actor uuid,p_operation_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('receipt',jsonb_build_object('operationId',o.id,'kind',o.kind,'revision',o.revision),
  'gift',private.gift_detail(p_actor,o.gift_id)) from private.gift_operations o where o.id=p_operation_id and o.actor_id=p_actor;
$$

create function private.gift_session_id(p_session_hash text,p_at timestamptz) returns uuid language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select t.gift_id from private.gift_claim_sessions s join private.gift_link_tokens t on t.token_hash=s.token_hash
 where s.session_hash=p_session_hash and s.expires_at>p_at and t.expires_at>p_at and t.revoked_at is null and t.consumed_at is null;
$$

create function private.order_delivery_snapshot(p_order_id uuid) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case when d.order_id is not null then jsonb_build_object('address',d.address,'addressRevision',d.address_revision,'shippingEvidence',d.shipping_evidence)
  else jsonb_build_object('address',o.address,'addressRevision',o.address_revision,'shippingEvidence',o.shipping_fee_breakdown) end
 from public.orders o left join private.order_delivery_private_snapshots d on d.order_id=o.id where o.id=p_order_id;
$$

-- A customer must use the safe party DTO for gifts. Existing non-gift RLS stays
-- unchanged; the restrictive policy also closes future permissive additions.
create function private.gift_direct_order_read_allowed(p_order_id uuid,p_actor uuid) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=p_order_id and (private.has_operator_capability(p_actor,'sales.read',false)
  or (o.user_id=p_actor and not exists(select 1 from private.order_delivery_private_snapshots d where d.order_id=o.id))));

grant execute on function public.request_order_claim(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,text,text,text) to service_role

create or replace function private.notify_order_claim(
  p_claim_id uuid,
  p_event text,
  p_title text,
  p_body text
)
returns void
language plpgsql
volatile
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $function$
declare
  v_claim public.order_cancellation_requests%rowtype;
  gift private.gift_intents;
begin
  select request.*
  into v_claim
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  where request.id = p_claim_id;

  if not found then
    return;
  end if;

  select * into gift from private.gift_intents where order_id=v_claim.order_id;
  if found then
    insert into public.notifications(user_id,type,title,body,link_path,source_type,source_id,dedupe_key)
    select party,'claim_updated','선물 요청 상태가 변경됐어요','선물함에서 교환·반품·취소 요청의 진행 상태를 확인해주세요.','/gifts/'||gift.id,'order_claim',v_claim.id::text,
      'gift-claim:'||p_event||':'||v_claim.id||':'||to_char(v_claim.updated_at,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS')
    from(select distinct unnest(array[gift.sender_id,gift.recipient_id]) party) parties where party is not null
    on conflict(user_id,dedupe_key) do nothing;
    return;
  end if;
  insert into public.notifications (
    user_id,
    type,
    title,
    body,
    link_path,
    source_type,
    source_id,
    dedupe_key
  )
  values (
    v_claim.requested_by,
    'claim_updated',
    p_title,
    p_body,
    '/orders/' || v_claim.order_id::text,
    'order_claim',
    v_claim.id::text,
    'claim:' || p_event || ':' || v_claim.id::text
      || ':' || pg_catalog.to_char(v_claim.updated_at, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS')
  )
  on conflict (user_id, dedupe_key) do nothing;
end;
$function$

  'requesterName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),case when coalesce(parties.actual_requester,c.requested_by)=g.sender_id then g.sender_label else g.recipient_label end,'이름 미등록'))
 from public.order_cancellation_requests c join private.gift_intents g on g.order_id=c.order_id
 left join private.gift_claim_parties parties on parties.claim_id=c.id
 left join public.profiles p on p.id=coalesce(parties.actual_requester,c.requested_by) where c.id=p_claim_id;
$$

-- transaction commits and handles exactly one gift per RPC transaction.
create function private.gift_account_deletion_blockers(p_actor uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$

 from private.gift_intents gift join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=gift.order_id where gift.recipient_id=p_actor and gift.sender_id<>p_actor and
 (purchase.status not in('canceled','done') and not private.order_all_items_delivered(purchase.id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=purchase.id and status in('requested','processing','needs_review')));
$$

create function public.service_list_fenced_gift_cleanup_candidates(p_limit integer default 100) returns uuid[]
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_gift_cleanup';end if;
 return array(select g.id from private.gift_intents g where g.order_id is null
  and exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences f where f.subject_user_id in(g.sender_id,g.recipient_id))
  and(g.state in('awaiting_acceptance','accepted') or exists(select 1 from private.gift_recipient_addresses where gift_id=g.id)
   or exists(select 1 from private.goods_transaction_quotes q where q.source->>'kind'='gift' and q.source->>'id'=g.id::text and q.order_id is null))
  order by g.id limit p_limit);
end $$

-- The legacy privacy trigger still redacts recipient, subject and raw error text.

create function private.shipment_email_delivery_state(p_order uuid,p_shipment uuid) returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 with keys as (
  select 'order_shipped:'||p_order||':'||p_shipment dedupe_key
  union all select 'order_shipped:'||p_order||':'||p_shipment||':recipient'
   where exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents g where g.order_id=p_order)
 ), states as (
  select case when d.status='sent' then 'sent'
   when d.status='pending' then case when d.claimed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '10 minutes' then 'busy' else 'unknown' end
   when d.status='failed' and coalesce(d.safe_error_code,d.last_error,'') !~ '^(provider_http_(429|5[0-9]{2})|provider_not_configured)$' then 'unknown'
   else 'ready' end state
  from keys k left join public.email_deliveries d using(dedupe_key)
 ) select case when bool_or(state='unknown') then 'unknown' when bool_or(state='busy') then 'busy'
   when bool_and(state='sent') then 'sent' else 'ready' end from states;
$$

ledger.name: recurring_billing_and_goods_subscriptions
statements:
-- Reviewed recurring billing and fixed-source goods subscriptions.
-- Public, provider-write and worker gates are OFF. No keys, jobs or provider
-- requests are provisioned here. Validated in a disposable clone before
-- approved local application with the shared GoodsTransaction migrations.

create function private.subscription_json_keys(p_value jsonb,p_keys text[]) returns boolean
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' and p_value ?& p_keys and p_value-p_keys='{}'::jsonb;
$$

create function private.subscription_valid_envelope(p_value jsonb) returns boolean
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(private.subscription_json_keys(p_value,array['v','keyVersion','iv','ciphertext','tag'])
  and p_value->'v'='1'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof(p_value->'keyVersion')='string'
  and p_value->>'keyVersion'~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
  and jsonb_typeof(p_value->'iv')='string' and p_value->>'iv'~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16}$'
  and jsonb_typeof(p_value->'tag')='string' and p_value->>'tag'~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$'
  and jsonb_typeof(p_value->'ciphertext')='string' and length(p_value->>'ciphertext') between 2 and 400 and p_value->>'ciphertext'~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$',false);
$$

create function private.subscription_normalize_intervals(p_value jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_value) is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_value) not between 1 and 6
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_value) e where jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string'
   or e.value#>>'{}' not in('week_1','week_2','week_4','month_1','month_2','month_3'))
  or (select count(distinct value) from jsonb_array_elements(p_value))<>jsonb_array_length(p_value) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_subscription_intervals';end if;
 select jsonb_agg(value order by value) into result from jsonb_array_elements(p_value);return result;
end $$

create table private.goods_subscription_runtime (
 singleton boolean primary key default true check(singleton),public_enabled boolean not null default false,
 charge_enabled boolean not null default false,worker_enabled boolean not null default false,fake_local_enabled boolean not null default false,
 terms_version text not null default 'goods-subscription-v1' check(terms_version~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')
)
insert into private.goods_subscription_runtime(singleton) values(true)

create table private.goods_subscription_policies (

 message text not null default '' check(char_length(message)<=500 and message=btrim(message) and message!~'[[:cntrl:]]'),
 revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),updated_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
 updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create table private.billing_profiles (

)

create table private.billing_customers (

)

create table private.billing_credentials (
 id uuid primary key,owner_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id),customer_id uuid not null references private.billing_customers(id),
 profile_id uuid not null references private.billing_profiles(id),envelope jsonb check(envelope is null or private.subscription_valid_envelope(envelope)),
 state text not null check(state in('active','revoking','revoked','needs_review')),issuer_code text not null check(issuer_code~'^[A-Z0-9]{2}$'),
 masked_number text not null check(masked_number~'^[0-9*]{8,20}$' and length(replace(masked_number,'*',''))<=12
  and length(masked_number)-length(replace(masked_number,'*',''))>=4 and masked_number!~'[0-9]{9}'),
 authenticated_at timestamptz not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),revoked_at timestamptz,
 revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),check((state='revoked')=(revoked_at is not null)),
 check((state='revoked')=(envelope is null))
)

create table private.billing_enrollments (

 nonce_envelope jsonb not null check(private.subscription_valid_envelope(nonce_envelope)),

 write_key_version text not null check(write_key_version~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'),
 idempotency_key text not null unique check(char_length(idempotency_key) between 1 and 300 and idempotency_key~'^[!-~]+$'),
 state text not null default 'prepared' check(state in('prepared','processing','ready','declined','unknown','needs_review','expired')),
 claim_token uuid,lease_until timestamptz,claim_fence bigint not null default 0 check(claim_fence>=0),
 first_dispatched_at timestamptz,recovery_until timestamptz,expires_at timestamptz not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 safe_reason text check(safe_reason is null or safe_reason~'^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$'),
 check((claim_token is null)=(lease_until is null)),check(expires_at>created_at and expires_at<=created_at+interval '10 minutes')
)
create index billing_enrollments_owner on private.billing_enrollments(owner_id,created_at,id)

create table private.goods_subscription_plans (
 id uuid primary key,owner_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id),creation_operation_id uuid not null unique,
 creation_request_hash text not null check(creation_request_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),

 revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),credential_id uuid references private.billing_credentials(id),

 next_slot integer not null default 0 check(next_slot between 0 and 1200),next_run_at timestamptz,
 pause_reason text check(pause_reason is null or pause_reason in('customer_paused','payment_failed','stock_unavailable','goods_unavailable',
  'schedule_missed','account_unavailable','card_unavailable','delivery_unavailable','terms_changed','payment_review')),
 draft_expires_at timestamptz not null,consented_at timestamptz,canceled_at timestamptz,

 check((state='canceled')=(canceled_at is not null))
)
create index goods_subscription_plans_owner on private.goods_subscription_plans(owner_id,state,updated_at,id)

create table private.goods_subscription_terms (
 id uuid primary key,plan_id uuid not null references private.goods_subscription_plans(id),owner_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id),
 selection jsonb not null,address jsonb not null,address_revision uuid not null,schedule jsonb not null,
 delivery_choices jsonb not null,renewal_terms jsonb not null,renewal_terms_hash text not null check(renewal_terms_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 policy_terms_version text not null,first_quote_id uuid,renewal_quote_id uuid,

 check(schedule=private.subscription_normalize_schedule(schedule)),check(jsonb_typeof(selection)='array' and jsonb_array_length(selection) between 1 and 100),
 check(jsonb_typeof(address)='object' and octet_length(address::text)<=4096),check(jsonb_typeof(delivery_choices)='object'),

)
alter table private.goods_subscription_plans add constraint subscription_current_terms_fk foreign key(current_terms_id) references private.goods_subscription_terms(id)

create table private.goods_subscription_cycles (
 id uuid primary key,plan_id uuid not null references private.goods_subscription_plans(id),owner_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id),
 cycle_number integer not null check(cycle_number>0),schedule_slot integer not null check(schedule_slot between 0 and 1200),
 terms_id uuid not null references private.goods_subscription_terms(id),scheduled_at timestamptz not null,
 state text not null default 'draft' check(state in('draft','ready','prepared','dispatching','unknown','needs_review','approved','declined','canceled','skipped')),
 revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),quote_id uuid,order_id uuid unique references public.orders(id),attempt_id uuid unique references public.payment_attempts(id),
 claim_token uuid,lease_until timestamptz,claim_fence bigint not null default 0 check(claim_fence>=0),
 dispatched_at timestamptz,settled_at timestamptz,next_check_at timestamptz,
 safe_reason text check(safe_reason is null or safe_reason~'^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$'),
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 unique(plan_id,cycle_number),unique(plan_id,terms_id,schedule_slot),check((claim_token is null)=(lease_until is null)),
 check(attempt_id is null or order_id is not null),check(dispatched_at is null or attempt_id is not null)
)

create unique index goods_subscription_one_unresolved on private.goods_subscription_cycles(plan_id)
 where state in('draft','ready','prepared','dispatching','unknown','needs_review')

create index goods_subscription_due on private.goods_subscription_cycles(coalesce(next_check_at,scheduled_at),id)
 where state in('ready','prepared','dispatching','unknown','needs_review')

create table private.goods_subscription_operations (
 operation_id uuid primary key,owner_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id),plan_id uuid not null references private.goods_subscription_plans(id),

 request_hash text not null check(request_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),receipt jsonb not null,

)

create table private.payment_provider_bindings (
 attempt_id uuid primary key references public.payment_attempts(id) on delete cascade,integration text not null check(integration='toss_billing'),
 owner_id uuid not null,profile_id uuid not null references private.billing_profiles(id),
 merchant_id text not null,environment text not null check(environment in('test','live')),
 credential_id uuid not null,cycle_id uuid not null unique,
 write_key_version text not null check(write_key_version~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'),first_dispatched_at timestamptz,
 policy_version integer not null default 1 check(policy_version=1),created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create table private.billing_refund_operations (
 attempt_id uuid primary key references private.payment_provider_bindings(attempt_id) on delete cascade,idempotency_key text not null unique,

create function private.subscription_policy_summary(p_good_id text) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,'goodUpdatedAt',g.updated_at,'revision',coalesce(p.revision,0),
  'enabled',coalesce(p.enabled,false),'intervals',coalesce(p.intervals,'["month_1"]'::jsonb),'message',coalesce(p.message,''))
 from public.goods g left join private.goods_subscription_policies p on p.good_id=g.id where g.id=p_good_id;
$$

create function private.billing_registration_summary(p_id uuid,p_server boolean default false) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'state',e.state,'expiresAt',e.expires_at,'credentialId',case when e.state='ready' then e.credential_id end)
 ||case when p_server then jsonb_build_object('ownerId',e.owner_id,'sessionId',e.session_id,'profileId',e.profile_id,
  'merchantId',p.merchant_id,'environment',p.environment,'adapter',p.adapter,'customerKey',c.customer_key,
  'credentialId',e.credential_id,'writeKeyVersion',e.write_key_version,'idempotencyKey',e.idempotency_key,
  'nonceEnvelope',e.nonce_envelope,'authEnvelope',e.auth_envelope,'firstDispatchedAt',e.first_dispatched_at,
  'claimToken',e.claim_token,'claimFence',e.claim_fence,'recoveryUntil',e.recovery_until) else '{}'::jsonb end
 from private.billing_enrollments e join private.billing_profiles p on p.id=e.profile_id
 join private.billing_customers c on c.id=e.customer_id where e.id=p_id;
$$

create function public.get_my_billing_registration(p_expected_actor_id uuid,p_id uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if auth.uid() is null or auth.uid() is distinct from p_expected_actor_id
  or not exists(select 1 from private.billing_enrollments where id=p_id and owner_id=auth.uid()) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='billing_registration_forbidden';end if;
 return private.billing_registration_summary(p_id,false);
end $$

language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$

$$

create function private.subscription_selection_allowed(p_selection jsonb,p_schedule jsonb) returns boolean
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_selection) line left join public.goods g on g.id=line->>'goodId'
  left join public.goods_variants v on v.id=(line->>'variantId')::uuid and v.good_id=g.id
  left join private.goods_subscription_policies p on p.good_id=g.id
  where g.id is null or v.id is null or v.preorder_policy_id is not null or g.sale_restriction<>'none' or g.archived_at is not null or g.published_at is null or v.archived_at is not null
   or not coalesce(p.enabled,false) or not(p.intervals?((p_schedule->>'unit')||'_'||(p_schedule->>'interval'))));
$$

create function private.subscription_plan_summary(p_plan_id uuid,p_details boolean default false) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'state',p.state,'revision',p.revision,'termsId',p.current_terms_id,'pauseReason',p.pause_reason,
  'nextRunAt',p.next_run_at,'consentedAt',p.consented_at,'canceledAt',p.canceled_at,'createdAt',p.created_at,'updatedAt',p.updated_at,
  'draftExpiresAt',p.draft_expires_at,'firstCycleId',p.first_cycle_id,'firstQuoteId',t.first_quote_id,'policyTermsVersion',t.policy_terms_version,
  'schedule',t.schedule,'selection',t.selection,'firstDisplay',t.first_display,'renewalDisplay',t.renewal_display,
  'card',case when c.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'state',c.state,'issuerCode',c.issuer_code,'number',c.masked_number,'revision',c.revision) end)
 ||case when p_details then jsonb_build_object('address',t.address,'deliveryChoices',t.delivery_choices,'addressRevision',t.address_revision,
  'cycles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x.id,'number',x.cycle_number,'state',x.state,'scheduledAt',x.scheduled_at,
    'orderId',x.order_id,'orderStatus',o.status,'amount',o.total,'settledAt',x.settled_at,'reason',x.safe_reason)
    order by x.cycle_number desc) from (select * from private.goods_subscription_cycles where plan_id=p.id order by cycle_number desc limit 50) x
    left join public.orders o on o.id=x.order_id),'[]'::jsonb)) else '{}'::jsonb end
 from private.goods_subscription_plans p join private.goods_subscription_terms t on t.id=p.current_terms_id
 left join private.billing_credentials c on c.id=p.credential_id where p.id=p_plan_id;
$$

create function public.service_list_billing_credential_revocations(p_limit integer default 10) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 perform private.subscription_require_service();if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_billing_batch';end if;
 return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'actorId',owner_id) order by created_at,id) from
  (select id,owner_id,created_at from private.billing_credentials where state='revoking' and coalesce(revoke_next_check_at,created_at)<=clock_timestamp()
   and (revoke_claim_token is null or revoke_lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) order by created_at,id limit p_limit) rows),'[]'::jsonb);
end $$

create function private.goods_subscription_account_blockers(p_actor uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(reason order by reason),'[]'::jsonb) from (
  select 'subscription_active'::text as reason where exists(select 1 from private.goods_subscription_plans where owner_id=p_actor and state in('active','awaiting_first_payment','paused','needs_confirmation'))
  union all select 'subscription_payment_pending' where exists(select 1 from private.goods_subscription_cycles where owner_id=p_actor and state in('prepared','dispatching','unknown','needs_review'))
  union all select 'billing_registration_pending' where exists(select 1 from private.billing_enrollments where owner_id=p_actor and first_dispatched_at is not null and state in('processing','unknown','needs_review'))
  union all select 'billing_card_cleanup' where exists(select 1 from private.billing_credentials where owner_id=p_actor and state<>'revoked')
 ) reasons;
$$

create function private.goods_subscription_account_retention(p_actor uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('version',1,'subscriptions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'state',p.state,'createdAt',p.created_at,
  'consentedAt',p.consented_at,'canceledAt',p.canceled_at,'cycles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'number',c.cycle_number,'state',c.state,
   'orderId',c.order_id,'amount',o.total,'scheduledAt',c.scheduled_at,'settledAt',c.settled_at) order by c.cycle_number)
   from private.goods_subscription_cycles c left join public.orders o on o.id=c.order_id where c.plan_id=p.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by p.created_at,p.id)
   from private.goods_subscription_plans p where p.owner_id=p_actor and p.state<>'draft'),'[]'::jsonb));
$$

-- Reviewed post-checkout COD evidence, public previews and finance readers.
-- No provider call or carrier collection occurs through these functions.
create function private.shipping_collect_document(p_shipment_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('shipmentId',o.shipment_id,'orderId',o.order_id,'originName',s.origin_name_snapshot,'amount',o.amount,
  'state',o.state,'revision',o.revision,'updatedAt',o.updated_at,'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'operationId',e.operation_id,'event',e.event,'amount',e.amount,'recordedAt',e.created_at,
   'occurredAt',e.evidence->'occurredAt','party',e.evidence->'party','reversesOperationId',e.evidence->'reversesOperationId','reference',e.evidence->'reference','note',e.evidence->'note') order by coalesce(e.previous_revision,0),e.created_at,e.operation_id)
   from private.shipping_collect_events e where e.shipment_id=o.shipment_id),'[]'))
 from private.shipping_collect_obligations o join public.order_shipments s on s.id=o.shipment_id where o.shipment_id=p_shipment_id;
$$
grant execute on function private.shipping_collect_document(uuid) to postgres

 public.admin_record_shipping_collect_event(uuid,uuid,integer,uuid,text,bigint,timestamptz,text,uuid,text,text,uuid) to authenticated

notify pgrst,'reload schema'

-- Address-free catalog comparison includes all physical base delivery charges.
-- It never claims a payable amount or a regional surcharge without an address.
create function private.goods_transaction_base_shipping_quote(p_items jsonb,p_legacy_quote jsonb,p_at timestamptz) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$declare lines jsonb;begin
 if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) item("goodId" text,"variantId" uuid,qty integer)
  join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=item."goodId"
  join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id where d.status='active' and d.quantity_terms is not null) then return p_legacy_quote;end if;
 select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('origin_id',grouped.origin_id,'good_id',grouped.good_id,'qty',1,'unit_price',grouped.subtotal,
  'fee_type',case when grouped.quantity_terms is null then grouped.shipping_fee_type else 'individual' end,
  'individual_fee',case when grouped.quantity_terms is null then grouped.individual_fee else private.goods_quantity_delivery_fee(grouped.qty,grouped.quantity_terms) end))
 into lines from(select good.id good_id,good.origin_id,good.shipping_fee_type,good.individual_fee,d.quantity_terms,
   sum(item.qty::numeric) qty,sum(item.qty::numeric*pricing.effective_price) subtotal
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) item("goodId" text,"variantId" uuid,qty integer)
  join public.goods good on good.id=item."goodId" join public.goods_variants variant on variant.id=item."variantId" and variant.good_id=good.id
  cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_variant_price(variant.id,p_at) pricing
  left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=good.id
  left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id and d.status='active'
  group by good.id,good.origin_id,good.shipping_fee_type,good.individual_fee,d.quantity_terms) grouped;
 return private.calculate_goods_shipping(lines);
end $$
revoke all on function private.goods_transaction_base_shipping_quote(jsonb,jsonb,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function private.goods_transaction_base_shipping_quote(jsonb,jsonb,timestamptz) to postgres
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.goods_transaction_base_shipping_quote(jsonb,jsonb,timestamptz)'::regprocedure)

-- Reviewed subscription customer pagination and operator read/inspection/export.
-- No provider request or rollout gate is enabled by this migration.
create function public.get_my_goods_subscriptions_page(p_expected_actor_id uuid,p_before_at timestamptz default null,p_before_id uuid default null,p_limit integer default 50) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 if auth.uid() is null or auth.uid() is distinct from p_expected_actor_id then raise insufficient_privilege using message='subscription_actor_changed';end if;
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 or (p_before_at is null) is distinct from (p_before_id is null) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_subscription_cursor';end if;
 with eligible as(select p.* from private.goods_subscription_plans p where p.owner_id=auth.uid() and (p.state<>'draft' or p.draft_expires_at>clock_timestamp())),
 page as(select * from eligible where p_before_at is null or (updated_at,id)<(p_before_at,p_before_id) order by updated_at desc,id desc limit p_limit+1),
 shown as(select * from page order by updated_at desc,id desc limit p_limit)
 select jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.subscription_plan_summary(id,false) order by updated_at desc,id desc) from shown),'[]'::jsonb),
  'total',(select count(*) from eligible),'hasMore',(select count(*)>p_limit from page),
  'nextCursor',case when (select count(*)>p_limit from page) then (select jsonb_build_object('updatedAt',updated_at,'id',id) from shown order by updated_at,id limit 1) end) into result;
 return result;
end $$

create function private.subscription_cycle_page(p_plan_id uuid,p_before_number integer,p_limit integer) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 with page as(select * from private.goods_subscription_cycles where plan_id=p_plan_id and (p_before_number is null or cycle_number<p_before_number) order by cycle_number desc limit p_limit+1),
 shown as(select * from page order by cycle_number desc limit p_limit)
 select jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'number',c.cycle_number,'state',c.state,'scheduledAt',c.scheduled_at,
  'orderId',c.order_id,'orderStatus',o.status,'amount',o.total,'settledAt',c.settled_at,'reason',c.safe_reason) order by c.cycle_number desc)
  from shown c left join public.orders o on o.id=c.order_id),'[]'::jsonb),'total',(select count(*) from private.goods_subscription_cycles where plan_id=p_plan_id),
  'hasMore',(select count(*)>p_limit from page),'nextBeforeNumber',case when (select count(*)>p_limit from page) then (select min(cycle_number) from shown) end);
$$

create function private.subscription_console_row(p_plan_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'ownerId',p.owner_id,'buyerName',coalesce(pr.nickname,'회원'),'state',p.state,'revision',p.revision,
  'createdAt',p.created_at,'updatedAt',p.updated_at,'nextRunAt',p.next_run_at,'reason',p.pause_reason,'schedule',t.schedule,
  'renewalOnlineTotal',t.renewal_display#>'{totals,onlineTotal}','renewalCollectTotal',t.renewal_display#>'{totals,collectShippingTotal}',
  'goodsLabel',coalesce((select string_agg(coalesce(g.name,'상품')||' '||(x->>'qty')||'개',', ' order by x->>'goodId',x->>'variantId')
    from jsonb_array_elements(t.selection) x left join public.goods g on g.id=x->>'goodId'),''),
  'cycleCount',(select count(*) from private.goods_subscription_cycles where plan_id=p.id),
  'paidCycleCount',(select count(*) from private.goods_subscription_cycles c join public.orders o on o.id=c.order_id where c.plan_id=p.id and c.state='approved' and o.status not in('pending','canceled')),
  'paidOnlineTotal',(select coalesce(sum(o.total),0) from private.goods_subscription_cycles c join public.orders o on o.id=c.order_id where c.plan_id=p.id and c.state='approved' and o.status not in('pending','canceled')),
  'latestCycle',case when last_cycle.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',last_cycle.id,'number',last_cycle.cycle_number,'state',last_cycle.state,
   'orderId',last_cycle.order_id,'dispatchedAt',last_cycle.dispatched_at,'nextCheckAt',last_cycle.next_check_at,'reason',last_cycle.safe_reason) end)
 from private.goods_subscription_plans p join private.goods_subscription_terms t on t.id=p.current_terms_id left join public.profiles pr on pr.id=p.owner_id
 left join lateral(select * from private.goods_subscription_cycles where plan_id=p.id order by cycle_number desc limit 1) last_cycle on true where p.id=p_plan_id;
$$

create function private.subscription_console_ids(p_state text,p_search text) returns table(id uuid,updated_at timestamptz)
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select p.id,p.updated_at from private.goods_subscription_plans p join private.goods_subscription_terms t on t.id=p.current_terms_id
 left join public.profiles pr on pr.id=p.owner_id where (p_state is null or p.state=p_state)
 and (p.state<>'draft' or p.draft_expires_at>clock_timestamp()) and (p_search='' or position(lower(p_search) in lower(p.id::text))>0
  or position(lower(p_search) in lower(coalesce(pr.nickname,'')))>0 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(t.selection) item
   left join public.goods g on g.id=item->>'goodId' where position(lower(p_search) in lower(coalesce(g.name,'')||' '||(item->>'goodId')))>0));

-- Reviewed integration of the existing phase-one fence and legal-snapshot lifecycle.
-- No auth deletion, payment-attempt anonymization or automatic card revocation.
create function private.goods_transaction_account_blockers(p_actor uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.gift_account_deletion_blockers(p_actor)
  ||coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',reason,'count',1,'path','/my/subscriptions') order by reason)
    from jsonb_array_elements_text(private.goods_subscription_account_blockers(p_actor)) reason),'[]')
  ||case when exists(select 1 from private.shipping_collect_obligations obligation join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=obligation.order_id
     where purchase.user_id=p_actor and obligation.state in('planned','refund_review','mismatch'))
    then jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','active_shipping_collect','count',(select count(*) from private.shipping_collect_obligations obligation
     join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=obligation.order_id where purchase.user_id=p_actor and obligation.state in('planned','refund_review','mismatch')),'path','/orders')) else '[]'::jsonb end;
$$

 ('order','order_cancellation','shipment','payment','refund','ticket_order','ticket_cancellation','ticket_check_in','subscription_contract'))

create function private.snapshot_goods_subscription_contracts(p_deletion_event_id uuid,p_actor uuid) returns void
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots(deletion_event_id,record_type,record_ref,snapshot_data,legal_basis,retain_until)
 select p_deletion_event_id,'subscription_contract',contract->>'id',contract,'ecommerce_transaction_v1',last_event.at+interval '5 years'
 from jsonb_array_elements(private.goods_subscription_account_retention(p_actor)->'subscriptions') contract
 cross join lateral(select greatest((contract->>'createdAt')::timestamptz,(contract->>'consentedAt')::timestamptz,(contract->>'canceledAt')::timestamptz,
   (select max((cycle->>'settledAt')::timestamptz) from jsonb_array_elements(contract->'cycles') cycle)) at) last_event
 where last_event.at+interval '5 years'>clock_timestamp()
 on conflict(deletion_event_id,record_type,record_ref) do update set snapshot_data=excluded.snapshot_data,
  retain_until=greatest(private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,excluded.retain_until)
 where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;
end $$

-- Retain consent evidence without shipping addresses, free-form item inputs,
-- billing identities, ciphertext, or provider secrets. Existing RPC shape stays v1.
create function private.subscription_retention_display(p_display jsonb,p_recorded_at timestamptz) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('calculationVersion',p_display->'calculationVersion','currency',p_display->'currency',
  'totals',jsonb_build_object('subtotal',p_display#>'{totals,subtotal}','volumeDiscountTotal',p_display#>'{totals,volumeDiscountTotal}',
   'netGoodsTotal',p_display#>'{totals,netGoodsTotal}','couponDiscountTotal',p_display#>'{totals,couponDiscountTotal}',
   'storeCreditTotal',p_display#>'{totals,storeCreditTotal}','prepaidShippingTotal',p_display#>'{totals,prepaidShippingTotal}',
   'collectShippingTotal',p_display#>'{totals,collectShippingTotal}','onlineTotal',p_display#>'{totals,onlineTotal}','customerTotal',p_display#>'{totals,customerTotal}'),
  'lines',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId',line->'goodId','variantId',line->'variantId','qty',line->'qty',
    'regularUnitPrice',line->'regularUnitPrice','unitPrice',line->'unitPrice','volumeUnitDiscount',line->'volumeUnitDiscount',
    'subtotal',line->'subtotal','volumeDiscountTotal',line->'volumeDiscountTotal','netSubtotal',line->'netSubtotal',
    'couponDiscount',line->'couponDiscount','storeCreditDiscount',line->'storeCreditDiscount','paidGoodsTotal',line->'paidGoodsTotal','volumePolicyId',line->'volumePolicyId') order by ordinal)
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'lines') with ordinality selected(line,ordinal)),'[]'),
  'shipping',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('originId',shipping->'originId','prepaidFee',shipping->'prepaidFee',
    'collectFee',shipping->'collectFee','fullFee',shipping->'fullFee','components',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'goodId',component->'goodId','paymentMode',component->'paymentMode','baseFee',component->'baseFee','regionalFee',component->'regionalFee',
     'totalFee',component->'totalFee','deliveryPolicyId',component->'deliveryPolicyId') order by component->>'goodId')
     from jsonb_array_elements(shipping->'components') component),'[]'),
    -- The public collector copy may contain contact/free text. Retain its hash
    -- and matching immutable business contract versions, never that copy itself.
    'collectorTermsHash',case when shipping->'collector' is not null and shipping->'collector'<>'null'::jsonb
      then encode(sha256(convert_to((shipping->'collector')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') end,
    'matchingCollectContractVersions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(contract.id order by contract.created_at,contract.id)
      from private.shipping_collect_contract_versions contract where contract.origin_id::text=shipping->>'originId'
       and contract.created_at<=p_recorded_at and contract.status='active'
       and jsonb_build_object('name',contract.contract_values->>'collectorName','method',contract.contract_values->>'collectionMethod',
        'refundContact',contract.contract_values->>'refundContact','instructions',contract.contract_values->>'customerInstructions')=shipping->'collector'),'[]')) order by ordinal)
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'shipping') with ordinality selected(shipping,ordinal)),'[]'));
$$

create or replace function private.goods_subscription_account_retention(p_actor uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('version',1,'subscriptions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'state',p.state,
  'createdAt',p.created_at,'consentedAt',p.consented_at,'canceledAt',p.canceled_at,'currentTermsId',p.current_terms_id,
  'terms',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'createdAt',t.created_at,'policyTermsVersion',t.policy_terms_version,
    'renewalTermsHash',t.renewal_terms_hash,'schedule',jsonb_build_object('unit',t.schedule->'unit','interval',t.schedule->'interval',
     'anchorDate',t.schedule->'anchorDate','time',t.schedule->'time','monthEnd',t.schedule->'monthEnd'),
    'selection',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId',line->'goodId','variantId',line->'variantId',
      'qty',line->'qty','inputRevision',line->'inputRevision') order by ordinal)
      from jsonb_array_elements(t.selection) with ordinality selected(line,ordinal)),'[]'),
    'firstAmounts',private.subscription_retention_display(t.first_display,t.created_at),
    'renewalAmounts',private.subscription_retention_display(t.renewal_display,t.created_at)) order by t.created_at,t.id)
    from private.goods_subscription_terms t where t.plan_id=p.id and exists(select 1 from private.goods_subscription_cycles c where c.plan_id=p.id and c.terms_id=t.id)),'[]'),
  'operations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',operation.operation_id,'command',operation.command,
    'recordedAt',operation.created_at,'requestHash',operation.request_hash,'revision',operation.receipt->'revision','state',operation.receipt->'state',
    'cycleId',cycle.id,'termsId',cycle.terms_id,'orderId',cycle.order_id) order by operation.created_at,operation.operation_id)
    from private.goods_subscription_operations operation left join private.goods_subscription_cycles cycle on cycle.plan_id=p.id and cycle.id::text=operation.receipt->>'cycleId'
    where operation.plan_id=p.id),'[]'),
  'cycles',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'number',c.cycle_number,'slot',c.schedule_slot,'termsId',c.terms_id,'state',c.state,
    'orderId',c.order_id,'amount',o.total,'scheduledAt',c.scheduled_at,'settledAt',c.settled_at) order by c.cycle_number)
    from private.goods_subscription_cycles c left join public.orders o on o.id=c.order_id where c.plan_id=p.id),'[]')) order by p.created_at,p.id)
   from private.goods_subscription_plans p where p.owner_id=p_actor and p.state<>'draft' and p.consented_at is not null),'[]'));
$$
revoke all on function private.subscription_retention_display(jsonb,timestamptz) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

notify pgrst,'reload schema'

-- Source categories still mean merchandise taxonomy; display nodes are separate.
create function private.category_display_source_category(p_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 with recursive lineage as (
  select c.id,c.parent_id,c.archived_at,1 as hops from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=p_id
  union all select p.id,p.parent_id,p.archived_at,l.hops+1 from public.catalog_categories p join lineage l on p.id=l.parent_id where l.hops<4
 ) select jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'name',c.name,'parentId',c.parent_id,'depth',c.depth,'sortOrder',c.sort_order,
  'publicEnabled',coalesce((select customer_enabled from public.category_activation_control where id='catalog'),false)
    and not exists(select 1 from lineage where archived_at is not null)
    and exists(select 1 from lineage where parent_id is null))
 from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=p_id and c.archived_at is null;
$$
revoke all on function private.category_display_source_category(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function private.category_display_source_category(uuid) to postgres

create or replace function private.category_display_category(p_id uuid) returns jsonb

  union all select p.id,p.parent_id,p.archived_at,l.hops+1 from private.category_display_nodes p join lineage l on p.id=l.parent_id where l.hops<4
 ) select jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'name',c.name,'parentId',c.parent_id,'depth',(select count(*) from lineage),'sortOrder',c.sort_order,
  'archivedAt',c.archived_at,'legacyCategoryId',c.legacy_category_id,

    and not exists(select 1 from lineage where archived_at is not null)

 from private.category_display_nodes c where c.id=p_id;
$$

  'video',jsonb_build_object('enabled',false,'goodId',null),'recommendations',jsonb_build_object('enabled',false,'title','추천상품','itemCount',3,'goodIds','[]'::jsonb));

create or replace function public.get_category_display_navigation() returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 with recursive display_tree as (
  select n.id,array[lpad(n.sort_order::text,10,'0')||':'||coalesce(n.legacy_sort_key,n.id::text)] path from private.category_display_nodes n where n.parent_id is null
  union all select n.id,t.path||(lpad(n.sort_order::text,10,'0')||':'||coalesce(n.legacy_sort_key,n.id::text)) from private.category_display_nodes n join display_tree t on n.parent_id=t.id
 ) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',n.id,'name',n.name,'depth',(private.category_display_category(n.id)->>'depth')::integer) order by t.path),'[]'::jsonb)
 from private.category_display_compositions d join private.category_display_nodes n on n.id=d.category_id join display_tree t on t.id=n.id

$$
