ledger.name: order_claim_refund_account_completion
statements:
-- Payer-only completion of a missing refund account on an existing
-- ordinary bank-transfer claim. Apply only to an owned disposable clone first.
-- Approval opens a requested refund row; it does not mean a transfer was filed.
-- No payment, refund amount, order status, stock, or gift contract is changed.

create table private.order_claim_refund_account_operations (
 id uuid primary key,
 actor_id uuid not null,
 session_id uuid not null,
 order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id) on delete cascade,
 claim_id uuid not null references public.order_cancellation_requests(id) on delete cascade,
 expected_revision integer not null check(expected_revision>=0),
 result_revision integer not null,
 state text not null check(state in('saved','sealed')),
 request_hash text check(request_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 hash_purged_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check(result_revision=expected_revision+case when state='saved' then 1 else 0 end),
 check((state='sealed' and request_hash is null and hash_purged_at is null)
  or(state='saved' and ((request_hash is not null and hash_purged_at is null)
    or(request_hash is null and hash_purged_at is not null))))
)
create index order_claim_refund_account_operations_claim on private.order_claim_refund_account_operations(claim_id)
alter table private.order_claim_refund_account_operations enable row level security
revoke all on private.order_claim_refund_account_operations from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.require_claim_refund_account_identity(p_actor uuid,p_session_id uuid) returns void
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
 if p_actor is null or auth.uid() is distinct from p_actor or p_session_id is null
  or auth.jwt()->>'session_id' is distinct from p_session_id::text
  or not exists(select 1 from auth.sessions where id=p_session_id and user_id=p_actor
    and (not_after is null or not_after>statement_timestamp()))
  or not exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=p_actor) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='refund_account_auth_changed';
 end if;
end $$

create function private.order_claim_refund_account_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests,p_order public.orders) returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case
  when p_order.id is null or p_claim.id is null or p_claim.order_id is distinct from p_order.id then 'claim_not_found'
  when exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents where order_id=p_order.id) then 'refund_account_gift_order'
  when p_order.payment_method is distinct from 'bank_transfer' or p_order.total<=0 then 'refund_account_payment_unavailable'
  when p_order.status::text not in('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done')
   or p_claim.claim_type not in('cancel','return')
   or p_claim.stage not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected','on_hold','processing','needs_review')
   or p_claim.status not in('requested','processing','needs_review') then 'refund_account_claim_closed'
  when exists(select 1 from private.claim_refund_accounts where claim_id=p_claim.id) then 'refund_account_already_recorded'
  when not exists(select 1 from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=p_order.id and provider='bank_transfer' and status='paid' and amount>0)
   or exists(select 1 from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=p_order.id and(provider<>'bank_transfer' or status<>'paid'))
   or (select sum(amount) from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=p_order.id) is distinct from p_order.total then 'refund_account_payment_unavailable'
  when exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id
   where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_order.id and(r.status<>'requested' or r.method is not null
    or r.filed_at is not null or r.completed_at is not null or r.handled_by is not null
    or r.cancellation_request_id is distinct from p_claim.id or r.amount<>p.amount)) then 'refund_account_finance_started'
  else null end;
$$

create function private.order_claim_refund_account_receipt(p_operation_id uuid,p_actor uuid,p_session_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('operationId',id,'actorId',actor_id,'orderId',order_id,'claimId',claim_id,
  'revision',expected_revision,'resultRevision',result_revision,'state',state,'createdAt',created_at)
 from private.order_claim_refund_account_operations where id=p_operation_id and actor_id=p_actor and session_id=p_session_id;
$$

-- The sole extra account-derived value follows the existing account's purge.
-- Historical receipts remain readable, with no raw account or digest returned.
create function private.purge_claim_refund_account_operation_hash() returns trigger
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
 if new.purged_at is not null and old.purged_at is null then
  update private.order_claim_refund_account_operations set request_hash=null,hash_purged_at=new.purged_at
   where claim_id=new.claim_id and state='saved' and request_hash is not null;
 end if;
 return null;
end $$

create trigger claim_refund_account_operation_hash_retention after update of purged_at on private.claim_refund_accounts
 for each row execute function private.purge_claim_refund_account_operation_hash()
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.require_claim_refund_account_identity(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.lock_claim_refund_account_session(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.order_claim_refund_account_blocker(public.order_cancellation_requests,public.orders)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.order_claim_refund_account_receipt(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.purge_claim_refund_account_operation_hash()'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('public.get_my_order_claim_refund_account_context(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('public.set_my_order_claim_refund_account(uuid,uuid,uuid,integer,text,text,text,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('public.read_my_order_claim_refund_account_operation(uuid,uuid,uuid,integer,uuid,uuid,boolean)'::regprocedure)
notify pgrst,'reload schema'

ledger.name: bank_transfer_refund_lifecycle
statements:
-- ADR-0010 bank-transfer refunds.
-- Cancellation confirmation restores stock, but only immutable transfer evidence
-- closes the payment, refund and claim. Card-provider evidence remains unchanged.

alter table public.refunds drop constraint refunds_status_check

alter table public.refunds add constraint refunds_status_check
 check(status in('requested','awaiting_transfer','done','failed'))

create table private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds (
 claim_id uuid primary key references public.order_cancellation_requests(id),
 order_id uuid not null unique references public.orders(id),
 payment_id uuid not null unique references public.payments(id),
 payer_id uuid not null,
 amount integer not null check(amount>0),
 state text not null check(state in('awaiting_transfer','completed')),
 confirmation_operation_id uuid not null unique,
 confirmed_by uuid not null,
 confirmed_at timestamptz not null,
 confirmation_evidence text not null check(char_length(confirmation_evidence) between 2 and 300),
 confirmation_note text not null check(char_length(confirmation_note) between 2 and 300),
 transfer_operation_id uuid unique,
 transferred_by uuid,
 transferred_at timestamptz,
 transfer_evidence text,
 transfer_note text,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check((state='awaiting_transfer' and transfer_operation_id is null and transferred_by is null and transferred_at is null
   and transfer_evidence is null and transfer_note is null)
  or(state='completed' and transfer_operation_id is not null and transferred_by is not null and transferred_at is not null
   and transfer_evidence is not null and transfer_note is not null
   and char_length(transfer_evidence) between 2 and 300 and char_length(transfer_note) between 2 and 300))
)

create table private.bank_transfer_refund_operations (
 id uuid primary key,
 actor_id uuid not null,
 session_id uuid not null,
 order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id),
 claim_id uuid not null references public.order_cancellation_requests(id),
 kind text not null check(kind in('confirm_cancellation','file_transfer','complete_transfer')),
 expected_revision integer not null check(expected_revision>=0),
 amount integer not null check(amount>0),
 state text not null check(state in('recorded','sealed')),
 request_hash text check(request_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 occurred_at timestamptz,
 evidence text,
 note text,
 receipt jsonb not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check((state='sealed' and request_hash is null and occurred_at is null and evidence is null and note is null)
  or(state='recorded' and request_hash is not null and occurred_at is not null
   and evidence is not null and note is not null
   and char_length(evidence) between 2 and 300 and char_length(note) between 2 and 300))
)
create index bank_transfer_refund_operations_claim on private.bank_transfer_refund_operations(claim_id,created_at,id)

create table private.bank_transfer_refund_account_views (
 id uuid primary key,
 actor_id uuid not null,
 session_id uuid not null,
 order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id),
 claim_id uuid not null references public.order_cancellation_requests(id),
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)
alter table private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds enable row level security
alter table private.bank_transfer_refund_operations enable row level security
alter table private.bank_transfer_refund_account_views enable row level security

revoke all on private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds,private.bank_transfer_refund_operations,
 private.bank_transfer_refund_account_views from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

-- Existing protected functions are owned by postgres on supported databases.
-- Their narrow read/dispatch grants are internal; no API role gets table access.
grant select on private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds to postgres

-- One bank-only implementation. The existing public finalizer dispatches here
-- only when the durable payment is bank_transfer, never from browser input.
create function private.bank_transfer_refund_legacy_completed(p_order_id uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders purchase where purchase.id=p_order_id
  and purchase.status='canceled' and purchase.payment_method='bank_transfer'
  and not exists(select 1 from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds where order_id=purchase.id)
  and(select count(*) from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=purchase.id and status<>'failed')=1
  and exists(select 1 from public.payments p join public.refunds r on r.payment_id=p.id
   join public.order_cancellation_requests c on c.id=r.cancellation_request_id and c.order_id=purchase.id
   where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=purchase.id and p.provider='bank_transfer' and p.user_id=purchase.user_id
    and p.status='refunded' and p.amount=purchase.total and p.amount>0
    and r.amount=p.amount and r.status='done' and r.method='bank_transfer' and r.filed_at is not null and r.completed_at is not null
    and c.stage='completed' and c.status='completed')
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=purchase.id));
$$

create function private.bank_transfer_refund_pending_evidence_valid(p_order_id uuid,p_payment_id uuid default null) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds lifecycle
  join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=lifecycle.order_id
  join public.order_cancellation_requests claim on claim.id=lifecycle.claim_id and claim.order_id=purchase.id
  join public.payments payment on payment.id=lifecycle.payment_id
  join public.refunds refund on refund.payment_id=payment.id
  where purchase.id=p_order_id and purchase.payment_method='bank_transfer' and lifecycle.state='awaiting_transfer'
   and(p_payment_id is null or payment.id=p_payment_id)
   and payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=purchase.id and payment.provider='bank_transfer' and payment.status='paid'
   and payment.user_id=lifecycle.payer_id and purchase.user_id=lifecycle.payer_id and claim.requested_by=lifecycle.payer_id
   and payment.amount=lifecycle.amount and purchase.total=lifecycle.amount and lifecycle.amount>0
   and refund.status='awaiting_transfer' and refund.method='bank_transfer' and refund.amount=lifecycle.amount
   and refund.cancellation_request_id=claim.id and refund.completed_at is null
   and claim.claim_type in('cancel','return') and claim.stage in('processing','needs_review')
   and private.claim_collections_complete(claim.id)
   and(select count(*) from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=purchase.id)=1);
$$

-- The order-level helper is valid for the finalizer. A claim reader/replay must
-- also prove that this particular claim owns the completed historical refund.
create function private.bank_transfer_refund_legacy_completed_claim(p_order_id uuid,p_claim_id uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.bank_transfer_refund_legacy_completed(p_order_id) and exists(
  select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c join public.refunds r on r.cancellation_request_id=c.id
  join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id
  where c.id=p_claim_id and c.order_id=p_order_id and c.stage='completed' and c.status='completed'
   and p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_order_id and p.provider='bank_transfer' and p.status='refunded'
   and r.status='done' and r.method='bank_transfer' and r.filed_at is not null and r.completed_at is not null);
$$

create trigger refunds_bank_transfer_evidence before insert or update on public.refunds
 for each row execute function private.guard_bank_transfer_refund_ledger()
create trigger payments_bank_transfer_evidence before update on public.payments for each row execute function private.guard_bank_transfer_refund_lifecycle()
create trigger claims_bank_transfer_evidence before update on public.order_cancellation_requests for each row execute function private.guard_bank_transfer_refund_lifecycle()
create trigger accounts_bank_transfer_pending before update on private.claim_refund_accounts for each row execute function private.guard_bank_transfer_refund_lifecycle()

-- Preserve financial proof in the existing legal refund snapshot. Account
-- numbers, holder names, session identifiers and request hashes are excluded.
create function private.bank_transfer_refund_legal_proof(p_payment_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('claimId',claim_id,'amount',amount,'state',state,'confirmationOperationId',confirmation_operation_id,
  'confirmedBy',confirmed_by,'confirmedAt',confirmed_at,'confirmationEvidence',confirmation_evidence,'confirmationNote',confirmation_note,
  'transferOperationId',transfer_operation_id,'transferredBy',transferred_by,'transferredAt',transferred_at,
  'transferEvidence',transfer_evidence,'transferNote',transfer_note)
 from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds where payment_id=p_payment_id;
$$
notify pgrst,'reload schema'

ledger.name: goods_aggregation_families
statements:
-- DRAFT: immutable financial families survive display regrouping and option conversion.
-- No existing goods, orders, policy versions or runtime gates are rewritten.
create table private.goods_aggregation_roots (
 root_good_id text primary key references public.goods(id),
 aggregation_id uuid not null unique default gen_random_uuid(),
 created_by uuid not null references auth.users(id),
 operation_id uuid not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create table private.goods_aggregation_members (
 good_id text primary key references public.goods(id),
 root_good_id text not null references private.goods_aggregation_roots(root_good_id),
 created_by uuid not null references auth.users(id),
 operation_id uuid not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)
create index goods_aggregation_members_root_idx on private.goods_aggregation_members(root_good_id,good_id)

create function private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good_id text) returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce((select root_good_id from private.goods_aggregation_members where good_id=p_good_id),p_good_id);
$$

create function private.guard_goods_aggregation_identity() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 raise check_violation using message='goods_aggregation_identity_immutable';
end $$

create trigger goods_aggregation_roots_immutable before update or delete on private.goods_aggregation_roots
 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_aggregation_identity()

create trigger goods_aggregation_members_immutable before update or delete on private.goods_aggregation_members
 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_aggregation_identity()

create function private.goods_aggregation_shared_policy(p_good_id text) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('originId',g.origin_id,'shippingFeeType',g.shipping_fee_type,'individualFee',g.individual_fee,
  'orderQuantityLimitEnabled',g.order_quantity_limit_enabled,'minOrderQty',g.min_order_qty,'maxOrderQty',g.max_order_qty,
  'memberPurchaseLimitEnabled',g.member_purchase_limit_enabled,'memberLifetimeQtyLimit',g.member_lifetime_qty_limit)
 from public.goods g where g.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good_id);
$$

create trigger goods_aggregation_shared_policy_guard before update on public.goods
 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_aggregation_policy()

create trigger goods_aggregation_config_guard before insert or update on private.goods_transaction_configs
 for each row execute function private.guard_goods_aggregation_config()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.member_goods_reserved_qty(p_user_id uuid, p_good_id text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(sum(item.qty::bigint),0)
  from public.order_items item join public.orders orders on orders.id=item.order_id
  where orders.user_id=p_user_id and private.goods_aggregation_owner(item.good_id)=private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good_id) and orders.status<>'canceled';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.check_goods_purchase_quantity(p_good goods, p_user_id uuid, p_qty bigint, p_check_minimum boolean)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when policy.order_quantity_limit_enabled and (policy.min_order_qty is null or policy.max_order_qty is null)
      then 'purchase_limit_not_configured'
    when policy.member_purchase_limit_enabled and policy.member_lifetime_qty_limit is null
      then 'purchase_limit_not_configured'
    when policy.order_quantity_limit_enabled and p_check_minimum and p_qty<policy.min_order_qty
      then 'order_quantity_below_minimum'
    when policy.order_quantity_limit_enabled and p_qty>policy.max_order_qty
      then 'order_quantity_above_maximum'
    when policy.member_purchase_limit_enabled and p_user_id is not null
      and private.member_goods_reserved_qty(p_user_id,policy.id)+p_qty>policy.member_lifetime_qty_limit
      then 'member_purchase_limit_exceeded'
    else null end
  from public.goods policy where policy.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good.id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_transaction_base_shipping_quote(p_items jsonb, p_legacy_quote jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare lines jsonb;begin
 if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) i("goodId" text) join private.goods_aggregation_members m on m.good_id=i."goodId") and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) item("goodId" text,"variantId" uuid,qty integer)
  join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(item."goodId")
  join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id where d.status='active' and d.quantity_terms is not null) then return p_legacy_quote;end if;
 select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('origin_id',grouped.origin_id,'good_id',grouped.good_id,'qty',1,'unit_price',grouped.subtotal,
  'fee_type',case when grouped.quantity_terms is null then grouped.shipping_fee_type else 'individual' end,
  'individual_fee',case when grouped.quantity_terms is null then grouped.individual_fee else private.goods_quantity_delivery_fee(grouped.qty,grouped.quantity_terms) end))
 into lines from(select good.id good_id,good.origin_id,good.shipping_fee_type,good.individual_fee,d.quantity_terms,
   sum(item.qty::numeric) qty,sum(item.qty::numeric*pricing.effective_price) subtotal
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) item("goodId" text,"variantId" uuid,qty integer)
  join public.goods good on good.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(item."goodId") join public.goods_variants variant on variant.id=item."variantId" and variant.good_id=item."goodId"
  cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_variant_price(variant.id,p_at) pricing
  left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=good.id
  left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id and d.status='active'
  group by good.id,good.origin_id,good.shipping_fee_type,good.individual_fee,d.quantity_terms) grouped;
 return private.calculate_goods_shipping(lines);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_transaction_terms_document(p_good_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,'revision',coalesce(c.revision,0),'goodUpdatedAt',g.updated_at,
  'volume',case when v.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',v.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',v.revision,'status',v.status,'terms',v.terms,'draftValues',v.draft_values) end,
  'delivery',case when d.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',d.revision,'status',d.status,
   'paymentMode',d.payment_mode,'quantityTerms',d.quantity_terms,'draftValues',d.draft_values) end)
 from public.goods g left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(g.id)
 left join private.goods_volume_discount_versions v on v.id=c.volume_version_id
 left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id where g.id=p_good_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_goods_transaction_offers(p_good_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 if p_good_ids is null or cardinality(p_good_ids)>1000 or array_position(p_good_ids,null) is not null
  or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_good_ids) id where char_length(id) not between 1 and 200 or id<>btrim(id) or id~'[[:cntrl:]]') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_transaction_offer_ids';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,
  'volume',case when v.status='active' then jsonb_build_object('id',v.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',v.revision,'status',v.status,'terms',v.terms,'draftValues','{}'::jsonb) end,
  'delivery',case when d.status='active' then jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',d.revision,'status',d.status,
   'paymentMode',d.payment_mode,'quantityTerms',d.quantity_terms,'draftValues','{}'::jsonb) end,
  'collectReady',coalesce(contract.status='active' and origin.is_active,false),
  'collector',case when contract.status='active' and origin.is_active then jsonb_build_object('name',contract.contract_values->>'collectorName',
   'method',contract.contract_values->>'collectionMethod','refundContact',contract.contract_values->>'refundContact','instructions',contract.contract_values->>'customerInstructions') end)
  ||case when family.aggregation_id is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('aggregation',jsonb_build_object('id',family.aggregation_id,'requiresV2',true,
   'runtimeEnabled',(select enabled from private.goods_transaction_runtime where singleton)),'sharedPolicy',private.goods_aggregation_shared_policy(g.id)) end
  order by g.id),'[]') into result from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id
  left join private.goods_aggregation_members member on member.good_id=g.id
  left join private.goods_aggregation_roots family on family.root_good_id=member.root_good_id
  join public.goods owner_good on owner_good.id=coalesce(member.root_good_id,g.id)
  left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=owner_good.id left join private.goods_volume_discount_versions v on v.id=c.volume_version_id
  left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id left join public.fulfillment_origins origin on origin.id=owner_good.origin_id
  left join private.shipping_collect_contracts collector on collector.origin_id=origin.id
  left join private.shipping_collect_contract_versions contract on contract.id=collector.version_id
 where g.id=any(p_good_ids) and g.published_at is not null and g.archived_at is null and g.sale_restriction='none'
  and ip.published_at is not null and ip.archived_at is null;
 return result;
end $function$

create function private.goods_group_conversion_blockers(p_good_id text) returns text[]
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select array_remove(array[
  case when not exists(select 1 from public.goods where id=p_good_id and archived_at is null) then 'source_unavailable' end,
  case when exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members where good_id=p_good_id) then 'already_grouped' end,
  case when exists(select 1 from public.goods_variants where good_id=p_good_id and preorder_policy_id is not null)
   then 'preorder_policy_attached' end,
  case when exists(select 1 from private.goods_subscription_policies where good_id=p_good_id and enabled)
   or exists(select 1 from private.goods_subscription_plans p join private.goods_subscription_terms t on t.id=p.current_terms_id
    where p.state in('awaiting_first_payment','active','paused','needs_confirmation')
     and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(t.selection) line where line->>'goodId'=p_good_id)) then 'subscription_active' end,
  case when exists(select 1 from private.gift_items item join private.gift_intents gift on gift.id=item.gift_id
    where item.good_id=p_good_id and gift.state in('awaiting_acceptance','accepted') and gift.order_id is null)
   then 'gift_pending' end,
  case when exists(select 1 from public.order_items item join public.orders o on o.id=item.order_id
    where item.good_id=p_good_id and o.status='pending')
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_items item join public.payment_attempts attempt on attempt.ref_id=item.order_id and attempt.purpose='order'
    where item.good_id=p_good_id and attempt.state in('prepared','confirming','unknown','needs_review')) then 'payment_pending' end,
  case when exists(select 1 from public.goods_variants v join private.goods_variant_purchase_costs c on c.variant_id=v.id
    where v.good_id=p_good_id and c.unit_cost_krw is not null) and not private.can_manage_goods_purchase_costs()
   then 'purchase_cost_permission_required' end,
  case when exists(select 1 from public.goods g where g.id=p_good_id and g.category_id is not null
    and not exists(select 1 from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=g.category_id and c.archived_at is null
      and not exists(select 1 from public.catalog_categories child where child.parent_id=c.id and child.archived_at is null)))
   then 'category_review_required' end
 ],null);
$$
revoke all on function private.goods_group_conversion_blockers(text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function private.goods_group_conversion_blockers(text) to postgres

-- All amounts requiring separate authority remain private. The fingerprint uses
-- only a cost revision and never returns purchase cost in a plan or audit row.
create function private.goods_group_source_hash(p_good_id text) returns text
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object(
  'good',(select to_jsonb(g) from public.goods g where id=p_good_id),
  'variants',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) order by v.id) from public.goods_variants v where good_id=p_good_id),
  'periods',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by p.id) from private.goods_variant_price_periods p where good_id=p_good_id),
  'external',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) order by e.variant_id) from private.goods_variant_external_identity e
    join public.goods_variants v on v.id=e.variant_id where v.good_id=p_good_id),
  'costRevisions',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(c.variant_id,c.revision) order by c.variant_id) from private.goods_variant_purchase_costs c
    join public.goods_variants v on v.id=c.variant_id where v.good_id=p_good_id),
  'attributes',(select to_jsonb(a) from public.goods_attribute_values a where good_id=p_good_id),
  'categorySchema',(select to_jsonb(s) from public.catalog_category_attribute_schemas s join public.goods g on g.category_id=s.category_id where g.id=p_good_id),
  'additionalCategories',(select jsonb_agg(category_id order by category_id) from public.goods_additional_categories where good_id=p_good_id),
  'benefit',(select to_jsonb(b) from private.goods_benefit_content b where good_id=p_good_id),
  'afterSales',(select to_jsonb(a) from private.goods_after_sales_content a where good_id=p_good_id),
  'sizeChart',(select to_jsonb(s) from private.goods_size_charts s where good_id=p_good_id),
  'media',(select to_jsonb(m) from private.goods_media_bindings m where good_id=p_good_id),
  'listing',(select to_jsonb(c) from private.goods_listing_colors c where good_id=p_good_id),
  'additional',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.sort_order,a.target_good_id) from private.goods_additional_links a where base_good_id=p_good_id),
  'owner',private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good_id),
  'sharedPolicy',private.goods_aggregation_shared_policy(p_good_id),
  'transactions',(select to_jsonb(c) from private.goods_transaction_configs c where good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good_id)),
  'kc',(select to_jsonb(k) from private.goods_kc_reviews k where good_id=p_good_id),
  'blockers',private.goods_group_conversion_blockers(p_good_id)
 )::text,'sha256'),'hex');
$$

  'additionalCategories',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(category_id order by category_id) from public.goods_additional_categories where good_id=g.id),'[]'),
  'afterSales',(select jsonb_build_array(phone,guide,seller_special_notes) from private.goods_after_sales_content where good_id=g.id),
  'sizeChart',(select jsonb_build_array(enabled,chart) from private.goods_size_charts where good_id=g.id))
 from public.goods g where g.id=p_good_id;
$$

-- A single bounded read owns group review scope, full-set summary, filtering and
-- pagination. Original review/order/good identity and moderation stay intact.
create function public.get_good_group_reviews(p_good_id text,p_sort text default 'recent',p_photo_only boolean default false,
 p_limit integer default 10,p_offset integer default 0) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare ids text[];result jsonb;
begin
 if p_sort is null or p_sort not in('recent','rating_desc','rating_asc') or p_photo_only is null
  or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 or p_offset is null or p_offset not between 0 and 1000000 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_review_page';end if;
 ids:=private.goods_group_review_good_ids(p_good_id);
 with visible as materialized (
  select r.id,r.good_id,r.order_id,r.rating,r.body,r.image_paths,r.user_id,r.created_at,r.edited_at,r.admin_reply,r.admin_reply_at,
   coalesce(nullif(btrim(author.nickname),''),'fan_'||left(r.user_id::text,6)) author_name,
   coalesce((select item.good_name_snapshot from public.order_items item where item.order_id=r.order_id and item.good_id=r.good_id order by item.id limit 1),g.name) good_name,
   coalesce((select array_agg(distinct item.variant_name_snapshot order by item.variant_name_snapshot) from public.order_items item
    where item.order_id=r.order_id and item.good_id=r.good_id and item.variant_name_snapshot is not null),'{}'::text[]) variant_names
  from public.reviews r join public.profiles author on author.id=r.user_id join public.goods g on g.id=r.good_id
  where r.good_id=any(ids) and r.status='visible'
 ), filtered as materialized (
  select * from visible where not p_photo_only or cardinality(image_paths)>0
 ), page as (
  select * from filtered order by case when p_sort='rating_desc' then rating end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='rating_asc' then rating end asc nulls last,created_at desc,id desc limit p_limit offset p_offset
 ) select jsonb_build_object('grouped',exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members where good_id=p_good_id) and cardinality(ids)>0,
  'summary',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'average',coalesce(round(avg(rating),2),0),
   'distribution',jsonb_build_array(count(*) filter(where rating=1),count(*) filter(where rating=2),count(*) filter(where rating=3),count(*) filter(where rating=4),count(*) filter(where rating=5)),
   'photoCount',count(*) filter(where cardinality(image_paths)>0)) from visible),
  'total',(select count(*) from filtered),
  'reviews',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'goodId',good_id,'goodName',good_name,'variantNames',to_jsonb(variant_names),
   'rating',rating,'body',body,'imagePaths',to_jsonb(coalesce(image_paths,'{}'::text[])),'authorName',author_name,
   'isMine',auth.uid() is not null and user_id=auth.uid(),'createdAt',created_at,'editedAt',edited_at,'adminReply',admin_reply,'adminReplyAt',admin_reply_at)
   order by case when p_sort='rating_desc' then rating end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='rating_asc' then rating end asc nulls last,created_at desc,id desc) from page),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end;
$$

-- One safe projection for all actual exchange allocations. Original purchase
-- identity remains explicit; the physical label comes from the shipment receipt.
create function private.claim_reshipment_items_read(p_claim_id uuid)
returns table(order_item_id uuid,original_good_id text,original_variant_id uuid,
 source_good_id text,source_variant_id uuid,good_id text,variant_id uuid,
 good_name_snapshot text,variant_name_snapshot text,variant_code_snapshot text,qty integer)
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select a.order_item_id,a.original_good_id,a.original_variant_id,a.source_good_id,a.source_variant_id,
  a.target_good_id,a.target_variant_id,a.good_name_snapshot,a.variant_name_snapshot,a.variant_code_snapshot,a.qty
 from private.group_claim_reshipment_allocations a where a.claim_id=p_claim_id
 union all
 select r.order_item_id,oi.good_id,oi.variant_id,r.good_id,r.source_variant_id,r.good_id,r.variant_id,
  oi.good_name_snapshot,r.variant_name_snapshot,r.variant_code_snapshot,r.qty
 from public.order_claim_reshipment_items r join public.order_items oi on oi.id=r.order_item_id
 where r.claim_id=p_claim_id;
$$

create function private.order_item_physical_unit(p_item_id uuid)
returns table(good_id text,variant_id uuid,generation_kind text,generation_id uuid,qty integer,
 good_name_snapshot text,variant_name_snapshot text,variant_code_snapshot text)
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select physical.good_id,physical.variant_id,physical.generation_kind,physical.generation_id,oi.qty,
  physical.good_name_snapshot,physical.variant_name_snapshot,physical.variant_code_snapshot
 from public.order_items oi
 cross join lateral (
  select r.good_id,r.variant_id,'exchange'::text generation_kind,c.id generation_id,
   r.good_name_snapshot,r.variant_name_snapshot,r.variant_code_snapshot,1 priority,c.reshipped_at,c.reference
  from public.order_cancellation_requests c cross join lateral private.claim_reshipment_items_read(c.id) r
  where c.order_id=oi.order_id and c.stage='completed' and c.reshipped_at is not null and r.order_item_id=oi.id
  union all
  select oi.good_id,oi.variant_id,'purchase',oi.id,oi.good_name_snapshot,oi.variant_name_snapshot,
   oi.variant_code_snapshot,0,null,null
  order by priority desc,reshipped_at desc,reference desc limit 1
 ) physical where oi.id=p_item_id;
$$

-- This compatibility UUID is only a display/unused legacy-finalizer alias.
-- Every stock writer below consumes the full physical tuple instead.
create or replace function private.order_item_stock_variant(target_item_id uuid)
returns uuid language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select variant_id from private.order_item_physical_unit(target_item_id);
$$

-- Callers may already own an order or original good lock. Never block on the
-- topology lock: a converter can be waiting on that original good. PT409 asks
-- the entire operation to retry, preventing an advisory/row-lock cycle.
create function private.lock_goods_stock_successor_topology() returns void
language plpgsql security invoker set search_path='' as $$
begin
 if not pg_try_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('goods-stock-successor-topology:v1',0)) then
  raise sqlstate 'PT409' using message='goods_group_retry';
 end if;
end;
$$

create function private.order_item_reshipment_options(p_item_id uuid)
returns table(good_id text,variant_id uuid,good_name text,variant_name text,variant_code text,stock_qty integer,is_current boolean)
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 with physical as (select * from private.order_item_physical_unit(p_item_id)),
 current_unit as (select target.* from physical cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_stock_successor(physical.good_id,physical.variant_id) target),
 current_group as (select m.group_id from current_unit c join private.goods_group_members m on m.good_id=c.good_id and m.variant_id=c.variant_id
  join private.goods_groups g on g.id=m.group_id and g.archived_at is null)
 select v.good_id,v.id,g.name,v.name,v.code,v.stock_qty,v.id=c.variant_id
 from current_unit c join public.goods_variants v on v.id=c.variant_id
  or (not exists(select 1 from current_group) and v.good_id=c.good_id and v.archived_at is null)
  or (v.archived_at is null and exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join current_group cg on cg.group_id=m.group_id where m.variant_id=v.id and m.good_id=v.good_id))
 join public.goods g on g.id=v.good_id
 where v.id=c.variant_id or (g.archived_at is null and v.archived_at is null)
 order by (v.id=c.variant_id) desc,g.name,v.sort_order,v.id;
$$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.admin_order_claim_detail_before_operational_fee(p_claim_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_claim record;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_actor is null or not public.is_staff() then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  select request.*
  into v_claim
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  where request.id = p_claim_id;

  if not found then
    return null;
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'claim', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_claim.id,
      'collectionPolicy',v_claim.collection_policy,
      'collectionComplete',private.claim_collections_complete(v_claim.id),
      'collections',private.claim_collection_records(v_claim.id),
      'reference', v_claim.reference,
      'orderId', v_claim.order_id,
      'claimType', v_claim.claim_type,
      'stage', v_claim.stage,
      'status', v_claim.status,
      'reason', v_claim.reason,
      'reasonType', v_claim.reason_type,
      'decisionNote', v_claim.decision_note,
      'holdReason', v_claim.hold_reason,
      'heldAt', v_claim.held_at,
      -- 보류를 풀었을 때 돌아갈 단계. 화면이 이 값을 봐야 processing에서 건 보류에
      -- 거부 버튼을 그리지 않는다(DB의 claim_not_rejectable와 같은 판정).
      'heldFrom', v_claim.held_from,
      'requestedAt', v_claim.requested_at,
      'decidedAt', v_claim.decided_at,
      'collectingAt', v_claim.collecting_at,
      'collectedAt', v_claim.collected_at,
      'completedAt', v_claim.completed_at,
      'reshipCarrier', v_claim.reship_carrier,
      'reshipTrackingNumber', v_claim.reship_tracking_number,
      'reshippedAt', v_claim.reshipped_at,
      'reshipDeliveredAt', v_claim.reship_delivered_at,
      'reshipDeliveredBy', v_claim.reship_delivered_by,
      'reshipDeliveredByName', (select nickname from public.profiles where id=v_claim.reship_delivered_by),
      'reshipDeliveryEvidence', v_claim.reship_delivery_evidence,
      'reshippedItems', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId',r.order_item_id,'name',r.good_name_snapshot,'goodId',r.good_id,'originalGoodId',r.original_good_id,
        'variantId',r.variant_id,'variantName',r.variant_name_snapshot,'variantCode',r.variant_code_snapshot,'qty',r.qty) order by r.order_item_id),'[]')
        from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(v_claim.id) r),
      'lastErrorCode', v_claim.last_error_code,
      'handlerName', (
        select handler.nickname
        from public.profiles as handler
        where handler.id = v_claim.decided_by
      )
    ),
    'order', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'id', orders.id,
        'status', orders.status,
        'total', orders.total,
        'shippingFee', orders.shipping_fee,
        'createdAt', orders.created_at,
        'deliveredAt', orders.delivered_at,
        'shipments', private.order_shipment_records(orders.id),
        'buyerName', profile.nickname,
        'buyerEmail', profile.email,
        'items', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'id', item.id,
            'goodId', item.good_id,
            'variantId', item.variant_id,
            'variantName', item.variant_name_snapshot,
            'currentVariantId', (select variant_id from private.order_item_reshipment_options(item.id) where is_current),
            'currentGoodId', (select good_id from private.order_item_reshipment_options(item.id) where is_current),
            'options', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',v.variant_id,'goodId',v.good_id,'goodName',v.good_name,'name',v.variant_name,'code',v.variant_code,'stockQty',v.stock_qty)
              order by v.is_current desc,v.good_name,v.variant_name,v.variant_id),'[]') from private.order_item_reshipment_options(item.id) v),
            'name', item.good_name_snapshot,
            'qty', item.qty,
            'unitPrice', item.unit_price
          ) order by item.id)
          from public.order_items as item
          where item.order_id = orders.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
      )
      from public.orders as orders
      join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
      where orders.id = v_claim.order_id
    ),
    'payment', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'id', payment.id,
        'provider', payment.provider,
        'status', payment.status,
        'amount', payment.amount,
        'createdAt', payment.created_at
      )
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = v_claim.order_id
        and payment.status <> 'failed'
      order by payment.created_at desc, payment.id desc
      limit 1
    ),
    'refund', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'status', refund.status,
        'amount', refund.amount,
        'method', refund.method,
        'filedAt', refund.filed_at,
        'completedAt', refund.completed_at,
        'settlementNote', refund.settlement_note,
        'handlerName', (
          select handler.nickname
          from public.profiles as handler
          where handler.id = refund.handled_by
        )
      )
      from public.refunds as refund
      join public.payments as payment on payment.id = refund.payment_id
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = v_claim.order_id
      order by refund.created_at desc, refund.id desc
      limit 1
    ),
    -- 뽑기권 발급/사용 여부. 취소·반품 완료 시 회수 대상이 남아 있는지를
    -- 운영자가 승인 전에 봐야 한다(약관 제17조).
    'cardPacks', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'issued', count(*),
        'consumed', count(*) filter (where ticket.consumed_at is not null),
        'revoked', count(*) filter (where ticket.revoked_at is not null)
      )
      from public.draw_tickets as ticket
      where ticket.source = 'order_paid'
        and ticket.source_id = v_claim.order_id
    ),
    'refundAccount', (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'maskedAccount', account.masked_account,
        'maskedHolder', account.masked_holder,
        'purgeAfter', account.purge_after,
        'purgedAt', account.purged_at
      )
      from private.claim_refund_accounts as account
      where account.claim_id = v_claim.id
    ),
    'timeline', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'action', entry.action,
        'createdAt', entry.created_at,
        'diff', entry.diff,
        'actorName', (
          select actor.nickname
          from public.profiles as actor
          where actor.id = entry.actor_id
        )
      ) order by entry.created_at, entry.id)
      from public.audit_log as entry
      where entry.target = 'order:' || v_claim.order_id::text
        -- 레거시 감사 액션(admin.order.cancellation_*)도 같은 클레임의 이력이다.
        -- 'claim'만 찾으면 #252 이전 경로로 처리된 건의 타임라인이 비어 보인다.
        and (entry.action like '%claim%' or entry.action like '%cancellation%')
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_type_change_blocker(p_claim order_cancellation_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
 when p_claim.claim_type not in('return','exchange') then 'claim_conversion_type_unavailable'
 when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then coalesce(p_claim.held_from,'requested') else p_claim.stage end)
  not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected') then 'claim_conversion_stage_unavailable'
 when p_claim.reshipped_at is not null or p_claim.reship_tracking_number is not null
  or exists(select 1 from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(p_claim.id)) then 'claim_conversion_reshipped'
 when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_conversion_finance_started'
 else null end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_reason_blocker(p_claim order_cancellation_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
 when p_claim.claim_type<>'exchange' then 'claim_reason_type_unavailable'
 when p_claim.stage='on_hold' and p_claim.held_from is null then 'claim_reason_stage_unavailable'
 when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then p_claim.held_from else p_claim.stage end)
  not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected') then 'claim_reason_stage_unavailable'
 when p_claim.reshipped_at is not null or p_claim.reship_tracking_number is not null
  or exists(select 1 from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(p_claim.id)) then 'claim_reason_reshipped'
 when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_reason_finance_started'
 else null end;
$function$

create function private.order_claim_reshipment_history(p_order_id uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'reshippedAt',c.reshipped_at,'items',(
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId',r.order_item_id,'goodId',r.good_id,'name',r.good_name_snapshot,

ledger.name: order_claim_contact_corrections
statements:
-- DRAFT: contact PII remains disabled until an explicit environment activation.
-- Field encryption and plaintext normalization belong to the server; SQL owns
-- authorization, exact envelopes, source/version CAS, fulfillment and retention.
create table private.order_claim_contact_runtime(singleton boolean primary key check(singleton),enabled boolean not null default false)
insert into private.order_claim_contact_runtime values(true,false)

create table private.order_claim_contact_plans(
 id uuid primary key,order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id),claim_id uuid not null references public.order_cancellation_requests(id),
 target text not null check(target in('collection','reshipment')),revision bigint not null check(revision between 1 and 9007199254740991),
 pii_version uuid,sealed_plan jsonb,source_kind text check(source_kind in('seller_intake','order_delivery')),source_id uuid,source_revision text,
 last_operation_id uuid,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),purged_at timestamptz,
 unique(claim_id,target),check((purged_at is null and pii_version is not null and sealed_plan is not null) or
 (purged_at is not null and pii_version is null and sealed_plan is null and source_kind is null and source_id is null and source_revision is null)))
create index order_claim_contact_plans_order on private.order_claim_contact_plans(order_id,claim_id)

create table private.order_claim_contact_operations(
 id uuid primary key,actor_id uuid not null,session_id uuid not null,order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id),
 claim_id uuid not null references public.order_cancellation_requests(id),command text not null check(command in('change','reshipment')),
 target text not null check(target in('collection','reshipment')),expected_claim_type text not null check(expected_claim_type in('return','exchange')),
 expected_claim_revision integer not null check(expected_claim_revision>=0),result_claim_revision integer check(result_claim_revision>=0),
 state text not null check(state in('saved','noop','sealed')),changed_fields text[] not null default '{}',request_hmac text,hmac_key_version text,history jsonb,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),purged_at timestamptz,
 check((request_hmac is null)=(hmac_key_version is null)),check(request_hmac is null or request_hmac~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 check(hmac_key_version is null or hmac_key_version~'^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'),
 check(command<>'reshipment' or(target='reshipment' and expected_claim_type='exchange' and changed_fields='{}')),
 check((state='sealed' and result_claim_revision is null and changed_fields='{}' and request_hmac is null and history is null)
 or(state<>'sealed' and result_claim_revision is not null)),
 check(history is null or(state='saved' and command='change')),check(purged_at is null or(request_hmac is null and history is null)))
create index order_claim_contact_operations_history on private.order_claim_contact_operations(claim_id,created_at desc,id desc)
create index order_claim_contact_operations_actor on private.order_claim_contact_operations(actor_id)

create table private.order_claim_reshipment_destinations(
 claim_id uuid primary key references public.order_cancellation_requests(id),order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id),
 operation_id uuid unique not null references private.order_claim_contact_operations(id) deferrable initially deferred,
 confirmed_claim_revision integer not null check(confirmed_claim_revision>=0),destination jsonb,confirmed_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),purged_at timestamptz,
 check((purged_at is null and destination is not null) or(purged_at is not null and destination is null)))

create table private.order_claim_contact_retention_cases(
 claim_id uuid not null references public.order_cancellation_requests(id),case_ref text not null check(case_ref~'^[A-Za-z0-9:_./-]{1,120}$'),
 order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id),legal_basis text not null check(legal_basis in('dispute_resolution','statutory_preservation','verified_rights_request')),
 revision bigint not null check(revision between 1 and 9007199254740991),state text not null check(state in('held','released','closed')),
 retain_until timestamptz,case_closed_at timestamptz,released_at timestamptz,last_occurred_at timestamptz not null,last_operation_id uuid not null,updated_at timestamptz not null,
 primary key(claim_id,case_ref),check(retain_until is null or isfinite(retain_until)),check(isfinite(last_occurred_at)),
 check((state='held' and retain_until is not null and case_closed_at is null) or(state='released' and retain_until is null and case_closed_at is null and released_at is not null)
 or(state='closed' and retain_until is null and case_closed_at is not null)))

create table private.order_claim_contact_retention_operations(
 id uuid primary key,actor_id uuid not null,session_id uuid not null,command text not null check(command in('case','purge')),
 request_hash text not null check(request_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),receipt jsonb not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp())

create function private.contact_field(p_value jsonb,p_key text) returns boolean language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select private.contact_keys(p_value,array['v','kid','iv','tag','ct']) and p_value->'v'='1'::jsonb
 and private.contact_key_version(p_value->'kid') and p_value->>'kid'=p_key
 and private.contact_base64url(p_value->'iv',12,16) and private.contact_base64url(p_value->'tag',16,22)
 and private.contact_base64url(p_value->'ct',null,8192);
$$

create function private.contact_address_envelope(p_value jsonb,p_key text) returns boolean language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select private.contact_keys(p_value,array['recipientName','phone','postalCode','address1','address2'])
 and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(case when jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' then p_value else '{}'::jsonb end) v where not private.contact_field(v.value,p_key) or(v.key<>'address2' and v.value->>'ct'=''));
$$

create function private.contact_plan_envelope(p_value jsonb) returns boolean language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select private.contact_keys(p_value,array['planId','piiVersion','keyVersion','addressHmac','addressHmacKeyVersion','address'])
 and private.contact_uuid(p_value->'planId') and private.contact_uuid(p_value->'piiVersion') and private.contact_key_version(p_value->'keyVersion')
 and private.contact_digest(p_value->'addressHmac') and private.contact_key_version(p_value->'addressHmacKeyVersion')
 and private.contact_address_envelope(p_value->'address',p_value->>'keyVersion');
$$

create function private.contact_history_envelope(p_value jsonb) returns boolean language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select private.contact_keys(p_value,array['piiVersion','keyVersion','before','after','agreement']) and private.contact_uuid(p_value->'piiVersion')
 and private.contact_key_version(p_value->'keyVersion') and private.contact_address_envelope(p_value->'before',p_value->>'keyVersion')
 and private.contact_address_envelope(p_value->'after',p_value->>'keyVersion') and private.contact_field(p_value->'agreement',p_value->>'keyVersion') and p_value#>>'{agreement,ct}'<>'';
$$

-- ECMAScript trim whitespace is explicit; PostgreSQL locale character classes
-- do not reliably include NBSP/BOM. C0/C1 controls are rejected before trimming.
create function private.contact_trim(p_value text) returns text language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select btrim(p_value,chr(9)||chr(10)||chr(11)||chr(12)||chr(13)||chr(32)||chr(160)||chr(5760)||chr(8192)||chr(8193)||chr(8194)||chr(8195)||chr(8196)||chr(8197)||chr(8198)||chr(8199)||chr(8200)||chr(8201)||chr(8202)||chr(8232)||chr(8233)||chr(8239)||chr(8287)||chr(12288)||chr(65279));
$$

create function private.contact_operation_receipt(p_op private.order_claim_contact_operations) returns jsonb language sql stable set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('operationId',p_op.id,'command',p_op.command,'orderId',p_op.order_id,'claimId',p_op.claim_id,'target',p_op.target,
 'actorId',p_op.actor_id,'sessionId',p_op.session_id,'expectedClaimType',p_op.expected_claim_type,'expectedClaimRevision',p_op.expected_claim_revision,
 'resultClaimRevision',p_op.result_claim_revision,'state',p_op.state,'changedFields',to_jsonb(p_op.changed_fields),'recordedAt',p_op.created_at,
 'piiState',case when p_op.state='sealed' then 'not_stored' when p_op.purged_at is not null then 'purged' when p_op.state='noop' then 'not_stored' else 'retained' end);
$$

create function private.contact_counts(p_claim uuid) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object(
 'plans',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_plans where claim_id=p_claim and sealed_plan is not null),
 'operations',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_operations where claim_id=p_claim and(history is not null or request_hmac is not null)),
 'destinations',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_reshipment_destinations where claim_id=p_claim and destination is not null),
 'addressEnvelopes',(select 5*count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_plans where claim_id=p_claim and sealed_plan is not null)
  +(select 10*count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_operations where claim_id=p_claim and history is not null)
  +(select 5*count(*) from private.order_claim_reshipment_destinations where claim_id=p_claim and destination is not null),
 'agreementEnvelopes',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_operations where claim_id=p_claim and history is not null),
 'requestHmacs',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_operations where claim_id=p_claim and request_hmac is not null),
 'addressHmacs',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_plans where claim_id=p_claim and sealed_plan is not null)
  +(select count(*) from private.order_claim_reshipment_destinations where claim_id=p_claim and destination is not null),
 'operatorReferences',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_operations where claim_id=p_claim));
$$

create function private.contact_retention_scope(p_claim uuid,p_now timestamptz) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('orderId',c.order_id,'claimId',c.id,'subjectKind',case when exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents where order_id=c.order_id) then 'gift_recipient' else 'buyer' end,
 'remaining',private.contact_counts(c.id))||private.contact_retention(c.id,p_now) from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.id=p_claim;
$$

create function private.contact_retention_remaining(p_subject uuid,p_now timestamptz) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 with scopes as(select private.contact_retention_scope(c.id,p_now) scope from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.claim_type in('return','exchange') and private.contact_subject(c.order_id)=p_subject)
 select jsonb_build_object('eligibleScopes',count(*) filter(where scope->>'state'='due'),'heldScopes',count(*) filter(where scope->>'state'='held'),
 'notDueScopes',count(*) filter(where scope->>'state'='not_due'),'operationallyBlockedScopes',count(*) filter(where scope->>'state' in('operational_pending','operational_unknown')),
 'piiFields',coalesce(sum(private.contact_count_sum(scope->'remaining')),0),'operatorReferences',(select count(*) from private.order_claim_contact_operations where actor_id=p_subject)) from scopes;
$$

-- Account-deletion fences must not overtake an unconfirmed replacement delivery.
create function private.contact_order_reshipment_pending(p_order uuid) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=p_order and c.claim_type='exchange' and c.stage='completed'
 and(c.reshipped_at is null or c.reship_carrier is null or c.reship_tracking_number is null or c.reship_delivered_at is null or c.reship_delivered_by is null or c.reship_delivery_evidence is null));
$$

create or replace function private.gift_account_deletion_blockers(p_actor uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case when count(*)=0 then '[]'::jsonb else jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','active_received_gift','count',count(*),'path','/gifts')) end
 from private.gift_intents gift join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=gift.order_id where gift.recipient_id=p_actor and gift.sender_id<>p_actor and
 (purchase.status not in('canceled','done') and not private.order_all_items_delivered(purchase.id)
 or private.contact_order_reshipment_pending(purchase.id)
 or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=purchase.id and status in('requested','processing','needs_review')));
$$

ledger.name: shipping_settings_delivery_policies
statements:
-- DRAFT: copy the existing versioned delivery contract through shipping templates.
-- Missing legacy delivery directives preserve the independent product policy.
-- No runtime, collector contract, order, volume policy, or family owner is changed.
create table private.shipping_settings_operations(
 operation_id uuid primary key,actor_id uuid not null,session_id uuid not null,command text not null check(command in('save','apply')),
 template_id uuid not null,expected_revision integer not null check(expected_revision>=0),request_hash text,
 receipt jsonb not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check(request_hash is null or request_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),check((receipt->>'state'='sealed')=(request_hash is null))
)
alter table private.shipping_settings_operations enable row level security
revoke all on private.shipping_settings_operations from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_value jsonb) returns boolean
language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_value)='string' and p_value#>>'{}'~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$',false);
$$

create function private.shipping_settings_good_id(p_value jsonb) returns boolean
language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_value)='string' and char_length(p_value#>>'{}') between 1 and 120
  and p_value#>>'{}'=btrim(p_value#>>'{}') and p_value#>>'{}'!~'[[:cntrl:]]',false);
$$

create function private.shipping_settings_operation_context(p_request jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_request) is distinct from 'object' or not p_request ?& array['operationId','command','templateId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'operationId') or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'templateId')
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedActorId') or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedSessionId')
  or coalesce(p_request->>'command','') not in('save','apply')
  or not private.transaction_uint(p_request->'expectedRevision',case when p_request->>'command'='apply' then 1 else 0 end,
   case when p_request->>'command'='save' then 2147483646 else 2147483647 end) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_settings_operation';end if;
 select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) into result from jsonb_each(p_request)
 where key=any(array['operationId','command','templateId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']);
 return result;
end $$

create function private.shipping_settings_delivery_input(p_good_id text) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case when d.id is null then 'null'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('status',d.status,'paymentMode',d.payment_mode,
  'quantityTerms',d.quantity_terms,'draftValues',d.draft_values) end
 from public.goods g left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(g.id)
 left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id where g.id=p_good_id;
$$

create function private.shipping_settings_effective(p_settings jsonb,p_delivery jsonb) returns jsonb
language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$

create function private.shipping_settings_good_guard(p_good public.goods) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',p_good.id,'updatedAt',p_good.updated_at,'ownerGoodId',owner.id,'ownerUpdatedAt',owner.updated_at,
  'transactionRevision',coalesce(c.revision,0),'deliveryVersionId',c.delivery_version_id,

create function private.record_shipping_settings_operation(p_context jsonb,p_hash text,p_receipt jsonb) returns void
language sql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$

$$

create function public.admin_search_goods_for_shipping_settings_v2(p_query text,p_page integer,p_expected_actor_id uuid,p_expected_session_id uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;pattern text;begin
 perform private.require_shipping_settings_identity(p_expected_actor_id,p_expected_session_id);
 if p_query is null or char_length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 100000 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_settings_filter';end if;
 pattern:='%'||replace(replace(replace(btrim(p_query),E'\\',E'\\\\'),'%',E'\\%'),'_',E'\\_')||'%';
 with matched as(select g.* from public.goods g where g.archived_at is null and (g.name ilike pattern escape E'\\' or g.code ilike pattern escape E'\\' or g.id ilike pattern escape E'\\')),
 page as(select * from matched order by updated_at desc,id limit 20 offset (p_page-1)*20)
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from matched),'page',p_page,'pageSize',20,'rows',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',page.id,'name',page.name,'code',page.code,'updatedAt',page.updated_at,'settings',private.good_shipping_settings(page),
  'templateId',page.shipping_settings_template_id,'templateRevision',page.shipping_settings_template_revision,'ownerGoodId',owner.id,
  'familyGoodIds',(private.shipping_settings_good_guard(page))->'familyGoodIds',
  'editable',owner.id=page.id,'blocker',case when owner.id<>page.id then 'goods_aggregation_policy_owned_by_source' else null end,
  'effective',private.shipping_settings_effective(private.good_shipping_settings(owner),private.shipping_settings_delivery_input(page.id))) order by page.updated_at desc,page.id),'[]'))
 into result from page join public.goods owner on owner.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(page.id);
 return result;
end $$
