ledger.name: shipping_charge_groups
statements:
-- DRAFT: explicit shipping charge groups, separate from physical shipments and
-- immutable goods aggregation identities. No existing membership is seeded.
-- This migration is prepared only; local/remote application needs separate approval.
create table private.shipping_charge_groups (
 id uuid primary key, origin_id uuid not null references public.fulfillment_origins(id),
 revision integer not null check(revision>0),version_id uuid not null,is_default boolean not null default false,
 created_by uuid not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 updated_by uuid not null,updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)
create unique index shipping_charge_groups_default_origin on private.shipping_charge_groups(origin_id) where is_default

create table private.shipping_charge_group_versions (
 id uuid primary key,group_id uuid not null references private.shipping_charge_groups(id) deferrable initially deferred,
 revision integer not null check(revision>0),policy_values jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(policy_values)='object'),
 regional_confirmed_by uuid,regional_confirmed_at timestamptz,
 created_by uuid not null,session_id uuid not null,operation_id uuid not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 unique(group_id,revision),unique(group_id,id,revision),
 check((regional_confirmed_by is null)=(regional_confirmed_at is null))
)

alter table private.shipping_charge_groups add constraint shipping_charge_groups_current_version
 foreign key(id,version_id,revision) references private.shipping_charge_group_versions(group_id,id,revision) deferrable initially deferred

create table private.shipping_charge_group_assignments (
 id uuid primary key,owner_good_id text not null unique references public.goods(id) on update cascade,
 group_id uuid references private.shipping_charge_groups(id),revision integer not null check(revision>0),version_id uuid not null,
 updated_by uuid not null,updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)
create index shipping_charge_group_assignments_group on private.shipping_charge_group_assignments(group_id,owner_good_id) where group_id is not null

create table private.shipping_charge_group_assignment_versions (
 id uuid primary key,assignment_id uuid not null references private.shipping_charge_group_assignments(id) deferrable initially deferred,
 revision integer not null check(revision>0),owner_good_id_at_write text not null,origin_id uuid not null,
 group_id uuid references private.shipping_charge_groups(id),group_revision integer,
 created_by uuid not null,session_id uuid not null,operation_id uuid not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 unique(assignment_id,revision),unique(assignment_id,id,revision),
 check((group_id is null)=(group_revision is null)),check(group_revision is null or group_revision>0)
)

alter table private.shipping_charge_group_assignments add constraint shipping_charge_group_assignment_current_version
 foreign key(id,version_id,revision) references private.shipping_charge_group_assignment_versions(assignment_id,id,revision) deferrable initially deferred

create table private.shipping_charge_group_operations (
 operation_id uuid primary key,actor_id uuid not null,session_id uuid not null,command text not null check(command in('save','assign')),
 group_id uuid,expected_revision integer not null check(expected_revision>=0),request_hash text,receipt jsonb not null,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check(request_hash is null or request_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),check((receipt->>'state'='sealed')=(request_hash is null))
)
alter table private.shipping_charge_groups enable row level security
alter table private.shipping_charge_group_versions enable row level security
alter table private.shipping_charge_group_assignments enable row level security
alter table private.shipping_charge_group_assignment_versions enable row level security
alter table private.shipping_charge_group_operations enable row level security

revoke all on private.shipping_charge_groups,private.shipping_charge_group_versions,private.shipping_charge_group_assignments,
 private.shipping_charge_group_assignment_versions,private.shipping_charge_group_operations from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.guard_shipping_charge_group_history() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 raise check_violation using message='shipping_charge_group_history_immutable';
end $$

create trigger shipping_charge_group_versions_immutable before update or delete on private.shipping_charge_group_versions
 for each row execute function private.guard_shipping_charge_group_history()

create trigger shipping_charge_group_assignment_versions_immutable before update or delete on private.shipping_charge_group_assignment_versions
 for each row execute function private.guard_shipping_charge_group_history()

create function private.shipping_charge_group_context(p_request jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_request) is distinct from 'object'
  or not p_request ?& array['operationId','command','groupId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'operationId') or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedActorId')
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedSessionId') or coalesce(p_request->>'command','') not in('save','assign')
  or not (private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'groupId') or (p_request->>'command'='assign' and p_request->'groupId'='null'::jsonb))
  or not private.transaction_uint(p_request->'expectedRevision',0,case when p_request->>'command'='save' then 2147483646 else 2147483647 end)
  or (p_request->>'command'='assign' and ((p_request->'groupId'='null'::jsonb) is distinct from (p_request->>'expectedRevision'='0'))) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_charge_group_operation';end if;
 select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) into result from jsonb_each(p_request)
 where key=any(array['operationId','command','groupId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']);
 return result;
end $$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_receipt(p_context jsonb,p_state text,p_group jsonb default null,p_default jsonb default null,p_goods jsonb default '[]') returns jsonb
language sql volatile set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('state',p_state,'operationId',p_context->'operationId','command',p_context->'command','groupId',p_context->'groupId',
  'expectedRevision',p_context->'expectedRevision','actorId',p_context->'expectedActorId','sessionId',p_context->'expectedSessionId',
  'group',p_group,'changedDefaultGroup',p_default,'appliedCount',jsonb_array_length(p_goods),'goods',p_goods,'recordedAt',clock_timestamp());
$$

create function private.record_shipping_charge_group_operation(p_context jsonb,p_hash text,p_receipt jsonb) returns void
language sql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$
 insert into private.shipping_charge_group_operations(operation_id,actor_id,session_id,command,group_id,expected_revision,request_hash,receipt)
 values((p_context->>'operationId')::uuid,(p_context->>'expectedActorId')::uuid,(p_context->>'expectedSessionId')::uuid,p_context->>'command',
  (p_context->>'groupId')::uuid,(p_context->>'expectedRevision')::integer,p_hash,p_receipt);
$$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_document(p_group_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select v.policy_values||jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'originId',g.origin_id,'revision',g.revision,'versionId',g.version_id,
  'assignedCount',(select count(*) from private.shipping_charge_group_assignments a where a.group_id=g.id),
  'createdAt',g.created_at,'updatedAt',g.updated_at)
 from private.shipping_charge_groups g join private.shipping_charge_group_versions v on v.id=g.version_id where g.id=p_group_id;
$$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_summary(p_group_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'originId',g.origin_id,'revision',g.revision,'name',v.policy_values->'name','enabled',v.policy_values->'enabled',
  'archived',v.policy_values->'archived','calculationMode',v.policy_values->'calculationMode','regionalMode',v.policy_values#>'{regional,mode}')
 from private.shipping_charge_groups g join private.shipping_charge_group_versions v on v.id=g.version_id where g.id=p_group_id;
$$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_origin(p_origin_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',o.id,'name',o.name,'updatedAt',o.updated_at,'defaultCarrier',o.default_carrier,'isActive',o.is_active,
  'defaultGroupId',d.id,'defaultGroupRevision',coalesce(d.revision,0))
 from public.fulfillment_origins o left join private.shipping_charge_groups d on d.origin_id=o.id and d.is_default where o.id=p_origin_id;
$$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_good_guard(p_good public.goods) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.shipping_settings_good_guard(p_good)||jsonb_build_object('originId',owner.origin_id,
  'assignmentRevision',coalesce(a.revision,0),'assignmentVersionId',a.version_id,'groupId',a.group_id,'groupRevision',g.revision)
 from public.goods owner left join private.shipping_charge_group_assignments a on a.owner_good_id=owner.id
 left join private.shipping_charge_groups g on g.id=a.group_id where owner.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good.id);
$$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_good_row(p_good public.goods,p_target_group_id uuid,p_clear boolean default false) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.shipping_charge_group_good_guard(p_good)||jsonb_build_object('name',p_good.name,'code',p_good.code,
  'editable',private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good.id)=p_good.id,'blocker',private.shipping_charge_group_assignment_blocker(p_good,p_target_group_id,p_clear),
  'effectiveCount',jsonb_array_length(private.shipping_settings_good_guard(p_good)->'familyGoodIds'));
$$

create function public.admin_list_shipping_charge_groups(p_origin_id uuid,p_query text,p_status text,p_page integer,p_expected_actor_id uuid,p_expected_session_id uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;origins jsonb;total integer;begin
 perform private.require_shipping_charge_group_identity(p_expected_actor_id,p_expected_session_id);
 if p_query is null or char_length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 1000000
  or p_status is null or p_status not in('all','active','inactive','archived') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_charge_group_search';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.shipping_charge_group_origin(id) order by id),'[]') into origins
 from public.fulfillment_origins where p_origin_id is null or id=p_origin_id;
 select count(*) into total from private.shipping_charge_groups g join private.shipping_charge_group_versions v on v.id=g.version_id
 where (p_origin_id is null or g.origin_id=p_origin_id) and position(lower(btrim(p_query)) in lower(v.policy_values->>'name'))>0
  and (p_status='all' or (p_status='archived' and (v.policy_values->>'archived')::boolean)
   or (p_status='active' and (v.policy_values->>'enabled')::boolean and not(v.policy_values->>'archived')::boolean)
   or (p_status='inactive' and not(v.policy_values->>'enabled')::boolean and not(v.policy_values->>'archived')::boolean));
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.shipping_charge_group_document(id) order by updated_at desc,id),'[]') into result from(
  select g.id,g.updated_at from private.shipping_charge_groups g join private.shipping_charge_group_versions v on v.id=g.version_id
  where (p_origin_id is null or g.origin_id=p_origin_id) and position(lower(btrim(p_query)) in lower(v.policy_values->>'name'))>0
   and (p_status='all' or (p_status='archived' and (v.policy_values->>'archived')::boolean)
    or (p_status='active' and (v.policy_values->>'enabled')::boolean and not(v.policy_values->>'archived')::boolean)
    or (p_status='inactive' and not(v.policy_values->>'enabled')::boolean and not(v.policy_values->>'archived')::boolean))
  order by g.updated_at desc,g.id limit 20 offset (p_page-1)*20) page;
 return jsonb_build_object('actorId',p_expected_actor_id,'sessionId',p_expected_session_id,
  'runtimeEnabled',coalesce((select enabled from private.goods_transaction_runtime where singleton),false),
  'canManageRegional',public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',true),'page',p_page,'pageSize',20,'total',total,'groups',result,'origins',origins);
end $$

create function private.guard_shipping_charge_group_good_origin() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 perform private.assert_shipping_charge_group_owner_assignment(new.id);return null;
end $$

create constraint trigger shipping_charge_group_good_origin_guard after update on public.goods
 deferrable initially deferred for each row when(old.origin_id is distinct from new.origin_id or old.id is distinct from new.id)
 execute function private.guard_shipping_charge_group_good_origin()

create function private.shipping_charge_group_public_details(p_raw_group jsonb) returns jsonb
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('version',1,'unassignedBaseFee',p_raw_group#>'{chargeGroupContract,unassignedBaseFee}',
  'originRegionalFee',p_raw_group#>'{chargeGroupContract,originRegionalFee}',
  'originRegionFeeUnit',p_raw_group#>'{chargeGroupContract,originRegionFeeUnit}',
  'groups',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('groupId',g->'groupId','revision',g->'revision','mode',g->'mode',
   'quantity',g->'quantity','subtotal',g->'subtotal','baseFee',g->'baseFee','regionalFee',g->'regionalFee','regionMode',g->'regionMode',
   'goodIds',(select jsonb_agg(t->'goodId' order by t->>'goodId') from jsonb_array_elements(p_raw_group->'deliveryTerms') t
    where t->>'chargeGroupId'=g->>'groupId')) order by g->>'groupId')
   from jsonb_array_elements(p_raw_group#>'{chargeGroupContract,groups}') g),'[]'));
$$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_display(p_raw_group jsonb) returns jsonb
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('originId',p_raw_group->'originId','prepaidFee',p_raw_group->'prepaidFee','collectFee',p_raw_group->'collectFee',
  'fullFee',p_raw_group->'fullFee','components',p_raw_group->'components','collector',p_raw_group->'collector')
  ||case when p_raw_group ? 'chargeDetails' then jsonb_build_object('chargeDetails',p_raw_group->'chargeDetails') else '{}'::jsonb end;
$$

-- A marker is an explicit new shape. Normal orders and gifts both use an
-- allowlist; no new internal snapshot can leak through a subtraction list.
create or replace function private.goods_transaction_public_shipping(p_source_kind text,p_raw_groups jsonb) returns jsonb
language sql immutable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(case when value ? 'chargeDetails' then jsonb_build_object('calculationVersion',2,'originId',value->'originId',
  'originName',value->'originName','totalFee',value->'totalFee','prepaidFee',value->'prepaidFee','collectFee',value->'collectFee','fullFee',value->'fullFee',
  'components',value->'components','collector',value->'collector','chargeDetails',private.shipping_charge_group_safe_details(value->'chargeDetails'))
 when p_source_kind='gift' then jsonb_build_object('calculationVersion',2,'originId',value->'originId',
  'originName',value->'originName','totalFee',value->'totalFee','prepaidFee',value->'prepaidFee','collectFee',value->'collectFee','fullFee',value->'fullFee',
  'components',value->'components','collector',value->'collector')
 else value-array['collectContractSnapshot','collectContractId','deliveryTerms'] end order by value->>'originId'),'[]')
 from jsonb_array_elements(p_raw_groups);
$$

create function private.shipping_charge_group_public_offer(p_good_id text) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'revision',g.revision,'calculationMode',v.policy_values->>'calculationMode',
  'regionalMode',v.policy_values#>>'{regional,mode}','available',(v.policy_values->>'enabled')::boolean and not(v.policy_values->>'archived')::boolean
   and o.is_active and coalesce((select enabled from private.goods_transaction_runtime where singleton),false),
  'inherited',a.owner_good_id<>p_good_id)
 from private.shipping_charge_group_assignments a join private.shipping_charge_groups g on g.id=a.group_id
 join private.shipping_charge_group_versions v on v.id=g.version_id join public.fulfillment_origins o on o.id=g.origin_id
 where a.owner_good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(p_good_id);
$$

-- Seal every new function before publishing the schema. Existing entrypoint
-- owners/ACLs stay unchanged; refresh only their canonical current fingerprints.
do $$declare fn regprocedure;item regclass;begin
 foreach item in array array['private.shipping_charge_groups'::regclass,'private.shipping_charge_group_versions'::regclass,
  'private.shipping_charge_group_assignments'::regclass,'private.shipping_charge_group_assignment_versions'::regclass,
  'private.shipping_charge_group_operations'::regclass] loop
  execute format('revoke all on %s from public,anon,authenticated,service_role',item);
  execute format('grant select,insert,update,delete on %s to postgres',item);
 end loop;
 for fn in select p.oid::regprocedure from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='private' and p.proname=any(array[
  'guard_shipping_charge_group_history','require_shipping_charge_group_identity','shipping_charge_group_context','shipping_charge_group_prior',
  'shipping_charge_group_receipt','record_shipping_charge_group_operation','shipping_charge_group_document','shipping_charge_group_summary',
  'shipping_charge_group_origin','shipping_charge_group_good_guard','shipping_charge_group_region_adapter','normalize_shipping_charge_group_values',
  'shipping_charge_group_assignment_blocker','shipping_charge_group_good_row','write_shipping_charge_group_version',
  'assert_shipping_charge_group_owner_assignment','guard_shipping_charge_group_good_origin','apply_shipping_charge_group_assignment_locked',
  'validate_shipping_charge_group_assignment','shipping_charge_group_region_match','shipping_charge_group_public_details','shipping_charge_group_display',
  'shipping_charge_group_safe_details','shipping_charge_group_effective_lines','calculate_shipping_charge_group_base','calculate_shipping_charge_group_shipping',
  'calculate_shipping_charge_groups_legacy','shipping_charge_group_public_offer','subscription_retention_display_before_shipping_charge_groups']) loop
  execute format('revoke all on function %s from public,anon,authenticated,service_role',fn);
  execute format('grant execute on function %s to postgres',fn);perform private.register_operator_internal_contract(fn);
 end loop;

  select date_trunc('day',p_observed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' day_start

 ) select avg(r.average_rating),avg(r.six_month_rating),(select count(*) from products),count(r.average_rating),count(r.six_month_rating),

create function public.admin_search_goods_group_console(p_filters jsonb default '{}') returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare
 query text:=btrim(coalesce(p_filters->>'query','')); field text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'field','all');
 status text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'status','all'); date_field text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'dateField','created');
 stock text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'stock','all'); shipping text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'shippingFee','all');
 sort_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'sort','created_desc'); category_id uuid; origin_id uuid; from_date date; to_date date;
 page integer:=coalesce((p_filters->>'page')::integer,1); page_size integer:=coalesce((p_filters->>'pageSize')::integer,50);
 result jsonb;
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;
 if jsonb_typeof(p_filters) is distinct from 'object' or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p_filters) k where k not in
 ('query','field','status','categoryId','dateField','from','to','stock','originId','shippingFee','sort','page','pageSize'))
 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_filters) e where jsonb_typeof(e.value) not in ('string','number','null'))
 or char_length(query)>100 or field not in ('all','goodId','groupId','code','name','maker') or status not in ('all','published','draft','archived')
 or date_field not in ('created','updated') or stock not in ('all','available','soldout') or shipping not in ('all','free','paid')
 or sort_value not in ('created_desc','updated_desc','name_asc') or page not between 1 and 100000 or page_size not in (20,50,100)
 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_filters'; end if;
 category_id:=nullif(p_filters->>'categoryId','')::uuid; origin_id:=nullif(p_filters->>'originId','')::uuid;
 if nullif(p_filters->>'from','') is not null and p_filters->>'from' !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'
 or nullif(p_filters->>'to','') is not null and p_filters->>'to' !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_dates'; end if;
 from_date:=nullif(p_filters->>'from','')::date; to_date:=nullif(p_filters->>'to','')::date;
 if from_date>to_date then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_dates'; end if;
 with recursive categories as (
  select c.id from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=category_id
  union all select c.id from public.catalog_categories c join categories p on c.parent_id=p.id
 ), matched as materialized (
  select g.*,c.name category_name,
   case when g.archived_at is not null then 'archived'
    when exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id
      where m.group_id=g.id and good.published_at is not null and good.archived_at is null) then 'published' else 'draft' end group_status
  from private.goods_groups g join public.goods common on common.id=g.common_good_id left join public.catalog_categories c on c.id=common.category_id
  where (from_date is null or (case date_field when 'created' then g.created_at else g.updated_at end)>=(from_date::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (to_date is null or (case date_field when 'created' then g.created_at else g.updated_at end)<((to_date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (category_id is null or common.category_id in(select id from categories))
   and (query='' or field in ('all','name') and position(lower(query) in lower(g.name))>0
    or field in ('all','groupId') and position(lower(query) in lower(g.id::text))>0
    or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id where m.group_id=g.id and (
      field='all' and position(lower(query) in lower(concat_ws(' ',good.id,good.code,good.name,good.notice_maker)))>0
      or field='goodId' and position(lower(query) in lower(good.id))>0
      or field='code' and position(lower(query) in lower(coalesce(good.code,'')))>0
      or field='maker' and position(lower(query) in lower(coalesce(good.notice_maker,'')))>0)))
   and (origin_id is null or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id where m.group_id=g.id and good.origin_id=origin_id))
   and (stock='all' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods_variants v on v.id=m.variant_id
     where m.group_id=g.id and v.archived_at is null and case stock when 'available' then v.stock_qty>0 else v.stock_qty=0 end))
   and (shipping='all' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id
     where m.group_id=g.id and case shipping when 'free' then good.shipping_fee_type='free' else good.shipping_fee_type<>'free' end))
 ), selected as materialized(select * from matched m where status='all' or m.group_status=status),
 paged as (select * from selected s order by case when sort_value='created_desc' then s.created_at end desc,
   case when sort_value='updated_desc' then s.updated_at end desc,case when sort_value='name_asc' then s.name end,s.id
   limit page_size offset (page::bigint-1)*page_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.goods_group_snapshot(p.id) order by
   case when sort_value='created_desc' then p.created_at end desc,case when sort_value='updated_desc' then p.updated_at end desc,
   case when sort_value='name_asc' then p.name end,p.id) from paged p),'[]'),
  'total',(select count(*) from selected),'page',page,'pageSize',page_size,
  'counts',jsonb_build_object('all',(select count(*) from matched),'published',(select count(*) from matched where group_status='published'),
   'draft',(select count(*) from matched where group_status='draft'),'archived',(select count(*) from matched where group_status='archived')),
  'metadata',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(p.id,jsonb_build_object('createdAt',p.created_at,'updatedAt',p.updated_at,'category',p.category_name)) from paged p),'{}')) into result;
 return result;
end;
$$

-- joins the anonymous analytics session ledger or inherits marketing consent.
create table private.member_activity_settings (

 revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0), enabled_since timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create table private.member_activity_consents (
 user_id uuid primary key references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
 choice text not null check(choice in ('accepted','declined')), notice_version text not null check(notice_version='member-activity-v1'),
 revision bigint not null check(revision>0), accepted_at timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),

create or replace function private.customer_segment_members(p_rule jsonb,p_at timestamptz)
returns table(customer_id uuid,marketing_consent boolean) language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare rule jsonb:=private.normalize_customer_segment_rule(p_rule); target text; months integer; days integer; period_start timestamptz; activity_start timestamptz;
begin
 if p_at is null or not isfinite(p_at) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_segment_time';end if;
 if not private.customer_segment_references_available(rule) then raise object_not_in_prerequisite_state using message='customer_segment_target_unavailable';end if;
 target:=rule->>'target';months:=(rule->>'months')::integer;days:=(rule->>'activityDays')::integer;
 period_start:=case when months is not null then ((p_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')-make_interval(months=>months)) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' end;
 activity_start:=greatest(p_at-make_interval(days=>coalesce(days,30)),(((p_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date-89)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'));
 return query
 with recursive category_tree as (
  select c.id from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=(rule->>'categoryId')::uuid
  union select child.id from public.catalog_categories child join category_tree parent on child.parent_id=parent.id
 ), scope_goods as materialized (
  select g.id from public.goods g where rule->>'goodsScope'='all'
   or (rule->>'goodsScope'='goods' and rule->'goodIds' ? g.id)
   or (rule->>'goodsScope'='category' and exists(select 1 from category_tree c where c.id=g.category_id
     or exists(select 1 from public.goods_additional_categories a where a.good_id=g.id and a.category_id=c.id)))
 ), valid_orders as materialized (
  select o.id,o.user_id,o.created_at from public.orders o where o.status in ('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done') and o.created_at<=p_at
   and exists(select 1 from public.payments p where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.status='paid' and p.amount=o.total)
 ), purchase_facts as (
  select o.user_id,count(*) orders,min(o.created_at) first_at,max(o.created_at) last_at from valid_orders o group by o.user_id
 ), candidates as (
  select p.id,p.consents,coalesce(f.orders,0) orders,f.first_at,f.last_at from public.profiles p left join purchase_facts f on f.user_id=p.id
  where p.role='user' and p.onboarded_at is not null and p.suspended_at is null
   and p.consents->'terms'='true'::jsonb and p.consents->'privacy'='true'::jsonb
   and p.birth_date is not null and p.birth_date<=((p_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date-interval '14 years')::date
   and not exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences fence where fence.subject_user_id=p.id)
   and (jsonb_array_length(rule->'grades')=0 or rule->'grades' ? p.loyalty_grade::text)
   and (jsonb_array_length(rule->'ageBands')=0 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(rule->'ageBands') band
    where case when band='60' then extract(year from age((p_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date,p.birth_date))>=60
      else extract(year from age((p_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date,p.birth_date))>=band::integer
       and extract(year from age((p_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date,p.birth_date))<band::integer+10 end))
 ) select c.id,coalesce(c.consents->'marketing'='true'::jsonb,false) from candidates c
 where case target
  when 'first_purchase' then c.orders=0
  when 'purchased' then exists(select 1 from valid_orders o where o.user_id=c.id and (period_start is null or o.created_at>=period_start)
    and (rule->>'goodsScope'='all' or exists(select 1 from public.order_items i join scope_goods g on g.id=i.good_id where i.order_id=o.id)))
  when 'first_purchase_recent' then c.orders>0 and c.first_at>=period_start
  when 'lapsed_purchase' then c.orders>0 and c.last_at<period_start
  when 'repeat_purchase' then c.orders>=2 and (period_start is null or (c.first_at<period_start and c.last_at>=period_start))
  when 'cart_unpurchased' then exists(select 1 from public.cart_items item join scope_goods g on g.id=item.good_id where item.user_id=c.id and item.qty>0
    and item.created_at<=p_at and (days is null or item.created_at>=p_at-make_interval(days=>days))
    and not exists(select 1 from valid_orders o join public.order_items i on i.order_id=o.id where o.user_id=c.id and i.good_id=item.good_id and o.created_at>=item.created_at))
  when 'wishlist_unpurchased' then exists(select 1 from public.wishlists item join scope_goods g on g.id=item.good_id where item.user_id=c.id
    and item.created_at<=p_at and (days is null or item.created_at>=p_at-make_interval(days=>days))
    and not exists(select 1 from valid_orders o join public.order_items i on i.order_id=o.id where o.user_id=c.id and i.good_id=item.good_id and o.created_at>=item.created_at))
  when 'unused_coupon' then exists(select 1 from public.user_coupons held join public.coupons coupon on coupon.code=held.coupon_code
    where held.user_id=c.id and held.status='active' and coupon.status='active' and held.usable_from<=p_at and (held.expires_at is null or held.expires_at>p_at)
      and (rule->>'couponCode' is null or held.coupon_code=rule->>'couponCode'))
  when 'ip_notifications' then exists(select 1 from public.ip_follows follow where follow.user_id=c.id and (follow.notify_drops or follow.notify_events)
    and (rule->>'ipId' is null or follow.ip_id=rule->>'ipId'))
  when 'visited' then exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_consents ac cross join private.member_activity_settings cfg
    where ac.user_id=c.id and ac.choice='accepted' and ac.accepted_at<=p_at and cfg.singleton and cfg.enabled
      and exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_events ev where ev.user_id=c.id and ev.observed_at>=activity_start and ev.observed_at<=p_at and ev.kind='visit'))
  when 'not_visited' then exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_consents ac cross join private.member_activity_settings cfg
    where ac.user_id=c.id and ac.choice='accepted' and ac.accepted_at<=activity_start and cfg.singleton and cfg.enabled and cfg.enabled_since<=activity_start
      and not exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_events ev where ev.user_id=c.id and ev.observed_at>=activity_start and ev.observed_at<=p_at and ev.kind='visit'))
  when 'product_viewed' then exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_consents ac cross join private.member_activity_settings cfg
    where ac.user_id=c.id and ac.choice='accepted' and ac.accepted_at<=p_at and cfg.singleton and cfg.enabled
      and exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_events ev join scope_goods sg on sg.id=ev.target_id
        where ev.user_id=c.id and ev.page_kind='good' and ev.kind='visit' and ev.observed_at>=activity_start and ev.observed_at<=p_at))
  when 'video_viewed' then exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_consents ac cross join private.member_activity_settings cfg
    where ac.user_id=c.id and ac.choice='accepted' and ac.accepted_at<=p_at and cfg.singleton and cfg.enabled
      and exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_events ev join scope_goods sg on sg.id=ev.target_id
        where ev.user_id=c.id and ev.page_kind='good' and ev.kind='video_started' and ev.observed_at>=activity_start and ev.observed_at<=p_at))
  when 'similar_product_viewed' then exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_consents ac cross join private.member_activity_settings cfg
    where ac.user_id=c.id and ac.choice='accepted' and ac.accepted_at<=p_at and cfg.singleton and cfg.enabled
      and exists(select 1 from private.member_activity_events ev where ev.user_id=c.id and ev.page_kind='good' and ev.kind='visit'
        and ev.observed_at>=activity_start and ev.observed_at<=p_at and not (rule->'goodIds' ? ev.target_id)
        and exists(select 1 from public.goods selected where rule->'goodIds' ? selected.id and selected.category_id=ev.category_id)))
  else false end;
end $$

create or replace function private.customer_segment_group(p_target text) returns text language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select case when p_target in ('not_visited','similar_product_viewed') then 'potential'
  when p_target in ('first_purchase','visited') then 'visitor'
  when p_target in ('cart_unpurchased','wishlist_unpurchased','unused_coupon','ip_notifications','product_viewed','video_viewed') then 'interested'
  when p_target in ('purchased','first_purchase_recent','lapsed_purchase') then 'buyer' when p_target='repeat_purchase' then 'loyal' end;
$$

revoke all on function private.normalize_customer_segment_rule(jsonb),private.customer_segment_members(jsonb,timestamptz),private.customer_segment_group(text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

   ('visited','최근 30일 방문 회원'),('not_visited','최근 30일 미방문 회원'),('product_viewed','최근 30일 상품 조회 회원'),('video_viewed','최근 30일 영상 시청 회원')) x(key,name)

create or replace function public.admin_list_customer_segments(p_query text default '',p_group text default 'all',p_target text default 'all',p_kind text default 'all',p_favorite_only boolean default false,p_page integer default 1,p_page_size integer default 20)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid(); result jsonb; q text:=btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage') then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if length(q)>100 or p_group is null or p_group not in ('all','potential','visitor','interested','buyer','loyal')
  or p_target is null or p_target not in ('all','first_purchase','cart_unpurchased','wishlist_unpurchased','unused_coupon','ip_notifications','purchased','first_purchase_recent','lapsed_purchase','repeat_purchase','visited','not_visited','product_viewed','video_viewed','similar_product_viewed')
  or p_kind is null or p_kind not in ('all','preset','custom') or p_favorite_only is null
  or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 1000000 or p_page_size is null or p_page_size not in (20,50,100) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_segment_filter';end if;
 with matched as materialized (
  select s.id,s.updated_at from private.customer_segments s where s.archived_at is null
   and (q='' or position(lower(q) in lower(s.name))>0 or position(lower(q) in s.id::text)>0 or position(lower(q) in lower('CSG-'||s.reference::text))>0)
   and (p_group='all' or private.customer_segment_group(s.rule->>'target')=p_group)
   and (p_target='all' or s.rule->>'target'=p_target)
   and (p_kind='all' or (s.preset_key is not null)=(p_kind='preset'))
   and (not p_favorite_only or exists(select 1 from private.customer_segment_favorites f where f.actor_id=actor and f.segment_id=s.id))
 ), page_rows as (select * from matched order by updated_at desc,id desc limit p_page_size offset (p_page-1)*p_page_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from matched),'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.customer_segment_document(id,actor) order by updated_at desc,id desc) from page_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
  'favorites',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.customer_segment_document(f.segment_id,actor) order by f.created_at,f.segment_id)
    from private.customer_segment_favorites f join private.customer_segments s on s.id=f.segment_id where f.actor_id=actor and s.archived_at is null),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end $$

create or replace function private.customer_segment_references_available(p_rule jsonb)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select (p_rule->>'target' not in ('visited','not_visited','product_viewed','video_viewed','similar_product_viewed') or (select enabled from private.member_activity_settings where singleton))
  and (p_rule->>'goodsScope'<>'goods' or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_rule->'goodIds') requested(id)
   where not exists(select 1 from public.goods good where good.id=requested.id)))
  and (p_rule->>'goodsScope'<>'category' or exists(select 1 from public.catalog_categories where id=(p_rule->>'categoryId')::uuid))
  and (p_rule->>'ipId' is null or exists(select 1 from public.ips where id=p_rule->>'ipId'))
  and (p_rule->>'couponCode' is null or exists(select 1 from public.coupons where code=p_rule->>'couponCode'));
$$

-- One disclosure per public review, including a later reversal. Multiple

create or replace function public.get_review_event_disclosures(p_review_ids uuid[])
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
 if p_review_ids is null or cardinality(p_review_ids)>500 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_event_targets';end if;
 return (with benefits as (
  select a.source_review_id review_id,e.title,a.revoked_at is not null revoked
   from private.review_event_awards a join private.review_events e on e.id=a.event_id and e.announced_at is not null
   where a.source_review_id=any(p_review_ids)
  union all
  select b.review_id,'BEST 리뷰 보상',b.revoked_at is not null from private.review_best_rewards b where b.review_id=any(p_review_ids) and b.amount>0
 ), disclosed as (
  select r.id,string_agg(distinct b.title,' · ' order by b.title) title,bool_and(b.revoked) revoked from benefits b
  join public.reviews r on r.id=b.review_id and r.status='visible'
  join public.goods g on g.id=r.good_id and g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none'
  join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null group by r.id
 ) select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('reviewId',id,'eventTitle',title,'revoked',revoked) order by id),'[]'::jsonb) from disclosed);
end $$

 SET search_path TO ''

  'createdAt',c.created_at,'updatedAt',c.updated_at,'archived',c.archived_at is not null,
  'estimate',private.customer_segment_estimate_document(c.estimate_id),
  'selectedProducts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','good','id',g.id,'label',g.name,'extra',g.code) order by requested.position) from jsonb_array_elements_text(c.content->'goodIds') with ordinality requested(id,position) join public.goods g on g.id=requested.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'runs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'scheduledAt',r.scheduled_at,'state',r.state,'reason',r.reason,'startedAt',r.started_at,'completedAt',r.completed_at,
   'candidateCount',r.candidate_count,'sentCount',(select count(*) from private.marketing_recipients rec where rec.run_id=r.id and rec.state='sent'),
   'excludedCount',(select count(*) from private.marketing_recipients rec where rec.run_id=r.id and rec.state='excluded'),
   'readCount',(select count(*) from private.marketing_recipients rec join public.notifications n on n.id=rec.notification_id where rec.run_id=r.id and n.read_at is not null)) order by r.scheduled_at,r.id)
   from private.marketing_runs r where r.campaign_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb)) from private.marketing_campaigns c join private.customer_segments s on s.id=c.segment_id where c.id=p_id;

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or private.is_account_write_fenced(auth.uid()) then return null;end if;
 select jsonb_build_object('id',rec.id,'registeredAt',rec.registered_at,'content',c.content,'coupon',private.marketing_coupon_document(c.content->>'couponCode'),
  'goodIds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(g.id order by choice.position)
    from jsonb_array_elements_text(c.content->'goodIds') with ordinality choice(id,position) join public.goods g on g.id=choice.id join public.ips i on i.id=g.ip_id
    where g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none' and i.archived_at is null and i.published_at is not null),'[]'::jsonb)) into result
 from private.marketing_recipients rec join private.marketing_runs r on r.id=rec.run_id join private.marketing_campaigns c on c.id=r.campaign_id
 where rec.id=p_recipient_id and rec.customer_id=auth.uid() and rec.state='sent' and exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=auth.uid() and suspended_at is null);
 return result;
end $function$

ledger.name: in_transit_claim_intake
statements: begin

-- Intake broadens to in-transit whole orders. Physical recovery is still a
-- separate prerequisite for every refund or replacement; no carrier API runs.
create function private.order_return_intake_eligible(p_order_id uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.order_all_items_delivered(p_order_id) or exists(
  select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=p_order_id and o.status='shipping'
   and exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id)
   and exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.status in ('shipping','delivered') and s.shipped_at is not null)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.status='canceled')
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id and coalesce((select sum(link.qty) from public.order_shipment_items link
    join public.order_shipments s on s.id=link.shipment_id where link.order_id=i.order_id and link.order_item_id=i.id and s.status in ('ready','shipping','delivered')),0)<>i.qty)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id and c.claim_type='exchange' and c.stage='completed'
    and (c.reshipped_at is null or c.reship_carrier is null or c.reship_tracking_number is null or c.reship_delivered_at is null or c.reship_delivered_by is null or c.reship_delivery_evidence is null))
 );
$$
revoke all on function private.order_return_intake_eligible(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_order_transition_during_cancellation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status is distinct from old.status
    and new.status <> 'canceled'
    -- Arrival records an already-dispatched package; it never releases a
    -- not-yet-dispatched item or advances a refund.
    and not (old.status='shipping' and new.status='delivered'
      and private.order_return_intake_eligible(old.id)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=old.id and (s.status<>'delivered' or s.delivered_at is null))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=old.id))
    and (
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.order_cancellation_claims as claim
        where claim.order_id = old.id
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
        where request.order_id = old.id
          and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
      )
    )
  then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '23514',
      message = 'order cancellation in progress';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

-- A whole-order replacement can be the first physical supply when the
-- original parcel was recalled in transit. Its own receipt is the evidence;
-- the original shipment timestamps are never fabricated or overwritten.
create or replace function private.order_all_items_delivered(target_order uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=target_order and o.status in ('delivered','done'))
  and exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=target_order)
  and (not exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=target_order and
    coalesce((select sum(link.qty) from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_shipments s on s.id=link.shipment_id
     where link.order_item_id=i.id and link.order_id=i.order_id and s.status='delivered' and s.delivered_at is not null),0)<>i.qty)
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=target_order and c.claim_type='exchange' and c.stage='completed'
    and c.reship_delivered_at is not null and c.reship_delivered_by is not null and c.reship_delivery_evidence is not null and private.claim_collections_complete(c.id)))
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=target_order and c.claim_type='exchange' and c.stage='completed'
    and (c.reshipped_at is null or c.reship_carrier is null or c.reship_tracking_number is null or c.reship_delivered_at is null or c.reship_delivered_by is null or c.reship_delivery_evidence is null));
$$

 select jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'orderId',c.order_id,'claimRevision',c.claim_revision,'editable',
  (case when c.stage='on_hold' then c.held_from else c.stage end) in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected')

 'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentId',s.id,'originName',s.origin_name_snapshot,'revision',coalesce(p.revision,0),
  'method',coalesce(p.method,i->>'method','not_requested'),'carrier',case when p.revision is not null then p.carrier else i->>'carrier' end,'trackingNumber',case when p.revision is not null then p.tracking_number else i->>'trackingNumber' end,
  'evidence',coalesce(p.evidence,i->>'note',''),'requestedOnce',coalesce(p.requested_once,false) or coalesce(i->>'method','not_requested')<>'not_requested',
  'collectedAt',x.collected_at,'updatedAt',p.updated_at) order by s.id)
  from public.order_shipments s left join private.claim_collection_plans p on p.claim_id=c.id and p.shipment_id=s.id
  left join public.order_claim_collections x on x.claim_id=c.id and x.shipment_id=s.id

  where s.order_id=c.order_id),'[]'::jsonb),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_withdrawal_blocker(p_claim order_cancellation_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
  when p_claim.stage='withdrawn' then 'claim_already_withdrawn'
  when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then coalesce(p_claim.held_from,'requested') else p_claim.stage end) not in('requested','in_review','collecting') then 'claim_withdrawal_started'
  when p_claim.collected_at is not null or p_claim.reshipped_at is not null
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_collections where claim_id=p_claim.id and collected_at is not null)
   or exists(select 1 from private.claim_collection_plans where claim_id=p_claim.id and customer_sent_once)
   or exists(select 1 from private.seller_order_claim_intakes intake cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(intake.payload->'collections') item
    where intake.claim_id=p_claim.id and item->>'method'='customer_sent') then 'claim_withdrawal_collection_started'
  when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
   or exists(select 1 from public.refunds refund join public.payments payment on payment.id=refund.payment_id where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
   or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_withdrawal_finance_started'
  else null end;
$function$

 select jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'orderId',c.order_id,'claimRevision',c.claim_revision,'revision',coalesce(l.revision,0),'claimType',c.claim_type,
 'policy',case when p_operator then private.claim_fee_policy_document() else null end,

   and not exists(select 1 from private.claim_fee_invoices where claim_id=c.id and state in('unpaid','reported','paid')),

 'history',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'invoiceId',e.invoice_id,'kind',e.kind,'at',e.created_at,

create function private.shipment_pack_identity(p_shipment uuid) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$

 'address',jsonb_build_object('recipientName',btrim(a->>'recipientName'),'phone',regexp_replace(a->>'phone','[[:space:]-]','','g'),

 'gift',exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents where order_id=o.id),
 'collector',(select value->'collector' from jsonb_array_elements(t.original_receipt#>'{display,shipping}') where value->>'originId'=s.origin_id::text))
 from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id left join private.order_delivery_private_snapshots d on d.order_id=o.id
 left join private.order_goods_transactions t on t.order_id=o.id cross join lateral(select private.operational_order_address(o.id) a)address where s.id=p_shipment;
$$

create function private.assert_shipment_pack_basis(p_ids uuid[]) returns void language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if exists(select 1 from private.shipment_pack_members m where m.shipment_id=any(p_ids) and m.released_at is null
  and m.identity_digest<>encode(extensions.digest(private.shipment_pack_identity(m.shipment_id)::text,'sha256'),'hex')) then
  raise sqlstate 'PT409' using message='shipment_pack_address_changed';end if;
end $$

$$

-- Packaging requires exact original payment and item-allocation evidence.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_pack_ready(p_shipment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare s public.order_shipments;o public.orders;a jsonb;begin
 select * into s from public.order_shipments where id=p_shipment;
 select * into o from public.orders where id=s.order_id;a:=private.shipment_pack_identity(p_shipment)->'address';
 if s.id is null or s.delivery_method<>'parcel' or s.status<>'ready' or o.status not in('confirmed','shipping')
  or s.shipped_at is not null or not private.shipment_preorder_allocation_ready(s.id)
  or coalesce(a->>'recipientName','')='' or coalesce(a->>'address1','')='' or coalesce(a->>'postalCode','')!~'^[0-9]{5}$'
  or coalesce(a->>'phone','')!~'^[0-9]{8,15}$'
  or not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items where shipment_id=s.id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items a join public.order_items i on i.id=a.order_item_id where a.shipment_id=s.id and (a.order_id<>o.id or i.order_id<>o.id or a.qty<>i.qty))
  or exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences where subject_user_id=any(private.contact_parties(o.id)))
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=o.id and status in('requested','processing','needs_review'))
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=o.id)
  or not exists(select 1 from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=o.id and user_id=o.user_id and amount=o.total and status='paid') then return false;end if;
 return true;
end $function$
commit

-- Ordinary review rights remain delivery + 90 days. Monthly creation is opt-in.
-- Existing repeat-purchase labels stay unknown; do not infer past write-time facts.
create table private.review_type_policy (
 singleton boolean primary key default true check(singleton), revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),
 enabled boolean not null default false, basis text not null default 'delivered' check(basis in('delivered','confirmed')),
 start_days integer check(start_days between 30 and 365), end_days integer check(end_days between 30 and 730),
 max_order_days integer check(max_order_days between 1 and 1095), reward_eligible boolean not null default false,
 evidence text not null default '',updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check(start_days is null or end_days is null or end_days>=start_days),
 check(not enabled or start_days is not null and end_days is not null)
)
insert into private.review_type_policy(singleton) values(true)
alter table private.review_type_policy enable row level security
revoke all on private.review_type_policy from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

alter table public.reviews add column review_kind text not null default 'ordinary' check(review_kind in('ordinary','month')),
 add column repeat_purchase boolean,add column write_deadline_at timestamptz,add column type_policy_revision bigint,
 add column month_reward_eligible boolean not null default false
update public.reviews r set write_deadline_at=private.review_write_deadline(o.delivered_at) from public.orders o where o.id=r.order_id
alter table public.reviews drop constraint reviews_order_good_user_unique
alter table public.reviews add constraint reviews_order_good_user_kind_unique unique(order_id,good_id,user_id,review_kind)
create index reviews_kind_recent_idx on public.reviews(review_kind,created_at desc,id desc)

create function private.review_type_policy_document() returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('revision',revision,'enabled',enabled,'basis',basis,'startDays',start_days,'endDays',end_days,
  'maxOrderDays',max_order_days,'rewardEligible',reward_eligible,'evidence',evidence,'updatedAt',updated_at) from private.review_type_policy where singleton;
$$

create function public.admin_get_review_type_policy() returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 perform private.require_operator_capability('cs.manage',false);return private.review_type_policy_document();end $$

create function private.review_type_window(p_order public.orders,p_kind text) returns table(opens_at timestamptz,deadline_at timestamptz,policy_revision bigint,reward_eligible boolean)
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case when p_kind='ordinary' then p_order.delivered_at else b.at+make_interval(days=>p.start_days) end,
 case when p_kind='ordinary' then private.review_write_deadline(p_order.delivered_at)
  else least(b.at+make_interval(days=>p.end_days),case when p.max_order_days is not null then p_order.created_at+make_interval(days=>p.max_order_days) end) end,
 case when p_kind='month' then p.revision end,p_kind='month' and p.reward_eligible
 from private.review_type_policy p cross join lateral(select case when p.basis='delivered' then p_order.delivered_at else
  (select confirmed_at from private.order_purchase_confirmations where order_id=p_order.id) end at)b
 where p.singleton and(p_kind='ordinary' or p_kind='month' and p.enabled and b.at is not null);
$$
create trigger review_type_snapshot before insert or update on public.reviews for each row execute function private.review_type_snapshot()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_review_targets(target_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_good_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, target_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, good_id text, good_name text, good_bg text, good_image_path text, ordered_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone, deadline_at timestamp with time zone, writable boolean, review_id uuid, review_rating smallint, review_body text, review_image_paths text[], review_status text, review_created_at timestamp with time zone, review_edited_at timestamp with time zone, admin_reply text, admin_reply_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 50), 1), 200);
begin
  if v_actor is null then
    raise invalid_authorization_specification using message = 'auth_required';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    ordered.id as order_id,
    item.good_id,
    good.name as good_name,
    good.bg as good_bg,
    good.image_path as good_image_path,
    ordered.created_at as ordered_at,
    ordered.delivered_at,
    private.review_write_deadline(ordered.delivered_at) as deadline_at,
    (
      review.id is null
      and ordered.delivered_at is not null
      and now() <= private.review_write_deadline(ordered.delivered_at)
    ) as writable,
    review.id as review_id,
    review.rating as review_rating,
    review.body as review_body,
    review.image_paths as review_image_paths,
    review.status as review_status,
    review.created_at as review_created_at,
    review.edited_at as review_edited_at,
    review.admin_reply,
    review.admin_reply_at
  from public.orders as ordered
  join public.order_items as item on item.order_id = ordered.id
  join public.goods as good on good.id = item.good_id
  left join public.reviews as review
    on review.order_id = ordered.id
    and review.good_id = item.good_id
    and review.user_id = v_actor
    and review.review_kind = 'ordinary'
  where ordered.user_id = v_actor
    and ordered.status in ('delivered', 'done')
    and (target_order_id is null or ordered.id = target_order_id)
    and (target_good_id is null or item.good_id = target_good_id)
  /* 쓸 수 있는 것이 먼저, 그중에서도 기한이 임박한 것이 위로. */
  order by
    case when review.id is null then 0 else 1 end,
    ordered.delivered_at desc nulls last,
    item.good_id
  limit v_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_review_targets_v2(target_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_good_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, target_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, good_id text, good_name text, good_bg text, good_image_path text, ordered_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone, deadline_at timestamp with time zone, writable boolean, review_id uuid, review_rating smallint, review_body text, review_image_paths text[], review_status text, review_created_at timestamp with time zone, review_edited_at timestamp with time zone, admin_reply text, admin_reply_at timestamp with time zone, review_kind text, opens_at timestamp with time zone, editable boolean, month_reward_eligible boolean, repeat_purchase boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 50), 1), 200);
begin
  if v_actor is null then
    raise invalid_authorization_specification using message = 'auth_required';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    ordered.id as order_id,
    item.good_id,
    good.name as good_name,
    good.bg as good_bg,
    good.image_path as good_image_path,
    ordered.created_at as ordered_at,
    ordered.delivered_at,
    coalesce(review.write_deadline_at,w.deadline_at) as deadline_at,
    (
      review.id is null
      and ordered.delivered_at is not null
      and now() between w.opens_at and w.deadline_at
      and private.review_event_purchase_eligible(ordered.id,v_actor,item.good_id)
      and not private.is_account_write_fenced(v_actor)
    ) as writable,
    review.id as review_id,
    review.rating as review_rating,
    review.body as review_body,
    review.image_paths as review_image_paths,
    review.status as review_status,
    review.created_at as review_created_at,
    review.edited_at as review_edited_at,
    review.admin_reply,
    review.admin_reply_at,kind.value,w.opens_at,
    review.id is not null and review.status='visible' and now()<=coalesce(review.write_deadline_at,w.deadline_at) and private.review_event_purchase_eligible(ordered.id,v_actor,item.good_id) and not private.is_account_write_fenced(v_actor),
    coalesce(review.month_reward_eligible,w.reward_eligible,false),review.repeat_purchase
  from public.orders as ordered
  join (select distinct order_id,good_id from public.order_items) as item on item.order_id = ordered.id
  join public.goods as good on good.id = item.good_id
  cross join (values('ordinary'::text),('month'::text)) kind(value)
  left join lateral private.review_type_window(ordered,kind.value)w on true
  left join public.reviews as review
    on review.order_id = ordered.id
    and review.good_id = item.good_id
    and review.user_id = v_actor
    and review.review_kind = kind.value
  where ordered.user_id = v_actor
    and ordered.status in ('delivered', 'done')
    and(kind.value='ordinary' or w.opens_at is not null or review.id is not null)
    and (target_order_id is null or ordered.id = target_order_id)
    and (target_good_id is null or item.good_id = target_good_id)
  /* 쓸 수 있는 것이 먼저, 그중에서도 기한이 임박한 것이 위로. */
  order by
    case when review.id is null then 0 else 1 end,
    ordered.delivered_at desc nulls last,
    item.good_id
  limit v_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_good_group_reviews_v3(p_good_id text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recent'::text, p_photo_only boolean DEFAULT false, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_kind text DEFAULT 'all', p_repeat text DEFAULT 'all')
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare ids text[];result jsonb;viewer uuid:=private.review_helpful_viewer_id();viewer_active boolean:=private.review_helpful_actor_is_active(viewer);
begin
 if p_kind is null or p_kind not in('all','ordinary','month') or p_repeat is null or p_repeat not in('all','yes','no','unknown') then raise invalid_parameter_value;end if;
 if p_sort is null or p_sort not in('recent','rating_desc','rating_asc','helpful_desc') or p_photo_only is null
  or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 or p_offset is null or p_offset not between 0 and 1000000 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_review_page';end if;
 ids:=private.goods_group_review_good_ids(p_good_id);
 with visible as materialized (
  select r.review_kind,r.repeat_purchase,r.id,r.good_id,r.order_id,r.rating,r.body,r.image_paths,r.user_id,r.created_at,r.edited_at,r.admin_reply,r.admin_reply_at,helpful.helpful_count,helpful.helpful_by_me,
   coalesce(nullif(btrim(author.nickname),''),'fan_'||left(r.user_id::text,6)) author_name,
   coalesce((select item.good_name_snapshot from public.order_items item where item.order_id=r.order_id and item.good_id=r.good_id order by item.id limit 1),g.name) good_name,
   coalesce((select array_agg(distinct item.variant_name_snapshot order by item.variant_name_snapshot) from public.order_items item
    where item.order_id=r.order_id and item.good_id=r.good_id and item.variant_name_snapshot is not null),'{}'::text[]) variant_names
  from public.reviews r join public.profiles author on author.id=r.user_id join public.goods g on g.id=r.good_id
  cross join lateral(select count(*)::bigint helpful_count,coalesce(bool_or(v.user_id=viewer),false) helpful_by_me
   from private.review_helpful_votes v where v.review_id=r.id) helpful
  where r.good_id=any(ids) and r.status='visible'
 ), filtered as materialized (
  select * from visible where (not p_photo_only or cardinality(image_paths)>0) and(p_kind='all' or review_kind=p_kind)
  and(p_repeat='all' or p_repeat='yes' and repeat_purchase is true or p_repeat='no' and repeat_purchase is false or p_repeat='unknown' and repeat_purchase is null)
 ), page as (
  select * from filtered order by case when p_sort='helpful_desc' then helpful_count end desc nulls last,case when p_sort='rating_desc' then rating end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='rating_asc' then rating end asc nulls last,created_at desc,id desc limit p_limit offset p_offset
 ) select jsonb_build_object('viewerAuthenticated',viewer is not null,'grouped',exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members where good_id=p_good_id) and cardinality(ids)>0,
  'summary',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'average',coalesce(round(avg(rating),2),0),
   'distribution',jsonb_build_array(count(*) filter(where rating=1),count(*) filter(where rating=2),count(*) filter(where rating=3),count(*) filter(where rating=4),count(*) filter(where rating=5)),
   'photoCount',count(*) filter(where cardinality(image_paths)>0)) from visible),
  'total',(select count(*) from filtered),
  'reviews',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',review_kind,'repeatPurchase',repeat_purchase,'id',id,'goodId',good_id,'goodName',good_name,'variantNames',to_jsonb(variant_names),
   'rating',rating,'body',body,'imagePaths',to_jsonb(coalesce(image_paths,'{}'::text[])),'authorName',author_name,
   'helpfulCount',helpful_count,'helpfulByMe',helpful_by_me,'canMarkHelpful',viewer_active and user_id<>viewer,'isMine',auth.uid() is not null and user_id=auth.uid(),'createdAt',created_at,'editedAt',edited_at,'adminReply',admin_reply,'adminReplyAt',admin_reply_at)
   order by case when p_sort='helpful_desc' then helpful_count end desc nulls last,case when p_sort='rating_desc' then rating end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='rating_asc' then rating end asc nulls last,created_at desc,id desc) from page),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_reviews_typed(p_review_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_rating integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_has_photo boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_has_reply boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_low_rating boolean DEFAULT false, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_field text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recent'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_best text DEFAULT 'all'::text,p_kind text DEFAULT 'all',p_repeat text DEFAULT 'all')
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, good_id text, good_name text, order_id uuid, user_id uuid, author_name text, author_email text, rating smallint, body text, image_paths text[], status text, hidden_reason text, hidden_at timestamp with time zone, admin_reply text, admin_reply_at timestamp with time zone, reply_author_name text, report_count bigint, open_report_count bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, edited_at timestamp with time zone, total_count bigint, best_selection jsonb, helpful_count bigint, review_kind text, repeat_purchase boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_field text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_field, '')), ''), 'all');
  v_sort text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_sort, '')), ''), 'recent');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

  if p_status is not null and p_status not in ('visible', 'hidden') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_status_filter';
  end if;
  if p_rating is not null and p_rating not between 1 and 5 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_rating_filter';
  end if;
  if v_field not in ('all', 'good', 'author', 'body') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_search_field';
  end if;
  if v_sort not in ('recent', 'oldest', 'rating_desc', 'rating_asc', 'good_name_asc', 'photo_count_desc', 'helpful_desc') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_sort';
  end if;
  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_date_range';
  end if;
  if v_query is not null and char_length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'review_search_query_too_long';
  end if;

  if p_best is null or p_best not in ('all','selected','not_selected','needs_review') then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_best_review_filter';end if;
  if p_kind is null or p_kind not in('all','ordinary','month') or p_repeat is null or p_repeat not in('all','yes','no','unknown') then raise invalid_parameter_value;end if;
  return query
  select
    review.id,
    review.good_id,
    good.name as good_name,
    review.order_id,
    review.user_id,
    coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(author.nickname, '')), ''),
      'fan_' || left(review.user_id::text, 6)
    ) as author_name,
    author.email as author_email,
    review.rating,
    review.body,
    review.image_paths,
    review.status,
    review.hidden_reason,
    review.hidden_at,
    review.admin_reply,
    review.admin_reply_at,
    replier.nickname as reply_author_name,
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.reports as report
      where report.target_type = 'review'
        and report.target_id = review.id::text
    ) as report_count,
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.reports as report
      where report.target_type = 'review'
        and report.target_id = review.id::text
        and report.status in ('open', 'reviewing')
    ) as open_report_count,
    review.created_at,
    review.edited_at,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count,
    private.review_best_state(review) as best_selection,
    helpful.helpful_count,review.review_kind,review.repeat_purchase
  from public.reviews as review
  join public.goods as good on good.id = review.good_id
  cross join lateral(select count(*)::bigint helpful_count from private.review_helpful_votes vote where vote.review_id=review.id) helpful
  join public.profiles as author on author.id = review.user_id
  left join public.profiles as replier on replier.id = review.admin_reply_by
  where(p_kind='all' or review.review_kind=p_kind) and(p_repeat='all' or p_repeat='yes' and review.repeat_purchase is true or p_repeat='no' and review.repeat_purchase is false or p_repeat='unknown' and review.repeat_purchase is null)
    and (p_review_id is null or review.id = p_review_id)
    and (p_best='all' or (p_best='not_selected' and not exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected)) or (p_best in ('selected','needs_review') and exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected and private.review_best_state(review)->>'state'=p_best)))
    and (p_status is null or review.status = p_status)
    and (p_rating is null or review.rating = p_rating)
    and (not coalesce(p_low_rating, false) or review.rating <= 2)
    and (
      p_has_photo is null
      or (p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) > 0)
      or (not p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) = 0)
    )
    and (
      p_has_reply is null
      or (p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is not null)
      or (not p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is null)
    )
    and (
      p_from is null
      or review.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or review.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      v_query is null
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'good')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(good.name)) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.good_id)) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'author')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.email, ''))) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'body')
        and position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.body)) > 0
      )
    )
  order by
    case when v_sort = 'helpful_desc' then helpful.helpful_count end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'photo_count_desc' then coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
