-- Version 1 receipts and readers remain immutable and callable.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_export_snapshot_v2(p_actor_id uuid, p_filters jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 p_review_id uuid;p_from date;p_to date;p_rating integer;p_status text;p_has_photo boolean;p_has_reply boolean;p_low_rating boolean;p_best text;
 p_kind text;p_repeat text;v_query text;v_field text;v_sort text;query_units integer;row_count integer;exported jsonb;fingerprint text;
 trim_chars constant text:=chr(9)||chr(10)||chr(11)||chr(12)||chr(13)||chr(32)||chr(160)||chr(5760)
  ||chr(8192)||chr(8193)||chr(8194)||chr(8195)||chr(8196)||chr(8197)||chr(8198)||chr(8199)||chr(8200)||chr(8201)||chr(8202)
  ||chr(8232)||chr(8233)||chr(8239)||chr(8287)||chr(12288)||chr(65279);
begin
 if p_actor_id is null or not private.has_operator_capability(p_actor_id,'cs.manage',false)
  or not exists(select 1 from auth.users u where u.id=p_actor_id and u.deleted_at is null
    and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=statement_timestamp())) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='review_export_auth_changed';end if;
 if p_filters is null or jsonb_typeof(p_filters)<>'object' or octet_length(p_filters::text)>3000
  or (select array_agg(key order by key) from jsonb_object_keys(p_filters) key)
    is distinct from array['best','field','from','kind','lowRating','photo','query','rating','repeat','reply','reviewId','sort','status','to']
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_filters) f where
    case when f.key='lowRating' then jsonb_typeof(f.value)<>'boolean'
     when f.key in ('from','to','reviewId') then jsonb_typeof(f.value) not in ('string','null')
     else jsonb_typeof(f.value)<>'string' end) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 if p_filters->>'kind' not in('all','ordinary','month') or p_filters->>'repeat' not in('all','yes','no','unknown')
  or p_filters->>'rating' not in ('all','1','2','3','4','5')
  or p_filters->>'status' not in ('all','visible','hidden')
  or p_filters->>'photo' not in ('all','with','without') or p_filters->>'reply' not in ('all','with','without')
  or p_filters->>'best' not in ('all','selected','not_selected','needs_review')
  or p_filters->>'field' not in ('all','good','author','body')
  or p_filters->>'sort' not in ('recent','oldest','rating_desc','rating_asc','good_name_asc','photo_count_desc','helpful_desc')
  or (p_filters->>'from' is not null and p_filters->>'from'!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
  or (p_filters->>'to' is not null and p_filters->>'to'!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
  or (p_filters->>'reviewId' is not null and p_filters->>'reviewId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 begin
  p_from:=(p_filters->>'from')::date;p_to:=(p_filters->>'to')::date;p_review_id:=(p_filters->>'reviewId')::uuid;
 exception when invalid_datetime_format or datetime_field_overflow or invalid_text_representation then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end;
 if p_from is not null and (p_from<date '0100-01-01' or p_from>date '9999-12-31')
  or p_to is not null and (p_to<date '0100-01-01' or p_to>date '9999-12-31')
  or p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from>p_to then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 v_query:=p_filters->>'query';
 select coalesce(sum(case when ascii(unit.ch)>65535 then 2 else 1 end),0)::integer
  into query_units from regexp_split_to_table(v_query,'') as unit(ch) where unit.ch<>'';
 if v_query<>btrim(v_query,trim_chars) or query_units>100 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 v_query:=nullif(v_query,'');v_field:=p_filters->>'field';v_sort:=p_filters->>'sort';
 p_rating:=nullif(p_filters->>'rating','all')::integer;p_status:=nullif(p_filters->>'status','all');p_best:=p_filters->>'best';
 p_kind:=p_filters->>'kind';p_repeat:=p_filters->>'repeat';
 p_low_rating:=(p_filters->>'lowRating')::boolean;
 p_has_photo:=case p_filters->>'photo' when 'with' then true when 'without' then false else null end;
 p_has_reply:=case p_filters->>'reply' when 'with' then true when 'without' then false else null end;
 with bounded as materialized (
  select row_number() over (  order by
    case when v_sort = 'helpful_desc' then helpful.helpful_count end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'photo_count_desc' then coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc
) ordinal,
   jsonb_build_object('kind',review.review_kind,'repeatPurchase',review.repeat_purchase,'id',review.id,'goodId',review.good_id,'goodName',good.name,
    'authorName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(author.nickname,'')),''),'fan_'||left(review.user_id::text,6)),
    'rating',review.rating,'body',review.body,'imageCount',coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0),
    'helpfulCount',helpful.helpful_count,'status',review.status,'bestState',private.review_best_state(review)->>'state',
    'reportCount',(select count(*) from public.reports report where report.target_type='review' and report.target_id=review.id::text),
    'openReportCount',(select count(*) from public.reports report where report.target_type='review' and report.target_id=review.id::text and report.status in ('open','reviewing')),
    'hasReply',review.admin_reply is not null,'replyAt',review.admin_reply_at,'createdAt',review.created_at,'editedAt',review.edited_at) value
  from public.reviews as review
  join public.goods as good on good.id = review.good_id
  cross join lateral(select count(*)::bigint helpful_count from private.review_helpful_votes vote where vote.review_id=review.id) helpful
  join public.profiles as author on author.id = review.user_id
  left join public.profiles as replier on replier.id = review.admin_reply_by
  where(p_kind='all' or review.review_kind=p_kind) and(p_repeat='all' or p_repeat='yes' and review.repeat_purchase is true or p_repeat='no' and review.repeat_purchase is false or p_repeat='unknown' and review.repeat_purchase is null)
    and (p_review_id is null or review.id = p_review_id)
    and (p_best='all' or (p_best='not_selected' and not exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected)) or (p_best in ('selected','needs_review') and exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected and private.review_best_state(review)->>'state'=p_best)))
    and (p_status is null or review.status = p_status)
    and (p_rating is null or review.rating = p_rating)
    and (not coalesce(p_low_rating, false) or review.rating <= 2)
    and (
      p_has_photo is null
      or (p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) > 0)
      or (not p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) = 0)
    )
    and (
      p_has_reply is null
      or (p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is not null)
      or (not p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is null)
    )
    and (
      p_from is null
      or review.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or review.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      v_query is null
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'good')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(good.name)) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.good_id)) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'author')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.email, ''))) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'body')
        and position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.body)) > 0
      )
    )

  order by
    case when v_sort = 'helpful_desc' then helpful.helpful_count end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'photo_count_desc' then coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc

  limit 10001
 ) select count(*)::integer,coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) into row_count,exported from bounded;
 if row_count>10000 then raise program_limit_exceeded using message='review_export_limit';end if;
 fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('version',2,'filters',p_filters,'rows',exported)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 return jsonb_build_object('version',2,'filters',p_filters,'total',row_count,'rows',exported,'capturedAt',statement_timestamp(),'fingerprint',fingerprint);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_export_reviews_v2(p_filters jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=(select auth.uid());session_text text:=(select auth.jwt()->>'session_id');session_id uuid;
begin
 if current_setting('role',true) is distinct from 'authenticated' or actor is null
  or (select auth.jwt()->>'sub') is distinct from actor::text or session_text is null
  or session_text!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='review_export_auth_changed';end if;
 session_id:=session_text::uuid;
 if not exists(select 1 from auth.sessions s where s.id=session_id and s.user_id=actor
  and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>statement_timestamp())) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='review_export_auth_changed';end if;
 return private.review_export_snapshot_v2(actor,p_filters);
end $function$

create table private.goods_production_settings (

 lead_days integer check(lead_days between 1 and 365),day_basis text not null default 'calendar' check(day_basis in('calendar','business')),
 closed_dates date[] not null default '{}',public_note text not null default '',evidence text not null,

)

 terms jsonb not null,revision bigint not null default 1 check(revision>0),
 state text not null default 'pending' check(state in('pending','started','completed','canceled')),
 basis_at timestamptz,due_at timestamptz,started_at timestamptz,completed_at timestamptz,
 created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check((basis_at is null)=(due_at is null)),check(completed_at is null or started_at is not null and completed_at>=started_at),
 check(state not in('started','completed') or started_at is not null),check(state<>'completed' or completed_at is not null)
)
create unique index production_original_once on private.order_production_jobs(order_item_id) where claim_id is null
create unique index production_replacement_once on private.order_production_jobs(order_item_id,claim_id) where claim_id is not null
create index production_order_jobs on private.order_production_jobs(order_id,state)

 actor_id uuid,session_id uuid,kind text not null,request jsonb not null,result jsonb not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp()
)

create function private.goods_production_terms(p_good text) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('version',1,'goodId',good_id,'revision',revision,'leadDays',lead_days,'dayBasis',day_basis,'closedDates',to_jsonb(closed_dates),'publicNote',public_note)
 from private.goods_production_settings where good_id=p_good and enabled;
$$

create function private.goods_production_document(p_good text) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,'revision',coalesce(s.revision,0),'enabled',coalesce(s.enabled,false),'leadDays',s.lead_days,
  'dayBasis',coalesce(s.day_basis,'calendar'),'closedDates',to_jsonb(coalesce(s.closed_dates,'{}'::date[])),
  'publicNote',coalesce(s.public_note,''),'evidence',coalesce(s.evidence,''),'updatedAt',coalesce(s.updated_at,g.updated_at))
 from public.goods g left join private.goods_production_settings s on s.good_id=g.id where g.id=p_good;
$$

create function public.admin_get_goods_production(p_good text) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 perform private.require_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false);return private.goods_production_document(p_good);end $$
create trigger production_item_guard before insert or update on public.order_items for each row execute function private.production_item_guard()

create function private.production_item_created() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if new.production_terms_snapshot is not null then insert into private.order_production_jobs(order_id,order_item_id,terms) values(new.order_id,new.id,new.production_terms_snapshot);end if;return new;end $$
create trigger production_item_created after insert on public.order_items for each row execute function private.production_item_created()

create function private.production_preorder_guard() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if new.preorder_policy_id is not null and exists(select 1 from private.goods_production_settings where good_id=new.good_id and enabled) then raise check_violation using message='production_preorder_conflict';end if;return new;end $$
create trigger production_preorder_guard before insert or update of preorder_policy_id on public.goods_variants for each row execute function private.production_preorder_guard()

create function private.production_payment_valid(p_order uuid) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders o join public.payments p on p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.amount=o.total and p.status='paid'
  join public.payment_attempts a on a.payment_id=p.id and a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id and a.user_id=o.user_id and a.provider=p.provider and a.amount=p.amount and a.state='approved'
  where o.id=p_order and(exists(select 1 from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id and e.approved_at is not null)
   or a.provider='bank_transfer' and exists(select 1 from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id)));
$$
create trigger production_payment_changed after insert or update of status on public.payments for each row execute function private.production_payment_changed()

create function private.production_order_canceled() returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 if new.status='canceled' then update private.order_production_jobs set state='canceled',revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() where order_id=new.id and state<>'canceled';end if;return new;end $$
create trigger production_order_canceled after update of status on public.orders for each row execute function private.production_order_canceled()
create trigger production_claim_changed before update on public.order_cancellation_requests for each row execute function private.production_claim_changed()
create trigger production_shipment_guard before update on public.order_shipments for each row execute function private.production_shipment_guard()

create function private.order_production_document(p_order uuid,p_admin boolean) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('orderId',o.id,'cancelReviewRequired',exists(select 1 from private.order_production_jobs where order_id=o.id and claim_id is null and started_at is not null),
 'canCancel',private.order_cancel_eligible(o.id),'jobs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'itemId',j.order_item_id,'claimId',j.claim_id,'goodId',i.good_id,'goodName',coalesce(i.good_name_snapshot,g.name),'quantity',i.qty,
 'revision',j.revision,'state',j.state,'terms',j.terms,'basisAt',j.basis_at,'dueAt',j.due_at,'startedAt',j.started_at,'completedAt',j.completed_at,
 'canStart',p_admin and j.state='pending' and j.basis_at is not null and private.production_payment_valid(o.id) and(case when j.claim_id is null then o.status in('paid','confirmed') and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=o.id and stage not in('completed','rejected','withdrawn')) else exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where id=j.claim_id and claim_type='exchange' and stage='collected') end),
 'canComplete',p_admin and j.state='started' and private.production_payment_valid(o.id) and(case when j.claim_id is null then o.status in('paid','confirmed') and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=o.id and stage not in('completed','rejected','withdrawn')) else exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where id=j.claim_id and claim_type='exchange' and stage='collected') end),
 'history',case when p_admin then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'kind',e.kind,'at',e.created_at,'evidence',e.request->>'evidence') order by e.created_at,e.id) from private.order_production_events e where e.job_id=j.id),'[]') else '[]'::jsonb end) order by j.created_at,j.id)
 from private.order_production_jobs j join public.order_items i on i.id=j.order_item_id join public.goods g on g.id=i.good_id where j.order_id=o.id),'[]'))
 from public.orders o where o.id=p_order;
$$

create function public.admin_get_order_production(p_order uuid) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.read',false);return private.order_production_document(p_order,true);end $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.request_order_claim_for_parties(p_order_id uuid, p_actor uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_gift_id uuid, p_claim_type text, p_reason text, p_reason_type text, p_bank_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_holder text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
  claim_at timestamptz;
  gift private.gift_intents;
  v_status public.order_status;
  v_delivered_at timestamptz;
  v_claim_id uuid;
  v_has_unresolved_attempt boolean;
  v_masked_account text;
  v_masked_holder text;
  v_payment_count integer;
begin
  if p_claim_type is null or p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type';
  end if;
  if p_reason_type is null or p_reason_type not in ('change_of_mind', 'defect') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason type';
  end if;
  if p_reason is null
    or btrim(p_reason) <> p_reason
    or length(p_reason) not between 1 and 200
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason';
  end if;

  -- Actor is the actual requester; p_user_id is exclusively the financial owner.
  if p_gift_id is null then
    if p_actor is distinct from p_user_id then return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);end if;
    -- Preserve the ordinary-order intake lock graph unchanged.
  else
    select * into gift from private.gift_intents where id=p_gift_id and order_id=p_order_id;
    if not found or p_actor is null or p_user_id is distinct from gift.sender_id or not(p_actor=gift.sender_id or p_actor=gift.recipient_id)
      or p_actor<>gift.sender_id and p_claim_type='cancel' then return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);end if;
    perform private.gift_lock_subjects(array[p_actor,gift.sender_id,gift.recipient_id]);
    if p_actor<>gift.sender_id and (p_bank_name is not null or p_account_number is not null or p_account_holder is not null) then
      raise insufficient_privilege using message='gift_payer_refund_account_required';end if;
  end if;

  -- Common intake/dispatch lock order: order → shipments → payment attempts/payments.
  select orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.delivered_at
  into v_user_id, v_status, v_delivered_at
  from public.orders
  where orders.id = p_order_id
  for update;

  if not found or p_user_id is null or v_user_id is distinct from p_user_id then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  perform s.id from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=p_order_id order by s.id for update;

  perform attempt.id
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  where attempt.purpose = 'order'
    and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by attempt.id
  for update;

  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state in (
        'prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved'
      )
  )
  into v_has_unresolved_attempt;

  claim_at:=case when p_gift_id is null then now() else clock_timestamp() end;
  if v_status = 'canceled' then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','already_canceled','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- 반품·교환은 배송 중부터 접수하되 전체 실물 회수는 후속 단계에서 검사한다.
  -- Customer cancellation is available only before order confirmation.
  if p_claim_type in ('return', 'exchange') then
    if not private.order_return_intake_eligible(p_order_id) then
      return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_claimable','claimId',v_claim_id);
    end if;
  elsif not private.order_cancel_eligible(p_order_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_cancelable','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- 교환도 청약철회 기한을 준용한다(변심 7일 · 하자 3개월). 판정의 진실원은
  -- 계속 order_withdrawal_deadline_passed 하나다.
  if public.order_withdrawal_deadline_passed(v_delivered_at, p_reason_type, claim_at) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','deadline_expired','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = p_order_id
      and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','already_requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- status는 적지 않는다. 투영은 private.order_claim_status_for_stage 하나가 만든다.
  insert into public.order_cancellation_requests (
    order_id,
    requested_by,
    reason,
    reason_type,
    claim_type,
    stage,
    requested_at
  )
  values (
    p_order_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_reason,
    p_reason_type,
    p_claim_type,
    'requested',
    claim_at
  )
  returning id into v_claim_id;
  if p_gift_id is not null then
    insert into private.gift_claim_parties(claim_id,gift_id,payer_id,recipient_id,actual_requester)
    values(v_claim_id,p_gift_id,gift.sender_id,gift.recipient_id,p_actor);
    insert into public.audit_log(actor_id,action,target,diff) values(p_actor,'gift.claim_requested','order:'||p_order_id,
      jsonb_build_object('giftId',p_gift_id,'claimId',v_claim_id,'claimType',p_claim_type,'reasonType',p_reason_type,'requesterParty',case when p_actor=gift.sender_id then 'sender' else 'recipient' end));
  end if;


  /*
   * 환불계좌는 무통장 환불의 유일한 경로이고 카드 fallback의 안전망이다.
   * 세 칸이 모두 있을 때만 저장한다 — 반쪽 계좌는 송금에 쓸 수 없다.
   *
   * 교환에는 저장하지 않는다. 교환의 종결은 재출고이고 어떤 경로로도 돈이
   * 돌아가지 않으므로 계좌를 받을 목적 자체가 없다. 화면은 반품에만 폼을
   * 보이지만 API로는 실어 보낼 수 있으므로 접수 함수가 거른다. 취소·반품은
   * 결제사 취소가 막혔을 때 송금이 유일한 경로라 계속 받고, 보관 기간은
   * 종결 stage에서 seal_order_claim_refund_account가 잡는다.
   */
  if p_claim_type <> 'exchange'
    and p_bank_name is not null
    and p_account_number is not null
    and p_account_holder is not null
  then
    v_masked_account := public.mask_refund_account_number(p_account_number);
    v_masked_holder := public.mask_refund_account_holder(p_account_holder);

    insert into private.claim_refund_accounts (
      claim_id,
      bank_name,
      account_number,
      account_holder,
      masked_account,
      masked_holder
    )
    values (
      v_claim_id,
      btrim(p_bank_name),
      p_account_number,
      btrim(p_account_holder),
      btrim(p_bank_name) || ' ' || v_masked_account,
      v_masked_holder
    );
  end if;

  -- 결제 이력이 없는 pending 주문은 예전처럼 즉시 종결한다.
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'pending'
    and not v_has_unresolved_attempt
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    )
  then
    perform public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(
      p_order_id,
      p_reason,
      array[]::text[]
    );

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'completed',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','completed','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  /*
   * 자동 승인 — paid(발주확인 전) 변심 취소.
   *
   * 아직 발주확인도 하지 않은 주문의 변심 취소를 사람이 판단할 이유가 없다.
   * 스마트스토어와 같은 경계다. confirmed부터는 발송 준비가 시작됐으므로
   * 운영자 판단으로 남긴다.
   *
   * 승인의 실질(durable claim + 환불 intent)은 admin_decide_order_cancellation의
   * 승인 분기와 같다. decided_by는 null로 남긴다 — 사람이 누른 적이 없다.
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'paid'
    and not exists(select 1 from private.order_production_jobs where order_id=p_order_id and claim_id is null and started_at is not null)
    and p_reason_type = 'change_of_mind'
  then
    insert into public.order_cancellation_claims (
      order_id,
      requested_by,
      previous_status
    )
    values (p_order_id, p_user_id, v_status)
    on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

    insert into public.refunds (
      payment_id,
      amount,
      reason,
      status,
      cancellation_request_id
    )
    select
      payment.id,
      payment.amount,
      p_reason,
      case when refund.status = 'done' then 'done' else 'requested' end,
      v_claim_id
    from public.payments as payment
    left join public.refunds as refund on refund.payment_id = payment.id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded')
    on conflict (payment_id) do update
    set
      cancellation_request_id = excluded.cancellation_request_id,
      reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
      status = case
        when public.refunds.status = 'done' then 'done'
        else 'requested'
      end;

    select count(*)::integer
    into v_payment_count
    from public.payments as payment
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded');

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'processing',
      decided_at = now(),
      provider_started_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
    values (
      p_user_id,
      'order.claim_auto_approved',
      'order:' || p_order_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'claimId', v_claim_id,
        'claimType', 'cancel',
        'from', 'requested',
        'to', 'processing',
        'previousOrderStatus', v_status::text,
        'reasonType', p_reason_type,
        'paymentCount', v_payment_count
      )
    );

    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      v_claim_id,
      'auto_approved',
      '취소 요청이 접수됐어요',
      '발송 전 주문이라 자동으로 승인됐습니다. 결제 취소 처리를 시작합니다.'
    );

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','auto_approved','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  perform private.notify_order_claim(
    v_claim_id,
    'requested',
    '클레임 요청이 접수됐어요',
    '요청을 접수했습니다. 담당자가 확인한 뒤 진행 상황을 알려드립니다.'
  );

  return jsonb_build_object('outcome','requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
end;
$function$

$$

create function private.shipment_production_summary(p_shipment uuid) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'completed',count(*) filter(where j.state='completed'),'ready',coalesce(bool_and(j.state='completed'),true),'dueAt',max(j.due_at))
 from private.order_production_jobs j join public.order_shipment_items i on i.order_item_id=j.order_item_id where i.shipment_id=p_shipment and j.claim_id is null;
$$

create function private.snapshot_order_production_contracts(p_event uuid,p_actor uuid) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots(deletion_event_id,record_type,record_ref,snapshot_data,legal_basis,retain_until)
 select p_event,'order_production',j.id::text,jsonb_build_object('jobRef',j.id,'orderRef',j.order_id,'itemRef',j.order_item_id,'claimRef',j.claim_id,'state',j.state,
 'terms',j.terms-'publicNote','basisAt',j.basis_at,'dueAt',j.due_at,'startedAt',j.started_at,'completedAt',j.completed_at,
 'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('operationId',e.id,'kind',e.kind,'at',e.created_at) order by e.created_at,e.id) from private.order_production_events e where e.job_id=j.id),'[]')),
 'ecommerce_transaction_v1',greatest(j.created_at,j.updated_at,j.completed_at)+interval '5 years'
 from private.order_production_jobs j where p_actor=any(private.contact_parties(j.order_id)) and greatest(j.created_at,j.updated_at,j.completed_at)+interval '5 years'>clock_timestamp()
 on conflict(deletion_event_id,record_type,record_ref) do update set snapshot_data=excluded.snapshot_data,retain_until=greatest(private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,excluded.retain_until) where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;
end $$

-- Product contract: checkout methods, explicit prepaid charges,
-- and immutable private download assets share a product contract revision.
begin

insert into storage.buckets(id,name,public,file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types) values
 ('goods-digital-private','goods-digital-private',false,52428800,array['application/pdf','application/zip','image/png','image/jpeg','audio/mpeg','video/mp4','text/plain'])
on conflict(id) do update set public=false,file_size_limit=excluded.file_size_limit,allowed_mime_types=excluded.allowed_mime_types

create table private.goods_digital_assets(
 id uuid primary key,actor_id uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,session_id uuid not null,
 filename text not null check(char_length(filename) between 1 and 160 and filename!~'[[:cntrl:]/\\]'),
 mime_type text not null check(mime_type in('application/pdf','application/zip','image/png','image/jpeg','audio/mpeg','video/mp4','text/plain')),
 path text not null unique,size_bytes integer not null check(size_bytes between 1 and 52428800),sha256 text check(sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 state text not null default 'pending' check(state in('pending','verified','retired','cleaned')),
 expires_at timestamptz not null,verified_at timestamptz,cleanup_claimed_at timestamptz,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check(state<>'verified' or sha256 is not null and verified_at is not null),
 check(path~'^[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(pdf|zip|png|jpg|mp3|mp4|txt)$')
)

 methods jsonb not null check(jsonb_typeof(methods)='array'),asset_ids uuid[] not null default '{}',

create function private.digital_file_metadata(p_ids uuid[]) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'name',a.filename,'mimeType',a.mime_type,'size',a.size_bytes) order by v.n),'[]')
 from unnest(p_ids) with ordinality v(id,n) join private.goods_digital_assets a on a.id=v.id and a.state='verified';
$$

create function private.goods_fulfillment_document(p_good text,p_internal boolean) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,'revision',coalesce(s.revision,0),'mode',coalesce(s.mode,'shipping'),
  'methods',coalesce(s.methods,'[{"method":"parcel","feeAmount":null,"feeBasis":"per_order","installationFee":0}]'),
  'files',private.digital_file_metadata(coalesce(s.asset_ids,'{}')),'publicNote',coalesce(s.public_note,''))
  ||case when p_internal then jsonb_build_object('evidence',coalesce(s.evidence,''),'updatedAt',coalesce(s.updated_at,g.updated_at)) else '{}'::jsonb end
 from public.goods g left join private.goods_fulfillment_settings s on s.good_id=g.id where g.id=p_good;
$$

create function public.admin_get_goods_fulfillment(p_good text) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 perform private.require_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false);return private.goods_fulfillment_document(p_good,true);end $$

create function public.can_upload_digital_asset(p_path text) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'catalog.manage',false) and not private.is_account_write_fenced(auth.uid()) and exists(
  select 1 from private.goods_digital_assets a join auth.sessions s on s.id=a.session_id and s.user_id=a.actor_id
  where a.actor_id=auth.uid() and a.session_id::text=auth.jwt()->>'session_id' and a.path=p_path and a.state='pending' and a.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   and(s.not_after is null or s.not_after>clock_timestamp()));
$$
create policy goods_digital_private_insert on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check(bucket_id='goods-digital-private' and public.can_upload_digital_asset(name))

create function private.digital_asset_referenced(p_id uuid) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from private.goods_fulfillment_settings where p_id=any(asset_ids))
 or exists(select 1 from public.order_items where fulfillment_terms_snapshot->'files' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',p_id)))
 or exists(select 1 from private.order_digital_downloads where asset_id=p_id);
$$

create function public.service_claim_digital_cleanup(p_limit integer default 10) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 if p_limit not between 1 and 50 then raise invalid_parameter_value;end if;
 with candidates as(select id from private.goods_digital_assets where state in('pending','verified','retired') and expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  and(cleanup_claimed_at is null or cleanup_claimed_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '10 minutes') and not private.digital_asset_referenced(id)
  order by expires_at,id for update skip locked limit p_limit), claimed as(
 update private.goods_digital_assets a set state='retired',cleanup_claimed_at=clock_timestamp() from candidates c where a.id=c.id returning a.*)
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'path',path)),'[]') into result from claimed;return result;
end $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_transaction_snapshot_matches(p_order_id uuid, p_total bigint, p_shipping_fee bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders purchase where purchase.id=p_order_id and purchase.calculation_version=2
  and purchase.total=p_total and purchase.shipping_fee=p_shipping_fee
  and exists(select 1 from private.order_goods_transactions where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select count(*)>0 and bool_and(item.volume_discount_total=item.qty::numeric*item.volume_unit_discount)
   and sum(item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price)-sum(item.volume_discount_total)+purchase.shipping_fee-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total=purchase.total
   and sum(item.volume_discount_total)=purchase.volume_discount_total
   and bool_and(item.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation
    where reservation.order_item_id=item.id and reservation.order_id=item.order_id and reservation.policy_id=item.preorder_policy_id
     and reservation.qty=item.qty and reservation.state in('reserved','allocated')))
   from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_items item left join private.order_price_allocations a on a.order_item_id=item.id
   where item.order_id=purchase.id and (a.order_item_id is null or a.order_id<>purchase.id or a.subtotal<>item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price
    or a.volume_discount<>item.volume_discount_total))
  and (select sum(a.coupon_discount)=purchase.discount_total and sum(a.store_credit_discount)=purchase.store_credit_total
   and sum(a.paid_goods_total)+purchase.shipping_fee=purchase.total from private.order_price_allocations a where a.order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select coalesce(sum(s.shipping_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_fee and coalesce(sum(s.shipping_collect_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_collect_total
   from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id and not exists(
   select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c where c.shipment_id=s.id group by c.shipment_id
    having sum(case when c.payment_mode='prepaid' then c.total_fee else c.installation_fee end)=s.shipping_fee
     and sum(case when c.payment_mode='collect' then c.total_fee-c.installation_fee else 0 end)=s.shipping_collect_fee))
  and not exists(select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c join public.order_shipments s on s.id=c.shipment_id
   where c.order_id=purchase.id and (s.order_id<>purchase.id or s.origin_id<>c.origin_id or not exists(
    select 1 from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id and item.good_id=c.good_id and item.origin_id_snapshot=c.origin_id)))
  and (select count(*) from private.shipping_charge_components where order_id=purchase.id)=
   (select count(distinct good_id) from public.order_items where order_id=purchase.id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_transaction_public_shipping(p_source_kind text, p_raw_groups jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE

  'components',value->'components','collector',value->'collector','chargeDetails',private.shipping_charge_group_safe_details(value->'chargeDetails'))
 when p_source_kind='gift' then jsonb_build_object('calculationVersion',2,'originId',value->'originId',
  'originName',value->'originName','totalFee',value->'totalFee','prepaidFee',value->'prepaidFee','collectFee',value->'collectFee','fullFee',value->'fullFee',
  'components',value->'components','collector',value->'collector')
 else value-array['collectContractSnapshot','collectContractId','deliveryTerms'] end ||case when value ? 'deliveryMethod' then jsonb_build_object('deliveryMethod',value->'deliveryMethod','deliveryPolicy',value->'deliveryPolicy') else '{}'::jsonb end order by value->>'originId',value->>'deliveryMethod'),'[]')
 from jsonb_array_elements(p_raw_groups);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_delivery_summary(p_shipment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('method',shipment.delivery_method,'policy',case when shipment.delivery_method='digital' then null else shipment.delivery_method_snapshot end,
    'canIssueReceipt',purchase.status in ('confirmed','shipping')
      and ((shipment.delivery_method in('pickup','none') and shipment.status='ready') or (shipment.delivery_method in('quick','direct','freight') and shipment.status='shipping'))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests request where request.order_id=purchase.id and request.status in ('requested','processing','needs_review'))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims claim where claim.order_id=purchase.id),
    'providerName',(select operation.evidence->>'providerName' from private.shipment_delivery_operations operation
      where operation.shipment_id=shipment.id and operation.kind in('quick_handoff','direct_handoff','freight_handoff') order by operation.recorded_at desc,operation.id limit 1))
  from public.order_shipments shipment join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=shipment.order_id where shipment.id=p_shipment_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.collect_settled_export(p_from date, p_to date, p_query text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with selected as materialized (
  select o.* from public.orders o join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id
  where o.status='done'
   and (p_from is null or o.created_at>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (p_to is null or o.created_at<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (p_query is null
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(o.id::text))>0
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'recipientName','')))>0
    or exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id
      and position(nullif(regexp_replace(lower(p_query),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),'') in lower(coalesce(s.tracking_number,'')))>0))
  order by o.created_at desc,o.id desc limit 1001
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',2,'capturedAt',statement_timestamp(),'orders',coalesce(jsonb_agg(
  jsonb_build_object(
   'id',o.id,'createdAt',o.created_at,'doneAt',o.done_at,'total',o.total,'shippingFee',o.shipping_fee,
   'couponDiscount',o.discount_total,'storeCredits',o.store_credit_total,
   'calculationVersion',o.calculation_version,'volumeDiscount',o.volume_discount_total,'shippingCollectTotal',o.shipping_collect_total,
   'shippingComponents',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',component.id,'shipmentId',component.shipment_id,'paymentMode',component.payment_mode,
    'baseFee',component.base_fee,'regionalFee',component.regional_fee,'totalFee',component.total_fee,'installationFee',component.installation_fee) order by component.id)
    from private.shipping_charge_components component where component.order_id=o.id),'[]'),
   'coupon',(
    select jsonb_build_object('code',r.coupon_code,'discountAmount',r.discount_amount,'eligibleSubtotal',r.eligible_subtotal,'terms',r.terms_snapshot)
    from public.coupon_redemptions r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status='applied'
   ),
   'payments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',payment.id,'amount',payment.amount,'status',payment.status,'provider',payment.provider,
    'approvedAt',approval.approved_at,
    'timeSource',case when approval.approved_at is null then null when payment.provider='bank_transfer' then 'bank_confirmation' else 'provider_approval' end
   ) order by payment.id)
    from public.payments payment left join lateral (
     select coalesce(
      (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
      (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id and a.provider='bank_transfer')
     ) as approved_at
     from public.payment_attempts a where a.payment_id=payment.id and a.purpose='order'
      and a.ref_id=o.id and a.state='approved' and a.amount=payment.amount
    ) approval on true
    where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=o.id and payment.status in('paid','refunded')),'[]'),
   'shipments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',s.id,'trackingNumber',s.tracking_number,'shippingFee',s.shipping_fee,'status',s.status,
    'shippingCollectFee',s.shipping_collect_fee,'collectState',(select obligation.state from private.shipping_collect_obligations obligation where obligation.shipment_id=s.id)
   ) order by s.id) from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id),'[]'),
   'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',item.id,'goodId',item.good_id,'variantId',item.variant_id,'goodName',item.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',item.variant_name_snapshot,
    'qty',item.qty,'unitPrice',item.unit_price,'regularUnitPrice',item.regular_unit_price_snapshot,
    'shipmentId',assignment.shipment_id,
    'allocation',(select jsonb_build_object('subtotal',allocation.subtotal,'volumeDiscount',allocation.volume_discount,'netSubtotal',allocation.net_subtotal,
     'couponDiscount',allocation.coupon_discount,'storeCreditDiscount',allocation.store_credit_discount,'paidGoodsTotal',allocation.paid_goods_total)
     from private.order_price_allocations allocation where allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=o.id),
    'erpCode',identity.erp_code,'erpName',identity.erp_name,'barcode',identity.barcode,'erpCapturedAt',identity.captured_at

     from private.order_price_allocations allocation where allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=o.id),
    'erpCode',identity.erp_code,'erpName',identity.erp_name,'barcode',identity.barcode,'erpCapturedAt',identity.captured_at
   ) order by assignment.shipment_id nulls last,item.id)
    from public.order_items item left join public.order_shipment_items assignment on assignment.order_item_id=item.id and assignment.order_id=o.id
    left join private.order_item_external_identity_snapshots identity on identity.order_item_id=item.id
    where item.order_id=o.id),'[]')
  ) order by o.created_at desc,o.id desc),'[]')) from selected o;
$function$

ledger.name: protected_digital_delivery
statements:
-- No durable bearer download URLs. Every transfer is re-authorized
-- against the purchased file set and current approved-payment/claim state.
begin
alter function private.order_cancel_eligible(uuid) rename to order_cancel_eligible_before_digital
revoke all on function private.order_cancel_eligible_before_digital(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.order_cancel_eligible(target_order uuid) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.order_cancel_eligible_before_digital(target_order) or exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=target_order and o.status in('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done')
  and exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id and i.fulfillment_terms_snapshot->>'mode' in('digital','no_delivery'))
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.delivery_method<>'digital' and(s.status<>'ready' or s.shipped_at is not null or s.delivered_at is not null)));
$$

-- A digital file has no parcel to physically collect. Preserve the real
-- collections of any physical items in the same order; never invent receipts.
create or replace function private.set_claim_collection_requirement() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path='' as $$begin
 new.collection_required:=new.claim_type in('return','exchange') and exists(select 1 from public.order_items where order_id=new.order_id and coalesce(fulfillment_terms_snapshot->>'mode','shipping')<>'digital');return new;
end $$
revoke all on function private.digital_download_context(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid),private.order_cancel_eligible(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
revoke all on function public.get_my_order_downloads(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.get_my_order_downloads(uuid) to authenticated
revoke all on function public.service_get_digital_download_info(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid),public.service_record_digital_download(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.service_get_digital_download_info(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid),public.service_record_digital_download(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text) to service_role
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.digital_download_context(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.order_cancel_eligible(uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.order_cancel_eligible_before_digital(uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('public.service_get_digital_download_info(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('public.service_record_digital_download(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid,text)'::regprocedure)

create function private.snapshot_order_fulfillment_contracts(p_event uuid,p_actor uuid) returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$begin
 insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots(deletion_event_id,record_type,record_ref,snapshot_data,legal_basis,retain_until)
 select p_event,'order_fulfillment',i.id::text,jsonb_build_object('orderRef',i.order_id,'itemRef',i.id,
  'terms',i.fulfillment_terms_snapshot-'publicNote'-'files',
  'files',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('assetId',a.id,'mimeType',a.mime_type,'size',a.size_bytes,'sha256',a.sha256) order by a.id)
    from private.goods_digital_assets a where i.fulfillment_terms_snapshot->'files' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id))),'[]'),
  'provided',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('operationId',d.id,'assetId',d.asset_id,'at',d.created_at,'sha256',d.sha256) order by d.created_at,d.id)
    from private.order_digital_downloads d where d.order_item_id=i.id),'[]')),
  'ecommerce_transaction_v1',greatest(o.created_at,(select max(created_at) from private.order_digital_downloads where order_item_id=i.id))+interval '5 years'
 from public.order_items i join public.orders o on o.id=i.order_id where p_actor=any(private.contact_parties(i.order_id)) and i.fulfillment_terms_snapshot is not null
  and greatest(o.created_at,(select max(created_at) from private.order_digital_downloads where order_item_id=i.id))+interval '5 years'>clock_timestamp()
 on conflict(deletion_event_id,record_type,record_ref) do update set snapshot_data=excluded.snapshot_data,retain_until=greatest(private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,excluded.retain_until) where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;
end $$
revoke all on function private.snapshot_order_fulfillment_contracts(uuid,uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.snapshot_order_fulfillment_contracts(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
notify pgrst,'reload schema'
commit

ledger.name: coupon_combination_policy
statements:
-- Product contract: opt-in coupon combinations, immutable issued benefit kind, and prepaid shipping discounts.
begin

alter table public.coupons add column benefit_kind text not null default 'goods' check(benefit_kind in('goods','shipping')),
 add column stackable boolean not null default false

alter table public.coupon_redemptions add column benefit_kind text not null default 'goods' check(benefit_kind in('goods','shipping')),
 add column application_index integer not null default 1 check(application_index between 1 and 6)
drop index public.coupon_redemptions_applied_order_uidx
create unique index coupon_redemptions_applied_order_position on public.coupon_redemptions(order_id,application_index) where status='applied'
create unique index coupon_redemptions_one_shipping on public.coupon_redemptions(order_id) where status='applied' and benefit_kind='shipping'
alter table private.goods_transaction_quotes add column user_coupon_ids uuid[]

alter table private.shipping_charge_components add column shipping_coupon_discount bigint not null default 0 check(shipping_coupon_discount>=0),
 drop constraint shipping_charge_components_check,
 add constraint shipping_charge_components_net_fee check(total_fee=base_fee+regional_fee+installation_fee-shipping_coupon_discount
  and shipping_coupon_discount<=base_fee+regional_fee and (payment_mode='prepaid' or shipping_coupon_discount=0))
alter table public.orders add column shipping_coupon_discount_total bigint not null default 0 check(shipping_coupon_discount_total>=0)

create table private.coupon_combination_policy(singleton boolean primary key default true check(singleton),revision bigint not null default 1,
 stacking_enabled boolean not null default false,max_goods_coupons integer not null default 1 check(max_goods_coupons between 1 and 5),
 shipping_enabled boolean not null default false,evidence text not null default '',updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp())
insert into private.coupon_combination_policy(singleton) values(true)

create table private.coupon_combination_operations(operation_id uuid primary key,actor_id uuid not null references auth.users(id),
 session_id uuid not null,request jsonb not null,receipt jsonb not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp())
alter table private.coupon_combination_policy enable row level security
alter table private.coupon_combination_operations enable row level security
revoke all on private.coupon_combination_policy,private.coupon_combination_operations from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function public.get_coupon_combination_policy() returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select jsonb_build_object('revision',revision,'stackingEnabled',stacking_enabled,'maxGoodsCoupons',max_goods_coupons,'shippingEnabled',shipping_enabled)
 from private.coupon_combination_policy where singleton;
$$

create function private.guard_issued_coupon_benefit() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path='' as $$
begin if old.issued_count>0 and (new.benefit_kind is distinct from old.benefit_kind or new.stackable is distinct from old.stackable) then
 raise check_violation using message='coupon_issued_benefit_immutable';end if;return new;end $$
create trigger coupon_issued_benefit_guard before update on public.coupons for each row execute function private.guard_issued_coupon_benefit()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_coupon_console_v2(p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, name text, discount_type text, discount_value integer, max_discount_amount integer, min_subtotal integer, starts_at timestamp with time zone, ends_at timestamp with time zone, issue_limit integer, issued_count integer, status text, grade_benefit loyalty_grade, used_count bigint, total_count bigint, recipient_segment text, goods_scope text, target_good_ids text[], terms_revision integer, target_goods jsonb, issue_starts_at timestamp with time zone, issue_ends_at timestamp with time zone, valid_days integer, benefit_kind text, stackable boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  needle text := btrim(coalesce(p_query, ''));
  normalized_status text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_status, 'all')));
  pattern text;
  phase text := coalesce(p_filters->>'phase','all');
  discount text := coalesce(p_filters->>'discountType','all');
  segment text := coalesce(p_filters->>'segment','any');
  date_field text := coalesce(p_filters->>'dateField','created');
  sort_key text := coalesce(p_filters->>'sort','created_desc');
  date_from date := nullif(p_filters->>'from','')::date;
  date_to date := nullif(p_filters->>'to','')::date;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null or not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

  if length(needle) > 100
     or normalized_status not in ('all', 'active', 'archived')
     or p_limit is null
     or p_limit not between 1 and 100
     or p_offset is null
     or p_offset < 0 or p_offset > 10000000
     or phase not in ('all','scheduled','live','ended','stopped')
     or discount not in ('all','fixed','percent')
     or segment not in ('any','all','first_purchase','repeat_purchase','grade')
     or date_field not in ('created','starts')
     or sort_key not in ('created_desc','name_asc','starts_desc','ends_asc')
     or (date_from is not null and date_to is not null and date_from > date_to) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_coupon_search';
  end if;

  -- `%`와 `_`는 검색어가 아니라 와일드카드로 해석되지 않게 한다. 나머지
  -- PostgREST 문법은 RPC 내부의 SQL 값으로만 취급되므로 필터 문자열을 만들지 않는다.
  pattern := '%' || replace(
    replace(replace(needle, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'),
    '_', E'\\_'
  ) || '%';

  return query
    select
      coupon.code,
      coupon.name,
      coupon.discount_type,
      coupon.discount_value,
      coupon.max_discount_amount,
      coupon.min_subtotal,
      coupon.starts_at,
      coupon.ends_at,
      coupon.issue_limit,
      coupon.issued_count,
      coupon.status,
      coupon.grade_benefit,
      (
        select count(*)::bigint
        from public.coupon_redemptions as redemption
        where redemption.coupon_code = coupon.code
          and redemption.status = 'applied'
      ) as used_count,
      count(*) over () as total_count,
      coupon.recipient_segment,coupon.goods_scope,coupon.target_good_ids,coupon.terms_revision,public.admin_coupon_target_goods(coupon),coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.issue_ends_at,coupon.valid_days,coupon.benefit_kind,coupon.stackable
    from public.coupons as coupon
    where (needle = ''
      or coupon.code ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or coupon.name ilike pattern escape E'\\')
      and (normalized_status = 'all' or coupon.status = normalized_status)
      and (discount='all' or coupon.discount_type=discount)
      and (segment='any' or (segment='grade' and coupon.grade_benefit is not null) or coupon.recipient_segment=segment)
      and (phase='all' or (phase='stopped' and coupon.status='archived')
        or (coupon.status='active' and ((phase='scheduled' and coalesce(coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.starts_at)>now())
        or (phase='ended' and least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end)<=now())
        or (phase='live' and coalesce(coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.starts_at)<=now() and (least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end) is null or least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end)>now())))))
      and (date_from is null or (case when date_field='starts' then coupon.starts_at else coupon.created_at end) >= (date_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
      and (date_to is null or (case when date_field='starts' then coupon.starts_at else coupon.created_at end) < ((date_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
    order by case when sort_key='name_asc' then coupon.name end asc,
      case when sort_key='starts_desc' then coupon.starts_at end desc,
      case when sort_key='ends_asc' then coupon.ends_at end asc nulls last,
      coupon.created_at desc, coupon.code asc
    limit p_limit
    offset p_offset;
end;
$function$
grant execute on function public.get_coupon_combination_policy() to authenticated

grant execute on function public.admin_get_coupon_combination_policy(),public.admin_save_coupon_combination_policy(jsonb,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid),public.admin_search_coupon_console_v2(text,text,integer,integer,jsonb) to authenticated
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_get_coupon_combination_policy()'::regprocedure,'marketing.manage','read',false)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_save_coupon_combination_policy(jsonb,bigint,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,'marketing.manage','write',false)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_search_coupon_console_v2(text,text,integer,integer,jsonb)'::regprocedure,'marketing.manage','read',false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.marketing_coupon_document(p_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('code',c.code,'name',c.name,'benefitKind',c.benefit_kind,'stackable',c.stackable,'discountType',c.discount_type,'discountValue',c.discount_value,
  'maxDiscountAmount',c.max_discount_amount,'minSubtotal',c.min_subtotal,'startsAt',c.starts_at,'endsAt',c.ends_at,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_transaction_snapshot_matches(p_order_id uuid, p_total bigint, p_shipping_fee bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders purchase where purchase.id=p_order_id and purchase.calculation_version=2
  and purchase.total=p_total and purchase.shipping_fee=p_shipping_fee
  and exists(select 1 from private.order_goods_transactions where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select count(*)>0 and bool_and(item.volume_discount_total=item.qty::numeric*item.volume_unit_discount)
   and sum(item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price)-sum(item.volume_discount_total)+purchase.shipping_fee-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total=purchase.total
   and sum(item.volume_discount_total)=purchase.volume_discount_total
   and bool_and(item.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation
    where reservation.order_item_id=item.id and reservation.order_id=item.order_id and reservation.policy_id=item.preorder_policy_id
     and reservation.qty=item.qty and reservation.state in('reserved','allocated')))
   from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_items item left join private.order_price_allocations a on a.order_item_id=item.id
   where item.order_id=purchase.id and (a.order_item_id is null or a.order_id<>purchase.id or a.subtotal<>item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price
    or a.volume_discount<>item.volume_discount_total))
  and (select sum(a.coupon_discount)=purchase.discount_total and sum(a.store_credit_discount)=purchase.store_credit_total
   and sum(a.paid_goods_total)+purchase.shipping_fee=purchase.total from private.order_price_allocations a where a.order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select coalesce(sum(s.shipping_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_fee and coalesce(sum(s.shipping_collect_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_collect_total
   from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id and not exists(
   select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c where c.shipment_id=s.id group by c.shipment_id
    having sum(case when c.payment_mode='prepaid' then c.total_fee else c.installation_fee end)=s.shipping_fee
     and sum(case when c.payment_mode='collect' then c.total_fee-c.installation_fee else 0 end)=s.shipping_collect_fee))
  and not exists(select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c join public.order_shipments s on s.id=c.shipment_id
   where c.order_id=purchase.id and (s.order_id<>purchase.id or s.origin_id<>c.origin_id or not exists(
    select 1 from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id and item.good_id=c.good_id and item.origin_id_snapshot=c.origin_id)))
  and (select coalesce(sum(discount_amount) filter(where benefit_kind='goods'),0)=purchase.discount_total
   and coalesce(sum(discount_amount) filter(where benefit_kind='shipping'),0)=purchase.shipping_coupon_discount_total from public.coupon_redemptions where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select coalesce(sum(shipping_coupon_discount),0)=purchase.shipping_coupon_discount_total from private.shipping_charge_components where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select count(*) from private.shipping_charge_components where order_id=purchase.id)=
   (select count(distinct good_id) from public.order_items where order_id=purchase.id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.collect_settled_export(p_from date, p_to date, p_query text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with selected as materialized (
  select o.* from public.orders o join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id
  where o.status='done'
   and (p_from is null or o.created_at>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (p_to is null or o.created_at<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (p_query is null
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(o.id::text))>0
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0
    or position(lower(p_query) in lower(coalesce(private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'recipientName','')))>0
    or exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id
      and position(nullif(regexp_replace(lower(p_query),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),'') in lower(coalesce(s.tracking_number,'')))>0))
  order by o.created_at desc,o.id desc limit 1001
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',2,'capturedAt',statement_timestamp(),'orders',coalesce(jsonb_agg(
  jsonb_build_object(
   'id',o.id,'createdAt',o.created_at,'doneAt',o.done_at,'total',o.total,'shippingFee',o.shipping_fee,
   'couponDiscount',o.discount_total,'storeCredits',o.store_credit_total,'shippingCouponDiscount',o.shipping_coupon_discount_total,
   'calculationVersion',o.calculation_version,'volumeDiscount',o.volume_discount_total,'shippingCollectTotal',o.shipping_collect_total,
   'shippingComponents',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',component.id,'shipmentId',component.shipment_id,'paymentMode',component.payment_mode,
    'baseFee',component.base_fee,'regionalFee',component.regional_fee,'totalFee',component.total_fee,'installationFee',component.installation_fee,'shippingCouponDiscount',component.shipping_coupon_discount) order by component.id)
    from private.shipping_charge_components component where component.order_id=o.id),'[]'),
   'coupon',(
    select jsonb_build_object('code',r.coupon_code,'discountAmount',r.discount_amount,'eligibleSubtotal',r.eligible_subtotal,'terms',r.terms_snapshot)
    from public.coupon_redemptions r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status='applied' and o.calculation_version=1 order by r.application_index limit 1
   ),
   'coupons',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',r.coupon_code,'discountAmount',r.discount_amount,'benefitKind',r.benefit_kind,'applicationIndex',r.application_index) order by r.application_index) from public.coupon_redemptions r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status='applied'),'[]'),
   'payments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',payment.id,'amount',payment.amount,'status',payment.status,'provider',payment.provider,
    'approvedAt',approval.approved_at,
    'timeSource',case when approval.approved_at is null then null when payment.provider='bank_transfer' then 'bank_confirmation' else 'provider_approval' end
   ) order by payment.id)
    from public.payments payment left join lateral (
     select coalesce(
      (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
      (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id and a.provider='bank_transfer')
     ) as approved_at
     from public.payment_attempts a where a.payment_id=payment.id and a.purpose='order'
      and a.ref_id=o.id and a.state='approved' and a.amount=payment.amount
    ) approval on true
    where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=o.id and payment.status in('paid','refunded')),'[]'),
   'shipments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',s.id,'trackingNumber',s.tracking_number,'shippingFee',s.shipping_fee,'status',s.status,
    'shippingCollectFee',s.shipping_collect_fee,'collectState',(select obligation.state from private.shipping_collect_obligations obligation where obligation.shipment_id=s.id)
   ) order by s.id) from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id),'[]'),
   'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',item.id,'goodId',item.good_id,'variantId',item.variant_id,'goodName',item.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',item.variant_name_snapshot,
    'qty',item.qty,'unitPrice',item.unit_price,'regularUnitPrice',item.regular_unit_price_snapshot,
    'shipmentId',assignment.shipment_id,
    'allocation',(select jsonb_build_object('subtotal',allocation.subtotal,'volumeDiscount',allocation.volume_discount,'netSubtotal',allocation.net_subtotal,
     'couponDiscount',allocation.coupon_discount,'storeCreditDiscount',allocation.store_credit_discount,'paidGoodsTotal',allocation.paid_goods_total)
     from private.order_price_allocations allocation where allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=o.id),
    'erpCode',identity.erp_code,'erpName',identity.erp_name,'barcode',identity.barcode,'erpCapturedAt',identity.captured_at
   ) order by assignment.shipment_id nulls last,item.id)
    from public.order_items item left join public.order_shipment_items assignment on assignment.order_item_id=item.id and assignment.order_id=o.id
    left join private.order_item_external_identity_snapshots identity on identity.order_item_id=item.id
    where item.order_id=o.id),'[]')
  ) order by o.created_at desc,o.id desc),'[]')) from selected o;
$function$

 )::text,'sha256'),'hex') from public.goods g where id=p_good;

ledger.name: coupon_category_targeting
statements:
-- Category coupons follow the current primary/additional category tree, including future goods.
-- Customer-designated definitions require an explicit admin grant; existing code coupons retain their contract.
begin

alter table public.coupons add column target_category_ids uuid[] not null default '{}',
 add column issuance_mode text not null default 'code' check(issuance_mode in ('code','targeted'))
alter table public.coupons drop constraint coupons_goods_scope_check
alter table public.coupons add constraint coupons_goods_scope_check check(goods_scope in ('all','selected_goods','selected_categories'))
alter table public.coupons drop constraint coupon_goods_scope_ready

alter table public.coupons add constraint coupon_goods_scope_ready check(
 (goods_scope='all' and cardinality(target_good_ids)=0 and cardinality(target_category_ids)=0)
 or (goods_scope='selected_goods' and cardinality(target_category_ids)=0 and (status='archived' or cardinality(target_good_ids)>0))
 or (goods_scope='selected_categories' and cardinality(target_good_ids)=0 and (status='archived' or cardinality(target_category_ids)>0)))

alter table public.coupons add constraint coupon_category_targets_valid check(cardinality(target_category_ids)<=100 and array_position(target_category_ids,null) is null),
 add constraint coupon_targeted_grade_exclusive check(issuance_mode<>'targeted' or grade_benefit is null)

create or replace function private.guard_issued_coupon_benefit() returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path='' as $$
begin if old.issued_count>0 and (new.benefit_kind is distinct from old.benefit_kind or new.stackable is distinct from old.stackable or new.issuance_mode is distinct from old.issuance_mode) then
 raise check_violation using message='coupon_issued_benefit_immutable';end if;return new;end $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_coupon_console_v3(p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, name text, discount_type text, discount_value integer, max_discount_amount integer, min_subtotal integer, starts_at timestamp with time zone, ends_at timestamp with time zone, issue_limit integer, issued_count integer, status text, grade_benefit loyalty_grade, used_count bigint, total_count bigint, recipient_segment text, goods_scope text, target_good_ids text[], terms_revision integer, target_goods jsonb, issue_starts_at timestamp with time zone, issue_ends_at timestamp with time zone, valid_days integer, benefit_kind text, stackable boolean, target_category_ids uuid[], issuance_mode text, target_categories jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  needle text := btrim(coalesce(p_query, ''));
  normalized_status text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_status, 'all')));
  pattern text;
  phase text := coalesce(p_filters->>'phase','all');
  discount text := coalesce(p_filters->>'discountType','all');
  segment text := coalesce(p_filters->>'segment','any');
  date_field text := coalesce(p_filters->>'dateField','created');
  sort_key text := coalesce(p_filters->>'sort','created_desc');
  date_from date := nullif(p_filters->>'from','')::date;
  date_to date := nullif(p_filters->>'to','')::date;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null or not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

  if length(needle) > 100
     or normalized_status not in ('all', 'active', 'archived')
     or p_limit is null
     or p_limit not between 1 and 100
     or p_offset is null
     or p_offset < 0 or p_offset > 10000000
     or phase not in ('all','scheduled','live','ended','stopped')
     or discount not in ('all','fixed','percent')
     or segment not in ('any','all','first_purchase','repeat_purchase','grade','targeted')
     or date_field not in ('created','starts')
     or sort_key not in ('created_desc','name_asc','starts_desc','ends_asc')
     or (date_from is not null and date_to is not null and date_from > date_to) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_coupon_search';
  end if;

  -- `%`와 `_`는 검색어가 아니라 와일드카드로 해석되지 않게 한다. 나머지
  -- PostgREST 문법은 RPC 내부의 SQL 값으로만 취급되므로 필터 문자열을 만들지 않는다.
  pattern := '%' || replace(
    replace(replace(needle, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'),
    '_', E'\\_'
  ) || '%';

  return query
    select
      coupon.code,
      coupon.name,
      coupon.discount_type,
      coupon.discount_value,
      coupon.max_discount_amount,
      coupon.min_subtotal,
      coupon.starts_at,
      coupon.ends_at,
      coupon.issue_limit,
      coupon.issued_count,
      coupon.status,
      coupon.grade_benefit,
      (
        select count(*)::bigint
        from public.coupon_redemptions as redemption
        where redemption.coupon_code = coupon.code
          and redemption.status = 'applied'
      ) as used_count,
      count(*) over () as total_count,
      coupon.recipient_segment,coupon.goods_scope,coupon.target_good_ids,coupon.terms_revision,public.admin_coupon_target_goods(coupon),coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.issue_ends_at,coupon.valid_days,coupon.benefit_kind,coupon.stackable,coupon.target_category_ids,coupon.issuance_mode,public.admin_coupon_target_categories(coupon)
    from public.coupons as coupon
    where (needle = ''
      or coupon.code ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or coupon.name ilike pattern escape E'\\')
      and (normalized_status = 'all' or coupon.status = normalized_status)
      and (discount='all' or coupon.discount_type=discount)
      and (segment='any' or (segment='grade' and coupon.grade_benefit is not null) or (segment='targeted' and coupon.issuance_mode='targeted') or (coupon.issuance_mode='code' and coupon.recipient_segment=segment))
      and (phase='all' or (phase='stopped' and coupon.status='archived')
        or (coupon.status='active' and ((phase='scheduled' and coalesce(coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.starts_at)>now())
        or (phase='ended' and least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end)<=now())
        or (phase='live' and coalesce(coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.starts_at)<=now() and (least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end) is null or least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end)>now())))))
      and (date_from is null or (case when date_field='starts' then coupon.starts_at else coupon.created_at end) >= (date_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
      and (date_to is null or (case when date_field='starts' then coupon.starts_at else coupon.created_at end) < ((date_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
    order by case when sort_key='name_asc' then coupon.name end asc,
      case when sort_key='starts_desc' then coupon.starts_at end desc,
      case when sort_key='ends_asc' then coupon.ends_at end asc nulls last,
      coupon.created_at desc, coupon.code asc
    limit p_limit
    offset p_offset;
end;
$function$
revoke all on function private.coupon_category_catalog(),private.coupon_good_matches(text,text[],uuid[],text),private.guard_issued_coupon_benefit() from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

statements:
-- Shipping template receipt and per-product fulfillment CAS. Existing orders keep immutable terms.
begin

create function private.shipping_settings_fulfillment_after(p_good text,p_settings jsonb) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select case when p_settings#>>'{fulfillment,mode}'='replace' then
  jsonb_build_object('goodId',p_good,'revision',(current->>'revision')::bigint+1,'mode',p_settings#>'{fulfillment,policy,mode}',
   'methods',p_settings#>'{fulfillment,policy,methods}','files','[]'::jsonb,'publicNote',p_settings#>'{fulfillment,policy,publicNote}') else current end
 from(select private.goods_fulfillment_document(p_good,false) current) s;
