ledger.name: customer_demographic_consent
statements: begin

-- Self-declared gender is optional, separate from marketing/activity consent,
-- and never projected through public profiles or individual operator records.
create table private.customer_demographic_consents (
 user_id uuid primary key references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
 choice text not null check(choice in ('accepted','declined')),
 gender text check(gender in ('female','male','other')),
 notice_version text not null check(notice_version='customer-demographics-v1'),
 revision bigint not null check(revision>0),
 accepted_at timestamptz,
 updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
 check((choice='accepted' and gender is not null and accepted_at is not null)
    or (choice='declined' and gender is null and accepted_at is null))
)
alter table private.customer_demographic_consents owner to postgres
alter table private.customer_demographic_consents enable row level security
revoke all on private.customer_demographic_consents from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

create function private.erase_fenced_customer_demographics() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
 update private.customer_demographic_consents set choice='declined',gender=null,accepted_at=null,
  revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() where user_id=new.subject_user_id and choice='accepted';
 return new;
end $$

create trigger erase_fenced_customer_demographics after insert on private.account_action_fences
 for each row execute function private.erase_fenced_customer_demographics()

create function public.admin_customer_demographic_report(p_scope text,p_grain text,p_from date,p_to date) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare today date:=(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date;
 basis date; result jsonb;
begin
 perform private.require_operator_capability('stats.read',false);
 if p_scope is null or p_scope not in ('members','purchasers') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_demographic_range'; end if;
 if p_scope='members' then
  if p_grain is not null or p_from is not null or p_to is not null then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_demographic_range'; end if;
  basis:=today;
 else
  if p_grain is null or p_grain not in ('week','month') or p_from is null or p_to is null
   or not isfinite(p_from) or not isfinite(p_to) or p_from<date '2010-01-01' or p_from>p_to
   or p_to-p_from+1>366 or p_to>=date_trunc(p_grain,today::timestamp)::date
   or p_from<>date_trunc(p_grain,p_from::timestamp)::date
   or p_to+1<>date_trunc(p_grain,(p_to+1)::timestamp)::date then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_demographic_range'; end if;
  basis:=p_to;
 end if;
 with paid as materialized (
  select o.user_id,max(t.paid_at) paid_at from private.admin_customer_purchase_payment_times() t
  join public.orders o on o.id=t.order_id
  where p_scope='purchasers' and t.paid_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
   and t.paid_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
  group by o.user_id
 ), customers as materialized (
  select p.id,extract(year from age(basis,p.birth_date))::integer age,
   case when c.choice='accepted' and (p_scope='members' or c.accepted_at<=paid.paid_at)
    then c.gender else 'undisclosed' end gender
  from public.profiles p left join private.customer_demographic_consents c on c.user_id=p.id
  left join paid on paid.user_id=p.id
  where p.role='user' and p.onboarded_at is not null and p.suspended_at is null
   and p.consents->'terms'='true'::jsonb and p.consents->'privacy'='true'::jsonb
   and not exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences f where f.subject_user_id=p.id)
   and (p_scope='members' or paid.user_id is not null)
 ), bands(band,low_age,high_age) as (
  values ('14_19',14,19),('20_24',20,24),('25_29',25,29),('30_34',30,34),('35_39',35,39),
   ('40_44',40,44),('45_49',45,49),('50_54',50,54),('55_59',55,59),('60_plus',60,1000)
 ), genders(gender) as (values ('female'),('male'),('other'),('undisclosed')),
 cells as (
  select b.band,b.low_age,g.gender,count(c.id) n from bands b cross join genders g
  left join customers c on c.age between b.low_age and b.high_age and c.gender=g.gender
  group by b.band,b.low_age,g.gender
 ), protected as (
  select *,count(*) filter(where n<10) over() hidden_count,row_number() over(order by n,band,gender) smallest
  from cells
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('scope',p_scope,'grain',p_grain,'from',p_from,'to',p_to,'ageAsOf',basis,
  'minimumCount',10,'asOf',statement_timestamp(),
  -- No row/column totals, percentages, raw denominator or user identifiers.
  -- If only one cell is hidden, also hide the next-smallest cell so a known
  -- overall customer count cannot reveal the suppressed remainder.
  'cells',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ageBand',band,'gender',gender,
    'count',case when n>=10 and not(hidden_count=1 and smallest=2) then n end)
   order by low_age,gender)) into result from protected;
 return result;
end $$
alter function public.customer_demographic_state() owner to postgres
alter function public.set_customer_demographic_consent(text,text,bigint,uuid,uuid,text) owner to postgres
alter function private.erase_fenced_customer_demographics() owner to postgres
alter function public.admin_customer_demographic_report(text,text,date,date) owner to postgres

grant execute on function public.customer_demographic_state(),public.set_customer_demographic_consent(text,text,bigint,uuid,uuid,text),
 public.admin_customer_demographic_report(text,text,date,date) to authenticated
select private.register_operator_internal_contract('private.erase_fenced_customer_demographics()'::regprocedure)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_customer_demographic_report(text,text,date,date)'::regprocedure,'stats.read','read',false)
commit

ledger.name: digital_redownload_claim_policy
statements: begin

create function private.order_has_digital_items(p_order uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security invoker set search_path='' as $$
 select exists(select 1 from public.order_items where order_id=p_order and fulfillment_terms_snapshot->>'mode'='digital');
$$
alter function private.order_has_digital_items(uuid) owner to postgres
revoke all on function private.order_has_digital_items(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.request_order_claim_for_parties(p_order_id uuid, p_actor uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_gift_id uuid, p_claim_type text, p_reason text, p_reason_type text, p_bank_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_holder text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
  claim_at timestamptz;
  gift private.gift_intents;
  v_status public.order_status;
  v_delivered_at timestamptz;
  v_claim_id uuid;
  v_has_unresolved_attempt boolean;
  v_masked_account text;
  v_masked_holder text;
  v_payment_count integer;
  v_expired_prepared_attempt_id uuid;
  v_attempt_state text;
begin
  if p_claim_type is null or p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type';
  end if;
  if p_reason_type is null or p_reason_type not in ('change_of_mind', 'defect') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason type';
  end if;
  if p_reason is null
    or btrim(p_reason) <> p_reason
    or length(p_reason) not between 1 and 200
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason';
  end if;

  -- Actor is the actual requester; p_user_id is exclusively the financial owner.
  if p_gift_id is null then
    if p_actor is distinct from p_user_id then return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);end if;
    -- Preserve the ordinary-order intake lock graph unchanged.
  else
    select * into gift from private.gift_intents where id=p_gift_id and order_id=p_order_id;
    if not found or p_actor is null or p_user_id is distinct from gift.sender_id or not(p_actor=gift.sender_id or p_actor=gift.recipient_id)
      or p_actor<>gift.sender_id and p_claim_type='cancel' then return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);end if;
    perform private.gift_lock_subjects(array[p_actor,gift.sender_id,gift.recipient_id]);
    if p_actor<>gift.sender_id and (p_bank_name is not null or p_account_number is not null or p_account_holder is not null) then
      raise insufficient_privilege using message='gift_payer_refund_account_required';end if;
  end if;

  -- Common intake/dispatch lock order: order → shipments → payment attempts/payments.
  select orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.delivered_at
  into v_user_id, v_status, v_delivered_at
  from public.orders
  where orders.id = p_order_id
  for update;

  if not found or p_user_id is null or v_user_id is distinct from p_user_id then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  perform s.id from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=p_order_id order by s.id for update;

  perform attempt.id
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  where attempt.purpose = 'order'
    and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by attempt.id
  for update;

  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state in (
        'prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved'
      )
  )
  into v_has_unresolved_attempt;

  claim_at:=case when p_gift_id is null then now() else clock_timestamp() end;
  if v_status = 'canceled' then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','already_canceled','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- 반품·교환은 배송 중부터 접수하되 전체 실물 회수는 후속 단계에서 검사한다.
  -- Customer cancellation is available only before order confirmation.
  if p_claim_type in ('return', 'exchange') then
    if not private.order_return_intake_eligible(p_order_id) or (p_claim_type='exchange' and private.order_has_digital_items(p_order_id)) then
      return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_claimable','claimId',v_claim_id);
    end if;
  elsif not private.order_cancel_eligible(p_order_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_cancelable','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- 교환도 청약철회 기한을 준용한다(변심 7일 · 하자 3개월). 판정의 진실원은
  -- 계속 order_withdrawal_deadline_passed 하나다.
  if public.order_withdrawal_deadline_passed(v_delivered_at, p_reason_type, claim_at) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','deadline_expired','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = p_order_id
      and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','already_requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- status는 적지 않는다. 투영은 private.order_claim_status_for_stage 하나가 만든다.
  insert into public.order_cancellation_requests (
    order_id,
    requested_by,
    reason,
    reason_type,
    claim_type,
    stage,
    requested_at
  )
  values (
    p_order_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_reason,
    p_reason_type,
    p_claim_type,
    'requested',
    claim_at
  )
  returning id into v_claim_id;
  if p_gift_id is not null then
    insert into private.gift_claim_parties(claim_id,gift_id,payer_id,recipient_id,actual_requester)
    values(v_claim_id,p_gift_id,gift.sender_id,gift.recipient_id,p_actor);
    insert into public.audit_log(actor_id,action,target,diff) values(p_actor,'gift.claim_requested','order:'||p_order_id,
      jsonb_build_object('giftId',p_gift_id,'claimId',v_claim_id,'claimType',p_claim_type,'reasonType',p_reason_type,'requesterParty',case when p_actor=gift.sender_id then 'sender' else 'recipient' end));
  end if;


  /*
   * 환불계좌는 무통장 환불의 유일한 경로이고 카드 fallback의 안전망이다.
   * 세 칸이 모두 있을 때만 저장한다 — 반쪽 계좌는 송금에 쓸 수 없다.
   *
   * 교환에는 저장하지 않는다. 교환의 종결은 재출고이고 어떤 경로로도 돈이
   * 돌아가지 않으므로 계좌를 받을 목적 자체가 없다. 화면은 반품에만 폼을
   * 보이지만 API로는 실어 보낼 수 있으므로 접수 함수가 거른다. 취소·반품은
   * 결제사 취소가 막혔을 때 송금이 유일한 경로라 계속 받고, 보관 기간은
   * 종결 stage에서 seal_order_claim_refund_account가 잡는다.
   */
  if p_claim_type <> 'exchange'
    and p_bank_name is not null
    and p_account_number is not null
    and p_account_holder is not null
  then
    v_masked_account := public.mask_refund_account_number(p_account_number);
    v_masked_holder := public.mask_refund_account_holder(p_account_holder);

    insert into private.claim_refund_accounts (
      claim_id,
      bank_name,
      account_number,
      account_holder,
      masked_account,
      masked_holder
    )
    values (
      v_claim_id,
      btrim(p_bank_name),
      p_account_number,
      btrim(p_account_holder),
      btrim(p_bank_name) || ' ' || v_masked_account,
      v_masked_holder
    );
  end if;

  /*
   * 결제 유효 시간이 이미 지난 결제 준비(prepared) 시도는 미해결이 아니다
   * (2026-10-12 브라우저 QA QA-1).
   *
   * 위에서 잡은 order → shipments → attempt 잠금 아래에서만 판정한다. 만료된
   * prepared 시도는 claim_goods_payment_attempt가 잠금 전·후 두 번 모두
   * goods_payment_attempt_expired로 거절하므로, 늦게 도착한 결제 완료 리디렉트가
   * 있어도 서버는 승인 API를 부르지 않는다. 토스는 인증을 마친 결제(IN_PROGRESS)도
   * 승인 API를 부르지 않으면 매입하지 않고 EXPIRED로 닫는다(코어 API Payment.status,
   * 웹훅 이벤트 PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED). Korpay도 confirm 호출 전에는 승인하지 않는다.
   *
   * 그래서 결제 원장이 없는 결제 대기 주문의 취소라면 그 시도를 expire_stale_checkouts·
   * reconcile_expired_prepared_goods_cancellation과 같은 규칙(prepared → canceled,
   * claim 토큰 제거, 만료 재확인을 갱신 조건에 둔다)으로 닫고 아래 즉시 종결로
   * 보낸다. 지금까지는 만료 여부와 상관없이 prepared를 미해결로 세어 요청을
   * requested로 남겼고, 재고·쿠폰·적립금이 결제 기한 + 5분 sweep까지 묶였다.
   *
   * 유효 시간이 남은 prepared, confirming·unknown·needs_review·approved는 종전처럼
   * 미해결이다. 결제 원장이 하나라도 있으면(실패 행 포함) 시도를 건드리지 않는다 —
   * 즉시 종결 조건과 같아야 시도만 닫히고 요청이 남는 중간 상태가 생기지 않는다.
   * 굿즈 주문의 시도는 하나다(payment_attempts_one_goods_order_idx).
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'pending'
    and v_has_unresolved_attempt
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    )
  then
    update public.payment_attempts as attempt
    set
      state = 'canceled',
      claim_token = null,
      claim_expires_at = null
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state = 'prepared'
      and attempt.expires_at is not null
      and attempt.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    returning attempt.id into v_expired_prepared_attempt_id;

    if v_expired_prepared_attempt_id is not null then
      select exists (
        select 1
        from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        where attempt.purpose = 'order'
          and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
          and attempt.state in (
            'prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved'
          )
      )
      into v_has_unresolved_attempt;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- 결제 이력이 없는 pending 주문은 예전처럼 즉시 종결한다.
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'pending'
    and not v_has_unresolved_attempt
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    )
  then
    perform public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(
      p_order_id,
      p_reason,
      array[]::text[]
    );

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'completed',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    -- 위에서 닫은 만료 시도는 reconcile_expired_prepared_goods_cancellation과 같은
    -- 결과 어휘로 남긴다. actor는 취소를 누른 구매자다.
    if v_expired_prepared_attempt_id is not null then
      insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
      values (
        p_actor,
        'order.prepared_goods_cancellation_completed',
        'order:' || p_order_id::text,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'attemptId', v_expired_prepared_attempt_id,
          'requestId', v_claim_id,
          'outcome', 'expired_no_capture',
          'trigger', 'customer_cancel_request'
        )
      );
    end if;

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','completed','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  /*
   * 자동 승인 — paid(발주확인 전) 변심 취소.
   *
   * 아직 발주확인도 하지 않은 주문의 변심 취소를 사람이 판단할 이유가 없다.
   * 스마트스토어와 같은 경계다. confirmed부터는 발송 준비가 시작됐으므로
   * 운영자 판단으로 남긴다.
   *
   * 승인의 실질(durable claim + 환불 intent)은 admin_decide_order_cancellation의
   * 승인 분기와 같다. decided_by는 null로 남긴다 — 사람이 누른 적이 없다.
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'paid'
    and not exists(select 1 from private.order_production_jobs where order_id=p_order_id and claim_id is null and started_at is not null)
    and not exists(select 1 from private.order_digital_downloads where order_id=p_order_id)
    and p_reason_type = 'change_of_mind'
  then
    insert into public.order_cancellation_claims (
      order_id,
      requested_by,
      previous_status
    )
    values (p_order_id, p_user_id, v_status)
    on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

    insert into public.refunds (
      payment_id,
      amount,
      reason,
      status,
      cancellation_request_id
    )
    select
      payment.id,
      payment.amount,
      p_reason,
      case when refund.status = 'done' then 'done' else 'requested' end,
      v_claim_id
    from public.payments as payment
    left join public.refunds as refund on refund.payment_id = payment.id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded')
    on conflict (payment_id) do update
    set
      cancellation_request_id = excluded.cancellation_request_id,
      reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
      status = case
        when public.refunds.status = 'done' then 'done'
        else 'requested'
      end;

    select count(*)::integer
    into v_payment_count
    from public.payments as payment
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded');

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'processing',
      decided_at = now(),
      provider_started_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
    values (
      p_user_id,
      'order.claim_auto_approved',
      'order:' || p_order_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'claimId', v_claim_id,
        'claimType', 'cancel',
        'from', 'requested',
        'to', 'processing',
        'previousOrderStatus', v_status::text,
        'reasonType', p_reason_type,
        'paymentCount', v_payment_count
      )
    );

    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      v_claim_id,
      'auto_approved',
      '취소 요청이 접수됐어요',
      '발송 전 주문이라 자동으로 승인됐습니다. 결제 취소 처리를 시작합니다.'
    );

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','auto_approved','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  if p_claim_type = 'cancel' and v_status = 'pending' then
    select attempt.state
    into v_attempt_state
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
    order by attempt.id
    limit 1;

    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      v_claim_id,
      'requested',
      '취소 요청이 접수됐어요',
      case v_attempt_state
        when 'prepared' then
          '결제가 끝나지 않은 주문이라 결제 기한이 지나면 결제 없이 자동으로 취소되고 알림을 보내드려요.'
        when 'confirming' then
          '결제 승인 결과를 확인한 뒤 주문 취소를 마무리합니다. 승인됐다면 결제를 취소하고, 승인되지 않았다면 결제 없이 취소한 뒤 알림을 보내드려요.'
        else
          '결제 결과를 확인한 뒤 주문 취소를 마무리하고 진행 상황을 알려드립니다.'
      end
    );

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  perform private.notify_order_claim(
    v_claim_id,
    'requested',
    '클레임 요청이 접수됐어요',
    '요청을 접수했습니다. 담당자가 확인한 뒤 진행 상황을 알려드립니다.'
  );

  return jsonb_build_object('outcome','requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
end;

-- ICONS 상담 콘솔. Existing inquiry messages remain the conversation source.
-- Read receipts belong to each operator and to exact displayed customer messages;
-- opening a conversation must never consume a message that arrived after the read.
create table private.inquiry_chat_reads (
  actor_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  message_id uuid not null references public.inquiry_messages(id) on delete cascade,
  read_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  primary key (actor_id, message_id)
)
alter table private.inquiry_chat_reads enable row level security
revoke all on private.inquiry_chat_reads from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
create index inquiry_chat_reads_message_idx on private.inquiry_chat_reads(message_id)
create index inquiry_messages_chat_customer_idx on public.inquiry_messages(inquiry_id, id) where author='user'

create function public.admin_inquiry_chat_console(
  p_status text default 'all', p_assignee text default 'all', p_period text default '7d',
  p_read text default 'all', p_sort text default 'recent', p_query text default '',
  p_limit integer default 30, p_offset integer default 0
) returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_query text := btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,30),1),100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_actor is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';
  end if;
  if p_status is null or p_status not in ('all','open','answered','closed')
    or p_period is null or p_period not in ('7d','30d','all')
    or p_read is null or p_read not in ('all','unread','read')
    or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('recent','oldest')
    or p_assignee is null or (p_assignee not in ('all','me','unassigned') and p_assignee !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    or char_length(v_query)>100 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_inquiry_chat_filter';
  end if;
  with base as materialized (
    select thread.id,thread.reference,thread.title,thread.category,thread.status,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(buyer.nickname),''),'고객_'||left(buyer.id::text,6)) buyer_name,
      thread.assignee_id,coalesce(nullif(btrim(assignee.nickname),''),'운영자_'||left(assignee.id::text,6)) assignee_name,
      thread.last_message_at,coalesce(latest.body,'') preview,coalesce(latest.author,'user') preview_author,
      (select count(*) from public.inquiry_messages message
        where message.inquiry_id=thread.id and message.author='user'
          and not exists(select 1 from private.inquiry_chat_reads seen where seen.actor_id=v_actor and seen.message_id=message.id)) unread_count
    from public.inquiries thread join public.profiles buyer on buyer.id=thread.user_id
    left join public.profiles assignee on assignee.id=thread.assignee_id
    left join lateral (select left(message.body,180) body,message.author from public.inquiry_messages message
      where message.inquiry_id=thread.id order by message.created_at desc,message.id desc limit 1) latest on true
    where (p_period='all' or thread.last_message_at >= current_timestamp-case p_period when '7d' then interval '7 days' else interval '30 days' end)
      and (p_assignee='all' or (p_assignee='me' and thread.assignee_id=v_actor)
        or (p_assignee='unassigned' and thread.assignee_id is null) or thread.assignee_id::text=lower(p_assignee))
      and (v_query='' or position(lower(v_query) in lower(thread.title))>0
        or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(buyer.nickname,'')))>0
        or thread.reference::text=v_query
        or exists(select 1 from public.inquiry_messages message where message.inquiry_id=thread.id
          and position(lower(v_query) in lower(message.body))>0))
  ), filtered as materialized (
    select * from base where (p_status='all' or status=p_status)
      and (p_read='all' or (p_read='unread' and unread_count>0) or (p_read='read' and unread_count=0))
  ), page as (
    select * from filtered order by
      case when p_sort='recent' then last_message_at end desc,
      case when p_sort='oldest' then last_message_at end asc,id
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by
      case when p_sort='recent' then last_message_at end desc,
      case when p_sort='oldest' then last_message_at end asc,id) from page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'total',(select count(*) from filtered),
    'counts',(select jsonb_build_object('all',count(*),'open',count(*) filter(where status='open'),
      'answered',count(*) filter(where status='answered'),'closed',count(*) filter(where status='closed')) from base),
    'unreadMessages',(select coalesce(sum(unread_count),0) from base),
    'staffOptions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',profile.id,
      'name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(profile.nickname),''),'운영자_'||left(profile.id::text,6))) order by profile.nickname,profile.id)
      from public.profiles profile where profile.role in ('staff','admin') and profile.suspended_at is null
        and private.has_operator_capability(profile.id,'cs.manage',false)),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result;
  return v_result;
end $$
revoke all on function public.admin_inquiry_chat_console(text,text,text,text,text,text,integer,integer) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
revoke all on function public.admin_mark_inquiry_chat_read(uuid,uuid[]) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_inquiry_chat_console(text,text,text,text,text,text,integer,integer)'::regprocedure,'cs.manage','read',false)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_mark_inquiry_chat_read(uuid,uuid[])'::regprocedure,'cs.manage','write',false)
notify pgrst,'reload schema'

ledger.name: smartstore_shipment_workbook
statements: begin

-- Keep the existing export's ready/cancellation/preorder/production/whole-pack
-- checks and CAS versions. The extra fields come from order snapshots and the
-- immutable price ledger, never from today's catalog prices.
create function public.admin_smartstore_shipment_export(p_ids uuid[]) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.manage',false);
  result:=public.admin_shipment_export(p_ids);
  if exists(
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(result->'shipments') shipment
    where jsonb_array_length(shipment->'lines')<>(select count(*) from public.order_shipment_items where shipment_id=(shipment->>'id')::uuid)
  ) or exists(
    select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items item on item.id=link.order_item_id
    where link.shipment_id=any(p_ids) and link.qty<>item.qty
  ) then raise check_violation using message='shipment_item_export_mismatch';end if;
  if exists(
    select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items item on item.id=link.order_item_id
    join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=item.order_id
    left join private.order_price_allocations allocation on allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=purchase.id
    where link.shipment_id=any(p_ids) and purchase.calculation_version=2 and allocation.order_item_id is null
  ) then raise check_violation using message='shipment_price_allocation_missing';end if;

  return jsonb_set(result,'{shipments}',(
    select jsonb_agg(shipment.value||jsonb_build_object('lines',(
      select jsonb_agg(line.value||jsonb_build_object('smartstore',jsonb_build_object(
        'itemId',item.id,'goodId',item.good_id,'goodType',item.good_type_snapshot,
        'buyerName',coalesce(profile.nickname,''),'buyerId',purchase.user_id,'buyerPhone','',
        'address1',coalesce(address.value->>'address1',''),'address2',coalesce(address.value->>'address2',''),
        'orderedAt',purchase.created_at,'paidAt',approval.approved_at,'confirmedAt',purchase.confirmed_at,
        'expectedShipDate',delivery.expected_ship_date,'shippedAt',delivery.shipped_at,'exportedAt',delivery.exported_at,
        'paymentMethod',purchase.payment_method,'productPrice',null,'optionPrice',null,
        'itemTotal',case when allocation.order_item_id is not null then allocation.paid_goods_total
          when purchase.calculation_version=1 and purchase.discount_total=0 and purchase.store_credit_total=0 and purchase.volume_discount_total=0
            then item.unit_price::bigint*item.qty else null end,
        'itemDiscount',discount.value,'sellerDiscount',discount.value,
        'regionalShippingFee',shipping.regional_fee,'shippingDiscount',shipping.coupon_discount
      )) order by line.ordinality)
      from jsonb_array_elements(shipment.value->'lines') with ordinality line(value,ordinality)
      join lateral(
        select original.*,row_number() over(order by original.id) as line_number
        from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items original on original.id=link.order_item_id
        where link.shipment_id=delivery.id
      ) item on item.line_number=line.ordinality
      left join private.order_price_allocations allocation on allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=purchase.id
      cross join lateral(select case when item.regular_unit_price_snapshot>=item.unit_price then
        case when allocation.order_item_id is not null then
          (item.regular_unit_price_snapshot-item.unit_price)::bigint*item.qty+allocation.volume_discount+allocation.coupon_discount+allocation.store_credit_discount
        when purchase.calculation_version=1 and purchase.discount_total=0 and purchase.store_credit_total=0 and purchase.volume_discount_total=0 then
          (item.regular_unit_price_snapshot-item.unit_price)::bigint*item.qty else null end
        else null end as value) discount
    )) order by shipment.ordinality)
    from jsonb_array_elements(result->'shipments') with ordinality shipment(value,ordinality)
    join public.order_shipments delivery on delivery.id=(shipment.value->>'id')::uuid
    join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=delivery.order_id
    left join public.profiles profile on profile.id=purchase.user_id
    cross join lateral(select private.operational_order_address(purchase.id) as value) address
    left join lateral(
      select min(coalesce(
        (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=attempt.id),
        (select confirmation.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations confirmation
          where confirmation.attempt_id=attempt.id and confirmation.order_id=purchase.id and attempt.provider='bank_transfer')
      )) as approved_at
      from public.payments payment join public.payment_attempts attempt on attempt.payment_id=payment.id
      where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=purchase.id and payment.status='paid'
        and payment.user_id=purchase.user_id and payment.amount=purchase.total
        and attempt.purpose='order' and attempt.ref_id=purchase.id and attempt.state='approved'
        and attempt.amount=payment.amount and attempt.provider=payment.provider and attempt.user_id=purchase.user_id
    ) approval on true
    left join lateral(
      select sum(component.regional_fee) as regional_fee,sum(component.shipping_coupon_discount) as coupon_discount
      from private.shipping_charge_components component where component.shipment_id=delivery.id and component.order_id=purchase.id
    ) shipping on true
  ));
end $$

  from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_import_item_tracking_batch(jsonb)'::regprocedure,'sales.manage','write',false)
notify pgrst,'reload schema'

  p_read text default 'all', p_sort text default 'recent', p_query text default '',
  p_limit integer default 30, p_offset integer default 0
) returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_query text := btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,30),1),100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_actor is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';
  end if;
  if p_status is null or p_status not in ('all','open','answered','closed')
    or p_period is null or p_period not in ('7d','30d','all')
    or p_read is null or p_read not in ('all','unread','read')
    or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('recent','oldest')
    or p_assignee is null or (p_assignee not in ('all','me','unassigned') and p_assignee !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    or char_length(v_query)>100 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_inquiry_chat_filter';
  end if;
  with base as materialized (
    select thread.id,thread.reference,thread.title,thread.category,thread.status,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(buyer.nickname),''),'고객_'||left(buyer.id::text,6)) buyer_name,
      thread.assignee_id,coalesce(nullif(btrim(assignee.nickname),''),'운영자_'||left(assignee.id::text,6)) assignee_name,
      thread.last_message_at,coalesce(latest.body,'') preview,coalesce(latest.author,'user') preview_author,
      coalesce((select jsonb_agg(tag.label order by tag.label) from private.inquiry_chat_tags tag where tag.inquiry_id=thread.id),'[]'::jsonb) tags,
      (select count(*) from public.inquiry_messages message
        where message.inquiry_id=thread.id and message.author='user'
          and not exists(select 1 from private.inquiry_chat_reads seen where seen.actor_id=v_actor and seen.message_id=message.id)) unread_count
    from public.inquiries thread join public.profiles buyer on buyer.id=thread.user_id
    left join public.profiles assignee on assignee.id=thread.assignee_id
    left join lateral (select left(message.body,180) body,message.author from public.inquiry_messages message
      where message.inquiry_id=thread.id order by message.created_at desc,message.id desc limit 1) latest on true
    where (p_period='all' or thread.last_message_at >= current_timestamp-case p_period when '7d' then interval '7 days' else interval '30 days' end)
      and (p_assignee='all' or (p_assignee='me' and thread.assignee_id=v_actor)
        or (p_assignee='unassigned' and thread.assignee_id is null) or thread.assignee_id::text=lower(p_assignee))
      and (v_query='' or position(lower(v_query) in lower(thread.title))>0
        or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(buyer.nickname,'')))>0
        or thread.reference::text=v_query
        or exists(select 1 from private.inquiry_chat_tags tag where tag.inquiry_id=thread.id and position(lower(v_query) in lower(tag.label))>0)
        or exists(select 1 from public.inquiry_messages message where message.inquiry_id=thread.id
          and position(lower(v_query) in lower(message.body))>0))
  ), filtered as materialized (
    select * from base where (p_status='all' or status=p_status)
      and (p_read='all' or (p_read='unread' and unread_count>0) or (p_read='read' and unread_count=0))
  ), page as (
    select * from filtered order by
      case when p_sort='recent' then last_message_at end desc,
      case when p_sort='oldest' then last_message_at end asc,id
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by
      case when p_sort='recent' then last_message_at end desc,
      case when p_sort='oldest' then last_message_at end asc,id) from page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'total',(select count(*) from filtered),
    'counts',(select jsonb_build_object('all',count(*),'open',count(*) filter(where status='open'),
      'answered',count(*) filter(where status='answered'),'closed',count(*) filter(where status='closed')) from base),
    'unreadMessages',(select coalesce(sum(unread_count),0) from base),
    'staffOptions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',profile.id,
      'name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(profile.nickname),''),'운영자_'||left(profile.id::text,6))) order by profile.nickname,profile.id)
      from public.profiles profile where profile.role in ('staff','admin') and profile.suspended_at is null
        and private.has_operator_capability(profile.id,'cs.manage',false)),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result;
  return v_result;
end $$

begin

 sha256 text check(sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),state text not null default 'pending' check(state in('pending','verified','retired','cleaned')),
 in_library boolean not null,expires_at timestamptz not null,created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),verified_at timestamptz,
 check(state<>'verified' or sha256 is not null and verified_at is not null),
 check(path~'^[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(jpg|png|webp|gif|mp4|pdf|txt|xls|xlsx|ppt|doc|docx|hwp)$')

create function private.inquiry_file_extension(p_mime text) returns text language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select case p_mime when 'image/jpeg' then 'jpg' when 'image/png' then 'png' when 'image/webp' then 'webp' when 'image/gif' then 'gif'
 when 'video/mp4' then 'mp4' when 'application/pdf' then 'pdf' when 'text/plain' then 'txt' when 'application/vnd.ms-excel' then 'xls'
 when 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' then 'xlsx' when 'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint' then 'ppt'
 when 'application/msword' then 'doc' when 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' then 'docx' when 'application/x-hwp' then 'hwp' end;
$$
alter table private.inquiry_chat_files add constraint inquiry_chat_file_type check(private.inquiry_file_extension(mime_type) is not null)

create function private.inquiry_file_metadata(p_ids uuid[]) returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',f.id,'name',f.filename,'mimeType',f.mime_type,'size',f.size_bytes) order by v.n),'[]'::jsonb)
 from unnest(p_ids) with ordinality v(id,n) join private.inquiry_chat_files f on f.id=v.id and f.sha256 is not null;
$$

create function public.can_upload_inquiry_file(p_path text) returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
 select private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'cs.manage',false) and not private.is_account_write_fenced(auth.uid()) and exists(
  select 1 from private.inquiry_chat_files f join auth.sessions s on s.id=f.session_id and s.user_id=f.actor_id
  where f.actor_id=auth.uid() and f.session_id::text=auth.jwt()->>'session_id' and f.path=p_path and f.state='pending' and f.expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   and(s.not_after is null or s.not_after>clock_timestamp()));
$$
create policy inquiry_files_private_insert on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check(bucket_id='inquiry-files-private' and public.can_upload_inquiry_file(name))

create function public.service_claim_inquiry_file_cleanup(p_limit integer default 5) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$declare result jsonb;begin
 if p_limit not between 1 and 20 then raise invalid_parameter_value;end if;
 with candidates as(select id from private.inquiry_chat_files f where state in('pending','verified','retired') and expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  and(not in_library or state<>'verified') and not exists(select 1 from public.inquiry_messages where f.id=any(file_ids))
  order by expires_at,id for update skip locked limit p_limit), claimed as(
 update private.inquiry_chat_files f set state='retired' from candidates c where f.id=c.id returning f.*)
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'path',path)),'[]') into result from claimed;return result;
end $$

ledger.name: release_main_admin_contracts
statements:
-- Reconcile deployed main cancellation and warehouse contracts with the admin
-- capability, gift, allocation, production and combined-pack domains.
begin

create or replace function public.admin_origin_tracking_candidates(target_origin_id uuid,target_tracking_numbers text[],target_phones text[])
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare origin public.fulfillment_origins;result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if target_origin_id is null or target_tracking_numbers is null or cardinality(target_tracking_numbers)>1000
  or array_position(target_tracking_numbers,null) is not null or target_phones is null or cardinality(target_phones)>1000
  or array_position(target_phones,null) is not null then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_tracking_batch';end if;
 select * into origin from public.fulfillment_origins where id=target_origin_id;
 if not found then raise no_data_found using message='warehouse_origin_not_found';end if;
 with candidates as (
  select s.id,s.order_id,s.status,s.carrier,s.tracking_number,s.shipped_at,a.address
  from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
  cross join lateral(select private.operational_order_address(o.id) address) a
  where s.origin_id=origin.id and s.delivery_method='parcel' and a.address->>'phone'=any(target_phones)
   and ((s.status='ready' and s.exported_at is not null and o.status in('confirmed','shipping'))
     or(s.status in('shipping','delivered') and o.status<>'canceled' and s.shipped_at>=now()-interval '45 days'))
  order by s.status<>'ready',s.shipped_at desc nulls first,s.id limit 5001
 ), bounded as(select * from candidates limit 5000)
 select jsonb_build_object('originId',origin.id,'template',origin.export_template,'active',origin.is_active,
  'defaultCarrier',origin.default_carrier,'truncated',(select count(*)>5000 from candidates),
  'shipments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'orderId',c.order_id,'status',c.status,
   'carrier',c.carrier,'trackingNumber',c.tracking_number,
   'lines',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('recipient',coalesce(c.address->>'recipientName',''),
    'phone',coalesce(c.address->>'phone',''),'postalCode',coalesce(c.address->>'postalCode',''),
    'address',concat_ws(' ',c.address->>'address1',nullif(c.address->>'address2','')),
    'goodName',i.good_name_snapshot,'optionName',concat_ws(' / ',nullif(i.variant_name_snapshot,''),
     (select string_agg((field->>'name')||': '||(field->>'value'),' / ' order by entry.ordinality)
      from jsonb_array_elements(i.custom_inputs_snapshot->'fields') with ordinality entry(field,ordinality))),'qty',coalesce(link.qty,i.qty),
    'deliveryNote',coalesce(c.address->>'deliveryNote','')) order by i.id)
    from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id
    where link.shipment_id=c.id),'[]')) order by c.status<>'ready',c.shipped_at desc nulls first,c.id) from bounded c),'[]'),
  'usedTracking',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trackingNumber',s.tracking_number,'shipmentId',s.id) order by s.tracking_number,s.id)
   from public.order_shipments s where s.carrier=origin.default_carrier and s.tracking_number=any(target_tracking_numbers)),'[]'))
 into result;
 return result;
end $$

create or replace function public.admin_origin_pending_export_ids(target_origin_id uuid) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 -- Count and select a whole physical package. A held, already-exported or
 -- unfinished-production sibling excludes the package before the 1,000-row cap.
 with pending as (
  select s.id,s.created_at,coalesce(private.shipment_pack_id(s.id),s.id) group_id,
   (select count(*) from public.order_shipment_items link where link.shipment_id=s.id) line_count
  from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
  where s.origin_id=target_origin_id and s.status='ready' and s.exported_at is null and s.delivery_method='parcel'
   and o.status in('confirmed','shipping') and private.shipment_preorder_allocation_ready(s.id)
   and(private.shipment_production_summary(s.id)->>'ready')::boolean
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status in('requested','processing','needs_review'))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=o.id)
 ), eligible as (
  select p.* from pending p where not exists(
   select 1 from unnest(private.shipment_pack_scope(array[p.id])) member(id)
   where not exists(select 1 from pending sibling where sibling.id=member.id))
 ), groups as (
  select group_id,min(created_at) created_at,sum(line_count) line_count,count(*) shipment_count
  from eligible group by group_id
 ), ordered as (
  select group_id,sum(line_count) over(order by created_at,group_id) running_lines,
   sum(shipment_count) over(order by created_at,group_id) running_shipments from groups
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('ids',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(e.id order by e.created_at,e.id) from eligible e
  join ordered g on g.group_id=e.group_id where g.running_lines<=1000 and g.running_shipments<=1000),'[]'),
  'total',(select count(*) from eligible)) into result;
 return result;
end $$

notify pgrst,'reload schema'

ledger.name: readable_order_numbers
statements: begin

-- Public references are independent of UUID primary keys and PG order IDs.
-- YYYYMMDD (Asia/Seoul) + kind (1 order / 2 item / 3 shipment) + daily sequence.
-- Separate kind digits prevent an order number pasted into an item sheet from
-- accidentally identifying an unrelated item with the same daily sequence.
create table private.commerce_number_counters (
  business_date date not null,
  kind smallint not null check (kind in (1,2,3)),
  last_value integer not null check (last_value between 1 and 9999999),
  primary key (business_date,kind)
)
alter table private.commerce_number_counters enable row level security
revoke all on private.commerce_number_counters from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
revoke all on function private.next_commerce_number(timestamptz,smallint) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

-- A migration-only backfill must not run order status, account-fence, outbox,
-- stock or updated_at triggers. Lock all three tables, save their exact trigger
-- states, update only the new columns, and restore those states in this same
-- transaction. Any failure rolls back the data AND the trigger state.
lock table public.orders,public.order_items,public.order_shipments in access exclusive mode

create temporary table commerce_number_trigger_states on commit drop as
select tgrelid, tgname, tgenabled from pg_trigger
where tgrelid in ('public.orders'::regclass,'public.order_items'::regclass,'public.order_shipments'::regclass)
  and not tgisinternal
alter table public.orders add column order_number text
alter table public.order_items add column product_order_number text
alter table public.order_shipments add column shipment_number text

with numbered as (
  select id, to_char(created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMMDD') date_key,
    row_number() over(partition by (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date order by created_at,id) n
  from public.orders
) update public.orders target set order_number=date_key||'1'||lpad(n::text,7,'0') from numbered where target.id=numbered.id

with numbered as (
  select item.id, to_char(purchase.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMMDD') date_key,
    row_number() over(partition by (purchase.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date order by purchase.created_at,purchase.id,item.id) n
  from public.order_items item join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=item.order_id
) update public.order_items target set product_order_number=date_key||'2'||lpad(n::text,7,'0') from numbered where target.id=numbered.id

with numbered as (
  select shipment.id, to_char(purchase.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMMDD') date_key,
    row_number() over(partition by (purchase.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date order by purchase.created_at,purchase.id,shipment.id) n
  from public.order_shipments shipment join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=shipment.order_id
) update public.order_shipments target set shipment_number=date_key||'3'||lpad(n::text,7,'0') from numbered where target.id=numbered.id

insert into private.commerce_number_counters(business_date,kind,last_value)
select to_date(left(number,8),'YYYYMMDD'),substring(number,9,1)::smallint,max(right(number,7)::integer)
from (
  select order_number number from public.orders union all
  select product_order_number from public.order_items union all
  select shipment_number from public.order_shipments
) numbers group by 1,2

alter table public.orders alter column order_number set not null,
  add constraint orders_number_format check(order_number ~ '^[0-9]{8}1[0-9]{7}$'),
  add constraint orders_order_number_key unique(order_number)

alter table public.order_items alter column product_order_number set not null,
  add constraint order_items_number_format check(product_order_number ~ '^[0-9]{8}2[0-9]{7}$'),
  add constraint order_items_product_order_number_key unique(product_order_number)

alter table public.order_shipments alter column shipment_number set not null,

ledger.name: smartstore_delivery_list_export
statements: begin

-- Read-only list export: unlike a warehouse instruction this includes new,
-- dispatched and delivered shipments and never marks them as exported.
create function public.admin_delivery_list_export_lines(p_ids uuid[]) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
  perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.manage',false);
  if p_ids is null or cardinality(p_ids) not between 1 and 1000 or array_position(p_ids,null) is not null
    or cardinality(p_ids)<>(select count(distinct id) from unnest(p_ids) id) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_delivery_export_ids';
  end if;
  if (select count(*) from public.order_shipments where id=any(p_ids))<>cardinality(p_ids)
    or exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.id=any(p_ids)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link where link.shipment_id=s.id))
    or exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items item on item.id=link.order_item_id
      where link.shipment_id=any(p_ids) and (link.qty<>item.qty or link.order_id<>item.order_id)) then
    raise check_violation using message='shipment_item_export_mismatch';
  end if;
  if exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items item on item.id=link.order_item_id
    join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=item.order_id
    left join private.order_price_allocations allocation on allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=purchase.id
    where link.shipment_id=any(p_ids) and purchase.calculation_version=2 and allocation.order_item_id is null) then
    raise check_violation using message='shipment_price_allocation_missing';
  end if;

  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'shipmentId',s.id,'itemId',item.id,'orderId',purchase.id,'shipmentUpdatedAt',s.updated_at,
      'orderNumber',purchase.order_number,'productOrderNumber',item.product_order_number,'shipmentNumber',s.shipment_number,
      'status',case when s.status='shipping' then 'shipping' when s.status='delivered' then
        case when purchase.status='done' then 'done' else 'delivered' end
        when s.status='canceled' then 'canceled' when purchase.status='shipping' then 'confirmed' else purchase.status::text end,
      'deliveryMethod',s.delivery_method,'shippedAt',s.shipped_at,'deliveredAt',s.delivered_at,'paidAt',approval.approved_at,
      'carrier',coalesce(carrier.label,s.carrier),'trackingNumber',s.tracking_number,
      'buyerName',coalesce(profile.nickname,''),'buyerId',purchase.user_id,'buyerPhone',null,
      'recipientName',address.value->>'recipientName','phone',address.value->>'phone','postalCode',address.value->>'postalCode',
      'address',nullif(concat_ws(' ',nullif(address.value->>'address1',''),nullif(address.value->>'address2','')),''),
      'goodId',item.good_id,'goodCode',good.code,'goodName',item.good_name_snapshot,
      'variantName',item.variant_name_snapshot,'customInputs',item.custom_inputs_snapshot,'qty',link.qty,
      'productPrice',null,'optionPrice',null,
      'itemTotal',case when allocation.order_item_id is not null then allocation.paid_goods_total
        when purchase.calculation_version=1 and purchase.discount_total=0 and purchase.store_credit_total=0 and purchase.volume_discount_total=0
          then item.unit_price::bigint*item.qty else null end,
      'itemDiscount',discount.value,'sellerDiscount',discount.value,
      'shippingFee',s.shipping_fee,'shippingCollectFee',s.shipping_collect_fee,
      'regionalShippingFee',shipping.regional_fee,'shippingDiscount',shipping.coupon_discount
    ) order by array_position(p_ids,s.id),item.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    from public.order_shipments s join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=s.order_id
    join public.order_shipment_items link on link.shipment_id=s.id and link.order_id=purchase.id
    join public.order_items item on item.id=link.order_item_id and item.order_id=purchase.id
    left join public.profiles profile on profile.id=purchase.user_id
    left join public.goods good on good.id=item.good_id
    left join public.shipping_carriers carrier on carrier.code=s.carrier
    cross join lateral(select private.operational_order_address(purchase.id) as value) address
    left join private.order_price_allocations allocation on allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=purchase.id
    cross join lateral(select case when item.regular_unit_price_snapshot>=item.unit_price then
      case when allocation.order_item_id is not null then
        (item.regular_unit_price_snapshot-item.unit_price)::bigint*item.qty+allocation.volume_discount+allocation.coupon_discount+allocation.store_credit_discount
      when purchase.calculation_version=1 and purchase.discount_total=0 and purchase.store_credit_total=0 and purchase.volume_discount_total=0 then
        (item.regular_unit_price_snapshot-item.unit_price)::bigint*item.qty else null end else null end as value) discount
    left join lateral(
      select min(coalesce(
        (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=attempt.id),
        (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=attempt.id and b.order_id=purchase.id and attempt.provider='bank_transfer')
      )) approved_at
      from public.payments payment join public.payment_attempts attempt on attempt.payment_id=payment.id
      where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=purchase.id and payment.status='paid'
        and payment.user_id=purchase.user_id and payment.amount=purchase.total
        and attempt.purpose='order' and attempt.ref_id=purchase.id and attempt.state='approved'
        and attempt.amount=payment.amount and attempt.provider=payment.provider and attempt.user_id=purchase.user_id
    ) approval on true
    left join lateral(select sum(component.regional_fee) regional_fee,sum(component.shipping_coupon_discount) coupon_discount
      from private.shipping_charge_components component where component.shipment_id=s.id and component.order_id=purchase.id) shipping on true
    where s.id=any(p_ids)
  );
end $$
revoke all on function public.admin_delivery_list_export_lines(uuid[]) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_delivery_list_export_lines(uuid[]) to authenticated
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_delivery_list_export_lines(uuid[])'::regprocedure,'sales.manage','read',false)
notify pgrst,'reload schema'
commit

ledger.name: restock_alert_variants
statements:
-- LFS 패리티 2차 L2 (#567) — PD-11 옵션 단위 재입고 알림.
--
-- 지금까지 재입고 알림은 굿즈 단위였다(restock_alerts unique(user, good)). 다옵션 굿즈에서
-- 옵션 하나만 품절이면 굿즈는 여전히 판매 중이라 그 옵션의 재입고를 기다릴 길이 없었다.
-- 신청에 옵션 키(variant_id)를 더한다. NULL 은 "모든 옵션" — 기존 굿즈 단위 신청이 그대로 이 뜻으로
-- 남는다(백필 없음).
--
-- "재고로 살 수 있는 옵션"은 사용 중(archived_at is null)이고 재고 판매(preorder_policy_id is null)이며
-- 재고가 있는(stock_qty > 0) 옵션이다. 예약판매 옵션은 재고가 아니라 예약 기간·물량으로 열리고 닫혀
-- 재입고 알림 대상이 아니다 — 그 옵션의 stock_qty 는 예약 주문에 할당할 실물 입고분이라 판매 재고가 아니다.
-- 아래 신청 판정·두 갈래의 발화·트리거 조건이 모두 이 술어 하나를 쓴다.
--
-- 발화는 두 갈래다.
--   ① 굿즈 행의 판매 가능 전이(기존 trg_goods_notify_restock): 굿즈 단위 신청과, 그 순간 재고로 살 수
--      있는 옵션의 옵션 신청을 깨운다. 판매 가능 술어(공개·보관·판매 제한·결제수단·IP 공개·품절 표시·
--      재고)는 기존 정의를 그대로 둔다. goods.stock_qty 는 보관·예약판매 옵션의 재고까지 더한 캐시라
--      굿즈 행이 판매 가능해져도 신청마다 재고로 살 수 있는 옵션을 다시 본다.
--   ② 옵션 행이 재고로 살 수 없음→살 수 있음으로 바뀌는 전이(신규 goods_variants_restock_notify): 재고
--      0→양수, 보관 옵션 복원, 예약판매→재고 판매 전환(재고가 남아 있을 때). 그 옵션의 신청과 굿즈 단위
--      신청을 깨운다. 다른 옵션이 판매 중이면 굿즈 행은 전후 모두 판매 가능이라 ①은 아무것도 깨우지
--      않는다 — 옵션 신청은 옵션 행의 전이로만 성립한다. 부모 굿즈의 재고 외 판매 가능 조건(공개·보관·
--      판매 제한·결제수단·IP 공개·품절 표시)은 따로 확인한다.
-- 두 갈래가 같은 신청을 함께 보아도 pending → notified 전이는 한 번뿐이라 알림도 한 번이다.
--
-- 부모 굿즈의 재고 외 판매 가능 조건(공개·보관·판매 제한·결제수단·IP 공개·품절 표시·판매 기간)은
-- private.restock_parent_open 하나로 판정한다. 판매 기간은 상세·주문 생성과 같은 판정이다(기간이 없으면
-- 무기한, 있으면 시작 ≤ 지금 < 종료). 재고가 들어온 순간 이 조건이 닫혀 있으면 깨우지 않고 신청은 pending
-- 으로 남는다. 조건이 다시 열리는 전이 가운데 굿즈 행이 바뀌는 것(결제수단·판매 제한·판매 기간 편집 등)은
-- ① 트리거가 바로 깨우고, 행이 바뀌지 않는 것(IP 재공개, 판매 기간 시작 시각 도래)은 5분 주기 청소 작업
-- (private.sweep_restock_alerts)이 깨운다.
--
-- 두 트리거는 재고를 바꾸는 트랜잭션(주문 생성·취소 환원·재고 조정·옵션 편집) 안에서 돈다. 팬아웃은
-- 예외를 밖으로 던지지 않는다 — 실패하면 그 블록만 되돌려 신청을 pending 으로 남기고(다음 전이에서
-- 다시 깨운다) 재고 쓰기는 그대로 진행한다. 재고 수량은 읽기만 한다.

-- ── 1. 옵션 키 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- 옵션은 반드시 같은 굿즈의 옵션이다(goods_variants_id_good_key). 장바구니 품목과 같은 형태로
-- 굿즈 URL 변경(on update cascade)·옵션 삭제(on delete cascade)를 따라가고, 검사는 커밋 시점에
-- 한다 — 굿즈 id 변경은 굿즈 FK 와 옵션 FK 두 경로로 같은 행에 전파되기 때문이다.
alter table public.restock_alerts
  add column variant_id uuid,
  add constraint restock_alerts_variant_good_fkey
    foreign key (variant_id, good_id) references public.goods_variants (id, good_id)
    on update cascade on delete cascade
    deferrable initially deferred

-- 사용자×굿즈×옵션 1행. 평범한 unique 는 NULL 끼리 겹쳐도 막지 못하므로 nulls not distinct 로
-- "모든 옵션" 신청도 사용자×굿즈당 1행으로 고정한다. 재신청은 새 행이 아니라 같은 행을 되돌린다.
alter table public.restock_alerts drop constraint restock_alerts_user_good_key

alter table public.restock_alerts
  add constraint restock_alerts_user_good_variant_key unique nulls not distinct (user_id, good_id, variant_id)

-- 옵션 전이 트리거의 pending 조회와 옵션 FK cascade 를 함께 받는다.
create index restock_alerts_variant_status_idx
  on public.restock_alerts (variant_id, status)
  where variant_id is not null

-- ── 1b. 부모 굿즈의 재고 외 판매 가능 조건 ───────────────────────────
-- 두 갈래의 발화와 청소 작업이 모두 이 술어 하나를 쓴다. 판매 기간 판정은 20261020085302 와 같다.
-- null 이 섞여도 거짓으로 접는다 — 트리거의 `if not (...)` 이 null 을 통과로 읽지 않게.
create function private.restock_parent_open(target_good public.goods)
returns boolean
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select coalesce(
    target_good.archived_at is null
    and target_good.published_at is not null
    and target_good.sale_restriction = 'none'
    and (target_good.allow_card_payment or target_good.allow_bank_transfer)
    and target_good.stock <> 'soldout'
    and (
      target_good.sale_starts_at is null
      or (now() >= target_good.sale_starts_at and now() < target_good.sale_ends_at)
    )
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.ips
      where ips.id = target_good.ip_id and ips.published_at is not null and ips.archived_at is null
    ),
    false
  );
$$

revoke all on function private.restock_parent_open(public.goods)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- ── 2. 깨우기(공용 팬아웃) ───────────────────────────────────────────
-- target_variant_id 가 null 이면 굿즈 단위 전이(①), 아니면 그 옵션의 전이(②)다.
-- 알림 문구·링크·dedupe 키는 어느 갈래가 깨워도 신청 하나에 같은 모양이다.
create function private.wake_restock_alerts(target_good public.goods, target_variant_id uuid)
returns integer
language plpgsql
volatile
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  woken integer := 0;
  -- 재신청→재품절→재입고 사이클마다 새 알림이어야 하므로 시각을 키에 넣는다(기존 규율).
  -- now() 는 트랜잭션 시작에 고정되므로 문장 시각(clock_timestamp) 밀리초로 사이클을 구분한다.
  stamp text := ((extract(epoch from pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint)::text;
begin
  if target_good.id is null then
    return 0;
  end if;

  -- 신청이 없는 굿즈가 절대다수다. 아래 예외 블록(서브트랜잭션)에 들어가기 전에 거른다.
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.restock_alerts as alert
    where alert.good_id = target_good.id and alert.status = 'pending'
  ) then
    return 0;
  end if;

  begin
    with flipped as (
      update public.restock_alerts as alert
      set status = 'notified', notified_at = now()
      where alert.good_id = target_good.id
        and alert.status = 'pending'
        and case
          -- ② 옵션이 살 수 있게 됐다: 그 옵션 신청과 "모든 옵션" 신청이 충족된다.
          when target_variant_id is not null then
            alert.variant_id is null or alert.variant_id = target_variant_id
          -- ① 굿즈가 판매 가능해졌다: "모든 옵션" 신청은 재고로 살 수 있는 옵션이 하나라도 있을 때,
          --    옵션 신청은 그 옵션을 지금 재고로 살 수 있을 때만 충족된다. goods.stock_qty 는 보관 옵션과
          --    예약판매 옵션의 실물 입고분까지 더한 캐시라(ADR-0015) 그것만으로는 살 수 있는 옵션이 있다는
          --    뜻이 아니다.
          when alert.variant_id is null then exists (
            select 1 from public.goods_variants as variant
            where variant.good_id = target_good.id
              and variant.archived_at is null
              and variant.preorder_policy_id is null
              and variant.stock_qty > 0
          )
          else exists (
            select 1 from public.goods_variants as variant
            where variant.id = alert.variant_id
              and variant.good_id = target_good.id
              and variant.archived_at is null
              and variant.preorder_policy_id is null
              and variant.stock_qty > 0
          )
        end
      returning alert.user_id, alert.variant_id
    ), fanned as (
      insert into public.notifications (
        user_id,
        type,
        title,
        body,
        link_path,
        source_type,
        source_id,
        dedupe_key
      )
      select
        flipped.user_id,
        'restock_available',
        '재입고 알림',
        left(
          case
            when flipped.variant_id is null or variant.name is null
              then target_good.name || ' 굿즈가 다시 판매를 시작했어요.'
            else target_good.name || ' · ' || variant.name || ' 옵션이 다시 판매를 시작했어요.'
          end,
          500
        ),
        -- 옵션 신청은 그 옵션을 고른 상세로 연다(?variant=, PD-14).
        '/shop/' || target_good.id
          || case when flipped.variant_id is null then '' else '?variant=' || flipped.variant_id::text end,
        'good',
        target_good.id,
        -- 옵션 신청은 키에 옵션을 담는다. 같은 사용자의 "모든 옵션" 신청과 옵션 신청이 한 문장에서
        -- 함께 깨어나도 서로의 알림을 지우지 않는다. 옵션 키는 굿즈 id 길이와 무관하게 128자 안이다.
        case
          when flipped.variant_id is null then 'restock:' || target_good.id || ':' || stamp
          else 'restock:' || flipped.variant_id::text || ':' || stamp
        end
      from flipped
      left join public.goods_variants as variant on variant.id = flipped.variant_id
      on conflict (user_id, dedupe_key) do nothing
      returning 1
    )
    select count(*) into woken from flipped;
  exception when others then
    -- 재고 쓰기를 되돌리지 않는다. 이 블록의 신청 전이·알림만 되돌아가 신청은 pending 으로 남는다.
    raise warning 'restock_alert_wake_failed good=% variant=% sqlstate=%',
      target_good.id, target_variant_id, sqlstate;
    return 0;
  end;

  return woken;
end;
$$

revoke all on function private.wake_restock_alerts(public.goods, uuid)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- ── 3. ① 굿즈 행의 판매 가능 전이 ───────────────────────────────────
-- 판매 가능 술어는 20260910072933 의 정의(공개·보관·판매 제한·결제수단·IP 공개·품절 표시·재고 캐시)에
-- 판매 기간을 더한 것이다. 팬아웃은 공용 함수로 옮긴다. IP 공개와 판매 기간의 '지금' 판정은 한 문장 안의
-- old·new 가 같은 값을 보므로 그 자체로는 전이를 만들지 않는다 — 판매 기간 칸을 고치는 편집은 old·new 의
-- 기간이 달라 전이가 되고, IP 재공개·시작 시각 도래는 청소 작업이 맡는다.
create or replace function private.notify_goods_restock()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path to ''
as $function$
begin
  -- 판매 가능 술어가 거짓→참으로 전이할 때만 발화한다.
  if not (private.restock_parent_open(new) and new.stock_qty > 0)
    or (private.restock_parent_open(old) and old.stock_qty > 0) then
    return new;
  end if;

  perform private.wake_restock_alerts(new, null);
  return new;
end;
$function$
revoke all on function private.notify_goods_restock() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.notify_goods_variant_restock() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 이름은 goods_variants_refresh_stock 뒤에 오도록 지었다(같은 시점 AFTER 트리거는 이름순).
-- 재고 캐시 갱신이 먼저 굿즈 행을 잠그고 굿즈 단위 전이(①)를 끝낸 뒤 이 트리거가 남은 옵션 신청을 본다.
-- preorder_policy_id 를 null 로 바꾸는 곳은 재고 판매 전환(admin_use_stock_supply) 하나이고, 그 RPC 도
-- 굿즈 → 옵션 순서로 잠근 뒤 옵션 행을 바꾸므로 이 트리거가 굿즈 행을 다시 잡아도 잠금 순서가 같다.
create trigger goods_variants_restock_notify
after update of stock_qty, archived_at, preorder_policy_id on public.goods_variants
for each row
when (
  (new.archived_at is null and new.preorder_policy_id is null and new.stock_qty > 0)
  and not (old.archived_at is null and old.preorder_policy_id is null and old.stock_qty > 0)
)
execute function private.notify_goods_variant_restock()

-- ① 굿즈 트리거는 재고·보관·공개 칸뿐 아니라 재고 외 판매 가능 조건을 바꾸는 칸(판매 제한·결제수단·판매
-- 기간)에도 발화한다. 재고가 들어온 순간 그 조건이 닫혀 pending 으로 남은 신청이, 조건이 다시 열리는 편집
-- (예: 무통장 재허용, 판매 기간을 지금으로 당김)에서 바로 깨어난다. 함수가 전이만 보고 일찍 끝나므로
-- 다른 편집에는 일이 없다. 정의는 20260908031346 을 대체한다.
drop trigger trg_goods_notify_restock on public.goods

create trigger trg_goods_notify_restock
after update of stock, stock_qty, archived_at, published_at, sale_restriction,
  allow_card_payment, allow_bank_transfer, sale_starts_at, sale_ends_at
on public.goods
for each row
execute function private.notify_goods_restock()

-- ── 4b. 청소: 굿즈·옵션 행이 바뀌지 않고 열린 조건 ────────────────────
-- IP 재공개(ips 행)나 판매 기간 시작 시각 도래(시간)는 굿즈·옵션 트리거가 보지 못한다. 받아 둔 신청은 신청
-- 시점에 그 대상을 재고로 살 수 없었다(신청 RPC 가 판매 중이면 거절한다). 그러니 지금 살 수 있으면 그 사이에
-- 전이가 있었던 것이다. 대기 신청이 있는 굿즈 가운데 재고 외 조건이 열린 굿즈를 골라 ①과 같은 판정으로
-- 깨운다(신청마다 그 대상을 지금 재고로 살 수 있을 때만). 재고를 쓰는 트랜잭션과 같은 순서(굿즈 행 잠금 →
-- 신청)를 따르고, 지금 잠긴 굿즈는 건너뛰어 다음 회차에 본다. 대기 신청이 없으면 아무 일도 하지 않는다.
create function private.sweep_restock_alerts()
returns integer
language plpgsql
volatile
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  candidate public.goods;
  woken integer := 0;
begin
  for candidate in
    select good.*
    from public.goods as good
    where good.id in (
        select alert.good_id from public.restock_alerts as alert where alert.status = 'pending'
      )
      and private.restock_parent_open(good)
    order by good.id
    for update of good skip locked
  loop
    woken := woken + private.wake_restock_alerts(candidate, null);
  end loop;
  return woken;
end;
$$

revoke all on function private.sweep_restock_alerts()
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 5분마다. cron.schedule 은 이름 기준 upsert 라 재적용에도 안전하다.
select cron.schedule('sweep-restock-alerts', '*/5 * * * *', 'select private.sweep_restock_alerts()')

revoke all on function public.request_restock_alert(text)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.request_restock_alert(text) to authenticated

revoke all on function public.request_variant_restock_alert(text, uuid)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.request_variant_restock_alert(text, uuid) to authenticated

-- ── 6. 메일 producer 용 옵션 이름 ───────────────────────────────────
-- 재입고 메일은 앱 producer 가 service role 로 notified 신청을 읽어 보낸다. service role 에는
-- goods_variants 읽기 권한이 없으므로(20260908020855 — 카탈로그 옵션은 anon·authenticated 공개
-- 읽기만 연다) 권한을 넓히지 않고, 그 굿즈의 notified 옵션 신청이 가리키는 옵션 이름만 돌려준다.
-- 알림 뒤에 사용 중지된 옵션도 이름은 그대로 돌려준다(알림 시점에는 판매 중이었다).
create function public.service_restock_alert_option_names(target_good_id text)
returns table (variant_id uuid, option_name text)
language sql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select variant.id, variant.name
  from public.goods_variants as variant
  where variant.good_id = target_good_id
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.restock_alerts as alert
      where alert.good_id = target_good_id
        and alert.variant_id = variant.id
        and alert.status = 'notified'
    )
  order by variant.sort_order, variant.id;
$$

revoke all on function public.service_restock_alert_option_names(text)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.service_restock_alert_option_names(text) to service_role

ledger.name: goods_review_summaries
statements:
-- ============================================================================
-- ICONS · 목록 카드 별점 — 공개 굿즈 리뷰 요약 배치 읽기 (LFS 패리티 2차 L4 · CL-02)
--
-- 굿즈샵·검색·온라인 팝업·홈의 상품 카드가 "리뷰가 있으면" 별점과 리뷰 수를 보인다(11 §8.3 CL-02).
-- 카탈로그 스냅샷이 공개 굿즈 ID 를 한 번에 넘기면 이 함수가 굿즈별 요약을 한 번에 돌려준다 —
-- 카드마다 상세 리뷰 RPC 를 부르는 N+1 을 만들지 않는다.
--
-- ## 상세 페이지와 같은 숫자
--
-- 굿즈 상세의 평점 요약(get_good_group_reviews_v3 summary)은 굿즈 그룹 범위다: 같은 그룹의 공개 굿즈
-- 리뷰를 함께 센다(private.goods_group_review_good_ids). 카드가 굿즈 하나만 세면 같은 굿즈가 목록에서는
-- "리뷰 없음", 상세에서는 "4.5점 · 12개"로 보인다. 그래서 같은 범위 함수와 같은 공개 조건
-- (status = 'visible', 평균은 소수 둘째 자리 반올림)을 쓴다.
--
-- ## 공개 범위
--
-- - 숨김(블라인드) 리뷰는 세지 않는다. 신고는 운영자가 블라인드하면 숨김이 된다 — 상세와 같은 규칙.
-- - 보관·비공개·판매 제한 굿즈와 비공개 IP 의 굿즈는 요약을 내지 않는다
--   (goods_group_public_good 가 그 판정을 소유한다). 공개 카탈로그 밖 ID 는 조용히 빠진다.
-- - 리뷰 0건 굿즈는 행이 없다 — "집계를 못 읽은 것"과 "리뷰가 없는 것"을 같은 값으로 만들지 않는다
--   (public.good_review_stats 와 같은 원칙). 화면은 행이 없으면 별점을 숨긴다.
--
-- ## 읽기 전용·봉인
--
-- STABLE SECURITY DEFINER(search_path ''): 그룹 범위 함수와 그룹 테이블은 postgres 전용이라 소유자
-- 권한으로 읽되, 돌려주는 값은 공개 리뷰의 개수·평균뿐이다. 행을 바꾸지 않는다.
-- 실행은 공개 브라우징처럼 anon·authenticated 에만 연다(service_role·PUBLIC 없음).
-- ============================================================================

begin

create function public.get_goods_review_summaries(p_good_ids text[])
returns jsonb
language plpgsql
stable
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  result jsonb;
begin
  if p_good_ids is null
    or pg_catalog.cardinality(p_good_ids) not between 1 and 500
    or pg_catalog.array_position(p_good_ids, null) is not null
    or exists (
      select 1 from pg_catalog.unnest(p_good_ids) as requested(id)
      where requested.id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    )
  then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_goods_review_summary_goods';
  end if;

  with requested as (
    select distinct requested.id
    from pg_catalog.unnest(p_good_ids) as requested(id)
  ), scope as (
    -- 비공개 굿즈는 빈 배열이라 여기서 사라진다. 그룹 밖 공개 굿즈는 자기 자신 하나다.
    select requested.id as good_id, member.good_id as member_id
    from requested
    cross join lateral pg_catalog.unnest(private.goods_group_review_good_ids(requested.id)) as member(good_id)
  ), summary as (
    select
      scope.good_id,
      pg_catalog.count(*)::bigint as review_count,
      round(avg(review.rating)::numeric, 2) as rating_average
    from scope
    join public.reviews as review
      on review.good_id = scope.member_id
     and review.status = 'visible'
    group by scope.good_id
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'goodId', summary.good_id,
        'reviewCount', summary.review_count,
        'ratingAverage', summary.rating_average
      )
      order by summary.good_id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into result
  from summary;

  return result;
end;
$$

comment on function public.get_goods_review_summaries(text[]) is
  '목록 카드 별점: 공개 굿즈별 공개 리뷰 수·평균(굿즈 상세와 같은 그룹 범위). 리뷰 0건·비공개 굿즈는 행이 없다.'
revoke all on function public.get_goods_review_summaries(text[]) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.get_goods_review_summaries(text[]) to anon, authenticated
notify pgrst, 'reload schema'
commit

ledger.name: home_notice_bar
statements:
-- L8a (#573, CH-01·CH-02): text notice bar kind and page-type targeting for
-- the global-shell notices. The shell reads every valid notice with a
-- cookie-free cached query (lib/notice-strip.server.ts) and decides page type,
-- session dismissal and the random strip on the client, so these rows carry
-- only what that read needs.
--
-- * notice_bar: one line of copy (title, 1..60 chars), an optional internal
--   link whose button label lives in payload.cta_label (required exactly when
--   a link exists), and payload.page_types. Text only: no artwork.
-- * notice_strip: may now carry payload.page_types. A strip without it keeps
--   the previous behavior (every shell page), so existing rows stay valid.
-- * page_types is a non-empty, duplicate-free subset of
--   home | collection | product | content | other, stored in that order.

create function private.is_valid_home_notice_page_types(candidate jsonb)
returns boolean
language plpgsql
immutable
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  -- plpgsql keeps the evaluation order explicit: the array functions below
  -- would raise on a scalar instead of rejecting it.
  if candidate is null or pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(candidate) <> 'array' then return false; end if;
  if pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(candidate) not between 1 and 5 then return false; end if;
  if exists (
    select 1 from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(candidate) as entries(entry)
    where pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(entry) <> 'string'
      or entry #>> '{}' not in ('home', 'collection', 'product', 'content', 'other')
  ) then
    return false;
  end if;
  return (
    select pg_catalog.count(distinct entry)
    from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements_text(candidate) as entries(entry)
  ) = pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(candidate);
end $$
revoke all on function private.is_valid_home_notice_page_types(jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function private.is_valid_home_notice_page_types(jsonb) to postgres
revoke all on function private.is_valid_home_notice_payload(text, jsonb, text) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function private.is_valid_home_notice_payload(text, jsonb, text) to postgres

alter table public.home_curations
  drop constraint home_curations_kind_check,
  drop constraint home_curations_link_path_check,
  add constraint home_curations_kind_check check (
    kind in (
      'hero', 'featured_ip', 'announcement',
      'notice_strip', 'notice_bar', 'editor_pick', 'band_banner', 'best_tab', 'benefit',
      'sales_best', 'review_best', 'product_mosaic', 'product_collection'
    )
  ),
  -- Same rule as before, with the text notice bar joining the hero in allowing
  -- a row without a destination (the bar then renders without a button).
  add constraint home_curations_link_path_check check (
    (kind in ('hero', 'notice_bar', 'product_collection') and link_path is null)
    or (kind <> 'product_collection' and link_path is not null and private.is_safe_home_curation_link(link_path))
  ),
  add constraint home_curations_notice_check check (
    private.is_valid_home_notice_payload(kind, payload, link_path)
    and (
      kind <> 'notice_bar'
      or (
        image_path is null
        and pg_catalog.char_length(title) between 1 and 60
        and title !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
      )
    )
  )

revoke all on function private.save_home_curation(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,text,text,integer,timestamptz,timestamptz,boolean,text,jsonb,timestamptz,boolean) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function private.save_home_curation(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,text,text,integer,timestamptz,timestamptz,boolean,text,jsonb,timestamptz,boolean) to postgres
