ledger.name: claim_bulk_step_context
statements:
-- 반품·교환·취소 목록의 단계 일괄 처리(회수 확인·환불 완료 확정·재출고)가 읽는 클레임 사실
-- (1027T-033·SHEET-049·SHEET-052, 2026-11-11 사용자 결정 "회수·환불·재출고 일괄 (Recommended)").
--
-- 결정 원문: "선택 건에 회수 확인·환불 완료 확정(건별 순차 결제 취소)·교환 재출고(행별 택배사·송장) 일괄, 확인창에
-- 건수·환불 합계, 무통장·가상계좌는 제외 사유 표시."
--
-- 이 함수는 읽기만 한다. 처리는 건마다 기존 단건 경로(회수 확인 RPC, 환불 접수·완료 확정 액션 → 결제사 취소
-- 오케스트레이터 → finalizer, 배송 건 재출고 service RPC)를 그대로 탄다. 여기서 정하는 것은 확인창에 보일 사실이다.
-- * refundAmount: [환불 완료 확정]이 결제사에 취소를 발행할 금액(환불 원장 금액, 원장이 아직 없으면 결제 금액).
--   확인창의 환불 합계는 서버가 이 값을 더한 것이고, 실행 직전에 건마다 다시 읽어 확인한 금액과 다르면 처리하지 않는다.
-- * refundBlocker: 일괄 환불 완료 확정에서 뺄 사유 코드(없으면 null). 무통장(계좌 송금 절차)·가상계좌(환불계좌 필요)·
--   코페이(취소 API 없음, drain 전용 수동 확인)·결제 없음·회수 미완료·보류·종결 등. 최종 판정은 처리 RPC·
--   오케스트레이터가 다시 한다.
-- * collections: 출고지(배송 건)별 회수 사실. 회수 생략을 결정한 배송 건(waived — 진실원은 결정 표
--   private.claim_collection_waived, 재출고 전에 결정만 한 배송 건 포함)과 반송 주소가 없는 배송 건은 앱이 일괄 회수
--   확인 대상에서 뺀다.
-- 운영자(sales.manage)만 부른다. 결제 증빙 원장(private)의 결제수단은 가상계좌 판정에만 쓰고 그대로 내보내지 않는다.
begin

create function private.order_claim_bulk_context_row(p_claim_id uuid)
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable set search_path='' as $function$
declare c public.order_cancellation_requests;pay record;ref record;virtual_account boolean:=false;complete boolean;blocker text;
begin
 select * into c from public.order_cancellation_requests where id=p_claim_id;
 if not found then return null;end if;
 -- 운영 상세(admin_order_claim_detail)와 같은 결제·환불 행을 고른다.
 select p.id,p.provider::text provider,p.status::text status,p.amount into pay from public.payments p
  where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=c.order_id and p.status<>'failed' order by p.created_at desc,p.id desc limit 1;
 select r.status,r.amount,r.method,r.filed_at,r.completed_at into ref from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id
  where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=c.order_id order by r.created_at desc,r.id desc limit 1;
 if pay.id is not null then
  virtual_account:=exists(select 1 from public.payment_attempts a join private.payment_provider_evidence e on e.payment_attempt_id=a.id
   where a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=c.order_id and (e.payment_method='가상계좌' or e.result_code='DONE_virtual_account'));
 end if;
 complete:=private.claim_collections_complete(c.id);
 blocker:=case
  when c.claim_type='exchange' then 'exchange_has_no_refund'
  when c.stage='on_hold' then 'claim_on_hold'
  when c.stage in ('requested','in_review') then 'claim_not_approved'
  when c.stage in ('rejected','withdrawn') then 'claim_closed'
  when c.stage='completed' then case when ref.completed_at is not null then 'refund_completed' else 'refund_record_only' end
  when c.stage='collecting' or (c.stage='collected' and not complete) then 'claim_collections_incomplete'
  when pay.id is null then 'payment_missing'
  when pay.provider='bank_transfer' then 'bank_transfer'
  when pay.provider='korpay' then 'korpay'
  when virtual_account then 'virtual_account'
  when pay.provider not in ('toss','nicepay') then 'provider_unsupported'
  when ref.method='bank_transfer' then 'refund_method_bank_transfer'
  when ref.completed_at is not null then 'refund_completed'
  when c.stage in ('processing','needs_review') and ref.status is null then 'refund_ledger_missing'
  when c.stage not in ('collected','processing','needs_review') then 'claim_not_refundable'
  else null end;
 return jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'reference',c.reference,'orderId',c.order_id,'claimType',c.claim_type,'stage',c.stage,
  'heldFrom',c.held_from,'collectionPolicy',c.collection_policy,'collectionRequired',c.collection_required,'collectionComplete',complete,
  'collectedAt',c.collected_at,'collectionReceivedOn',c.collection_received_on,
  'collections',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentId',x.shipment_id,'originName',x.origin_name_snapshot,
    'collectedAt',x.collected_at,'receivedOn',x.received_on,
    'waived',private.claim_collection_waived(x.claim_id,x.shipment_id),
    'returnAddressReady',btrim(x.return_address_snapshot)<>'' or exists(select 1 from public.fulfillment_origins o where o.id=x.origin_id and coalesce(btrim(o.return_address),'')<>''))
    order by x.origin_name_snapshot,x.shipment_id) from public.order_claim_collections x where x.claim_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'paymentProvider',pay.provider,'paymentStatus',pay.status,
  'refundMethod',ref.method,'refundFiledAt',ref.filed_at,'refundCompletedAt',ref.completed_at,
  'refundAmount',case when pay.id is null then null else coalesce(ref.amount,pay.amount) end,
  'refundBlocker',blocker);
end $function$
revoke all on function private.order_claim_bulk_context_row(uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
revoke all on function public.admin_order_claim_bulk_context(uuid[]) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_order_claim_bulk_context(uuid[]) to authenticated
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_order_claim_bulk_context(uuid[])'::regprocedure,'sales.manage','read',false)
commit
notify pgrst,'reload schema'

ledger.name: return_fee_deduction_settings
statements:
-- 반품배송비 차감(QNA-033) — 스위치·차감 결정 원장·판정 함수.
--
-- 원래 요청: 서원 회신 E3 "고객 변심은 쇼핑몰에서 택배비 차감 후 환불 진행, 불량의 경우는 물류에서 지급합니다".
-- 2026-11-11 사용자 결정(묶음 8): "차감·부분 취소 모두 (Recommended)" — 단순 변심 반품배송비를 환불금에서 차감하고 결제사
-- 부분 취소로 '결제액 − 차감액'을 돌려준다. ADR-0017의 '전액 환불' 원칙을 반품배송비에 한해 바꾼다(ADR-0031).
--
-- 오케스트레이터 판단(사용자 판단 위임 원칙 ①~④):
--  * 스위치는 DB가 강제하고 기본 꺼짐이다. 켜는 것은 게이트 5개(토스 상점 부분 취소 사용 확인·나이스페이 부분 취소 계약·
--    반품배송비 금액·배송/반품 정책 문서 개정 7일 공지·서원 착불/불량 운임 계약) 뒤의 후속 migration이다
--    (docs/runbooks/return-fee-deduction.md). 꺼져 있으면 판정 함수가 null을 돌려주고 어떤 원장도 바뀌지 않는다.
--  * 차감액 = 반품배송비 정책 금액(편도), 최초 배송비가 0원(무료배송)이면 왕복(편도×2). 환불액을 넘지 않는다 —
--    차감액이 결제액 이상이면 환불액이 0원이 되어 결제사 취소 증거가 없는 '환불'이 생기므로 자동 차감하지 않고 전액 환불한 뒤
--    배송비 청구 원장으로 받게 안내한다(deviation, ADR-0031).
--  * 단순 변심 반품(claim_type='return' and reason_type='change_of_mind')만 차감한다. 하자·오배송(판매자 귀책)·취소·교환은
--    판정 대상이 아니다(판정 함수가 null).
--  * 부분 취소가 안 되는 결제(나이스페이 계약 전·코페이·가상계좌, 토스 isPartialCancelable=false·과세 제외 금액은 결제사
--    조회 때 판정)는 차감하지 않고 전액 환불한 뒤 기존 배송비 청구 원장으로 따로 받는 길을 안내한다. 선물 주문은 결제한 분과
--    요청한 분이 다를 수 있어 자동 차감하지 않는다(배송비 청구 원장이 납부 대상을 고른다).
--  * 같은 요청에 배송비 청구(입금 대기·입금 알림·입금 확인)가 있으면 차감하지 않고, 차감을 결정한 요청에는 새 배송비 청구를
--    만들 수 없다(이중 청구 방지, 다음 migration의 claim_fee_document 치환).
--  * 차감은 환불 접수(filed) 때 한 번 결정되고 그 뒤 바뀌지 않는다(접수 뒤에는 유형·사유 변경이 이미 막혀 있다). 스위치를
--    꺼도 이미 결정한 요청은 그대로 진행한다 — 결제사 부분 취소가 이미 나갔을 수 있어 같은 요청의 금액이 중간에 바뀌면
--    결제사 잔액과 원장이 어긋난다.
begin

-- 1. 스위치(한 행). 켤 때는 편도 금액·근거(정책 문서 개정 공지 등)·켠 시각이 필요하다.
create table private.return_fee_deduction_settings (
  singleton boolean primary key default true check (singleton),
  enabled boolean not null default false,
  one_way_amount integer check (one_way_amount is null or one_way_amount between 1 and 1000000),
  evidence text check (evidence is null or (evidence = btrim(evidence) and char_length(evidence) between 2 and 1000 and evidence !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')),
  enabled_at timestamptz,
  revision integer not null default 1 check (revision >= 1),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  constraint return_fee_deduction_settings_enabled_shape
    check (not enabled or (one_way_amount is not null and evidence is not null and enabled_at is not null))
)
insert into private.return_fee_deduction_settings(singleton) values (true)
alter table private.return_fee_deduction_settings enable row level security
revoke all on table private.return_fee_deduction_settings from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.audit_return_fee_deduction_settings() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create trigger return_fee_deduction_settings_revision before update on private.return_fee_deduction_settings
  for each row execute function private.audit_return_fee_deduction_settings()

create trigger return_fee_deduction_settings_audit after update on private.return_fee_deduction_settings
  for each row execute function private.audit_return_fee_deduction_settings()

create trigger return_fee_deduction_settings_keep before delete on private.return_fee_deduction_settings
  for each row execute function private.audit_return_fee_deduction_settings()

-- 2. 요청별 차감 결정. 환불 접수 때 한 번 적고 금액·근거는 바뀌지 않는다. 상태만 앞으로 간다:
--    planned(결정) → provider_confirmed(결제사 부분 취소를 조회로 확인, 카드) → applied(환불 원장 확정)
--    planned → not_applied(결제사가 부분 취소를 받지 않는 결제라 전액 환불로 돌림, 돈이 움직이기 전).
create table private.claim_refund_deductions (
  claim_id uuid primary key references public.order_cancellation_requests(id) on delete restrict,
  order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id) on delete restrict,
  payment_id uuid not null unique references public.payments(id) on delete restrict,
  provider public.payment_provider not null check (provider in ('toss', 'bank_transfer')),
  payment_amount bigint not null check (payment_amount > 0),
  one_way_amount integer not null check (one_way_amount between 1 and 1000000),
  basis text not null check (basis in ('one_way', 'round_trip')),
  initial_shipping_fee bigint not null check (initial_shipping_fee >= 0),
  deduction_amount bigint not null check (deduction_amount > 0),
  refund_amount bigint not null check (refund_amount > 0),
  settings_revision integer not null check (settings_revision >= 1),
  state text not null default 'planned' check (state in ('planned', 'provider_confirmed', 'applied', 'not_applied')),
  not_applied_reason text check (not_applied_reason is null or not_applied_reason = 'partial_cancel_unavailable'),
  provider_transaction_key text check (provider_transaction_key is null or provider_transaction_key ~ '^[\x21-\x7e]{1,64}$'),
  decided_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  decided_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  provider_confirmed_at timestamptz,
  applied_at timestamptz,
  not_applied_at timestamptz,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  constraint claim_refund_deductions_amounts check (refund_amount = payment_amount - deduction_amount),
  constraint claim_refund_deductions_basis check (deduction_amount = one_way_amount::bigint * case basis when 'round_trip' then 2 else 1 end),
  constraint claim_refund_deductions_not_applied check ((state = 'not_applied') = (not_applied_reason is not null and not_applied_at is not null)),
  constraint claim_refund_deductions_confirmed check (state not in ('provider_confirmed') or provider_confirmed_at is not null),
  constraint claim_refund_deductions_applied check ((state = 'applied') = (applied_at is not null)),
  constraint claim_refund_deductions_card_confirmation check (provider <> 'bank_transfer' or (provider_confirmed_at is null and provider_transaction_key is null and state <> 'not_applied'))
)
create index claim_refund_deductions_order_idx on private.claim_refund_deductions(order_id)
alter table private.claim_refund_deductions enable row level security
revoke all on table private.claim_refund_deductions from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.guard_claim_refund_deduction() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create trigger claim_refund_deductions_guard before update or delete on private.claim_refund_deductions
  for each row execute function private.guard_claim_refund_deduction()
revoke all on function private.return_fee_deduction_plan(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.record_return_fee_deduction(uuid, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 5. 결제 한 건의 '확정 환불액'을 정하는 값들. 결정이 없으면 차감 0 — 지금과 같다.
--    active: 결정 뒤 아직 전액 환불로 돌리지 않은 차감(planned·provider_confirmed·applied).
create function private.claim_refund_active_deduction(p_payment_id uuid) returns bigint
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select d.deduction_amount from private.claim_refund_deductions d
    where d.payment_id = p_payment_id and d.state in ('planned', 'provider_confirmed', 'applied')), 0)::bigint;
$$
revoke all on function private.claim_refund_active_deduction(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.claim_refund_settled_amount(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.claim_refund_deduction_view(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 문서에 덧붙일 필드. 보일 것이 없으면 빈 객체라 스위치가 꺼진 동안 문서 모양이 한 글자도 바뀌지 않는다.
create function private.claim_refund_deduction_field(p_claim_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select case when view is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('refundDeduction', view) end
  from (select private.claim_refund_deduction_view(p_claim_id) as view) source;
$$
revoke all on function private.claim_refund_deduction_field(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 감사 기록에 덧붙일 필드. 결정이 없으면 빈 객체.
create function private.claim_refund_deduction_audit(p_claim_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select jsonb_build_object('refundDeduction', jsonb_build_object('state', d.state,
      'paymentAmount', d.payment_amount, 'deductionAmount', d.deduction_amount,
      'refundAmount', case when d.state = 'not_applied' then d.payment_amount else d.refund_amount end,
      'basis', d.basis, 'reason', d.not_applied_reason))
    from private.claim_refund_deductions d where d.claim_id = p_claim_id), '{}'::jsonb);
$$
revoke all on function private.claim_refund_deduction_audit(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create function private.format_krw(p_amount bigint) returns text
language sql immutable set search_path = '' as $$
  select to_char(p_amount, 'FM999,999,999,990') || '원';
$$
revoke all on function private.format_krw(bigint) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.claim_refund_deduction_notice(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 7. 공개 정책 읽기(구매자 반품 안내·상품 상세가 쓴다). 꺼져 있으면 금액을 싣지 않는다.
create function public.get_return_fee_deduction_policy() returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select case when s.enabled
    then jsonb_build_object('enabled', true, 'oneWayAmount', s.one_way_amount)
    else jsonb_build_object('enabled', false, 'oneWayAmount', null) end
  from private.return_fee_deduction_settings s where s.singleton;
$$
revoke all on function public.get_return_fee_deduction_policy() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.get_return_fee_deduction_policy() to anon, authenticated

-- 8. 구매자 주문 상세의 차감 표시. 본인 주문(결제한 분)의 결정만 돌려준다. 결정이 없으면 null.
create function public.get_my_order_claim_refund_deduction(p_order_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select jsonb_build_object('claimId', d.claim_id, 'state', d.state,
    'paymentAmount', d.payment_amount, 'deductionAmount', d.deduction_amount,
    'refundAmount', case when d.state = 'not_applied' then d.payment_amount else d.refund_amount end,
    'basis', d.basis, 'oneWayAmount', d.one_way_amount, 'reason', d.not_applied_reason, 'provider', d.provider)
  from private.claim_refund_deductions d
  join public.orders o on o.id = d.order_id
  where d.order_id = p_order_id and auth.uid() is not null and o.user_id = auth.uid()
  order by d.decided_at desc limit 1;
$$
revoke all on function public.get_my_order_claim_refund_deduction(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.get_my_order_claim_refund_deduction(uuid) to authenticated
commit
notify pgrst, 'reload schema'

ledger.name: return_fee_deduction_refund_ledger
statements:
-- 반품배송비 차감(QNA-033, ADR-0031) — 환불 원장·finalizer를 '원결제 전액'에서 '확정 환불액'으로.
--
-- 앞 migration(20261112223000)의 차감 결정을 환불 경로에 잇는다. 결정이 없으면(스위치가 꺼져 있었거나 단순 변심 반품이
-- 아니면) 모든 치환은 지금과 같은 값을 만든다 — 차감 0, 덧붙일 필드 '{}', 알림 문구 null → 기존 문구.
--
--  * 환불 접수(admin_record_order_claim_refund filed, 입고완료 → 처리중)가 차감을 결정하고 환불 원장 금액을 '결제액 − 차감액'으로 연다.
--  * 카드(토스): 오케스트레이터가 결정을 읽어 결제사 부분 취소를 발행하고, 취소 뒤 조회로 잔액을 확인하면
--    service_record_order_claim_partial_refund로 확인을 적는다(provider_confirmed). 결제사가 부분 취소를 받지 않는 결제면
--    service_fallback_order_claim_refund_deduction으로 전액 환불로 돌린 뒤(not_applied) 지금처럼 전액 취소한다.
--    finalizer는 부분 취소 확인 없이 차감이 남아 있으면 확정하지 않는다(refund_deduction_evidence_required).
--  * 무통장: 송금액(bank_transfer_claim_refunds.amount)이 '결제액 − 차감액'이다. 송금 대기 목록·송금 엑셀은 이 금액을 읽는다.
--  * 같은 요청에 차감을 결정하면 배송비 청구를 새로 만들 수 없다(이중 청구 방지).
begin

-- 접수 전 단계에서 보이는 예상 차감(일괄 확인창의 환불 금액). 접수 뒤에는 환불 원장 금액이 진실원이다.
create function private.claim_refund_preview_deduction(p_claim_id uuid, p_payment_id uuid) returns bigint
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select (view->>'deductionAmount')::bigint
    from (select private.claim_refund_deduction_view(p_claim_id) as view) source
    where (view->>'applicable')::boolean and view->>'paymentId' = p_payment_id::text), 0)::bigint;
$$
revoke all on function private.claim_refund_preview_deduction(uuid, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 2. 카드 finalizer: 환불 원장 금액은 확정 환불액이다. 부분 취소 확인이 없는 차감이 남아 있으면 확정하지 않는다.
select private.t12a_patch_function('public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(uuid,text,text[])'::regprocedure, array[
$a$    payment.id,
    payment.amount,
    p_reason,
    'done'$a$,
$a$    payment.id,
    -- 확정 환불액(ADR-0031): 차감 결정이 없거나 전액 환불로 돌렸으면 결제액, 결제사 부분 취소를 확인했으면 '결제액 − 차감액'.
    private.claim_refund_settled_amount(payment.id),
    p_reason,
    'done'$a$,
$a$  update public.payments as payment
  set status = 'refunded'$a$,
$a$  update private.claim_refund_deductions as deduction
  set state = 'applied', applied_at = coalesce(deduction.applied_at, clock_timestamp())
  where deduction.order_id = p_order_id
    and deduction.state = 'provider_confirmed';

  update public.payments as payment
  set status = 'refunded'$a$
])

-- 4. 무통장 finalizer: 송금액 = 결제액 − 차감액. 송금 완료 증빙으로 끝날 때 차감 결정을 확정한다.
select private.t12a_patch_function('private.finalize_bank_transfer_claim_refund(uuid,text)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$purchase.total<>lifecycle.amount then$a$,
$a$purchase.total-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(lifecycle.payment_id)<>lifecycle.amount then$a$,
$a$or payment.amount<>lifecycle.amount or payment.status not in('paid','refunded') then$a$,
$a$or payment.amount-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id)<>lifecycle.amount or payment.status not in('paid','refunded') then$a$,
$a$values(payment.id,payment.amount,p_reason,case when lifecycle.state='completed'$a$,
$a$values(payment.id,lifecycle.amount,p_reason,case when lifecycle.state='completed'$a$,
$a$ if lifecycle.state='completed' then update public.payments set status='refunded' where id=payment.id and status<>'refunded';end if;$a$,
$a$ if lifecycle.state='completed' then update private.claim_refund_deductions set state='applied',applied_at=coalesce(applied_at,clock_timestamp())
  where payment_id=payment.id and state='planned';end if;
 if lifecycle.state='completed' then update public.payments set status='refunded' where id=payment.id and status<>'refunded';end if;$a$
])

-- 송금 대기 증빙 판정(주문 취소 전이 가드가 읽는다)도 송금액 기준이다.
select private.t12a_patch_function('private.bank_transfer_refund_pending_evidence_valid(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$and payment.amount=lifecycle.amount and purchase.total=lifecycle.amount and lifecycle.amount>0$a$,
$a$and payment.amount-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id)=lifecycle.amount
   and purchase.total-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id)=lifecycle.amount and lifecycle.amount>0$a$
])

select private.t12a_patch_function('private.bank_transfer_refund_blocker(public.order_cancellation_requests,public.orders,text)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$or refund.amount<>payment.amount$a$,
$a$or refund.amount<>payment.amount-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id)$a$,
$a$or lifecycle.amount<>payment.amount$a$,
$a$or lifecycle.amount<>payment.amount-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id)$a$
])

select private.t12a_patch_function('public.admin_record_bank_transfer_refund(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,integer,integer,timestamp with time zone,text,text,boolean,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$values(claim.id,purchase.id,payment.id,purchase.user_id,payment.amount,'awaiting_transfer',$a$,
$a$values(claim.id,purchase.id,payment.id,purchase.user_id,payment.amount-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id),'awaiting_transfer',$a$,
$a$'revision',p_expected_revision,'resultRevision',result_revision));$a$,
$a$'revision',p_expected_revision,'resultRevision',result_revision)||private.claim_refund_deduction_audit(claim.id));$a$
])

select private.t12a_patch_function('public.admin_bank_transfer_refund_context(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$'gift',exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents where order_id=purchase.id));$a$,
$a$'gift',exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents where order_id=purchase.id))||private.claim_refund_deduction_field(claim.id);$a$
])

-- 5. 일괄 확인창(T11b): 환불 금액은 차감 뒤 금액이다(접수 전에는 판정, 접수 뒤에는 환불 원장).
select private.t12a_patch_function('private.order_claim_bulk_context_row(uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$'refundAmount',case when pay.id is null then null else coalesce(ref.amount,pay.amount) end,$a$,
$a$'refundAmount',case when pay.id is null then null else coalesce(ref.amount,pay.amount-private.claim_refund_preview_deduction(c.id,pay.id)) end,$a$,
$a$'refundBlocker',blocker);$a$,
$a$'refundBlocker',blocker)||private.claim_refund_deduction_field(c.id);$a$
])

-- 6. 운영 상세: 환불 단계가 차감·환불액을 보인다(없으면 필드를 싣지 않는다).
select private.t12a_patch_function('public.admin_order_claim_detail(uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$  return result || jsonb_build_object('sellerIntake', private.seller_claim_intake_json(p_claim_id),'gift',private.gift_admin_claim_party(p_claim_id));$a$,
$a$  -- 반품배송비 차감(QNA-033): 결정 또는 접수 전 판정. 스위치가 꺼져 있고 결정이 없으면 덧붙이지 않는다.
  result := result || private.claim_refund_deduction_field(p_claim_id);
  return result || jsonb_build_object('sellerIntake', private.seller_claim_intake_json(p_claim_id),'gift',private.gift_admin_claim_party(p_claim_id));$a$
])

-- 7. 배송비 청구: 차감을 결정한 요청에는 새 청구를 만들 수 없다(같은 반품배송비를 두 번 받지 않는다).
select private.t12a_patch_function('private.claim_fee_document(uuid,uuid,boolean)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$   and not exists(select 1 from private.claim_fee_invoices where claim_id=c.id and state in('unpaid','reported','paid')),$a$,
$a$   and not exists(select 1 from private.claim_fee_invoices where claim_id=c.id and state in('unpaid','reported','paid'))
   and not exists(select 1 from private.claim_refund_deductions d where d.claim_id=c.id and d.state in('planned','provider_confirmed','applied')),$a$
])

-- 8. 오케스트레이터(service_role) 경로.
-- 8-1. 요청의 차감 결정(카드 부분 취소 대상). 없으면 null.
create function public.service_order_claim_refund_deduction(p_request_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select jsonb_build_object('claimId', d.claim_id, 'paymentId', d.payment_id, 'provider', d.provider, 'state', d.state,
    'paymentAmount', d.payment_amount, 'deductionAmount', d.deduction_amount, 'refundAmount', d.refund_amount)
  from private.claim_refund_deductions d where d.claim_id = p_request_id;
$$
revoke all on function public.service_order_claim_refund_deduction(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.service_order_claim_refund_deduction(uuid) to service_role
revoke all on function public.service_record_order_claim_partial_refund(uuid, uuid, bigint, text, text, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.service_record_order_claim_partial_refund(uuid, uuid, bigint, text, text, uuid) to service_role
revoke all on function public.service_fallback_order_claim_refund_deduction(uuid, uuid, uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.service_fallback_order_claim_refund_deduction(uuid, uuid, uuid) to service_role
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.service_record_order_claim_partial_refund(uuid,uuid,bigint,text,text,uuid)'::regprocedure, 'sales.manage', 'service_finish', false)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.service_fallback_order_claim_refund_deduction(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure, 'sales.manage', 'service_finish', false)

-- 재정의한 함수의 등록된 계약을 새 본문·ACL로 다시 적는다(분류는 기존 행 그대로).
do $$declare fn regprocedure; contract record; begin
  foreach fn in array array[
    'public.admin_record_order_claim_refund(uuid,text,text,text)'::regprocedure,
    'public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(uuid,text,text[])'::regprocedure,
    'public.complete_order_cancellation_request(uuid,text[],uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'private.finalize_bank_transfer_claim_refund(uuid,text)'::regprocedure,
    'private.bank_transfer_refund_blocker(public.order_cancellation_requests,public.orders,text)'::regprocedure,
    'private.bank_transfer_refund_pending_evidence_valid(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'public.admin_record_bank_transfer_refund(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,integer,integer,timestamp with time zone,text,text,boolean,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'public.admin_bank_transfer_refund_context(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'private.order_claim_bulk_context_row(uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'public.admin_order_claim_detail(uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'private.claim_fee_document(uuid,uuid,boolean)'::regprocedure] loop
    select * into contract from private.operator_rpc_contracts r where r.signature::regprocedure = fn;
    if found then perform private.register_operator_rpc_contract(fn, contract.capability, contract.guard_kind, contract.legacy_admin_only);
    elsif exists(select 1 from private.operator_internal_contracts r where r.signature::regprocedure = fn) then
      perform private.register_operator_internal_contract(fn);
    end if;
  end loop;
end $$
drop function private.t12a_patch_function(regprocedure, text[])
commit
notify pgrst, 'reload schema'

ledger.name: order_partial_cancellation
statements:
-- 재고 부족 품목·수량 부분 취소(QNA-020, ADR-0032) — 스위치·원장·판정·운영자 RPC·결제사 확인 기록.
--
-- 원래 요청: 서원 회신 C7 "재고가 부족한 제품은 고객의견을 물어본 후 결정사항을 말씀 주시면 그대로 진행합니다",
-- E1 "품절의 경우 해당 고객정보를 전달드립니다".
-- 2026-11-11 사용자 결정(묶음 8): "차감·부분 취소 모두 (Recommended)" — 재고 부족 시 품목·수량 부분 취소 뒤 나머지 출고.
--
-- 오케스트레이터 판단(판단 위임 원칙 ① 원문 ② 업계 ③ 좁히지 않음 ④ 돈·재고는 안전한 쪽 + 스위치·감사):
--  * 스위치는 DB가 강제하고 기본 꺼짐이다. T12a 스위치 행(private.return_fee_deduction_settings)의 별도 칸
--    (partial_cancel_enabled)이다 — 결제사 부분 취소 기능의 켬 여부를 한 감사 행에 모으되, 게이트가 다르므로(반품배송비 금액·
--    서원 운임 계약은 필요 없고 서원 품절 통보 경로 E1이 필요) 따로 켠다. 꺼져 있으면 어떤 원장도 바뀌지 않고 판정은 'partial_cancel_disabled'.
--  * 운영자만 연다(고객 직접 신청 없음 — 원문 "결정사항을 말씀 주시면 그대로 진행"). 고객 결정 기록은 필수다.
--  * 발송 전 주문(결제완료·발주확인, 모든 배송 건 발송 전)만. 환불액 = 고른 품목·수량의 불변 배분액(복수구매 할인·쿠폰·적립금
--    배분 반영, 누적 비례 배분이라 같은 품목을 여러 번 나눠 취소해도 합이 배분액과 같다) + 남은 품목이 없어진 배송 건의 선결제
--    배송비. 남은 주문의 쿠폰 조건 재판정·회수는 하지 않는다. 그 품목에 배분된 적립금은 적립금으로 되돌린다(고객 불리 없음).
--  * 토스 카드: 시작(processing) → 서버가 결제사 부분 취소(취소마다 다른 멱등키, 잔액 기대값 검증) → 확인되면 그때 재고 복원·
--    배송 건 조정·카드팩 회수를 한 트랜잭션에서 적용(completed). 결제사가 부분 취소를 받지 않으면(isPartialCancelable=false 등)
--    돈이 움직이지 않았으므로 품목 부분 취소 자체를 진행하지 않는다(rejected — 전액 환불로 돌리지 않는다). 처리 중에는 그 주문의
--    출고지시·발송·다른 클레임을 막는다(결제사 취소와 출고가 엇갈리지 않게).
--  * 무통장: 결제사가 없으므로 시작 때 바로 적용하고 송금 대기(awaiting_transfer, 송금액 = 배분액)로 둔다. 운영자가 송금 증빙을
--    적으면 completed. 송금 대기·증빙 모델은 T03·ADR-0010과 같다(비종결 상태 → 불변 송금 증빙으로 종결).
--  * 부분 취소를 받지 않는 결제(나이스페이 계약 전·코페이·토스 가상계좌·정기배송 바인딩)와 버전 1 주문, 예약 판매·주문제작·
--    디지털·통합 이력 품목은 판정 단계에서 막고 이유를 보인다('재고 부족' 부분 취소의 대상이 아니거나 재고 복원 단위가 품목 전체).
--  * 선물 주문도 연다 — 환불은 결제자에게(결제사 취소는 원결제수단, 무통장은 결제자 계좌), 결정 기록은 결제자의 결정이다.
--  * 환불액 0원(전액 할인·적립금 품목)은 결제사를 부르지 않고 바로 적용·완료한다(적립금 몫만 되돌림). 남는 잔액이 0원이 되는
--    부분 취소는 남은 잔액 전부를 결제사 부분 취소로 보낸다(결제 상태는 그대로 두고 부분 취소 누적으로 표현).
--  * 합포장 팩 멤버 배송 건을 닫게 되면 먼저 합포장을 해제하게 한다(shipment_packed, 팩을 암묵적으로 바꾸지 않음).
--  * 결제확인필요(needs_review)는 결제 담당(레거시 admin + 세션)이 사유와 함께 해소한다: 결제사 조회로 돈이 안 움직였음을
--    확인하면 진행하지 않음, 이미 취소됐으면 그 거래 키로 적용을 강제(재고 승계가 바뀌었으면 승계를 따라 복원).
begin

-- 1. 스위치(T12a 행의 별도 칸). 켤 때는 근거와 켠 시각이 필요하다. 행의 감사·리비전 트리거가 이 칸 변경도 남긴다.
alter table private.return_fee_deduction_settings
  add column partial_cancel_enabled boolean not null default false,
  add column partial_cancel_evidence text check (partial_cancel_evidence is null or (partial_cancel_evidence = btrim(partial_cancel_evidence)
    and char_length(partial_cancel_evidence) between 2 and 1000 and partial_cancel_evidence !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')),
  add column partial_cancel_enabled_at timestamptz,
  add constraint return_fee_deduction_settings_partial_cancel_shape
    check (not partial_cancel_enabled or (partial_cancel_evidence is not null and partial_cancel_enabled_at is not null))

create function private.order_partial_cancel_enabled() returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select s.partial_cancel_enabled from private.return_fee_deduction_settings s where s.singleton), false);
$$
revoke all on function private.order_partial_cancel_enabled() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 2. 원장. 머리(한 번의 부분 취소) · 품목 줄 · 닫힌 배송 건 · 무통장 환불계좌.
create table private.order_partial_cancellations (
  id uuid primary key default extensions.gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id uuid not null references public.orders(id) on delete restrict,
  payment_id uuid not null references public.payments(id) on delete restrict,
  provider public.payment_provider not null check (provider in ('toss', 'bank_transfer')),
  sequence integer not null check (sequence >= 1),
  reason_code text not null check (reason_code = 'out_of_stock'),
  customer_decision text not null check (customer_decision = btrim(customer_decision) and char_length(customer_decision) between 2 and 500
    and translate(customer_decision, E'\n\r\t', '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'),
  note text check (note is null or (note = btrim(note) and char_length(note) between 1 and 500 and translate(note, E'\n\r\t', '') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')),
  warehouse_stop_confirmed boolean not null,
  payment_amount bigint not null check (payment_amount > 0),
  balance_before bigint not null check (balance_before >= 0 and balance_before <= payment_amount),
  goods_refund_amount bigint not null check (goods_refund_amount >= 0),
  shipping_refund_amount bigint not null check (shipping_refund_amount >= 0),
  refund_amount bigint not null check (refund_amount >= 0),
  store_credit_restore_amount bigint not null default 0 check (store_credit_restore_amount >= 0),
  state text not null check (state in ('processing', 'needs_review', 'rejected', 'completed', 'awaiting_transfer')),
  last_error_code text check (last_error_code is null or last_error_code ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$'),
  provider_transaction_key text check (provider_transaction_key is null or provider_transaction_key ~ '^[\x21-\x7e]{1,64}$'),
  provider_confirmed_at timestamptz,
  operation_id uuid not null unique,
  created_by uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  applied_at timestamptz,
  completed_at timestamptz,
  rejected_at timestamptz,
  -- 무통장: 환불계좌를 받아 송금 대기로 접수한 시각·운영자(T03 환불 접수와 같은 단계, 송금 대기 목록·엑셀이 읽는다).
  filed_at timestamptz,
  filed_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  -- 결제확인필요 해소(결제 담당 판단). 사유·결과는 감사 기록에도 남는다.
  resolved_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  resolved_at timestamptz,
  resolution text check (resolution is null or resolution in ('not_moved', 'already_canceled')),
  resolution_reason text check (resolution_reason is null or (resolution_reason = btrim(resolution_reason) and char_length(resolution_reason) between 5 and 500)),
  transfer_operation_id uuid unique,
  transferred_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete restrict,
  transferred_at timestamptz,
  transfer_evidence text check (transfer_evidence is null or (transfer_evidence = btrim(transfer_evidence) and char_length(transfer_evidence) between 2 and 300)),
  transfer_note text check (transfer_note is null or (transfer_note = btrim(transfer_note) and char_length(transfer_note) between 2 and 300)),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  unique (order_id, sequence),
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_amounts check (refund_amount = goods_refund_amount + shipping_refund_amount and refund_amount <= balance_before),
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_resolution check ((resolution is null) = (resolved_at is null and resolved_by is null and resolution_reason is null)),
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_filed check ((provider = 'bank_transfer' and refund_amount > 0) = (filed_at is not null and filed_by is not null)),
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_applied check ((state in ('completed', 'awaiting_transfer')) = (applied_at is not null)),
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_completed check ((state = 'completed') = (completed_at is not null)),
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_rejected check ((state = 'rejected') = (rejected_at is not null)),
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_provider_state check (
    provider = 'toss' and state <> 'awaiting_transfer' and transfer_operation_id is null
      and (state <> 'completed' or refund_amount = 0 or (provider_confirmed_at is not null and provider_transaction_key is not null))
    -- 무통장은 시작 트랜잭션 안에서 processing으로 넣고 같은 트랜잭션에서 바로 적용해 송금 대기로 넘긴다(실패하면 함께 롤백).
    or provider = 'bank_transfer' and state in ('processing', 'awaiting_transfer', 'completed') and provider_confirmed_at is null and provider_transaction_key is null),
  -- 송금 증빙은 돈을 보낸 무통장 완료에만 있다(0원 환불은 송금 없이 바로 완료).
  constraint order_partial_cancellations_transfer check (
    (provider = 'bank_transfer' and state = 'completed' and refund_amount > 0) = (transfer_operation_id is not null and transferred_by is not null
      and transferred_at is not null and transfer_evidence is not null and transfer_note is not null))
)

-- 한 주문에 결제사 확인을 기다리는 부분 취소는 하나뿐이다(잔액 기대값이 서로 엇갈리지 않게).
create unique index order_partial_cancellations_in_flight on private.order_partial_cancellations(order_id) where state in ('processing', 'needs_review')
create index order_partial_cancellations_payment on private.order_partial_cancellations(payment_id)
create index order_partial_cancellations_transfer_queue on private.order_partial_cancellations(created_at, id) where state = 'awaiting_transfer'
alter table private.order_partial_cancellations enable row level security
revoke all on table private.order_partial_cancellations from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create table private.order_partial_cancellation_items (
  partial_cancellation_id uuid not null references private.order_partial_cancellations(id) on delete restrict,
  order_id uuid not null,
  order_item_id uuid not null,
  shipment_id uuid not null references public.order_shipments(id) on delete restrict,
  qty integer not null check (qty > 0),
  canceled_qty_before integer not null check (canceled_qty_before >= 0),
  gross_amount bigint not null check (gross_amount >= 0),
  volume_discount bigint not null check (volume_discount >= 0),
  coupon_discount bigint not null check (coupon_discount >= 0),
  store_credit_discount bigint not null check (store_credit_discount >= 0),
  goods_refund_amount bigint not null check (goods_refund_amount >= 0),
  primary key (partial_cancellation_id, order_item_id),
  foreign key (order_id, order_item_id) references public.order_items(order_id, id) on delete restrict
)
create index order_partial_cancellation_items_item on private.order_partial_cancellation_items(order_item_id)
alter table private.order_partial_cancellation_items enable row level security
revoke all on table private.order_partial_cancellation_items from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create table private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments (
  partial_cancellation_id uuid not null references private.order_partial_cancellations(id) on delete restrict,
  order_id uuid not null,
  shipment_id uuid not null unique,
  shipping_fee_refund bigint not null check (shipping_fee_refund >= 0),
  primary key (partial_cancellation_id, shipment_id),
  foreign key (order_id, shipment_id) references public.order_shipments(order_id, id) on delete restrict
)
alter table private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments enable row level security
revoke all on table private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 무통장 환불계좌(운영자가 고객 결정과 함께 받은 계좌). 원문은 송금 완료 30일 뒤 지운다(클레임 환불계좌와 같은 보관 기간).
create table private.order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts (
  partial_cancellation_id uuid primary key references private.order_partial_cancellations(id) on delete restrict,
  bank_name text check (bank_name is null or (btrim(bank_name) = bank_name and char_length(bank_name) between 1 and 40)),
  account_number text check (account_number is null or account_number ~ '^[0-9-]{8,30}$'),
  account_holder text check (account_holder is null or (btrim(account_holder) = account_holder and char_length(account_holder) between 1 and 40)),
  masked_account text not null,
  masked_holder text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  purge_after timestamptz,
  purged_at timestamptz,
  constraint order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts_purged check (purged_at is null or (bank_name is null and account_number is null and account_holder is null))
)
alter table private.order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts enable row level security
revoke all on table private.order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 금액·품목·근거는 바뀌지 않고 상태는 정해진 방향으로만 간다. 행은 지우지 못한다.
create function private.guard_order_partial_cancellation() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then raise check_violation using message = 'partial_cancellation_immutable'; end if;
  if (new.id, new.order_id, new.payment_id, new.provider, new.sequence, new.reason_code, new.customer_decision, new.note,
      new.warehouse_stop_confirmed, new.payment_amount, new.balance_before, new.goods_refund_amount, new.shipping_refund_amount,
      new.refund_amount, new.store_credit_restore_amount, new.operation_id, new.created_by, new.created_at)
    is distinct from
     (old.id, old.order_id, old.payment_id, old.provider, old.sequence, old.reason_code, old.customer_decision, old.note,
      old.warehouse_stop_confirmed, old.payment_amount, old.balance_before, old.goods_refund_amount, old.shipping_refund_amount,
      old.refund_amount, old.store_credit_restore_amount, old.operation_id, old.created_by, old.created_at)
    or (old.applied_at is not null and new.applied_at is distinct from old.applied_at)
    or not (old.state = new.state
      or old.state = 'processing' and new.state in ('needs_review', 'rejected', 'completed')
      or old.state = 'processing' and old.provider = 'bank_transfer' and new.state = 'awaiting_transfer'
      or old.state = 'needs_review' and new.state in ('processing', 'rejected', 'completed')
      or old.state = 'awaiting_transfer' and new.state = 'completed')
    or old.state in ('rejected', 'completed') and new is distinct from old
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'partial_cancellation_immutable';
  end if;
  new.updated_at := clock_timestamp();
  return new;
end $$
revoke all on function private.guard_order_partial_cancellation() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create trigger order_partial_cancellations_guard before update or delete on private.order_partial_cancellations
  for each row execute function private.guard_order_partial_cancellation()

create function private.guard_order_partial_cancellation_children() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  raise check_violation using message = 'partial_cancellation_immutable';
end $$
revoke all on function private.guard_order_partial_cancellation_children() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create trigger order_partial_cancellation_items_guard before update or delete on private.order_partial_cancellation_items
  for each row execute function private.guard_order_partial_cancellation_children()

create trigger order_partial_cancellation_shipments_guard before update or delete on private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments
  for each row execute function private.guard_order_partial_cancellation_children()

-- 3. 읽기 도우미. '적용됨' = 재고·배송 건·환불 의무에 반영됨(완료 또는 송금 대기). 부분 취소가 없으면 모두 0·false — 지금과 같다.
create function private.order_item_partially_canceled_qty(p_order_item_id uuid) returns integer
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select sum(line.qty) from private.order_partial_cancellation_items line
    join private.order_partial_cancellations head on head.id = line.partial_cancellation_id
    where line.order_item_id = p_order_item_id and head.applied_at is not null), 0)::integer;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_item_partially_canceled_qty(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create function private.order_item_active_qty(p_order_item_id uuid) returns integer
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select (item.qty - private.order_item_partially_canceled_qty(item.id))::integer from public.order_items item where item.id = p_order_item_id;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_item_active_qty(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 적용된 부분 취소로 그 품목에서 빠진 금액(누적). 출고 파일·매출 보고가 남은 금액을 계산할 때 뺀다.
create function private.order_item_partial_cancel_totals(p_order_item_id uuid,
  out qty integer, out gross_amount bigint, out volume_discount bigint, out coupon_discount bigint,
  out store_credit_discount bigint, out paid_amount bigint)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce(sum(line.qty), 0)::integer, coalesce(sum(line.gross_amount), 0)::bigint, coalesce(sum(line.volume_discount), 0)::bigint,
    coalesce(sum(line.coupon_discount), 0)::bigint, coalesce(sum(line.store_credit_discount), 0)::bigint,
    coalesce(sum(line.goods_refund_amount), 0)::bigint
  from private.order_partial_cancellation_items line
  join private.order_partial_cancellations head on head.id = line.partial_cancellation_id
  where line.order_item_id = p_order_item_id and head.applied_at is not null;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_item_partial_cancel_totals(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 결제 한 건에서 부분 취소로 이미 돌려줬거나(완료) 돌려줄 의무가 확정된(송금 대기) 금액. 뒤의 전액 취소·반품은 남은 잔액만 돌려준다.
create function private.payment_partial_refunded_amount(p_payment_id uuid) returns bigint
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select sum(head.refund_amount) from private.order_partial_cancellations head
    where head.payment_id = p_payment_id and head.applied_at is not null), 0)::bigint;
$$
revoke all on function private.payment_partial_refunded_amount(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create function private.order_partial_refunded_amount(p_order_id uuid) returns bigint
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select sum(head.refund_amount) from private.order_partial_cancellations head
    where head.order_id = p_order_id and head.applied_at is not null), 0)::bigint;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_partial_refunded_amount(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 굿즈 몫(배송비 제외)만. 적립 기준액(결제액 − 배송비)에서 뺀다.
create function private.order_partial_canceled_goods_amount(p_order_id uuid) returns bigint
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select sum(head.goods_refund_amount) from private.order_partial_cancellations head
    where head.order_id = p_order_id and head.applied_at is not null), 0)::bigint;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_partial_canceled_goods_amount(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create function private.shipment_closed_by_partial_cancel(p_shipment_id uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select exists(select 1 from private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments closed
    join private.order_partial_cancellations head on head.id = closed.partial_cancellation_id
    where closed.shipment_id = p_shipment_id and head.applied_at is not null);
$$
revoke all on function private.shipment_closed_by_partial_cancel(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 결제사 확인을 기다리는 부분 취소. 이 동안 그 주문의 출고지시·발송·다른 클레임을 막는다.
create function private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(p_order_id uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select exists(select 1 from private.order_partial_cancellations head
    where head.order_id = p_order_id and head.state in ('processing', 'needs_review'));
$$
revoke all on function private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 4. 판정. 주문 단위 막힘 이유(빈 배열이면 열 수 있다)와 품목 단위 막힘 이유.
create function private.order_partial_cancellation_payment(p_order_id uuid) returns public.payments
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select p.* from public.payments p where p.purpose = 'order' and p.ref_id = p_order_id and p.status <> 'failed'
  order by p.created_at desc, p.id desc limit 1;
$$

revoke all on function private.order_partial_cancellation_item_blocker(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 누적 비례 배분: 품목 수량 Q 중 c개가 취소됐을 때까지 빠진 몫. c = Q면 정확히 전부다(나눠 취소해도 합이 맞다).
create function private.partial_cancel_prorate(p_amount bigint, p_canceled integer, p_qty integer) returns bigint
language sql immutable set search_path = '' as $$
  select case when p_canceled >= p_qty then p_amount
    else floor(p_amount::numeric * p_canceled::numeric / p_qty::numeric)::bigint end;
$$
revoke all on function private.partial_cancel_prorate(bigint, integer, integer) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create function private.partial_cancellation_items_label(p_id uuid) returns text
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select string_agg(format('%s%s %s개', item.good_name_snapshot,
      case when item.option_sale_mode_snapshot = 'random' or nullif(item.variant_name_snapshot, '') is null then ''
        else ' (' || item.variant_name_snapshot || ')' end, line.qty), ', ' order by item.good_name_snapshot, item.id)
  from private.order_partial_cancellation_items line join public.order_items item on item.id = line.order_item_id

-- 9. 화면이 읽는 모양.
-- p_level: customer(구매자) < read(주문 조회 sales.read: 고객 결정 요약까지) < manage(sales.manage: 운영 메모·처리자·상태 코드·배송 건)
--   < legacy(레거시 관리자 + sales.manage: 송금 증빙·메모·계좌(마스킹)·해소 사유). 높은 단계는 낮은 단계를 모두 싣는다.
create function private.order_partial_cancellation_json(p_id uuid, p_level text) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select jsonb_build_object('id', head.id, 'sequence', head.sequence, 'state', head.state, 'provider', head.provider,
    'refundAmount', head.refund_amount, 'goodsRefundAmount', head.goods_refund_amount, 'shippingRefundAmount', head.shipping_refund_amount,
    'storeCreditRestoreAmount', head.store_credit_restore_amount, 'createdAt', head.created_at, 'appliedAt', head.applied_at,
    'completedAt', head.completed_at, 'transferredAt', head.transferred_at,
    'items', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId', line.order_item_id, 'goodName', item.good_name_snapshot,
        'variantName', case when p_level in ('customer', 'read') and item.option_sale_mode_snapshot = 'random' then null else item.variant_name_snapshot end,
        'qty', line.qty, 'goodsRefundAmount', line.goods_refund_amount) order by item.good_name_snapshot, item.id)
      from private.order_partial_cancellation_items line join public.order_items item on item.id = line.order_item_id
      where line.partial_cancellation_id = head.id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'closedShipmentCount', (select count(*) from private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments c where c.partial_cancellation_id = head.id))
  || case when p_level in ('read', 'manage', 'legacy') then jsonb_build_object('customerDecision', head.customer_decision) else '{}'::jsonb end
  || case when p_level in ('manage', 'legacy') then jsonb_build_object('note', head.note,
      'warehouseStopConfirmed', head.warehouse_stop_confirmed, 'lastErrorCode', head.last_error_code, 'balanceBefore', head.balance_before,
      'paymentAmount', head.payment_amount, 'createdBy', (select nickname from public.profiles where id = head.created_by),
      'filedAt', head.filed_at, 'resolution', head.resolution, 'resolvedAt', head.resolved_at,
      'closedShipments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentId', s.id, 'shipmentNumber', s.shipment_number,
          'originName', s.origin_name_snapshot, 'shippingFeeRefund', c.shipping_fee_refund) order by s.shipment_number)
        from private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments c join public.order_shipments s on s.id = c.shipment_id
        where c.partial_cancellation_id = head.id), '[]'::jsonb)) else '{}'::jsonb end
  || case when p_level = 'legacy' then jsonb_build_object('transferEvidence', head.transfer_evidence, 'transferNote', head.transfer_note,
      'resolutionReason', head.resolution_reason,
      'refundAccount', (select jsonb_build_object('maskedAccount', a.masked_account, 'maskedHolder', a.masked_holder, 'purged', a.purged_at is not null)
        from private.order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts a where a.partial_cancellation_id = head.id)) else '{}'::jsonb end
  from private.order_partial_cancellations head where head.id = p_id;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_partial_cancellation_json(uuid, text) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 결제 한 건의 부분 취소 누계(전액 취소·반품 오케스트레이터가 남은 잔액을 계산할 때 읽는다). 없으면 빈 배열.

-- 11-4. 보고·조회가 덧붙이는 필드. 부분 취소가 없으면 빈 객체라 기존 문서 모양이 한 글자도 바뀌지 않는다.
-- 거래확정 엑셀 품목: 부분 취소 수량·남은 수량과 취소분의 배분(복수구매 할인 뒤 금액·복수구매 할인·쿠폰·적립금·결제 몫).
-- 엑셀은 이 값으로 수량과 금액 열을 남은 몫으로 쓴다(원래 배분 − 취소분).
create function private.order_item_partial_cancel_report_fields(p_order_item_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select case when totals.qty > 0 then jsonb_build_object('canceledQty', totals.qty, 'activeQty', item.qty - totals.qty,
      'partialCanceledPaidAmount', totals.paid_amount, 'partialCanceledGrossAmount', totals.gross_amount,
      'partialCanceledVolumeDiscount', totals.volume_discount, 'partialCanceledCouponDiscount', totals.coupon_discount,
      'partialCanceledStoreCreditDiscount', totals.store_credit_discount)
    else '{}'::jsonb end
  from public.order_items item cross join lateral private.order_item_partial_cancel_totals(item.id) totals
  where item.id = p_order_item_id;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_item_partial_cancel_report_fields(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 거래확정 엑셀 주문: 적용된 부분 취소 환불 합계와 건별 요약.
create function private.order_partial_cancel_report_fields(p_order_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select case when exists(select 1 from private.order_partial_cancellations h where h.order_id = p_order_id and h.applied_at is not null)
    then jsonb_build_object('partialRefundedAmount', private.order_partial_refunded_amount(p_order_id),
      'partialCancellations', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sequence', h.sequence, 'state', h.state, 'refundAmount', h.refund_amount,
          'shippingRefundAmount', h.shipping_refund_amount, 'appliedAt', h.applied_at) order by h.sequence)
        from private.order_partial_cancellations h where h.order_id = p_order_id and h.applied_at is not null))
    else '{}'::jsonb end;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_partial_cancel_report_fields(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 주문 품목 조회: 취소 수량과 남은 금액(남은 수량 × 판매가), 취소분 결제 몫(배분 후 금액에서 뺀다).
create function private.order_item_partial_cancel_console_fields(p_order_item_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select case when totals.qty > 0 then jsonb_build_object('canceledQty', totals.qty, 'activeQty', item.qty - totals.qty,
      'activeItemAmount', (item.qty - totals.qty)::bigint * item.unit_price::bigint, 'partialCanceledPaidAmount', totals.paid_amount)
    else '{}'::jsonb end
  from public.order_items item cross join lateral private.order_item_partial_cancel_totals(item.id) totals
  where item.id = p_order_item_id;
$$
revoke all on function private.order_item_partial_cancel_console_fields(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 12. 구매자 주문 상세. 본인 주문의 적용된 부분 취소만(결제사 확인 전·진행하지 않은 건은 보이지 않는다).

language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.order_partial_cancellation_json(head.id, 'customer') order by head.sequence), '[]'::jsonb)

  where head.order_id = p_order_id and head.applied_at is not null and auth.uid() is not null and o.user_id = auth.uid();
$$

ledger.name: order_partial_cancellation_readers
statements:
-- 재고 부족 부분 취소(QNA-020, ADR-0032) — 기존 판정·출고·재고·환불·보고가 '적용된 부분 취소'를 읽게 한다.
--
-- 앞 migration(20261112224500)의 원장을 기존 함수에 잇는다. 부분 취소가 없으면(스위치가 꺼져 있었으면) 모든 치환은 지금과
-- 같은 값을 만든다 — 취소 수량 0, 부분 환불액 0, 처리 중 아님, 닫힌 배송 건 없음.
--  * 처리 중(결제사 확인 대기)인 부분 취소가 있으면 그 주문의 출고지시·묶음 출고·발송 상태 전이·다른 취소를 막는다.
--  * 품목의 '살아 있는 수량' = 주문 수량 − 적용된 부분 취소 수량. 배송 건 품목(order_shipment_items.qty)은 이 수량이다.
--    출고 파일·배송완료 판정·반품 접수 판정은 이 수량과 대조하고, 부분 취소로 닫힌 배송 건은 주문 상태 계산에서 뺀다.
--  * 뒤의 주문 전체 취소는 이미 복원한 수량을 빼고 남은 수량만 재고로 되돌린다. 환불 원장·결제사 취소는 남은 잔액이다
--    (오케스트레이터가 잔액 기대값으로 부분 취소, finalizer는 '결제액 − 부분 환불 − 차감').
--  * 반품배송비 차감(ADR-0031)은 남은 잔액을 기준으로 판정·차감한다.
--  * PG 정산 대사는 부분 취소 거래키를 그 부분 취소 금액과 맞춘다. 매출 보고·스토어 분석은 부분 취소 금액·수량을 뺀다.
--    적립 기준액은 취소된 굿즈 금액을 뺀다. 무통장 부분 취소 환불계좌는 클레임 환불계좌와 같은 일정으로 지운다.
--  * 결제사 확인·송금을 기다리는 부분 취소 환불은 계정 삭제를 막는 미결 환불이다.
begin

-- 1. 처리 중인 부분 취소가 있으면 출고·발송·다른 취소를 막는다.
select private.t12b_patch_function('private.assert_order_dispatch_allowed(uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$    or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=target_order) then$a$,
$a$    or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=target_order)
    or private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(target_order) then$a$
])

select private.t12b_patch_function('private.admin_shipment_export_before_preorder(uuid[])'::regprocedure, array[
$a$ or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c join public.order_shipments s on s.order_id=c.order_id where s.id=any(target_ids)) then raise check_violation using message='order cancellation in progress';end if;$a$,
$a$ or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c join public.order_shipments s on s.order_id=c.order_id where s.id=any(target_ids))
 or exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.id=any(target_ids) and private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(s.order_id)) then raise check_violation using message='order cancellation in progress';end if;$a$,
-- 줄 수량은 배송 건 품목 수량이다(부분 취소가 없으면 주문 수량과 같다).
$a$'qty',i.qty,'unitPrice',i.unit_price,$a$,
$a$'qty',link.qty,'unitPrice',i.unit_price,$a$
])

select private.t12b_patch_function('public.admin_origin_pending_export_ids(uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=o.id)$a$,
$a$   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=o.id)
   and not private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(o.id)$a$
])

select private.t12b_patch_function('private.shipment_pack_ready(uuid)'::regprocedure, array[
$a$(a.order_id<>o.id or i.order_id<>o.id or a.qty<>i.qty))$a$,
$a$(a.order_id<>o.id or i.order_id<>o.id or a.qty<>private.order_item_active_qty(i.id)))$a$,

--   송금할 돈이 없으므로 송금 대기 원장(금액 > 0)을 만들지 않고, 환불 0원으로 확정해 같은 한 번에 닫는다(재고·카드팩은 남은 몫만 되돌린다).
--   토스 경로의 `remaining = 0 && 부분 환불 > 0` 분기와 같은 조건이다.
create function private.bank_transfer_zero_refund_payment(p_order_id uuid) returns uuid
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select p.id from public.payments p
  where p.purpose = 'order' and p.ref_id = p_order_id and p.provider = 'bank_transfer' and p.status in ('paid', 'refunded')
    and p.amount > 0 and p.amount = private.payment_partial_refunded_amount(p.id)
    and (select count(*) from public.payments x where x.purpose = 'order' and x.ref_id = p_order_id and x.status <> 'failed') = 1;
$$
revoke all on function private.bank_transfer_zero_refund_payment(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

$a$ elsif p_kind='confirm_cancellation' and private.bank_transfer_zero_refund_payment(purchase.id)=payment.id then
  -- 앞선 부분 취소들이 결제액을 모두 돌려줬다(남은 잔액 0원). 송금할 돈이 없으므로 송금 대기 없이 환불 0원으로 확정하고 클레임을 닫는다.
  if claim.status<>'processing' then update public.order_cancellation_requests set stage='processing',last_error_code=null where id=claim.id;end if;

 elsif p_kind='confirm_cancellation' then

  values(claim.id,purchase.id,payment.id,purchase.user_id,payment.amount-private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id),'awaiting_transfer',p_operation_id,
   p_expected_actor_id,p_occurred_at,p_evidence,p_note);
  perform public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(purchase.id,claim.reason,array[]::text[]);$a$,
$a$ if p_kind<>'complete_transfer' then
  update public.order_cancellation_requests set stage='processing',last_error_code=null,updated_at=happened where id=claim.id;$a$,
$a$ if p_kind<>'complete_transfer' then
