-- 권한 회수(역할 회수)와 최초 전환 때 미지정으로 회수되는 운영자의 세션을 같은 트랜잭션에서 끊는다.
select private.t8_patch_function('public.admin_change_operator_role(uuid,text,integer,bigint,uuid)',
$a$update public.profiles set role='user' where id=p_profile_id;$a$,
$a$update public.profiles set role='user' where id=p_profile_id;
    -- 회수한 운영자의 로그인 세션을 모두 끊는다(OPS-005). 이미 받은 access token은 만료까지 남지만 운영자 능력이 없다.
    perform private.operator_revoke_auth_sessions(p_profile_id);$a$)

select private.t8_patch_function('public.admin_activate_operator_access(jsonb,bigint,uuid)',
$a$if role_name is null then update public.profiles set role='user' where id=target;$a$,
$a$if role_name is null then update public.profiles set role='user' where id=target;
      -- 전환 때 회수되는 운영자의 로그인 세션도 끊는다(OPS-005).
      perform private.operator_revoke_auth_sessions(target);$a$)

-- 4. 관리 화면 문서: 스위치와 운영자별 등록 상태. 운영자는 지금 운영자 권한이 있는 계정(전환 전 호환 포함)이다.
create function private.operator_mfa_policy_document() returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$
  with operators as (
    select p.id from public.profiles p
    where p.role in ('staff','admin') and private.operator_access_for(p.id)->>'mode'<>'none'
  ), factors as (
    select o.id,
      count(f.id) filter (where f.status::text='verified' and f.factor_type::text='totp') as verified,
      count(f.id) filter (where f.status::text<>'verified' and f.factor_type::text='totp') as unverified,
      max(f.updated_at) filter (where f.status::text='verified' and f.factor_type::text='totp') as verified_at
    from operators o left join auth.mfa_factors f on f.user_id=o.id group by o.id
  ), directory as (
    select r.value||jsonb_build_object('verifiedFactors',f.verified,'unverifiedFactors',f.unverified,'verifiedAt',f.verified_at) as entry
    from jsonb_array_elements(private.operator_directory_rows(coalesce((select array_agg(id) from operators),'{}'::uuid[]))) r
    join factors f on f.id=(r.value->>'id')::uuid
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('required',c.required,'revision',c.revision,'updatedAt',c.updated_at,
    'updatedBy',(select p.nickname from public.profiles p where p.id=c.updated_by),
    'operators',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(entry order by (entry->>'verifiedFactors')::integer,entry->>'nickname',entry->>'id') from directory),'[]'::jsonb),
    'unenrolledCount',(select count(*) from factors where verified=0))
  from private.operator_mfa_policy c where c.singleton;
$$
revoke all on function private.operator_mfa_policy_document() from public,anon,authenticated,service_role

-- volatile: 권한 가드가 잠금을 쓰므로 PostgREST 읽기 전용 트랜잭션에 들어가지 않게 한다(다른 admin_get_*와 같다).
create function public.admin_get_operator_mfa_policy() returns jsonb
language plpgsql volatile security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
  perform private.require_operator_capability('operators.manage',true);
  return private.operator_mfa_policy_document();
end $$
revoke all on function public.admin_get_operator_mfa_policy() from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_get_operator_mfa_policy() to authenticated
revoke all on function public.admin_save_operator_mfa_policy(boolean,bigint,uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_save_operator_mfa_policy(boolean,bigint,uuid) to authenticated
revoke all on function public.admin_reset_operator_mfa(uuid,uuid) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_reset_operator_mfa(uuid,uuid) to authenticated

-- 5. 운영자 계약 지문. 바꾼 함수는 기존 분류값 그대로, 새 함수는 새로 적는다.
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_current_operator_access()'::regprocedure,'home','manual',false)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_change_operator_role(uuid,text,integer,bigint,uuid)'::regprocedure,'operators.manage','manual',true)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_activate_operator_access(jsonb,bigint,uuid)'::regprocedure,'operators.manage','manual',true)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_get_operator_mfa_policy()'::regprocedure,'operators.manage','read',true)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_save_operator_mfa_policy(boolean,bigint,uuid)'::regprocedure,'operators.manage','write',true)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_reset_operator_mfa(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,'operators.manage','write',true)

-- 2-1에서 본문을 바꾼 함수는 등록된 분류값 그대로 지문을 다시 적는다.
do $register$
declare item record;
begin
  for item in select c.signature,c.capability,c.guard_kind,c.legacy_admin_only from private.operator_rpc_contracts c
    where to_regprocedure(c.signature) in ('public.service_inquiry_file_download(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_export_bank_transfer_refund_accounts(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_export_order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_resolve_order_partial_cancellation(uuid,text,text,text,bigint,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_record_review_export(uuid,uuid,jsonb,text,integer,timestamp with time zone,text)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_record_review_export_v2(uuid,uuid,jsonb,text,integer,timestamp with time zone,text)'::regprocedure)
  loop
    perform private.register_operator_rpc_contract(item.signature::regprocedure,item.capability,item.guard_kind,item.legacy_admin_only);
  end loop;
  perform private.register_operator_internal_contract(to_regprocedure(c.signature)) from private.operator_internal_contracts c
    where to_regprocedure(c.signature) in ('private.contact_require_identity(uuid,uuid,text,boolean,uuid[],boolean)'::regprocedure,
      'private.digital_operator_session(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,'private.inquiry_file_session(uuid,uuid,boolean)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_inquiry_file_download(uuid,uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_export_bank_transfer_refund_accounts(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_export_order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_resolve_order_partial_cancellation(uuid,text,text,text,bigint,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_record_review_export(uuid,uuid,jsonb,text,integer,timestamp with time zone,text)'::regprocedure,
      'public.service_record_review_export_v2(uuid,uuid,jsonb,text,integer,timestamp with time zone,text)'::regprocedure);
end $register$

select private.register_operator_internal_contract(signature::regprocedure) from (values
  ('private.has_operator_capability(uuid,text,boolean)'),
  ('private.require_actor_operator_capability(uuid,text,boolean)'),
  ('private.operator_mfa_required()'),
  ('private.operator_mfa_session_ok(uuid,uuid)'),
  ('private.operator_mfa_service_session_ok(uuid,uuid)'),
  ('private.operator_mfa_session_verified(uuid)'),
  ('private.operator_mfa_blocks(uuid)'),
  ('private.operator_revoke_auth_sessions(uuid)'),
  ('private.operator_mfa_policy_document()')
) as target(signature)

ledger.name: operator_pii_access_log
statements:
-- 개인정보 접속기록(CUS-084·OPS-014·OPS-015).
--
-- 개인정보의 안전성 확보조치 기준 제8조: 개인정보취급자가 개인정보처리시스템에 접속한 기록(계정·접속일시·접속지·처리한
-- 정보주체·수행업무)을 보관하고 정기적으로 점검한다. 보관은 1년 이상, 5만 명 이상이거나 고유식별·민감정보를 처리하면
-- 2년 이상이다. 보수적으로 2년을 쓴다(ERP 읽기 접근 기록과 같은 기준, 20261109120000).
--
-- 무엇을 남기나: 어드민 고객 상세·주문 상세·주문 검색(이름·연락처·이메일 검색)·클레임 상세·클레임 연락처 원문·환불계좌
-- 원문 열람과 개인정보가 담긴 엑셀·출고지시 파일 내려받기, 그리고 이 기록 자체의 점검 열람·내려받기.
-- 개인정보 원문(이름·전화·주소·검색어)은 남기지 않는다. 대상은 회원·주문·클레임·배송 건·선물·리뷰 ID와 건수로 남긴다
-- (대량 내려받기는 ID 없이 건수와 기존 내려받기 감사 기록 번호만 남길 수 있다 — 조건은 그 감사 기록에 있다).
-- 접속지(IP)는 DB가 알 수 없다(PostgREST 앞단은 Next 서버다). 서버가 Vercel이 덮어쓰는 요청 헤더에서 읽어 넘긴다.
--
-- 쓰기: service_role만 부르는 public.service_record_operator_pii_access 하나. 행위자는 서버가 확인한 로그인 계정이다.
-- 운영자(owner 포함)·authenticated·service_role 모두 표를 직접 읽거나 고칠 수 없다(RLS + 권한 회수).
-- append-only: 트리거가 UPDATE·TRUNCATE를 막고, DELETE는 보관 기간이 지난 행만 허용한다(정리 cron이 그 길로 지운다).
--
-- 점검: 매니저 관리 권한(operators.manage — 통합·주매니저, 호환 단계 admin)만 public.admin_pii_access_log로 읽는다.
-- 읽기 RPC는 STABLE이라 PostgREST가 READ ONLY 트랜잭션으로 부른다 — 잠그는 private.require_operator_capability 대신
-- 잠금 없는 public.has_operator_capability(...)로 판정한다(cs_reply_read_transaction_mode). 점검 화면 열람·내려받기의
-- 기록은 서버가 같은 service 경로로 남긴다(IP가 필요해서).
--
-- 같은 화면을 다시 그리는 것(조회 조건 유지 새로고침·처리 후 재검증)은 10분 안에 같은 운영자·같은 화면·같은 대상·같은 접속지면
-- 한 번만 남긴다(열람·검색만. 내려받기·원문 확인·정정은 매번 남긴다). 상담 구매이력 열람 감사와 같은 원칙이다.
--
-- 이상 징후(단순 규칙, 점검 화면의 표시): 근무시간 외(KST 평일 08~21시 밖·주말), 대량(한 기록의 대상 1,000건 이상),
-- 몰아보기(같은 운영자가 같은 1시간에 상세·원문 50건 이상).

create table private.operator_pii_access_log (
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
  accessed_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  actor_id uuid not null,
  -- 기록 시점의 운영자 접근(통합·주·부매니저 등 역할, 호환 단계 legacy_admin·legacy_staff, 없으면 none).
  actor_access text not null check (actor_access ~ '^[a-z_]{1,32}$'),
  client_ip inet,
  action text not null check (action in ('view', 'search', 'export', 'reveal', 'correct')),
  surface text not null check (surface ~ '^[a-z][a-z_]{0,31}([.][a-z][a-z_]{0,31}){0,2}$'),
  -- 화면·경로만. 쿼리 문자열(검색어가 들어간다)은 받지 않는다.
  path text not null check (length(path) <= 300 and path ~ '^/(admin|api/admin)(/[A-Za-z0-9._~%-]+)*$'),
  subject_kind text not null check (subject_kind in ('member', 'order', 'claim', 'shipment', 'gift', 'review', 'none')),
  subject_ids uuid[] not null default '{}' check (cardinality(subject_ids) <= 1000 and array_position(subject_ids, null) is null),
  subject_count integer not null check (subject_count >= cardinality(subject_ids) and subject_count <= 1000000),
  -- 대상의 회원(주문·클레임·배송 건의 구매자와 선물 받는 사람, 선물의 보낸·받는 사람, 리뷰 작성자). '이 회원의 정보를 누가 봤나'를 한 번에 찾는다.
  member_ids uuid[] not null default '{}' check (cardinality(member_ids) <= 2000 and array_position(member_ids, null) is null),
  detail jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(detail) = 'object' and octet_length(detail::text) <= 2000),
  fingerprint text not null check (fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'),
  check (subject_kind <> 'none' or (cardinality(subject_ids) = 0 and subject_count = 0))
)

comment on table private.operator_pii_access_log is
  '개인정보 접속기록(안전성 확보조치 기준 제8조). append-only, 2년 보관. 개인정보 원문은 저장하지 않는다.'
create index operator_pii_access_log_at_idx on private.operator_pii_access_log (accessed_at desc, id desc)
create index operator_pii_access_log_actor_idx on private.operator_pii_access_log (actor_id, accessed_at desc)
create index operator_pii_access_log_subject_idx on private.operator_pii_access_log using gin (subject_ids)
create index operator_pii_access_log_member_idx on private.operator_pii_access_log using gin (member_ids)
alter table private.operator_pii_access_log enable row level security
revoke all on private.operator_pii_access_log from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 보관 기간의 단일 진실원. 정리 cron과 삭제 트리거가 같은 값을 본다. 앱 상수(PII_ACCESS_LOG_RETENTION_YEARS)와 같다.
create function private.pii_access_log_retention()
returns interval language sql immutable set search_path = '' as $$ select interval '2 years' $$

create function private.guard_pii_access_log_truncate()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'pii_access_log_append_only';
end $$
revoke all on function private.pii_access_log_retention() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.guard_pii_access_log_change() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
revoke all on function private.guard_pii_access_log_truncate() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

revoke all on function public.service_record_operator_pii_access(uuid, text, text, text, inet, text, uuid[], integer, jsonb)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

grant execute on function public.service_record_operator_pii_access(uuid, text, text, text, inet, text, uuid[], integer, jsonb)
  to service_role

-- 점검용 행 + 이상 징후. 몰아보기는 거르기 전에 그 기간의 같은 운영자·같은 KST 시간의 상세·원문 열람 수로 판정한다.
create function private.pii_access_log_entries(
  p_from date, p_to date, p_actor uuid, p_action text, p_surface text, p_subject uuid, p_flag text
) returns table (
  id bigint, accessed_at timestamptz, actor_id uuid, actor_access text, client_ip inet, action text, surface text,
  path text, subject_kind text, subject_ids uuid[], subject_count integer, member_ids uuid[], detail jsonb,
  off_hours boolean, bulk boolean, burst boolean
)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  with ranged as (
    select l.*, (l.accessed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') as local_at
    from private.operator_pii_access_log l
    where l.accessed_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
      and l.accessed_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
  ), flagged as (
    select r.*,
      (extract(isodow from r.local_at) in (6, 7) or extract(hour from r.local_at) < 8 or extract(hour from r.local_at) >= 21) as is_off_hours,
      (r.subject_count >= 1000) as is_bulk,
      (r.action in ('view', 'reveal') and count(*) filter (where r.action in ('view', 'reveal'))
        over (partition by r.actor_id, date_trunc('hour', r.local_at)) >= 50) as is_burst
    from ranged r
  )
  select f.id, f.accessed_at, f.actor_id, f.actor_access, f.client_ip, f.action, f.surface, f.path, f.subject_kind,
    f.subject_ids, f.subject_count, f.member_ids, f.detail, f.is_off_hours, f.is_bulk, f.is_burst
  from flagged f
  where (p_actor is null or f.actor_id = p_actor)
    and (p_action is null or f.action = p_action)
    and (p_surface is null or f.surface = p_surface)
    and (p_subject is null or f.subject_ids @> array[p_subject] or f.member_ids @> array[p_subject])
    and (p_flag is null
      or (p_flag = 'any' and (f.is_off_hours or f.is_bulk or f.is_burst))
      or (p_flag = 'off_hours' and f.is_off_hours)
      or (p_flag = 'bulk' and f.is_bulk)
      or (p_flag = 'burst' and f.is_burst));
$$

revoke all on function private.pii_access_log_entries(date, date, uuid, text, text, uuid, text)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

revoke all on function private.validate_pii_access_log_filters(date, date, text, text, text)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

create function private.pii_access_log_actor_name(p_actor uuid)
returns text language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce((select nullif(btrim(p.nickname), '') from public.profiles p where p.id = p_actor), '운영자_' || left(p_actor::text, 6));
$$
revoke all on function private.pii_access_log_actor_name(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 점검 목록 엑셀. 같은 조건 최대 10,000건(넘으면 54000). 대상 ID는 최대 1,000개 그대로 넘기고 파일 칸에서 줄인다.
create function public.admin_export_pii_access_log(
  p_from date, p_to date, p_actor uuid default null, p_action text default null, p_surface text default null,
  p_subject uuid default null, p_flag text default null
) returns jsonb
language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare
  total bigint;
  result_rows jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('operators.manage', true) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'operator_capability_required';
  end if;
  perform private.validate_pii_access_log_filters(p_from, p_to, p_action, p_surface, p_flag);
  select count(*) into total from private.pii_access_log_entries(p_from, p_to, p_actor, p_action, p_surface, p_subject, p_flag);
  if total > 10000 then
    raise program_limit_exceeded using message = 'pii_access_log_export_limit';
  end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', e.id::text,
      'at', e.accessed_at,
      'actorId', e.actor_id,
      'actorName', private.pii_access_log_actor_name(e.actor_id),
      'actorAccess', e.actor_access,
      'ip', host(e.client_ip),
      'action', e.action,
      'surface', e.surface,
      'path', e.path,
      'subjectKind', e.subject_kind,
      'subjectIds', to_jsonb(e.subject_ids),
      'subjectCount', e.subject_count,
      'memberIds', to_jsonb(e.member_ids),
      'memberCount', cardinality(e.member_ids),
      'detail', e.detail,
      'flags', to_jsonb(array_remove(array[
        case when e.off_hours then 'off_hours' end,
        case when e.bulk then 'bulk' end,
        case when e.burst then 'burst' end], null))
    ) order by e.accessed_at desc, e.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  into result_rows
  from private.pii_access_log_entries(p_from, p_to, p_actor, p_action, p_surface, p_subject, p_flag) e;
  return jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to, 'total', total, 'capturedAt', clock_timestamp(), 'rows', result_rows);
end $$

revoke all on function public.admin_pii_access_log(date, date, uuid, text, text, uuid, text, integer)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_pii_access_log(date, date, uuid, text, text, uuid, text, integer) to authenticated

revoke all on function public.admin_export_pii_access_log(date, date, uuid, text, text, uuid, text)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_export_pii_access_log(date, date, uuid, text, text, uuid, text) to authenticated

select private.register_operator_rpc_contract(
  'public.admin_pii_access_log(date,date,uuid,text,text,uuid,text,integer)'::regprocedure, 'operators.manage', 'read', true)

select private.register_operator_rpc_contract(
  'public.admin_export_pii_access_log(date,date,uuid,text,text,uuid,text)'::regprocedure, 'operators.manage', 'read', true)
revoke all on function private.purge_pii_access_log() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
select cron.schedule('operator-pii-access-log-retention', '37 3 * * *', $job$select private.purge_pii_access_log()$job$)

ledger.name: member_withdrawal_processing
statements:
-- 문의로 받은 회원 탈퇴의 운영자 처리(원장 CUS-036·CUS-035·OPS-021).
--
-- 탈퇴 신청 기능(#137 Phase 1)은 readiness 값 없이는 켜지지 않아 탈퇴는 1:1 문의로 받는다. 지금까지의 처리 절차는
-- '어드민에서 정지 + SQL 편집기에서 private.erase_member_address_book 실행 + 수기 기록'이라 SQL 권한자만 처리할 수 있었고
-- 감사가 남지 않았으며 휴대폰 번호·마케팅 수신 동의·로그인 세션은 그대로 남았다. 이 migration은 그 임시 절차를 어드민
-- 고객 상세의 '탈퇴 요청 처리' 한 동작으로 시스템화한다.
--
-- 이 동작은 hard delete가 아니다. 정책(docs/account-deletion-retention-policy.md §1·§2)이 정한 완전한 탈퇴 —
-- 법정 snapshot 분리 → 메일 fence → hard delete → 별도 compliance 프로젝트 tombstone — 의 선행 조건이 아직 없으므로
-- 프로필(이메일·닉네임·생년월일)·Auth 사용자·거래 기록·커뮤니티 작성물·Storage 객체는 남긴다. 지우는 것은 법정 보존 대상이
-- 아니고 탈퇴 봉인(account_action_fences) 트리거가 지우는 것과 같은 범위다.
--
-- public.admin_process_member_withdrawal(회원, 문의 번호, 처리 메모) — platform.manage(회원 관리·정지와 같은 권한):
--   · 문의 번호는 그 회원이 쓴 1:1 문의여야 한다(본인 요청의 근거).
--   · 진행 중 의무(private.account_deletion_blockers — 탈퇴 신청과 같은 판정)와 운영자 소속이 있으면 아무것도 바꾸지 않고
--     남은 의무를 돌려준다(status blocked).
--   · 한 트랜잭션에서: 정지(public.admin_suspend_user — 정지 감사 포함), 주소록(private.erase_member_address_book),
--     휴대폰 번호·인증 요청·이력(private.erase_member_phone), 마케팅 정보 수신 동의 전 수단 철회(원장에 source
--     member_withdrawal로 기록, 파생값 consents.marketing=false), 성별(고객 통계 동의) 철회, 활동 기록·동의 철회, 진행 중
--     이메일 변경 요청, 대기 중인 재입고 알림 신청 삭제, 로그인 세션(auth.sessions·refresh token) 삭제.
--   · 처리 기록(private.member_withdrawal_processings)과 감사 로그(admin.member.withdrawal_processed: 문의 번호·지운 개수,
--     개인정보 원문·메모 없음)를 남긴다. 다시 부르면 처음 기록을 돌려주고(멱등) 그 사이 생긴 세션만 다시 끊는다.
-- 재로그인 차단은 Supabase Auth 관리 API(ban)가 맡는다 — DB가 할 수 없고 관리 API에는 사용자 id로 세션을 끊는 호출이
-- 없어서 세션 삭제는 위 RPC가, 로그인·토큰 갱신 차단은 앱 서버가 관리 API로 한다. 앱은 차단을 적용한 뒤
-- public.admin_confirm_member_withdrawal_signin_block으로 auth.users.banned_until을 DB가 직접 확인해 기록·감사한다.
-- 탈퇴 처리한 계정은 정지 해제를 막는다(admin_unsuspend_user).
begin

-- 1. 처리 기록. 회원당 한 행 — 처리 사실·문의 번호·처리자와 재로그인 차단 확인 시각만 둔다(개인정보 원문 없음).
--    회원 프로필이 나중에 hard delete되면 함께 지워진다(그때는 compliance tombstone이 이어받는다).
create table private.member_withdrawal_processings (
  user_id uuid primary key references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  inquiry_reference bigint not null check (inquiry_reference > 0),
  processed_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  processed_at timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(),
  signin_blocked_at timestamptz,
  signin_blocked_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  check (signin_blocked_by is null or signin_blocked_at is not null),
  check (signin_blocked_at is null or signin_blocked_at >= processed_at)
)
alter table private.member_withdrawal_processings owner to postgres
alter table private.member_withdrawal_processings enable row level security
revoke all on private.member_withdrawal_processings from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

comment on table private.member_withdrawal_processings is
  '문의로 받은 회원 탈퇴의 운영자 처리 기록(admin_process_member_withdrawal). hard delete가 아니라 정지·비법정 개인정보 삭제·세션 종료까지다 — 남는 항목과 이유는 docs/account-deletion-retention-policy.md §5.'

-- 2. 마케팅 정보 수신 동의 원장의 출처에 '탈퇴 처리'를 더한다(철회 기록의 근거, 정보통신망법 제50조).
alter table private.customer_marketing_consents drop constraint customer_marketing_consents_source_check

alter table private.customer_marketing_consents add constraint customer_marketing_consents_source_check
  check (source in ('legacy', 'legacy_app', 'onboarding', 'settings', 'member_withdrawal'))
alter table private.customer_marketing_consent_events drop constraint customer_marketing_consent_events_source_check

alter table private.customer_marketing_consent_events add constraint customer_marketing_consent_events_source_check
  check (source in ('legacy', 'legacy_app', 'onboarding', 'settings', 'member_withdrawal'))
alter function private.revoke_member_auth_sessions(uuid) owner to postgres
revoke all on function private.revoke_member_auth_sessions(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 4. 화면이 읽는 처리 상태(처리 전이면 processed=false).
create function private.member_withdrawal_document(p_user_id uuid) returns jsonb
language sql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$
  select coalesce(
    (select jsonb_build_object('processed', true, 'processedAt', w.processed_at, 'inquiryReference', w.inquiry_reference,
       'signinBlocked', w.signin_blocked_at is not null, 'signinBlockedAt', w.signin_blocked_at)
     from private.member_withdrawal_processings w where w.user_id = p_user_id),
    jsonb_build_object('processed', false, 'processedAt', null, 'inquiryReference', null,
      'signinBlocked', false, 'signinBlockedAt', null));
$$
alter function private.member_withdrawal_document(uuid) owner to postgres
revoke all on function private.member_withdrawal_document(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
alter function public.admin_process_member_withdrawal(uuid, bigint, text) owner to postgres
revoke all on function public.admin_process_member_withdrawal(uuid, bigint, text) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_process_member_withdrawal(uuid, bigint, text) to authenticated
alter function public.admin_confirm_member_withdrawal_signin_block(uuid) owner to postgres
revoke all on function public.admin_confirm_member_withdrawal_signin_block(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_confirm_member_withdrawal_signin_block(uuid) to authenticated
alter function public.admin_member_withdrawal_status(uuid) owner to postgres
revoke all on function public.admin_member_withdrawal_status(uuid) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_member_withdrawal_status(uuid) to authenticated

-- 9. 운영자 계약 지문. 새 RPC는 분류를 등록하고, 재정의한 정지 해제는 기존 분류 그대로 다시 등록한다.
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_process_member_withdrawal(uuid,bigint,text)'::regprocedure, 'platform.manage', 'write', false)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_confirm_member_withdrawal_signin_block(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'platform.manage', 'write', false)
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_member_withdrawal_status(uuid)'::regprocedure, 'platform.manage', 'read', false)
drop function private.t10_withdrawal_patch_function(regprocedure, text[])
notify pgrst, 'reload schema'
commit

ledger.name: member_withdrawal_followups
statements:
-- 문의로 받은 회원 탈퇴 처리의 후속(원장 CUS-035·CUS-036 리뷰).
--
-- 1. 정지 회원도 '계정' 유형 1:1 문의로 탈퇴를 요청할 수 있게 좁게 연다. 정지 회원의 계정 문의는 글만 받는다 — 이미지 첨부와
--    주문·굿즈 연결은 DB가 거절한다(account_suspended_inquiry_limited). 다른 유형의 새 문의와 다른 보호 액션은 그대로 막고
--    하루 20건 상한도 그대로다. 이어 쓰기도 계정 문의에만, 첨부 없이 허용한다(지금까지 DB는 정지 회원의 이어 쓰기를 따로 막지
--    않았다 — 앱만 막았다). 온보딩 미완료 회원은 DB가 원래 막지 않으므로 같은 규칙(계정 문의만·첨부·연결 없음)을 앱이 지킨다.
-- 2. 탈퇴 처리 직후 남은 access token(최대 1시간)으로 PostgREST를 직접 불러 마케팅 정보 수신에 다시 동의하거나 재입고 알림을
--    신청하지 못하게 한다. 정지 회원은 동의 '켜기'(동의하지 않은 수단을 동의로 바꾸기)와 재입고 알림 신청만 거절한다 —
--    동의 철회는 언제나 받는다(정보통신망법 제50조). 회원이 consents.marketing을 직접 쓰는 옛 경로도 켜는 값은 받지 않는다.
-- 3. 처리 전 확인창이 문의 번호의 제목·유형·작성일을 대조할 수 있게 읽기 RPC를 둔다.
begin

-- 1-a. 새 문의: 정지 회원은 '계정' 유형만, 첨부·주문·굿즈 연결 없이 접수한다.
select private.t10_followup_patch_function('private.create_inquiry_before_system_notice(text,text,text,uuid,text,text[])'::regprocedure, array[
$a$      and profile.suspended_at is not null
  ) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'account_suspended';$a$,
$a$      and profile.suspended_at is not null
  ) and (v_category <> 'account' or cardinality(coalesce(target_image_paths, '{}'::text[])) > 0
    or target_order_id is not null or target_good_id is not null) then
    -- 정지 회원은 계정 문의(탈퇴 요청·정지 문의)를 글로만 접수한다 — 탈퇴 경로가 막히지 않게(원장 CUS-035).
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = case when v_category <> 'account' then 'account_suspended'
      else 'account_suspended_inquiry_limited' end;$a$
])
alter function public.admin_member_withdrawal_inquiry(uuid, bigint) owner to postgres
revoke all on function public.admin_member_withdrawal_inquiry(uuid, bigint) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_member_withdrawal_inquiry(uuid, bigint) to authenticated
select private.register_operator_rpc_contract('public.admin_member_withdrawal_inquiry(uuid,bigint)'::regprocedure, 'platform.manage', 'read', false)
drop function private.t10_followup_patch_function(regprocedure, text[])
notify pgrst, 'reload schema'
commit

ledger.name: goods_type_layer_cleanup
statements:
-- create or replace라 소유자·권한이 그대로다. 봉인을 다시 확인하고 본문 지문을 다시 적는다(분류는 기존 행 그대로).
revoke all on function public.admin_upsert_category(uuid,uuid,text,text,uuid,integer,timestamp with time zone,text)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role
grant execute on function public.admin_upsert_category(uuid,uuid,text,text,uuid,integer,timestamp with time zone,text) to authenticated

select private.register_operator_rpc_contract(
  'public.admin_upsert_category(uuid,uuid,text,text,uuid,integer,timestamp with time zone,text)'::regprocedure,
  'catalog.manage', 'write', false)
alter table public.catalog_categories drop column good_type

delete from private.operator_rpc_contracts
  where signature = 'public.admin_set_category_type_migration(uuid,text,uuid,text,text)'

delete from private.operator_internal_contracts
  where signature = 'public.admin_set_category_type_migration(uuid,text,uuid,text,text)'

delete from private.operator_policy_contracts
  where schema_name = 'public' and table_name = 'goods_type_category_migrations'
drop table public.goods_type_category_migrations
revoke all on function private.admin_goods_workspace_matches(text,text,text,text,uuid,text) from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- 남은 참조가 있으면 여기서 멈춘다(plpgsql은 의존을 추적하지 않는다).
do $$
declare
  callers text;
begin
  select string_agg(p.oid::regprocedure::text, ', ' order by p.oid::regprocedure::text) into callers
  from pg_catalog.pg_proc as p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace as n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
  where n.nspname in ('public', 'private')
    and (p.prosrc ~ 'goods_type_category_migrations' or p.prosrc ~ '''type_(missing|category_mismatch|no_category)'''
      or (p.prosrc ~ '\mgood_type\M' and p.oid <> 'public.admin_upsert_category(uuid,uuid,text,text,uuid,integer,timestamp with time zone,text)'::regprocedure));
  if callers is not null then
    raise exception 'goods_type_cleanup_remaining_callers: %', callers;
  end if;
end $$

ledger.name: goods_type_columns_unused
statements:
-- ADR-0044 칸 삭제 1단계: 상품 유형(goods.type)과 주문 유형 스냅샷(order_items.good_type_snapshot)을 아무도 쓰지 않게 한다.
--
-- 두 칸은 다음 migration(2단계)에서 지운다. 배포는 DB가 먼저, 앱이 몇 분 뒤에 바뀌므로 칸을 지우기 전에
-- 쓰는 쪽을 먼저 멈춘다. 이 migration 뒤에는
--   1. 상품·주문 저장이 두 칸을 쓰지 않는다. 새 행은 기본값 ''을 받고, 기존 값은 바뀌지 않는다.
--      상품 저장 RPC(admin_upsert_good)의 target_type 인자는 시그니처를 유지한 채 받기만 하고 무시한다.
--   2. KC 맥락(private.goods_kc_context)과 KC 가드가 유형을 보지 않는다. 저장된 KC 검토 기록은 고치지 않고,
--      현재 여부를 비교할 때 기록의 옛 'type' 키를 빼고 비교한다(공개 중 상품의 KC 검토가 풀리지 않는다).
--   3. 그룹 공통정보 저장은 'type' 키를 받아도 되고 안 받아도 된다(이전 앱은 보내고, 새 앱은 보내지 않는다).
-- 읽는 쪽(카테고리 진열·주문 조회·스마트스토어 출고·탈퇴 법정 기록)은 이전 앱이 그 응답 키를 아직 읽으므로 그대로 두고,
-- 2단계에서 칸과 함께 걷는다.

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 0. 쓰는 쪽이 값을 빼도 넣을 수 있게 기본값을 둔다(NOT NULL은 2단계에서 칸과 함께 사라진다).
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
alter table public.goods alter column type set default ''
alter table public.order_items alter column good_type_snapshot set default ''

comment on column public.goods.type is
  'ADR-0044로 쓰지 않는 칸(다음 migration에서 삭제). 어떤 저장 경로도 쓰지 않고 새 상품은 ''''이다. KC 맥락에 들어가지 않는다.'

comment on column public.order_items.good_type_snapshot is
  'ADR-0044로 쓰지 않는 칸(다음 migration에서 삭제). 새 주문 줄은 ''''이다.'

revoke all on function private.goods_type_column_patch(regprocedure, jsonb)
  from public, anon, authenticated, service_role

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. KC: 맥락·가드·현재 여부 비교에서 유형을 뺀다.
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function private.goods_kc_context(p_good_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('good',jsonb_build_object('ipId',good.ip_id,'name',good.name,
    'maker',good.notice_maker,'origin',good.notice_origin,'material',good.notice_material,'size',good.notice_size),
    'variants',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',variant.id,'name',variant.name,'attributes',variant.attributes,
      'active',variant.archived_at is null) order by variant.id),'[]') from public.goods_variants variant where variant.good_id=good.id))
  from public.goods good where good.id=p_good_id;
$function$

-- 이 migration 전에 저장한 검토 기록의 맥락에는 'type'이 있다. 기록은 그대로 두고 비교할 때만 뺀다.
select private.goods_type_column_patch('private.goods_kc_review_current(text)'::regprocedure, jsonb_build_array(
  jsonb_build_array(
    $a$and review.context_snapshot->'good'=private.goods_kc_context(p_good_id)->'good'$a$,

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 6. 쓰는 쪽이 남았으면 여기서 멈춘다(plpgsql은 칸 의존을 추적하지 않는다).
--    읽는 쪽 7개는 2단계에서 칸과 함께 걷는다.
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
declare
  writers text;
begin
  select string_agg(p.oid::regprocedure::text, ', ' order by p.oid::regprocedure::text) into writers
  from pg_catalog.pg_proc as p join pg_catalog.pg_namespace as n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
  where n.nspname in ('public', 'private')
    and (p.prosrc ~ 'good_type_snapshot' or p.prosrc ~ '''goodType''' or p.prosrc ~ '\m(good|source_good|p_good)\.type\M'
      -- 상품 행 트리거만 본다(다른 표의 트리거도 old.type·new.type을 쓴다).
      or p.prosrc ~ '\m(old|new)\.type\M' and exists(
        select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_trigger as t where t.tgfoid = p.oid and t.tgrelid = 'public.goods'::regclass))
    and p.oid not in (
      'private.category_display_page(uuid,jsonb,jsonb,integer,text,bigint)'::regprocedure,
      'private.category_display_public_good(public.goods,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
      'public.my_order_items(uuid[])'::regprocedure,
      'public.get_my_gift_checkout_order(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
      'public.get_my_gift_checkout_order_numbered(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure,
      'private.admin_order_detail_before_preorder(uuid)'::regprocedure,
      'public.admin_smartstore_shipment_export(uuid[])'::regprocedure,
      'private.snapshot_account_deletion_legal_records(uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure);
  if writers is not null then
    raise exception 'goods_type_column_remaining_writers: %', writers;
  end if;
end $$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.account_deletion_blockers(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with unresolved_payments as (
    select
      coalesce(attempt.payment_id::text, 'attempt:' || attempt.id::text) as blocker_ref,
      coalesce(payment.purpose, attempt.purpose) as purpose
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    left join public.payments as payment on payment.id = attempt.payment_id
    where attempt.user_id = p_user_id
      and (
        attempt.state in ('prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review')
        or (attempt.state = 'approved' and attempt.payment_id is null)
      )

    union

    -- An attempt linked to the same legacy pending payment represents one
    -- obligation, not two public blockers.
    select payment.id::text, payment.purpose
    from public.payments as payment
    where payment.user_id = p_user_id
      and payment.status = 'pending'
  ),
  unresolved_refunds as (
    select refund.id::text as blocker_ref, payment.purpose
    from public.refunds as refund
    join public.payments as payment on payment.id = refund.payment_id
    where payment.user_id = p_user_id
      and refund.status in ('requested', 'failed', 'awaiting_transfer')
    union all
    select head.id::text as blocker_ref, payment.purpose
    from private.order_partial_cancellations as head
    join public.payments as payment on payment.id = head.payment_id
    where payment.user_id = p_user_id
      and head.state in ('processing', 'needs_review', 'awaiting_transfer')
  ),
  blocker_counts as (
    select
      1 as priority,
      'active_order'::text as code,
      pg_catalog.count(*)::integer as blocker_count,
      '/orders'::text as path
    from public.orders as order_record
    where order_record.user_id = p_user_id
      and (order_record.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'confirmed', 'shipping') or private.contact_order_reshipment_pending(order_record.id))

    union all

    select
      2,
      'active_cancellation',
      pg_catalog.count(*)::integer,
      '/orders'
    from (
      select request.order_id::text as blocker_ref
      from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
      join public.orders as order_record on order_record.id = request.order_id
      where order_record.user_id = p_user_id
        and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')

      union

      select claim.order_id::text
      from public.order_cancellation_claims as claim
      join public.orders as order_record on order_record.id = claim.order_id
      where order_record.user_id = p_user_id
    ) as active_cancellation

    union all

    select 3, 'active_order_payment', pg_catalog.count(*)::integer, '/orders'
    from unresolved_payments
    where purpose = 'order'

    union all

    select 4, 'active_ticket_payment', pg_catalog.count(*)::integer, '/tickets'
    from unresolved_payments
    where purpose = 'ticket'

    union all

    select 5, 'active_payment_attempt', pg_catalog.count(*)::integer, '/settings'
    from unresolved_payments
    where purpose not in ('order', 'ticket')

    union all

    select 6, 'active_order_refund', pg_catalog.count(*)::integer, '/orders'
    from unresolved_refunds
    where purpose = 'order'

    union all

    select 7, 'active_ticket_refund', pg_catalog.count(*)::integer, '/tickets'
    from unresolved_refunds
    where purpose = 'ticket'

    union all

    select 8, 'active_refund', pg_catalog.count(*)::integer, '/settings'
    from unresolved_refunds
    where purpose not in ('order', 'ticket')

    union all

    select
      9,
      'active_ticket',
      pg_catalog.count(*)::integer,
      '/tickets'
    from public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
    join public.events as event on event.id = ticket_order.event_id
    where ticket_order.user_id = p_user_id
      and (
        ticket_order.status = 'pending'
        or (
          ticket_order.status = 'paid'
          and (event.ends_at is null or event.ends_at > pg_catalog.now())
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.tickets as ticket
            where ticket.ticket_order_id = ticket_order.id
              and ticket.status = 'valid'
          )
        )
      )

    union all

    select
      10,
      'active_ticket_cancellation',
      pg_catalog.count(*)::integer,
      '/tickets'
    from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
    join public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
      on ticket_order.id = request.ticket_order_id
    where ticket_order.user_id = p_user_id
      and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')

    union all

    select
      11,
      'staff_handover',
      pg_catalog.count(*)::integer,
      '/settings'
    from public.profiles as profile
    where profile.id = p_user_id
      and profile.role in ('staff', 'admin')
  )
  select coalesce(
    pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        'code', blocker.code,
        'count', blocker.blocker_count,
        'path', blocker.path
      )
      order by blocker.priority
    ) filter (where blocker.blocker_count > 0),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) || private.goods_transaction_account_blockers(p_user_id) || private.claim_fee_account_blockers(p_user_id)
  from blocker_counts as blocker;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.account_deletion_email_fence_ready(p_deletion_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

    select 1
    from private.account_deletion_requests as request
    join private.email_intents as intent on intent.id = request.notification_intent_id
    join private.email_intent_fences as fence on fence.intent_id = intent.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.account_deletion_public_status(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'status', case request.status
      when 'blocked_active_obligation' then 'blocked'
      else 'processing'
    end,
    'phase', case request.status
      when 'blocked_active_obligation' then 'fenced'
      else 'awaiting_notification'
    end,
    'nextAction', case request.status
      when 'blocked_active_obligation'
        then coalesce(request.blocker_summary -> 0 ->> 'path', '/settings')
      else 'retry_later'
    end,
    'blockers', request.blocker_summary
  )
  from private.account_deletion_requests as request
  where request.subject_user_id = p_user_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.admin_customer_purchase_payment_times()
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, paid_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 -- Set-based equivalent of admin_sales_order_date(order,'paid'). Keep the
 -- inner provider MIN, per-attempt bank fallback and outer MIN in that order.
 -- Current payment/order status is intentionally absent: refunds retain history.
 -- The matching fields stay inside CASE: filtering three correlated join keys
 -- made the planner estimate one match and repeatedly aggregate all evidence.
 with provider_times as materialized (
  select evidence.payment_attempt_id,min(evidence.approved_at) approved_at
  from private.payment_provider_evidence evidence group by evidence.payment_attempt_id
 )
 select attempt.ref_id,min(case
  when payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=attempt.ref_id and payment.amount=attempt.amount
   then coalesce(provider.approved_at,bank.confirmed_at)
  end)
 from public.payment_attempts attempt join public.payments payment on payment.id=attempt.payment_id
 left join provider_times provider on provider.payment_attempt_id=attempt.id
 left join public.bank_transfer_confirmations bank on bank.attempt_id=attempt.id
  and bank.order_id=attempt.ref_id and attempt.provider='bank_transfer'
 where attempt.purpose='order'
 group by attempt.ref_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.admin_goods_import_records_before_additional_categories(target_codes text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], target_ids text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[])
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not coalesce(public.is_staff(),false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff required'; end if;
  return query select entry.value||jsonb_build_object('kcReview',public.admin_read_goods_kc(entry.value#>>'{good,id}'),
    'fingerprint',private.goods_import_fingerprint(entry.value#>>'{good,id}'))
    from private.admin_goods_import_records_before_kc(target_codes,target_ids) entry(value);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.admin_goods_import_records_before_kc(target_codes text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[], target_ids text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[])
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare can_read_costs boolean:=private.can_manage_goods_purchase_costs();
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not public.is_staff() then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff_required'; end if;
  if coalesce(cardinality(target_codes),0)+coalesce(cardinality(target_ids),0)>500 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='import_record_limit';
  end if;
  return query select jsonb_build_object('good',to_jsonb(good),'fingerprint',private.goods_import_fingerprint(good.id),
    'variants',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(variant)
      ||jsonb_build_object('erp_code',external_identity.erp_code,'erp_name',external_identity.erp_name,
        'barcode',external_identity.barcode,'external_updated_at',external_identity.updated_at)
      ||case when can_read_costs then jsonb_build_object('purchase_cost_krw',cost.unit_cost_krw,
        'purchase_tax_basis',cost.tax_basis,'purchase_cost_revision',cost.revision) else '{}'::jsonb end
      order by variant.is_default desc,variant.sort_order,variant.id),'[]'::jsonb)
      from public.goods_variants variant
      left join private.goods_variant_external_identity external_identity on external_identity.variant_id=variant.id
      left join private.goods_variant_purchase_costs cost on cost.variant_id=variant.id where variant.good_id=good.id))
    from public.goods good where good.code=any(target_codes) or good.id=any(target_ids) order by good.id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.admin_goods_sale_period_matches(p_period text, p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_ends_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case p_period
    when 'scheduled' then p_starts_at is not null and now() < p_starts_at
    when 'ended' then p_ends_at is not null and now() >= p_ends_at
    else true end
$function$
