CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_instant_discount_schedule(p_good_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with good as (
    select g.id, g.price, g.compare_at_price from public.goods g where g.id = p_good_id
  ), live as (
    select p.id, p.variant_id, p.revision, p.regular_price, p.discount_price, p.starts_at, p.ends_at, p.promotion_id,
      v.archived_at as variant_archived_at
    from private.goods_variant_price_periods p
    join public.goods_variants v on v.id = p.variant_id
    where p.good_id = p_good_id and p.state = 'active' and p.ends_at > pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()
  ), active_variants as (
    select v.id from public.goods_variants v where v.good_id = p_good_id and v.archived_at is null
  ), facts as (
    select
      (select count(*) from live) as live_count,
      (select count(distinct variant_id) from live) as live_variants,
      (select count(*) from live where variant_archived_at is not null) as archived_rows,
      (select count(*) from active_variants) as active_count,
      (select count(*) from active_variants a where not exists(select 1 from live l where l.variant_id = a.id)) as uncovered,
      (select count(distinct starts_at) from live) as start_count,
      (select count(distinct ends_at) from live) as end_count,
      (select count(distinct regular_price - discount_price) from live) as amount_count,
      (select count(*) from live where promotion_id is not null) as promotion_rows,
      (select min(regular_price - discount_price) from live) as amount,
      (select min(starts_at) from live) as starts_at,
      (select max(ends_at) from live) as ends_at,
      (select min(discount_price) from live) as min_price,
      (select max(discount_price) from live) as max_price,
      (select coalesce(g.compare_at_price > g.price, false) from good g) as instant_active
  ), judged as (
    select f.*,
      case
        when f.live_count = 0 then 'none'
        when f.promotion_rows = 0 and not coalesce(f.instant_active, false) and f.archived_rows = 0 and f.uncovered = 0
          and f.live_count = f.live_variants and f.live_variants = f.active_count
          and f.start_count = 1 and f.end_count = 1 and f.amount_count = 1 then 'editable'
        else 'managed'
      end as state
    from facts f
  )
  select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'state', j.state,
    'reason', case when j.state <> 'managed' then null
      when j.promotion_rows > 0 then 'promotion'
      when coalesce(j.instant_active, false) then 'instant'
      else 'mixed' end,
    'uncovered', case when j.live_count = 0 then 0 else j.uncovered end,
    'fingerprint', case when j.live_count = 0 then 'none' else pg_catalog.md5((
      select pg_catalog.string_agg(l.id::text || ':' || l.revision::text, ',' order by l.id) from live l)) end,
    'period', case when j.state = 'editable' then pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'amount', j.amount, 'startsAt', j.starts_at, 'endsAt', j.ends_at) end,
    'summary', case when j.live_count = 0 then null else pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'count', j.live_count, 'minPrice', j.min_price, 'maxPrice', j.max_price, 'startsAt', j.starts_at, 'endsAt', j.ends_at) end,
    'promotions', coalesce((
      select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id', promotion.id, 'name', promotion.name) order by promotion.name, promotion.id)
      from private.discount_promotions promotion
      where promotion.id in (select l.promotion_id from live l where l.promotion_id is not null)), '[]'::jsonb))
  from judged j;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_listing_metrics()
 RETURNS TABLE(good_id text, sales_total bigint, sales_30d bigint, wish_count bigint, review_count bigint, rating_average numeric, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with bounds as (
    select date_trunc('day', statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as today,
      statement_timestamp() as captured_at
  ), eligible as materialized (
    select g.id, g.created_at
    from public.goods g
    where g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction = 'none'
      and exists(select 1 from public.ips ip where ip.id = g.ip_id and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null)
  ), total_sales as (
    select s.good_id, s.quantity from bounds
    cross join lateral private.goods_effective_sales('-infinity'::timestamptz, bounds.captured_at) s
  ), recent_sales as (
    select s.good_id, s.quantity from bounds
    cross join lateral private.goods_effective_sales(bounds.today - interval '30 days', bounds.today) s
  ), wishes as (
    select w.good_id, count(*) as wish_count from public.wishlists w join eligible on eligible.id = w.good_id group by w.good_id
  ), review_stats as (
    select r.good_id, count(*) as review_count, round(avg(r.rating)::numeric, 2) as rating_average
    from public.reviews r join eligible on eligible.id = r.good_id
    where r.status = 'visible' group by r.good_id
  )
  select e.id, coalesce(ts.quantity, 0)::bigint, coalesce(rs.quantity, 0)::bigint, coalesce(w.wish_count, 0)::bigint,
    coalesce(r.review_count, 0)::bigint, r.rating_average, e.created_at
  from eligible e
  left join total_sales ts on ts.good_id = e.id
  left join recent_sales rs on rs.good_id = e.id
  left join wishes w on w.good_id = e.id
  left join review_stats r on r.good_id = e.id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_media_metadata_valid(p_metadata jsonb, p_source_size integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare field text;
begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_metadata)<>'object' or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(p_metadata))<>7
  or not p_metadata ?& array['width','height','durationMs','byteSize','sha256','videoCodec','audioCodec'] then return false;end if;
 foreach field in array array['width','height','durationMs','byteSize'] loop
  if jsonb_typeof(p_metadata->field)<>'number' or (p_metadata->>field)!~'^[0-9]{1,8}$' then return false;end if;
 end loop;
 return (p_metadata->>'width')::integer between 1 and 1920 and (p_metadata->>'height')::integer between 1 and 1920
  and (p_metadata->>'durationMs')::integer between 1 and 60000 and (p_metadata->>'byteSize')::integer=p_source_size
  and p_source_size between 1 and 52428800 and jsonb_typeof(p_metadata->'sha256')='string' and jsonb_typeof(p_metadata->'videoCodec')='string' and p_metadata->>'sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  and p_metadata->>'videoCodec'~'^avc1\.[a-fA-F0-9]{6}$' and (p_metadata->'audioCodec'='null'::jsonb or p_metadata->>'audioCodec'='mp4a.40.2');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_order_snapshot_matches_v1(p_order_id uuid, p_total bigint, p_shipping_fee bigint)
 RETURNS boolean

 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

    (select purchase.discount_total+purchase.store_credit_total from public.orders purchase where purchase.id=p_order_id)=p_total
    and bool_and(item.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation
      where reservation.order_item_id=item.id and reservation.order_id=item.order_id and reservation.policy_id=item.preorder_policy_id
        and reservation.qty=item.qty and reservation.state in ('reserved','allocated')))
  from public.order_items item where item.order_id=p_order_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_preorder_remaining(p_policy_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  -- Allocation permanently consumes the approved future supply. A later refund
  -- restores physical stock, so it must not also reopen future-sale capacity.
  select case when policy.capacity_qty is null then null else greatest(0,policy.capacity_qty::bigint-coalesce((select sum(reservation.qty::bigint)
    from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation where reservation.policy_id=policy.id and reservation.state<>'released'),0))::integer end
  from private.goods_preorder_policies policy where policy.id=p_policy_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_preorder_schedule_change_document(p_change_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with changed as (
  select s.order_id,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentId',pc.shipment_id,
    'label',coalesce(s.shipment_number,upper(right(s.id::text,8))),'originName',s.origin_name_snapshot,
    'fromDate',pc.from_date,'toDate',pc.to_date,'noticeOnly',pc.from_date=pc.to_date) order by pc.shipment_id) shipments
  from private.order_shipment_promise_changes pc join public.order_shipments s on s.id=pc.shipment_id
  where pc.bulk_change_id=p_change_id group by s.order_id
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'goodId',c.good_id,'goodName',g.name,'variantId',c.variant_id,'variantName',v.name,
  'expectedShipDate',c.to_date,'reason',c.reason,'title',n.title,'customerBody',n.customer_body,'actorName',a.nickname,
  'createdAt',c.created_at,'noticeId',c.notice_id,'requestedAt',n.requested_at,
  'emailEnabled',coalesce((select control.enabled from private.order_delay_notice_delivery_control control where control.singleton),false),
  'smsQueued',c.sms_queued,'shipmentCount',c.shipment_count,'orderCount',c.order_count,'excludedCount',cardinality(c.excluded_shipment_ids),
  'conditionExcludedCount',case when c.condition_excluded_counts is null then null
    else (select coalesce(sum(counted.value::integer),0) from jsonb_each_text(c.condition_excluded_counts) counted) end,
  'conditionExcludedCounts',c.condition_excluded_counts,
  'policyAction',c.policy_action,'policies',c.policies,
  'targets',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'orderId',t.order_id,'orderNumber',o.order_number,'audience',t.audience,
    'hasEmail',t.recipient_email is not null,'shipments',coalesce(changed.shipments,'[]'::jsonb),'inAppStatus',t.in_app_status,
    'emailStatus',case when i.state in ('accepted','sent','delivered','delayed') then 'sent'
      when i.state in ('bounced','complained','failed') then 'failed' when i.state='suppressed' then 'suppressed' else t.email_status end,
    'emailProviderState',i.state,
    'errorCode',case when i.state in ('bounced','complained','failed') then 'provider_rejected'
      when i.state='suppressed' then 'provider_suppressed' else t.error_code end,
    'retryable',t.retryable and coalesce(i.accepted_at is null,true)
      and coalesce(i.state not in ('needs_review','failed','bounced','complained','suppressed'),true),
    'smsStatus',sms.status,'smsReason',sms.reason) order by o.order_number,t.audience,t.id)
    from private.order_delay_notice_targets t join public.orders o on o.id=t.order_id
    left join changed on changed.order_id=t.order_id
    left join private.email_intents i on i.id=t.email_intent_id
    left join private.order_delay_notice_sms_jobs sms on sms.target_id=t.id
    where t.notice_id=c.notice_id),'[]'::jsonb))
 from private.goods_preorder_schedule_changes c join public.goods g on g.id=c.good_id
 left join public.goods_variants v on v.id=c.variant_id
 join private.order_delay_notices n on n.id=c.notice_id
 left join public.profiles a on a.id=c.actor_id
 where c.id=p_change_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_preorder_schedule_open_policies(p_good_id text, p_variant_id uuid, p_to_date date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with selected as (
  select v.id variant_id,v.name variant_name,v.sort_order,policy.id policy_id,policy.revision,policy.state,policy.starts_at,policy.ends_at,
   policy.expected_ship_date,private.goods_preorder_remaining(policy.id) remaining
  from public.goods_variants v join private.goods_preorder_policies policy on policy.id=v.preorder_policy_id
  where v.good_id=p_good_id and v.archived_at is null and (p_variant_id is null or v.id=p_variant_id)
 ), open as (
  select * from selected where state='active' and ends_at>statement_timestamp() and expected_ship_date<>p_to_date and coalesce(remaining,0)>0
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'policies',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variantId',o.variant_id,'variantName',o.variant_name,'policyId',o.policy_id,
    'revision',o.revision,'expectedShipDate',o.expected_ship_date,'startsAt',o.starts_at,'endsAt',o.ends_at,'remainingQty',o.remaining)
    order by o.sort_order,o.variant_id) from open o),'[]'::jsonb),
  'blockReason',case
   when not exists(select 1 from open) then null
   when exists(select 1 from open where p_to_date<(ends_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date) then 'before_sale_end'
   when (select option_sale_mode from public.goods where id=p_good_id)='random'
    and (exists(select 1 from selected where variant_id not in (select variant_id from open))
     or exists(select 1 from public.goods_variants v where v.good_id=p_good_id and v.archived_at is null and v.preorder_policy_id is null))
    then 'random_option_state'
  end)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_preorder_schedule_plan(p_good_id text, p_variant_id uuid, p_to_date date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with scoped as (
  select distinct link.shipment_id
  from public.goods_variants v
  join public.order_items item on item.variant_id=v.id and item.good_id=v.good_id
  join public.order_shipment_items link on link.order_id=item.order_id and link.order_item_id=item.id
  where v.good_id=p_good_id and (p_variant_id is null or v.id=p_variant_id) and item.supply_source='preorder'
 ), base as (
  select s.id shipment_id,s.order_id,o.order_number,o.status::text order_status,o.payment_method::text payment_method,
   coalesce(s.shipment_number,upper(right(s.id::text,8))) shipment_label,s.origin_name_snapshot origin_name,
   s.status shipment_status,s.exported_at,s.original_expected_ship_date original_date,s.expected_ship_date current_date_value,
   (extract(epoch from s.updated_at)*1000000)::bigint version,
   (select max(other.preorder_expected_ship_date) from public.order_shipment_items other_link
     join public.order_items other on other.order_id=other_link.order_id and other.id=other_link.order_item_id
     where other_link.shipment_id=s.id and other.supply_source='preorder'
      and not (other.good_id=p_good_id and (p_variant_id is null or other.variant_id=p_variant_id))) other_bound,
   coalesce((select change.bulk_change_id is null from private.order_shipment_promise_changes change where change.shipment_id=s.id
     order by change.created_at desc,change.id desc limit 1),false) individually_changed,
   coalesce((select change.to_date from private.order_shipment_promise_changes change where change.shipment_id=s.id and change.bulk_change_id is not null
     order by change.created_at desc,change.id desc limit 1),s.original_expected_ship_date) known_date,
   exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id and c.status in ('requested','processing','needs_review'))
    or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=o.id) cancellation
  from scoped join public.order_shipments s on s.id=scoped.shipment_id join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
 ), dated as (
  select b.*,greatest(p_to_date,b.other_bound) new_date,
   greatest(p_to_date,b.other_bound)=b.current_date_value and b.individually_changed and b.current_date_value<>b.known_date notice_only
  from base b
 ), planned as (
  select d.*,
   case
    when d.order_status='canceled' or d.shipment_status='canceled' then 'canceled'
    when d.shipment_status in ('shipping','delivered') then 'shipped'
    when d.exported_at is not null then 'exported'
    when d.cancellation then 'cancellation_in_progress'
    when d.order_status not in ('pending','paid','confirmed','shipping') or d.original_date is null then 'not_open'
    when d.other_bound is not null and p_to_date<d.other_bound and p_to_date<>d.current_date_value
      and d.new_date=d.current_date_value and not d.notice_only then 'other_preorder'
    when d.new_date=d.current_date_value and not d.notice_only then 'unchanged'
    when d.other_bound is not null and d.new_date<d.current_date_value then 'other_preorder'
   end reason
  from dated d
 ), policies as (
  select private.goods_preorder_schedule_open_policies(p_good_id,p_variant_id,p_to_date) value
 )
 select jsonb_build_object(
  'targets',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentId',p.shipment_id,'orderId',p.order_id,'orderNumber',p.order_number,
    'shipmentLabel',p.shipment_label,'originName',p.origin_name,'orderStatus',p.order_status,'paymentMethod',p.payment_method,
    'currentDate',p.current_date_value,'originalDate',p.original_date,'knownDate',p.known_date,'newDate',p.new_date,
    'noticeOnly',p.notice_only,'individuallyChanged',p.individually_changed,'otherPreorder',p.other_bound is not null,'version',p.version)
    order by p.order_number,p.shipment_label,p.shipment_id) from planned p where p.reason is null),'[]'::jsonb),
  'excluded',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row_value order by sort_key) from (
    select jsonb_build_object('shipmentId',p.shipment_id,'orderId',p.order_id,'orderNumber',p.order_number,'shipmentLabel',p.shipment_label,
      'originName',p.origin_name,'orderStatus',p.order_status,'currentDate',p.current_date_value,'reason',p.reason) row_value,
      array_position(array['cancellation_in_progress','other_preorder','unchanged','exported','not_open','shipped','canceled'],p.reason)::text
       ||':'||p.order_number||':'||p.shipment_label sort_key
    from planned p where p.reason is not null
    order by array_position(array['cancellation_in_progress','other_preorder','unchanged','exported','not_open','shipped','canceled'],p.reason),
     p.order_number,p.shipment_label limit 500) shown),'[]'::jsonb),
  'excludedCounts',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(counted.reason,counted.total) from
    (select p.reason,count(*) total from planned p where p.reason is not null group by p.reason) counted),'{}'::jsonb),
  'excludedTotal',(select count(*) from planned p where p.reason is not null),
  'targetShipments',(select count(*) from planned p where p.reason is null),
  'targetOrders',(select count(distinct p.order_id) from planned p where p.reason is null),
  'openPolicies',(select value->'policies' from policies),
  'policyBlockReason',(select value->>'blockReason' from policies),
  'fingerprint',md5(coalesce((select string_agg(p.shipment_id::text||':'||p.version::text||':'||p.new_date::text||':'||p.notice_only::text,',' order by p.shipment_id)
    from planned p where p.reason is null),'')||'|'||coalesce((select string_agg(policy->>'policyId'||':'||(policy->>'revision'),',' order by policy->>'policyId')
    from policies,jsonb_array_elements(policies.value->'policies') policy),''))
 )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_transaction_base_shipping_quote(p_items jsonb, p_legacy_quote jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare lines jsonb;begin
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) i("goodId" text) join private.shipping_charge_group_assignments a on a.owner_good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(i."goodId") and a.group_id is not null) then raise check_violation using message='checkout_contract_upgrade_required';end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) i("goodId" text) join private.goods_aggregation_members m on m.good_id=i."goodId") and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) item("goodId" text,"variantId" uuid,qty integer)
  join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(item."goodId")
  join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id where d.status='active' and d.quantity_terms is not null) then return p_legacy_quote;end if;
 select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('origin_id',grouped.origin_id,'good_id',grouped.good_id,'qty',1,'unit_price',grouped.subtotal,
  'fee_type',case when grouped.quantity_terms is null then grouped.shipping_fee_type else 'individual' end,
  'individual_fee',case when grouped.quantity_terms is null then grouped.individual_fee else private.goods_quantity_delivery_fee(grouped.qty,grouped.quantity_terms) end))
 into lines from(select good.id good_id,good.origin_id,good.shipping_fee_type,good.individual_fee,d.quantity_terms,
   sum(item.qty::numeric) qty,sum(item.qty::numeric*pricing.effective_price) subtotal
  from jsonb_to_recordset(p_items) item("goodId" text,"variantId" uuid,qty integer)
  join public.goods good on good.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(item."goodId") join public.goods_variants variant on variant.id=item."variantId" and variant.good_id=item."goodId"
  cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_variant_price(variant.id,p_at) pricing
  left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=good.id
  left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id and d.status='active'
  group by good.id,good.origin_id,good.shipping_fee_type,good.individual_fee,d.quantity_terms) grouped;
 return private.calculate_goods_shipping(lines);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.goods_transaction_snapshot_matches(p_order_id uuid, p_total bigint, p_shipping_fee bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders purchase where purchase.id=p_order_id and purchase.calculation_version=2
  and purchase.total=p_total and purchase.shipping_fee=p_shipping_fee
  and exists(select 1 from private.order_goods_transactions where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select count(*)>0 and bool_and(item.volume_discount_total=item.qty::numeric*item.volume_unit_discount)
   and sum(item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price)-sum(item.volume_discount_total)+purchase.shipping_fee-purchase.discount_total-purchase.store_credit_total=purchase.total
   and sum(item.volume_discount_total)=purchase.volume_discount_total
   and bool_and(item.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation
    where reservation.order_item_id=item.id and reservation.order_id=item.order_id and reservation.policy_id=item.preorder_policy_id
     and reservation.qty=item.qty and reservation.state in('reserved','allocated')))
   from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_items item left join private.order_price_allocations a on a.order_item_id=item.id
   where item.order_id=purchase.id and (a.order_item_id is null or a.order_id<>purchase.id or a.subtotal<>item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price
    or a.volume_discount<>item.volume_discount_total))
  and (select sum(a.coupon_discount)=purchase.discount_total and sum(a.store_credit_discount)=purchase.store_credit_total
   and sum(a.paid_goods_total)+purchase.shipping_fee=purchase.total from private.order_price_allocations a where a.order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select coalesce(sum(s.shipping_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_fee and coalesce(sum(s.shipping_collect_fee),0)=purchase.shipping_collect_total
   from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=purchase.id and not exists(
   select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c where c.shipment_id=s.id group by c.shipment_id
    having sum(case when c.payment_mode='prepaid' then c.total_fee else c.installation_fee end)=s.shipping_fee
     and sum(case when c.payment_mode='collect' then c.total_fee-c.installation_fee else 0 end)=s.shipping_collect_fee))
  and not exists(select 1 from private.shipping_charge_components c join public.order_shipments s on s.id=c.shipment_id
   where c.order_id=purchase.id and (s.order_id<>purchase.id or s.origin_id<>c.origin_id or not exists(
    select 1 from public.order_items item where item.order_id=purchase.id and item.good_id=c.good_id and item.origin_id_snapshot=c.origin_id)))
  and (select coalesce(sum(discount_amount) filter(where benefit_kind='goods'),0)=purchase.discount_total
   and coalesce(sum(discount_amount) filter(where benefit_kind='shipping'),0)=purchase.shipping_coupon_discount_total from public.coupon_redemptions where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select coalesce(sum(shipping_coupon_discount),0)=purchase.shipping_coupon_discount_total from private.shipping_charge_components where order_id=purchase.id)
  and (select count(*) from private.shipping_charge_components where order_id=purchase.id)=
   (select count(distinct good_id) from public.order_items where order_id=purchase.id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.grant_grade_benefit_coupons(p_user_id uuid, p_from_grade public.loyalty_grade, p_to_grade public.loyalty_grade)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
begin
  for r in
    select coupon.*, private.coupon_issue_expiry(coupon,statement_timestamp()) as held_expiry
    from public.coupons as coupon
    where coupon.status = 'active'
      and private.coupon_recipient_reason(coupon.recipient_segment,p_user_id) is null
      -- 이미 끝난 정의는 발급하지 않는다 — 쓸 수 없는 쿠폰을 혜택이라 말하며
      -- 유한 발급 한도만 소모하게 된다.
      and (coupon.ends_at is null or coupon.ends_at > now())
      and (coupon.issue_starts_at is null or coupon.issue_starts_at<=statement_timestamp())
      and (coupon.issue_starts_at is null or coupon.issue_ends_at is null or coupon.issue_ends_at>statement_timestamp())
      and coupon.grade_benefit is not null
      and coupon.grade_benefit_cadence = 'upgrade'
      and coupon.grade_benefit > p_from_grade
      and coupon.grade_benefit <= p_to_grade
    order by coupon.code
    for update
  loop
    if r.issue_limit is not null and r.issued_count >= r.issue_limit then
      continue;
    end if;

    if exists (
      select 1 from public.user_coupons as held
      where held.coupon_code = r.code and held.user_id = p_user_id
    ) then
      continue;
    end if;

    update public.coupons
    set issued_count = issued_count + 1
    where code = r.code;

    insert into public.user_coupons (coupon_code, user_id, issued_source, expires_at)
    values (r.code, p_user_id, 'grade_benefit', r.held_expiry);
  end loop;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.guard_active_catalog_parent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  parent_archived_at timestamptz;
begin
  if tg_table_name = 'cards' then
    if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
      perform pool.id
      from public.card_pools as pool
      where pool.id = new.pool_id
      order by pool.id
      for update of pool;
    else
      perform pool.id
      from public.card_pools as pool
      where pool.id = old.pool_id
         or pool.id = new.pool_id
      order by pool.id
      for update of pool;
    end if;
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    perform ip.id
    from public.ips as ip
    where ip.id = new.ip_id
    order by ip.id
    for update of ip;
  else
    perform ip.id
    from public.ips as ip
    where ip.id = old.ip_id
       or ip.id = new.ip_id
    order by ip.id
    for update of ip;
  end if;

  if new.archived_at is not null or new.ip_id is null then
    return new;
  end if;

  select ip.archived_at
    into parent_archived_at
  from public.ips as ip
  where ip.id = new.ip_id;

  if found and parent_archived_at is not null then
    raise check_violation using message = 'parent_archived';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.guard_draw_ticket_issuance()

AS $function$
declare
  gate_enabled boolean;
begin
  -- Serialize issuance against an operator disabling the singleton. Either the
  -- issuance transaction finishes first, or it observes OFF after the update.
  select control.enabled
  into gate_enabled
  from private.card_reward_control as control
  where control.singleton
  for share;

  if not coalesce(gate_enabled, false) then

    return null;
  end if;

  return new;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.guard_ip_archive()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.goods as good
    where good.ip_id = new.id
      and good.archived_at is null
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from public.cards as card
    where card.ip_id = new.id
      and card.archived_at is null
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from public.events as event_record
    where event_record.ip_id = new.id
      and event_record.archived_at is null
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'ip_has_active_children';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.card_pools as pool
    where pool.ip_id = new.id
      and (pool.active_to is null or pool.active_to > pg_catalog.now())
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from public.reward_policies as policy
    where policy.target_ip_id = new.id
      and policy.active
      and (policy.active_to is null or policy.active_to > pg_catalog.now())
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from public.games as game
    join public.events as event_record on event_record.id = game.event_id
    where event_record.ip_id = new.id
      and (game.active_to is null or game.active_to > pg_catalog.now())
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from public.games as game
    join public.card_pools as pool on pool.id = game.reward_pool_id
    where pool.ip_id = new.id
      and (game.active_to is null or game.active_to > pg_catalog.now())
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'ip_has_active_operations';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.home_curations as curation
    where curation.kind = 'featured_ip'
      and curation.ip_id = new.id
      and curation.enabled
      and (curation.active_to is null or curation.active_to > pg_catalog.now())
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'ip_has_active_home_curation';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

  join private.billing_profiles p on p.id=c.profile_id join private.goods_subscription_cycles x on x.id=new.cycle_id
  join private.goods_subscription_plans g on g.id=x.plan_id
  where a.id=new.attempt_id and a.provider='toss' and a.purpose='order' and a.user_id=new.owner_id and a.ref_id=x.order_id
   and c.owner_id=new.owner_id and x.owner_id=new.owner_id and g.credential_id=c.id and c.profile_id=new.profile_id
   and p.merchant_id=new.merchant_id and p.environment=new.environment) then
  raise check_violation using message='billing_financial_binding_invalid';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.guard_unresolved_goods_payment_cancellation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'canceled'
    and old.status is distinct from 'canceled'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.payment_attempts as attempt
      where attempt.purpose = 'order'
        and attempt.ref_id = old.id
        and not(attempt.provider='bank_transfer' and attempt.state='approved'
          and private.bank_transfer_refund_pending_evidence_valid(old.id,attempt.payment_id))

        and (
          attempt.state in (
            'prepared',
            'confirming',
            'unknown',
            'needs_review'
          )
          or (
            attempt.state = 'approved'
            and not exists (
              select 1
              from public.payments as payment
              where payment.id = attempt.payment_id
                and payment.provider = attempt.provider
                and payment.purpose = 'order'
                and payment.ref_id = attempt.ref_id
                and payment.status in ('canceled', 'refunded')
            )
          )
        )
    )
  then
    raise check_violation using
      message = 'goods_payment_attempt_requires_reconciliation';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

  where p.id=p_actor and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=statement_timestamp())
   and p.suspended_at is null and p.onboarded_at is not null
   and nullif(btrim(coalesce(p.email,u.email),U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF'),'') is not null

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.inquiry_satisfaction_staff_insert()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.author<>'staff' then return new;end if;
 -- No account lock here: the established staff writer already owns the parent.
 perform 1 from public.inquiries where id=new.inquiry_id for update;
 if not found then raise foreign_key_violation using message='inquiry_satisfaction_parent_missing';end if;
 insert into private.inquiry_satisfaction_state(inquiry_id,latest_answer_id,revision)
 values(new.inquiry_id,new.id,1)
 on conflict(inquiry_id) do update set latest_answer_id=excluded.latest_answer_id,
  value_answer_id=null,value=null,rated_at=null,revision=private.inquiry_satisfaction_state.revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp();
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.inquiry_satisfaction_viewer()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid(); session_text text:=auth.jwt()->>'session_id';
begin
 if actor is null or session_text is null or session_text!~*'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then return null;end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from auth.users u join public.profiles p on p.id=u.id
  join auth.sessions s on s.user_id=u.id and s.id=session_text::uuid
  where u.id=actor and u.deleted_at is null and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>statement_timestamp())) then return null;end if;
 return actor;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.lock_claim_refund_account_session(p_actor uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 -- A logout/expiry update and an accepted write have a single ordering point.
 -- Readers that only return context remain STABLE and do not take row locks.
 perform id from auth.sessions where id=p_session_id and user_id=p_actor
  and (not_after is null or not_after>clock_timestamp()) for share;
 if not found then raise insufficient_privilege using message='refund_account_auth_changed';end if;
 perform private.require_claim_refund_account_identity(p_actor,p_session_id);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.loyalty_monthly_coupon_run_summaries(p_limit integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'grantMonth', to_char(run.grant_month, 'YYYY-MM'),
      'startedAt', run.started_at,
      'finishedAt', run.finished_at,
      'finishReason', run.finish_reason,
      'members', run.member_count,
      'recipients', run.recipient_count,
      'granted', run.granted_count,
      'skipped', run.skipped_count,
      'coupons', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code', issued.coupon_code, 'name', coalesce(coupon.name, issued.coupon_code), 'granted', issued.granted)
          order by issued.coupon_code)
        from (
          select held.coupon_code, count(*)::integer as granted
          from public.user_coupons as held
          where held.grade_benefit_month = run.grant_month
          group by held.coupon_code
        ) as issued
        left join public.coupons as coupon on coupon.code = issued.coupon_code
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by run.grant_month desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select * from private.loyalty_monthly_coupon_runs
    order by grant_month desc
    limit greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limit, 6), 24))
  ) as run;
$function$

  'segmentRevision',c.segment_revision,'segmentName',s.name,'rule',c.rule,'ruleHash',c.rule_hash,'content',c.content,'coupon',private.marketing_coupon_document(c.content->>'couponCode'),'schedule',c.schedule,'exclusion',c.exclusion,
  'createdAt',c.created_at,'updatedAt',c.updated_at,'archived',c.archived_at is not null,
  'estimate',private.customer_segment_estimate_document(c.estimate_id),
  'selectedProducts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','good','id',g.id,'label',g.name,'extra',g.code) order by requested.position) from jsonb_array_elements_text(c.content->'goodIds') with ordinality requested(id,position) join public.goods g on g.id=requested.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'runs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'scheduledAt',r.scheduled_at,'state',r.state,'reason',r.reason,'startedAt',r.started_at,'completedAt',r.completed_at,
   'candidateCount',r.candidate_count,'sentCount',(select count(*) from private.marketing_recipients rec where rec.run_id=r.id and rec.state='sent'),
   'excludedCount',(select count(*) from private.marketing_recipients rec where rec.run_id=r.id and rec.state='excluded'),
   'readCount',(select count(*) from private.marketing_recipients rec join public.notifications n on n.id=rec.notification_id where rec.run_id=r.id and n.read_at is not null)) order by r.scheduled_at,r.id)
   from private.marketing_runs r where r.campaign_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb)) from private.marketing_campaigns c join private.customer_segments s on s.id=c.segment_id where c.id=p_id;

  where g.id is null or g.archived_at is not null or g.published_at is null or g.sale_restriction<>'none' or i.archived_at is not null or i.published_at is null) and (p_content->>'couponCode' is null or exists(select 1 from public.coupons c where c.code=p_content->>'couponCode' and c.status='active' and c.issuance_mode='code' and (c.ends_at is null or c.ends_at>statement_timestamp()) and ((case when c.issue_starts_at is null then c.ends_at else c.issue_ends_at end) is null or (case when c.issue_starts_at is null then c.ends_at else c.issue_ends_at end)>statement_timestamp())));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.marketing_coupon_document(p_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('code',c.code,'name',c.name,'benefitKind',c.benefit_kind,'stackable',c.stackable,'discountType',c.discount_type,'discountValue',c.discount_value,
  'maxDiscountAmount',c.max_discount_amount,'minSubtotal',c.min_subtotal,'startsAt',c.starts_at,'endsAt',c.ends_at,

  'available',c.status='active' and c.issuance_mode='code' and coalesce(c.issue_starts_at,c.starts_at)<=statement_timestamp()
    and ((case when c.issue_starts_at is null then c.ends_at else c.issue_ends_at end) is null or (case when c.issue_starts_at is null then c.ends_at else c.issue_ends_at end)>statement_timestamp())
    and (c.ends_at is null or c.ends_at>statement_timestamp()) and (c.issue_limit is null or c.issued_count<c.issue_limit))
 from public.coupons c where c.code=p_code;

 from private.marketing_links l left join public.goods g on g.id=l.good_id left join public.shopping_stories s on s.id=l.story_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.materialize_order_fulfillment_holds(p_order_id uuid)

declare inserted integer;
begin
  insert into private.order_fulfillment_holds(order_id, reason, evidence_key, payment_attempt_id, detail)
  select p_order_id, 'test_payment', 'test_payment:' || a.id::text, a.id,

  get diagnostics inserted = row_count;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.member_variant_reserved_qty(p_user_id uuid, p_variant_id uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$

  from public.orders o join public.order_items item on item.order_id=o.id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.my_review_targets_v2_before_numbers(target_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_good_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, target_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, good_id text, good_name text, good_bg text, good_image_path text, ordered_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone, deadline_at timestamp with time zone, writable boolean, review_id uuid, review_rating smallint, review_body text, review_image_paths text[], review_status text, review_created_at timestamp with time zone, review_edited_at timestamp with time zone, admin_reply text, admin_reply_at timestamp with time zone, review_kind text, opens_at timestamp with time zone, editable boolean, month_reward_eligible boolean, repeat_purchase boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 50), 1), 200);
begin
  if v_actor is null then
    raise invalid_authorization_specification using message = 'auth_required';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    ordered.id as order_id,
    item.good_id,
    good.name as good_name,
    good.bg as good_bg,
    good.image_path as good_image_path,
    ordered.created_at as ordered_at,
    ordered.delivered_at,
    coalesce(review.write_deadline_at,w.deadline_at) as deadline_at,
    (
      review.id is null
      and ordered.delivered_at is not null
      and now() between w.opens_at and w.deadline_at
      and (kind.value='ordinary' or private.review_event_purchase_eligible(ordered.id,v_actor,item.good_id))
      and not private.is_account_write_fenced(v_actor)
    ) as writable,
    review.id as review_id,
    review.rating as review_rating,
    review.body as review_body,
    review.image_paths as review_image_paths,
    review.status as review_status,
    review.created_at as review_created_at,
    review.edited_at as review_edited_at,
    review.admin_reply,
    review.admin_reply_at,kind.value,w.opens_at,
    review.id is not null and review.status='visible' and now()<=coalesce(review.write_deadline_at,w.deadline_at) and (kind.value='ordinary' or private.review_event_purchase_eligible(ordered.id,v_actor,item.good_id)) and not private.is_account_write_fenced(v_actor),
    coalesce(review.month_reward_eligible,w.reward_eligible,false),review.repeat_purchase
  from public.orders as ordered
  join (select distinct oi.order_id,oi.good_id from public.order_items oi) as item on item.order_id = ordered.id
  join public.goods as good on good.id = item.good_id
  cross join (values('ordinary'::text),('month'::text)) kind(value)
  left join lateral private.review_type_window(ordered,kind.value)w on true
  left join public.reviews as review
    on review.order_id = ordered.id
    and review.good_id = item.good_id
    and review.user_id = v_actor
    and review.review_kind = kind.value
  where ordered.user_id = v_actor
    and ordered.status in ('delivered', 'done')
    and(kind.value='ordinary' or w.opens_at is not null or review.id is not null)
    and (target_order_id is null or ordered.id = target_order_id)
    and (target_good_id is null or item.good_id = target_good_id)
  /* 쓸 수 있는 것이 먼저, 그중에서도 기한이 임박한 것이 위로. */
  order by
    case when review.id is null then 0 else 1 end,
    ordered.delivered_at desc nulls last,
    item.good_id
  limit v_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.next_commerce_sequence(p_business_day date, p_kind smallint)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer;
begin
  if p_business_day is null or not isfinite(p_business_day) or p_business_day not between date '2000-01-01' and date '9999-12-31'
    or p_kind is null or p_kind not in (1,2,3) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_commerce_number_input';
  end if;
  insert into private.commerce_number_counters as counter(business_date,kind,last_value)

  or not(jsonb_typeof(e.value)='string' and e.value#>>'{}' in('prepaid','collect') or private.transaction_json_keys(e.value,array['method','paymentMode'])
   and e.value->>'method' in('parcel','quick','pickup','direct','freight','none','digital') and e.value->>'paymentMode' in('prepaid','collect'))) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_delivery_choices';end if;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.normalize_goods_transaction_selection(p_selection jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare entry jsonb;result jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_selection) is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_selection) not between 1 and 19239
  or octet_length(p_selection::text)>2097152 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_transaction_selection';end if;
 for entry in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_selection) loop
  if not private.transaction_json_keys(entry,array['goodId','variantId','qty','inputRevision','inputValues'])
   or jsonb_typeof(entry->'goodId') is distinct from 'string' or char_length(entry->>'goodId') not between 1 and 200
   or entry->>'goodId'<>btrim(entry->>'goodId') or entry->>'goodId'~'[[:cntrl:]]'
   or jsonb_typeof(entry->'variantId') is distinct from 'string' or entry->>'variantId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
   or not private.transaction_uint(entry->'qty',1,2147483647) or not private.transaction_uint(entry->'inputRevision',0,2147483647)
   or jsonb_typeof(entry->'inputValues') is distinct from 'object' then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_transaction_selection';end if;
  if (select count(*) from jsonb_each(entry->'inputValues'))>5
   or (((entry->>'inputRevision')::integer=0) is distinct from (entry->'inputValues'='{}'::jsonb))
   or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(entry->'inputValues') e where e.key!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    or jsonb_typeof(e.value) is distinct from 'string' or char_length(e.value#>>'{}') not between 1 and 100
    or (e.value#>>'{}')<>btrim(e.value#>>'{}') or (e.value#>>'{}')~'[[:cntrl:]]') then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_transaction_selection';end if;
 end loop;
 if (select count(distinct value-'qty') from jsonb_array_elements(p_selection))<>jsonb_array_length(p_selection) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='duplicate_transaction_selection';end if;
 select jsonb_agg(value order by value->>'goodId',value->>'variantId',(value->>'inputRevision')::integer,(value->'inputValues')::text)
  into result from jsonb_array_elements(p_selection);return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.normalize_operator_invitation(p_entry jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare normalized jsonb; email text; name text;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_entry) is distinct from 'object' or p_entry-array['id','email','name','managerRole','duty','tokenHash','sourceDigest','recipientDigest']::text[]<>'{}'::jsonb
    or jsonb_typeof(p_entry->'id') is distinct from 'string' or p_entry->>'id' !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_entry->'email') is distinct from 'string' or jsonb_typeof(p_entry->'name') is distinct from 'string'
    or coalesce(p_entry->>'managerRole','') not in ('primary','deputy','influencer','agency','logistics')
    or coalesce(p_entry->>'duty','') not in ('sales','marketing','cs','design_content','logistics','accounting','management','other')
    or coalesce(p_entry->>'tokenHash','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' or coalesce(p_entry->>'sourceDigest','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' or coalesce(p_entry->>'recipientDigest','') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_operator_invitation'; end if;
  email:=lower(btrim(p_entry->>'email')); name:=btrim(p_entry->>'name');
  if length(email)>320 or email !~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+\.[^[:space:]@]+$' or email ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
    or length(name) not between 1 and 100 or name ~ '[[:cntrl:]]' then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_operator_invitation'; end if;
  normalized:=p_entry||jsonb_build_object('id',(p_entry->>'id')::uuid,'email',email,'name',name);
  return normalized;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.normalize_order_address_change(p_address jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare normalized jsonb; field text;
begin
 if p_address is null or jsonb_typeof(p_address)<>'object'
  or not(p_address ?& array['recipientName','phone','postalCode','address1'])
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p_address)k where k not in ('recipientName','phone','postalCode','address1','address2','deliveryNote'))
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_address)e where jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string') then

 foreach field in array array['recipientName','phone','postalCode','address1','address2','deliveryNote'] loop
  if coalesce(p_address->>field,'')~'[[:cntrl:]]' then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_order_address';end if;
 end loop;
 normalized:=jsonb_build_object('recipientName',btrim(p_address->>'recipientName'),'phone',btrim(p_address->>'phone'),
  'postalCode',btrim(p_address->>'postalCode'),'address1',btrim(p_address->>'address1'),

 if char_length(normalized->>'recipientName') not between 1 and 50 or normalized->>'phone'!~'^[0-9]{8,15}$'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.notify_draw_ticket_insert_statement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  locked_source record;
begin
  for locked_source in
    select
      inserted_ticket.user_id,
      inserted_ticket.source,
      inserted_ticket.source_id
    from inserted_draw_tickets as inserted_ticket
    group by
      inserted_ticket.user_id,
      inserted_ticket.source,
      inserted_ticket.source_id
    order by
      inserted_ticket.user_id,
      inserted_ticket.source,
      inserted_ticket.source_id
  loop
    perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
      pg_catalog.hashtextextended(
        locked_source.user_id::text
          || pg_catalog.chr(31)
          || locked_source.source
          || pg_catalog.chr(31)
          || locked_source.source_id::text,
        0
      )
    );
  end loop;

  with inserted_sources as (
    select
      inserted_ticket.user_id,
      inserted_ticket.source,
      inserted_ticket.source_id
    from inserted_draw_tickets as inserted_ticket
    group by
      inserted_ticket.user_id,
      inserted_ticket.source,
      inserted_ticket.source_id
  ),
  source_totals as (
    select
      inserted_source.user_id,
      inserted_source.source,
      inserted_source.source_id,
      count(*)::integer as ticket_count
    from inserted_sources as inserted_source
    join public.draw_tickets as draw_ticket
      on draw_ticket.user_id = inserted_source.user_id
      and draw_ticket.source = inserted_source.source
      and draw_ticket.source_id = inserted_source.source_id
    group by
      inserted_source.user_id,
      inserted_source.source,
      inserted_source.source_id
  )
  insert into public.notifications (
    user_id,
    type,
    title,
    body,
    link_path,
    source_type,
    source_id,
    dedupe_key
  )
  select
    source_total.user_id,
    'draw_ticket_issued',
    '카드팩이 도착했어요',
    '카드팩 ' || source_total.ticket_count::text || '개가 발급됐습니다.',
    '/packs',
    source_total.source,
    source_total.source_id::text,
    'draw_ticket:' || source_total.source || ':' || source_total.source_id::text
  from source_totals as source_total
  on conflict (user_id, dedupe_key) do update set
    title = excluded.title,
    body = excluded.body,
    read_at = null,
    created_at = now();

  return null;
end;
$function$

 values(p_order,p_item,p_claim,p_terms,p_basis,private.production_deadline(p_basis,p_terms))
 on conflict(order_item_id,claim_id) where claim_id is not null do update set
  state=case when order_production_jobs.completed_at is not null then 'completed' else 'pending' end,
  revision=order_production_jobs.revision+1,
  basis_at=case when order_production_jobs.completed_at is not null then order_production_jobs.basis_at else greatest(excluded.basis_at,clock_timestamp()) end,
  due_at=case when order_production_jobs.completed_at is not null then order_production_jobs.due_at else private.production_deadline(greatest(excluded.basis_at,clock_timestamp()),excluded.terms) end,
  started_at=case when order_production_jobs.completed_at is not null then order_production_jobs.started_at end,
  updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 where order_production_jobs.state='canceled';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.operator_mfa_policy_document()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with operators as (
    select p.id from public.profiles p
    where p.role in ('staff','admin') and private.operator_access_for(p.id)->>'mode'<>'none'
  ), factors as (
    select o.id,
      count(f.id) filter (where f.status::text='verified' and f.factor_type::text='totp') as verified,
      count(f.id) filter (where f.status::text<>'verified' and f.factor_type::text='totp') as unverified,
      max(f.updated_at) filter (where f.status::text='verified' and f.factor_type::text='totp') as verified_at
    from operators o left join auth.mfa_factors f on f.user_id=o.id group by o.id
  ), directory as (
    select r.value||jsonb_build_object('verifiedFactors',f.verified,'unverifiedFactors',f.unverified,'verifiedAt',f.verified_at) as entry
    from jsonb_array_elements(private.operator_directory_rows(coalesce((select array_agg(id) from operators),'{}'::uuid[]))) r
    join factors f on f.id=(r.value->>'id')::uuid
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('required',c.required,'revision',c.revision,'updatedAt',c.updated_at,
    'updatedBy',(select p.nickname from public.profiles p where p.id=c.updated_by),
    'operators',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(entry order by (entry->>'verifiedFactors')::integer,entry->>'nickname',entry->>'id') from directory),'[]'::jsonb),
    'unenrolledCount',(select count(*) from factors where verified=0))
  from private.operator_mfa_policy c where c.singleton;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_address_change_blocker(p_order public.orders)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE

AS $function$

  when p_order.status not in ('paid','confirmed') then 'order_not_ready'
  when p_order.shipped_at is not null or p_order.delivered_at is not null or p_order.done_at is not null then 'order_dispatched'
  when not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments where order_id=p_order.id) then 'shipments_missing'
  when exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments where order_id=p_order.id and
   (status<>'ready' or exported_at is not null or shipped_at is not null or delivered_at is not null or tracking_number is not null)) then 'order_dispatched'
  when exists(select 1 from public.audit_log where target='order:'||p_order.id::text and
   (action='admin.shipment.exported' or (action in ('admin.order.status_updated','admin.shipment.status_updated') and diff->>'to' in ('shipping','delivered','done')))) then 'order_dispatched'
  when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=p_order.id and status in ('requested','processing','needs_review'))
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_order.id) then 'order_claim_open'
  else null end;

 RETURNS boolean

  and exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=target_order)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=target_order and
   coalesce((select sum(link.qty) from public.order_shipment_items link where link.order_item_id=i.id and link.order_id=i.order_id),0)<>private.order_item_active_qty(i.id))
  and (not exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=target_order and
    coalesce((select sum(link.qty) from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_shipments s on s.id=link.shipment_id
     where link.order_item_id=i.id and link.order_id=i.order_id and s.status='delivered' and s.delivered_at is not null),0)<>private.order_item_active_qty(i.id))
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=target_order and c.claim_type='exchange' and c.stage='completed'
    and not private.claim_reshipment_delivery_pending(c) and private.claim_collections_complete(c.id)))

  and o.shipped_at is null and o.delivered_at is null and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and(s.status<>'ready' or s.shipped_at is not null or s.delivered_at is not null)));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_cancel_eligible_before_production(target_order uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select
   -- 고객 직접 취소(ADR-0017): 발주확인 전, 발주·발송 이력 없음.
   (o.status in ('pending','paid') and o.confirmed_at is null
   and o.shipped_at is null and o.delivered_at is null and o.done_at is null
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id
     and (s.status<>'ready' or s.shipped_at is not null or s.delivered_at is not null or s.exported_at is not null))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.audit_log a where a.target='order:'||o.id::text
     and ((a.action='admin.order.status_updated' and a.diff->>'to' in ('confirmed','shipping','delivered','done'))
       or a.action in ('admin.shipment.status_updated','admin.shipment.exported'))))
   or
   -- 운영자 전액 취소(ADR-0018): 발주확인 뒤라도 어떤 배송 건도 발송되지 않았고,
   -- 이 주문에 staff가 사유와 함께 연 취소가 진행 중일 때만. 출고지시 여부는
   -- 접수 RPC가 창고 중단 확인으로 따로 묻는다.
   (o.status in ('paid','confirmed')
   and o.shipped_at is null and o.delivered_at is null and o.done_at is null
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id
     and (s.status not in ('ready','canceled') or s.shipped_at is not null or s.delivered_at is not null))
   and exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests r where r.order_id=o.id
     and r.origin='staff' and r.claim_type='cancel' and r.status in ('processing','needs_review')))
   from public.orders o where o.id=target_order),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_cancel_eligible(target_order uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select not private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(target_order) and (private.order_cancel_eligible_before_digital(target_order) or exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=target_order and o.status in('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done')
  and exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id and i.fulfillment_terms_snapshot->>'mode' in('digital','no_delivery'))
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.delivery_method<>'digital' and(s.status<>'ready' or s.shipped_at is not null or s.delivered_at is not null))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_bulk_context_row(p_claim_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare c public.order_cancellation_requests;pay record;ref record;virtual_account boolean:=false;complete boolean;blocker text;
begin
 select * into c from public.order_cancellation_requests where id=p_claim_id;
 if not found then return null;end if;
 -- 운영 상세(admin_order_claim_detail)와 같은 결제·환불 행을 고른다.
 select p.id,p.provider::text provider,p.status::text status,p.amount into pay from public.payments p
  where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=c.order_id and p.status<>'failed' order by p.created_at desc,p.id desc limit 1;
 select r.status,r.amount,r.method,r.filed_at,r.completed_at into ref from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id
  where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=c.order_id order by r.created_at desc,r.id desc limit 1;
 if pay.id is not null then
  virtual_account:=exists(select 1 from public.payment_attempts a join private.payment_provider_evidence e on e.payment_attempt_id=a.id
   where a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=c.order_id and (e.payment_method='가상계좌' or e.result_code='DONE_virtual_account'));
 end if;
 complete:=private.claim_collections_complete(c.id);
 blocker:=case
  when c.claim_type='exchange' then 'exchange_has_no_refund'
  when c.stage='on_hold' then 'claim_on_hold'
  when c.stage in ('requested','in_review') then 'claim_not_approved'
  when c.stage in ('rejected','withdrawn') then 'claim_closed'
  when c.stage='completed' then case when ref.completed_at is not null then 'refund_completed' else 'refund_record_only' end
  when c.stage='collecting' or (c.stage='collected' and not complete) then 'claim_collections_incomplete'
  when pay.id is null then 'payment_missing'
  when pay.provider='bank_transfer' then 'bank_transfer'
  when pay.provider='korpay' then 'korpay'
  when virtual_account then 'virtual_account'
  when pay.provider not in ('toss','nicepay') then 'provider_unsupported'
  when ref.method='bank_transfer' then 'refund_method_bank_transfer'
  when ref.completed_at is not null then 'refund_completed'
  when c.stage in ('processing','needs_review') and ref.status is null then 'refund_ledger_missing'
  when c.stage not in ('collected','processing','needs_review') then 'claim_not_refundable'
  else null end;
 return jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'reference',c.reference,'orderId',c.order_id,'claimType',c.claim_type,'stage',c.stage,
  'heldFrom',c.held_from,'collectionPolicy',c.collection_policy,'collectionRequired',c.collection_required,'collectionComplete',complete,
  'collectedAt',c.collected_at,'collectionReceivedOn',c.collection_received_on,
  'collections',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentId',x.shipment_id,'originName',x.origin_name_snapshot,
    'collectedAt',x.collected_at,'receivedOn',x.received_on,
    'waived',private.claim_collection_waived(x.claim_id,x.shipment_id),
    'returnAddressReady',btrim(x.return_address_snapshot)<>'' or exists(select 1 from public.fulfillment_origins o where o.id=x.origin_id and coalesce(btrim(o.return_address),'')<>''),
    'bundles',private.claim_collection_bundles_json(x.claim_id,x.shipment_id,true))
    order by x.origin_name_snapshot,x.shipment_id) from public.order_claim_collections x where x.claim_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb),
  'paymentProvider',pay.provider,'paymentStatus',pay.status,
  'refundMethod',ref.method,'refundFiledAt',ref.filed_at,'refundCompletedAt',ref.completed_at,
  'refundAmount',case when pay.id is null then null else coalesce(ref.amount,pay.amount-private.payment_partial_refunded_amount(pay.id)-private.claim_refund_preview_deduction(c.id,pay.id)) end,
  'refundBlocker',blocker)||private.claim_refund_deduction_field(c.id);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_reason_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
 when p_claim.claim_type<>'exchange' then 'claim_reason_type_unavailable'
 when p_claim.stage='on_hold' and p_claim.held_from is null then 'claim_reason_stage_unavailable'
 when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then p_claim.held_from else p_claim.stage end)
  not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected') then 'claim_reason_stage_unavailable'
 when p_claim.reshipped_at is not null or p_claim.reship_tracking_number is not null
  or exists(select 1 from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(p_claim.id)) then 'claim_reason_reshipped'
 when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_reason_finance_started'
 else null end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_refund_account_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests, p_order public.orders)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
  when p_order.id is null or p_claim.id is null or p_claim.order_id is distinct from p_order.id then 'claim_not_found'
  when exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents where order_id=p_order.id) then 'refund_account_gift_order'
  when private.bank_transfer_zero_refund_payment(p_order.id) is not null then 'refund_account_not_needed'
  when p_order.payment_method is distinct from 'bank_transfer' or p_order.total<=0 then 'refund_account_payment_unavailable'
  when p_order.status::text not in('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done')
   or p_claim.claim_type not in('cancel','return')
   or p_claim.stage not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected','on_hold','processing','needs_review')
   or p_claim.status not in('requested','processing','needs_review') then 'refund_account_claim_closed'
  when exists(select 1 from private.claim_refund_accounts where claim_id=p_claim.id) then 'refund_account_already_recorded'
  when not exists(select 1 from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=p_order.id and provider='bank_transfer' and status='paid' and amount>0)
   or exists(select 1 from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=p_order.id and(provider<>'bank_transfer' or status<>'paid'))
   or (select sum(amount) from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=p_order.id) is distinct from p_order.total then 'refund_account_payment_unavailable'
  when exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id
   where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_order.id and(r.status<>'requested' or r.method is not null
    or r.filed_at is not null or r.completed_at is not null or r.handled_by is not null
    or r.cancellation_request_id is distinct from p_claim.id or r.amount<>p.amount)) then 'refund_account_finance_started'
  else null end;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'reshippedAt',c.reshipped_at,'items',(
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId',r.order_item_id,'goodId',r.good_id,'name',r.good_name_snapshot,
   'variantId',r.variant_id,'variantName',r.variant_name_snapshot,'variantCode',r.variant_code_snapshot,'qty',r.qty) order by r.order_item_id),'[]')
  from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(c.id) r)) order by c.reshipped_at,c.reference),'[]') into result
 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=p_order_id and c.stage='completed' and c.reshipped_at is not null
  and exists(select 1 from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(c.id));
 return result;end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_reshipment_parcels(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p.parcel order by p.reshipped_at,p.reference,p.sort_key),'[]'::jsonb) from(
  select r.reshipped_at,c.reference,r.id::text sort_key,jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'reshipmentId',r.id,'carrier',r.carrier,
   'trackingNumber',r.tracking_number,'reshippedAt',r.reshipped_at,'deliveredAt',r.delivered_at,'collectionWaived',r.collection_waived,
   'items',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId',x.order_item_id,'name',x.name,'variantName',x.variant_name,'qty',x.qty) order by x.order_item_id),'[]'::jsonb) from(
    select ri.order_item_id,oi.good_name_snapshot name,ri.variant_name_snapshot variant_name,ri.qty
    from public.order_claim_reshipment_items ri join public.order_items oi on oi.id=ri.order_item_id where ri.reshipment_id=r.id
    union all
    select a.order_item_id,a.good_name_snapshot,a.variant_name_snapshot,a.qty from private.group_claim_reshipment_allocations a where a.reshipment_id=r.id) x)) parcel
  from public.order_claim_reshipments r join public.order_cancellation_requests c on c.id=r.claim_id
  where r.order_id=p_order_id and c.order_id=p_order_id
  union all
  select c.reshipped_at,c.reference,'',jsonb_build_object('claimId',c.id,'reshipmentId',null,'carrier',c.reship_carrier,
   'trackingNumber',c.reship_tracking_number,'reshippedAt',c.reshipped_at,'deliveredAt',c.reship_delivered_at,'collectionWaived',false,
   'items',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId',x.order_item_id,'name',x.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',x.variant_name_snapshot,'qty',x.qty) order by x.order_item_id),'[]'::jsonb)
    from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(c.id) x))
  from public.order_cancellation_requests c
  where c.order_id=p_order_id and c.claim_type='exchange' and c.reshipped_at is not null and c.reship_carrier is not null and c.reship_tracking_number is not null
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipments r where r.claim_id=c.id)
 ) p;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_type_change_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
 when p_claim.claim_type not in('return','exchange') then 'claim_conversion_type_unavailable'
 when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then coalesce(p_claim.held_from,'requested') else p_claim.stage end)
  not in('requested','in_review','collecting','collected') then 'claim_conversion_stage_unavailable'
 when p_claim.reshipped_at is not null or p_claim.reship_tracking_number is not null
  or exists(select 1 from private.claim_reshipment_items_read(p_claim.id)) then 'claim_conversion_reshipped'
 when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_conversion_finance_started'
 else null end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_claim_withdrawal_blocker(p_claim public.order_cancellation_requests)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case
  when p_claim.stage='withdrawn' then 'claim_already_withdrawn'
  when (case when p_claim.stage='on_hold' then coalesce(p_claim.held_from,'requested') else p_claim.stage end) not in('requested','in_review','collecting') then 'claim_withdrawal_started'
  when p_claim.collected_at is not null or p_claim.reshipped_at is not null
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_collections where claim_id=p_claim.id and collected_at is not null)
   or exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_collection_bundles where claim_id=p_claim.id and collected_at is not null)
   or exists(select 1 from private.claim_collection_plans where claim_id=p_claim.id and customer_sent_once)
   or exists(select 1 from private.seller_order_claim_intakes intake cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(intake.payload->'collections') item
    where intake.claim_id=p_claim.id and item->>'method'='customer_sent') then 'claim_withdrawal_collection_started'
  when exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_claim.order_id)
   or exists(select 1 from public.refunds refund join public.payments payment on payment.id=refund.payment_id where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=p_claim.order_id)
   or exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=p_claim.order_id and status='canceled') then 'claim_withdrawal_finance_started'
  else null end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_delay_notice_snapshot(target_order uuid, target_shipments uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('orderUpdatedAt',o.updated_at,'orderStatus',o.status,'buyerId',o.user_id,'delayUpdatedAt',d.updated_at,
  'delayRevision',encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(d.reason,'')||coalesce(d.expected_ship_date::text,''),'sha256'),'hex'),
  'shipments',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'updatedAt',s.updated_at,'expectedShipDate',s.expected_ship_date) order by s.id)
    from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.id=any(target_shipments)))
 from public.orders o left join public.order_dispatch_delays d on d.order_id=o.id
 where o.id=target_order and o.status in ('confirmed','shipping')
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=o.id)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id and c.status in ('requested','processing','needs_review'))
  and cardinality(target_shipments)>0
  and (select count(*) from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.id=any(target_shipments)
    and s.status='ready' and case when s.original_expected_ship_date is not null
      then s.expected_ship_date<(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
      else o.confirmed_at<now()-interval '3 days' end)=cardinality(target_shipments)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_delay_notice_target_current(target_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(t.snapshot=case when n.kind='preorder_schedule' then private.preorder_schedule_notice_snapshot(t.order_id,t.shipment_ids) else private.order_delay_notice_snapshot(t.order_id,t.shipment_ids) end
   and t.buyer_id=case when t.audience='recipient' then g.recipient_id else o.user_id end
   and t.recipient_email is not distinct from nullif(lower(btrim(p.email)),'')
   and (n.expected_ship_date is null or n.expected_ship_date>=(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date),false)
 from private.order_delay_notice_targets t join private.order_delay_notices n on n.id=t.notice_id
 join public.orders o on o.id=t.order_id left join private.gift_intents g on g.order_id=o.id
 join public.profiles p on p.id=t.buyer_id where t.id=target_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_fulfillment_held_orders()
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, placed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select x.order_id, min(x.placed_at) from (
    select h.order_id, h.created_at as placed_at from private.order_fulfillment_holds h join public.orders o on o.id = h.order_id
    where h.released_at is null and o.status <> 'canceled'
    union all
    select a.ref_id, a.updated_at from private.payment_attempt_key_modes k join public.payment_attempts a on a.id = k.attempt_id
    join public.orders o on o.id = a.ref_id
    where k.key_mode = 'test' and a.purpose = 'order' and a.state = 'approved' and o.status <> 'canceled'
      and not exists(select 1 from private.order_fulfillment_holds h where h.order_id = a.ref_id and h.evidence_key = 'test_payment:' || a.id::text)
  ) x group by x.order_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_fulfillment_hold_document(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'reason', r.reason,
      'placedAt', coalesce(h.created_at, (select max(a.updated_at) from public.payment_attempts a
        where a.purpose = 'order' and a.ref_id = p_order_id and a.state = 'approved')),
      'providerStatus', h.detail->>'providerStatus',
      'providerCanceledAmount', (h.detail->>'providerCanceledAmount')::bigint,
      'unexplainedAmount', (h.detail->>'unexplainedAmount')::bigint,
      'paymentAmount', (h.detail->>'paymentAmount')::bigint,
      'outboundBlocked', private.order_fulfillment_blocking(p_order_id)) order by r.reason), '[]'::jsonb)
  from unnest(private.order_fulfillment_hold_reasons(p_order_id)) r(reason)
  left join lateral (select x.created_at, x.detail from private.order_fulfillment_holds x
    where x.order_id = p_order_id and x.reason = r.reason and x.released_at is null order by x.created_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) h on true;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_fulfillment_hold_reasons(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when not exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id = p_order_id and o.status <> 'canceled') then '{}'::text[]
    else coalesce((select array_agg(distinct r.reason order by r.reason) from (
      select h.reason from private.order_fulfillment_holds h where h.order_id = p_order_id and h.released_at is null
      union all
      select 'test_payment' from public.payment_attempts a join private.payment_attempt_key_modes k on k.attempt_id = a.id
      where a.purpose = 'order' and a.ref_id = p_order_id and a.state = 'approved' and k.key_mode = 'test'
        and not exists(select 1 from private.order_fulfillment_holds h where h.order_id = p_order_id and h.evidence_key = 'test_payment:' || a.id::text)
    ) r), '{}'::text[]) end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_item_reshipment_options(p_item_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(good_id text, variant_id uuid, good_name text, variant_name text, variant_code text, stock_qty integer, is_current boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with physical as (select * from private.order_item_physical_unit(p_item_id)),
 current_unit as (select target.* from physical cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_stock_successor(physical.good_id,physical.variant_id) target),
 current_group as (select m.group_id from current_unit c join private.goods_group_members m on m.good_id=c.good_id and m.variant_id=c.variant_id
  join private.goods_groups g on g.id=m.group_id and g.archived_at is null)
 select v.good_id,v.id,g.name,v.name,v.code,v.stock_qty,v.id=c.variant_id
 from current_unit c join public.goods_variants v on v.id=c.variant_id
  or (not exists(select 1 from current_group) and v.good_id=c.good_id and v.archived_at is null)
  or (v.archived_at is null and exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join current_group cg on cg.group_id=m.group_id where m.variant_id=v.id and m.good_id=v.good_id))
 join public.goods g on g.id=v.good_id
 where v.id=c.variant_id or (g.archived_at is null and v.archived_at is null)
 order by (v.id=c.variant_id) desc,g.name,v.sort_order,v.id;
$function$
