 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('id', head.id, 'sequence', head.sequence, 'state', head.state, 'provider', head.provider,
    'refundAmount', head.refund_amount, 'goodsRefundAmount', head.goods_refund_amount, 'shippingRefundAmount', head.shipping_refund_amount,
    'storeCreditRestoreAmount', head.store_credit_restore_amount, 'createdAt', head.created_at, 'appliedAt', head.applied_at,
    'completedAt', head.completed_at, 'transferredAt', head.transferred_at,
    'items', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId', line.order_item_id, 'goodName', item.good_name_snapshot,
        'variantName', case when p_level in ('customer', 'read') and item.option_sale_mode_snapshot = 'random' then null else item.variant_name_snapshot end,
        'qty', line.qty, 'goodsRefundAmount', line.goods_refund_amount) order by item.good_name_snapshot, item.id)
      from private.order_partial_cancellation_items line join public.order_items item on item.id = line.order_item_id
      where line.partial_cancellation_id = head.id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'closedShipmentCount', (select count(*) from private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments c where c.partial_cancellation_id = head.id))
  || case when p_level in ('read', 'manage', 'legacy') then jsonb_build_object('customerDecision', head.customer_decision) else '{}'::jsonb end
  || case when p_level in ('manage', 'legacy') then jsonb_build_object('note', head.note,
      'warehouseStopConfirmed', head.warehouse_stop_confirmed, 'lastErrorCode', head.last_error_code, 'balanceBefore', head.balance_before,
      'paymentAmount', head.payment_amount, 'createdBy', (select nickname from public.profiles where id = head.created_by),
      'filedAt', head.filed_at, 'resolution', head.resolution, 'resolvedAt', head.resolved_at,
      'closedShipments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentId', s.id, 'shipmentNumber', s.shipment_number,
          'originName', s.origin_name_snapshot, 'shippingFeeRefund', c.shipping_fee_refund) order by s.shipment_number)
        from private.order_partial_cancellation_shipments c join public.order_shipments s on s.id = c.shipment_id
        where c.partial_cancellation_id = head.id), '[]'::jsonb)) else '{}'::jsonb end
  || case when p_level = 'legacy' then jsonb_build_object('transferEvidence', head.transfer_evidence, 'transferNote', head.transfer_note,
      'resolutionReason', head.resolution_reason,
      'refundAccount', (select jsonb_build_object('maskedAccount', a.masked_account, 'maskedHolder', a.masked_holder, 'purged', a.purged_at is not null)
        from private.order_partial_cancellation_refund_accounts a where a.partial_cancellation_id = head.id)) else '{}'::jsonb end
  from private.order_partial_cancellations head where head.id = p_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.order_production_document(p_order uuid, p_admin boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('orderId',o.id,'cancelReviewRequired',exists(select 1 from private.order_production_jobs where order_id=o.id and claim_id is null and started_at is not null),
 'canCancel',private.order_cancel_eligible(o.id),'jobs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',j.id,'itemId',j.order_item_id,'claimId',j.claim_id,'goodId',i.good_id,'goodName',coalesce(i.good_name_snapshot,g.name),'quantity',i.qty,
 'revision',j.revision,'state',j.state,'terms',j.terms,'basisAt',j.basis_at,'dueAt',j.due_at,'startedAt',j.started_at,'completedAt',j.completed_at,
 'canStart',p_admin and j.state='pending' and j.basis_at is not null and private.production_payment_valid(o.id) and(case when j.claim_id is null then o.status in('paid','confirmed') and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=o.id and stage not in('completed','rejected','withdrawn')) else private.claim_production_ready(j.claim_id,j.order_item_id) end),
 'canComplete',p_admin and j.state='started' and private.production_payment_valid(o.id) and(case when j.claim_id is null then o.status in('paid','confirmed') and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=o.id and stage not in('completed','rejected','withdrawn')) else private.claim_production_ready(j.claim_id,j.order_item_id) end),
 'history',case when p_admin then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'kind',e.kind,'at',e.created_at,'evidence',e.request->>'evidence') order by e.created_at,e.id) from private.order_production_events e where e.job_id=j.id),'[]') else '[]'::jsonb end) order by j.created_at,j.id)
 from private.order_production_jobs j join public.order_items i on i.id=j.order_item_id join public.goods g on g.id=i.good_id where j.order_id=o.id),'[]'))
 from public.orders o where o.id=p_order;
$function$

 select private.order_all_items_delivered(p_order_id) or exists(
  select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=p_order_id and o.status='shipping'
   and exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id)
   and exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.status in ('shipping','delivered') and s.shipped_at is not null)
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.status='canceled' and not private.shipment_closed_by_partial_cancel(s.id))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_items i where i.order_id=o.id and coalesce((select sum(link.qty) from public.order_shipment_items link
    join public.order_shipments s on s.id=link.shipment_id where link.order_id=i.order_id and link.order_item_id=i.id and s.status in ('ready','shipping','delivered')),0)<>private.order_item_active_qty(i.id))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id and private.claim_reshipment_delivery_pending(c))
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.pii_access_log_entries(p_from date, p_to date, p_actor uuid, p_action text, p_surface text, p_subject uuid, p_flag text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, accessed_at timestamp with time zone, actor_id uuid, actor_access text, client_ip inet, action text, surface text, path text, subject_kind text, subject_ids uuid[], subject_count integer, member_ids uuid[], detail jsonb, off_hours boolean, bulk boolean, burst boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with ranged as (
    select l.*, (l.accessed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') as local_at
    from private.operator_pii_access_log l
    where l.accessed_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
      and l.accessed_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
  ), flagged as (
    select r.*,
      (extract(isodow from r.local_at) in (6, 7) or extract(hour from r.local_at) < 8 or extract(hour from r.local_at) >= 21) as is_off_hours,
      (r.subject_count >= 1000) as is_bulk,
      (r.action in ('view', 'reveal') and count(*) filter (where r.action in ('view', 'reveal'))
        over (partition by r.actor_id, date_trunc('hour', r.local_at)) >= 50) as is_burst
    from ranged r
  )
  select f.id, f.accessed_at, f.actor_id, f.actor_access, f.client_ip, f.action, f.surface, f.path, f.subject_kind,
    f.subject_ids, f.subject_count, f.member_ids, f.detail, f.is_off_hours, f.is_bulk, f.is_burst
  from flagged f
  where (p_actor is null or f.actor_id = p_actor)
    and (p_action is null or f.action = p_action)
    and (p_surface is null or f.surface = p_surface)
    and (p_subject is null or f.subject_ids @> array[p_subject] or f.member_ids @> array[p_subject])
    and (p_flag is null
      or (p_flag = 'any' and (f.is_off_hours or f.is_bulk or f.is_burst))
      or (p_flag = 'off_hours' and f.is_off_hours)
      or (p_flag = 'bulk' and f.is_bulk)
      or (p_flag = 'burst' and f.is_burst));
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('buyerId',o.user_id,
  'shipments',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'expectedShipDate',s.expected_ship_date) order by s.id)
    from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.id=any(target_shipments)))
 from public.orders o
 where o.id=target_order and o.status in ('pending','paid','confirmed','shipping')
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=o.id)

  and cardinality(target_shipments)>0
  and (select count(*) from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=o.id and s.id=any(target_shipments)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.preserve_claim_withdrawal()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if old.stage='withdrawn' and (new.stage<>old.stage or new.status<>old.status or new.claim_type<>old.claim_type or new.withdrawn_at is distinct from old.withdrawn_at) then
  raise check_violation using message='claim_already_withdrawn';end if;
 new.claim_revision:=old.claim_revision+1;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.product_detail_paid_orders(p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, approved_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select o.id,min(approval.approved_at) as approved_at
 from public.orders o
 join public.payments p on p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.status='paid' and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.amount=o.total
 join public.payment_attempts a on a.payment_id=p.id and a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id and a.state='approved'
  and a.amount=p.amount and a.provider=p.provider and a.user_id=o.user_id
 cross join lateral (select coalesce(
  (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
  (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id and a.provider='bank_transfer')
 ) as approved_at) approval
 where o.status in ('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done') and approval.approved_at>=p_start and approval.approved_at<p_end
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id
   and c.claim_type in ('cancel','return') and (c.status='completed' or c.stage='completed'))
 group by o.id;
$function$
functions.signature: private.product_detail_paid_orders(timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.production_order_canceled()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if new.status='canceled' then update private.order_production_jobs set state='canceled',revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() where order_id=new.id and state<>'canceled';end if;return new;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.production_payment_changed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare at_value timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();begin
 if new.purpose<>'order' then return new;end if;
 if new.status='paid' then update private.order_production_jobs set basis_at=at_value,due_at=private.production_deadline(at_value,terms),updated_at=at_value where order_id=new.ref_id and claim_id is null and basis_at is null;
 elsif new.status in('refunded','canceled') then update private.order_production_jobs set state='canceled',revision=revision+1,updated_at=at_value where order_id=new.ref_id and state<>'canceled';end if;
 return new;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.production_payment_valid(p_order uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.orders o join public.payments p on p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.amount=o.total and p.status='paid'
  join public.payment_attempts a on a.payment_id=p.id and a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id and a.user_id=o.user_id and a.provider=p.provider and a.amount=p.amount and a.state='approved'
  where o.id=p_order and(exists(select 1 from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id and e.approved_at is not null)
   or a.provider='bank_transfer' and exists(select 1 from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.production_shipment_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.project_order_claim_stage()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- INSERT: 레거시 경로는 status만 준다(예: 20260714190001의 needs_review 이관).
  -- stage는 컬럼 기본값 'requested'로 채워지므로 그대로 두면 투영 CHECK를 어긴다.
  -- 새 경로는 반대로 stage만 준다. 둘 다 명시한 INSERT는 손대지 않는다 — 그 조합이
  -- 틀렸다면 조용히 고치는 것보다 CHECK로 막히는 편이 낫다.
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    if new.stage is not distinct from 'requested'
      and new.status is distinct from 'requested'
    then
      new.stage := new.status;
    elsif new.stage is distinct from 'requested'
      and new.status is not distinct from 'requested'
    then
      new.status := private.order_claim_status_for_stage(new.stage);
    end if;
    return new;
  end if;

  if new.stage is distinct from old.stage
    and new.status is not distinct from old.status
  then
    -- 절차가 움직였고 호출자는 status를 적지 않았다. 파생값은 여기서 만든다.
    new.status := private.order_claim_status_for_stage(new.stage);
  elsif new.status is distinct from old.status
    and new.stage is not distinct from old.stage
  then
    -- 레거시 writer. status에서 stage를 되돌린다 — requested로 감는 경로(정합화
    -- 재시도)는 절차를 처음으로 감지 않고 이미 지난 단계를 보존한다.
    new.stage := case
      when new.status in ('processing', 'needs_review', 'completed', 'rejected')
        then new.status
      when old.stage in ('in_review', 'collecting', 'collected', 'on_hold')
        then old.stage
      else 'requested'
    end;
    new.status := private.order_claim_status_for_stage(new.stage);
  end if;

  -- 둘 다 바꾼 UPDATE는 그대로 통과시킨다. 일치하면 CHECK가 받고, 어긋나면 막는다.
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.record_goods_reconciliation_audit(p_claim_token uuid, p_operation text, p_target_id uuid, p_actor_ref text, p_case_ref text, p_claim_status text, p_outcome public.payment_attempt_state DEFAULT NULL::public.payment_attempt_state)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_audit private.goods_payment_reconciliation_audits%rowtype;
begin
  if p_claim_token is null
    or p_operation not in ('payment', 'refund')
    or p_target_id is null
    or p_actor_ref is null
    or p_actor_ref !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$'
    or p_case_ref is null
    or p_case_ref !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$'
    or p_claim_status not in ('claimed', 'in_progress', 'terminal')
    or ((p_claim_status = 'terminal') is distinct from (p_outcome is not null))
  then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'goods_reconciliation_audit_invalid';
  end if;

  insert into private.goods_payment_reconciliation_audits (
    claim_token,
    operation,
    target_id,
    actor_ref,
    case_ref,
    claim_status,
    outcome,
    finalized_at
  )
  values (
    p_claim_token,
    p_operation,
    p_target_id,
    p_actor_ref,
    p_case_ref,
    p_claim_status,
    p_outcome,
    case when p_outcome is null then null else pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() end
  )
  on conflict (claim_token) do nothing;

  select audit.*
  into strict v_audit
  from private.goods_payment_reconciliation_audits as audit
  where audit.claim_token = p_claim_token
  for update;

  if v_audit.operation is distinct from p_operation
    or v_audit.target_id is distinct from p_target_id
    or v_audit.actor_ref is distinct from p_actor_ref
    or v_audit.case_ref is distinct from p_case_ref
  then
    raise unique_violation using message = 'goods_reconciliation_audit_conflict';
  end if;

  if v_audit.claim_status <> 'terminal' then
    update private.goods_payment_reconciliation_audits
    set
      claim_status = p_claim_status,
      outcome = p_outcome,
      finalized_at = case
        when p_outcome is null then null
        else pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
      end
    where claim_token = p_claim_token;
  end if;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into private.operator_internal_contracts(signature,definition_md5)
  select p.oid::regprocedure::text,md5(concat_ws('|',p.prosrc,p.prolang::text,p.provolatile::text,
    p.prosecdef::text,p.proisstrict::text,p.proparallel::text,coalesce(p.proconfig::text,''),
    coalesce(p.proacl::text,''),p.proowner::text,p.prorettype::text,p.proretset::text,
    p.proargtypes::text,coalesce(p.proallargtypes::text,''),coalesce(p.proargmodes::text,''),
    coalesce(p.proargnames::text,''),coalesce(p.proargdefaults::text,'')))
  from pg_proc p where p.oid=p_function::oid

AS $function$
begin
  if not exists(select 1 from unnest(array['owner','primary','deputy','influencer','agency','logistics']) as role_name
    where p_capability=any(private.operator_role_capabilities(role_name))) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='operator_policy_capability_invalid';end if;

  from pg_policy p join pg_class c on c.oid=p.polrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
  where p.polrelid=p_table::oid and p.polname=p_policy

  for v_shipment in
    select m.shipment_id from private.shipment_pack_members m join public.order_shipments s on s.id=m.shipment_id
     where m.released_at is null and s.status='canceled' order by m.shipment_id
  loop
    if private.release_shipment_pack_member_on_cancel(v_shipment) then v_released:=v_released+1; end if;
  end loop;
  return v_released;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.release_coupons_on_order_cancel()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.coupon_redemptions
  set status = 'released',
      released_at = now(),
      release_reason = 'order_canceled'
  where order_id = new.id
    and status = 'applied';

  update public.user_coupons as held
  set status = 'active',
      used_at = null,
      used_order_id = null
  from public.coupon_redemptions as redemption
  where redemption.order_id = new.id
    and redemption.status = 'released'
    and redemption.release_reason = 'order_canceled'
    and held.id = redemption.user_coupon_id
    and held.status = 'used'
    and held.used_order_id = new.id;

  return null;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.request_order_claim_for_parties(p_order_id uuid, p_actor uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_gift_id uuid, p_claim_type text, p_reason text, p_reason_type text, p_bank_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_account_holder text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid;
  claim_at timestamptz;
  gift private.gift_intents;
  v_status public.order_status;
  v_delivered_at timestamptz;
  v_claim_id uuid;
  v_has_unresolved_attempt boolean;
  v_masked_account text;
  v_masked_holder text;
  v_payment_count integer;
  v_expired_prepared_attempt_id uuid;
  v_attempt_state text;
begin
  if p_claim_type is null or p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type';
  end if;
  if p_reason_type is null or p_reason_type not in ('change_of_mind', 'defect') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason type';
  end if;
  if p_reason is null
    or btrim(p_reason) <> p_reason
    or length(p_reason) not between 1 and 200
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason';
  end if;

  -- Actor is the actual requester; p_user_id is exclusively the financial owner.
  if p_gift_id is null then
    if p_actor is distinct from p_user_id then return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);end if;
    -- Preserve the ordinary-order intake lock graph unchanged.
  else
    select * into gift from private.gift_intents where id=p_gift_id and order_id=p_order_id;
    if not found or p_actor is null or p_user_id is distinct from gift.sender_id or not(p_actor=gift.sender_id or p_actor=gift.recipient_id)
      or p_actor<>gift.sender_id and p_claim_type='cancel' then return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);end if;
    perform private.gift_lock_subjects(array[p_actor,gift.sender_id,gift.recipient_id]);
    if p_actor<>gift.sender_id and (p_bank_name is not null or p_account_number is not null or p_account_holder is not null) then
      raise insufficient_privilege using message='gift_payer_refund_account_required';end if;
  end if;

  -- Common intake/dispatch lock order: order → shipments → payment attempts/payments.
  select orders.user_id, orders.status, orders.delivered_at
  into v_user_id, v_status, v_delivered_at
  from public.orders
  where orders.id = p_order_id
  for update;

  if not found or p_user_id is null or v_user_id is distinct from p_user_id then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_found','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  perform s.id from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=p_order_id order by s.id for update;

  perform attempt.id
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  where attempt.purpose = 'order'
    and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by attempt.id
  for update;

  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state in (
        'prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved'
      )
  )
  into v_has_unresolved_attempt;

  claim_at:=case when p_gift_id is null then now() else clock_timestamp() end;
  if v_status = 'canceled' then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','already_canceled','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- 반품·교환은 배송 중부터 접수하되 전체 실물 회수는 후속 단계에서 검사한다.
  -- Customer cancellation is available only before order confirmation.
  if p_claim_type in ('return', 'exchange') then
    if not private.order_return_intake_eligible(p_order_id) or (p_claim_type='exchange' and private.order_has_digital_items(p_order_id)) then
      return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_claimable','claimId',v_claim_id);
    end if;
  elsif not private.order_cancel_eligible(p_order_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','not_cancelable','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- 교환도 청약철회 기한을 준용한다(변심 7일 · 하자 3개월). 판정의 진실원은
  -- 계속 order_withdrawal_deadline_passed 하나다.
  if public.order_withdrawal_deadline_passed(v_delivered_at, p_reason_type, claim_at) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','deadline_expired','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = p_order_id
      and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','already_requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  -- status는 적지 않는다. 투영은 private.order_claim_status_for_stage 하나가 만든다.
  insert into public.order_cancellation_requests (
    order_id,
    requested_by,
    reason,
    reason_type,
    claim_type,
    stage,
    requested_at
  )
  values (
    p_order_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_reason,
    p_reason_type,
    p_claim_type,
    'requested',
    claim_at
  )
  returning id into v_claim_id;
  if p_gift_id is not null then
    insert into private.gift_claim_parties(claim_id,gift_id,payer_id,recipient_id,actual_requester)
    values(v_claim_id,p_gift_id,gift.sender_id,gift.recipient_id,p_actor);
    insert into public.audit_log(actor_id,action,target,diff) values(p_actor,'gift.claim_requested','order:'||p_order_id,
      jsonb_build_object('giftId',p_gift_id,'claimId',v_claim_id,'claimType',p_claim_type,'reasonType',p_reason_type,'requesterParty',case when p_actor=gift.sender_id then 'sender' else 'recipient' end));
  end if;


  /*
   * 환불계좌는 무통장 환불의 유일한 경로이고 카드 fallback의 안전망이다.
   * 세 칸이 모두 있을 때만 저장한다 — 반쪽 계좌는 송금에 쓸 수 없다.
   *
   * 교환에는 저장하지 않는다. 교환의 종결은 재출고이고 어떤 경로로도 돈이
   * 돌아가지 않으므로 계좌를 받을 목적 자체가 없다. 화면은 반품에만 폼을
   * 보이지만 API로는 실어 보낼 수 있으므로 접수 함수가 거른다. 취소·반품은
   * 결제사 취소가 막혔을 때 송금이 유일한 경로라 계속 받고, 보관 기간은
   * 종결 stage에서 seal_order_claim_refund_account가 잡는다.
   */
  if p_claim_type <> 'exchange'
    and p_bank_name is not null
    and p_account_number is not null
    and p_account_holder is not null
  then
    v_masked_account := public.mask_refund_account_number(p_account_number);
    v_masked_holder := public.mask_refund_account_holder(p_account_holder);

    insert into private.claim_refund_accounts (
      claim_id,
      bank_name,
      account_number,
      account_holder,
      masked_account,
      masked_holder
    )
    values (
      v_claim_id,
      btrim(p_bank_name),
      p_account_number,
      btrim(p_account_holder),
      btrim(p_bank_name) || ' ' || v_masked_account,
      v_masked_holder
    );
  end if;

  /*
   * 결제 유효 시간이 이미 지난 결제 준비(prepared) 시도는 미해결이 아니다
   * (2026-10-12 브라우저 QA QA-1).
   *
   * 위에서 잡은 order → shipments → attempt 잠금 아래에서만 판정한다. 만료된
   * prepared 시도는 claim_goods_payment_attempt가 잠금 전·후 두 번 모두
   * goods_payment_attempt_expired로 거절하므로, 늦게 도착한 결제 완료 리디렉트가
   * 있어도 서버는 승인 API를 부르지 않는다. 토스는 인증을 마친 결제(IN_PROGRESS)도
   * 승인 API를 부르지 않으면 매입하지 않고 EXPIRED로 닫는다(코어 API Payment.status,
   * 웹훅 이벤트 PAYMENT_STATUS_CHANGED). Korpay도 confirm 호출 전에는 승인하지 않는다.
   *
   * 그래서 결제 원장이 없는 결제 대기 주문의 취소라면 그 시도를 expire_stale_checkouts·
   * reconcile_expired_prepared_goods_cancellation과 같은 규칙(prepared → canceled,
   * claim 토큰 제거, 만료 재확인을 갱신 조건에 둔다)으로 닫고 아래 즉시 종결로
   * 보낸다. 지금까지는 만료 여부와 상관없이 prepared를 미해결로 세어 요청을
   * requested로 남겼고, 재고·쿠폰·적립금이 결제 기한 + 5분 sweep까지 묶였다.
   *
   * 유효 시간이 남은 prepared, confirming·unknown·needs_review·approved는 종전처럼
   * 미해결이다. 결제 원장이 하나라도 있으면(실패 행 포함) 시도를 건드리지 않는다 —
   * 즉시 종결 조건과 같아야 시도만 닫히고 요청이 남는 중간 상태가 생기지 않는다.
   * 굿즈 주문의 시도는 하나다(payment_attempts_one_goods_order_idx).
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'pending'
    and v_has_unresolved_attempt
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    )
  then
    update public.payment_attempts as attempt
    set
      state = 'canceled',
      claim_token = null,
      claim_expires_at = null
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state = 'prepared'
      and attempt.expires_at is not null
      and attempt.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    returning attempt.id into v_expired_prepared_attempt_id;

    if v_expired_prepared_attempt_id is not null then
      select exists (
        select 1
        from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        where attempt.purpose = 'order'
          and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
          and attempt.state in (
            'prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review', 'approved'
          )
      )
      into v_has_unresolved_attempt;
    end if;
  end if;

  -- 결제 이력이 없는 pending 주문은 예전처럼 즉시 종결한다.
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'pending'
    and not v_has_unresolved_attempt
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    )
  then
    perform public.finalize_order_cancellation_with_provider_evidence(
      p_order_id,
      p_reason,
      array[]::text[]
    );

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'completed',
      completed_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    -- 위에서 닫은 만료 시도는 reconcile_expired_prepared_goods_cancellation과 같은
    -- 결과 어휘로 남긴다. actor는 취소를 누른 구매자다.
    if v_expired_prepared_attempt_id is not null then
      insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
      values (
        p_actor,
        'order.prepared_goods_cancellation_completed',
        'order:' || p_order_id::text,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'attemptId', v_expired_prepared_attempt_id,
          'requestId', v_claim_id,
          'outcome', 'expired_no_capture',
          'trigger', 'customer_cancel_request'
        )
      );
    end if;

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','completed','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  /*
   * 자동 승인 — paid(발주확인 전) 변심 취소.
   *
   * 아직 발주확인도 하지 않은 주문의 변심 취소를 사람이 판단할 이유가 없다.
   * 스마트스토어와 같은 경계다. confirmed부터는 발송 준비가 시작됐으므로
   * 운영자 판단으로 남긴다.
   *
   * 승인의 실질(durable claim + 환불 intent)은 admin_decide_order_cancellation의
   * 승인 분기와 같다. decided_by는 null로 남긴다 — 사람이 누른 적이 없다.
   */
  if p_claim_type = 'cancel'
    and v_status = 'paid'
    and not exists(select 1 from private.order_production_jobs where order_id=p_order_id and claim_id is null and started_at is not null)
    and not exists(select 1 from private.order_digital_downloads where order_id=p_order_id)
    and p_reason_type = 'change_of_mind'
  then
    insert into public.order_cancellation_claims (
      order_id,
      requested_by,
      previous_status
    )
    values (p_order_id, p_user_id, v_status)
    on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

    insert into public.refunds (
      payment_id,
      amount,
      reason,
      status,
      cancellation_request_id
    )
    select
      payment.id,
      payment.amount - private.payment_partial_refunded_amount(payment.id),
      p_reason,
      case when refund.status = 'done' then 'done' else 'requested' end,
      v_claim_id
    from public.payments as payment
    left join public.refunds as refund on refund.payment_id = payment.id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded')
    on conflict (payment_id) do update
    set
      cancellation_request_id = excluded.cancellation_request_id,
      reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
      status = case
        when public.refunds.status = 'done' then 'done'
        else 'requested'
      end;

    select count(*)::integer
    into v_payment_count
    from public.payments as payment
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded');

    update public.order_cancellation_requests
    set
      stage = 'processing',
      decided_at = now(),
      provider_started_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = v_claim_id;

    insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
    values (
      p_user_id,
      'order.claim_auto_approved',
      'order:' || p_order_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'claimId', v_claim_id,
        'claimType', 'cancel',
        'from', 'requested',
        'to', 'processing',
        'previousOrderStatus', v_status::text,
        'reasonType', p_reason_type,
        'paymentCount', v_payment_count
      )
    );

    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      v_claim_id,
      'auto_approved',
      '취소 요청이 접수됐어요',
      '발송 전 주문이라 자동으로 승인됐습니다. 결제 취소 처리를 시작합니다.'
    );

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','auto_approved','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  if p_claim_type = 'cancel' and v_status = 'pending' then
    select attempt.state
    into v_attempt_state
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
    order by attempt.id
    limit 1;

    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      v_claim_id,
      'requested',
      '취소 요청이 접수됐어요',
      case v_attempt_state
        when 'prepared' then
          '결제가 끝나지 않은 주문이라 결제 기한이 지나면 결제 없이 자동으로 취소되고 알림을 보내드려요.'
        when 'confirming' then
          '결제 승인 결과를 확인한 뒤 주문 취소를 마무리합니다. 승인됐다면 결제를 취소하고, 승인되지 않았다면 결제 없이 취소한 뒤 알림을 보내드려요.'
        else
          '결제 결과를 확인한 뒤 주문 취소를 마무리하고 진행 상황을 알려드립니다.'
      end
    );

    return jsonb_build_object('outcome','requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
  end if;

  perform private.notify_order_claim(
    v_claim_id,
    'requested',
    '클레임 요청이 접수됐어요',
    '요청을 접수했습니다. 담당자가 확인한 뒤 진행 상황을 알려드립니다.'
  );

  return jsonb_build_object('outcome','requested','claimId',v_claim_id);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_bank_transfer_refund_identity(p_actor uuid, p_session uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 perform private.require_claim_refund_account_identity(p_actor,p_session);
 -- The current payment-operations gate is sales.manage with legacy admin-only;
 -- there is no payments.manage capability in the accepted capability registry.
 if not private.has_operator_capability(p_actor,'sales.manage',true) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='bank_refund_permission_required';end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_card_rewards_enabled()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  gate_enabled boolean;
begin
  select control.enabled
  into gate_enabled
  from private.card_reward_control as control
  where control.singleton
  for share;

  if not coalesce(gate_enabled, false) then
    raise exception 'card_rewards_disabled' using errcode = '55000';
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.require_claim_refund_account_identity(p_actor uuid, p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_actor is null or auth.uid() is distinct from p_actor or p_session_id is null
  or auth.jwt()->>'session_id' is distinct from p_session_id::text
  or not exists(select 1 from auth.sessions where id=p_session_id and user_id=p_actor
    and (not_after is null or not_after>statement_timestamp()))
  or not exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=p_actor) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='refund_account_auth_changed';
 end if;
end $function$

 RETURNS uuid

AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=(select auth.uid());
begin

  return private.require_actor_operator_capability(actor,p_capability,p_legacy_admin_only);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reserve_first_purchase_coupon(p_order_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_coupon_code text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_export_snapshot_v2(p_actor_id uuid, p_filters jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 p_review_id uuid;p_from date;p_to date;p_rating integer;p_status text;p_has_photo boolean;p_has_reply boolean;p_low_rating boolean;p_best text;
 p_kind text;p_repeat text;v_query text;v_field text;v_sort text;query_units integer;row_count integer;exported jsonb;fingerprint text;
 trim_chars constant text:=chr(9)||chr(10)||chr(11)||chr(12)||chr(13)||chr(32)||chr(160)||chr(5760)
  ||chr(8192)||chr(8193)||chr(8194)||chr(8195)||chr(8196)||chr(8197)||chr(8198)||chr(8199)||chr(8200)||chr(8201)||chr(8202)
  ||chr(8232)||chr(8233)||chr(8239)||chr(8287)||chr(12288)||chr(65279);
begin
 if p_actor_id is null or not private.has_operator_capability(p_actor_id,'cs.manage',false)
  or not exists(select 1 from auth.users u where u.id=p_actor_id and u.deleted_at is null
    and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=statement_timestamp())) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='review_export_auth_changed';end if;
 if p_filters is null or jsonb_typeof(p_filters)<>'object' or octet_length(p_filters::text)>3000
  or (select array_agg(key order by key) from jsonb_object_keys(p_filters) key)
    is distinct from array['best','field','from','kind','lowRating','photo','query','rating','repeat','reply','reviewId','sort','status','to']
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_filters) f where
    case when f.key='lowRating' then jsonb_typeof(f.value)<>'boolean'
     when f.key in ('from','to','reviewId') then jsonb_typeof(f.value) not in ('string','null')
     else jsonb_typeof(f.value)<>'string' end) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 if p_filters->>'kind' not in('all','ordinary','month') or p_filters->>'repeat' not in('all','yes','no','unknown')
  or p_filters->>'rating' not in ('all','1','2','3','4','5')
  or p_filters->>'status' not in ('all','visible','hidden')
  or p_filters->>'photo' not in ('all','with','without') or p_filters->>'reply' not in ('all','with','without')
  or p_filters->>'best' not in ('all','selected','not_selected','needs_review')
  or p_filters->>'field' not in ('all','good','author','body')
  or p_filters->>'sort' not in ('recent','oldest','rating_desc','rating_asc','good_name_asc','photo_count_desc','helpful_desc')
  or (p_filters->>'from' is not null and p_filters->>'from'!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
  or (p_filters->>'to' is not null and p_filters->>'to'!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
  or (p_filters->>'reviewId' is not null and p_filters->>'reviewId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 begin
  p_from:=(p_filters->>'from')::date;p_to:=(p_filters->>'to')::date;p_review_id:=(p_filters->>'reviewId')::uuid;
 exception when invalid_datetime_format or datetime_field_overflow or invalid_text_representation then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end;
 if p_from is not null and (p_from<date '0100-01-01' or p_from>date '9999-12-31')
  or p_to is not null and (p_to<date '0100-01-01' or p_to>date '9999-12-31')
  or p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from>p_to then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 v_query:=p_filters->>'query';
 select coalesce(sum(case when ascii(unit.ch)>65535 then 2 else 1 end),0)::integer
  into query_units from regexp_split_to_table(v_query,'') as unit(ch) where unit.ch<>'';
 if v_query<>btrim(v_query,trim_chars) or query_units>100 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 v_query:=nullif(v_query,'');v_field:=p_filters->>'field';v_sort:=p_filters->>'sort';
 p_rating:=nullif(p_filters->>'rating','all')::integer;p_status:=nullif(p_filters->>'status','all');p_best:=p_filters->>'best';
 p_kind:=p_filters->>'kind';p_repeat:=p_filters->>'repeat';
 p_low_rating:=(p_filters->>'lowRating')::boolean;
 p_has_photo:=case p_filters->>'photo' when 'with' then true when 'without' then false else null end;
 p_has_reply:=case p_filters->>'reply' when 'with' then true when 'without' then false else null end;
 with bounded as materialized (
  select row_number() over (  order by
    case when v_sort = 'helpful_desc' then helpful.helpful_count end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'photo_count_desc' then coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc
) ordinal,
   jsonb_build_object('kind',review.review_kind,'repeatPurchase',review.repeat_purchase,'id',review.id,'goodId',review.good_id,'goodName',good.name,
    'authorName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(author.nickname,'')),''),'fan_'||left(review.user_id::text,6)),
    'rating',review.rating,'body',review.body,'imageCount',coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0),
    'helpfulCount',helpful.helpful_count,'status',review.status,'bestState',private.review_best_state(review)->>'state',
    'reportCount',(select count(*) from public.reports report where report.target_type='review' and report.target_id=review.id::text),
    'openReportCount',(select count(*) from public.reports report where report.target_type='review' and report.target_id=review.id::text and report.status in ('open','reviewing')),
    'hasReply',review.admin_reply is not null,'replyAt',review.admin_reply_at,'createdAt',review.created_at,'editedAt',review.edited_at) value
  from public.reviews as review
  join public.goods as good on good.id = review.good_id
  cross join lateral(select count(*)::bigint helpful_count from private.review_helpful_votes vote where vote.review_id=review.id) helpful
  join public.profiles as author on author.id = review.user_id
  left join public.profiles as replier on replier.id = review.admin_reply_by
  where(p_kind='all' or review.review_kind=p_kind) and(p_repeat='all' or p_repeat='yes' and review.repeat_purchase is true or p_repeat='no' and review.repeat_purchase is false or p_repeat='unknown' and review.repeat_purchase is null)
    and (p_review_id is null or review.id = p_review_id)
    and (p_best='all' or (p_best='not_selected' and not exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected)) or (p_best in ('selected','needs_review') and exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected and private.review_best_state(review)->>'state'=p_best)))
    and (p_status is null or review.status = p_status)
    and (p_rating is null or review.rating = p_rating)
    and (not coalesce(p_low_rating, false) or review.rating <= 2)
    and (
      p_has_photo is null
      or (p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) > 0)
      or (not p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) = 0)
    )
    and (
      p_has_reply is null
      or (p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is not null)
      or (not p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is null)
    )
    and (
      p_from is null
      or review.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or review.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      v_query is null
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'good')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(good.name)) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.good_id)) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'author')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.email, ''))) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'body')
        and position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.body)) > 0
      )
    )

  order by
    case when v_sort = 'helpful_desc' then helpful.helpful_count end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'photo_count_desc' then coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc

  limit 10001
 ) select count(*)::integer,coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) into row_count,exported from bounded;
 if row_count>10000 then raise program_limit_exceeded using message='review_export_limit';end if;
 fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('version',2,'filters',p_filters,'rows',exported)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 return jsonb_build_object('version',2,'filters',p_filters,'total',row_count,'rows',exported,'capturedAt',statement_timestamp(),'fingerprint',fingerprint);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_export_snapshot(p_actor_id uuid, p_filters jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 p_review_id uuid;p_from date;p_to date;p_rating integer;p_status text;p_has_photo boolean;p_has_reply boolean;p_low_rating boolean;p_best text;
 v_query text;v_field text;v_sort text;query_units integer;row_count integer;exported jsonb;fingerprint text;
 trim_chars constant text:=chr(9)||chr(10)||chr(11)||chr(12)||chr(13)||chr(32)||chr(160)||chr(5760)
  ||chr(8192)||chr(8193)||chr(8194)||chr(8195)||chr(8196)||chr(8197)||chr(8198)||chr(8199)||chr(8200)||chr(8201)||chr(8202)
  ||chr(8232)||chr(8233)||chr(8239)||chr(8287)||chr(12288)||chr(65279);
begin
 if p_actor_id is null or not private.has_operator_capability(p_actor_id,'cs.manage',false)
  or not exists(select 1 from auth.users u where u.id=p_actor_id and u.deleted_at is null
    and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=statement_timestamp())) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='review_export_auth_changed';end if;
 if p_filters is null or jsonb_typeof(p_filters)<>'object' or octet_length(p_filters::text)>3000
  or (select array_agg(key order by key) from jsonb_object_keys(p_filters) key)
    is distinct from array['best','field','from','lowRating','photo','query','rating','reply','reviewId','sort','status','to']
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_filters) f where
    case when f.key='lowRating' then jsonb_typeof(f.value)<>'boolean'
     when f.key in ('from','to','reviewId') then jsonb_typeof(f.value) not in ('string','null')
     else jsonb_typeof(f.value)<>'string' end) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 if p_filters->>'rating' not in ('all','1','2','3','4','5')
  or p_filters->>'status' not in ('all','visible','hidden')
  or p_filters->>'photo' not in ('all','with','without') or p_filters->>'reply' not in ('all','with','without')
  or p_filters->>'best' not in ('all','selected','not_selected','needs_review')
  or p_filters->>'field' not in ('all','good','author','body')
  or p_filters->>'sort' not in ('recent','oldest','rating_desc','rating_asc','good_name_asc','photo_count_desc','helpful_desc')
  or (p_filters->>'from' is not null and p_filters->>'from'!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
  or (p_filters->>'to' is not null and p_filters->>'to'!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
  or (p_filters->>'reviewId' is not null and p_filters->>'reviewId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 begin
  p_from:=(p_filters->>'from')::date;p_to:=(p_filters->>'to')::date;p_review_id:=(p_filters->>'reviewId')::uuid;
 exception when invalid_datetime_format or datetime_field_overflow or invalid_text_representation then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end;
 if p_from is not null and (p_from<date '0100-01-01' or p_from>date '9999-12-31')
  or p_to is not null and (p_to<date '0100-01-01' or p_to>date '9999-12-31')
  or p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from>p_to then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 v_query:=p_filters->>'query';
 select coalesce(sum(case when ascii(unit.ch)>65535 then 2 else 1 end),0)::integer
  into query_units from regexp_split_to_table(v_query,'') as unit(ch) where unit.ch<>'';
 if v_query<>btrim(v_query,trim_chars) or query_units>100 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_export_filters';end if;
 v_query:=nullif(v_query,'');v_field:=p_filters->>'field';v_sort:=p_filters->>'sort';
 p_rating:=nullif(p_filters->>'rating','all')::integer;p_status:=nullif(p_filters->>'status','all');p_best:=p_filters->>'best';
 p_low_rating:=(p_filters->>'lowRating')::boolean;
 p_has_photo:=case p_filters->>'photo' when 'with' then true when 'without' then false else null end;
 p_has_reply:=case p_filters->>'reply' when 'with' then true when 'without' then false else null end;
 with bounded as materialized (
  select row_number() over (  order by
    case when v_sort = 'helpful_desc' then helpful.helpful_count end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'photo_count_desc' then coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc
) ordinal,
   jsonb_build_object('id',review.id,'goodId',review.good_id,'goodName',good.name,
    'authorName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(author.nickname,'')),''),'fan_'||left(review.user_id::text,6)),
    'rating',review.rating,'body',review.body,'imageCount',coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0),
    'helpfulCount',helpful.helpful_count,'status',review.status,'bestState',private.review_best_state(review)->>'state',
    'reportCount',(select count(*) from public.reports report where report.target_type='review' and report.target_id=review.id::text),
    'openReportCount',(select count(*) from public.reports report where report.target_type='review' and report.target_id=review.id::text and report.status in ('open','reviewing')),
    'hasReply',review.admin_reply is not null,'replyAt',review.admin_reply_at,'createdAt',review.created_at,'editedAt',review.edited_at) value
  from public.reviews as review
  join public.goods as good on good.id = review.good_id
  cross join lateral(select count(*)::bigint helpful_count from private.review_helpful_votes vote where vote.review_id=review.id) helpful
  join public.profiles as author on author.id = review.user_id
  left join public.profiles as replier on replier.id = review.admin_reply_by
  where (p_review_id is null or review.id = p_review_id)
    and (p_best='all' or (p_best='not_selected' and not exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected)) or (p_best in ('selected','needs_review') and exists(select 1 from private.review_best_selections selection where selection.review_id=review.id and selection.selected and private.review_best_state(review)->>'state'=p_best)))
    and (p_status is null or review.status = p_status)
    and (p_rating is null or review.rating = p_rating)
    and (not coalesce(p_low_rating, false) or review.rating <= 2)
    and (
      p_has_photo is null
      or (p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) > 0)
      or (not p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) = 0)
    )
    and (
      p_has_reply is null
      or (p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is not null)
      or (not p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is null)
    )
    and (
      p_from is null
      or review.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or review.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      v_query is null
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'good')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(good.name)) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.good_id)) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'author')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.email, ''))) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'body')
        and position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.body)) > 0
      )
    )

  order by
    case when v_sort = 'helpful_desc' then helpful.helpful_count end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'photo_count_desc' then coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc

  limit 10001
 ) select count(*)::integer,coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) into row_count,exported from bounded;
 if row_count>10000 then raise program_limit_exceeded using message='review_export_limit';end if;
 fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('version',1,'filters',p_filters,'rows',exported)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 return jsonb_build_object('version',1,'filters',p_filters,'total',row_count,'rows',exported,'capturedAt',statement_timestamp(),'fingerprint',fingerprint);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_helpful_actor_is_active(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select p_actor is not null and exists(select 1 from public.profiles p join auth.users u on u.id=p.id
  where p.id=p_actor and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until<=statement_timestamp()) and p.suspended_at is null and p.onboarded_at is not null
   and nullif(btrim(coalesce(p.email,u.email),U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF'),'') is not null and nullif(btrim(p.nickname,U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF'),'') is not null
   and p.birth_date is not null and p.birth_date<=(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'UTC')::date
   and p.consents->'terms'='true'::jsonb and p.consents->'privacy'='true'::jsonb
   and not exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences f where f.subject_user_id=p_actor));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_helpful_viewer_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid();session_text text:=auth.jwt()->>'session_id';
begin
 if actor is null or session_text is null or session_text!~*'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then return null;end if;
 if not exists(select 1 from auth.users u join public.profiles p on p.id=u.id
  join auth.sessions s on s.user_id=u.id and s.id=session_text::uuid
  where u.id=actor and u.deleted_at is null and (s.not_after is null or s.not_after>statement_timestamp())) then return null;end if;
 return actor;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_rating_snapshot(p_observed_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(average_rating numeric, six_month_rating numeric, eligible_product_count bigint, rated_product_count bigint, six_month_rated_product_count bigint, review_count bigint, six_month_review_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with cutoff as materialized (
  select date_trunc('day',p_observed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' day_start
 ), products as materialized (
  select g.id from public.goods g join public.ips i on i.id=g.ip_id
  where g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and i.archived_at is null and i.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none'
 ), visible_reviews as materialized (
  select r.good_id,r.rating,r.created_at from public.reviews r join products p on p.id=r.good_id cross join cutoff c
  where r.status='visible' and r.created_at<c.day_start
 ), reviews_by_product as (
  select r.good_id,avg(r.rating) average_rating,
   avg(r.rating) filter(where r.created_at>=((c.day_start at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')-interval '6 months') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') six_month_rating,
   count(*) review_count,
   count(*) filter(where r.created_at>=((c.day_start at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')-interval '6 months') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') six_month_review_count
  from visible_reviews r cross join cutoff c group by r.good_id
 ) select avg(r.average_rating),avg(r.six_month_rating),(select count(*) from products),count(r.average_rating),count(r.six_month_rating),
  coalesce(sum(r.review_count),0)::bigint,coalesce(sum(r.six_month_review_count),0)::bigint from reviews_by_product r;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_type_window(p_order public.orders, p_kind text)
 RETURNS TABLE(opens_at timestamp with time zone, deadline_at timestamp with time zone, policy_revision bigint, reward_eligible boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when p_kind='ordinary' then p_order.delivered_at else b.at+make_interval(days=>p.start_days) end,
 case when p_kind='ordinary' then private.review_write_deadline(p_order.delivered_at)
  else least(b.at+make_interval(days=>p.end_days),case when p.max_order_days is not null then p_order.created_at+make_interval(days=>p.max_order_days) end) end,
 case when p_kind='month' then p.revision end,p_kind='month' and p.reward_eligible
 from private.review_type_policy p cross join lateral(select case when p.basis='delivered' then p_order.delivered_at else
  (select confirmed_at from private.order_purchase_confirmations where order_id=p_order.id) end at)b
 where p.singleton and(p_kind='ordinary' or p_kind='month' and p.enabled and b.at is not null);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.seal_order_claim_refund_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.stage in('completed','rejected','withdrawn') and (tg_op='INSERT' or old.stage is distinct from new.stage) then
  update private.claim_refund_accounts set purge_after=coalesce(purge_after,now()+interval '30 days') where claim_id=new.id and purged_at is null;
 end if;

end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.seller_claim_collection_targets(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'shipmentId', s.id, 'originId', s.origin_id, 'originName', s.origin_name_snapshot,
    'returnAddress', private.shipment_return_address_summary(s.id), 'status', s.status,
    'items', (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', item.id, 'name', item.good_name_snapshot, 'qty', link.qty) order by item.id)
      from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items item on item.id = link.order_item_id where link.shipment_id = s.id)
  ) order by s.origin_id, s.id), '[]')
  from public.order_shipments s join public.fulfillment_origins origin on origin.id = s.origin_id
  where s.order_id = p_order_id and exists (select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link where link.shipment_id = s.id);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_current_trackings(p_shipment uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(carrier text, tracking_number text, since timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select t.carrier, t.tracking_number, max(t.since) from (
    select s.carrier, s.tracking_number, coalesce(s.exported_at, o.confirmed_at, s.shipped_at) as since from public.order_shipments s
      join public.orders o on o.id = s.order_id
      where s.id = p_shipment and s.carrier is not null and s.tracking_number is not null and s.shipped_at is not null
    union all
    select x.carrier, x.tracking_number, coalesce(s.exported_at, o.confirmed_at, s.shipped_at) from public.order_shipment_extra_trackings x
      join public.order_shipments s on s.id = x.shipment_id
      join public.orders o on o.id = s.order_id
      where x.shipment_id = p_shipment and s.shipped_at is not null
  ) t group by t.carrier, t.tracking_number;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_delay_notice_summary(p_shipment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with latest as (
  select n.id,n.requested_at,t.in_app_status,t.email_status,i.state provider_state
  from private.order_delay_notice_targets t
  join private.order_delay_notices n on n.id=t.notice_id and n.requested_at is not null and n.kind='dispatch_delay'
  join public.order_shipments s on s.id=p_shipment_id and s.order_id=t.order_id
  left join private.email_intents i on i.id=t.email_intent_id
  where t.shipment_ids @> array[p_shipment_id]
  order by n.requested_at desc,n.id desc,t.id desc limit 1
 ), effective as (
  select *,case when provider_state in ('accepted','sent','delivered','delayed') then 'sent'
   when provider_state in ('bounced','complained','failed') then 'failed'
   when provider_state='suppressed' then 'suppressed'
   when provider_state in ('unknown','needs_review') then 'unknown'
   when provider_state='queued' then 'queued'
   when provider_state='dispatching' then 'processing' else email_status end effective_email
  from latest
 ) select coalesce((select jsonb_build_object(
  'status',case when in_app_status='sent' and effective_email='sent' then 'sent'
    when effective_email='unknown' then 'unknown'
    when in_app_status='sent' and effective_email in ('failed','suppressed') then 'partial_failed'
    when effective_email in ('prepared','queued','processing') then 'pending' else 'unknown' end,
  'noticeId',id,'requestedAt',requested_at,'inAppStatus',in_app_status,
  'emailStatus',effective_email,'emailProviderState',provider_state) from effective),
  jsonb_build_object('status','not_sent','noticeId',null,'requestedAt',null,'inAppStatus',null,'emailStatus',null,'emailProviderState',null));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_delivery_summary(p_shipment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('method',shipment.delivery_method,'customerMethod',shipment.fulfillment_partition,
    'changedBy',(select case when operation.evidence->>'source'='dispatch_console' then 'store'
        when operation.evidence ? 'customerRequestReference' then 'customer' end
      from private.shipment_delivery_operations operation where operation.shipment_id=shipment.id and operation.kind='method_selected'
      order by operation.recorded_at desc,operation.id desc limit 1),'policy',case when shipment.delivery_method='digital' then null else shipment.delivery_method_snapshot end,
    'canIssueReceipt',purchase.status in ('confirmed','shipping')
      and ((shipment.delivery_method in('pickup','none') and shipment.status='ready') or (shipment.delivery_method in('quick','direct','freight') and shipment.status='shipping'))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests request where request.order_id=purchase.id and request.status in ('requested','processing','needs_review'))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims claim where claim.order_id=purchase.id),
    'providerName',(select operation.evidence->>'providerName' from private.shipment_delivery_operations operation
      where operation.shipment_id=shipment.id and operation.kind in('quick_handoff','direct_handoff','freight_handoff') order by operation.recorded_at desc,operation.id limit 1))
  from public.order_shipments shipment join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=shipment.order_id where shipment.id=p_shipment_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_email_delivery_state(p_order uuid, p_shipment uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with keys as (
  select 'order_shipped:'||p_order||':'||p_shipment dedupe_key
  union all select 'order_shipped:'||p_order||':'||p_shipment||':recipient'
   where exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents g where g.order_id=p_order)
 ), states as (
  select case when d.status='sent' then 'sent'
   when d.status='pending' then case when d.claimed_at>clock_timestamp()-interval '10 minutes' then 'busy' else 'unknown' end
   when d.status='failed' and coalesce(d.safe_error_code,d.last_error,'') !~ '^(provider_http_(429|5[0-9]{2})|provider_not_configured)$' then 'unknown'
   else 'ready' end state
  from keys k left join public.email_deliveries d using(dedupe_key)
 ) select case when bool_or(state='unknown') then 'unknown' when bool_or(state='busy') then 'busy'
   when bool_and(state='sent') then 'sent' else 'ready' end from states;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_pack_document(p_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare ids uuid[]:=private.shipment_pack_scope(p_ids);rows jsonb;stamp text;can_create boolean;begin
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'orderId',s.order_id,'originName',s.origin_name_snapshot,'buyerName',coalesce(p.nickname,'구매자'),
 'recipientName',private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'recipientName','status',s.status,'exportedAt',s.exported_at,'updatedAt',s.updated_at,
 'orderUpdatedAt',o.updated_at,'identity',encode(extensions.digest(private.shipment_pack_identity(s.id)::text,'sha256'),'hex'),
 'shippingFee',s.shipping_fee,'collectFee',s.shipping_collect_fee,'ready',private.shipment_pack_ready(s.id),'pack',private.shipment_pack_summary(s.id)) order by s.id),'[]') into rows
 from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id where s.id=any(ids);
 stamp:=encode(extensions.digest(rows::text,'sha256'),'hex');
 select cardinality(p_ids) between 2 and 100 and cardinality(ids)=cardinality(p_ids) and jsonb_array_length(rows)=cardinality(ids)
  and bool_and(value->>'ready'='true' and value->'exportedAt'='null'::jsonb and value->'pack'='null'::jsonb)
  and count(distinct value->>'identity')=1 into can_create from jsonb_array_elements(rows);
 return jsonb_build_object('version',stamp,'canCreate',coalesce(can_create,false),'rows',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value-'identity'-'orderUpdatedAt'),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(rows)));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipment_pack_ready(p_shipment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare s public.order_shipments;o public.orders;a jsonb;begin
 select * into s from public.order_shipments where id=p_shipment;
 select * into o from public.orders where id=s.order_id;a:=private.shipment_pack_identity(p_shipment)->'address';
 if s.id is null or s.delivery_method<>'parcel' or s.status<>'ready' or o.status not in('confirmed','shipping')
  or s.shipped_at is not null or not private.shipment_preorder_allocation_ready(s.id)
  or coalesce(a->>'recipientName','')='' or coalesce(a->>'address1','')='' or coalesce(a->>'postalCode','')!~'^[0-9]{5}$'
  or coalesce(a->>'phone','')!~'^[0-9]{8,15}$'
  or not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items where shipment_id=s.id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items a join public.order_items i on i.id=a.order_item_id where a.shipment_id=s.id and (a.order_id<>o.id or i.order_id<>o.id or a.qty<>private.order_item_active_qty(i.id)))
  or exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences where subject_user_id=any(private.contact_parties(o.id)))
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=o.id and status in('requested','processing','needs_review'))
  or exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=o.id)
  or private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(o.id)
  or private.order_fulfillment_held(o.id)
  or not exists(select 1 from public.payments where purpose='order' and ref_id=o.id and user_id=o.user_id and amount=o.total and status='paid') then return false;end if;
 return true;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipping_charge_group_context(p_request jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_request) is distinct from 'object'
  or not p_request ?& array['operationId','command','groupId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'operationId') or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedActorId')
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedSessionId') or coalesce(p_request->>'command','') not in('save','assign')
  or not (private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'groupId') or (p_request->>'command'='assign' and p_request->'groupId'='null'::jsonb))
  or not private.transaction_uint(p_request->'expectedRevision',0,case when p_request->>'command'='save' then 2147483646 else 2147483647 end)
  or (p_request->>'command'='assign' and ((p_request->'groupId'='null'::jsonb) is distinct from (p_request->>'expectedRevision'='0'))) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_charge_group_operation';end if;
 select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) into result from jsonb_each(p_request)
 where key=any(array['operationId','command','groupId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']);
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipping_charge_group_prior(p_context jsonb, p_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare previous private.shipping_charge_group_operations;begin
 select * into previous from private.shipping_charge_group_operations where operation_id=(p_context->>'operationId')::uuid;
 if not found then return null;end if;
 if previous.actor_id is distinct from (p_context->>'expectedActorId')::uuid or previous.session_id is distinct from (p_context->>'expectedSessionId')::uuid
  or previous.command is distinct from p_context->>'command' or previous.group_id is distinct from (p_context->>'groupId')::uuid
  or previous.expected_revision is distinct from (p_context->>'expectedRevision')::integer
  or (p_hash is not null and previous.receipt->>'state'<>'sealed' and previous.request_hash is distinct from p_hash) then
  raise sqlstate 'PT409' using message='shipping_charge_group_operation_conflict';end if;
 return previous.receipt;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipping_settings_operation_context(p_request jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_request) is distinct from 'object' or not p_request ?& array['operationId','command','templateId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'operationId') or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'templateId')
  or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedActorId') or not private.shipping_settings_uuid(p_request->'expectedSessionId')
  or coalesce(p_request->>'command','') not in('save','apply')
  or not private.transaction_uint(p_request->'expectedRevision',case when p_request->>'command'='apply' then 1 else 0 end,
   case when p_request->>'command'='save' then 2147483646 else 2147483647 end) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_settings_operation';end if;
 select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) into result from jsonb_each(p_request)
 where key=any(array['operationId','command','templateId','expectedRevision','expectedActorId','expectedSessionId']);
 return result;
end $function$

  'collectorName',case when v.status='active' and p_origin.is_active then v.contract_values->>'collectorName' else null end)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.shipping_settings_prior(p_context jsonb, p_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare previous private.shipping_settings_operations;begin
 select * into previous from private.shipping_settings_operations where operation_id=(p_context->>'operationId')::uuid;
 if not found then return null;end if;
 if previous.actor_id is distinct from (p_context->>'expectedActorId')::uuid or previous.session_id is distinct from (p_context->>'expectedSessionId')::uuid
  or previous.command is distinct from p_context->>'command' or previous.template_id is distinct from (p_context->>'templateId')::uuid
  or previous.expected_revision is distinct from (p_context->>'expectedRevision')::integer
  or (p_hash is not null and previous.receipt->>'state'<>'sealed' and previous.request_hash is distinct from p_hash) then
  raise sqlstate 'PT409' using message='shipping_settings_operation_conflict';end if;
 return previous.receipt;
end $function$
