CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.snapshot_account_deletion_legal_records(p_deletion_event_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_tracking_hmac_key bytea;
  v_tracking_key_version smallint;
begin
  perform private.snapshot_goods_subscription_contracts(p_deletion_event_id,p_user_id);
  perform private.snapshot_claim_fee_contracts(p_deletion_event_id,p_user_id);
 perform private.snapshot_order_production_contracts(p_deletion_event_id,p_user_id);
 perform private.snapshot_order_fulfillment_contracts(p_deletion_event_id,p_user_id);
 perform private.snapshot_order_partial_cancellations(p_deletion_event_id,p_user_id);
  select
    control.shipment_tracking_hmac_key,
    control.shipment_tracking_key_version
    into strict v_tracking_hmac_key, v_tracking_key_version
  from private.account_deletion_control as control
  where control.singleton;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'order',
    order_record.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'orderRef', order_record.id::text,
      'status', order_record.status,
      'total', order_record.total,
      'shippingFee', order_record.shipping_fee,
      'shippingCouponDiscount',order_record.shipping_coupon_discount_total,
      'couponApplications',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('redemptionRef',r.id,'benefitKind',r.benefit_kind,
       'applicationIndex',r.application_index,'discountAmount',r.discount_amount,'eligibleSubtotal',r.eligible_subtotal,
       'status',r.status,'appliedAt',r.applied_at,'releasedAt',r.released_at) order by r.application_index,r.id)
       from public.coupon_redemptions r where r.order_id=order_record.id),'[]'),
      'calculationVersion',order_record.calculation_version,'volumeDiscount',order_record.volume_discount_total,
      'couponDiscount',order_record.discount_total,'storeCredits',order_record.store_credit_total,'shippingCollectTotal',order_record.shipping_collect_total,
      'shippingCharges',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',component.id,'shipmentRef',component.shipment_id,'mode',component.payment_mode,
       'baseFee',component.base_fee,'regionalFee',component.regional_fee,'installationFee',component.installation_fee,
       'shippingCouponDiscount',component.shipping_coupon_discount,'totalFee',component.total_fee) order by component.id)
       from private.shipping_charge_components component where component.order_id=order_record.id),'[]'),
      'shippingCollect',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentRef',obligation.shipment_id,'amount',obligation.amount,'state',obligation.state,
       'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('operationId',e.operation_id,'event',e.event,'amount',e.amount,'recordedAt',e.created_at,
        'occurredAt',e.evidence->'occurredAt','reversesOperationId',e.evidence->'reversesOperationId') order by coalesce(e.previous_revision,0),e.created_at,e.operation_id)
        from private.shipping_collect_events e where e.shipment_id=obligation.shipment_id),'[]')) order by obligation.shipment_id)
       from private.shipping_collect_obligations obligation where obligation.order_id=order_record.id),'[]'),
      'contractedAt', order_record.created_at,
      'items', coalesce(
        (
          select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
            pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
              'goodRef', item.good_id,
              'goodName', item.good_name_snapshot,
              'goodType', item.good_type_snapshot,
              'ipRef', item.good_ip_id_snapshot,
              'quantity', item.qty,
              'unitPrice', item.unit_price,
              'allocation',(select jsonb_build_object('calculationVersion',a.calculation_version,'subtotal',a.subtotal,'volumeDiscount',a.volume_discount,
               'netSubtotal',a.net_subtotal,'couponDiscount',a.coupon_discount,'storeCreditDiscount',a.store_credit_discount,'paidGoodsTotal',a.paid_goods_total)
               from private.order_price_allocation_ledger a where a.order_item_id=item.id and a.order_id=order_record.id)
            )
            order by item.id
          )
          from public.order_items as item
          where item.order_id = order_record.id
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    ) || coalesce((select jsonb_build_object('allocationLedger',jsonb_build_object('sourceCalculationVersion',h.source_calculation_version,
       'ruleVersion',h.rule_version,'inputHash',h.input_hash,'frozenAt',h.frozen_at,'paymentAmount',h.payment_amount,'paidGoodsTotal',h.paid_goods_total,
       'shippingTotal',h.shipping_total,
       'shipments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('shipmentRef',v.shipment_id,'prepaidShippingFee',v.prepaid_shipping_fee) order by v.shipment_id)
        from private.order_v1_shipment_allocations v where v.order_id=order_record.id),'[]'::jsonb)))
       from private.order_v1_price_allocation_heads h where h.order_id=order_record.id),'{}'::jsonb),
    'ecommerce_transaction_v1',
    order_record.created_at + interval '5 years'
  from public.orders as order_record
  where order_record.user_id = p_user_id
    and order_record.created_at + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'order_cancellation',
    request.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'cancellationRef', request.id::text,
      'orderRef', request.order_id::text,
      'status', request.status,
      'decision', case
        when request.status = 'rejected' then 'rejected'
        when request.decided_at is not null
          and request.status in ('processing', 'needs_review', 'completed')
          then 'approved'
        when request.status = 'requested' then 'pending'
        else 'unknown'
      end,
      'reasonType', request.reason_type,
      'requestedAt', request.requested_at,
      'decidedAt', request.decided_at,
      'providerStartedAt', request.provider_started_at,
      'completedAt', request.completed_at
    ),
    'ecommerce_transaction_v1',
    request.requested_at + interval '5 years'
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  join public.orders as order_record on order_record.id = request.order_id
  where order_record.user_id = p_user_id
    and request.requested_at + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'shipment',
    shipment.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'orderRef', order_record.id::text,
      'shipmentRef', shipment.id::text,
      'originName', shipment.origin_name_snapshot,
      'status', shipment.status,
      'carrier', shipment.carrier,
      'opaqueTrackingRef', case
        when shipment.tracking_number is null then null
        else pg_catalog.encode(
          extensions.hmac(
            pg_catalog.convert_to(
              'account-deletion-shipment-v1|'
                || shipment.carrier
                || '|'
                || shipment.tracking_number,
              'UTF8'
            ),
            v_tracking_hmac_key,
            'sha256'
          ),
          'hex'
        )
      end,
      'trackingKeyVersion', case
        when shipment.tracking_number is null then null
        else v_tracking_key_version
      end,
      'shippedAt', shipment.shipped_at,
      'suppliedAt', shipment.delivered_at
    ),
    'ecommerce_transaction_v1',
    coalesce(
      shipment.delivered_at,
      shipment.shipped_at,
      order_record.created_at
    ) + interval '5 years'
  from public.order_shipments as shipment
  join public.orders as order_record on order_record.id=shipment.order_id
  where order_record.user_id = p_user_id
    and shipment.delivered_at is not null
    and coalesce(
      shipment.delivered_at,
      shipment.shipped_at,
      order_record.created_at
    ) + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'payment',
    payment.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'paymentRef', payment.id::text,
      'provider', payment.provider,
      'purpose', payment.purpose,
      'relatedRef', payment.ref_id,
      'amount', payment.amount,
      'currency', 'KRW',
      'status', payment.status,
      'ledgerRecordedAt', payment.created_at,
      'integrationBinding',(select jsonb_build_object('integration',binding.integration,'profileId',binding.profile_id,'merchantId',binding.merchant_id,
       'environment',binding.environment,'writeKeyVersion',binding.write_key_version,'firstDispatchedAt',binding.first_dispatched_at)
       from public.payment_attempts attempt join private.payment_provider_bindings binding on binding.attempt_id=attempt.id where attempt.payment_id=payment.id),
      'approvedAt', (
        select pg_catalog.max(evidence.approved_at)
        from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        join private.payment_provider_evidence as evidence
          on evidence.payment_attempt_id = attempt.id
        where attempt.payment_id = payment.id
          and attempt.state = 'approved'
      )
    ),
    case when payment.purpose = 'ticket'
      then 'ticket_transaction_v1'
      else 'ecommerce_transaction_v1'
    end,
    payment.created_at + interval '5 years'
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.user_id = p_user_id
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.payment_attempts as attempt
      join private.payment_provider_evidence as evidence
        on evidence.payment_attempt_id = attempt.id
      where attempt.payment_id = payment.id
        and attempt.state = 'approved'
        and evidence.approved_at is not null
    )
    and payment.created_at + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'refund',
    refund.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'refundRef', refund.id::text,
      'paymentRef', refund.payment_id::text,
      'relatedCancellationRef', coalesce(
        refund.cancellation_request_id::text,
        refund.ticket_cancellation_request_id::text
      ),
      'amount', refund.amount,
      'status', refund.status,
      'bankTransferProof', private.bank_transfer_refund_legal_proof(refund.payment_id),
      'requestedAt', refund.created_at,
      'refundedAt', case
        when refund.status = 'done' then coalesce(
          order_request.completed_at,
          ticket_request.completed_at
        )
        else null
      end
    ),
    case when payment.purpose = 'ticket'
      then 'ticket_transaction_v1'
      else 'ecommerce_transaction_v1'
    end,
    refund.created_at + interval '5 years'
  from public.refunds as refund
  join public.payments as payment on payment.id = refund.payment_id
  left join public.order_cancellation_requests as order_request
    on order_request.id = refund.cancellation_request_id
  left join public.ticket_cancellation_requests as ticket_request
    on ticket_request.id = refund.ticket_cancellation_request_id
  where payment.user_id = p_user_id
    and refund.status = 'done'
    and coalesce(order_request.completed_at, ticket_request.completed_at) is not null
    and refund.created_at + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'ticket_order',
    ticket_order.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'ticketOrderRef', ticket_order.id::text,
      'eventRef', ticket_order.event_id,
      'status', ticket_order.status,
      'total', ticket_order.total,
      'contractedAt', ticket_order.created_at,
      'tickets', coalesce(
        (
          select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
            pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
              'ticketRef', ticket.id::text,
              'ticketTypeRef', ticket.ticket_type_id::text,
              'status', ticket.status
            )
            order by ticket.id
          )
          from public.tickets as ticket
          where ticket.ticket_order_id = ticket_order.id
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    ),
    'ticket_transaction_v1',
    ticket_order.created_at + interval '5 years'
  from public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
  where ticket_order.user_id = p_user_id
    and ticket_order.created_at + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'ticket_cancellation',
    request.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'cancellationRef', request.id::text,
      'ticketOrderRef', request.ticket_order_id::text,
      'source', request.source,
      'status', request.status,
      'policyCode', request.policy_code,
      'cutoffAt', request.cutoff_at,
      'grossAmount', request.gross_amount,
      'feeAmount', request.fee_amount,
      'refundAmount', request.refund_amount,
      'requestedAt', request.requested_at,
      'providerStartedAt', request.provider_started_at,
      'completedAt', request.completed_at
    ),
    'ticket_transaction_v1',
    request.requested_at + interval '5 years'
  from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
  join public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
    on ticket_order.id = request.ticket_order_id
  where ticket_order.user_id = p_user_id
    and request.requested_at + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;

  insert into private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots (
    deletion_event_id,
    record_type,
    record_ref,
    snapshot_data,
    legal_basis,
    retain_until
  )
  select
    p_deletion_event_id,
    'ticket_check_in',
    ticket.id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'ticketRef', ticket.id::text,
      'ticketOrderRef', ticket.ticket_order_id::text,
      'checkedAt', check_in.checked_at
    ),
    'ticket_transaction_v1',
    check_in.checked_at + interval '5 years'
  from public.check_ins as check_in
  join public.tickets as ticket on ticket.id = check_in.ticket_id
  join public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
    on ticket_order.id = ticket.ticket_order_id
  where ticket_order.user_id = p_user_id
    and check_in.checked_at + interval '5 years' > pg_catalog.now()
  on conflict (deletion_event_id, record_type, record_ref) do update
  set
    snapshot_data = excluded.snapshot_data,
    legal_basis = excluded.legal_basis,
    retain_until = greatest(
      private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.retain_until,
      excluded.retain_until
    )
  where private.account_deletion_legal_snapshots.destroyed_at is null;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_reconcile_adjustments(p_variant_ids uuid[], p_as_of timestamp with time zone)

 LANGUAGE sql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_reconcile_document(p_snapshot_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id',s.id,'originId',s.origin_id,'originName',o.name,'sourceLabel',s.source_label,'asOf',s.as_of,
    'createdAt',s.created_at,'createdByName',coalesce(creator.nickname,''),
    'rowCount',s.row_count,'matchedCount',s.matched_count,'issueCount',s.issue_count,
    'changedCount',(select count(*) from private.stock_reconcile_snapshot_items i where i.snapshot_id=s.id and i.target_qty<>i.stock_qty),
    'appliedAt',s.applied_at,'appliedByName',applier.nickname,'applyReason',s.apply_reason,'applyResult',s.apply_result,
    'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'variantId',i.variant_id,'goodId',v.good_id,'goodsCode',g.code,'goodsName',g.name,'optionName',v.name,'optionCode',v.code,
        'sourceRow',i.source_row,'matchKind',i.match_kind,'fileQty',i.file_qty,'stockQty',i.stock_qty,'pendingQty',i.pending_qty,
        'shippedSinceQty',i.shipped_since_qty,'returnedSinceQty',i.returned_since_qty,'awaitingReturnQty',i.awaiting_return_qty,
        'adjustedSinceCount',i.adjusted_since_count,'adjustedSinceQty',i.adjusted_since_qty,
        'difference',i.difference,'targetQty',i.target_qty,
        'appliedDelta',i.applied_delta,'stockAfter',i.stock_after,'preorder',v.preorder_policy_id is not null,
        'stockBefore',i.stock_before,'appliedPendingQty',i.applied_pending_qty,'appliedShippedSinceQty',i.applied_shipped_since_qty,
        'appliedReturnedSinceQty',i.applied_returned_since_qty,'appliedAwaitingReturnQty',i.applied_awaiting_return_qty)
      order by (i.target_qty<>i.stock_qty) desc,abs(i.difference) desc,g.name,v.sort_order,i.variant_id)
      from private.stock_reconcile_snapshot_items i
      join public.goods_variants v on v.id=i.variant_id
      join public.goods g on g.id=v.good_id
      where i.snapshot_id=s.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'issues',s.issues)
  from private.stock_reconcile_snapshots s
  left join public.fulfillment_origins o on o.id=s.origin_id
  left join public.profiles creator on creator.id=s.created_by
  left join public.profiles applier on applier.id=s.applied_by
  where s.id=p_snapshot_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_reconcile_flows(p_variant_ids uuid[], p_as_of timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(variant_id uuid, pending_qty bigint, shipped_since_qty bigint, returned_since_qty bigint, awaiting_return_qty bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with targets as (
    select distinct supplied.id from unnest(p_variant_ids) as supplied(id) where supplied.id is not null
  ), members as (
    select t.id as member_id,t.id as holder_id from targets t
    union
    select h.source_id,h.holder_id from private.stock_reconcile_holders() h join targets t on t.id=h.holder_id
  ), units as (
    select oi.id as item_id,oi.order_id,(oi.qty-private.order_item_partially_canceled_qty(oi.id))::bigint as qty,m.holder_id,o.status as order_status,
      case when s.id is not null then s.status in ('shipping','delivered') or s.shipped_at is not null
        else o.status in ('shipping','delivered','done') or o.shipped_at is not null end as left_warehouse,
      case when s.id is not null then coalesce(s.shipped_at,s.delivered_at) else coalesce(o.shipped_at,o.delivered_at) end as left_at
    from public.order_items oi
    join members m on m.member_id=oi.variant_id
    join public.orders o on o.id=oi.order_id
    left join public.order_shipment_items si on si.order_item_id=oi.id
    left join public.order_shipments s on s.id=si.shipment_id
    where (s.id is null or (s.fulfillment_partition<>'digital' and (s.status<>'canceled' or s.shipped_at is not null)))
      and (oi.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations r
        where r.order_item_id=oi.id and r.state in ('allocated','returned')))
  ), restorations as (
    -- 취소·환불의 재고 복원 기록(private.restore_order_item_supply). 품목마다 한 번이다.
    select u.item_id,u.left_warehouse,u.left_at,a.created_at as restored_at,(a.diff->>'delta')::bigint as qty,
      (a.diff->>'variantId')::uuid as restored_variant_id,u.order_id
    from units u
    join public.audit_log a on a.target='order:'||u.order_id::text and a.action='order.option_stock_restored'
      and a.diff->>'orderItemId'=u.item_id::text
  ), reshipped as (
    -- 교환 재출고: 재출고 시각에 재고를 빼고 바로 보낸다. 배송 건(출고지)마다 재출고하면 그 배송 건 재출고 행의 시각이고,
    -- 이 기능 전 클레임 단위 한 쌍(reshipment_id 없음)은 클레임 재출고 시각이다. 그룹상품 교환은 별도 배정 원장에 남는다.
    select m.holder_id,ri.qty::bigint as qty,coalesce(r.reshipped_at,c.reshipped_at) as left_at
    from public.order_claim_reshipment_items ri
    join public.order_cancellation_requests c on c.id=ri.claim_id
    left join public.order_claim_reshipments r on r.id=ri.reshipment_id
    join members m on m.member_id=ri.variant_id
    where coalesce(r.reshipped_at,c.reshipped_at) is not null
    union all
    select m.holder_id,a.qty::bigint,coalesce(r.reshipped_at,c.reshipped_at)
    from private.group_claim_reshipment_allocations a
    join public.order_cancellation_requests c on c.id=a.claim_id
    left join public.order_claim_reshipments r on r.id=a.reshipment_id
    join members m on m.member_id=a.target_variant_id
    where coalesce(r.reshipped_at,c.reshipped_at) is not null
  ), member_items as (
    -- 구매·교환 재출고·회수로 이 옵션들의 실물이었던 적이 있는 품목만 회수 옵션을 계산한다.
    select oi.id from public.order_items oi join members m on m.member_id=oi.variant_id
    union
    select ri.order_item_id from public.order_claim_reshipment_items ri join members m on m.member_id in (ri.variant_id,ri.source_variant_id)
    union
    select a.order_item_id from private.group_claim_reshipment_allocations a join members m on m.member_id in (a.target_variant_id,a.returned_variant_id)
  ), collected as (
    -- 회수한 클레임의 실물. 출고지별 회수 기록이 있는 클레임은 배송 건마다 그 입고 시각에 그 배송 건 품목이 돌아온다.
    -- 회수 생략 결정이 효력 있는 배송 건(private.claim_collection_waived)은 창고로 돌아오지 않으므로 뺀다. 회수 옵션은 교환
    -- 재출고가 끝났으면 기록된 회수 옵션, 아니면 그 클레임 전의 실물 단위다. 복원 여부: 교환은 회수품을 복원한 그 배송 건 재출고
    -- 행(회수 생략으로 보낸 재출고는 복원하지 않았다, 이 기능 전 클레임 단위 한 쌍이면 클레임 재출고), 취소·반품은 주문 취소·완료.
    select x.collected_at,(j->>'qty')::bigint as qty,oi.id as item_id,
      coalesce(
        (select ri.source_variant_id from public.order_claim_reshipment_items ri where ri.claim_id=c.id and ri.order_item_id=oi.id limit 1),
        (select a.returned_variant_id from private.group_claim_reshipment_allocations a where a.claim_id=c.id and a.order_item_id=oi.id limit 1),
        (select p.variant_id from private.order_item_physical_unit(oi.id) p)) as returned_variant_id,
      case when c.claim_type='exchange' then exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipments r where r.claim_id=c.id and r.shipment_id=x.shipment_id
            and not r.collection_waived)
          or (c.reshipped_at is not null and not exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipments r where r.claim_id=c.id))
        else o.status='canceled' or c.stage='completed' end as restored,c.id as claim_id
    from public.order_claim_collection_bundles x
    join public.order_cancellation_requests c on c.id=x.claim_id
    join public.orders o on o.id=c.order_id
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(x.items_snapshot) j
    join public.order_items oi on oi.id=(j->>'orderItemId')::uuid and oi.order_id=c.order_id
    where x.collected_at is not null and c.stage not in ('rejected','withdrawn')
      and not private.claim_collection_waived(x.claim_id,x.shipment_id)
      and oi.id in (select mi.id from member_items mi)
      and (oi.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations r
        where r.order_item_id=oi.id and r.state in ('allocated','returned')))
    union all
    -- 출고지별 회수 기록이 없는 클레임(레거시 회수): 주문 단위 클레임이라 그 주문에서 창고를 떠난 품목 전부가 클레임 회수
    -- 시각에 돌아온다. 교환 재고 반영은 그 품목의 배송 건 재출고 기록(배송 건 재출고가 시작된 클레임), 아니면 클레임 재출고다.
    select c.collected_at,oi.qty::bigint as qty,oi.id,
      coalesce(
        (select ri.source_variant_id from public.order_claim_reshipment_items ri where ri.claim_id=c.id and ri.order_item_id=oi.id limit 1),
        (select a.returned_variant_id from private.group_claim_reshipment_allocations a where a.claim_id=c.id and a.order_item_id=oi.id limit 1),
        (select p.variant_id from private.order_item_physical_unit(oi.id) p)) as returned_variant_id,
      case when c.claim_type<>'exchange' then o.status='canceled' or c.stage='completed'
        when exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipments r where r.claim_id=c.id) then
          exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipment_items ri where ri.claim_id=c.id and ri.order_item_id=oi.id and ri.reshipment_id is not null)
          or exists(select 1 from private.group_claim_reshipment_allocations a where a.claim_id=c.id and a.order_item_id=oi.id and a.reshipment_id is not null)
        else c.reshipped_at is not null end as restored,c.id as claim_id
    from public.order_cancellation_requests c
    join public.orders o on o.id=c.order_id
    join public.order_items oi on oi.order_id=c.order_id
    where c.collected_at is not null and c.stage not in ('rejected','withdrawn') and oi.id in (select mi.id from member_items mi)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_collections x where x.claim_id=c.id)
      and (oi.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations r
        where r.order_item_id=oi.id and r.state in ('allocated','returned')))
      and coalesce((select (s.status in ('shipping','delivered') or s.shipped_at is not null) and s.fulfillment_partition<>'digital'
          from public.order_shipment_items si join public.order_shipments s on s.id=si.shipment_id where si.order_item_id=oi.id),
        o.shipped_at is not null)
  ), returned as (
    select m.holder_id,c.qty,c.collected_at,c.restored
    from collected c join members m on m.member_id=c.returned_variant_id
    where not exists(select 1 from private.claim_defective_stock d join public.order_cancellation_requests dc on dc.id=d.claim_id
      where d.order_item_id=c.item_id and d.claim_id=c.claim_id and dc.claim_type=d.source and dc.stage not in ('rejected','withdrawn'))
    union all
    -- 회수 클레임 없이 재고가 복원된 출고분은 복원 시각에 돌아온 것으로 본다.
    select m.holder_id,r.qty,r.restored_at,true
    from restorations r join members m on m.member_id=r.restored_variant_id
    where r.left_warehouse and (r.left_at is null or r.left_at<=r.restored_at)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=r.order_id
        and c.collected_at is not null and c.stage not in ('rejected','withdrawn'))
      -- 배송 건 회수로 이미 센 품목은 복원 시각에 다시 세지 않는다(클레임 회수 완료 전의 출고지별 입고).
      and not exists(select 1 from collected cc where cc.item_id=r.item_id)
  )
  select t.id,
    coalesce((select sum(u.qty) from units u where u.holder_id=t.id and u.order_status<>'canceled' and not u.left_warehouse
      and not exists(select 1 from restorations r where r.item_id=u.item_id)),0)::bigint,
    (coalesce((select sum(u.qty) from units u where u.holder_id=t.id and u.left_warehouse and u.left_at>p_as_of),0)
      +coalesce((select sum(r.qty) from reshipped r where r.holder_id=t.id and r.left_at>p_as_of),0))::bigint,
    coalesce((select sum(r.qty) from returned r where r.holder_id=t.id and r.collected_at>p_as_of),0)::bigint,
    coalesce((select sum(r.qty) from returned r where r.holder_id=t.id and not r.restored),0)::bigint
  from targets t;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_reconcile_holders()
 RETURNS TABLE(source_id uuid, holder_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with recursive chain(source_id,holder_id,depth) as (
    select s.source_variant_id,s.target_variant_id,1 from private.goods_stock_successors s
    union all
    select c.source_id,s.target_variant_id,c.depth+1 from chain c
      join private.goods_stock_successors s on s.source_variant_id=c.holder_id
    where c.depth<128
  )
  select distinct on (c.source_id) c.source_id,c.holder_id from chain c order by c.source_id,c.depth desc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_reconcile_resolve(p_rows jsonb, p_origin_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(source_row integer, match_key text, file_qty integer, variant_id uuid, good_id text, match_kind text, issue text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with input as (
    select (x->>'row')::integer as source_row,
      nullif(upper(btrim(x->>'goodsCode')),'') as goods_code,
      nullif(upper(btrim(x->>'optionCode')),'') as option_code,
      nullif(btrim(x->>'erpCode'),'') as erp_code,
      nullif(btrim(x->>'barcode'),'') as barcode,
      (x->>'qty')::integer as file_qty
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows) x
  ), looked as (
    select i.*,
      (select v.id from public.goods_variants v where v.code=i.option_code) as by_option,
      (select e.variant_id from private.goods_variant_external_identity e where lower(e.erp_code)=lower(i.erp_code)) as by_erp,
      (select e.variant_id from private.goods_variant_external_identity e where lower(e.barcode)=lower(i.barcode)) as by_barcode,
      (select g.id from public.goods g where g.code=i.goods_code) as goods_id,
      coalesce(i.option_code,i.erp_code,i.barcode,i.goods_code) as match_key
    from input i
  ), picked as (
    select l.*,
      (select count(distinct candidate) from unnest(array[l.by_option,l.by_erp,l.by_barcode]) candidate where candidate is not null) as key_hits,
      case when l.goods_id is null then null else
        (select case when count(*)=1 then min(v.id::text)::uuid end from public.goods_variants v
          where v.good_id=l.goods_id and v.archived_at is null) end as by_goods
    from looked l
  ), chosen as (
    select p.*,coalesce(p.by_option,p.by_erp,p.by_barcode,p.by_goods) as candidate,
      case when p.by_option is not null then 'option_code' when p.by_erp is not null then 'erp_code'
        when p.by_barcode is not null then 'barcode' when p.by_goods is not null then 'goods_code' end as kind
    from picked p
  ), classified as (
    select c.source_row,c.match_key,c.file_qty,v.good_id,c.kind,
      case
        when c.key_hits>1 or (c.goods_id is not null and c.candidate is not null and v.good_id<>c.goods_id) then 'conflict'
        when c.candidate is null and c.goods_id is not null then 'option_required'
        when c.candidate is null then 'not_found'
        when g.archived_at is not null then 'goods_archived'
        when v.archived_at is not null then 'option_stopped'
        when p_origin_id is not null and g.origin_id is distinct from p_origin_id then 'other_origin'
      end as issue,
      c.candidate
    from chosen c
    left join public.goods_variants v on v.id=c.candidate
    left join public.goods g on g.id=v.good_id
  ), counted as (
    select k.*,count(*) filter(where k.issue is null) over(partition by k.candidate) as same_option_rows
    from classified k
  )
  select c.source_row,c.match_key,c.file_qty,
    case when c.issue is null and c.same_option_rows=1 then c.candidate end,
    case when c.issue is null and c.same_option_rows=1 then c.good_id end,
    case when c.issue is null and c.same_option_rows=1 then c.kind end,
    case when c.issue is null and c.same_option_rows>1 then 'duplicate' else c.issue end
  from counted c;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_safety_digest_document(p_now timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with s as (select * from private.stock_safety_digest_settings where singleton),
  day as (select (p_now at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as today),
  due as (select ((day.today+s.send_time) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') as today_at,((day.today+1+s.send_time) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') as next_at from s,day)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'revision',s.revision,'enabled',s.enabled,'sendTime',to_char(s.send_time,'HH24:MI'),
    'operatorRecipients',to_jsonb(s.operator_recipients),'enabledAt',s.enabled_at,'updatedAt',s.updated_at,
    'updatedByName',updater.nickname,
    'nextSendAt',case when not s.enabled then null
      when exists(select 1 from private.stock_safety_digest_runs r,day where r.digest_date=day.today) then due.next_at
      when p_now>=due.today_at then p_now else due.today_at end,
    'lowStockCount',(select jsonb_array_length(private.stock_safety_digest_items())),
    'origins',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('originId',o.id,'originCode',o.code,'originName',o.name,'active',o.is_active,
        'revision',coalesce(r.revision,0),'recipients',coalesce(to_jsonb(r.recipients),'[]'::jsonb)) order by o.is_active desc,o.name,o.id)
      from public.fulfillment_origins o left join private.stock_safety_digest_origin_recipients r on r.origin_id=o.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'runs',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('digestDate',run.digest_date,'createdAt',run.created_at,
        'itemCount',run.item_count,'deliveries',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('audience',d.audience,
            'originNames',to_jsonb(d.origin_names),'recipient',d.recipient,'itemCount',d.item_count,'status',d.email_status,
            'errorCode',d.error_code,'attempts',d.attempts,'updatedAt',d.updated_at) order by d.audience desc,d.origin_names,d.recipient)
          from private.stock_safety_digest_deliveries d where d.digest_date=run.digest_date),'[]'::jsonb))
        order by run.digest_date desc)
      from (select * from private.stock_safety_digest_runs order by digest_date desc limit 7) run),'[]'::jsonb))
  from s cross join due left join public.profiles updater on updater.id=s.updated_by;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_safety_digest_items()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variantId',v.id,'goodId',g.id,'goodsCode',g.code,'goodsName',g.name,
      'optionName',v.name,'optionCode',v.code,'erpCode',e.erp_code,'erpName',e.erp_name,'barcode',e.barcode,
      'stockQty',v.stock_qty,'threshold',v.low_stock_threshold,'originId',g.origin_id,'originName',o.name)
    order by o.name nulls last,g.name,v.sort_order,v.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  from public.goods_variants v
  join public.goods g on g.id=v.good_id
  left join public.fulfillment_origins o on o.id=g.origin_id
  left join private.goods_variant_external_identity e on e.variant_id=v.id
  where v.archived_at is null and v.low_stock_threshold is not null and v.stock_qty<=v.low_stock_threshold
    and g.archived_at is null and g.stock<>'soldout';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.stock_safety_digest_job_items(p_digest_date date, p_origin_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(i order by ordinal),'[]'::jsonb) from (
    select i,ordinal from private.stock_safety_digest_runs r,jsonb_array_elements(r.items) with ordinality as e(i,ordinal)
    where r.digest_date=p_digest_date and (cardinality(p_origin_ids)=0 or i->>'originId'=any(p_origin_ids::text[]))
    order by ordinal limit 300) picked;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension text, p_key text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case p_dimension
  when 'total' then '전체'
  when 'channel' then concat(
   case split_part(p_key,'/',1) when 'direct' then '직접·출처 미확인' when 'search' then '검색' when 'social' then '소셜'
    when 'email' then '이메일' when 'paid' then '유료 캠페인 표기' when 'referral' then '기타 외부' when 'internal' then '스토어 내부' else '기타' end,
   ' · ',case split_part(p_key,'/',2) when 'none' then '출처 없음' when 'google' then 'Google' when 'naver' then '네이버'
    when 'bing' then 'Bing' when 'daum' then '다음' when 'instagram' then 'Instagram' when 'facebook' then 'Facebook'
    when 'youtube' then 'YouTube' when 'kakao' then '카카오' when 'x' then 'X' when 'threads' then 'Threads'
    when 'email' then '이메일' when 'icons' then 'ICONS' else '기타' end,
   case split_part(p_key,'/',3) when 'cpc' then ' / CPC' when 'paid_social' then ' / 유료 소셜' else '' end)
  when 'page' then case p_key when 'home' then '스토어 홈' when 'shop' then '상품 목록' when 'good' then '상품 상세'
   when 'stories' then '쇼핑스토리 목록' when 'story' then '쇼핑스토리' when 'ip' then 'IP'
   when 'events' then '이벤트 목록' when 'event' then '이벤트 상세' else p_key end
  when 'good' then coalesce((select name from public.goods where id=p_key),'보관된 상품')
  when 'ip' then coalesce((select title from public.ips where id=p_key),'보관된 IP')
  when 'category' then coalesce((select name from public.catalog_categories where id::text=p_key),'보관된 카테고리')
  when 'link' then coalesce((select coalesce(g.name,s.title,c.name,l.original_title) from private.marketing_links l
   left join public.goods g on g.id=l.good_id left join public.shopping_stories s on s.id=l.story_id
   left join public.catalog_categories c on c.id=l.category_id where l.id::text=p_key),'보관된 링크')
  else p_key end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_analytics_metric_json(p_views bigint, p_product_views bigint, p_sessions bigint, p_landings bigint, p_orders bigint, p_converted bigint, p_gross bigint, p_refunds bigint, p_has_observation boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('pageViews',case when p_has_observation then coalesce(p_views,0) end,
  'productViews',case when p_has_observation then coalesce(p_product_views,0) end,
  'sessions',case when p_has_observation then coalesce(p_sessions,0) end,
  'linkLandings',case when p_has_observation then coalesce(p_landings,0) end,
  'orders',case when p_has_observation then coalesce(p_orders,0) end,
  'convertedSessions',case when p_has_observation then coalesce(p_converted,0) end,
  'conversionRate',case when p_has_observation and p_sessions>0 then round(p_converted::numeric*100/p_sessions,2) end,
  'grossAmount',case when p_has_observation then p_gross end,'refundAmount',case when p_has_observation then p_refunds end,
  'netAmount',case when p_has_observation then p_gross-p_refunds end);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_analytics_paid_orders(p_from timestamp with time zone, p_until timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, session_id uuid, bound_at timestamp with time zone, channel text, source text, medium text, link_id uuid, page_kind text, paid_at timestamp with time zone, gross_amount bigint, refund_amount bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select b.order_id,b.session_id,b.bound_at,b.channel,b.source,b.medium,b.link_id,b.page_kind,
  proof.confirmed_at,p.amount,(coalesce((select sum(r.amount) from public.refunds r where r.payment_id=p.id and r.status='done'),0)
  +private.payment_partial_refunded_amount(p.id))::bigint
 from private.store_analytics_order_bindings b join private.store_analytics_sessions s on s.id=b.session_id and s.revoked_at is null
 join public.orders o on o.id=b.order_id
 join public.payment_attempts a on a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id and a.user_id=o.user_id and a.state in ('approved','canceled')
 join public.payments p on p.id=a.payment_id and p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.user_id=o.user_id
  and p.provider=a.provider and p.amount=a.amount and p.amount=o.total and p.amount>0 and p.status in ('paid','canceled','refunded')
 join lateral(select min(coalesce(e.approved_at,e.recorded_at)) as confirmed_at from private.payment_provider_evidence e
  where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id and e.evidence_kind='confirm_approved') proof on proof.confirmed_at>=b.bound_at and proof.confirmed_at<b.bound_at+interval '7 days'
 where s.created_at>=p_from and s.created_at<p_until and ((a.provider in ('toss','korpay','nicepay') and o.payment_method='card')
   or(a.provider='bank_transfer' and o.payment_method='bank_transfer'
    and exists(select 1 from public.bank_transfer_confirmations confirmation where confirmation.order_id=o.id and confirmation.attempt_id=a.id)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_analytics_period_rows(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(day date, dimension text, key text, page_views bigint, product_views bigint, sessions bigint, link_landings bigint, orders bigint, converted_sessions bigint, gross_amount bigint, refund_amount bigint, archived boolean, observed_until timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select d.day,d.dimension,d.key,d.page_views,d.product_views,d.sessions,d.link_landings,d.orders,d.converted_sessions,d.gross_amount,d.refund_amount,true,d.observed_until
 from private.store_analytics_daily d where d.day between p_from and p_to
  and d.day>=((statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date-interval '13 months')::date
 union all
 select d.day::date,r.*,false,statement_timestamp() from generate_series(p_from::timestamp,p_to::timestamp,interval '1 day') d(day)
 cross join lateral private.store_analytics_raw_rows(d.day::date) r
 where not exists(select 1 from private.store_analytics_daily_coverage c where c.day=d.day::date)
  and d.day::date>=(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date-89;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_analytics_rate(p_scope text, p_limit integer, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare used integer;begin
 insert into private.store_analytics_rate_buckets(bucket,scope,requests) values(date_trunc('minute',p_at),p_scope,1)
 on conflict(bucket,scope) do update set requests=store_analytics_rate_buckets.requests+1 returning requests into used;
 if used>p_limit then raise exception using errcode='P0429',message='analytics_rate_limited';end if;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_analytics_raw_rows(p_day date)
 RETURNS TABLE(dimension text, key text, page_views bigint, product_views bigint, sessions bigint, link_landings bigint, orders bigint, converted_sessions bigint, gross_amount bigint, refund_amount bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with events as materialized(
  select e.* from private.store_analytics_events e join private.store_analytics_sessions s on s.id=e.session_id and s.revoked_at is null
  where e.observed_at>=p_day::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' and e.observed_at<(p_day+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'),
 event_groups as (
  select d.dimension,d.key,e.session_id,count(*)::bigint views,count(*) filter(where e.page_kind='good')::bigint product_views,
   count(*) filter(where e.landing_link_id is not null)::bigint landings
  from events e cross join lateral(values
   ('total','all'),('channel',e.channel||'/'||e.source||'/'||e.medium),('page',e.page_kind),
   ('good',case when e.page_kind='good' then e.target_id end),('ip',e.ip_id),('category',e.category_id::text),('link',e.link_id::text)
  )d(dimension,key) where d.key is not null group by d.dimension,d.key,e.session_id),
 paid as materialized(select * from private.store_analytics_paid_orders(p_day::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul',(p_day+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')),
 paid_dimensions as (
  select p.*,d.dimension,d.key from paid p cross join lateral(values
   ('total','all'),('channel',p.channel||'/'||p.source||'/'||p.medium),('page',p.page_kind),('link',p.link_id::text)
  )d(dimension,key) where d.key is not null
  union all
  select p.*,d.dimension,d.key from paid p cross join lateral(
   select distinct 'good'::text dimension,e.target_id key from events e join public.order_items i on i.good_id=e.target_id and i.order_id=p.order_id
    where e.session_id=p.session_id and e.page_kind='good' and e.observed_at<=p.bound_at
   union select distinct 'ip',e.ip_id from events e join public.order_items i on i.good_id=e.target_id and i.order_id=p.order_id
    where e.session_id=p.session_id and e.page_kind='good' and e.ip_id is not null and e.observed_at<=p.bound_at
   union select distinct 'category',e.category_id::text from events e join public.order_items i on i.good_id=e.target_id and i.order_id=p.order_id
    where e.session_id=p.session_id and e.page_kind='good' and e.category_id is not null and e.observed_at<=p.bound_at
  )d),
 payment_groups as (
  select dimension,key,session_id,count(*)::bigint orders,sum(gross_amount)::bigint gross_amount,sum(refund_amount)::bigint refund_amount
  from paid_dimensions group by dimension,key,session_id)
 select e.dimension,e.key,sum(e.views)::bigint,sum(e.product_views)::bigint,count(*)::bigint,sum(e.landings)::bigint,
  sum(coalesce(p.orders,0))::bigint,count(*) filter(where p.orders>0)::bigint,
  case when e.dimension in ('total','channel','link') then sum(coalesce(p.gross_amount,0))::bigint end,
  case when e.dimension in ('total','channel','link') then sum(coalesce(p.refund_amount,0))::bigint end
 from event_groups e left join payment_groups p on p.dimension=e.dimension and p.key=e.key and p.session_id=e.session_id
 group by e.dimension,e.key;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_presentation_valid(p_section text, p_values jsonb)

 IMMUTABLE

   and p_values->>'themeColor'=any(array['#78bb53','#292b2c','#666668','#6b90dc','#654f43','#72d887','#20c5b0','#ff9dc5','#fc5296','#e96061','#ee4a44','#af7de7','#fcdf33','#f79a49','#eae1d8'])

   and p_values->>'imageShape' in ('square','portrait') and p_values->>'imageMode' in ('primary','gallery')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.subscription_normalize_intervals(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 if jsonb_typeof(p_value) is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(p_value) not between 1 and 6
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_value) e where jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string'
   or e.value#>>'{}' not in('week_1','week_2','week_4','month_1','month_2','month_3'))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.subscription_renewal_terms(p_display jsonb, p_selection jsonb, p_schedule jsonb, p_address_revision uuid)

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare goods jsonb;shipping jsonb;begin
 if p_display->>'calculationVersion'<>'2' or p_display->>'currency'<>'KRW' or p_display->'userCouponId'<>'null'::jsonb
  or p_display#>>'{totals,couponDiscountTotal}'<>'0' or p_display#>>'{totals,storeCreditTotal}'<>'0'
  or p_display#>>'{paymentMethods,card}'<>'true' or p_address_revision is null then

 select jsonb_agg(value-'lineId' order by (value-'lineId')::text collate "C") into goods from jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'lines');

  from jsonb_array_elements(value->'components') component)) order by value::text collate "C") into shipping from jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'shipping');
 return jsonb_build_object('version',1,'currency','KRW','selection',p_selection,'schedule',private.subscription_normalize_schedule(p_schedule),
  'addressRevision',p_address_revision,'onlineTotal',p_display#>'{totals,onlineTotal}','collectShippingTotal',p_display#>'{totals,collectShippingTotal}',
  'goods',goods,'shipping',shipping);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.subscription_retention_display_before_shipping_charge_groups(p_display jsonb, p_recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('calculationVersion',p_display->'calculationVersion','currency',p_display->'currency',
  'totals',jsonb_build_object('subtotal',p_display#>'{totals,subtotal}','volumeDiscountTotal',p_display#>'{totals,volumeDiscountTotal}',
   'netGoodsTotal',p_display#>'{totals,netGoodsTotal}','couponDiscountTotal',p_display#>'{totals,couponDiscountTotal}',
   'storeCreditTotal',p_display#>'{totals,storeCreditTotal}','prepaidShippingTotal',p_display#>'{totals,prepaidShippingTotal}',
   'collectShippingTotal',p_display#>'{totals,collectShippingTotal}','onlineTotal',p_display#>'{totals,onlineTotal}','customerTotal',p_display#>'{totals,customerTotal}'),
  'lines',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId',line->'goodId','variantId',line->'variantId','qty',line->'qty',
    'regularUnitPrice',line->'regularUnitPrice','unitPrice',line->'unitPrice','volumeUnitDiscount',line->'volumeUnitDiscount',
    'subtotal',line->'subtotal','volumeDiscountTotal',line->'volumeDiscountTotal','netSubtotal',line->'netSubtotal',
    'couponDiscount',line->'couponDiscount','storeCreditDiscount',line->'storeCreditDiscount','paidGoodsTotal',line->'paidGoodsTotal','volumePolicyId',line->'volumePolicyId') order by ordinal)
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'lines') with ordinality selected(line,ordinal)),'[]'),
  'shipping',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('originId',shipping->'originId','prepaidFee',shipping->'prepaidFee',
    'collectFee',shipping->'collectFee','fullFee',shipping->'fullFee','components',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'goodId',component->'goodId','paymentMode',component->'paymentMode','baseFee',component->'baseFee','regionalFee',component->'regionalFee',
     'totalFee',component->'totalFee','deliveryPolicyId',component->'deliveryPolicyId') order by component->>'goodId')
     from jsonb_array_elements(shipping->'components') component),'[]'),
    -- The public collector copy may contain contact/free text. Retain its hash
    -- and matching immutable business contract versions, never that copy itself.
    'collectorTermsHash',case when shipping->'collector' is not null and shipping->'collector'<>'null'::jsonb
      then encode(sha256(convert_to((shipping->'collector')::text,'UTF8')),'hex') end,
    'matchingCollectContractVersions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(contract.id order by contract.created_at,contract.id)
      from private.shipping_collect_contract_versions contract where contract.origin_id::text=shipping->>'originId'
       and contract.created_at<=p_recorded_at and contract.status='active'
       and jsonb_build_object('name',contract.contract_values->>'collectorName','method',contract.contract_values->>'collectionMethod',
        'refundContact',contract.contract_values->>'refundContact','instructions',contract.contract_values->>'customerInstructions')=shipping->'collector'),'[]')) order by ordinal)
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'shipping') with ordinality selected(shipping,ordinal)),'[]'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.subscription_retention_display(p_display jsonb, p_recorded_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;shipping jsonb;begin
 result:=private.subscription_retention_display_before_shipping_charge_groups(p_display,p_recorded_at);
 if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'shipping') where value ? 'chargeDetails') then return result;end if;
 select jsonb_agg(retained.value||case when source.value ? 'chargeDetails'
  then jsonb_build_object('chargeDetails',private.shipping_charge_group_safe_details(source.value->'chargeDetails')) else '{}'::jsonb end order by retained.position)
 into shipping from jsonb_array_elements(result->'shipping') with ordinality retained(value,position)
 join jsonb_array_elements(p_display->'shipping') with ordinality source(value,position) on source.position=retained.position;
 return jsonb_set(result,'{shipping}',shipping);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.suggest_bank_deposit_order(p_depositor_name text, p_amount bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, confidence text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with normalized as (
    select upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_depositor_name, ''), '\s', '', 'g')) as name
  ),
  candidate as (
    select
      orders.id,
      orders.total,
      private.bank_transfer_deposit_code(orders.id) as code,
      private.bank_transfer_switch_grace_code(orders.id) as grace_code,
      upper(regexp_replace(
        coalesce(orders.address ->> 'recipientName', ''), '\s', '', 'g'
      )) as recipient
    from public.orders, normalized
    where orders.status = 'pending'
      and orders.payment_method = 'bank_transfer'
  ),
  by_code_all as (
    select
      candidate.id,
      case when candidate.total = p_amount then 'code_amount' else 'code' end as confidence
    from candidate, normalized
    where (position(candidate.code in normalized.name) > 0
      or (candidate.grace_code is not null and position(candidate.grace_code in normalized.name) > 0))
  ),
  by_code as (
    select * from by_code_all where (select count(distinct by_code_all.id) from by_code_all) = 1
  ),
  by_amount as (
    select candidate.id, 'amount_name'::text as confidence
    from candidate, normalized
    where candidate.total = p_amount
      and candidate.recipient <> ''
      and position(candidate.recipient in normalized.name) > 0
      -- 동명이인·같은 금액이 둘 이상이면 사람이 골라야 한다.
      and (
        select count(*)
        from candidate as peer, normalized as peer_name
        where peer.total = p_amount
          and peer.recipient <> ''
          and position(peer.recipient in peer_name.name) > 0
      ) = 1
  )
  -- 정렬 없이 limit 1을 쓰면 후보가 둘일 때 제안이 실행마다 달라진다. 확신도가
  -- 높은 쪽을 먼저 보고, 같으면 주문 id로 고정한다 — 같은 입금에 같은 제안이
  -- 나와야 운영자가 화면을 새로고침하고 다른 주문을 보지 않는다.
  select id, confidence
  from (
    select id, confidence from by_code
    union all
    select id, confidence from by_amount where not exists (select 1 from by_code_all)
  ) as suggestion
  order by
    case confidence
      when 'code_amount' then 0
      when 'code' then 1
      else 2
    end,
    id
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.sweep_restock_alerts()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  candidate public.goods;
  woken integer := 0;
begin
  for candidate in
    select good.*
    from public.goods as good
    where good.id in (
        select alert.good_id from public.restock_alerts as alert where alert.status = 'pending'
      )
      and private.restock_parent_open(good)
    order by good.id
    for update of good skip locked
  loop
    woken := woken + private.wake_restock_alerts(candidate, null);
  end loop;
  return woken;
end;
$function$

 SET search_path TO ''

begin

    insert into public.goods_variants(good_id,price,stock_qty,is_default)
    values (new.id,new.price,new.stock_qty,true);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.system_health_report()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  at timestamptz := now();
  vercel_jobs jsonb; cron_jobs jsonb; failures jsonb; payments jsonb; emails jsonb;
  failing integer; stalled integer; problem integer; unresolved integer; mail_failed integer; mail_bounced integer;
begin
  -- Vercel cron: 작업별 마지막 상태와 24시간 실패 수.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_json order by job_key), '[]'::jsonb) into vercel_jobs from (
    select s.job_key, jsonb_build_object('jobKey', s.job_key, 'source', 'vercel_cron', 'label', s.label, 'schedule', null,
      'expectedIntervalMinutes', s.expected_interval_minutes, 'lastRunAt', s.last_finished_at, 'lastSuccessAt', s.last_success_at,
      'lastFailureAt', s.last_failure_at, 'lastStatusCode', s.last_status_code, 'lastErrorCode', s.last_error_code,
      'consecutiveFailures', s.consecutive_failures,
      'failures24h', (select count(*) from private.system_job_failures f where f.job_key = s.job_key and f.source = 'vercel_cron'
        and f.occurred_at > at - interval '24 hours'),
      'failing', s.consecutive_failures > 0,
      -- 실행 기록 자체가 끊겼다(크론이 불리지 않거나 함수가 시간 초과로 끝나 기록하지 못함). 실패가 이어지는 것은 failing이다.
      'stalled', s.last_finished_at < at - private.system_job_stall_threshold(s.expected_interval_minutes),
      'active', true) row_json
    from private.system_job_status s) v;

  -- pg_cron: 최근 실행 표본(런 번호 역순 20,000회 ≈ 2.8일)에서 작업별 마지막 실행·성공·24시간 실패. 표본이 멈춤 기준보다 짧거나,
  -- 처음 본 지(private.system_pg_cron_jobs) 멈춤 기준이 지나지 않았거나 아직 정리 잡이 보지 못한 새 잡이면 멈춤을 판정하지 않는다
  -- (새 잡은 첫 실행 전까지 '기록 없음'). 실행 안에서 건너뛴 행(실패 기록의 pg_cron 줄)도 그 작업의 실패로 센다.
  with recent as materialized (
    select d.jobid, d.status, d.start_time, d.end_time from cron.job_run_details d order by d.runid desc limit 20000
  ), horizon as (
    select min(r.start_time) as since from recent r
  ), runs as (
    select r.jobid,
      max(r.end_time) filter (where r.status = 'succeeded') as last_success_at,
      max(coalesce(r.end_time, r.start_time)) filter (where r.status = 'failed') as last_failure_at,
      max(coalesce(r.end_time, r.start_time)) filter (where r.status in ('succeeded', 'failed')) as last_run_at,
      count(*) filter (where r.status = 'failed' and r.start_time > at - interval '24 hours') as failures,
      (array_agg(r.status order by r.start_time desc) filter (where r.status in ('succeeded', 'failed')))[1] as last_status
    from recent r group by r.jobid
  ), skipped as (
    select f.job_key, max(f.occurred_at) as last_at, count(*) filter (where f.occurred_at > at - interval '24 hours') as failures
    from private.system_job_failures f where f.source = 'pg_cron' group by f.job_key
  ), jobs as (
    select j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active, private.cron_schedule_minutes(j.schedule) as minutes,
      runs.last_success_at, runs.last_failure_at, runs.last_run_at, coalesce(runs.failures, 0) as run_failures, runs.last_status,
      skipped.last_at as skipped_at, coalesce(skipped.failures, 0) as skipped_failures, horizon.since, seen.first_seen_at
    from cron.job j
    left join runs on runs.jobid = j.jobid
    left join skipped on skipped.job_key = j.jobname
    left join private.system_pg_cron_jobs seen on seen.jobname = j.jobname
    cross join horizon
    where j.jobname is not null
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('jobKey', r.jobname, 'source', 'pg_cron', 'label', null, 'schedule', r.schedule,
      'expectedIntervalMinutes', r.minutes, 'lastRunAt', r.last_run_at, 'lastSuccessAt', r.last_success_at,
      'lastFailureAt', nullif(greatest(coalesce(r.last_failure_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz), coalesce(r.skipped_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz)), '-infinity'::timestamptz),
      'lastStatusCode', null,
      'lastErrorCode', case when r.last_status = 'failed' then 'pg_cron_failed'
        when r.skipped_at > at - private.system_job_stall_threshold(coalesce(r.minutes, 60)) then 'rows_skipped' end,
      'consecutiveFailures', case when r.last_status = 'failed' then 1 else 0 end,
      'failures24h', r.run_failures + r.skipped_failures,
      'failing', r.active and (coalesce(r.last_status = 'failed', false)
        or coalesce(r.skipped_at > at - private.system_job_stall_threshold(coalesce(r.minutes, 60)), false)),
      'stalled', r.active and r.minutes is not null and r.since is not null and r.first_seen_at is not null
        and r.since < at - private.system_job_stall_threshold(r.minutes)
        and r.first_seen_at < at - private.system_job_stall_threshold(r.minutes)
        and coalesce(r.last_success_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) < at - private.system_job_stall_threshold(r.minutes),
      'active', r.active) order by r.jobname), '[]'::jsonb)
  into cron_jobs from jobs r;

  -- 최근 24시간 실패(최신 50건): 기록된 실패 + pg_cron 실패 실행. 오류 원문(return_message)은 싣지 않는다.
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_json order by occurred_at desc), '[]'::jsonb) into failures from (
    select x.occurred_at, jsonb_build_object('jobKey', x.job_key, 'source', x.source, 'occurredAt', x.occurred_at,
      'statusCode', x.status_code, 'errorCode', x.error_code) row_json
    from (
      select f.job_key, f.source, f.occurred_at, f.status_code, f.error_code from private.system_job_failures f
      where f.occurred_at > at - interval '24 hours'
      union all
      select j.jobname, 'pg_cron', coalesce(d.end_time, d.start_time), null::integer, 'pg_cron_failed'
      from (select * from cron.job_run_details order by runid desc limit 20000) d
      join cron.job j on j.jobid = d.jobid
      where d.status = 'failed' and d.start_time > at - interval '24 hours' and j.jobname is not null
    ) x order by x.occurred_at desc limit 50) l;

  -- 미종결 결제 시도(굿즈·티켓·그 밖).
  select jsonb_build_object(
      'goods', count(*) filter (where a.purpose = 'order'),
      'tickets', count(*) filter (where a.purpose = 'ticket'),
      'other', count(*) filter (where a.purpose not in ('order', 'ticket')),
      'oldestAt', min(a.created_at)),
    count(*)
  into payments, unresolved
  from public.payment_attempts a
  where a.state in ('unknown', 'needs_review', 'confirming') and private.payment_attempt_unresolved(a.state, a.claim_expires_at, at);

  -- 메일: 우리·발송사 쪽 실패(실패·결과 불명·확인 필요)와 반송(반송·수신 거부·발송사 차단). 최근 24시간.
  select (select count(*) from public.email_deliveries d where d.status = 'failed' and d.claimed_at > at - interval '24 hours')
    + (select count(*) from private.email_intents i where i.state in ('failed', 'unknown', 'needs_review') and i.updated_at > at - interval '24 hours'),
    (select count(*) from private.email_intents i where i.state in ('bounced', 'complained', 'suppressed') and i.updated_at > at - interval '24 hours')
  into mail_failed, mail_bounced;
  emails := jsonb_build_object('failed24h', mail_failed, 'bounced24h', mail_bounced);

  select count(*) filter (where (e->>'failing')::boolean), count(*) filter (where (e->>'stalled')::boolean),
    count(*) filter (where (e->>'failing')::boolean or (e->>'stalled')::boolean)
  into failing, stalled, problem
  from jsonb_array_elements(vercel_jobs || cron_jobs) e;

  return jsonb_build_object('asOf', at, 'jobs', vercel_jobs || cron_jobs, 'recentFailures', failures,
    'payments', payments, 'emails', emails,
    'counts', jsonb_build_object('failingJobs', failing, 'stalledJobs', stalled, 'problemJobs', problem,
      'unresolvedPayments', unresolved, 'emailFailures', mail_failed, 'emailBounces', mail_bounced,
      -- 운영 할 일 건수: 지금 문제가 있는 작업 + 미종결 결제 + 메일 발송 실패. 반송은 받는 주소 문제라 화면에서만 보인다.
      'issues', problem + unresolved + mail_failed));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.tracking_number_conflict(p_carrier text, p_tracking text, p_shipments uuid[], p_order uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with target as (
    select s.id, s.order_id, s.origin_id, private.tracking_destination_key(private.operational_order_address(s.order_id)) destination
    from public.order_shipments s

    union select s.order_id from public.order_shipments s
      where s.id = any(private.shipment_pack_scope(coalesce(p_shipments, '{}'::uuid[])))
  ), uses as (
    select 'shipment' source, s.order_id, s.id shipment_id, s.origin_id, s.delivery_method, s.status, s.delivered_at
    from public.order_shipments s where s.carrier = p_carrier and s.tracking_number = p_tracking
    union all
    select 'extra', x.order_id, x.shipment_id, s.origin_id, s.delivery_method, s.status, s.delivered_at
    from public.order_shipment_extra_trackings x join public.order_shipments s on s.id = x.shipment_id
    where x.carrier = p_carrier and x.tracking_number = p_tracking
    union all
    select 'reshipment', r.order_id, r.shipment_id, s.origin_id, s.delivery_method,
      case when r.delivered_at is null then 'shipping' else 'delivered' end, r.delivered_at
    from public.order_claim_reshipments r left join public.order_shipments s on s.id = r.shipment_id
    where r.carrier = p_carrier and r.tracking_number = p_tracking
    union all
    -- 옛 클레임 단위 재출고만(배송 건별 기록이 있는 클레임은 같은 번호를 이 열에도 적는다 — 위 기록이 진실원이다).
    select 'reshipment', q.order_id, null, null, null, null, null
    from public.order_cancellation_requests q where q.reship_carrier = p_carrier and q.reship_tracking_number = p_tracking
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_claim_reshipments r where r.claim_id = q.id)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('source', u.source, 'orderId', u.order_id, 'shipmentId', u.shipment_id)
  from uses u join public.orders uo on uo.id = u.order_id
  where u.order_id not in (select id from allowed)
    and uo.status <> 'canceled'
    and not (u.origin_id is not null and u.delivery_method = 'parcel'
      and (u.status = 'shipping' or (u.status = 'delivered' and u.delivered_at >= now() - interval '7 days'))
      and exists(select 1 from target t
        where t.origin_id = u.origin_id and t.destination is not null and t.destination = private.tracking_destination_key(private.operational_order_address(uo.id))))
  order by u.source, u.order_id
  limit 1;
$function$

AS $function$

      where c.code = p_carrier and c.tracking_number_pattern is not null), true);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.tracking_phone_key(p_phone text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.tracking_shipments_related(p_first uuid, p_second uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_first = p_second or exists(
    select 1 from public.order_shipments a join public.orders ao on ao.id = a.order_id,
      public.order_shipments b join public.orders bo on bo.id = b.order_id
    where a.id = p_first and b.id = p_second and (
      a.order_id = b.order_id
      or b.id = any(private.shipment_pack_scope(array[a.id]))
      or (a.origin_id = b.origin_id and private.tracking_destination_key(private.operational_order_address(ao.id)) is not null
        and private.tracking_destination_key(private.operational_order_address(ao.id))
          = private.tracking_destination_key(private.operational_order_address(bo.id)))));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.transition_first_purchase_coupon()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.status='paid' then update private.coupon_first_purchase_claims set state='consumed',consumed_at=clock_timestamp() where order_id=new.id and state='reserved';
 elsif new.status='canceled' then update private.coupon_first_purchase_claims set state='released',released_at=clock_timestamp() where order_id=new.id and state<>'released'; end if;
 return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.trim_checkout_drafts(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update private.checkout_drafts as draft
  set lines = '[]'::jsonb, scrubbed_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  where draft.user_id = p_user_id and draft.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() and draft.scrubbed_at is null;
  delete from private.checkout_drafts as draft
  where draft.user_id = p_user_id and draft.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() - private.checkout_draft_trace_ttl();
  delete from private.checkout_drafts as draft
  where draft.id in (
    select live.id from private.checkout_drafts as live
    where live.user_id = p_user_id
    order by live.created_at desc, live.id desc
    offset 19
  );
end;
$function$
