CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_order_delay_notice(target_notice uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

 if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff required';end if;
 select jsonb_build_object('id',n.id,'title',n.title,'customerBody',n.customer_body,'expectedShipDate',n.expected_ship_date,
  'createdAt',n.created_at,'expiresAt',n.expires_at,'requestedAt',n.requested_at,'kind',n.kind,
  'emailEnabled',(select enabled from private.order_delay_notice_delivery_control where singleton),'targets',coalesce((
   select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'orderId',t.order_id,'orderNumber',(select o.order_number from public.orders o where o.id=t.order_id),'buyerName',t.buyer_name,'audience',t.audience,'recipientEmail',t.recipient_email,
    'shipmentIds',t.shipment_ids,'shipmentLabels',t.shipment_labels,'messageBody',t.message_body,'inAppStatus',t.in_app_status,
    'emailStatus',case when i.state in ('accepted','sent','delivered','delayed') then 'sent'
      when i.state in ('bounced','complained','failed') then 'failed' when i.state='suppressed' then 'suppressed' else t.email_status end,
    'emailProviderState',i.state,'errorCode',case when i.state in ('bounced','complained','failed') then 'provider_rejected'
      when i.state='suppressed' then 'provider_suppressed' else t.error_code end,
    'retryable',t.retryable and coalesce(i.accepted_at is null,true) and coalesce(i.state not in ('needs_review','failed','bounced','complained','suppressed'),true),
    'attempts',t.attempts) order by t.order_id)
   from private.order_delay_notice_targets t left join private.email_intents i on i.id=t.email_intent_id where t.notice_id=n.id),'[]'))
 into result from private.order_delay_notices n where n.id=target_notice;
 if result is null then raise no_data_found using message='delay_notice_not_found';end if;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_review_event(p_id uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_filter text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare document jsonb; can_pay boolean;
begin
 if not private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 100000 or char_length(coalesce(p_query,''))>100 or p_filter is null or p_filter not in ('all','eligible','selected','awarded','revoked','unavailable') then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_event_search';end if;
 document:=private.review_event_document(p_id);if document is null then return null;end if;
 can_pay:=private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'marketing.manage',true);
 return (with rows as materialized(
  select entry.*,r.body,r.rating,r.image_paths,r.updated_at review_updated_at,private.review_event_review_fingerprint(r) review_fingerprint,r.status review_status,r.created_at review_created_at,
   coalesce(nullif(btrim(profile.nickname),''),'고객') nickname,coalesce(g.name,'삭제된 상품') good_name,
   private.review_event_entry_problem(entry) problem,award.granted_at,award.revoked_at,award.revoke_reason,award.expires_at
  from private.review_event_entries entry left join public.reviews r on r.id=entry.review_id left join public.profiles profile on profile.id=entry.user_id
  left join public.goods g on g.id=entry.good_id left join private.review_event_awards award on award.entry_id=entry.id
  where entry.event_id=p_id
 ), filtered as(
  select * from rows where (btrim(coalesce(p_query,''))='' or position(lower(btrim(p_query)) in lower(nickname||' '||good_name||' '||coalesce(body,'')))>0 or source_review_id::text=btrim(p_query))
   and (p_filter='all' or p_filter='eligible' and problem is null and granted_at is null or p_filter='selected' and selected
    or p_filter='awarded' and granted_at is not null and revoked_at is null or p_filter='revoked' and revoked_at is not null or p_filter='unavailable' and problem is not null)
 ), page as(select * from filtered order by entered_at desc,id limit 50 offset (p_page-1)*50)
 select jsonb_build_object('event',document,'total',(select count(*) from filtered),'page',p_page,'pageSize',50,'canPay',can_pay,
  'creditPolicy',(select jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'maxBalance',max_balance,'validityDays',validity_days) from private.store_credit_policy where singleton),
  'selected',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'reviewUpdatedAt',selected_review_updated_at,'reviewFingerprint',selected_review_fingerprint) order by id) from rows where selected),'[]'::jsonb),
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'reviewId',review_id,'userId',user_id,'goodId',good_id,'goodName',good_name,'nickname',nickname,
   'body',body,'rating',rating,'imagePaths',coalesce(to_jsonb(image_paths),'[]'::jsonb),'enteredAt',entered_at,'reviewUpdatedAt',review_updated_at,'reviewFingerprint',review_fingerprint,
   'selected',selected,'selectionReason',selection_reason,'selectionChanged',selected and (selected_review_updated_at is distinct from review_updated_at or selected_review_fingerprint is distinct from review_fingerprint),
   'problem',problem,'creditAmount',credit_amount,'grantedAt',granted_at,'revokedAt',revoked_at,'revokeReason',revoke_reason,'expiresAt',expires_at) order by entered_at desc,id) from page),'[]'::jsonb)));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_goods_console_export_candidates(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_ip_id text DEFAULT ''::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'active'::text, p_stock text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_readiness text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(good_id text, option_rows integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if auth.uid() is null or not coalesce(public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false),false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;
  return query select (matched.good).id, greatest(1,(select count(*)::integer from public.goods_variants variant
    where variant.good_id = (matched.good).id and (variant.archived_at is null or variant.is_default)))
    from private.admin_goods_console_matches(p_query,p_ip_id,p_status,p_stock,p_category_id,p_readiness,p_filters) matched
    order by (matched.good).id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_goods_export_candidates(search_text text DEFAULT ''::text, ip_filter text DEFAULT ''::text, status_filter text DEFAULT 'active'::text, stock_filter text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(good_id text, option_rows integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

 if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff_required'; end if;
 return query select good.id,greatest(1,(select count(*)::integer from public.goods_variants variant
   where variant.good_id=good.id and (variant.archived_at is null or variant.is_default)))
 from public.admin_search_goods(search_text) good where (ip_filter='' or good.ip_id=ip_filter)
 and case status_filter when 'all' then true when 'archived' then good.archived_at is not null
   when 'draft' then good.archived_at is null and good.published_at is null
   when 'published' then good.archived_at is null and good.published_at is not null else good.archived_at is null end
 and case stock_filter when 'soldout' then good.stock='soldout' or public.admin_goods_active_stock_qty(good)=0
   when 'ok' then good.stock='ok' and public.admin_goods_active_stock_qty(good)>0
   when 'low' then good.stock='low' and public.admin_goods_active_stock_qty(good)>0 else true end
 order by good.id;
end;
$function$

        where p.good_id = entry.value#>>'{good,id}' and p.state = 'active' and p.ends_at > pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()), '[]'::jsonb))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_goods_manual_recovery_attempts(p_order_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, request_id uuid, attempt_id uuid, provider_order_id text, state text, amount bigint, currency text, manual_recovery_available boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',true) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles as profile
    where profile.id = (select auth.uid())
      and private.has_operator_capability(profile.id,'sales.manage',true)
      and profile.suspended_at is null
  ) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'admin required';
  end if;

  if p_order_ids is null or pg_catalog.cardinality(p_order_ids) = 0 then
    return;
  end if;

  if pg_catalog.cardinality(p_order_ids) > 100 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'too many order ids';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    attempt.ref_id,
    request.id,
    attempt.id,
    attempt.provider_order_id,
    attempt.state::text,
    attempt.amount,
    attempt.currency,
    (
      (
        attempt.state in ('approved', 'unknown', 'needs_review')
        or (
          attempt.state = 'confirming'
          and (
            attempt.claim_expires_at is null
            or attempt.claim_expires_at <= pg_catalog.now()
          )
        )
      )
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from private.goods_payment_manual_recovery_claims as manual_claim
        where manual_claim.attempt_id = attempt.id
          and manual_claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
      )
    ) as manual_recovery_available
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  join public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    on request.order_id = attempt.ref_id
   and request.status in ('processing', 'needs_review')
  join public.order_cancellation_claims as cancellation_claim
    on cancellation_claim.order_id = attempt.ref_id
   and cancellation_claim.requested_by = request.requested_by
  where attempt.provider = 'korpay'
    and attempt.purpose = 'order'
    and attempt.ref_id = any(p_order_ids)
  order by attempt.ref_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_inquiry_chat_console(p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_assignee text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_period text DEFAULT '7d'::text, p_read text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recent'::text, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 30, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_query text := btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,30),1),100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if v_actor is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';
  end if;
  if p_status is null or p_status not in ('all','open','answered','closed')
    or p_period is null or p_period not in ('7d','30d','all')
    or p_read is null or p_read not in ('all','unread','read')
    or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('recent','oldest')
    or p_assignee is null or (p_assignee not in ('all','me','unassigned') and p_assignee !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
    or char_length(v_query)>100 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_inquiry_chat_filter';
  end if;
  with base as materialized (
    select thread.id,thread.reference,thread.title,thread.category,thread.status,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(buyer.nickname),''),'고객_'||left(buyer.id::text,6)) buyer_name,
      thread.assignee_id,coalesce(nullif(btrim(assignee.nickname),''),'운영자_'||left(assignee.id::text,6)) assignee_name,
      thread.last_message_at,coalesce(latest.body,'') preview,coalesce(latest.author,'user') preview_author,
      coalesce((select jsonb_agg(tag.label order by tag.label) from private.inquiry_chat_tags tag where tag.inquiry_id=thread.id),'[]'::jsonb) tags,
      (select count(*) from public.inquiry_messages message
        where message.inquiry_id=thread.id and message.author='user'
          and not exists(select 1 from private.inquiry_chat_reads seen where seen.actor_id=v_actor and seen.message_id=message.id)) unread_count
    from public.inquiries thread join public.profiles buyer on buyer.id=thread.user_id
    left join public.profiles assignee on assignee.id=thread.assignee_id
    left join lateral (select left(message.body,180) body,message.author from public.inquiry_messages message
      where message.inquiry_id=thread.id order by message.created_at desc,message.id desc limit 1) latest on true
    where (p_period='all' or thread.last_message_at >= current_timestamp-case p_period when '7d' then interval '7 days' else interval '30 days' end)
      and (p_assignee='all' or (p_assignee='me' and thread.assignee_id=v_actor)
        or (p_assignee='unassigned' and thread.assignee_id is null) or thread.assignee_id::text=lower(p_assignee))
      and (v_query='' or position(lower(v_query) in lower(thread.title))>0
        or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(buyer.nickname,'')))>0
        or thread.reference::text=v_query
        or exists(select 1 from private.inquiry_chat_tags tag where tag.inquiry_id=thread.id and position(lower(v_query) in lower(tag.label))>0)
        or exists(select 1 from public.inquiry_messages message where message.inquiry_id=thread.id
          and position(lower(v_query) in lower(message.body))>0))
  ), filtered as materialized (
    select * from base where (p_status='all' or status=p_status)
      and (p_read='all' or (p_read='unread' and unread_count>0) or (p_read='read' and unread_count=0))
  ), page as (
    select * from filtered order by
      case when p_sort='recent' then last_message_at end desc,
      case when p_sort='oldest' then last_message_at end asc,id
    limit v_limit offset v_offset
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by
      case when p_sort='recent' then last_message_at end desc,
      case when p_sort='oldest' then last_message_at end asc,id) from page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'total',(select count(*) from filtered),
    'counts',(select jsonb_build_object('all',count(*),'open',count(*) filter(where status='open'),
      'answered',count(*) filter(where status='answered'),'closed',count(*) filter(where status='closed')) from base),
    'unreadMessages',(select coalesce(sum(unread_count),0) from base),
    'staffOptions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',profile.id,
      'name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(profile.nickname),''),'운영자_'||left(profile.id::text,6))) order by profile.nickname,profile.id)
      from public.profiles profile where profile.role in ('staff','admin') and profile.suspended_at is null
        and private.has_operator_capability(profile.id,'cs.manage',false)),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result;
  return v_result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_inquiry_context(target_inquiry_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_thread public.inquiries%rowtype;
  v_order jsonb := 'null'::jsonb;
  v_buyer jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

  select * into v_thread
  from public.inquiries as thread
  where thread.id = target_inquiry_id;

  if not found then
    raise no_data_found using message = 'inquiry_not_found';
  end if;

  if v_thread.order_id is not null and public.has_operator_capability('sales.read') then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'id', target.id, 'orderNumber', target.order_number,
      'status', target.status::text,
      'total', target.total,
      'createdAt', target.created_at,
      'shipments', private.order_shipment_records(target.id),
      'itemCount', (
        select coalesce(sum(item.qty), 0)
        from public.order_items as item
        where item.order_id = target.id
      ),
      'leadItemName', (
        select item.good_name_snapshot
        from public.order_items as item
        where item.order_id = target.id
        order by item.id
        limit 1
      ),
      'payment', (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'provider', summary.provider,
          'status', summary.status,
          'amount', summary.amount
        )
        from public.payment_summaries as summary
        where summary.purpose = 'order'
          and summary.ref_id = target.id
        order by (summary.status = 'paid') desc, summary.created_at desc
        limit 1
      ),
      'claims', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'status', request.status,
            'requestedAt', request.requested_at,
            'decidedAt', request.decided_at,
            'reasonType', request.reason_type
          )
          order by request.requested_at desc
        )
        from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
        where request.order_id = target.id
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    )
    into v_order
    from public.orders as target
    where target.id = v_thread.order_id;
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', buyer.id,
    'nickname', buyer.nickname,
    'email', buyer.email,
    'suspendedAt', buyer.suspended_at,
    'orderCount', (
      select count(*)
      from public.orders as target
      where target.user_id = buyer.id
        and target.status <> 'pending'
    ),
    'inquiryCount', (
      select count(*)
      from public.inquiries as other
      where other.user_id = buyer.id
    ),
    'openInquiryCount', (
      select count(*)
      from public.inquiries as other
      where other.user_id = buyer.id
        and other.status <> 'closed'
    )
  )
  into v_buyer
  from public.profiles as buyer
  where buyer.id = v_thread.user_id;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.read') then v_buyer:=jsonb_set(v_buyer,'{orderCount}','null'::jsonb); end if;
  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage') and jsonb_typeof(v_order)='object' then
    v_order:=v_order||jsonb_build_object('payment',null,'claims','[]'::jsonb);
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('order', coalesce(v_order, 'null'::jsonb), 'buyer', v_buyer);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_inquiry_satisfaction_console_numbered(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_field text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_satisfaction text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_query text:=nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query,'')),'');v_field text:=coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_field,'')),''),'all');
 v_limit integer:=least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,20),1),100);v_offset integer:=greatest(coalesce(p_offset,0),0);result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_status is not null and p_status not in ('open','answered','closed') then raise check_violation using message='invalid_inquiry_status_filter';end if;
 if p_category is not null and p_category not in ('order','claim','good','account','etc') then raise check_violation using message='invalid_inquiry_category_filter';end if;
 if v_field not in ('all','title','buyer','order') then raise check_violation using message='invalid_inquiry_search_field';end if;
 if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from>p_to then raise check_violation using message='invalid_inquiry_date_range';end if;
 if v_query is not null and char_length(v_query)>100 then raise check_violation using message='inquiry_search_query_too_long';end if;
 if p_satisfaction is null or p_satisfaction not in ('all','satisfied','dissatisfied','unrated') then raise check_violation using message='invalid_inquiry_satisfaction_filter';end if;
 with base as materialized (
  select thread.id,thread.reference,thread.category,thread.title,thread.status,thread.user_id,buyer.nickname buyer_name,buyer.email buyer_email,
   case when public.has_operator_capability('sales.read') then thread.order_id else null::uuid end order_id,
   case when public.has_operator_capability('sales.read') then (select o.order_number from public.orders o where o.id=thread.order_id) else null::text end order_number,
   thread.good_id,good.name good_name,thread.handled_by,handler.nickname handler_name,thread.created_at,thread.last_message_at,thread.answered_at,thread.closed_at,
   (select count(*) from public.inquiry_messages message where message.inquiry_id=thread.id) message_count,
   thread.assignee_id,case when assignee.id is null then null else coalesce(nullif(btrim(assignee.nickname),''),'운영자_'||left(assignee.id::text,6)) end assignee_name,
   thread.waiting_since,private.inquiry_satisfaction_current(thread.id)->>'value' satisfaction
  from public.inquiries thread join public.profiles buyer on buyer.id=thread.user_id
  left join public.profiles handler on handler.id=thread.handled_by left join public.profiles assignee on assignee.id=thread.assignee_id
  left join public.goods good on good.id=thread.good_id
  where (p_status is null or thread.status=p_status) and (p_category is null or thread.category=p_category)
   and (p_from is null or thread.created_at>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (p_to is null or thread.created_at<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (v_query is null
    or (v_field in ('all','title') and position(lower(v_query) in lower(thread.title))>0)
    or (v_field in ('all','buyer') and (position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(buyer.nickname,'')))>0 or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(buyer.email,'')))>0))
    or (v_field in ('all','order') and public.has_operator_capability('sales.read') and ((position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(thread.order_id::text,'')))>0 or exists(select 1 from public.orders o where o.id=thread.order_id and position(v_query in o.order_number)>0)) or lower(v_query)=lower(thread.reference::text))))
 ), filtered as materialized (select * from base where p_satisfaction='all' or coalesce(satisfaction,'unrated')=p_satisfaction),
 page as (select * from filtered order by case status when 'open' then 0 when 'answered' then 1 else 2 end,
  case when status='open' then waiting_since else last_message_at end,id limit v_limit offset v_offset)
 select jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) order by case status when 'open' then 0 when 'answered' then 1 else 2 end,
   case when status='open' then waiting_since else last_message_at end,id) from page),'[]'::jsonb),
  'total',(select count(*) from filtered),'summary',(select jsonb_build_object('satisfied',count(*) filter(where satisfaction='satisfied'),
   'dissatisfied',count(*) filter(where satisfaction='dissatisfied'),'unrated',count(*) filter(where satisfaction is null)) from base)) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

        order by profile.nickname nulls last, profile.id)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_bank_transfer_refunds_numbered(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid();session_id uuid;rows jsonb;total bigint;
begin
 begin session_id:=(auth.jwt()->>'session_id')::uuid;exception when invalid_text_representation then raise insufficient_privilege using message='bank_refund_permission_required';end;
 perform private.require_bank_transfer_refund_identity(actor,session_id);
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 or p_offset is null or p_offset<0 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_bank_refund_page';end if;
 select count(*)+(select count(*) from private.order_partial_cancellations where provider='bank_transfer' and state='awaiting_transfer')
  into total from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds where state='awaiting_transfer';
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_data order by confirmed_at,claim_id),'[]') into rows from(
  select lifecycle.confirmed_at,lifecycle.claim_id,jsonb_build_object('claimId',claim.id,'orderId',purchase.id,'orderNumber',purchase.order_number,'reference',claim.reference,
   'claimType',claim.claim_type,'amount',lifecycle.amount,'confirmedAt',lifecycle.confirmed_at,'filedAt',refund.filed_at,
   'updatedAt',greatest(lifecycle.updated_at,claim.updated_at),'revision',claim.claim_revision,
   'gift',parties.claim_id is not null,'payerName',payer.nickname,'requesterName',requester.nickname) row_data
  from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds lifecycle join public.order_cancellation_requests claim on claim.id=lifecycle.claim_id
  join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=lifecycle.order_id
  join public.refunds refund on refund.payment_id=lifecycle.payment_id
  left join private.gift_claim_parties parties on parties.claim_id=claim.id
  left join public.profiles payer on payer.id=lifecycle.payer_id
  left join public.profiles requester on requester.id=coalesce(parties.actual_requester,claim.requested_by)
  where lifecycle.state='awaiting_transfer'
  union all
  select head.applied_at,head.id,jsonb_build_object('kind','partial_cancellation','partialCancellationId',head.id,'orderId',purchase.id,
   'orderNumber',purchase.order_number,'sequence',head.sequence,'amount',head.refund_amount,'confirmedAt',head.applied_at,'filedAt',head.filed_at,
   'updatedAt',head.updated_at,'gift',exists(select 1 from private.gift_intents g where g.order_id=purchase.id),'payerName',payer.nickname) row_data
  from private.order_partial_cancellations head join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=head.order_id
  left join public.profiles payer on payer.id=purchase.user_id
  where head.provider='bank_transfer' and head.state='awaiting_transfer'
  order by 1,2 limit p_limit offset p_offset
 ) queue;
 return jsonb_build_object('rows',rows,'total',total,'limit',p_limit,'offset',p_offset);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_bank_transfer_refunds(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid();session_id uuid;rows jsonb;total bigint;
begin
 begin session_id:=(auth.jwt()->>'session_id')::uuid;exception when invalid_text_representation then raise insufficient_privilege using message='bank_refund_permission_required';end;
 perform private.require_bank_transfer_refund_identity(actor,session_id);
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 or p_offset is null or p_offset<0 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_bank_refund_page';end if;
 select count(*) into total from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds where state='awaiting_transfer';
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_data order by confirmed_at,claim_id),'[]') into rows from(
  select lifecycle.confirmed_at,lifecycle.claim_id,jsonb_build_object('claimId',claim.id,'orderId',purchase.id,'reference',claim.reference,
   'claimType',claim.claim_type,'amount',lifecycle.amount,'confirmedAt',lifecycle.confirmed_at,'filedAt',refund.filed_at,
   'updatedAt',greatest(lifecycle.updated_at,claim.updated_at),'revision',claim.claim_revision,
   'gift',parties.claim_id is not null,'payerName',payer.nickname,'requesterName',requester.nickname) row_data
  from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds lifecycle join public.order_cancellation_requests claim on claim.id=lifecycle.claim_id
  join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=lifecycle.order_id
  join public.refunds refund on refund.payment_id=lifecycle.payment_id
  left join private.gift_claim_parties parties on parties.claim_id=claim.id
  left join public.profiles payer on payer.id=lifecycle.payer_id
  left join public.profiles requester on requester.id=coalesce(parties.actual_requester,claim.requested_by)
  where lifecycle.state='awaiting_transfer' order by lifecycle.confirmed_at,lifecycle.claim_id limit p_limit offset p_offset
 ) queue;
 return jsonb_build_object('rows',rows,'total',total,'limit',p_limit,'offset',p_offset);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_customer_segments(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_group text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_target text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_kind text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_favorite_only boolean DEFAULT false, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid(); result jsonb; q text:=btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage') then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if length(q)>100 or p_group is null or p_group not in ('all','potential','visitor','interested','buyer','loyal')
  or p_target is null or p_target not in ('all','first_purchase','cart_unpurchased','wishlist_unpurchased','unused_coupon','ip_notifications','purchased','first_purchase_recent','lapsed_purchase','repeat_purchase','visited','not_visited','product_viewed','video_viewed','similar_product_viewed')
  or p_kind is null or p_kind not in ('all','preset','custom') or p_favorite_only is null
  or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 1000000 or p_page_size is null or p_page_size not in (20,50,100) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_segment_filter';end if;
 with matched as materialized (
  select s.id,s.updated_at from private.customer_segments s where s.archived_at is null
   and (q='' or position(lower(q) in lower(s.name))>0 or position(lower(q) in s.id::text)>0 or position(lower(q) in lower('CSG-'||s.reference::text))>0)
   and (p_group='all' or private.customer_segment_group(s.rule->>'target')=p_group)
   and (p_target='all' or s.rule->>'target'=p_target)
   and (p_kind='all' or (s.preset_key is not null)=(p_kind='preset'))
   and (not p_favorite_only or exists(select 1 from private.customer_segment_favorites f where f.actor_id=actor and f.segment_id=s.id))
 ), page_rows as (select * from matched order by updated_at desc,id desc limit p_page_size offset (p_page-1)*p_page_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from matched),'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.customer_segment_document(id,actor) order by updated_at desc,id desc) from page_rows),'[]'::jsonb),
  'favorites',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.customer_segment_document(f.segment_id,actor) order by f.created_at,f.segment_id)
    from private.customer_segment_favorites f join private.customer_segments s on s.id=f.segment_id where f.actor_id=actor and s.archived_at is null),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_defective_stock(p_limit integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare limit_value integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 200), 1), 500);
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read', false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'operator_capability_required'; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'variants', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row order by row->>'goodName', row->>'variantName', row->>'variantId') from (
      select jsonb_build_object('goodId', d.good_id, 'goodName', d.good_name, 'variantId', d.variant_id, 'variantName', d.variant_name,
        'variantCode', d.variant_code, 'qty', sum(d.qty), 'entries', count(*), 'lastRecordedAt', max(d.recorded_at)) as row
      from private.claim_defective_stock d where d.state = 'recorded'
      group by d.good_id, d.good_name, d.variant_id, d.variant_name, d.variant_code) grouped), '[]'::jsonb),
    'entries', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row order by (row->>'recordedAt') desc, row->>'id') from (
      select jsonb_build_object('id', d.id, 'claimId', d.claim_id, 'claimReference', c.reference, 'orderItemId', d.order_item_id,
        'goodName', d.good_name, 'variantId', d.variant_id, 'variantName', d.variant_name, 'variantCode', d.variant_code, 'qty', d.qty,
        'recordedAt', d.recorded_at, 'recordedByName', coalesce(p.nickname, ''), 'claimType', d.source) as row
      from private.claim_defective_stock d join public.order_cancellation_requests c on c.id = d.claim_id
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = d.recorded_by
      where d.state = 'recorded' order by d.recorded_at desc, d.id limit limit_value) recent), '[]'::jsonb),
    'pending', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(row order by row->>'claimReference') from (
      select jsonb_build_object('claimId', c.id, 'claimReference', c.reference, 'stage', c.stage, 'qty', sum(d.qty), 'items', count(*)) as row
      from private.claim_defective_stock d join public.order_cancellation_requests c on c.id = d.claim_id
      join public.orders o on o.id = c.order_id
      where d.state = 'planned' and c.claim_type = 'return' and c.stage not in ('rejected','withdrawn') and o.status = 'canceled'
      group by c.id, c.reference, c.stage) waiting), '[]'::jsonb));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_draw_ticket_grants(target_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(operation_id uuid, granted_at timestamp with time zone, actor_nickname text, recipient_id uuid, recipient_nickname text, recipient_masked_email text, pool_id uuid, pool_name text, quantity bigint, opened_count bigint, revoked_count bigint, reason text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  normalized_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 20), 1), 100);
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    grant_group.source_id,
    grant_group.granted_at,
    coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(actor_profile.nickname, E' \t\n\r\f\v'), ''),
      'staff_' || left(coalesce(audit.actor_id::text, ''), 6)
    ),
    grant_group.user_id,
    coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(recipient_profile.nickname, E' \t\n\r\f\v'), ''),
      'fan_' || left(grant_group.user_id::text, 6)
    ),
    case
      when nullif(btrim(coalesce(recipient_profile.email, '')), '') is null
        then '이메일 없음'::text
      when strpos(recipient_profile.email, '@') > 1
        then left(split_part(recipient_profile.email, '@', 1), 1)
          || '***@'
          || split_part(recipient_profile.email, '@', 2)
      else '***'::text
    end,
    grant_group.pool_id,
    pool.name,
    grant_group.quantity,
    grant_group.opened_count,
    grant_group.revoked_count,
    coalesce(audit.diff ->> 'reason', '사유 기록 없음')
  from (
    select
      ticket.source_id,
      ticket.user_id,
      ticket.pool_id,
      min(ticket.created_at) as granted_at,
      count(*)::bigint as quantity,
      count(*) filter (where ticket.consumed_at is not null)::bigint as opened_count,
      count(*) filter (where ticket.revoked_at is not null)::bigint as revoked_count
    from public.draw_tickets as ticket
    where ticket.source = 'admin_grant'
    group by ticket.source_id, ticket.user_id, ticket.pool_id
  ) as grant_group
  left join public.audit_log as audit
    on audit.id = grant_group.source_id
    and audit.action = 'admin.draw_ticket.granted'
  left join public.profiles as actor_profile on actor_profile.id = audit.actor_id
  left join public.profiles as recipient_profile on recipient_profile.id = grant_group.user_id
  left join public.card_pools as pool on pool.id = grant_group.pool_id
  order by grant_group.granted_at desc, grant_group.source_id
  limit normalized_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_erp_categories()
 RETURNS TABLE(erp_category text, item_count bigint, category_id uuid, updated_at timestamp with time zone, fallback_category_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false) then

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_games()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, type text, title text, event_id text, event_title text, config jsonb, variant_kind text, marble_count integer, reward_pool_id uuid, reward_pool_name text, reward_pool_active_from timestamp with time zone, reward_pool_active_to timestamp with time zone, reward_pool_ready boolean, ip_id text, ip_title text, per_user_daily_limit integer, active_from timestamp with time zone, active_to timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, play_count bigint, last_played_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    game.id,
    game.type,
    game.title,
    game.event_id,
    event_record.title as event_title,
    game.config,
    case
      when game.config #>> '{variant,kind}' in ('card', 'goods')
        then game.config #>> '{variant,kind}'
      else 'unknown'
    end as variant_kind,
    case
      when game.config ->> 'marbleCount' ~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
        then (game.config ->> 'marbleCount')::integer
      else null
    end as marble_count,
    game.reward_pool_id,
    pool.name as reward_pool_name,
    pool.active_from as reward_pool_active_from,
    pool.active_to as reward_pool_active_to,
    private.catalog_pool_has_active_lineup(pool.id) as reward_pool_ready,
    pool.ip_id,
    ip.title as ip_title,
    game.per_user_daily_limit,
    game.active_from,
    game.active_to,
    game.created_at,
    game.updated_at,
    play_summary.play_count,
    play_summary.last_played_at
  from public.games as game
  left join public.card_pools as pool
    on pool.id = game.reward_pool_id
  left join public.ips as ip
    on ip.id = pool.ip_id
  left join public.events as event_record
    on event_record.id = game.event_id
  left join lateral (
    select
      count(*)::bigint as play_count,
      max(game_play.created_at) as last_played_at
    from public.game_plays as game_play
    where game_play.game_id = game.id
  ) as play_summary on true
  order by game.created_at desc, game.id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_goods_preorder_reservations(p_good_id text, p_state text DEFAULT 'reserved'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare total_count integer; result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if not coalesce(public.has_operator_capability('sales.read',false),false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff required'; end if;
  if (p_state is not null and p_state not in ('reserved','allocated','released','returned')) or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100
    or p_offset is null or p_offset<0 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_preorder_reservation_query'; end if;
  select count(*) into total_count from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation join public.order_items item on item.id=reservation.order_item_id
    where item.good_id=p_good_id and (p_state is null or reservation.state=p_state);
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('orderItemId',row.order_item_id,'orderId',row.order_id,'policyId',row.policy_id,
    'variantId',row.variant_id,'variantName',row.variant_name_snapshot,'qty',row.qty,'state',row.state,'createdAt',row.created_at,
    'orderStatus',row.order_status,'fulfillmentHold',private.order_fulfillment_blocking(row.order_id),'expectedShipDate',row.preorder_expected_ship_date,'physicalStockQty',row.physical_stock_qty,
    'allocatedAt',row.allocated_at,'allocationReference',case when public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage') then row.allocation_reference end,'releasedAt',row.released_at,'releaseReason',case when public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage') then row.release_reason end)
    order by row.created_at,row.order_item_id),'[]'::jsonb) into result from (
      select reservation.*,item.variant_id,item.variant_name_snapshot,item.preorder_expected_ship_date,variant.stock_qty physical_stock_qty,purchase.status order_status
      from private.goods_preorder_reservations reservation join public.order_items item on item.id=reservation.order_item_id
      join public.goods_variants variant on variant.id=item.variant_id join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=reservation.order_id
      where item.good_id=p_good_id and (p_state is null or reservation.state=p_state)
      order by reservation.created_at,reservation.order_item_id limit p_limit offset p_offset) row;

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare ids uuid[]; total_count bigint; q text:=btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));

 if not private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'marketing.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_source is null or p_source not in ('home','good','story','category') or length(q)>100 or p_status is null or p_status not in ('all','available','unavailable')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_notification_history(target_limit integer DEFAULT 20, target_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(operation_id uuid, actor_name text, scope text, ip_id text, ip_title text, title text, body text, recipient_count bigint, sent_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if target_limit is null or target_limit < 1 or target_limit > 100 then
    raise exception 'invalid_history_limit' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if target_offset is null or target_offset < 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid_history_offset' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  return query
    select
      audit.id,
      case
        when profile.nickname is null or profile.nickname = '' then '운영자'
        else profile.nickname
      end,
      audit.diff #>> '{request,scope}',
      audit.diff #>> '{request,ip_id}',
      audit.diff #>> '{result,ip_title}',
      audit.diff #>> '{request,title}',
      audit.diff #>> '{request,body}',
      (audit.diff #>> '{result,recipient_count}')::bigint,
      audit.created_at
    from public.audit_log as audit
    left join public.profiles as profile
      on profile.id = audit.actor_id
    where audit.action = 'admin.notification.sent'
    order by audit.created_at desc, audit.id desc
    limit target_limit
    offset target_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_reward_policies()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, pool_id uuid, trigger text, target_ip_id text, target_good_id text, min_amount bigint, tickets_per_grant integer, active boolean, active_from timestamp with time zone, active_to timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, issued_count bigint, available_count bigint, opened_count bigint, revoked_count bigint, order_count bigint, last_issued_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    reward_policy.id,
    reward_policy.pool_id,
    reward_policy.trigger,
    reward_policy.target_ip_id,
    reward_policy.target_good_id,
    reward_policy.min_amount,
    reward_policy.tickets_per_grant,
    reward_policy.active,
    reward_policy.active_from,
    reward_policy.active_to,
    reward_policy.created_at,
    reward_policy.updated_at,
    count(ticket.id)::bigint as issued_count,
    count(ticket.id) filter (
      where ticket.consumed_at is null and ticket.revoked_at is null
    )::bigint as available_count,
    count(ticket.id) filter (where ticket.consumed_at is not null)::bigint
      as opened_count,
    count(ticket.id) filter (where ticket.revoked_at is not null)::bigint
      as revoked_count,
    count(distinct ticket.source_id) filter (
      where ticket.source = 'order_paid'
    )::bigint as order_count,
    max(ticket.created_at) as last_issued_at
  from public.reward_policies as reward_policy
  left join public.draw_tickets as ticket
    on ticket.reward_policy_id = reward_policy.id
  group by reward_policy.id
  order by reward_policy.created_at desc, reward_policy.id;
end;
$function$

 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.shipping_charge_group_document(id) order by updated_at desc,id),'[]') into result from(
  select g.id,g.updated_at from private.shipping_charge_groups g join private.shipping_charge_group_versions v on v.id=g.version_id
  where (p_origin_id is null or g.origin_id=p_origin_id) and position(lower(btrim(p_query)) in lower(v.policy_values->>'name'))>0

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_mark_seowon_shipments_exported(target_versions jsonb, target_batch uuid, target_labels jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid; total integer;
begin
  actor:=private.require_operator_capability('sales.dispatch',false);
  if target_batch is null or jsonb_typeof(target_labels) is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(target_labels) not between 1 and 1000
    or jsonb_typeof(target_versions) is distinct from 'array'
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(target_labels) label where jsonb_typeof(label)<>'object'
      or label->>'shipmentId' is null or label->>'shipmentId' !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      or jsonb_typeof(label->'suffix')<>'string' or label->>'suffix' !~ '^([0-9]{2,3})?$')
    or (select count(distinct lower(label->>'shipmentId')) from jsonb_array_elements(target_labels) label)<>jsonb_array_length(target_labels)
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(target_labels) label where not exists(
      select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(target_versions) version where lower(version->>'id')=lower(label->>'shipmentId'))) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_seowon_export_labels';
  end if;
  if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(target_labels) label
    left join public.order_shipments s on s.id=(label->>'shipmentId')::uuid
    left join public.fulfillment_origins origin on origin.id=s.origin_id
    where s.id is null or origin.export_template is distinct from 'seowon_xlsx') then
    raise check_violation using message='invalid_seowon_export_labels';
  end if;
  total:=public.admin_mark_shipments_exported(target_versions);
  insert into private.seowon_export_labels(shipment_id,export_batch,recipient_suffix,recorded_by)
  select (label->>'shipmentId')::uuid,target_batch,label->>'suffix',actor from jsonb_array_elements(target_labels) label
  on conflict(shipment_id) do update set export_batch=excluded.export_batch,recipient_suffix=excluded.recipient_suffix,
    recorded_by=excluded.recorded_by,recorded_at=clock_timestamp();
  insert into public.audit_log(actor_id,action,target,diff) values(actor,'admin.shipment.seowon_labels_recorded','seowon_export:'||target_batch,
    jsonb_build_object('shipments',jsonb_array_length(target_labels),'suffixed',(select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(target_labels) label where label->>'suffix'<>'')));
  return total;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_operations_contact_history(row_limit integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, actor_name text, scope text, origin_name text, changed_fields text[], created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;
  if row_limit is null or row_limit not between 1 and 50 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_operations_contact_history_limit';
  end if;
  return query
  select audit.id, coalesce(nullif(actor.nickname, ''), '관리자'), audit.diff ->> 'scope', origin.name,
    array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(audit.diff -> 'changedFields')), audit.created_at
  from public.audit_log audit
  left join public.profiles actor on actor.id = audit.actor_id
  left join public.fulfillment_origins origin on origin.id = (audit.diff ->> 'originId')::uuid
  where audit.action = 'admin.operations_contact.updated'
  order by audit.created_at desc, audit.id desc limit row_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_operations_contacts()
 RETURNS TABLE(scope text, origin_id uuid, origin_name text, origin_active boolean, owner_name text, contact text, source_reference text, handoff_reference text, updated_at timestamp with time zone, updated_by_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;
  return query
  with targets as (
    select 'operations'::text as scope, null::uuid as origin_id,
      null::text as origin_name, null::boolean as origin_active
    union all
    select 'origin'::text, origin.id, origin.name, origin.is_active
      from public.fulfillment_origins origin
  )
  select target.scope, target.origin_id, target.origin_name, target.origin_active,
    coalesce(saved.owner_name, ''), coalesce(saved.contact, ''),
    coalesce(saved.source_reference, ''), coalesce(saved.handoff_reference, ''),
    saved.updated_at,
    case when saved.updated_by is null then null
      else coalesce(nullif(editor.nickname, ''), '관리자') end
  from targets target
  left join private.operations_contacts saved on saved.scope = target.scope
    and saved.origin_id is not distinct from target.origin_id
  left join public.profiles editor on editor.id = saved.updated_by
  order by (target.scope = 'operations') desc, target.origin_name, target.origin_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_operator_inquiry_history(p_from date, p_to date, p_operator uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor uuid;
  range_start timestamptz;
  range_end timestamptz;
  summary jsonb;
  detail jsonb := null;
  total bigint;
  page integer := null;
  page_size constant integer := 50;
begin
  actor := private.require_operator_capability('operators.manage');
  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from > p_to or p_to - p_from > 366 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'operator_inquiry_history_range_invalid';
  end if;
  range_start := p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul';
  range_end := (p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul';

  with grouped as (
    select a.actor_id,
      count(*) filter (where a.action = 'admin.inquiry.answered') as answers,
      count(*) filter (where a.action = 'admin.inquiry.closed') as closes,
      count(*) filter (where a.action = 'admin.inquiry.reassigned') as reassignments,
      count(distinct a.target) as inquiries,
      max(a.created_at) as last_at
    from public.audit_log a
    where a.action in ('admin.inquiry.answered', 'admin.inquiry.closed', 'admin.inquiry.reassigned')
      and a.created_at >= range_start and a.created_at < range_end
      and a.actor_id is not null and a.target like 'inquiries:%'
    group by a.actor_id
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'operatorId', g.actor_id,
      'name', coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.nickname), ''), '운영자_' || left(g.actor_id::text, 6)),
      'managerRole', m.manager_role,
      'answers', g.answers, 'closes', g.closes, 'reassignments', g.reassignments,
      'inquiries', g.inquiries, 'lastAt', g.last_at
    ) order by g.last_at desc, g.actor_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into summary
  from grouped g
  left join public.profiles p on p.id = g.actor_id
  left join private.operator_memberships m on m.profile_id = g.actor_id;

  if p_operator is not null then
    select count(*) into total from public.audit_log a
    where a.actor_id = p_operator
      and a.action in ('admin.inquiry.answered', 'admin.inquiry.closed', 'admin.inquiry.reassigned')
      and a.created_at >= range_start and a.created_at < range_end
      and a.target like 'inquiries:%';
    page := least(greatest(coalesce(p_page, 1), 1), greatest(1, (total + page_size - 1) / page_size)::integer);
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'operatorId', p_operator,
      'name', coalesce(nullif(btrim(op.nickname), ''), '운영자_' || left(p_operator::text, 6)),
      'page', page, 'pageSize', page_size, 'total', total,
      'items', coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'id', r.id::text,
            'at', r.created_at,
            'kind', case r.action when 'admin.inquiry.reassigned' then 'reassigned' when 'admin.inquiry.answered' then 'answered' else 'closed' end,
            'inquiryId', i.id, 'reference', i.reference, 'title', i.title, 'status', i.status,
            'fromName', case when r.action = 'admin.inquiry.reassigned' and r.before_id is not null
              then coalesce(nullif(btrim(before_profile.nickname), ''), '운영자_' || left(r.before_id::text, 6)) end,
            'toName', case when r.action = 'admin.inquiry.reassigned' and r.after_id is not null
              then coalesce(nullif(btrim(after_profile.nickname), ''), '운영자_' || left(r.after_id::text, 6)) end
          ) order by r.created_at desc, r.step desc, r.id desc)
        from (
          select a.id, a.created_at, a.action,
            case a.action when 'admin.inquiry.answered' then 1 when 'admin.inquiry.reassigned' then 2 else 3 end as step,
            case when a.target ~* '^inquiries:[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then substr(a.target, 11)::uuid end as inquiry_id,
            case when a.diff->>'before' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then (a.diff->>'before')::uuid end as before_id,
            case when a.diff->>'after' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' then (a.diff->>'after')::uuid end as after_id
          from public.audit_log a
          where a.actor_id = p_operator
            and a.action in ('admin.inquiry.answered', 'admin.inquiry.closed', 'admin.inquiry.reassigned')
            and a.created_at >= range_start and a.created_at < range_end
            and a.target like 'inquiries:%'
          order by a.created_at desc,
            case a.action when 'admin.inquiry.answered' then 1 when 'admin.inquiry.reassigned' then 2 else 3 end desc,
            a.id desc
          limit page_size offset (page - 1) * page_size
        ) r
        left join public.inquiries i on i.id = r.inquiry_id
        left join public.profiles before_profile on before_profile.id = r.before_id
        left join public.profiles after_profile on after_profile.id = r.after_id
      ), '[]'::jsonb))
    into detail
    from (select 1) as one
    left join public.profiles op on op.id = p_operator;
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_log(actor_id, action, target, diff)
  values (actor, 'admin.operator.inquiry_history_viewed', 'operators:inquiry_history',
    jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to, 'operatorId', p_operator, 'page', page));

  return jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to, 'operators', summary, 'detail', detail);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_order_item_allocation_inputs(p_order_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  -- STABLE 조회는 PostgREST가 읽기 전용 트랜잭션으로 부르므로 잠금을 잡는 require_* 대신 잠금 없는 판정을 쓴다
  -- (20261020085358_goods_order_readers_readonly_authorization과 같은 관례).
  if not coalesce(private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'sales.read',false),false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';
  end if;
  if p_order_ids is null or cardinality(p_order_ids) not between 1 and 1000 or array_position(p_order_ids,null) is not null then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_order_allocation_ids';
  end if;
  return (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'orderId',o.id,'calculationVersion',o.calculation_version,
      'couponDiscount',o.discount_total,'storeCredits',o.store_credit_total,'volumeDiscount',o.volume_discount_total,
      'coupon',case when coupon.redemption_id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('discountAmount',coupon.discount_amount,
        'eligibleSubtotal',coupon.eligible_subtotal,'terms',coupon.terms_snapshot) end,
      'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'goodId',i.good_id,'ipId',i.good_ip_id_snapshot,'qty',i.qty,'unitPrice',i.unit_price,
          'regularUnitPrice',i.regular_unit_price_snapshot,
          'couponEligible',case when coupon.redemption_id is null then null else private.coupon_line_eligible_now(coupon.terms_snapshot,i.good_id,i.good_ip_id_snapshot) end,
          'allocation',case when a.order_item_id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('volumeDiscount',a.volume_discount,
            'couponDiscount',a.coupon_discount,'storeCreditDiscount',a.store_credit_discount,'paidGoodsTotal',a.paid_goods_total) end)
          order by i.id)
        from public.order_items i
        left join private.order_price_allocation_ledger a on a.order_item_id=i.id and a.order_id=o.id
        where i.order_id=o.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by o.id),'[]'::jsonb)
    from public.orders o
    left join lateral (
      select r.id as redemption_id,r.discount_amount,r.eligible_subtotal,r.terms_snapshot from public.coupon_redemptions r
      where r.order_id=o.id and r.status='applied' and r.benefit_kind='goods' and o.calculation_version=1
      order by r.application_index limit 1
    ) coupon on true
    where o.id=any(p_order_ids)
  );
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_origin_pending_export_ids(target_origin_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.dispatch',false) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 -- Count and select a whole physical package. A held, already-exported or
 -- unfinished-production sibling excludes the package before the 1,000-row cap.
 with pending as (
  select s.id,s.created_at,coalesce(private.shipment_pack_id(s.id),s.id) group_id,
   (select count(*) from public.order_shipment_items link where link.shipment_id=s.id) line_count
  from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
  where s.origin_id=target_origin_id and s.status='ready' and s.exported_at is null and s.delivery_method='parcel'
   and o.status in('confirmed','shipping') and private.shipment_preorder_allocation_ready(s.id)
   and(private.shipment_production_summary(s.id)->>'ready')::boolean
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests r where r.order_id=o.id and r.status in('requested','processing','needs_review'))
   and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=o.id)
   and not private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(o.id)
   and not private.order_fulfillment_held(o.id)
 ), eligible as (
  select p.* from pending p where not exists(
   select 1 from unnest(private.shipment_pack_scope(array[p.id])) member(id)
   where not exists(select 1 from pending sibling where sibling.id=member.id))
 ), groups as (
  select group_id,min(created_at) created_at,sum(line_count) line_count,count(*) shipment_count
  from eligible group by group_id
 ), ordered as (
  select group_id,sum(line_count) over(order by created_at,group_id) running_lines,
   sum(shipment_count) over(order by created_at,group_id) running_shipments from groups
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('ids',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(e.id order by e.created_at,e.id) from eligible e
  join ordered g on g.group_id=e.group_id where g.running_lines<=1000 and g.running_shipments<=1000),'[]'),
  'total',(select count(*) from eligible)) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_origin_tracking_candidates(target_origin_id uuid, target_tracking_numbers text[], target_phones text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare origin public.fulfillment_origins;result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.dispatch',false) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if target_origin_id is null or target_tracking_numbers is null or cardinality(target_tracking_numbers)>1000
  or array_position(target_tracking_numbers,null) is not null or target_phones is null or cardinality(target_phones)>1000
  or array_position(target_phones,null) is not null then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_tracking_batch';end if;
 select * into origin from public.fulfillment_origins where id=target_origin_id;
 if not found then raise no_data_found using message='warehouse_origin_not_found';end if;
 with candidates as (
  select s.id,s.shipment_number,s.order_id,s.status,s.carrier,s.tracking_number,s.shipped_at,a.address
  from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
  cross join lateral(select private.operational_order_address(o.id) address) a
  where s.origin_id=origin.id and s.delivery_method='parcel' and a.address->>'phone'=any(target_phones)
   and ((s.status='ready' and s.exported_at is not null and o.status in('confirmed','shipping'))
     or(s.status in('shipping','delivered') and o.status<>'canceled' and s.shipped_at>=now()-interval '45 days'))
  order by s.status<>'ready',s.shipped_at desc nulls first,s.id limit 5001
 ), bounded as(select * from candidates limit 5000)
 select jsonb_build_object('originId',origin.id,'template',origin.export_template,'active',origin.is_active,
  'defaultCarrier',origin.default_carrier,'truncated',(select count(*)>5000 from candidates),
  'shipments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'shipmentNumber',c.shipment_number,
   'seowonLabel',(select jsonb_build_object('batch',l.export_batch,'suffix',l.recipient_suffix) from private.seowon_export_labels l where l.shipment_id=c.id),
   'pack',(select jsonb_build_object('id',pack.summary->>'id','shipmentIds',pack.summary->'shipmentIds')
     from (select private.shipment_pack_summary(c.id) summary) pack where pack.summary is not null),
   'orderId',c.order_id,'status',c.status,'fulfillmentHold',c.status='ready' and private.order_fulfillment_held(c.order_id),
   'carrier',c.carrier,'trackingNumber',c.tracking_number,'extraTrackingNumbers',private.shipment_extra_tracking_numbers(c.id),
   'lines',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('recipient',coalesce(c.address->>'recipientName',''),
    'phone',coalesce(c.address->>'phone',''),'postalCode',coalesce(c.address->>'postalCode',''),
    'address',concat_ws(' ',c.address->>'address1',nullif(c.address->>'address2','')),
    'goodName',i.good_name_snapshot,'optionName',concat_ws(' / ',nullif(i.variant_name_snapshot,''),
     (select string_agg((field->>'name')||': '||(field->>'value'),' / ' order by entry.ordinality)
      from jsonb_array_elements(i.custom_inputs_snapshot->'fields') with ordinality entry(field,ordinality))),'qty',coalesce(link.qty,i.qty),
    'deliveryNote',coalesce(c.address->>'deliveryNote','')) order by i.id)
    from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id
    where link.shipment_id=c.id),'[]')) order by c.status<>'ready',c.shipped_at desc nulls first,c.id) from bounded c),'[]'),
  'usedTracking',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('trackingNumber',s.tracking_number,'shipmentId',s.id) order by s.tracking_number,s.id)
   from (select s.tracking_number,s.id from public.order_shipments s where s.carrier=origin.default_carrier and s.tracking_number=any(target_tracking_numbers)
     union select x.tracking_number,x.shipment_id from public.order_shipment_extra_trackings x where x.carrier=origin.default_carrier and x.tracking_number=any(target_tracking_numbers)) s),'[]'))
 into result;
 return result;
end $function$
