 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.manage',false);
  return public.admin_record_order_claim_origin_collection(p_claim_id,p_shipment_id,p_evidence,null::date);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_record_order_claim_refund(p_claim_id uuid, p_method text, p_stage text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_claim record;
  v_order_status public.order_status;
  v_refund_count integer;
begin
  perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.manage',false);

  if p_method not in ('pg_cancel', 'bank_transfer') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid refund method';
  end if;
  if p_stage not in ('filed', 'completed') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid refund stage';
  end if;
  if p_note is not null
    and (btrim(p_note) <> p_note or length(p_note) not between 1 and 300)
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid settlement note';
  end if;

  select request.order_id
  into v_claim
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  where request.id = p_claim_id;

  if not found then
    raise no_data_found using message = 'claim_not_found';
  end if;

  select orders.status
  into v_order_status
  from public.orders
  where orders.id = v_claim.order_id
  for update;

  select request.*
  into v_claim
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  where request.id = p_claim_id
  for update;

  perform private.assert_claim_collections_complete(p_claim_id);
  if exists(select 1 from public.orders where id=v_claim.order_id and payment_method='bank_transfer') then
    perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.manage',true);
    if p_method<>'bank_transfer' then raise check_violation using message='bank_refund_method_required';end if;
    if p_stage='completed' and private.bank_transfer_refund_legacy_completed_claim(v_claim.order_id,p_claim_id) then return 'completed';end if;
    if p_stage='filed' and v_claim.claim_type='cancel' and not exists(select 1 from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds where claim_id=p_claim_id and state='awaiting_transfer') then
      raise check_violation using message='bank_refund_confirmation_required';end if;
    if p_stage='completed' and not exists(select 1 from private.bank_transfer_claim_refunds where claim_id=p_claim_id and state='completed')
      and private.bank_transfer_zero_refund_payment(v_claim.order_id) is null then
      raise check_violation using message='bank_refund_evidence_required';end if;
  end if;


  if v_claim.claim_type = 'exchange' then
    raise exception using message = 'exchange_has_no_refund';
  end if;

  /*
   * 계좌 송금은 받아 둔 계좌가 있을 때만 적을 수 있다.
   *
   * 없는 계좌로 'bank_transfer'를 기록하면 원장은 송금했다고 말하고 구매자에게는
   * "등록하신 환불계좌로 송금을 접수했습니다"가 나간다 — 존재하지 않는 계좌를
   * 근거로 한 안내다. 파기된 행(purged_at)은 통과시킨다: 수집 사실은 남아 있고,
   * 그때 송금은 실제로 그 계좌로 갔다.
   */
  if p_method = 'bank_transfer'
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from private.claim_refund_accounts as account
      where account.claim_id = p_claim_id
    )
    and private.bank_transfer_zero_refund_payment(v_claim.order_id) is null
  then
    raise exception using message = 'claim_refund_account_missing';
  end if;

  perform payment.id
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = v_claim.order_id
  order by payment.id
  for update;

  if p_stage = 'filed' then
    if v_claim.stage not in ('collected', 'processing') then
      raise exception using message = 'claim_not_refundable';
    end if;

    -- 반품은 입고가 확인된 뒤에야 durable claim이 생긴다. 그 전에 만들면
    -- 물건이 돌아오지 않은 주문의 재고가 복원 대기 상태로 열린다.
    if v_claim.stage = 'collected' then
      insert into public.order_cancellation_claims (
        order_id,
        requested_by,
        previous_status
      )
      values (v_claim.order_id, v_claim.requested_by, v_order_status)
      on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

      -- 반품배송비 차감(QNA-033, ADR-0031): 단순 변심 반품이고 스위치가 켜져 있으면 여기서 한 번 결정한다.
      -- 환불 원장 금액은 '결제액 − 차감액'으로 연다. 결정이 없으면 차감 0 — 지금과 같은 전액이다.
      perform private.record_return_fee_deduction(p_claim_id, v_actor);

      insert into public.refunds (
        payment_id,
        amount,
        reason,
        status,
        cancellation_request_id
      )
      select
        payment.id,
        payment.amount - private.claim_refund_active_deduction(payment.id),
        v_claim.reason,
        case when refund.status = 'done' then 'done' else 'requested' end,
        p_claim_id
      from public.payments as payment
      left join public.refunds as refund on refund.payment_id = payment.id
      where payment.purpose = 'order'
        and payment.ref_id = v_claim.order_id
        and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'canceled', 'refunded')
      on conflict (payment_id) do update
      set
        cancellation_request_id = excluded.cancellation_request_id,
        reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
        amount = case
          when public.refunds.status <> 'done' and private.claim_refund_active_deduction(public.refunds.payment_id) > 0
            then excluded.amount
          else public.refunds.amount
        end,
        status = case
          when public.refunds.status = 'done' then 'done'
          else 'requested'
        end;

      update public.order_cancellation_requests
      set
        stage = 'processing',
        provider_started_at = coalesce(provider_started_at, now()),
        updated_at = now()
      where id = p_claim_id;
    end if;

    -- 수단·처리자·접수시각은 첫 기록이 이긴다. 재접수가 덮으면 이미 계좌로 송금한
    -- 건이 결제사 취소로 보이고, 실제로 접수한 사람이 마지막 클릭한 사람으로 바뀐다.
    -- 갱신 가능한 것은 상계·정산 메모뿐이다.
    update public.refunds as refund
    set
      method = coalesce(refund.method, p_method),
      handled_by = coalesce(refund.handled_by, v_actor),
      filed_at = coalesce(refund.filed_at, now()),
      settlement_note = coalesce(p_note, refund.settlement_note)
    from public.payments as payment
    where refund.payment_id = payment.id
      and payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = v_claim.order_id;

    insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
    values (
      v_actor,
      'admin.order.claim_refund_filed',
      'order:' || v_claim.order_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'claimId', p_claim_id,
        'claimType', v_claim.claim_type,
        'method', p_method,
        'from', v_claim.stage,
        'to', 'processing'
      ) || private.claim_refund_deduction_audit(p_claim_id)
    );

    /*
     * 토스 결제의 pg_cancel 접수는 아직 결제사 취소가 나가기 전이다. 취소는
     * 서버 오케스트레이터가 발행하고, 검증되면 complete_order_cancellation_request가
     * '결제 취소가 완료됐어요'를 따로 보낸다. "결제사에 접수했다"는 문구는 운영자가
     * 이메일로 접수한 뒤 기록하는 Korpay에만 사실이다.
     */
    perform private.notify_order_claim(
      p_claim_id,
      'refund_filed',
      '환불 접수가 완료됐어요',
      coalesce(private.claim_refund_deduction_notice(p_claim_id,
        case when p_method = 'bank_transfer' then 'filed_bank_transfer' else 'filed' end), case
        when p_method = 'bank_transfer'
          then '등록하신 환불계좌로 송금을 접수했습니다.'
        when exists (
          select 1
          from public.payments as payment
          where payment.purpose = 'order'
            and payment.ref_id = v_claim.order_id
            and payment.provider in ('toss', 'nicepay')
            and payment.status <> 'failed'
        )
          then '환불 절차를 시작했습니다. 결제사 취소가 확인되면 다시 알려드립니다.'
        else '결제사에 결제 취소를 접수했습니다. 카드사 처리 일정에 따라 반영 시점이 다를 수 있습니다.'
      end)
    );

    return 'filed';
  end if;

  -- 완료 기록.
  if v_claim.stage <> 'completed' then
    raise exception using message = 'claim_refund_finalization_required';
  end if;

  update public.refunds as refund
  set
    method = coalesce(refund.method, p_method),
    handled_by = coalesce(refund.handled_by, v_actor),
    completed_at = coalesce(refund.completed_at, now()),
    settlement_note = coalesce(p_note, refund.settlement_note)
  from public.payments as payment
  where refund.payment_id = payment.id
    and payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = v_claim.order_id;

  get diagnostics v_refund_count = row_count;

  -- 환불 원장이 한 줄도 없는 완료는 "돈은 돌아갔는데 장부가 비었다"는 뜻이다.
  -- 첫 판매 리스크 목록이 지적한 그 상태를 여기서 막는다.
  if v_refund_count = 0 then
    raise exception using message = 'claim_refund_ledger_missing';
  end if;

  -- 환불계좌 파기 기한은 여기서 잡지 않는다. 클레임이 종결 stage에 닿는 순간
  -- private.seal_order_claim_refund_account가 이미 잡았다 — 거절·교환·레거시
  -- 완료까지 같은 규칙을 받으려면 판정이 한 곳에 있어야 한다.

  insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
  values (
    v_actor,
    'admin.order.claim_refund_completed',
    'order:' || v_claim.order_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'claimId', p_claim_id,
      'claimType', v_claim.claim_type,
      'method', p_method,
      'refundRows', v_refund_count,
      'settlementNote', p_note
    ) || private.claim_refund_deduction_audit(p_claim_id)
  );

  perform private.notify_order_claim(
    p_claim_id,
    'refund_completed',
    '환불이 완료됐어요',
    coalesce(private.claim_refund_deduction_notice(p_claim_id, 'completed'),
      '환급 처리가 완료됐습니다. 결제수단에 따라 반영 시점이 다를 수 있습니다.')
  );

  return 'completed';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_resolve_goods_references(p_refs text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result_value jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;
  if p_refs is null or cardinality(p_refs) not between 1 and 1000 or array_position(p_refs,null) is not null
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_refs) ref where ref<>btrim(ref) or char_length(ref) not between 1 and 200) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_references';
  end if;
  with refs as materialized (
    select input.ref,input.ordinality from unnest(p_refs) with ordinality input(ref,ordinality)
  ), hits as materialized (
    select refs.ordinality,good.id,case when good.id=refs.ref then 'id' else 'code' end matched_by
    from refs join public.goods good on good.id=refs.ref or good.code=upper(refs.ref)
  ), resolved as materialized (
    select refs.ref,refs.ordinality,count(distinct hits.id) hit_count,min(hits.id) good_id,min(hits.matched_by) matched_by
    from refs left join hits on hits.ordinality=refs.ordinality group by refs.ref,refs.ordinality
  ), base as materialized (
    select g as good,g.id,g.name,g.code,g.archived_at is not null or ip.archived_at is not null as archived,
      ip.published_at is not null as ip_published,
      g.published_at is not null and ip.published_at is not null and g.archived_at is null and ip.archived_at is null and g.sale_restriction='none' as is_published
    from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id
    where g.id in (select good_id from resolved where hit_count=1)
  ), eligible as materialized (
    select b.*,coalesce(s.price,(b.good).price) as current_price,coalesce(s.available,0)<=0 as sold_out,coalesce(s.preorder,false) as preorder,
      coalesce(s.discounted,false) or coalesce((b.good).compare_at_price>(b.good).price,false) as discounted,
      (private.calculate_goods_shipping(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('origin_id',(b.good).origin_id,'good_id',b.id,'qty',1,
        'unit_price',coalesce(s.price,(b.good).price),'fee_type',(b.good).shipping_fee_type,'individual_fee',(b.good).individual_fee)))->>'totalFee')::bigint=0 as free_shipping
    from base b cross join lateral (
      select min(price.effective_price) price,sum(supply.available_qty) available,bool_or(v.preorder_policy_id is not null) preorder,
        bool_or(price.effective_price<price.regular_price) discounted
      from public.goods_variants v
      cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_variant_price(v.id,statement_timestamp()) price
      cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_variant_supply(v.id,statement_timestamp()) supply
      where v.good_id=b.id and v.archived_at is null
    ) s
    where not b.archived
  ), review_metrics as (
    select r.good_id,count(*) review_count,avg(r.rating)::numeric rating_average from public.reviews r join eligible g on g.id=r.good_id where r.status='visible' group by r.good_id
  ), wishes as (
    select w.good_id,count(*) wish_count from public.wishlists w join eligible g on g.id=w.good_id group by w.good_id
  ), paid_orders as materialized (
    -- 관련상품 찾기 검색·홈 판매 순위와 같은 결제 근거와 취소·반품 완료 제외다.
    select o.id,min(approval.approved_at) approved_at
    from public.orders o
    join public.payments p on p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.status='paid' and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.amount=o.total
    join public.payment_attempts a on a.payment_id=p.id and a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id and a.state='approved' and a.amount=p.amount and a.provider=p.provider and a.user_id=o.user_id
    cross join lateral (select coalesce(
      (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
      (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id and a.provider='bank_transfer')) approved_at) approval
    where o.status in ('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done') and approval.approved_at is not null
      and exists(select 1 from public.order_items item join eligible g on g.id=item.good_id where item.order_id=o.id)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id and c.claim_type in ('cancel','return') and (c.status='completed' or c.stage='completed'))
    group by o.id
  ), sales as (
    select item.good_id,sum(item.qty::bigint) quantity from paid_orders p join public.order_items item on item.order_id=p.id join eligible g on g.id=item.good_id
    where p.approved_at>=statement_timestamp()-interval '30 days' and p.approved_at<statement_timestamp() group by item.good_id
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref',r.ref,
      'status',case when r.hit_count=0 then 'not_found' when r.hit_count>1 then 'ambiguous' else 'found' end,
      'matchedBy',case when r.hit_count=1 then r.matched_by end,
      'id',b.id,'name',b.name,'code',b.code,'archived',coalesce(b.archived,false),'published',coalesce(b.is_published,false),
      'candidate',case when e.id is null then null else private.shopping_story_admin_good(e.good,e.ip_published,false)||jsonb_build_object(
        'reviewCount',coalesce(rm.review_count,0),'ratingAverage',round(rm.rating_average,2),'wishCount',coalesce(w.wish_count,0),
        'salesQuantity',coalesce(s.quantity,0),'freeShipping',e.free_shipping,'discounted',e.discounted,
        'saleType',case when e.preorder then 'preorder' else 'stock' end) end) order by r.ordinality),'[]'::jsonb) into result_value
  from resolved r
  left join base b on b.id=r.good_id and r.hit_count=1
  left join eligible e on e.id=b.id
  left join review_metrics rm on rm.good_id=e.id
  left join wishes w on w.good_id=e.id
  left join sales s on s.good_id=e.id;
  return result_value;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_review_console_counts()
 RETURNS TABLE(total_reviews bigint, low_rating_reviews bigint, awaiting_reply_reviews bigint, hidden_reviews bigint, reported_reviews bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

  /* 미처리 신고는 조인으로 붙인다. FILTER 안에 상관 서브쿼리를 넣으면 읽는 사람이
     "행마다 도는 쿼리"를 못 알아보고, 신고 테이블이 커졌을 때 여기가 먼저 느려진다. */
  return query
  with reported as (
    select distinct report.target_id as review_id
    from public.reports as report
    where report.target_type = 'review'
      and report.status in ('open', 'reviewing')
  )
  select
    pg_catalog.count(*)::bigint,
    pg_catalog.count(*) filter (where review.rating <= 2)::bigint,
    pg_catalog.count(*) filter (
      where review.admin_reply is null and review.status = 'visible'
    )::bigint,
    pg_catalog.count(*) filter (where review.status = 'hidden')::bigint,
    pg_catalog.count(*) filter (where reported.review_id is not null)::bigint
  from public.reviews as review
  left join reported on reported.review_id = review.id::text;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_review_event_credit_policy()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 return (select jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'maxBalance',max_balance,'validityDays',validity_days) from private.store_credit_policy where singleton);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_review_insights(p_focus text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'analysis'::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; day_start timestamptz:=date_trunc('day',statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul';
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='forbidden'; end if;
  if p_focus is null or p_focus not in ('all','photo','coverage','rating','unanswered')
    or p_query is null or char_length(p_query)>100 or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('analysis','reviews','rating')
    or p_page is null or p_page<1 or p_page>100000 or p_page_size is null or p_page_size not in (20,50,100)
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_review_insights_filter'; end if;
  with products as materialized (
    select g.id,g.name,g.price,g.image_path from public.goods g join public.ips i on i.id=g.ip_id
    where g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and i.archived_at is null and i.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none'
  ), visible_reviews as materialized (
    select r.* from public.reviews r join products p on p.id=r.good_id
    where r.status='visible' and r.created_at<day_start
  ), reviews_by_product as (
    select good_id,count(*) review_count,count(*) filter(where cardinality(image_paths)>0) photo_count,
      count(*) filter(where nullif(btrim(admin_reply),'') is null) unanswered_count,
      avg(rating) average_rating,
      avg(rating) filter(where created_at>=((day_start at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')-interval '6 months') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') six_month_rating
    from visible_reviews group by good_id
  ), delivered_cohort as materialized (
    -- One review can be written per order × product, even with multiple options/text entries.
    select distinct oi.order_id,oi.good_id from public.orders o join public.order_items oi on oi.order_id=o.id join products p on p.id=oi.good_id
    where o.status in ('delivered','done') and o.delivered_at>=day_start-interval '90 days' and o.delivered_at<day_start
  ), coverage_by_product as (
    select c.good_id,count(*) delivered_count,count(*) filter(where exists(
      select 1 from public.reviews r where r.order_id=c.order_id and r.good_id=c.good_id and r.created_at<day_start
    )) reviewed_count from delivered_cohort c group by c.good_id
  ), metrics as materialized (
    select p.*,coalesce(r.review_count,0) review_count,coalesce(r.photo_count,0) photo_count,
      coalesce(r.unanswered_count,0) unanswered_count,r.average_rating,r.six_month_rating,
      coalesce(c.delivered_count,0) delivered_count,coalesce(c.reviewed_count,0) reviewed_count,
      100.0*r.photo_count/nullif(r.review_count,0) photo_rate,
      100.0*c.reviewed_count/nullif(c.delivered_count,0) coverage_rate
    from products p left join reviews_by_product r on r.good_id=p.id left join coverage_by_product c on c.good_id=p.id
  ), benchmark as (
    select 100.0*sum(photo_count)/nullif(sum(review_count),0) photo_rate,
      100.0*sum(reviewed_count)/nullif(sum(delivered_count),0) coverage_rate,
      avg(average_rating) average_rating,avg(six_month_rating) six_month_rating from metrics
  ), tagged as materialized (
    select m.*,coalesce(m.photo_rate<b.photo_rate,false) low_photo,
      coalesce(m.coverage_rate<b.coverage_rate,false) low_coverage,
      coalesce(m.average_rating<4.6,false) low_rating
    from metrics m cross join benchmark b
    where p_query='' or strpos(lower(m.name),lower(btrim(p_query)))>0 or strpos(lower(m.id),lower(btrim(p_query)))>0
  ), filtered as materialized (
    select * from tagged where case p_focus when 'photo' then low_photo when 'coverage' then low_coverage
      when 'rating' then low_rating when 'unanswered' then unanswered_count>0 else true end
  ), page_rows as (
    select * from filtered order by
      case when p_sort='reviews' then review_count end desc,
      case when p_sort='rating' or p_sort='analysis' and p_focus='rating' then average_rating end asc nulls last,
      case when p_sort='analysis' and p_focus='photo' then photo_rate end asc nulls last,
      case when p_sort='analysis' and p_focus='coverage' then coverage_rate end asc nulls last,
      case when p_sort='analysis' then unanswered_count end desc,review_count desc,id
    limit p_page_size offset (p_page-1)*p_page_size
  ), recent as (
    select count(*) total,count(*) filter(where rating<=3) low_count from public.reviews r join products p on p.id=r.good_id
    where r.status='visible' and r.created_at>=day_start-interval '1 day' and r.created_at<=statement_timestamp()
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'asOf',(day_start at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date-1,
    'cohortFrom',((day_start-interval '90 days') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date,
    'summary',(select jsonb_build_object('newReviews',recent.total,'newLowReviews',recent.low_count,
      'averageRating',round(b.average_rating,2),'sixMonthRating',round(b.six_month_rating,2),
      'photoRate',round(b.photo_rate,1),'coverageRate',round(b.coverage_rate,1)) from benchmark b cross join recent),
    'counts',(select jsonb_build_object('all',count(*),'photo',count(*) filter(where low_photo),
      'coverage',count(*) filter(where low_coverage),'rating',count(*) filter(where low_rating),'unanswered',count(*) filter(where unanswered_count>0)) from tagged),
    'total',(select count(*) from filtered),'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name,'price',price,'imagePath',image_path,
      'reviewCount',review_count,'photoCount',photo_count,'unansweredCount',unanswered_count,
      'averageRating',round(average_rating,2),'photoRate',round(photo_rate,1),'coverageRate',round(coverage_rate,1),
      'deliveredCount',delivered_count,'reviewedCount',reviewed_count)) from page_rows),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) into result;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_sales_report(p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_ip_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_ip text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_ip_id, '')), '');
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('stats.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('stats.read',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to <= p_from then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_report_range';
  end if;

  with scoped as (
    select
      orders.id,
      orders.total - private.order_partial_refunded_amount(orders.id) as total,
      orders.payment_method,
      (orders.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as kst_date
    from public.orders
    where orders.status = any (private.revenue_order_statuses())
      and orders.created_at >= p_from
      and orders.created_at < p_to
  ),
  daily as (
    select
      scoped.kst_date,
      count(*) as order_count,
      sum(scoped.total) as revenue
    from scoped
    group by scoped.kst_date
  ),
  methods as (
    select
      scoped.payment_method,
      count(*) as order_count,
      sum(scoped.total) as revenue
    from scoped
    group by scoped.payment_method
  ),
  goods_rank as (
    select
      item.good_id,
      max(item.good_name_snapshot) as name,
      max(item.good_ip_id_snapshot) as ip_id,
      sum(private.order_item_active_qty(item.id)) as qty,
      sum(item.qty::numeric*item.unit_price::numeric-coalesce((select allocation.volume_discount from private.order_price_allocations allocation where allocation.order_item_id=item.id),0)
        -(select c.gross_amount from private.order_item_partial_cancel_totals(item.id) c)) as revenue
    from public.order_items as item
    join scoped on scoped.id = item.order_id
    where v_ip is null or item.good_ip_id_snapshot = v_ip
    group by item.good_id having sum(private.order_item_active_qty(item.id)) > 0
    order by revenue desc, qty desc, item.good_id
    limit 20
  ),
  ticket_scoped as (
    select
      ticket_order.id,
      ticket_order.event_id,
      ticket_order.total,
      (ticket_order.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as kst_date
    from public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
    where ticket_order.status = 'paid'
      and ticket_order.created_at >= p_from
      and ticket_order.created_at < p_to
  ),
  tickets as (
    select
      ticket_scoped.event_id,
      max(coalesce(event.title, ticket_scoped.event_id)) as event_title,
      count(*) as order_count,
      sum(ticket_scoped.total) as revenue,
      coalesce(sum(reservation.quantity), 0) as ticket_count
    from ticket_scoped
    left join public.events as event on event.id = ticket_scoped.event_id
    left join public.ticket_order_reservations as reservation
      on reservation.ticket_order_id = ticket_scoped.id
    group by ticket_scoped.event_id
    order by revenue desc, ticket_scoped.event_id
    limit 20
  ),
  -- 회차 축. 이벤트 합계만으로는 "어느 회차가 안 팔리는가"를 볼 수 없고, 그
  -- 판단이 정원 조정의 근거다. 매출은 예약 스냅샷(수량 × 단가)에서 센다 —
  -- ticket_orders.total은 회차별로 쪼갤 수 없다.
  ticket_occurrences as (
    select
      reservation.ticket_type_id,
      max(coalesce(ticket_type.name, '이름 없는 회차')) as occurrence_name,
      max(coalesce(event.title, ticket_scoped.event_id)) as event_title,
      sum(reservation.quantity) as ticket_count,
      sum(reservation.quantity::bigint * reservation.unit_price::bigint) as revenue
    from ticket_scoped
    join public.ticket_order_reservations as reservation
      on reservation.ticket_order_id = ticket_scoped.id
    left join public.ticket_types as ticket_type on ticket_type.id = reservation.ticket_type_id
    left join public.events as event on event.id = ticket_scoped.event_id
    group by reservation.ticket_type_id
    order by revenue desc, reservation.ticket_type_id
    limit 20
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'daily', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'date', to_char(daily.kst_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
          'orderCount', daily.order_count,
          'revenue', daily.revenue,
          -- 객단가는 정수 원 단위로 내린다. 소수점 원은 화면에서 의미가 없다.
          'averageOrderValue', (daily.revenue / greatest(daily.order_count, 1))::bigint
        )
        order by daily.kst_date
      )
      from daily
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'paymentMethods', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'method', methods.payment_method,
          'orderCount', methods.order_count,
          'revenue', methods.revenue
        )
        order by methods.revenue desc
      )
      from methods
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'goods', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'goodId', goods_rank.good_id,
          'name', goods_rank.name,
          'ipId', goods_rank.ip_id,
          'qty', goods_rank.qty,
          'revenue', goods_rank.revenue
        )
      )
      from goods_rank
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'tickets', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'eventId', tickets.event_id,
          'eventTitle', tickets.event_title,
          'orderCount', tickets.order_count,
          'ticketCount', tickets.ticket_count,
          'revenue', tickets.revenue
        )
      )
      from tickets
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ticketOccurrences', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'ticketTypeId', ticket_occurrences.ticket_type_id,
          'occurrenceName', ticket_occurrences.occurrence_name,
          'eventTitle', ticket_occurrences.event_title,
          'ticketCount', ticket_occurrences.ticket_count,
          'revenue', ticket_occurrences.revenue
        )
      )
      from ticket_occurrences
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_coupon_console_scheduled(p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, name text, discount_type text, discount_value integer, max_discount_amount integer, min_subtotal integer, starts_at timestamp with time zone, ends_at timestamp with time zone, issue_limit integer, issued_count integer, status text, grade_benefit public.loyalty_grade, used_count bigint, total_count bigint, recipient_segment text, goods_scope text, target_good_ids text[], terms_revision integer, target_goods jsonb, issue_starts_at timestamp with time zone, issue_ends_at timestamp with time zone, valid_days integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  needle text := btrim(coalesce(p_query, ''));
  normalized_status text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_status, 'all')));
  pattern text;
  phase text := coalesce(p_filters->>'phase','all');
  discount text := coalesce(p_filters->>'discountType','all');
  segment text := coalesce(p_filters->>'segment','any');
  date_field text := coalesce(p_filters->>'dateField','created');
  sort_key text := coalesce(p_filters->>'sort','created_desc');
  date_from date := nullif(p_filters->>'from','')::date;
  date_to date := nullif(p_filters->>'to','')::date;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null or not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

  if length(needle) > 100
     or normalized_status not in ('all', 'active', 'archived')
     or p_limit is null
     or p_limit not between 1 and 100
     or p_offset is null
     or p_offset < 0 or p_offset > 10000000
     or phase not in ('all','scheduled','live','ended','stopped')
     or discount not in ('all','fixed','percent')
     or segment not in ('any','all','first_purchase','repeat_purchase','grade')
     or date_field not in ('created','starts')
     or sort_key not in ('created_desc','name_asc','starts_desc','ends_asc')
     or (date_from is not null and date_to is not null and date_from > date_to) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_coupon_search';
  end if;

  -- `%`와 `_`는 검색어가 아니라 와일드카드로 해석되지 않게 한다. 나머지
  -- PostgREST 문법은 RPC 내부의 SQL 값으로만 취급되므로 필터 문자열을 만들지 않는다.
  pattern := '%' || replace(
    replace(replace(needle, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'),
    '_', E'\\_'
  ) || '%';

  return query
    select
      coupon.code,
      coupon.name,
      coupon.discount_type,
      coupon.discount_value,
      coupon.max_discount_amount,
      coupon.min_subtotal,
      coupon.starts_at,
      coupon.ends_at,
      coupon.issue_limit,
      coupon.issued_count,
      coupon.status,
      coupon.grade_benefit,
      (
        select count(*)::bigint
        from public.coupon_redemptions as redemption
        where redemption.coupon_code = coupon.code
          and redemption.status = 'applied'
      ) as used_count,
      count(*) over () as total_count,
      coupon.recipient_segment,coupon.goods_scope,coupon.target_good_ids,coupon.terms_revision,public.admin_coupon_target_goods(coupon),coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.issue_ends_at,coupon.valid_days
    from public.coupons as coupon
    where (needle = ''
      or coupon.code ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or coupon.name ilike pattern escape E'\\')
      and (normalized_status = 'all' or coupon.status = normalized_status)
      and (discount='all' or coupon.discount_type=discount)
      and (segment='any' or (segment='grade' and coupon.grade_benefit is not null) or coupon.recipient_segment=segment)
      and (phase='all' or (phase='stopped' and coupon.status='archived')
        or (coupon.status='active' and ((phase='scheduled' and coalesce(coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.starts_at)>now())
        or (phase='ended' and least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end)<=now())
        or (phase='live' and coalesce(coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.starts_at)<=now() and (least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end) is null or least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end)>now())))))
      and (date_from is null or (case when date_field='starts' then coupon.starts_at else coupon.created_at end) >= (date_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
      and (date_to is null or (case when date_field='starts' then coupon.starts_at else coupon.created_at end) < ((date_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
    order by case when sort_key='name_asc' then coupon.name end asc,
      case when sort_key='starts_desc' then coupon.starts_at end desc,
      case when sort_key='ends_asc' then coupon.ends_at end asc nulls last,
      coupon.created_at desc, coupon.code asc
    limit p_limit
    offset p_offset;
end;
$function$

  -- `%`와 `_`는 검색어가 아니라 와일드카드로 해석되지 않게 한다. 나머지
  -- PostgREST 문법은 RPC 내부의 SQL 값으로만 취급되므로 필터 문자열을 만들지 않는다.
  pattern := '%' || replace(
    replace(replace(needle, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'),

  return query
    select
      coupon.code,

      coupon.max_discount_amount,
      coupon.min_subtotal,

      coupon.status,

      (
        select count(*)::bigint
        from public.coupon_redemptions as redemption
        where redemption.coupon_code = coupon.code
          and redemption.status = 'applied'
      ) as used_count,
      count(*) over () as total_count,
      coupon.recipient_segment,coupon.goods_scope,coupon.target_good_ids,coupon.terms_revision,public.admin_coupon_target_goods(coupon),coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.issue_ends_at,coupon.valid_days,coupon.benefit_kind,coupon.stackable
    from public.coupons as coupon
    where (needle = ''
      or coupon.code ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or coupon.name ilike pattern escape E'\\')
      and (normalized_status = 'all' or coupon.status = normalized_status)
      and (discount='all' or coupon.discount_type=discount)
      and (segment='any' or (segment='grade' and coupon.grade_benefit is not null) or coupon.recipient_segment=segment)
      and (phase='all' or (phase='stopped' and coupon.status='archived')
        or (coupon.status='active' and ((phase='scheduled' and coalesce(coupon.issue_starts_at,coupon.starts_at)>now())
        or (phase='ended' and least(coupon.ends_at,case when coupon.issue_starts_at is null then coupon.ends_at else coupon.issue_ends_at end)<=now())

AS $function$

begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

     or pg_catalog.length(coalesce(v_needle, '')) > 100 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_erp_item_search';
  end if;
  if v_needle is null then
    return;
  end if;

  v_escaped := pg_catalog.replace(
    pg_catalog.replace(pg_catalog.replace(v_needle, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'),
    '_', E'\\_');

  return query
    select
      item.code,
      item.name,
      item.category,
      item.sale_price,
      item.barcode,
      private.erp_category_target(item.category)
    from public.erp_items as item
    where item.name ilike '%' || v_escaped || '%' escape E'\\'
       or item.code ilike '%' || v_escaped || '%' escape E'\\'
    order by
      case
        when pg_catalog.lower(item.code) = pg_catalog.lower(v_needle) then 0
        when item.name ilike v_escaped || '%' escape E'\\' then 1
        when item.code ilike v_escaped || '%' escape E'\\' then 2
        else 3
      end,
      pg_catalog.length(item.name),
      item.name,
      item.code
    limit p_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_goods_console(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_ip_id text DEFAULT ''::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'active'::text, p_stock text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_readiness text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  result jsonb;
  sort_value text := coalesce(p_filters->>'sort', 'created_desc');
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if auth.uid() is null or not coalesce(public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false),false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;
  if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 0 and 100 or p_offset is null or p_offset < 0 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_goods_console_page';
  end if;
  if p_status is null or p_status not in ('active','all','draft','published','archived') then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_goods_console_status';
  end if;
  if p_stock is null or p_stock not in ('all','ok','low','soldout','stopped','out_of_stock') then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_goods_workspace_filter';
  end if;
  -- 판매기간 축은 건수를 위해 여기서 거른다(나머지 조건 검증은 admin_goods_console_matches가 한다).
  if jsonb_typeof(p_filters) is distinct from 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(p_filters->'salePeriod') not in ('string','null')
    or coalesce(p_filters->>'salePeriod','all') not in ('all','scheduled','ended') then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_goods_console_filter';
  end if;
  with period_universe as materialized (
    select * from private.admin_goods_console_matches(p_query,p_ip_id,'all','all',p_category_id,p_readiness,p_filters - 'salePeriod')
  ), universe as materialized (
    select * from period_universe
    where private.admin_goods_sale_period_matches(coalesce(p_filters->>'salePeriod','all'),(good).sale_starts_at,(good).sale_ends_at)
  ), scope as (
    select * from universe where private.admin_goods_stock_filter_matches(p_stock,(good).stock,(readiness->>'activeStockQty')::bigint)
  ), status_scope as materialized (
    select * from universe where case p_status
      when 'all' then true when 'archived' then (good).archived_at is not null
      when 'draft' then (good).archived_at is null and (good).published_at is null
      when 'published' then (good).archived_at is null and (good).published_at is not null
      else (good).archived_at is null end
  ), matched as materialized (
    select * from status_scope where private.admin_goods_stock_filter_matches(p_stock,(good).stock,(readiness->>'activeStockQty')::bigint)
  ), period_scope as (
    select * from period_universe where case p_status
      when 'all' then true when 'archived' then (good).archived_at is not null
      when 'draft' then (good).archived_at is null and (good).published_at is null
      when 'published' then (good).archived_at is null and (good).published_at is not null
      else (good).archived_at is null end
      and private.admin_goods_stock_filter_matches(p_stock,(good).stock,(readiness->>'activeStockQty')::bigint)
  ), ordered as (
    select *, row_number() over(order by
      case when sort_value = 'created_desc' then (good).created_at end desc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'updated_desc' then (good).updated_at end desc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'name_asc' then (good).name end asc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'number_asc' then (good).product_no end asc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'number_desc' then (good).product_no end desc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'price_asc' then (readiness->>'priceMin')::bigint end asc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'price_desc' then (readiness->>'priceMin')::bigint end desc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'stock_asc' then (readiness->>'availableQty')::bigint end asc nulls last,
      case when sort_value = 'stock_desc' then (readiness->>'availableQty')::bigint end desc nulls last,
      (good).id asc) as position
    from matched
  ), page as (select * from ordered order by position limit p_limit offset p_offset)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'checkedAt',statement_timestamp(), 'total',(select count(*) from matched),
    'statusCounts',(select jsonb_build_object(
      'all',count(*), 'active',count(*) filter(where (good).archived_at is null),
      'draft',count(*) filter(where (good).archived_at is null and (good).published_at is null),
      'published',count(*) filter(where (good).archived_at is null and (good).published_at is not null),
      'archived',count(*) filter(where (good).archived_at is not null)) from scope),
    'stockCounts',(select jsonb_build_object(
      'out_of_stock',count(*) filter(where private.admin_goods_stock_filter_matches('out_of_stock',(good).stock,(readiness->>'activeStockQty')::bigint)),
      'low',count(*) filter(where private.admin_goods_stock_filter_matches('low',(good).stock,(readiness->>'activeStockQty')::bigint))) from status_scope),
    'saleStateCounts',jsonb_build_object(
      'scheduled',(select count(*) from period_scope where private.admin_goods_sale_period_matches('scheduled',(good).sale_starts_at,(good).sale_ends_at)),
      'stopped',(select count(*) from status_scope where private.admin_goods_stock_filter_matches('stopped',(good).stock,(readiness->>'activeStockQty')::bigint)),
      'ended',(select count(*) from period_scope where private.admin_goods_sale_period_matches('ended',(good).sale_starts_at,(good).sale_ends_at))),
    'reasonCounts',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(code,total) from (
      select code,count(*) total from matched cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(readiness->'reasonCodes') code group by code
    ) counts),'{}'),
    'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',(good).id,'productNo',(good).product_no,'code',(good).code,'name',(good).name,'ipId',(good).ip_id,
      'ipTitle',(select title from public.ips where id=(good).ip_id),
      'categoryId',(good).category_id,'categoryName',(select name from public.catalog_categories where id=(good).category_id),
      'imagePath',(good).image_path,'publishedAt',(good).published_at,'archivedAt',(good).archived_at,
      'createdAt',(good).created_at,'updatedAt',(good).updated_at,
      'stock',(good).stock,'stockQty',(good).stock_qty,'readiness',readiness
    ) order by position) from page),'[]')
  ) into result;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_goods_for_shipping_charge_group(p_query text, p_origin_id uuid, p_group_id uuid, p_page integer, p_expected_actor_id uuid, p_expected_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare total integer;result jsonb;begin
 perform private.require_shipping_charge_group_identity(p_expected_actor_id,p_expected_session_id);
 if p_query is null or char_length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 1000000 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_charge_group_search';end if;
 select count(*) into total from public.goods g join public.goods owner on owner.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(g.id)
 left join private.shipping_charge_group_assignments a on a.owner_good_id=owner.id
 where g.archived_at is null and (p_origin_id is null or owner.origin_id=p_origin_id) and (p_group_id is null or a.group_id=p_group_id)
  and position(lower(btrim(p_query)) in lower(g.id||' '||g.name||' '||coalesce(g.code,'')))>0;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(private.shipping_charge_group_good_row(g,a.group_id) order by g.updated_at desc,g.id),'[]') into result
 from (select g.id from public.goods g join public.goods owner on owner.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(g.id)
  left join private.shipping_charge_group_assignments a on a.owner_good_id=owner.id
  where g.archived_at is null and (p_origin_id is null or owner.origin_id=p_origin_id) and (p_group_id is null or a.group_id=p_group_id)
   and position(lower(btrim(p_query)) in lower(g.id||' '||g.name||' '||coalesce(g.code,'')))>0
  order by g.updated_at desc,g.id limit 20 offset (p_page-1)*20) page join public.goods g on g.id=page.id
 left join private.shipping_charge_group_assignments a on a.owner_good_id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(g.id);
 return jsonb_build_object('actorId',p_expected_actor_id,'sessionId',p_expected_session_id,'page',p_page,'pageSize',20,'total',total,'goods',result);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_goods_for_shipping_settings_v2(p_query text, p_page integer, p_expected_actor_id uuid, p_expected_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;pattern text;begin
 perform private.require_shipping_settings_identity(p_expected_actor_id,p_expected_session_id);
 if p_query is null or char_length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 100000 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipping_settings_filter';end if;
 pattern:='%'||replace(replace(replace(btrim(p_query),E'\\',E'\\\\'),'%',E'\\%'),'_',E'\\_')||'%';
 with matched as(select g.* from public.goods g where g.archived_at is null and (g.name ilike pattern escape E'\\' or g.code ilike pattern escape E'\\' or g.id ilike pattern escape E'\\')),
 page as(select * from matched order by updated_at desc,id limit 20 offset (p_page-1)*20)
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from matched),'page',p_page,'pageSize',20,'rows',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',page.id,'name',page.name,'code',page.code,'updatedAt',page.updated_at,'settings',private.good_shipping_settings(page),
  'templateId',page.shipping_settings_template_id,'templateRevision',page.shipping_settings_template_revision,'ownerGoodId',owner.id,
  'familyGoodIds',(private.shipping_settings_good_guard(page))->'familyGoodIds',
  'editable',owner.id=page.id,'blocker',case when owner.id<>page.id then 'goods_aggregation_policy_owned_by_source' else null end,
  'effective',private.shipping_settings_effective(private.good_shipping_settings(owner),private.shipping_settings_delivery_input(page.id))) order by page.updated_at desc,page.id),'[]'))
 into result from page join public.goods owner on owner.id=private.goods_aggregation_owner(page.id);
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_goods_for_shipping_settings_v3(p_query text, p_page integer, p_expected_actor_id uuid, p_expected_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;rows jsonb;begin
 result:=public.admin_search_goods_for_shipping_settings_v2(p_query,p_page,p_expected_actor_id,p_expected_session_id);
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(item.value||jsonb_build_object('effective',item.value->'effective'||jsonb_build_object('chargeGroup',private.shipping_settings_charge_summary(g),'fulfillment',private.goods_fulfillment_document(g.id,false))) order by item.ordinality),'[]')
 into rows from jsonb_array_elements(result->'rows') with ordinality item(value,ordinality)
 join public.goods g on g.id=item.value->>'id';
 return jsonb_set(result,'{rows}',rows);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_goods_group_console(p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 query text:=btrim(coalesce(p_filters->>'query','')); field text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'field','all');
 status text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'status','all'); date_field text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'dateField','created');
 filter_stock text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'stock','all'); shipping text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'shippingFee','all');
 sort_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'sort','created_desc'); filter_category_id uuid; filter_origin_id uuid; from_date date; to_date date;
 page integer:=coalesce((p_filters->>'page')::integer,1); page_size integer:=coalesce((p_filters->>'pageSize')::integer,50);
 result jsonb;
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;
 if jsonb_typeof(p_filters) is distinct from 'object' or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p_filters) k where k not in
 ('query','field','status','categoryId','dateField','from','to','stock','originId','shippingFee','sort','page','pageSize'))
 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_filters) e where jsonb_typeof(e.value) not in ('string','number','null'))
 or char_length(query)>100 or field not in ('all','goodId','groupId','code','name','maker') or status not in ('all','published','draft','archived')
 or date_field not in ('created','updated') or filter_stock not in ('all','available','soldout') or shipping not in ('all','free','paid')
 or sort_value not in ('created_desc','updated_desc','name_asc') or page not between 1 and 100000 or page_size not in (20,50,100)
 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_filters'; end if;
 filter_category_id:=nullif(p_filters->>'categoryId','')::uuid; filter_origin_id:=nullif(p_filters->>'originId','')::uuid;
 if nullif(p_filters->>'from','') is not null and p_filters->>'from' !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'
 or nullif(p_filters->>'to','') is not null and p_filters->>'to' !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_dates'; end if;
 from_date:=nullif(p_filters->>'from','')::date; to_date:=nullif(p_filters->>'to','')::date;
 if from_date>to_date then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_dates'; end if;
 with recursive categories as (
  select c.id from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=filter_category_id
  union all select c.id from public.catalog_categories c join categories p on c.parent_id=p.id
 ), matched as materialized (
  select g.*,c.name category_name,
   case when g.archived_at is not null then 'archived'
    when exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id
      where m.group_id=g.id and good.published_at is not null and good.archived_at is null) then 'published' else 'draft' end group_status
  from private.goods_groups g join public.goods common on common.id=g.common_good_id left join public.catalog_categories c on c.id=common.category_id
  where (from_date is null or (case date_field when 'created' then g.created_at else g.updated_at end)>=(from_date::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (to_date is null or (case date_field when 'created' then g.created_at else g.updated_at end)<((to_date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and (filter_category_id is null or common.category_id in(select id from categories))
   and (query='' or field in ('all','name') and position(lower(query) in lower(g.name))>0
    or field in ('all','groupId') and position(lower(query) in lower(g.id::text))>0
    or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id where m.group_id=g.id and (
      field='all' and position(lower(query) in lower(concat_ws(' ',good.id,good.code,good.name,good.notice_maker)))>0
      or field='goodId' and position(lower(query) in lower(good.id))>0
      or field='code' and position(lower(query) in lower(coalesce(good.code,'')))>0
      or field='maker' and position(lower(query) in lower(coalesce(good.notice_maker,'')))>0)))
   and (filter_origin_id is null or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id where m.group_id=g.id and good.origin_id=filter_origin_id))
   and (filter_stock='all' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods_variants v on v.id=m.variant_id
     where m.group_id=g.id and v.archived_at is null and case filter_stock when 'available' then v.stock_qty>0 else v.stock_qty=0 end))
   and (shipping='all' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members m join public.goods good on good.id=m.good_id
     where m.group_id=g.id and case shipping when 'free' then good.shipping_fee_type='free' else good.shipping_fee_type<>'free' end))
 ), selected as materialized(select * from matched m where status='all' or m.group_status=status),
 paged as (select * from selected s order by case when sort_value='created_desc' then s.created_at end desc,
   case when sort_value='updated_desc' then s.updated_at end desc,case when sort_value='name_asc' then s.name end,s.id
   limit page_size offset (page::bigint-1)*page_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.goods_group_snapshot(p.id) order by
   case when sort_value='created_desc' then p.created_at end desc,case when sort_value='updated_desc' then p.updated_at end desc,
   case when sort_value='name_asc' then p.name end,p.id) from paged p),'[]'),
  'total',(select count(*) from selected),'page',page,'pageSize',page_size,
  'counts',jsonb_build_object('all',(select count(*) from matched),'published',(select count(*) from matched where group_status='published'),
   'draft',(select count(*) from matched where group_status='draft'),'archived',(select count(*) from matched where group_status='archived')),
  'metadata',coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(p.id,jsonb_build_object('createdAt',p.created_at,'updatedAt',p.updated_at,'category',p.category_name)) from paged p),'{}')) into result;
 return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_goods(search_text text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS SETOF public.goods
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  needle text := btrim(coalesce(search_text, ''));
  pattern text;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'admin_only';
  end if;
  if length(needle) > 100 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'goods_search_too_long';
  end if;
  pattern := '%' || replace(replace(replace(needle, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'), '_', E'\\_') || '%';
  return query
    select good.*
    from public.goods good
    where needle = ''
      or good.name ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or coalesce(good.name_en, '') ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or good.code ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or good.id ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      or good.product_no::text = needle
      or exists (
        select 1 from unnest(good.search_keywords) as item(keyword)
        where item.keyword ilike pattern escape E'\\'
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.goods_variants variant
        left join private.goods_variant_external_identity external_identity
          on external_identity.variant_id = variant.id
        where variant.good_id = good.id
          and (
            variant.code ilike pattern escape E'\\'
            or external_identity.erp_code ilike pattern escape E'\\'
            or external_identity.erp_name ilike pattern escape E'\\'
            or external_identity.barcode ilike pattern escape E'\\'
          )
      );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_inquiries(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_category text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_field text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, reference bigint, category text, title text, status text, user_id uuid, buyer_name text, buyer_email text, order_id uuid, good_id text, good_name text, handled_by uuid, handler_name text, created_at timestamp with time zone, last_message_at timestamp with time zone, answered_at timestamp with time zone, closed_at timestamp with time zone, message_count bigint, total_count bigint, assignee_id uuid, assignee_name text, waiting_since timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_field text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_field, '')), ''), 'all');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';
  end if;

  if p_status is not null and p_status not in ('open', 'answered', 'closed') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_inquiry_status_filter';
  end if;
  if p_category is not null
    and p_category not in ('order', 'claim', 'good', 'account', 'etc')
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_inquiry_category_filter';
  end if;
  if v_field not in ('all', 'title', 'buyer', 'order') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_inquiry_search_field';
  end if;
  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_inquiry_date_range';
  end if;
  if v_query is not null and char_length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'inquiry_search_query_too_long';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    thread.id,
    thread.reference,
    thread.category,
    thread.title,
    thread.status,
    thread.user_id,
    buyer.nickname as buyer_name,
    buyer.email as buyer_email,
    case when public.has_operator_capability('sales.read') then thread.order_id else null::uuid end,
    thread.good_id,
    good.name as good_name,
    thread.handled_by,
    handler.nickname as handler_name,
    thread.created_at,
    thread.last_message_at,
    thread.answered_at,
    thread.closed_at,
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.inquiry_messages as message
      where message.inquiry_id = thread.id
    ) as message_count,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count,
    thread.assignee_id,
    case when assignee.id is null then null else
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(assignee.nickname), ''), '운영자_' || left(assignee.id::text, 6)) end,
    thread.waiting_since
  from public.inquiries as thread
  join public.profiles as buyer on buyer.id = thread.user_id
  left join public.profiles as handler on handler.id = thread.handled_by
  left join public.profiles as assignee on assignee.id = thread.assignee_id
  left join public.goods as good on good.id = thread.good_id
  where (p_status is null or thread.status = p_status)
    and (p_category is null or thread.category = p_category)
    and (
      p_from is null
      or thread.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or thread.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      v_query is null
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'title')
        and position(lower(v_query) in lower(thread.title)) > 0
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'buyer')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(buyer.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(buyer.email, ''))) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'order') and public.has_operator_capability('sales.read')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(thread.order_id::text, ''))) > 0
          or lower(v_query) = lower(thread.reference::text)
        )
      )
    )
  /* 미답변이 먼저, 그중에서도 오래 기다린 것이 위로. 종결은 맨 아래다. */
  order by
    case thread.status when 'open' then 0 when 'answered' then 1 else 2 end,
    case when thread.status = 'open' then thread.waiting_since else thread.last_message_at end,
    thread.id
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_members(target_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, target_limit integer DEFAULT 20, target_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(profile_id uuid, nickname text, masked_email text, role public.user_role, created_at timestamp with time zone, suspended_at timestamp with time zone, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  normalized_query text := nullif(
    pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(target_query, ''), E' \t\n\r\f\v'),
    ''
  );
  normalized_limit integer := least(
    greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 20), 1),
    100
  );
  normalized_offset integer := greatest(
    coalesce(target_offset, 0),
    0
  );
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'auth_required' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage',false) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if normalized_query is not null and pg_catalog.length(normalized_query) > 100 then
    raise exception 'member_search_query_too_long' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    profile.id,
    coalesce(
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(profile.nickname, E' \t\n\r\f\v'), ''),
      'fan_' || pg_catalog.left(profile.id::text, 6)
    ),
    case
      when nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(profile.email, '')), '') is null
        then '이메일 없음'::text
      when pg_catalog.strpos(profile.email, '@') > 1
        then pg_catalog.left(pg_catalog.split_part(profile.email, '@', 1), 1)
          || '***@'
          || pg_catalog.split_part(profile.email, '@', 2)
      else '***'::text
    end,
    profile.role,
    profile.created_at,
    profile.suspended_at,
    pg_catalog.count(*) over()::bigint
  from public.profiles as profile
  where normalized_query is null
    or pg_catalog.strpos(
      pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(profile.nickname, '')),
      pg_catalog.lower(normalized_query)
    ) > 0
    or pg_catalog.strpos(
      pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(profile.email, '')),
      pg_catalog.lower(normalized_query)
    ) > 0
  order by case when pg_catalog.lower(profile.email)=pg_catalog.lower(normalized_query) then 0 else 1 end,
    profile.created_at desc, profile.id desc
  limit normalized_limit
  offset normalized_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_order_claims(p_claim_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_stage text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_reason_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, reference bigint, order_id uuid, claim_type text, stage text, reason_type text, staff_reason_code text, buyer_id uuid, buyer_name text, buyer_email text, order_status public.order_status, order_total bigint, requested_at timestamp with time zone, collected_at timestamp with time zone, completed_at timestamp with time zone, refund_method text, handler_name text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
  v_stages text[];
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_claim_type is not null and p_claim_type not in ('cancel', 'return', 'exchange') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim type filter';
  end if;
  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim date range';
  end if;
  if v_query is not null and length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'claim search query too long';
  end if;
  -- 사유 필터: 구매자 사유(change_of_mind·defect), 운영자 전액 취소 전체(staff),
  -- 운영자 전액 취소의 사유 하나(staff:<사유 코드>). 모르는 값은 빈 목록이 아니라 거절한다.
  if p_reason_type is not null and p_reason_type not in (
    'change_of_mind', 'defect', 'staff',
    'staff:out_of_stock', 'staff:customer_request', 'staff:test_payment_cleanup', 'staff:other'
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid claim reason filter';
  end if;

  -- 'open'은 단계 하나가 아니라 "아직 끝나지 않은 것 전부"다. 화면이 이 집합을
  -- 직접 나열하면 단계를 하나 더할 때 목록에서만 조용히 빠진다.
  if p_stage = 'open' then
    v_stages := array[
      'requested', 'in_review', 'collecting', 'collected',
      'on_hold', 'processing', 'needs_review'
    ];
  elsif p_stage is not null then
    v_stages := array[p_stage];
  end if;

  return query
  select
    request.id,
    request.reference,
    request.order_id,
    request.claim_type,
    request.stage,
    request.reason_type,
    request.staff_reason_code,
    orders.user_id as buyer_id,
    profile.nickname as buyer_name,
    profile.email as buyer_email,
    orders.status as order_status,
    orders.total as order_total,
    request.requested_at,
    request.collected_at,
    request.completed_at,
    refund.method as refund_method,
    handler.nickname as handler_name,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
  join public.orders as orders on orders.id = request.order_id
  join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
  left join public.profiles as handler on handler.id = request.decided_by
  left join lateral (
    select payment_refund.method
    from public.refunds as payment_refund
    join public.payments as payment on payment.id = payment_refund.payment_id
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = request.order_id
    order by payment_refund.created_at desc, payment_refund.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as refund on true
  where (p_claim_type is null or request.claim_type = p_claim_type)
    and (v_stages is null or request.stage = any(v_stages))
    and (
      p_reason_type is null
      or (p_reason_type not like 'staff:%' and request.reason_type = p_reason_type)
      or (
        p_reason_type like 'staff:%'
        and request.reason_type = 'staff'
        and request.staff_reason_code = substr(p_reason_type, 7)
      )
    )
    and (
      p_from is null
      or request.requested_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or request.requested_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      v_query is null
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(request.order_id::text)) > 0
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(request.reference::text)) > 0
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.email, ''))) > 0
      or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.nickname, ''))) > 0
    )
  order by request.requested_at desc, request.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_order_items_console(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_field text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_date_field text DEFAULT 'ordered'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text, p_payment_method text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare needle text:=nullif(btrim(p_query),'');result jsonb;
begin
 if not private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'sales.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 500 or p_offset is null or p_offset not between 0 and 100000
  or p_field is null or p_field not in ('all','order','item','nickname','email','recipient','tracking','phone','product')
  or (p_status is not null and not exists(select 1 from unnest(enum_range(null::public.order_status))s where s::text=p_status))
 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_order_item_search';end if;
 perform private.admin_validate_sales_search(case when p_field='item' then 'order' else p_field end,p_date_field,p_sort,p_payment_method,p_from,p_to,needle);
 with base as materialized (
  select i.id item_id,o.id order_id,o.status,o.created_at,private.admin_sales_order_date(o,p_date_field) selected_at,
   private.order_item_active_qty(i.id) qty,i.unit_price,private.order_item_active_qty(i.id)::bigint*i.unit_price::bigint amount,
   jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'productOrderNumber',i.product_order_number,'orderId',o.id,'orderNumber',o.order_number,'userId',o.user_id,'buyerName',coalesce(p.nickname,'이름 미등록'),
    'recipientName',private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'recipientName','status',o.status,'createdAt',o.created_at,
    'goodId',i.good_id,'goodName',i.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',i.variant_name_snapshot,'variantCode',i.variant_code_snapshot,
    'customInputs',i.custom_inputs_snapshot,'qty',i.qty,'unitPrice',i.unit_price,'itemAmount',i.qty::bigint*i.unit_price::bigint,
    'shipmentId',shipment.id,'shipmentStatus',shipment.status,'originName',shipment.origin_name_snapshot,
    'trackingNumber',shipment.tracking_number,'carrierLabel',coalesce(carrier.label,shipment.carrier),
    'claim',case when claim.id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id',claim.id,'type',claim.claim_type,'stage',claim.stage) end) || private.order_item_partial_cancel_console_fields(i.id) document
  from public.order_items i join public.orders o on o.id=i.order_id join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id
  left join public.order_shipment_items mapping on mapping.order_item_id=i.id and mapping.order_id=o.id
  left join public.order_shipments shipment on shipment.id=mapping.shipment_id and shipment.order_id=o.id
  left join public.shipping_carriers carrier on carrier.code=shipment.carrier
  left join lateral (select c.id,c.claim_type,c.stage from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id order by c.requested_at desc,c.id desc limit 1)claim on true
  where (p_payment_method is null or o.payment_method::text=p_payment_method)
   and (p_from is null or private.admin_sales_order_date(o,p_date_field)>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
   and (p_to is null or private.admin_sales_order_date(o,p_date_field)<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
   and (needle is null
    or (p_field in ('all','order') and (strpos(lower(o.id::text),lower(needle))>0 or strpos(o.order_number,needle)>0))
    or (p_field in ('all','item') and (strpos(lower(i.id::text),lower(needle))>0 or strpos(i.product_order_number,needle)>0))
    or (p_field in ('all','nickname') and strpos(lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')),lower(needle))>0)
    or (p_field in ('all','email') and strpos(lower(coalesce(p.email,'')),lower(needle))>0)
    or (p_field in ('all','recipient') and strpos(lower(coalesce(private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'recipientName','')),lower(needle))>0)
    or (p_field in ('all','phone') and strpos(regexp_replace(coalesce(private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'phone',''),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),nullif(regexp_replace(needle,'[[:space:]-]','','g'),''))>0)
    or (p_field in ('all','tracking') and strpos(lower(coalesce(shipment.tracking_number,'')),nullif(regexp_replace(lower(needle),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),''))>0)
    or (p_field in ('all','tracking') and shipment.id is not null and exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_extra_trackings extra where extra.shipment_id=shipment.id
      and strpos(lower(extra.tracking_number),nullif(regexp_replace(lower(needle),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),''))>0))
    or (p_field in ('all','product') and (strpos(lower(i.good_name_snapshot),lower(needle))>0
     or strpos(lower(coalesce(i.variant_name_snapshot,'')),lower(needle))>0
     or strpos(lower(coalesce(i.variant_code_snapshot,'')),lower(needle))>0 or strpos(lower(i.good_id),lower(needle))>0)))
 ), filtered as materialized(select * from base where p_status is null or status::text=p_status),
 page as (select *,row_number() over(order by
   case when p_sort='amount_high' then amount end desc nulls last,
   case when p_sort='amount_low' then amount end asc nulls last,
   case when p_sort='oldest' then selected_at end asc nulls last,
   case when p_sort<>'oldest' then selected_at end desc nulls last,
   case when p_sort='oldest' then order_id end asc,order_id desc,item_id) ordinal
  from filtered order by ordinal limit p_limit offset p_offset)
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from filtered),'orderCount',(select count(distinct order_id) from filtered),
  'qty',(select coalesce(sum(qty),0) from filtered),
  'fingerprint',(select md5(coalesce(string_agg(document::text,'' order by item_id),'')) from filtered),
  'counts',(select jsonb_object_agg(s::text,(select count(*) from base b where b.status=s)) from unnest(enum_range(null::public.order_status))s),
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(document order by ordinal) from page),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, user_id uuid, buyer_name text, buyer_email text, status public.order_status, total bigint, address jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, shipping_carrier text, tracking_number text, confirmed_at timestamp with time zone, shipped_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone, done_at timestamp with time zone, cancellation_request_id uuid, cancellation_request_status text, cancellation_reason_type text, cancellation_requested_at timestamp with time zone, cancellation_decided_at timestamp with time zone, cancellation_decision_note text, cancellation_claim_type text, cancellation_stage text, cancellation_staff_reason_code text, cancellation_last_error_code text, total_count bigint, order_number text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
      begin
        if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
        return query select source.id,source.user_id,source.buyer_name,source.buyer_email,source.status,source.total,source.address,source.created_at,source.updated_at,source.shipping_carrier,source.tracking_number,source.confirmed_at,source.shipped_at,source.delivered_at,source.done_at,source.cancellation_request_id,source.cancellation_request_status,source.cancellation_reason_type,source.cancellation_requested_at,source.cancellation_decided_at,source.cancellation_decision_note,source.cancellation_claim_type,source.cancellation_stage,source.cancellation_staff_reason_code,source.cancellation_last_error_code,source.total_count,purchase.order_number from private.admin_search_orders_console_before_numbers(p_status,p_from,p_to,p_query,p_limit,p_offset,p_confirmed_before,p_field,p_date_field,p_sort,p_payment_method) with ordinality source
