CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_orders(p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_confirmed_before timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_field text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, user_id uuid, buyer_name text, buyer_email text, status public.order_status, total bigint, address jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, shipping_carrier text, tracking_number text, confirmed_at timestamp with time zone, shipped_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone, done_at timestamp with time zone, cancellation_request_id uuid, cancellation_request_status text, cancellation_reason_type text, cancellation_requested_at timestamp with time zone, cancellation_decided_at timestamp with time zone, cancellation_decision_note text, cancellation_claim_type text, cancellation_stage text, cancellation_staff_reason_code text, cancellation_last_error_code text, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
  v_field text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_field), ''), 'all');
  -- 운송장 입력은 저장 시 하이픈·공백을 제거한다. 고객이 택배사에서
  -- 복사한 표기(1234-5678)를 그대로 붙여도 같은 배송 건을 찾게 한다.
  v_tracking_query text := nullif(
    regexp_replace(lower(coalesce(p_query, '')), '[[:space:]-]', '', 'g'),
    ''
  );
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 100);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.read',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  if p_status is not null
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(enum_range(null::public.order_status)) as allowed(value)
      where allowed.value::text = p_status
    )
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order status filter';
  end if;

  if v_field not in ('all', 'order', 'nickname', 'email', 'recipient', 'tracking') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order search field';
  end if;

  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid order date range';
  end if;

  if v_query is not null and length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'order search query too long';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    orders.id,
    orders.user_id,
    profile.nickname as buyer_name,
    profile.email as buyer_email,
    orders.status,
    orders.total,
    private.operational_order_address(orders.id),
    orders.created_at,
    orders.updated_at,
    (select max(s.carrier)
     from public.order_shipments as s
     where s.order_id = orders.id
     having count(*) = 1),
    (select max(s.tracking_number)
     from public.order_shipments as s
     where s.order_id = orders.id
     having count(*) = 1),
    orders.confirmed_at,
    orders.shipped_at,
    orders.delivered_at,
    orders.done_at,
    cancellation.id as cancellation_request_id,
    cancellation.status as cancellation_request_status,
    cancellation.reason_type as cancellation_reason_type,
    cancellation.requested_at as cancellation_requested_at,
    cancellation.decided_at as cancellation_decided_at,
    cancellation.decision_note as cancellation_decision_note,
    cancellation.claim_type as cancellation_claim_type,
    cancellation.stage as cancellation_stage,
    cancellation.staff_reason_code as cancellation_staff_reason_code,
    cancellation.last_error_code as cancellation_last_error_code,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.orders as orders
  join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
  left join lateral (
    select
      request.id,
      request.status,
      request.reason_type,
      request.requested_at,
      request.decided_at,
      request.decision_note,
      request.claim_type,
      request.stage,
      request.staff_reason_code,
      request.last_error_code
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = orders.id
    order by request.requested_at desc, request.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as cancellation on true
  where (p_status is null or orders.status::text = p_status)
    and (
      p_from is null
      or orders.created_at >= (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    and (
      p_to is null
      or orders.created_at < ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    )
    -- 발주확인 기록이 없는 주문은 지연 목록에 넣지 않는다.
    and (p_confirmed_before is null or orders.confirmed_at < p_confirmed_before)
    and (
      v_query is null
      or (
        v_field = 'all'
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(orders.id::text)) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(profile.email, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(private.operational_order_address(orders.id) ->> 'recipientName', ''))) > 0
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.order_shipments as shipment
            where shipment.order_id = orders.id
              and position(v_tracking_query in lower(coalesce(shipment.tracking_number, ''))) > 0
          )
        )
      )

AS $function$

  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff_required';

  if p_status is not null and p_status not in ('visible', 'hidden') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_status_filter';
  end if;
  if p_rating is not null and p_rating not between 1 and 5 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_rating_filter';
  end if;
  if v_field not in ('all', 'good', 'author', 'body') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_search_field';
  end if;
  if v_sort not in ('recent', 'oldest', 'rating_desc', 'rating_asc', 'good_name_asc', 'photo_count_desc') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_sort';
  end if;
  if p_from is not null and p_to is not null and p_from > p_to then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_date_range';
  end if;
  if v_query is not null and char_length(v_query) > 100 then
    raise check_violation using message = 'review_search_query_too_long';

  if p_best is null or p_best not in ('all','selected','not_selected','needs_review') then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_best_review_filter';end if;

    good.name as good_name,
    review.order_id,
    review.user_id,

      nullif(btrim(coalesce(author.nickname, '')), ''),
      'fan_' || left(review.user_id::text, 6)

    author.email as author_email,
    review.rating,
    review.body,
    review.image_paths,
    review.status,
    review.hidden_reason,
    review.hidden_at,
    review.admin_reply,

      p_has_photo is null
      or (p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) > 0)
      or (not p_has_photo and coalesce(cardinality(review.image_paths),0) = 0)
    )
    and (
      p_has_reply is null
      or (p_has_reply and review.admin_reply is not null)

      p_from is null

    and (
      v_query is null

          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.good_id)) > 0

      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'author')
        and (
          position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.nickname, ''))) > 0
          or position(lower(v_query) in lower(coalesce(author.email, ''))) > 0
        )
      )
      or (
        v_field in ('all', 'body')
        and position(lower(v_query) in lower(review.body)) > 0
      )
    )
  order by
    case when v_sort = 'good_name_asc' then good.name end asc nulls last,

    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'oldest' then review.created_at end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;

 if (p_delay_notice_status is not null and p_delay_notice_status not in ('sent','partial_failed','pending','unknown','not_sent'))
   or p_field is null or p_field not in ('all','order','shipment','buyer','recipient','tracking','product')
   or p_date_field is null or p_date_field not in ('ordered','paid','confirmed','shipped','delivered')
   or (p_method is not null and p_method not in ('parcel','quick','pickup','direct','freight','none','digital'))
   or (p_payment_method is not null and p_payment_method not in ('card','bank_transfer'))
   or p_sort is null or p_sort not in ('newest','oldest','amount_high','amount_low') then
   raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shipment_search';end if;
 with matched as materialized (
  select s.*,private.shipment_delay_notice_summary(s.id) delay_notice_summary,basis.search_at,o.user_id,o.created_at order_created_at,o.order_number,o.confirmed_at,o.total,o.status order_status,
   coalesce(nullif(p.nickname,''),'fan_'||left(o.user_id::text,6)) buyer_name,private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'recipientName' recipient_name,
   o.payment_method,coalesce((select change.reason from private.order_shipment_promise_changes change where change.shipment_id=s.id order by change.created_at desc,change.id limit 1),delay.reason) delay_reason,
   coalesce(s.expected_ship_date,delay.expected_ship_date) delay_expected_date,
   o.status='paid' and s.status='ready' is_new,
   o.status in ('confirmed','shipping') and s.status='ready' is_ready,
   o.status in ('confirmed','shipping') and s.status='ready' and case when s.original_expected_ship_date is not null
     then s.expected_ship_date<(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
     else o.confirmed_at<now()-interval '3 days' end is_delayed,
   o.status<>'canceled' and s.status='shipping' is_transit,
   o.status<>'canceled' and s.status='delivered' is_delivered
  from public.order_shipments s join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
  left join public.profiles p on p.id=o.user_id left join public.order_dispatch_delays delay on delay.order_id=o.id
  cross join lateral (select case p_date_field when 'shipped' then s.shipped_at when 'delivered' then s.delivered_at
   else private.admin_sales_order_date(o,p_date_field) end search_at) basis
  where (p_origin_id is null or s.origin_id=p_origin_id)
    and (p_method is null or s.delivery_method=p_method)
    and (p_payment_method is null or o.payment_method::text=p_payment_method)
    and (p_from is null or basis.search_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    and (p_to is null or basis.search_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')
    and (needle is null
      or (p_field in ('all','shipment') and (position(lower(needle) in s.id::text)>0 or position(needle in s.shipment_number)>0))
      or (p_field in ('all','order') and (position(lower(needle) in o.id::text)>0 or position(needle in o.order_number)>0))
      or ((select public.has_operator_capability('sales.read',false)) and (p_field in ('all','buyer') and (position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(p.nickname,'')))>0 or position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(p.email,'')))>0)))
      or (p_field in ('all','recipient') and position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(private.operational_order_address(o.id)->>'recipientName','')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','tracking') and position(nullif(regexp_replace(lower(needle),'[[:space:]-]','','g'),'') in lower(coalesce(s.tracking_number,'')))>0)
      or (p_field in ('all','product') and exists(select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id
        where link.shipment_id=s.id and (position(lower(needle) in lower(i.good_name_snapshot))>0 or position(lower(needle) in lower(coalesce(i.variant_name_snapshot,'')))>0))))
 ), notice_matched as materialized (
  select * from matched where p_delay_notice_status is null or delay_notice_summary->>'status'=p_delay_notice_status
 ), filtered as materialized (
  select * from notice_matched where case p_tab when 'new' then is_new when 'ready' then is_ready when 'delayed' then is_delayed when 'transit' then is_transit else is_delivered end
 ), ranked as (
 select *,row_number() over(order by
  case when p_sort='amount_high' then total end desc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='amount_low' then total end asc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='oldest' then search_at end asc nulls last,
  case when p_sort<>'oldest' then search_at end desc nulls last,
  case when p_sort='oldest' then id end asc,id desc) display_order from filtered
 ), page as (select * from ranked order by display_order limit p_limit offset p_offset), output as (
 select page.*,coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'productOrderNumber',i.product_order_number,'name',i.good_name_snapshot,'variantName',i.variant_name_snapshot,'qty',link.qty) order by i.id)
  from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id where link.shipment_id=page.id),'[]') items from page
 ) select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from filtered),'counts',(select jsonb_build_object(
   'new',count(*) filter(where is_new),'ready',count(*) filter(where is_ready),'delayed',count(*) filter(where is_delayed),
   'transit',count(*) filter(where is_transit),'delivered',count(*) filter(where is_delivered)) from notice_matched),
   'delayNoticeFingerprint',(select encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'notice',delay_notice_summary) order by id)::text,'[]'),'sha256'),'hex') from filtered),
   'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'orderId',order_id,'orderNumber',order_number,'shipmentNumber',shipment_number,'originId',origin_id,'originName',origin_name_snapshot,
    'status',status,'createdAt',order_created_at,'confirmedAt',confirmed_at,'buyerName',buyer_name,'recipientName',recipient_name,
    'total',total,'paymentMethod',payment_method,'shippingFee',shipping_fee,'carrier',carrier,'trackingNumber',tracking_number,
    'shippedAt',shipped_at,'deliveredAt',delivered_at,'exportedAt',exported_at,'updatedAt',updated_at,
    'delayReason',delay_reason,'expectedShipDate',delay_expected_date,'originalExpectedShipDate',original_expected_ship_date,
    'preorderReady',private.shipment_preorder_allocation_ready(id),'delayNotice',delay_notice_summary,'items',private.with_order_item_custom_inputs(items),'delivery',private.shipment_delivery_summary(id)) order by display_order) from output),'[]')) into result;
 return private.shipment_console_for_reader(result);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_shopping_story_goods_filtered(p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
 field_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'field','all'); category_value uuid;
 visibility_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'visibility','all'); stock_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'stock','all');
 sale_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'saleType','all'); reviews_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'reviews','all');
 sort_value text:=coalesce(p_filters->>'sort','latest'); rating_value numeric;
 free_value boolean; discount_value boolean;
 min_value bigint; max_value bigint; query_value text:=lower(btrim(p_query)); result_value jsonb;
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('store.manage') then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_query is null or char_length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 1000000
  or jsonb_typeof(p_filters) is distinct from 'object'
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(p_filters) k where k not in ('field','categoryId','visibility','stock','saleType','reviews','sort','minRating','freeShipping','discounted','minPrice','maxPrice'))
  or exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(p_filters) e where case
    when e.key in ('field','visibility','stock','saleType','reviews','sort') then jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'string'
    when e.key='categoryId' then jsonb_typeof(e.value) not in ('string','null')
    when e.key in ('freeShipping','discounted') then jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'boolean'
    when e.key='minRating' then jsonb_typeof(e.value)<>'number'
    else jsonb_typeof(e.value) not in ('number','null') end)
  or field_value not in ('all','name','code','id') or visibility_value not in ('all','published','draft')
  or stock_value not in ('all','available','soldout') or sale_value not in ('all','stock','preorder')
  or reviews_value not in ('all','with','without') or sort_value not in ('latest','popular','sales','reviews','rating','price_asc','price_desc','name')
 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shopping_story_goods_filter';end if;
 rating_value:=coalesce((p_filters->>'minRating')::numeric,0);
 free_value:=coalesce((p_filters->>'freeShipping')::boolean,false);discount_value:=coalesce((p_filters->>'discounted')::boolean,false);
 if rating_value not in (0,3,4,4.5) or (p_filters->>'categoryId') is not null and (p_filters->>'categoryId') !~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shopping_story_goods_filter';end if;
 category_value:=(p_filters->>'categoryId')::uuid;
 if (p_filters->>'minPrice') is not null and (p_filters->>'minPrice') !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
  or (p_filters->>'maxPrice') is not null and (p_filters->>'maxPrice') !~ '^[0-9]{1,9}$'
 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shopping_story_goods_filter';end if;
 min_value:=(p_filters->>'minPrice')::bigint;max_value:=(p_filters->>'maxPrice')::bigint;
 if min_value>100000000 or max_value>100000000 or min_value>max_value then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_shopping_story_goods_filter';end if;
 with recursive categories as (
   select c.id,c.name::text path,c.sort_order::text||':'||c.name||':'||c.id::text sort_path from public.catalog_categories c where c.parent_id is null and c.archived_at is null
   union all select c.id,p.path||' > '||c.name,p.sort_path||'/'||c.sort_order::text||':'||c.name||':'||c.id::text from public.catalog_categories c join categories p on c.parent_id=p.id where c.archived_at is null
 ), descendants as (
   select c.id from public.catalog_categories c where c.id=category_value and c.archived_at is null
   union all select c.id from public.catalog_categories c join descendants p on c.parent_id=p.id where c.archived_at is null
 ), base as materialized (
   select g as good,g.id,g.name,g.created_at,ip.published_at is not null as ip_published,
    g.published_at is not null and ip.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none' as is_published
   from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id
   where g.archived_at is null and ip.archived_at is null
    and (category_value is null or g.category_id in (select id from descendants)
      or exists(select 1 from public.goods_additional_categories extra where extra.good_id=g.id and extra.category_id in (select id from descendants)))
    and (query_value='' or position(query_value in lower(case field_value when 'name' then g.name when 'code' then g.code when 'id' then g.id else g.name||' '||g.code||' '||g.id end))>0)
 ), eligible as materialized (
   select b.*,coalesce(s.price,(b.good).price) as current_price,coalesce(s.available,0) as available,
    coalesce(s.available,0)<=0 as sold_out,coalesce(s.preorder,false) as preorder,
    coalesce(s.discounted,false) or coalesce((b.good).compare_at_price>(b.good).price,false) as discounted,
    (private.calculate_goods_shipping(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('origin_id',(b.good).origin_id,'good_id',b.id,'qty',1,
     'unit_price',coalesce(s.price,(b.good).price),'fee_type',(b.good).shipping_fee_type,'individual_fee',(b.good).individual_fee)))->>'totalFee')::bigint=0 as free_shipping
   from base b cross join lateral (
    select min(price.effective_price) price,sum(supply.available_qty) available,bool_or(v.preorder_policy_id is not null) preorder,
     bool_or(price.effective_price<price.regular_price) discounted
    from public.goods_variants v
    cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_variant_price(v.id,statement_timestamp()) price
    cross join lateral private.resolve_goods_variant_supply(v.id,statement_timestamp()) supply
    where v.good_id=b.id and v.archived_at is null
   ) s
   where visibility_value='all' or b.is_published=(visibility_value='published')
 ), review_metrics as (
   select r.good_id,count(*) review_count,avg(r.rating)::numeric rating_average from public.reviews r join eligible g on g.id=r.good_id where r.status='visible' group by r.good_id
 ), wishes as (
   select w.good_id,count(*) wish_count from public.wishlists w join eligible g on g.id=w.good_id group by w.good_id
 ), paid_orders as materialized (
   -- Same evidence and completed cancel/return exclusions as get_home_sales_rankings.
   select o.id,min(approval.approved_at) approved_at
   from public.orders o
   join public.payments p on p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.status='paid' and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.amount=o.total
   join public.payment_attempts a on a.payment_id=p.id and a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id and a.state='approved' and a.amount=p.amount and a.provider=p.provider and a.user_id=o.user_id
   cross join lateral (select coalesce(
    (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
    (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id and a.provider='bank_transfer')) approved_at) approval
   where o.status in ('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done') and approval.approved_at is not null
    and exists(select 1 from public.order_items item join eligible g on g.id=item.good_id where item.order_id=o.id)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id and c.claim_type in ('cancel','return') and (c.status='completed' or c.stage='completed'))
   group by o.id
 ), sales as (
   select item.good_id,sum(item.qty::bigint) quantity from paid_orders p join public.order_items item on item.order_id=p.id join eligible g on g.id=item.good_id
   where p.approved_at>=statement_timestamp()-interval '30 days' and p.approved_at<statement_timestamp() group by item.good_id
 ), filtered as materialized (
   select g.*,coalesce(r.review_count,0) review_count,r.rating_average,coalesce(w.wish_count,0) wish_count,coalesce(s.quantity,0) sales_quantity
   from eligible g left join review_metrics r on r.good_id=g.id left join wishes w on w.good_id=g.id left join sales s on s.good_id=g.id
   where (stock_value='all' or g.sold_out=(stock_value='soldout')) and (sale_value='all' or g.preorder=(sale_value='preorder'))
    and (not free_value or g.free_shipping) and (not discount_value or g.discounted)
    and (reviews_value='all' or (coalesce(r.review_count,0)>0)=(reviews_value='with'))
    and (rating_value=0 or r.rating_average>=rating_value)
    and (min_value is null or g.current_price>=min_value) and (max_value is null or g.current_price<=max_value)
 ), ranked as (
   select f.*,row_number() over(order by
    case when sort_value='popular' then wish_count end desc,
    case when sort_value in ('sales','popular') then sales_quantity end desc,
    case when sort_value='sales' then wish_count end desc,
    case when sort_value='reviews' then review_count end desc,
    case when sort_value in ('reviews','rating') then rating_average end desc nulls last,
    case when sort_value='rating' then review_count end desc,
    case when sort_value='price_asc' then current_price end asc,
    case when sort_value='price_desc' then current_price end desc,
    case when sort_value='name' then name end asc,created_at desc,id) position from filtered f
 ), page as (select * from ranked order by position limit 20 offset (p_page-1)*20)
 select jsonb_build_object('page',p_page,'pageSize',20,'checkedAt',statement_timestamp(),'total',(select count(*) from filtered),
  'categories',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'path',path) order by sort_path) from categories),'[]'::jsonb),
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.shopping_story_admin_good(p.good,p.ip_published,false)||jsonb_build_object(
   'reviewCount',review_count,'ratingAverage',round(rating_average,2),'wishCount',wish_count,'salesQuantity',sales_quantity,
   'freeShipping',free_shipping,'discounted',discounted,'saleType',case when preorder then 'preorder' else 'stock' end) order by position) from page p),'[]'::jsonb)) into result_value;
 return result_value;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_store_credit_console(p_mode text DEFAULT 'batches'::text, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_kind text DEFAULT ''::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb; query text:=btrim(coalesce(p_query,''));
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('marketing.manage',true) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

 perform private.assert_store_credit_admin();
 if p_mode is null or p_mode not in ('batches','ledger') or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 100000 or p_page_size is null or p_page_size not in (20,50,100,10000) or length(query)>200 or p_from>p_to
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='store_credit_filters_invalid'; end if;
 with all_rows as (
  select b.id::text id,b.created_at,'batch' source,b.status kind,b.reason,b.amount,(b.result->>'count')::integer recipients,
   (b.result->>'gross')::bigint gross,coalesce((b.result->>'completedCount')::integer,0) completed,b.purpose,null::uuid user_id,null::uuid order_id,
   b.actor_id,b.id batch_id,null::bigint available_delta,null::bigint reserved_delta,null::bigint debt_delta,b.expires_at
   from private.store_credit_batches b where p_mode='batches'
  union all
  select o.operation_id::text,o.created_at,'individual','completed',o.payload->>'reason',(o.payload->>'amount')::bigint,1,(o.payload->>'amount')::bigint,1,'general',
   (o.payload->>'userId')::uuid,null::uuid,o.actor_id,null::uuid,null::bigint,null::bigint,null::bigint,(o.payload->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz
   from private.store_credit_operations o where p_mode='batches' and o.kind='adjustment' and (o.payload->>'amount')::bigint>0
   and not exists(select 1 from private.store_credit_batch_recipients r where r.operation_id=o.operation_id)
  union all
  select l.id::text,l.created_at,'ledger',l.kind,l.reason,l.amount,1,l.amount,1,'',l.user_id,l.order_id,l.actor_id,r.batch_id,l.available_delta,l.reserved_delta,l.debt_delta,l.expires_at
   from public.store_credit_ledger l left join private.store_credit_batch_recipients r on r.operation_id=l.operation_id where p_mode='ledger'
 ), filtered as (
  select a.*,coalesce(p.nickname,'') nickname,case when position('@' in p.email)>0 then left(p.email,1)||'***@'||split_part(p.email,'@',2) else '' end masked_email
  from all_rows a left join public.profiles p on p.id=a.user_id
  where (p_from is null or a.created_at>=(p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'))
   and(p_to is null or a.created_at<((p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')) and(coalesce(p_kind,'')='' or a.kind=p_kind)
   and(query='' or a.id=query or a.user_id::text=query or a.order_id::text=query or a.batch_id::text=query or lower(p.email)=lower(query)
    or position(lower(query) in lower(a.reason))>0 or position(lower(query) in lower(p.nickname))>0
    or (p_mode='batches' and exists(select 1 from private.store_credit_batch_recipients r join public.profiles c on c.id=r.user_id
     where r.batch_id=a.batch_id and(c.id::text=query or lower(c.email)=lower(query) or position(lower(query) in lower(c.nickname))>0))))
 ), paged as (select * from filtered order by created_at desc,id desc limit p_page_size offset (p_page-1)*p_page_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from filtered),'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'id',id,'createdAt',created_at,'source',source,'kind',kind,'reason',reason,'amount',amount,'recipients',recipients,'gross',gross,'completed',completed,'purpose',purpose,
  'userId',user_id,'orderId',order_id,'actorId',actor_id,'batchId',batch_id,'availableDelta',available_delta,'reservedDelta',reserved_delta,'debtDelta',debt_delta,'expiresAt',expires_at,'nickname',nickname,'maskedEmail',masked_email)
  order by created_at desc,id desc) from paged),'[]')) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_shipment_barcode_gaps(p_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], p_origin_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not coalesce(private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'sales.dispatch',false),false) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';
 end if;
 if (p_ids is null)=(p_origin_id is null) or cardinality(p_ids)>1000 or array_position(p_ids,null) is not null then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_export_selection';
 end if;
 -- 대상 배송 건을 행 집합으로 만들어 품목과 조인한다. 출고지 대기 건을 배열로 모아 = any()로 거르면
 -- 품목 행마다 배열 전체를 비교해 대기 3,000건에서 약 0.8초가 걸렸다.
 return (select count(distinct coalesce(i.variant_id::text,i.good_id||'/'||coalesce(i.variant_name_snapshot,'')))
  from (select unnest(p_ids) id where p_origin_id is null
   union all
   select pending.id from public.order_shipments pending join public.orders o on o.id=pending.order_id
   where p_origin_id is not null and pending.origin_id=p_origin_id and pending.status='ready' and pending.exported_at is null
    and pending.delivery_method='parcel' and o.status in('confirmed','shipping')) target
  join public.order_shipment_items link on link.shipment_id=target.id
  join public.order_shipments s on s.id=link.shipment_id
  join public.fulfillment_origins origin on origin.id=s.origin_id
  join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id
  left join private.order_item_external_identity_snapshots identity_snapshot on identity_snapshot.order_item_id=i.id
  left join private.goods_variant_external_identity identity_live on identity_live.variant_id=i.variant_id
  where (origin.export_template in('seowon_xlsx','wms_csv')
    or (origin.export_template='standard' and origin.export_columns @> '[{"key":"barcode"}]'::jsonb))
   and coalesce(identity_snapshot.barcode,identity_live.barcode) is null)::integer;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_shipment_collect_summaries(p_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.dispatch',false);
 if cardinality(p_ids) is null or cardinality(p_ids) not between 1 and 1000 or array_position(p_ids,null) is not null then raise invalid_parameter_value;end if;
 -- 착불이 없는 배송 건은 null, 없는 id는 키가 없다. 영수증 모양이 배열이 아니면 수납 정보만 null로 둔다(목록 전체를 깨지 않는다).
 return (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(s.id,case when s.shipping_collect_fee>0 then jsonb_build_object(
    'collectFee',s.shipping_collect_fee,
    'collector',(select group_value->'collector' from jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(t.original_receipt#>'{display,shipping}')='array'
       then t.original_receipt#>'{display,shipping}' else '[]'::jsonb end) group_value
      where group_value->>'originId'=s.origin_id::text and jsonb_typeof(group_value->'collector')='object' limit 1)) end),'{}'::jsonb)
  from public.order_shipments s left join private.order_goods_transactions t on t.order_id=s.order_id
  where s.id=any(p_ids));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_shipping_region_expiry_metadata(p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT statement_timestamp())
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if auth.uid() is null or not public.has_operator_capability('catalog.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff_required'; end if;
  if p_at is null or not isfinite(p_at) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_warning_time'; end if;
  with candidates as (
    select policy.id,policy.version,policy.starts_at,policy.ends_at,
      origin.id origin_id,origin.name origin_name,origin.default_carrier carrier_code,carrier.label carrier_label
    from public.fulfillment_origins origin
    join public.shipping_carriers carrier on carrier.code=origin.default_carrier and carrier.is_active
    cross join lateral (
      (select p.id,p.version,p.starts_at,p.ends_at from private.shipping_region_policies p
        where p.origin_id=origin.id and p.carrier_code=origin.default_carrier and p.status='active' and p.starts_at<=p_at
        order by p.starts_at desc,p.version desc limit 1)
      union all
      (select p.id,p.version,p.starts_at,p.ends_at from private.shipping_region_policies p
        where p.origin_id=origin.id and p.carrier_code=origin.default_carrier and p.status='active'
          and p.starts_at>p_at and p.ends_at<=p_at+interval '7 days')
    ) policy
    where origin.is_active
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',candidate.id,'name',policy.configuration->>'name','version',candidate.version,'status','active',
    'startsAt',candidate.starts_at,'endsAt',candidate.ends_at,'originId',candidate.origin_id,
    'originName',candidate.origin_name,'carrierCode',candidate.carrier_code,'carrierLabel',candidate.carrier_label
  ) order by candidate.ends_at,candidate.id),'[]'::jsonb) into result
  from candidates candidate join private.shipping_region_policies policy on policy.id=candidate.id
  where candidate.ends_at<=p_at+interval '7 days';
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_smartstore_shipment_barcode_gaps(p_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], p_origin_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not coalesce(private.has_operator_capability(auth.uid(),'sales.dispatch',false),false) then
  raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';
 end if;
 if (p_ids is null)=(p_origin_id is null) or cardinality(p_ids)>1000 or array_position(p_ids,null) is not null then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_export_selection';
 end if;
 -- 대상은 기존 경고와 같다: 고른 배송 건, 또는 출고지의 미전달 발송 대기 택배 건(주문 확정·배송 중).
 -- 같은 옵션은 한 번만 세고, 옵션이 지워진 품목은 상품·옵션 이름으로 센다. 값은 출고 파일과 같은 규칙(스냅샷 우선, 비면 지금 값)이다.
 return (select count(distinct coalesce(i.variant_id::text,i.good_id||'/'||coalesce(i.variant_name_snapshot,'')))
  from (select unnest(p_ids) id where p_origin_id is null
   union all
   select pending.id from public.order_shipments pending join public.orders o on o.id=pending.order_id
   where p_origin_id is not null and pending.origin_id=p_origin_id and pending.status='ready' and pending.exported_at is null
    and pending.delivery_method='parcel' and o.status in('confirmed','shipping')) target
  join public.order_shipment_items link on link.shipment_id=target.id
  join public.order_items i on i.id=link.order_item_id
  left join private.order_item_external_identity_snapshots identity_snapshot on identity_snapshot.order_item_id=i.id
  left join private.goods_variant_external_identity identity_live on identity_live.variant_id=i.variant_id
  where coalesce(identity_snapshot.barcode,identity_live.barcode) is null)::integer;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_smartstore_shipment_export(p_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  perform private.require_operator_capability('sales.dispatch',false);
  result:=public.admin_shipment_export(p_ids);
  if exists(
    select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(result->'shipments') shipment
    where jsonb_array_length(shipment->'lines')<>(select count(*) from public.order_shipment_items where shipment_id=(shipment->>'id')::uuid)
  ) or exists(
    select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items item on item.id=link.order_item_id
    where link.shipment_id=any(p_ids) and link.qty<>private.order_item_active_qty(item.id)
  ) then raise check_violation using message='shipment_item_export_mismatch';end if;
  if exists(
    select 1 from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items item on item.id=link.order_item_id
    join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=item.order_id
    left join private.order_price_allocations allocation on allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=purchase.id
    where link.shipment_id=any(p_ids) and purchase.calculation_version=2 and allocation.order_item_id is null
  ) then raise check_violation using message='shipment_price_allocation_missing';end if;

  return jsonb_set(result,'{shipments}',(
    select jsonb_agg(shipment.value||jsonb_build_object('lines',(
      select jsonb_agg(line.value||jsonb_build_object('smartstore',private.shipment_export_detail_for_reader(jsonb_build_object(
        'itemId',item.id,'productOrderNumber',item.product_order_number,'orderNumber',purchase.order_number,'shipmentNumber',delivery.shipment_number,'goodId',item.good_id,'goodType',item.good_type_snapshot,
        'buyerName',coalesce(profile.nickname,''),'buyerId',purchase.user_id,'buyerPhone','',
        'address1',coalesce(address.value->>'address1',''),'address2',coalesce(address.value->>'address2',''),
        'orderedAt',purchase.created_at,'paidAt',approval.approved_at,'confirmedAt',purchase.confirmed_at,
        'expectedShipDate',delivery.expected_ship_date,'shippedAt',delivery.shipped_at,'exportedAt',delivery.exported_at,
        'paymentMethod',purchase.payment_method,'productPrice',null,'optionPrice',null,
        'itemTotal',case when allocation.order_item_id is not null then allocation.paid_goods_total-(select c.paid_amount from private.order_item_partial_cancel_totals(item.id) c)
          when purchase.calculation_version=1 and purchase.discount_total=0 and purchase.store_credit_total=0 and purchase.volume_discount_total=0
            then item.unit_price::bigint*item.qty else null end,
        'itemDiscount',discount.value,'sellerDiscount',discount.value,
        'regionalShippingFee',shipping.regional_fee,'shippingDiscount',shipping.coupon_discount
      ),(select public.has_operator_capability('sales.read',false)))) order by line.ordinality)
      from jsonb_array_elements(shipment.value->'lines') with ordinality line(value,ordinality)
      join lateral(
        select original.*,row_number() over(order by original.id) as line_number
        from public.order_shipment_items link join public.order_items original on original.id=link.order_item_id
        where link.shipment_id=delivery.id
      ) item on item.line_number=line.ordinality
      left join private.order_price_allocation_ledger allocation on allocation.order_item_id=item.id and allocation.order_id=purchase.id
      cross join lateral(select case when item.regular_unit_price_snapshot>=item.unit_price then
        case when allocation.order_item_id is not null then
          (item.regular_unit_price_snapshot-item.unit_price)::bigint*private.order_item_active_qty(item.id)+allocation.volume_discount+allocation.coupon_discount+allocation.store_credit_discount
          -(select c.volume_discount+c.coupon_discount+c.store_credit_discount from private.order_item_partial_cancel_totals(item.id) c)
        when purchase.calculation_version=1 and purchase.discount_total=0 and purchase.store_credit_total=0 and purchase.volume_discount_total=0 then
          (item.regular_unit_price_snapshot-item.unit_price)::bigint*item.qty else null end
        else null end as value) discount
    )) order by shipment.ordinality)
    from jsonb_array_elements(result->'shipments') with ordinality shipment(value,ordinality)
    join public.order_shipments delivery on delivery.id=(shipment.value->>'id')::uuid
    join public.orders purchase on purchase.id=delivery.order_id
    left join public.profiles profile on profile.id=purchase.user_id
    cross join lateral(select private.operational_order_address(purchase.id) as value) address
    left join lateral(
      select min(coalesce(
        (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=attempt.id),
        (select confirmation.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations confirmation
          where confirmation.attempt_id=attempt.id and confirmation.order_id=purchase.id and attempt.provider='bank_transfer')
      )) as approved_at
      from public.payments payment join public.payment_attempts attempt on attempt.payment_id=payment.id
      where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=purchase.id and payment.status='paid'
        and payment.user_id=purchase.user_id and payment.amount=purchase.total
        and attempt.purpose='order' and attempt.ref_id=purchase.id and attempt.state='approved'
        and attempt.amount=payment.amount and attempt.provider=payment.provider and attempt.user_id=purchase.user_id
    ) approval on true
    left join lateral(
      select sum(component.regional_fee) as regional_fee,sum(component.shipping_coupon_discount) as coupon_discount
      from private.shipping_charge_components component where component.shipment_id=delivery.id and component.order_id=purchase.id
    ) shipping on true
  ));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_start_order_cancellation(p_order_id uuid, p_reason_code text, p_note text, p_warehouse_stop_confirmed boolean)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_order public.orders%rowtype;
  v_note text := nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_note, '')), '');
  v_request_id uuid;
  v_exported_count integer;
  v_payment_count integer;
  v_reason_label text;
  v_notice text;
begin
  perform private.require_actor_operator_capability(v_actor,'sales.manage',false);

  if p_reason_code is null
    or p_reason_code not in ('out_of_stock', 'customer_request', 'test_payment_cleanup', 'other')
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_staff_cancellation_reason';
  end if;

  if (v_note is not null and (
        char_length(v_note) > 500
        or pg_catalog.translate(v_note, E'\n\r\t', '') ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
      ))
    or (p_reason_code = 'other' and (v_note is null or char_length(v_note) < 5))
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_staff_cancellation_note';
  end if;

  -- 공통 잠금 순서: order → shipments → request → attempts → payments.
  select order_record.*
  into v_order
  from public.orders as order_record
  where order_record.id = p_order_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise no_data_found using message = 'order_not_found';
  end if;

  perform shipment.id
  from public.order_shipments as shipment
  where shipment.order_id = p_order_id
  order by shipment.id
  for update;

  if v_order.status not in ('paid', 'confirmed')
    or v_order.shipped_at is not null
    or v_order.delivered_at is not null
    or v_order.done_at is not null
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'order_not_staff_cancelable';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_shipments as shipment
    where shipment.order_id = p_order_id
      and (
        shipment.status not in ('ready', 'canceled')
        or shipment.shipped_at is not null
        or shipment.delivered_at is not null
      )
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'shipment_already_dispatched';
  end if;

  select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer
  into v_exported_count
  from public.order_shipments as shipment
  where shipment.order_id = p_order_id
    and shipment.status = 'ready'
    and shipment.exported_at is not null;

  if v_exported_count > 0 and p_warehouse_stop_confirmed is distinct from true then
    raise check_violation using message = 'warehouse_stop_confirmation_required';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.order_id = p_order_id
      and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  ) or exists (
    select 1
    from public.order_cancellation_claims as claim
    where claim.order_id = p_order_id
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'order_claim_in_progress';
  end if;
  -- 결제사 확인을 기다리는 재고 부족 부분 취소(ADR-0032). 클레임이 아니라 그 부분 취소의 결제 확인을 먼저 마쳐야 한다.
  if private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(p_order_id) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'partial_cancel_in_progress';
  end if;

  perform attempt.id
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  where attempt.purpose = 'order'
    and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by attempt.id
  for update;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.payment_attempts as attempt
    where attempt.purpose = 'order'
      and attempt.ref_id = p_order_id
      and attempt.state in ('prepared', 'confirming', 'unknown', 'needs_review')
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'payment_reconciliation_required';
  end if;

  perform payment.id
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
  order by payment.id
  for update;

  /*
   * 이 경로가 결제사 취소까지 닫을 수 있는 결제만 받는다.
   *
   * 토스 결제는 서버 오케스트레이터가 전액 취소를 발행하고 fresh 조회로 검증한다.
   * Korpay(취소 API 없음)와 무통장(계좌 송금 종결 미구현, #279·#280·#281)은 이
   * 경로로 열면 결제확인필요에 영구히 갇히므로 시작 자체를 거절한다.
   */
  select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer
  into v_payment_count
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    and payment.status <> 'failed';

  if v_payment_count = 0 or exists (
    select 1
    from public.payments as payment
    where payment.purpose = 'order'
      and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
      and payment.status <> 'failed'
      and (
        payment.provider not in ('toss', 'nicepay')
        or payment.status <> 'paid'
        or nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(payment.payment_key), '') is null
      )
  ) then
    raise check_violation using message = 'staff_cancellation_toss_only';
  end if;

  v_reason_label := case p_reason_code
    when 'out_of_stock' then '품절·출고 불가'
    when 'customer_request' then '고객 요청(CS 접수)'
    when 'test_payment_cleanup' then '테스트 결제 정리'
    else '기타'
  end;

  insert into public.order_cancellation_requests (
    order_id,
    requested_by,
    reason,
    reason_type,
    claim_type,
    stage,
    origin,
    staff_reason_code,
    staff_note,
    initiated_by,
    warehouse_stop_confirmed,
    decided_by,
    decided_at,
    provider_started_at
  )
  values (
    p_order_id,
    v_order.user_id,
    '운영자 전액 취소 · ' || v_reason_label,
    'staff',
    'cancel',
    'processing',
    'staff',
    p_reason_code,
    v_note,
    v_actor,
    v_exported_count > 0,
    v_actor,
    pg_catalog.now(),
    pg_catalog.now()
  )
  returning id into v_request_id;

  insert into private.operator_cancellation_authorizations(request_id,actor_id)
  values(v_request_id,v_actor) on conflict do nothing;

  insert into public.order_cancellation_claims (order_id, requested_by, previous_status)
  values (p_order_id, v_order.user_id, v_order.status)
  on conflict (order_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.refunds (payment_id, amount, reason, status, cancellation_request_id)
  select
    payment.id,
    payment.amount - private.payment_partial_refunded_amount(payment.id),
    '운영자 전액 취소 · ' || v_reason_label,
    'requested',
    v_request_id
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'order'
    and payment.ref_id = p_order_id
    and payment.status = 'paid'
  on conflict (payment_id) do update
  set
    cancellation_request_id = excluded.cancellation_request_id,
    reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
    status = case when public.refunds.status = 'done' then 'done' else 'requested' end;

  insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
  values (
    v_actor,
    'admin.order.staff_cancellation_started',
    'order:' || p_order_id::text,
    pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'claimId', v_request_id,
      'claimType', 'cancel',
      'to', 'processing',
      'reasonCode', p_reason_code,
      'note', v_note,
      'previousOrderStatus', v_order.status::text,
      'exportedShipmentCount', v_exported_count,
      'warehouseStopConfirmed', v_exported_count > 0,
      'paymentCount', v_payment_count
    )
  );

  v_notice := case p_reason_code
    when 'out_of_stock' then '판매자 사정(품절·출고 불가)으로 주문 전체를 취소하고 결제 금액 전액을 환불합니다.'
    when 'customer_request' then '요청하신 주문 취소를 접수해 주문 전체를 취소하고 결제 금액 전액을 환불합니다.'
    when 'test_payment_cleanup' then '테스트 결제로 만들어진 주문이라 주문 전체를 취소하고 결제를 취소합니다.'
    else '주문 전체를 취소하고 결제 금액 전액을 환불합니다. 자세한 사유는 고객센터로 문의해주세요.'
  end;

  perform private.notify_order_claim(
    v_request_id,
    'staff_cancel_started',
    '주문 취소를 진행해요',
    v_notice
  );

  return v_request_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_stock_dispatch_warnings(p_origin_id uuid, p_min_difference integer DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.dispatch',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
  if p_min_difference is null or p_min_difference not between 1 and 1000000 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_stock_dispatch_warning_threshold';
  end if;
  with holders as (
    select h.source_id,h.holder_id from private.stock_reconcile_holders() h
  ), batch as (
    select distinct coalesce(h.holder_id,oi.variant_id) as variant_id
    from public.order_shipments s
    join public.orders o on o.id=s.order_id
    join public.order_shipment_items si on si.shipment_id=s.id
    join public.order_items oi on oi.id=si.order_item_id
    left join holders h on h.source_id=oi.variant_id
    where s.status='ready' and o.status in ('paid','confirmed','shipping') and s.fulfillment_partition<>'digital'
      and (p_origin_id is null or s.origin_id=p_origin_id)
      and (oi.supply_source='stock' or exists(select 1 from private.goods_preorder_reservations r
        where r.order_item_id=oi.id and r.state='allocated'))
  ), latest as (
    select distinct on (i.variant_id) i.variant_id,i.file_qty,s.as_of,s.created_at,s.id as snapshot_id
    from private.stock_reconcile_snapshot_items i
    join private.stock_reconcile_snapshots s on s.id=i.snapshot_id
    where i.variant_id in(select variant_id from batch)
    order by i.variant_id,s.as_of desc,s.created_at desc,s.id desc
  ), latest_flows as (
    -- 흐름은 기준 시각이 같은 옵션끼리 한 번에 센다.
    select grouped.as_of,f.* from (select l.as_of,array_agg(l.variant_id) as ids from latest l group by l.as_of) grouped
    cross join lateral private.stock_reconcile_flows(grouped.ids,grouped.as_of) f
  ), measured as (
    select l.*,v.stock_qty,v.name as option_name,v.code as option_code,g.id as good_id,g.code as goods_code,g.name as goods_name,
      f.pending_qty,f.shipped_since_qty,f.returned_since_qty,f.awaiting_return_qty,
      l.file_qty::bigint-f.shipped_since_qty+f.returned_since_qty-f.awaiting_return_qty as expected_qty,
      l.file_qty::bigint-(v.stock_qty::bigint+f.pending_qty+f.awaiting_return_qty+f.shipped_since_qty-f.returned_since_qty) as difference
    from latest l
    join latest_flows f on f.variant_id=l.variant_id and f.as_of=l.as_of
    join public.goods_variants v on v.id=l.variant_id
    join public.goods g on g.id=v.good_id
  ), unreconciled_ids as (
    select b.variant_id from batch b where not exists(select 1 from latest l where l.variant_id=b.variant_id)
  ), unreconciled as (
    select u.variant_id,v.name as option_name,v.code as option_code,g.name as goods_name,f.pending_qty
    from unreconciled_ids u
    join private.stock_reconcile_flows(array(select ui.variant_id from unreconciled_ids ui),clock_timestamp()) f on f.variant_id=u.variant_id
    join public.goods_variants v on v.id=u.variant_id
    join public.goods g on g.id=v.good_id
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'originId',p_origin_id,'minDifference',p_min_difference,'checkedAt',clock_timestamp(),
    'batchVariantCount',(select count(*) from batch),
    'latestAsOf',(select max(as_of) from latest),
    'warnings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variantId',m.variant_id,'goodId',m.good_id,'goodsCode',m.goods_code,
        'goodsName',m.goods_name,'optionName',m.option_name,'optionCode',m.option_code,
        'kind',case when m.pending_qty>m.expected_qty then 'shortage' else 'mismatch' end,
        'snapshotId',m.snapshot_id,'asOf',m.as_of,'fileQty',m.file_qty,'stockQty',m.stock_qty,'pendingQty',m.pending_qty,
        'shippedSinceQty',m.shipped_since_qty,'returnedSinceQty',m.returned_since_qty,'awaitingReturnQty',m.awaiting_return_qty,
        'expectedQty',m.expected_qty,'difference',m.difference,'shortageQty',greatest(m.pending_qty-m.expected_qty,0))
      order by (m.pending_qty>m.expected_qty) desc,abs(m.difference) desc,m.goods_name,m.option_code)
      from measured m where m.pending_qty>m.expected_qty or abs(m.difference)>=p_min_difference),'[]'::jsonb),
    'unreconciledCount',(select count(*) from unreconciled),
    'unreconciled',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('variantId',u.variant_id,'goodsName',u.goods_name,
        'optionName',u.option_name,'optionCode',u.option_code,'pendingQty',u.pending_qty) order by u.goods_name,u.option_code)
      from (select * from unreconciled order by goods_name,option_code limit 20) u),'[]'::jsonb))
  into result;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_store_analytics_notice_report(p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare at_time timestamptz:=statement_timestamp(); today date:=(statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date; result jsonb;
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('stats.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from>p_to or p_to-p_from>=60 or p_to>today then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='analytics_invalid_filter';end if;
 with archived as(
  select d.day,d.curation_id,d.placement,d.impressions,d.clicks,d.impression_sessions,d.click_sessions
  from private.store_analytics_notice_daily d
  where d.day between p_from and p_to and d.day>=(today-interval '13 months')::date
 ),raw as(
  select (e.observed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date as day,e.curation_id,e.placement,
   count(*) filter(where e.interaction='impression')::bigint as impressions,
   count(*) filter(where e.interaction='click')::bigint as clicks,
   count(distinct e.session_id) filter(where e.interaction='impression')::bigint as impression_sessions,
   count(distinct e.session_id) filter(where e.interaction='click')::bigint as click_sessions
  from private.store_analytics_notice_events e
  join private.store_analytics_sessions s on s.id=e.session_id and s.revoked_at is null
  where e.observed_at>=p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' and e.observed_at<(p_to+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul'
   and not exists(select 1 from private.store_analytics_daily_coverage c where c.day=(e.observed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date)
  group by 1,2,3
 ),totals as(
  select f.curation_id,f.placement,sum(f.impressions)::bigint as impressions,sum(f.clicks)::bigint as clicks,
   sum(f.impression_sessions)::bigint as impression_sessions,sum(f.click_sessions)::bigint as click_sessions
  from (select * from archived union all select * from raw) f group by f.curation_id,f.placement
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'observedAt',at_time,
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('curationId',t.curation_id,'placement',t.placement,'title',c.title,
    'impressions',t.impressions,'clicks',t.clicks,'impressionSessions',t.impression_sessions,'clickSessions',t.click_sessions,
    'clickRate',case when t.impressions>0 then round(t.clicks::numeric*100/t.impressions,2) end)
   order by t.impressions desc,t.clicks desc,t.curation_id,t.placement)
   from totals t left join public.home_curations c on c.id=t.curation_id),'[]'::jsonb))
 into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_store_analytics_report(p_from date, p_to date, p_dimension text DEFAULT 'channel'::text, p_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_compare text DEFAULT 'previous'::text, p_grain text DEFAULT 'day'::text, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare compare_from date;compare_to date;result jsonb;at_time timestamptz:=statement_timestamp();
begin
 if not public.has_operator_capability('stats.read',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required';end if;
 if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_from>p_to or p_to-p_from>=60 or p_to>(at_time at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
  or p_dimension is null or p_dimension not in ('channel','page','good','ip','category','link')
  or(p_key is not null and(length(p_key) not between 1 and 200 or p_key~'[[:cntrl:]]'))
  or p_compare is null or p_compare not in ('previous','year','none') or p_grain is null or p_grain not in ('day','week','month')
  or p_query is null or length(p_query)>100 or p_page is null or p_page not between 1 and 100000
  or p_page_size is null or p_page_size not in (20,10000) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='analytics_invalid_filter';end if;
 if p_compare='previous' then compare_to:=p_from-1;compare_from:=p_from-(p_to-p_from+1);
 elsif p_compare='year' then compare_from:=(p_from-interval '1 year')::date;compare_to:=(p_to-interval '1 year')::date;end if;
 with periods as(select 'current'::text period,p_from date_from,p_to date_to
  union all select 'comparison',compare_from,compare_to where compare_from is not null),
 coverage_days as materialized(select p.period,d.day::date,private.store_analytics_day_coverage(d.day::date,at_time) coverage
  from periods p cross join lateral generate_series(p.date_from::timestamp,p.date_to::timestamp,interval '1 day') d(day)),
 period_coverage as(select period,count(*)::integer days,
  count(*) filter(where coverage->>'state'='observed')::integer observed_days,
  count(*) filter(where coverage->>'state' in ('collecting','partial'))::integer partial_days,
  count(*) filter(where coverage->>'state' in ('unmeasured','paused','expired','future'))::integer missing_days,
  count(*) filter(where(coverage->>'archived')::boolean)::integer archived_days,
  coalesce(sum((coverage->>'observedMinutes')::integer),0)::integer observed_minutes,
  coalesce(sum((coverage->>'expectedMinutes')::integer),0)::integer expected_minutes,
  max((coverage->>'observedUntil')::timestamptz) observed_until
  from coverage_days group by period),
 facts as materialized(select p.period,r.* from periods p cross join lateral private.store_analytics_period_rows(p.date_from,p.date_to) r),
 summary as(select p.period,private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(r.page_views)::bigint,sum(r.product_views)::bigint,sum(r.sessions)::bigint,
  sum(r.link_landings)::bigint,sum(r.orders)::bigint,sum(r.converted_sessions)::bigint,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.gross_amount),0)::bigint end,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount),0)::bigint end,
  count(r.day)>0 or c.observed_days=c.days) metrics
  from periods p join period_coverage c on c.period=p.period left join facts r on r.period=p.period
   and r.dimension=case when p_key is null then 'total' else p_dimension end and r.key=coalesce(p_key,'all')
  group by p.period,c.observed_days,c.days),
 bucket_coverage as(select period,date_trunc(p_grain,day::timestamp)::date bucket,
  bool_and(coverage->>'state'='observed') complete,bool_or((coverage->>'archived')::boolean) archived,
  array_agg(distinct coverage->>'state') states from coverage_days group by period,bucket),
 trend as(select c.period,c.bucket,c.states,c.archived,private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(r.page_views)::bigint,sum(r.product_views)::bigint,sum(r.sessions)::bigint,
  sum(r.link_landings)::bigint,sum(r.orders)::bigint,sum(r.converted_sessions)::bigint,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.gross_amount),0)::bigint end,
  case when p_key is null or p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(r.refund_amount),0)::bigint end,
  count(r.day)>0 or c.complete) metrics
  from bucket_coverage c left join facts r on r.period=c.period and date_trunc(p_grain,r.day::timestamp)::date=c.bucket
   and r.dimension=case when p_key is null then 'total' else p_dimension end and r.key=coalesce(p_key,'all')
  group by c.period,c.bucket,c.states,c.archived,c.complete),
 detail_keys as(select distinct key from facts where dimension=p_dimension
  union select id::text from private.marketing_links where p_dimension='link'),
 details as(select k.key,private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension,k.key) label,
  private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(f.page_views) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   sum(f.product_views) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,sum(f.sessions) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   sum(f.link_landings) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,sum(f.orders) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   sum(f.converted_sessions) filter(where f.period='current')::bigint,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.gross_amount) filter(where f.period='current'),0)::bigint end,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.refund_amount) filter(where f.period='current'),0)::bigint end,
   count(f.day) filter(where f.period='current')>0 or(select observed_days=days from period_coverage where period='current')) metrics,
  case when compare_from is not null then private.store_analytics_metric_json(sum(f.page_views) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   sum(f.product_views) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,sum(f.sessions) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   sum(f.link_landings) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,sum(f.orders) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   sum(f.converted_sessions) filter(where f.period='comparison')::bigint,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.gross_amount) filter(where f.period='comparison'),0)::bigint end,
   case when p_dimension in ('channel','link') then coalesce(sum(f.refund_amount) filter(where f.period='comparison'),0)::bigint end,
   count(f.day) filter(where f.period='comparison')>0 or(select observed_days=days from period_coverage where period='comparison')) end comparison,
  bool_or(f.archived) archived,max(f.observed_until) observed_until
  from detail_keys k left join facts f on f.key=k.key and f.dimension=p_dimension
  where (p_key is null or k.key=p_key) and (btrim(p_query)='' or strpos(lower(private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension,k.key)),lower(btrim(p_query)))>0 or strpos(k.key,lower(btrim(p_query)))>0)
  group by k.key),
 detail_page as(select * from details order by(metrics->>'sessions')::bigint desc nulls last,label,key limit p_page_size offset(p_page-1)*p_page_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('from',p_from,'to',p_to,'comparisonFrom',compare_from,'comparisonTo',compare_to,
  'dimension',p_dimension,'selectedKey',p_key,'selectedLabel',case when p_key is not null then private.store_analytics_label(p_dimension,p_key) end,
  'summary',(select metrics from summary where period='current'),'comparison',(select metrics from summary where period='comparison'),
  'coverage',(select to_jsonb(c)-'period' from period_coverage c where period='current'),
  'comparisonCoverage',(select to_jsonb(c)-'period' from period_coverage c where period='comparison'),
  'trend',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',bucket,'metrics',metrics,'states',states,'archived',archived) order by bucket) from trend where period='current'),'[]'),
  'comparisonTrend',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',bucket,'metrics',metrics,'states',states,'archived',archived) order by bucket) from trend where period='comparison'),'[]'),
  'rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',key,'label',label,'metrics',metrics,'comparison',comparison,'archived',coalesce(archived,false),'observedUntil',observed_until)
   order by(metrics->>'sessions')::bigint desc nulls last,label,key) from detail_page),'[]'),'total',(select count(*) from details),
  'collection',(select jsonb_build_object('enabled',enabled,'startedAt',activated_at,'noticeVersion',notice_version,
   'lastHeartbeatAt',(select max(observed_at) from private.store_analytics_health),'rawRetentionDays',90,'aggregateRetentionMonths',13,
   'retentionBacklog',(select count(*) from private.store_analytics_sessions where created_at<(((at_time at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date-89)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')))
   from private.store_analytics_settings where id),'observedAt',at_time,'advertisingCost',null,'roas',null)
 into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_store_settings_history(row_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, actor_name text, action text, target text, created_at timestamp with time zone, diff jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not (public.has_operator_capability('seller.read') or public.has_operator_capability('store.manage') or public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage')) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if not (public.has_operator_capability('seller.read') or public.has_operator_capability('store.manage') or public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage')) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff_required'; end if;
  return query select a.id,p.nickname,a.action,a.target,a.created_at,a.diff from public.audit_log a
    left join public.profiles p on p.id=a.actor_id
    where a.action in ('admin.store_settings.updated','admin.shipping_carrier.saved','admin.fulfillment_origin.saved') and (
 (a.target in ('store_settings:branding','store_settings:navigation','store_settings:inquiry_auto_replies') and public.has_operator_capability('store.manage'))
 or (a.target in ('store_settings:business','store_settings:bank_transfer') and public.has_operator_capability('seller.manage'))
 or (a.action in ('admin.shipping_carrier.saved','admin.fulfillment_origin.saved') and public.has_operator_capability('platform.manage'))
)
    order by a.created_at desc,a.id desc limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(row_limit,50),100));
end $function$

 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, buyer_name text, buyer_id uuid, recipient_name text, total bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone, extended_at timestamp with time zone, deposit_code text, item_summary text, attempt_state public.payment_attempt_state, total_count bigint, order_number text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_unpaid_bank_transfer_orders(p_query text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 50, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, buyer_name text, buyer_id uuid, recipient_name text, total bigint, created_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone, extended_at timestamp with time zone, deposit_code text, item_summary text, attempt_state public.payment_attempt_state, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 200);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0);
  v_query text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_query, '')), '');
begin
  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='operator_capability_required'; end if;

  if not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage',false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'staff required';
  end if;

  return query
  with candidate as (
    select
      orders.id,
      orders.user_id,
      orders.total,
      orders.created_at,
      orders.expires_at,
      orders.bank_transfer_extended_at,
      private.bank_transfer_deposit_code(orders.id) as code,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(profile.nickname), ''), 'fan_' || left(orders.user_id::text, 6))
        as buyer,
      -- 안내한 입금자명은 수령인 + 주문코드다. 주소 전체가 아니라 이 한 칸만
      -- 나간다 — 대조에 필요한 것이 그것뿐이다.
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(orders.address ->> 'recipientName'), ''), '') as recipient,
      (
        select attempt.state
        from public.payment_attempts as attempt
        where attempt.purpose = 'order'
          and attempt.ref_id = orders.id
      ) as attempt_state,
      (
        select string_agg(
          item.good_name_snapshot || ' × ' || item.qty::text,
          ', '
          order by item.good_name_snapshot
        )
        from public.order_items as item
        where item.order_id = orders.id
      ) as items
    from public.orders
    left join public.profiles as profile on profile.id = orders.user_id
    where orders.status = 'pending'
      and orders.payment_method = 'bank_transfer'
  ),
  filtered as (
    select *
    from candidate
    where v_query is null
      or candidate.code = upper(v_query)
      or private.bank_transfer_switch_grace_code(candidate.id) = upper(v_query)
      or candidate.id::text = lower(v_query)
      or candidate.buyer ilike '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_query, '\', '\\'), '%', '\%'), '_', '\_') || '%'
  )
  select
    filtered.id,
    filtered.buyer,
    filtered.user_id,
    filtered.recipient,
    filtered.total,
    filtered.created_at,
    filtered.expires_at,
    filtered.bank_transfer_extended_at,
    filtered.code,
    coalesce(filtered.items, ''),
    filtered.attempt_state,
    count(*) over ()
  from filtered
  order by filtered.expires_at nulls last, filtered.created_at
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_unresolved_payment_attempts(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare at timestamptz := now(); result jsonb;
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null or not public.has_operator_capability('sales.manage', false) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'operator_capability_required';
  end if;
  if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 200 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_payment_attempt_filter';
  end if;
  with open_attempts as materialized (
    select a.* from public.payment_attempts a
    where a.state in ('unknown', 'needs_review', 'confirming') and private.payment_attempt_unresolved(a.state, a.claim_expires_at, at)
  ), page as (
    select a.* from open_attempts a order by a.created_at, a.id limit p_limit
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total', (select count(*) from open_attempts),
    'asOf', at,
    'items', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'attemptId', a.id, 'purpose', a.purpose, 'provider', a.provider, 'state', a.state,
      'reason', case when a.state = 'confirming' then 'confirming_stalled' else a.state::text end,
      'amount', a.amount, 'currency', a.currency, 'refId', a.ref_id,
      'orderNumber', case when a.purpose = 'order' then (select o.order_number from public.orders o where o.id = a.ref_id) end,
      'createdAt', a.created_at, 'updatedAt', a.updated_at, 'claimExpiresAt', a.claim_expires_at,
      'lastCheckedAt', greatest(
        (select max(g.requested_at) from private.goods_payment_reconciliation_audits g where g.target_id = a.id and g.operation = 'payment'),
        (select max(t.requested_at) from private.ticket_payment_reconciliation_audits t where t.target_id = a.id and t.operation = 'payment')),
      'reconcilable', (a.purpose = 'order' and a.provider in ('toss', 'nicepay')) or (a.purpose = 'ticket' and a.provider = 'toss'))
      order by a.created_at, a.id) from page a), '[]'::jsonb))
  into result;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_update_operation_alerts(p_action text, p_ids uuid[], p_through timestamp with time zone, p_category text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_state text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=(select auth.uid()); changed integer;
begin
  perform private.require_operator_capability('home',false);

 if actor is null or not public.has_operator_capability('home',false) then raise insufficient_privilege using message='staff_required';end if;
 if p_action is null or p_action not in('read','hide','restore') or p_through is null or not isfinite(p_through) or p_through>clock_timestamp()
  or (p_ids is not null and(cardinality(p_ids) not between 1 and 100 or array_position(p_ids,null) is not null))
  or p_category is null or p_category not in('all','orders','claims','inquiries','questions','reviews','system')
  or p_state is null or p_state not in('all','unread','hidden') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_alert_update';end if;
 insert into private.admin_operation_alert_states(alert_id,actor_id,read_at,hidden_at)
 select a.id,actor,case when p_action='read' then clock_timestamp() end,case when p_action='hide' then clock_timestamp() end
 from private.admin_operation_alerts a left join private.admin_operation_alert_states s on s.alert_id=a.id and s.actor_id=actor
 where a.created_at<=p_through and a.created_at>statement_timestamp()-interval '90 days' and public.has_operator_capability(private.operator_alert_capability(a.category))
  and(p_ids is null or a.id=any(p_ids)) and(p_category='all' or a.category=p_category)
  and case p_state when 'hidden' then s.hidden_at is not null when 'unread' then s.read_at is null and s.hidden_at is null else s.hidden_at is null end
 on conflict(alert_id,actor_id) do update set
  read_at=case when p_action='read' then coalesce(private.admin_operation_alert_states.read_at,excluded.read_at) else private.admin_operation_alert_states.read_at end,
  hidden_at=case when p_action='hide' then coalesce(private.admin_operation_alert_states.hidden_at,excluded.hidden_at) when p_action='restore' then null else private.admin_operation_alert_states.hidden_at end;
 get diagnostics changed=row_count;
 return changed;
end;$function$
