CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_catalog_categories()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code text, name text, parent_id uuid, depth integer, sort_order integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with recursive category_lineage as (
    select category.id as leaf_id, category.parent_id, category.archived_at
    from public.catalog_categories as category
    union all
    select lineage.leaf_id, parent.parent_id, parent.archived_at
    from category_lineage as lineage
    join public.catalog_categories as parent on parent.id = lineage.parent_id
  )
  select category.id, category.code, category.name, category.parent_id, category.depth, category.sort_order
  from public.catalog_categories as category
  where private.category_customer_enabled()
    and category.archived_at is null
    and not exists (
      select 1 from category_lineage as lineage
      where lineage.leaf_id = category.id and lineage.archived_at is not null
    )
  order by category.depth, category.sort_order, category.code
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_good_announcements(p_good_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with eligible as materialized (
  select n.*,n.important and (n.important_starts_at is null or n.important_starts_at<=statement_timestamp())
    and (n.important_ends_at is null or n.important_ends_at>statement_timestamp()) as effective_important,
   greatest(n.starts_at,n.important_starts_at) as importance_starts,least(n.ends_at,n.important_ends_at) as importance_ends
  from public.goods_announcements n where n.enabled
   and exists(select 1 from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id where g.id=p_good_id
    and g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and private.good_sale_restriction_visible(g.sale_restriction,(select auth.uid())) and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null)
   and (n.all_goods or exists(select 1 from public.goods_announcement_goods links where links.announcement_id=n.id and links.good_id=p_good_id))
 ) select jsonb_build_object('items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'title',title,'body',body,'format',body_format,
   'category',category,'device',device,'important',effective_important,'placement',placement) order by effective_important desc,updated_at desc,id)
  from eligible where (starts_at is null or starts_at<=statement_timestamp()) and (ends_at is null or ends_at>statement_timestamp())),'[]'),
  'nextChangeAt',(select min(at) from eligible cross join lateral(values(starts_at),(ends_at),
   (case when important and coalesce(importance_starts,'-infinity')<coalesce(importance_ends,'infinity') then importance_starts end),
   (case when important and coalesce(importance_starts,'-infinity')<coalesce(importance_ends,'infinity') then importance_ends end))boundary(at)
   where at>statement_timestamp() and isfinite(at)));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_good_group_reviews_v2(p_good_id text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'recent'::text, p_photo_only boolean DEFAULT false, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare ids text[];result jsonb;viewer uuid:=private.review_helpful_viewer_id();viewer_active boolean:=private.review_helpful_actor_is_active(viewer);
begin
 if p_sort is null or p_sort not in('recent','rating_desc','rating_asc','helpful_desc') or p_photo_only is null
  or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 50 or p_offset is null or p_offset not between 0 and 1000000 then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_group_review_page';end if;
 ids:=private.goods_group_review_good_ids(p_good_id);
 with visible as materialized (
  select r.id,r.good_id,r.order_id,r.rating,r.body,r.image_paths,r.user_id,r.created_at,r.edited_at,r.admin_reply,r.admin_reply_at,helpful.helpful_count,helpful.helpful_by_me,
   coalesce(nullif(btrim(author.nickname),''),'fan_'||left(r.user_id::text,6)) author_name,
   coalesce((select item.good_name_snapshot from public.order_items item where item.order_id=r.order_id and item.good_id=r.good_id order by item.id limit 1),g.name) good_name,
   coalesce((select array_agg(distinct case when item.option_sale_mode_snapshot='random' then '랜덤' else item.variant_name_snapshot end
     order by case when item.option_sale_mode_snapshot='random' then '랜덤' else item.variant_name_snapshot end) from public.order_items item
    where item.order_id=r.order_id and item.good_id=r.good_id and item.variant_name_snapshot is not null),'{}'::text[]) variant_names
  from public.reviews r join public.profiles author on author.id=r.user_id join public.goods g on g.id=r.good_id
  cross join lateral(select count(*)::bigint helpful_count,coalesce(bool_or(v.user_id=viewer),false) helpful_by_me
   from private.review_helpful_votes v where v.review_id=r.id) helpful
  where r.good_id=any(ids) and r.status='visible'
 ), filtered as materialized (
  select * from visible where not p_photo_only or cardinality(image_paths)>0
 ), page as (
  select * from filtered order by case when p_sort='helpful_desc' then helpful_count end desc nulls last,case when p_sort='rating_desc' then rating end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='rating_asc' then rating end asc nulls last,created_at desc,id desc limit p_limit offset p_offset
 ) select jsonb_build_object('viewerAuthenticated',viewer is not null,'grouped',exists(select 1 from private.goods_group_members where good_id=p_good_id) and cardinality(ids)>0,
  'summary',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'average',coalesce(round(avg(rating),2),0),
   'distribution',jsonb_build_array(count(*) filter(where rating=1),count(*) filter(where rating=2),count(*) filter(where rating=3),count(*) filter(where rating=4),count(*) filter(where rating=5)),
   'photoCount',count(*) filter(where cardinality(image_paths)>0)) from visible),
  'total',(select count(*) from filtered),
  'reviews',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'goodId',good_id,'goodName',good_name,'variantNames',to_jsonb(variant_names),
   'rating',rating,'body',body,'imagePaths',to_jsonb(coalesce(image_paths,'{}'::text[])),'authorName',author_name,
   'helpfulCount',helpful_count,'helpfulByMe',helpful_by_me,'canMarkHelpful',viewer_active and user_id<>viewer,'isMine',auth.uid() is not null and user_id=auth.uid(),'createdAt',created_at,'editedAt',edited_at,'adminReply',admin_reply,'adminReplyAt',admin_reply_at)
   order by case when p_sort='helpful_desc' then helpful_count end desc nulls last,case when p_sort='rating_desc' then rating end desc nulls last,
    case when p_sort='rating_asc' then rating end asc nulls last,created_at desc,id desc) from page),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end;
$function$

 where g.id=p_good_id and g.published_at is not null and g.archived_at is null and private.good_sale_restriction_visible(g.sale_restriction,(select auth.uid())) and ip.published_at is not null and ip.archived_at is null;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_good_relation_compositions(p_good_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with matching as materialized(
  select r.* from public.goods_relations r where r.enabled and
   ((r.kind='together' and r.image_path is null and r.representative_good_id=p_good_id)
    or ((r.kind in ('similar','codi') or r.image_path is not null) and exists(select 1 from public.goods_relation_members m where m.relation_id=r.id and m.good_id=p_good_id)))
 ),public_members as materialized(

 ),eligible as materialized(

 ),active as(select * from eligible where (starts_at is null or starts_at<=statement_timestamp()) and (ends_at is null or ends_at>statement_timestamp()))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_goods_review_summaries(p_good_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  result jsonb;
begin
  if p_good_ids is null
    or pg_catalog.cardinality(p_good_ids) not between 1 and 500
    or pg_catalog.array_position(p_good_ids, null) is not null
    or exists (
      select 1 from pg_catalog.unnest(p_good_ids) as requested(id)
      where requested.id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$'
    )
  then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_goods_review_summary_goods';
  end if;

  with requested as (
    select distinct requested.id
    from pg_catalog.unnest(p_good_ids) as requested(id)
  ), scope as (
    -- 비공개 굿즈는 빈 배열이라 여기서 사라진다. 그룹 밖 공개 굿즈는 자기 자신 하나다.
    select requested.id as good_id, member.good_id as member_id
    from requested
    cross join lateral pg_catalog.unnest(private.goods_group_review_good_ids(requested.id)) as member(good_id)
  ), summary as (
    select
      scope.good_id,
      pg_catalog.count(*)::bigint as review_count,
      round(avg(review.rating)::numeric, 2) as rating_average
    from scope
    join public.reviews as review
      on review.good_id = scope.member_id
     and review.status = 'visible'
    group by scope.good_id
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'goodId', summary.good_id,
        'reviewCount', summary.review_count,
        'ratingAverage', summary.rating_average
      )
      order by summary.good_id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into result
  from summary;

  return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_goods_sales_ranking(p_period text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare ranking jsonb;
begin
  if p_period is null or p_period not in ('realtime', 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly')
    or p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 200 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_sales_ranking';
  end if;
  with bounds as (
    select date_trunc('day', statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as today,
      statement_timestamp() as captured_at
  ), period_window as (
    select case p_period when 'realtime' then today when 'daily' then today - interval '1 day'
        when 'weekly' then today - interval '7 days' else today - interval '30 days' end as starts_at,
      case p_period when 'realtime' then captured_at else today end as ends_at
    from bounds
  ), eligible as materialized (
    select g.id, g.created_at
    from public.goods g
    where g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction = 'none'
      and exists(select 1 from public.ips ip where ip.id = g.ip_id and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null)
  ), quantities as (
    select s.good_id, s.quantity from period_window w
    cross join lateral private.goods_effective_sales(w.starts_at, w.ends_at) s
    join eligible on eligible.id = s.good_id
  ), wishes as (
    select w.good_id, count(*) as wish_count from public.wishlists w join eligible on eligible.id = w.good_id group by w.good_id
  ), ranked as (
    select g.id, row_number() over(order by coalesce(q.quantity, 0) desc, coalesce(w.wish_count, 0) desc, g.created_at desc, g.id) as position
    from eligible g
    left join quantities q on q.good_id = g.id
    left join wishes w on w.good_id = g.id
    where coalesce(q.quantity, 0) > 0 or coalesce(w.wish_count, 0) > 0
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ranked.id order by ranked.position), '[]'::jsonb) into ranking
  from ranked where ranked.position <= p_limit;
  return ranking;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_goods_transaction_offers(p_good_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 if p_good_ids is null or cardinality(p_good_ids)>1000 or array_position(p_good_ids,null) is not null
  or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_good_ids) id where char_length(id) not between 1 and 200 or id<>btrim(id) or id~'[[:cntrl:]]') then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_goods_transaction_offer_ids';end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId',g.id,
  'volume',case when v.status='active' then jsonb_build_object('id',v.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',v.revision,'status',v.status,'terms',v.terms,'draftValues','{}'::jsonb) end,
  'delivery',case when d.status='active' then jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'goodId',g.id,'revision',d.revision,'status',d.status,
   'paymentMode',d.payment_mode,'quantityTerms',d.quantity_terms,'draftValues','{}'::jsonb) end,
  'collectReady',coalesce(contract.status='active' and origin.is_active,false),
  'collector',case when contract.status='active' and origin.is_active then jsonb_build_object('name',contract.contract_values->>'collectorName',
   'method',contract.contract_values->>'collectionMethod','refundContact',contract.contract_values->>'refundContact','instructions',contract.contract_values->>'customerInstructions') end)
  ||case when family.aggregation_id is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('aggregation',jsonb_build_object('id',family.aggregation_id,'requiresV2',true,
   'runtimeEnabled',(select enabled from private.goods_transaction_runtime where singleton)),'sharedPolicy',private.goods_aggregation_shared_policy(g.id)) end
  ||case when private.shipping_charge_group_public_offer(g.id) is null then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('chargeGroup',private.shipping_charge_group_public_offer(g.id)) end
  order by g.id),'[]') into result from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id
  left join private.goods_aggregation_members member on member.good_id=g.id
  left join private.goods_aggregation_roots family on family.root_good_id=member.root_good_id
  join public.goods owner_good on owner_good.id=coalesce(member.root_good_id,g.id)
  left join private.goods_transaction_configs c on c.good_id=owner_good.id left join private.goods_volume_discount_versions v on v.id=c.volume_version_id
  left join private.goods_delivery_versions d on d.id=c.delivery_version_id left join public.fulfillment_origins origin on origin.id=owner_good.origin_id
  left join private.shipping_collect_contracts collector on collector.origin_id=origin.id
  left join private.shipping_collect_contract_versions contract on contract.id=collector.version_id
 where g.id=any(p_good_ids) and g.published_at is not null and g.archived_at is null and private.good_sale_restriction_visible(g.sale_restriction,(select auth.uid()))
  and ip.published_at is not null and ip.archived_at is null;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_home_announcement_popup()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with selected as materialized (
  select n.*,s.dismiss_key,greatest(n.starts_at,s.starts_at) as effective_starts,least(n.ends_at,s.ends_at) as effective_ends,
   n.important and (n.important_starts_at is null or n.important_starts_at<=statement_timestamp())
    and (n.important_ends_at is null or n.important_ends_at>statement_timestamp()) as effective_important
  from private.home_announcement_popup s join public.goods_announcements n on n.id=s.announcement_id where s.singleton and n.enabled
 ), eligible as materialized(select * from selected where effective_starts<effective_ends)
 select jsonb_build_object('item',(select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'title',title,'body',body,'format',body_format,'device',device,
  'important',effective_important,'dismissKey',dismiss_key,'startsAt',effective_starts,'endsAt',effective_ends)
  from eligible where effective_starts<=statement_timestamp() and effective_ends>statement_timestamp()),
  'nextChangeAt',(select min(at) from eligible cross join lateral(values(effective_starts),(effective_ends),
   (case when important and important_starts_at>effective_starts and important_starts_at<effective_ends then important_starts_at end),
   (case when important and important_ends_at>effective_starts and important_ends_at<effective_ends then important_ends_at end))boundary(at)
   where at>statement_timestamp() and isfinite(at)));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_home_best_review_candidates(p_good_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if p_good_ids is null or cardinality(p_good_ids) not between 1 and 200
    or array_ndims(p_good_ids) is distinct from 1
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_home_review_goods'; end if;
  if array_position(p_good_ids,null) is not null
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_good_ids) id where id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_home_review_goods'; end if;

  with eligible as materialized (
    select g.id from public.goods g
    join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id
    where g.id=any(p_good_ids) and g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null
      and g.sale_restriction='none' and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'goodId',g.id,
    'representative',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'rating',r.rating,'body',r.body,
      'authorName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),'팬'),'createdAt',r.created_at)
  ) order by g.id),'[]'::jsonb) into result
  from eligible g
  cross join lateral (
    select r.id,r.user_id,r.rating,r.body,r.created_at
    from private.review_best_selections selection
    join public.reviews r on r.id=selection.review_id
    where r.good_id=g.id and r.status='visible'
      and selection.selected and selection.invalidated_at is null
      and selection.review_fingerprint=md5(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',r.id,'body',r.body,'rating',r.rating,'images',r.image_paths,'status',r.status)::text)
      and exists(select 1 from public.profiles author where author.id=r.user_id and author.suspended_at is null)
      and not exists(select 1 from private.account_action_fences fence where fence.subject_user_id=r.user_id)
      -- Read-only equivalent of review_event_purchase_eligible in this statement
      -- snapshot. The dependency guard above prevents silently copying a changed
      -- purchase/fingerprint contract. Future changes must update both readers.
      and exists(
        select 1 from public.orders o
        where o.id=r.order_id and o.user_id=r.user_id and o.status in ('delivered','done') and o.delivered_at is not null
          and exists(select 1 from public.order_items item where item.order_id=o.id and item.good_id=r.good_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests claim
            where claim.order_id=o.id and claim.claim_type in ('cancel','return')
              and (claim.status='completed' or claim.stage='completed'))
          and exists(
            select 1 from public.payments payment
            join public.payment_attempts attempt on attempt.payment_id=payment.id
              and attempt.purpose='order' and attempt.ref_id=o.id and attempt.user_id=o.user_id
              and attempt.provider=payment.provider and attempt.amount=payment.amount and attempt.state='approved'
            where payment.purpose='order' and payment.ref_id=o.id and payment.user_id=o.user_id
              and payment.amount=o.total and payment.status='paid'
              and (exists(select 1 from private.payment_provider_evidence evidence
                where evidence.payment_attempt_id=attempt.id and evidence.approved_at is not null)
                or attempt.provider='bank_transfer' and exists(select 1 from public.bank_transfer_confirmations confirmation
                  where confirmation.attempt_id=attempt.id and confirmation.order_id=o.id))
          )
      )
    order by r.rating desc,public.get_public_review_helpful_count(r.id) desc,r.created_at desc,r.id
    limit 1
  ) r
  left join public.public_profiles p on p.id=r.user_id;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_home_review_candidates(p_good_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if p_good_ids is null or cardinality(p_good_ids) not between 1 and 200
    or array_position(p_good_ids,null) is not null
    or exists(select 1 from unnest(p_good_ids) id where id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$')
  then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_home_review_goods'; end if;
  with bounds as (
    select date_trunc('day',statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as today
  ), eligible as (
    select g.id from public.goods g where g.id=any(p_good_ids)
      and g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none'
      and exists(select 1 from public.ips ip where ip.id=g.ip_id and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null)
  ), statistics as (
    select r.good_id,round(avg(r.rating)::numeric,2) rating_average,count(*) review_count,
      max(r.created_at) filter(where r.created_at>=bounds.today-interval '7 days' and r.created_at<bounds.today) as recent_review_at
    from public.reviews r join eligible g on g.id=r.good_id cross join bounds
    where r.status='visible' group by r.good_id
  ), best as materialized (
    select chosen.* from jsonb_to_recordset(public.get_home_best_review_candidates(p_good_ids))
      as chosen("goodId" text,representative jsonb)
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'goodId',s.good_id,'ratingAverage',s.rating_average,'reviewCount',s.review_count,'recentReviewAt',s.recent_review_at,
    'representative',coalesce(best.representative,jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'rating',r.rating,'body',r.body,
      'authorName',coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.nickname),''),'팬'),'createdAt',r.created_at))
  ) order by s.good_id),'[]'::jsonb) into result
  from statistics s
  cross join lateral (
    select id,user_id,rating,body,created_at from public.reviews r
    where r.good_id=s.good_id and r.status='visible'
    order by r.rating desc,public.get_public_review_helpful_count(r.id) desc,r.created_at desc,r.id limit 1
  ) r
  left join public.public_profiles p on p.id=r.user_id
  left join best on best."goodId"=s.good_id;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_home_sales_rankings()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with bounds as (
    select date_trunc('day',statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' as today,
      statement_timestamp() as captured_at
  ), eligible as materialized (
    select g.id,g.created_at
    from public.goods g
    where g.archived_at is null and g.published_at is not null and g.sale_restriction='none'
      and exists(select 1 from public.ips ip where ip.id=g.ip_id and ip.archived_at is null and ip.published_at is not null)
  ), paid_orders as materialized (
    select o.id,min(approval.approved_at) as approved_at
    from public.orders o
    join public.payments p on p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=o.id and p.status='paid'
      and p.user_id=o.user_id and p.amount=o.total
    join public.payment_attempts a on a.payment_id=p.id and a.purpose='order' and a.ref_id=o.id
      and a.state='approved' and a.amount=p.amount and a.provider=p.provider and a.user_id=o.user_id
    cross join lateral (
      select coalesce(
        (select min(e.approved_at) from private.payment_provider_evidence e where e.payment_attempt_id=a.id),
        (select b.confirmed_at from public.bank_transfer_confirmations b where b.attempt_id=a.id and b.order_id=o.id and a.provider='bank_transfer')
      ) as approved_at
    ) approval
    where o.status in ('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done')
      and approval.approved_at is not null
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests c where c.order_id=o.id
        and c.claim_type in ('cancel','return') and (c.status='completed' or c.stage='completed'))
    group by o.id
  ), periods as (
    select 'realtime'::text period,today starts_at,captured_at ends_at from bounds
    union all select 'daily',today-interval '1 day',today from bounds
    union all select 'weekly',today-interval '7 days',today from bounds
    union all select 'monthly',today-interval '30 days',today from bounds
  ), quantities as (
    select period,item.good_id,sum(private.order_item_active_qty(item.id)::bigint) quantity
    from periods
    join paid_orders paid on paid.approved_at>=starts_at and paid.approved_at<ends_at
    join public.order_items item on item.order_id=paid.id
    join eligible on eligible.id=item.good_id
    group by period,item.good_id
  ), wishes as (
    select w.good_id,count(*) wish_count from public.wishlists w join eligible on eligible.id=w.good_id group by w.good_id
  ), ranked as (
    select periods.period,g.id,
      row_number() over(partition by periods.period order by coalesce(q.quantity,0) desc,
        coalesce(w.wish_count,0) desc,g.created_at desc,g.id) as position
    from periods cross join eligible g
    left join quantities q on q.period=periods.period and q.good_id=g.id
    left join wishes w on w.good_id=g.id
    where coalesce(q.quantity,0)>0 or coalesce(w.wish_count,0)>0
  )
  select jsonb_object_agg(period,coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(id order by position) from ranked where ranked.period=periods.period and position<=4
  ),'[]'::jsonb)) from periods;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 if auth.uid() is null or auth.uid() is distinct from p_expected_actor_id then raise insufficient_privilege using message='subscription_actor_changed';end if;
 if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 or (p_before_at is null) is distinct from (p_before_id is null) then

 with eligible as(select p.* from private.goods_subscription_plans p where p.owner_id=auth.uid() and (p.state<>'draft' or p.draft_expires_at>clock_timestamp())),
 page as(select * from eligible where p_before_at is null or (updated_at,id)<(p_before_at,p_before_id) order by updated_at desc,id desc limit p_limit+1),
 shown as(select * from page order by updated_at desc,id desc limit p_limit)
 select jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(private.subscription_plan_summary(id,false) order by updated_at desc,id desc) from shown),'[]'::jsonb),
  'total',(select count(*) from eligible),'hasMore',(select count(*)>p_limit from page),
  'nextCursor',case when (select count(*)>p_limit from page) then (select jsonb_build_object('updatedAt',updated_at,'id',id) from shown order by updated_at,id limit 1) end) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_order_downloads(p_order uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare purchase public.orders;available boolean;begin
 select * into purchase from public.orders where id=p_order and user_id=auth.uid();
 if not found or private.is_account_write_fenced(auth.uid()) then raise no_data_found;end if;
 available:=purchase.status in('paid','confirmed','shipping','delivered','done') and private.production_payment_valid(p_order)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_requests where order_id=p_order and stage not in('completed','rejected','withdrawn'))
  and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims where order_id=p_order)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.refunds r join public.payments p on p.id=r.payment_id where p.purpose='order' and p.ref_id=p_order and r.status in('requested','processing','done'))
  and not private.order_fulfillment_held(p_order);
 return jsonb_build_object('orderId',p_order,'canCancel',private.order_cancel_eligible(p_order),'reviewRequired',exists(select 1 from private.order_digital_downloads where order_id=p_order),
  'items',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('itemId',i.id,'name',i.good_name_snapshot,'files',i.fulfillment_terms_snapshot->'files','available',available,
   'firstProvidedAt',(select min(created_at) from private.order_digital_downloads where order_item_id=i.id)) order by i.id)
   from public.order_items i where i.order_id=p_order and i.fulfillment_terms_snapshot->>'mode'='digital'),'[]'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_order_payment_display(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  actor uuid := auth.uid();
  result jsonb;
begin
  if actor is null then raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'auth_required'; end if;
  if p_order_id is null then return null; end if;
  select jsonb_build_object(
           'provider', payment.provider::text,
           'method', evidence.payment_method,
           'detail', evidence.masked_payment_method,
           'approvedAt', evidence.approved_at)
    into result
    from public.payments payment
    left join public.payment_attempts attempt on attempt.payment_id = payment.id
    left join lateral (
      select e.payment_method, e.masked_payment_method, e.approved_at
        from private.payment_provider_evidence e
       where e.payment_attempt_id = attempt.id
         and (e.payment_method is not null or e.masked_payment_method is not null)
       order by e.recorded_at desc, e.id desc
       limit 1) evidence on true
   where payment.purpose = 'order' and payment.ref_id = p_order_id and payment.user_id = actor
   order by payment.created_at desc, payment.id desc
   limit 1;
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_order_return_pickup(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid := (select auth.uid()); viewer text; enabled boolean; pickup_count integer; direct_count integer;
begin
  select case when g.recipient_id = actor then 'recipient' when g.sender_id = actor then 'sender' when g.id is null and o.user_id = actor then 'buyer' end
  into viewer from public.orders o left join private.gift_intents g on g.order_id = o.id where o.id = p_order_id;
  if viewer is null or viewer = 'sender' then return jsonb_build_object('pickupBundles', 0, 'directBundles', 0); end if;
  select coalesce((select settings.pickup_enabled from private.return_pickup_settings settings where settings.singleton), false) into enabled;
  select count(*) filter (where x.pickup), count(*) filter (where not x.pickup) into pickup_count, direct_count
  from (select exists(select 1 from private.claim_return_pickups p where p.bundle_id = b.id
        and (p.state = 'requested' or (enabled and p.state in ('pending','failed')))) or private.claim_return_pickup_eligible(b) as pickup
    from public.order_cancellation_requests c join public.order_claim_collection_bundles b on b.claim_id = c.id
    where c.order_id = p_order_id and c.claim_type in ('return','exchange')
      and (case when c.stage = 'on_hold' then c.held_from else c.stage end) = 'collecting'
      and private.claim_return_pickup_block(b) is null) x;
  return jsonb_build_object('pickupBundles', coalesce(pickup_count, 0), 'directBundles', coalesce(direct_count, 0));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_product_detail_interests()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid(); result jsonb;
begin
 if actor is null or not (public.get_product_detail_experience_config()->>'interests')::boolean then
  return jsonb_build_object('ownerId',actor,'cart','[]'::jsonb,'wishlist','[]'::jsonb,'repurchase','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 with eligible as materialized (
  select g.id from public.goods g join public.ips ip on ip.id=g.ip_id where g.published_at is not null and g.archived_at is null
   and private.good_sale_restriction_visible(g.sale_restriction,(select auth.uid())) and ip.published_at is not null and ip.archived_at is null
 ), cart as (
  select c.good_id id,max(c.created_at) moment from public.cart_items c join eligible g on g.id=c.good_id where c.user_id=actor
   group by c.good_id order by moment desc,c.good_id limit 30
 ), wishes as (
  select w.good_id id,w.created_at moment from public.wishlists w join eligible g on g.id=w.good_id where w.user_id=actor
   order by moment desc,w.good_id limit 30
 ), repeated as (
  select i.good_id id,max(paid.approved_at) moment from private.product_detail_paid_orders(statement_timestamp()-interval '2 years',statement_timestamp()) paid
   join public.orders o on o.id=paid.id and o.user_id=actor join public.order_items i on i.order_id=o.id join eligible g on g.id=i.good_id
   group by i.good_id having count(distinct o.id)>=2 order by moment desc,i.good_id limit 30
 ) select jsonb_build_object('ownerId',actor,
  'cart',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(id order by moment desc,id) from cart),'[]'::jsonb),
  'wishlist',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(id order by moment desc,id) from wishes),'[]'::jsonb),
  'repurchase',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(id order by moment desc,id) from repeated),'[]'::jsonb)) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

   e.starts_on::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul',(e.ends_on+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul',e.announces_on::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul',
   ((e.announces_on+interval '1 year')::date+1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul']) boundary where e.archived_at is null and boundary>statement_timestamp())));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_storefront_category_menu()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

  select n.id,n.parent_id,1 depth,array[lpad(n.sort_order::text,10,'0')||':'||coalesce(n.legacy_sort_key,n.id::text)] path
  from private.category_display_nodes n where n.parent_id is null and n.archived_at is null
  union all select n.id,n.parent_id,t.depth+1,t.path||(lpad(n.sort_order::text,10,'0')||':'||coalesce(n.legacy_sort_key,n.id::text))
  from private.category_display_nodes n join display_tree t on n.parent_id=t.id where n.archived_at is null and t.depth<4
 ), flagged as (
  select t.id,t.parent_id,t.depth,t.path,n.name,n.image_path,
   exists(select 1 from private.category_display_compositions d where d.category_id=t.id and d.enabled
    and exists(select 1 from private.category_display_matching_goods(private.category_display_values(t.id)) limit 1)) navigable
  from display_tree t join private.category_display_nodes n on n.id=t.id
  where coalesce((select c.customer_enabled from public.category_activation_control c where c.id='catalog'),false)
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',f.id,'parentId',f.parent_id,'name',f.name,'depth',f.depth,'imagePath',f.image_path,'navigable',f.navigable) order by f.path),'[]'::jsonb)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.good_product_questions(target_good_id text, target_limit integer DEFAULT 10, target_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with viewer as (
    select
      (select auth.uid()) as id,
      coalesce(public.has_operator_capability('cs.manage'), false) as can_manage
  ),
  listed as (
    select
      question.id,
      question.good_id,
      question.user_id,
      question.body,
      question.status,
      question.is_secret,
      question.answer_body,
      question.answered_at,
      question.created_at,
      (
        not question.is_secret
        or (viewer.id is not null and question.user_id = viewer.id)
        or viewer.can_manage
      ) as readable
    from public.product_questions as question
    cross join viewer
    where question.good_id = target_good_id
      and question.status = 'visible'
  ),
  paged as (
    select listed.*
    from listed
    order by listed.created_at desc, listed.id desc
    limit least(greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 10), 1), 50)
    offset greatest(coalesce(target_offset, 0), 0)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'count', (select count(*) from listed),
    'rows', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          case when paged.readable then jsonb_build_object(
            'id', paged.id,
            'goodId', paged.good_id,
            'userId', paged.user_id,
            'body', paged.body,
            'status', paged.status,
            'isSecret', paged.is_secret,
            'masked', false,
            'answered', paged.answer_body is not null,
            'answerBody', paged.answer_body,
            'answeredAt', paged.answered_at,
            'createdAt', paged.created_at
          ) else jsonb_build_object(
            'id', paged.id,
            'goodId', paged.good_id,
            'userId', null,
            'body', null,
            'status', paged.status,
            'isSecret', true,
            'masked', true,
            'answered', paged.answer_body is not null,
            'answerBody', null,
            'answeredAt', null,
            'createdAt', paged.created_at
          ) end
          order by paged.created_at desc, paged.id desc
        )
        from paged
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.good_reviews(target_good_id text, target_sort text DEFAULT 'recent'::text, target_photo_only boolean DEFAULT false, target_limit integer DEFAULT 10, target_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, rating smallint, body text, image_paths text[], author_name text, is_mine boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, edited_at timestamp with time zone, admin_reply text, admin_reply_at timestamp with time zone, total_count bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_sort text := coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(target_sort, '')), ''), 'recent');
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 10), 1), 50);
  v_offset integer := greatest(coalesce(target_offset, 0), 0);
begin
  if v_sort not in ('recent', 'rating_desc', 'rating_asc') then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid_review_sort';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    review.id,
    review.rating,
    review.body,
    review.image_paths,
    coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(author.nickname, '')), ''),
      'fan_' || left(review.user_id::text, 6)
    ) as author_name,
    (v_actor is not null and review.user_id = v_actor) as is_mine,
    review.created_at,
    review.edited_at,
    review.admin_reply,
    review.admin_reply_at,
    count(*) over()::bigint as total_count
  from public.reviews as review
  join public.profiles as author on author.id = review.user_id
  where review.good_id = target_good_id
    and review.status = 'visible'
    and (
      not coalesce(target_photo_only, false)
      or cardinality(review.image_paths) > 0
    )
  order by
    case when v_sort = 'rating_desc' then review.rating end desc nulls last,
    case when v_sort = 'rating_asc' then review.rating end asc nulls last,
    review.created_at desc,
    review.id desc
  limit v_limit
  offset v_offset;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_order_transition_during_cancellation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  -- 출고 보류(테스트 키 결제·결제사 직접 취소)가 있으면 아직 나가지 않은 주문을 발송으로 넘기지 않는다.
  if new.status is distinct from old.status and new.status in ('shipping', 'delivered') and old.status in ('pending', 'paid', 'confirmed')
    and private.order_fulfillment_held(old.id) then
    raise exception using errcode = '23514', message = 'order fulfillment hold';
  end if;
  -- 결제사 확인을 기다리는 재고 부족 부분 취소(ADR-0032)가 있으면 발송·배송완료로 넘어가지 않는다.
  if new.status is distinct from old.status and new.status in ('shipping', 'delivered', 'done')
    and private.order_partial_cancel_in_flight(old.id) then
    raise exception using errcode = '23514', message = 'order cancellation in progress';
  end if;
  if new.status is distinct from old.status
    and new.status <> 'canceled'
    -- Arrival records an already-dispatched package; it never releases a
    -- not-yet-dispatched item or advances a refund.
    and not (old.status='shipping' and new.status='delivered'
      and private.order_return_intake_eligible(old.id)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_shipments s where s.order_id=old.id and (s.status<>'delivered' or s.delivered_at is null))
      and not exists(select 1 from public.order_cancellation_claims c where c.order_id=old.id))
    and (
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.order_cancellation_claims as claim
        where claim.order_id = old.id
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.order_cancellation_requests as request
        where request.order_id = old.id
          and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
      )
    )
  then
    raise exception using
      errcode = '23514',
      message = 'order cancellation in progress';
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_order_item_display(p_order_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, regular_unit_price integer, volume_unit_discount integer, active_qty integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare actor uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if actor is null then raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'auth required'; end if;
  if p_order_ids is null or cardinality(p_order_ids) > 1000 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_order_item_ids'; end if;
  return query
  select visible.id,
    case when parent.calculation_version = 2 and grouped.uniform then grouped.regular_price end,
    case when parent.calculation_version = 2 and grouped.uniform and grouped.regular_price is not null then grouped.volume_discount
         else 0 end,
    greatest(grouped.remaining, 0)
  from public.my_order_items(p_order_ids) visible
  join public.orders parent on parent.id = visible.order_id
  cross join lateral (
    select
      sum(private.order_item_active_qty(member.id))::integer as remaining,
      min(member.regular_unit_price_snapshot) as regular_price,
      min(member.volume_unit_discount)::integer as volume_discount,
      (count(distinct member.regular_unit_price_snapshot) <= 1
        and count(member.regular_unit_price_snapshot) in (0, count(*))
        and count(distinct member.volume_unit_discount) = 1
        and count(distinct member.unit_price) = 1) as uniform
    from public.order_items member
    where member.order_id = visible.order_id
      and (member.id = visible.id
        or (visible.option_sale_mode = 'random' and member.good_id = visible.good_id and member.option_sale_mode_snapshot = 'random'))
  ) grouped;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_order_items(p_order_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, order_id uuid, product_order_number text, good_id text, qty integer, unit_price integer, good_name_snapshot text, good_type_snapshot text, variant_id uuid, variant_name_snapshot text, variant_code_snapshot text, custom_inputs_snapshot jsonb, supply_source text, preorder_expected_ship_date date, option_sale_mode text, shipment_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid();
begin
  if actor is null then raise insufficient_privilege using message='auth required'; end if;
  if p_order_ids is null or cardinality(p_order_ids)>1000 then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_order_item_ids'; end if;
  return query
  with owned as (
    select item.id item_id,item.order_id item_order_id,item.good_id item_good_id,item.qty item_qty,item.option_sale_mode_snapshot item_mode
    from public.order_items item
    join public.orders o on o.id=item.order_id
    where item.order_id=any(p_order_ids) and o.user_id=actor and private.gift_direct_order_read_allowed(o.id,actor)
  ), random_groups as (
    select (array_agg(owned.item_id order by owned.item_id))[1] representative_id,least(sum(owned.item_qty::bigint),2147483647)::integer total_qty
    from owned where owned.item_mode='random' group by owned.item_order_id,owned.item_good_id
  ), visible as (
    select owned.item_id visible_id,owned.item_qty visible_qty,false visible_random from owned where owned.item_mode is null
    union all
    select random_groups.representative_id,random_groups.total_qty,true from random_groups
  )
  select item.id,item.order_id,item.product_order_number,item.good_id,visible.visible_qty,item.unit_price,item.good_name_snapshot,item.good_type_snapshot,
    case when visible.visible_random then coalesce((select key_variant.id from public.goods_variants key_variant
        where key_variant.good_id=item.good_id and key_variant.is_default and key_variant.archived_at is null limit 1),allocation.cart_variant_id)
      else item.variant_id end,
    case when visible.visible_random then '랜덤' else item.variant_name_snapshot end,
    case when visible.visible_random then null else item.variant_code_snapshot end,
    item.custom_inputs_snapshot,item.supply_source,item.preorder_expected_ship_date,
    case when visible.visible_random then 'random' else 'select' end,
    shipment_item.shipment_id
  from visible
  join public.order_items item on item.id=visible.visible_id
  left join private.order_item_random_allocations allocation on allocation.order_item_id=item.id
  left join public.order_shipment_items shipment_item on shipment_item.order_item_id=item.id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_review_targets(target_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, target_good_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, target_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(order_id uuid, good_id text, good_name text, good_bg text, good_image_path text, ordered_at timestamp with time zone, delivered_at timestamp with time zone, deadline_at timestamp with time zone, writable boolean, review_id uuid, review_rating smallint, review_body text, review_image_paths text[], review_status text, review_created_at timestamp with time zone, review_edited_at timestamp with time zone, admin_reply text, admin_reply_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(target_limit, 50), 1), 200);
begin
  if v_actor is null then
    raise invalid_authorization_specification using message = 'auth_required';
  end if;

  return query
  select
    ordered.id as order_id,
    item.good_id,
    good.name as good_name,
    good.bg as good_bg,
    good.image_path as good_image_path,
    ordered.created_at as ordered_at,
    ordered.delivered_at,
    private.review_write_deadline(ordered.delivered_at) as deadline_at,
    (
      review.id is null
      and ordered.delivered_at is not null
      and now() <= private.review_write_deadline(ordered.delivered_at)
    ) as writable,
    review.id as review_id,
    review.rating as review_rating,
    review.body as review_body,
    review.image_paths as review_image_paths,
    review.status as review_status,
    review.created_at as review_created_at,
    review.edited_at as review_edited_at,
    review.admin_reply,
    review.admin_reply_at
  from public.orders as ordered
  join public.order_items as item on item.order_id = ordered.id
  join public.goods as good on good.id = item.good_id
  left join public.reviews as review
    on review.order_id = ordered.id
    and review.good_id = item.good_id
    and review.user_id = v_actor
    and review.review_kind = 'ordinary'
  where ordered.user_id = v_actor
    and ordered.status in ('delivered', 'done')
    and (target_order_id is null or ordered.id = target_order_id)
    and (target_good_id is null or item.good_id = target_good_id)
  /* 쓸 수 있는 것이 먼저, 그중에서도 기한이 임박한 것이 위로. */
  order by
    case when review.id is null then 0 else 1 end,
    ordered.delivered_at desc nulls last,
    item.good_id
  limit v_limit;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prepare_ticket_payment_attempt(p_user_id uuid, p_ticket_order_id uuid, p_provider public.payment_provider)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_order public.ticket_orders%rowtype;
  v_attempt public.payment_attempts%rowtype;
  v_attempt_id uuid;
begin
  if p_user_id is null
    or p_ticket_order_id is null
    or p_provider not in ('toss', 'korpay')
  then
    raise object_not_in_prerequisite_state using message = 'ticket_payment_unavailable';
  end if;

  select ticket_order.*
  into v_order
  from public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
  where ticket_order.id = p_ticket_order_id
  for update;

  if not found or v_order.user_id is distinct from p_user_id then
    raise no_data_found using message = 'ticket_order_not_found';
  end if;

  perform request.id
  from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
  where request.ticket_order_id = v_order.id
    and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  order by request.requested_at desc, request.id
  for update of request;
  if found then
    raise object_not_in_prerequisite_state using message = 'ticket_cancellation_in_progress';
  end if;

  if v_order.status is distinct from 'pending'
    or v_order.expires_at is null
    or v_order.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    or v_order.total <= 0
    or private.is_account_write_fenced(p_user_id)
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles as profile
      where profile.id = p_user_id
        and profile.suspended_at is not null
    )
    or not private.ticket_order_snapshot_matches(
      v_order.id,
      v_order.event_id,
      v_order.total
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.tickets as ticket
      where ticket.ticket_order_id = v_order.id
    )
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.payments as payment
      where payment.purpose = 'ticket'
        and payment.ref_id = v_order.id
        and payment.status in ('pending', 'paid')
    )
  then
    raise object_not_in_prerequisite_state using message = 'ticket_order_not_payable';
  end if;

  select attempt.*
  into v_attempt
  from public.payment_attempts as attempt
  where attempt.purpose = 'ticket'
    and attempt.ref_id = v_order.id
  for update;

  if found then
    if v_attempt.user_id is distinct from p_user_id
      or v_attempt.provider is distinct from p_provider
      or v_attempt.amount is distinct from v_order.total
      or v_attempt.currency is distinct from 'KRW'
      or v_attempt.state is distinct from 'prepared'
      or v_attempt.expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    then
      raise object_not_in_prerequisite_state using message = 'ticket_payment_attempt_not_preparable';
    end if;
    return private.ticket_payment_attempt_json(v_attempt);
  end if;

  v_attempt_id := extensions.gen_random_uuid();
  insert into public.payment_attempts (
    id,
    provider,
    user_id,
    purpose,
    ref_id,
    amount,
    currency,
    state,
    idempotency_key,
    provider_order_id,
    provider_product_code,
    expires_at
  )
  values (
    v_attempt_id,
    p_provider,
    p_user_id,
    'ticket',
    v_order.id,
    v_order.total,
    'KRW',
    'prepared',
    'ticket:' || v_order.id::text,
    'T' || pg_catalog.replace(v_attempt_id::text, '-', ''),
    'P' || pg_catalog.replace(v_attempt_id::text, '-', ''),
    least(v_order.expires_at, pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() + interval '10 minutes')
  )
  returning * into v_attempt;

  return private.ticket_payment_attempt_json(v_attempt);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_bank_deposits(p_source text, p_deposits jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_source text := nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_source, '')), '');
  v_inserted integer := 0;
begin
  if v_source is null or char_length(v_source) > 40 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_deposit_source';
  end if;

  if p_deposits is null or jsonb_typeof(p_deposits) <> 'array' then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_deposit_batch';
  end if;

  with candidate as (
    select
      nullif(btrim(entry ->> 'externalId'), '') as external_id,
      (entry ->> 'depositedAt')::timestamptz as deposited_at,
      nullif(btrim(entry ->> 'depositorName'), '') as depositor_name,
      (entry ->> 'amount')::bigint as amount,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(entry ->> 'rawReference', '')), '') as raw_reference
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_deposits) as entry
  ),
  inserted as (
    insert into public.bank_deposits (
      source, external_id, deposited_at, depositor_name, amount, raw_reference
    )
    select
      v_source,
      candidate.external_id,
      candidate.deposited_at,
      candidate.depositor_name,
      candidate.amount,
      candidate.raw_reference
    from candidate
    where candidate.external_id is not null
      and candidate.deposited_at is not null
      and candidate.depositor_name is not null
      and candidate.amount > 0
    -- 이미 본 입금은 조용히 넘어간다. 두 번째 적재가 오류가 되면 재수집이
    -- 배치 하나 때문에 통째로 실패한다.
    on conflict (source, external_id) do nothing
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*)::integer into v_inserted from inserted;

  return v_inserted;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_ticket_provider_cancellation_evidence(p_ticket_order_id uuid, p_reason text, p_provider_payment_key text, p_provider_raw jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_refund_confirmed boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_order_user_id uuid;
  v_order_status public.ticket_order_status;
  v_order_total bigint;
  v_event_id text;
  v_cutoff_at timestamptz;
  v_request_id uuid;
  v_request_status text;
  v_payment_id uuid;
  v_payment_user_id uuid;
  v_payment_purpose public.payment_purpose;
  v_payment_ref_id uuid;
  v_payment_amount bigint;
  v_payment_status public.payment_status;
  v_payment_key text;
  v_idempotency_key text;
begin
  if p_refund_confirmed is null
    or (p_refund_confirmed and p_provider_raw is null)
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'verified refund evidence required';
  end if;

  if p_reason is null
    or btrim(p_reason) <> p_reason
    or length(p_reason) not between 1 and 200
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid cancellation reason';
  end if;

  if p_provider_payment_key is null
    or nullif(btrim(p_provider_payment_key), '') is null
    or length(p_provider_payment_key) > 200
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'invalid payment evidence';
  end if;

  select
    ticket_order.user_id,
    ticket_order.status,
    ticket_order.total,
    ticket_order.event_id
  into
    v_order_user_id,
    v_order_status,
    v_order_total,
    v_event_id
  from public.ticket_orders as ticket_order
  where ticket_order.id = p_ticket_order_id
  for update of ticket_order;

  if not found then
    raise no_data_found using message = 'ticket order not found';
  end if;

  select request.id, request.status
  into v_request_id, v_request_status
  from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
  where request.ticket_order_id = p_ticket_order_id
    and request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review')
  order by request.requested_at desc, request.id
  limit 1
  for update of request;

  if not found then
    select request.id, request.status
    into v_request_id, v_request_status
    from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
    where request.ticket_order_id = p_ticket_order_id
      and request.status = 'completed'
    order by request.requested_at desc, request.id
    limit 1
    for update of request;
  end if;

  if v_request_id is null then
    select event_record.starts_at
    into v_cutoff_at
    from public.events as event_record
    where event_record.id = v_event_id
    for share of event_record;

    insert into public.ticket_cancellation_requests (
      ticket_order_id,
      requested_by,
      source,
      status,
      policy_code,
      cutoff_at,
      gross_amount,
      fee_amount,
      refund_amount,
      reason,
      provider_started_at,
      completed_at
    )
    values (
      p_ticket_order_id,
      v_order_user_id,
      'provider',
      case when v_order_status = 'canceled' then 'completed' else 'processing' end,
      'event_start_full_refund_v1',
      v_cutoff_at,
      v_order_total,
      0,
      v_order_total,
      p_reason,
      now(),
      case when v_order_status = 'canceled' then now() else null end
    )
    returning id, status into v_request_id, v_request_status;
  end if;

  perform payment.id
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.purpose = 'ticket'
    and payment.ref_id = p_ticket_order_id
  order by payment.id
  for update of payment;

  perform ticket.id
  from public.tickets as ticket
  where ticket.ticket_order_id = p_ticket_order_id
  order by ticket.id
  for update of ticket;

  perform ticket_type.id
  from public.ticket_types as ticket_type
  where ticket_type.id in (
    select ticket.ticket_type_id
    from public.tickets as ticket
    where ticket.ticket_order_id = p_ticket_order_id
  )
  order by ticket_type.id
  for update of ticket_type;

  select
    payment.id,
    payment.user_id,
    payment.purpose,
    payment.ref_id,
    payment.amount,
    payment.status,
    payment.payment_key,
    payment.idempotency_key
  into
    v_payment_id,
    v_payment_user_id,
    v_payment_purpose,
    v_payment_ref_id,
    v_payment_amount,
    v_payment_status,
    v_payment_key,
    v_idempotency_key
  from public.payments as payment
  where payment.payment_key = p_provider_payment_key;

  if not found
    or v_payment_purpose is distinct from 'ticket'
    or v_payment_ref_id is distinct from p_ticket_order_id
    or v_payment_user_id is distinct from v_order_user_id
    or v_payment_amount is distinct from v_order_total
    or v_payment_key is distinct from p_provider_payment_key
    or v_idempotency_key is distinct from p_provider_payment_key
  then
    raise check_violation using message = 'payment evidence mismatch';
  end if;

  if p_provider_raw is not null then
    update public.payments
    set raw = p_provider_raw
    where id = v_payment_id;
  end if;

  if p_refund_confirmed or v_payment_status in ('paid', 'refunded') then
    insert into public.refunds (
      payment_id,
      amount,
      reason,
      status,
      ticket_cancellation_request_id
    )
    values (
      v_payment_id,
      v_payment_amount,
      p_reason,
      'done',
      v_request_id
    )
    on conflict (payment_id) do update
    set
      amount = excluded.amount,
      reason = coalesce(public.refunds.reason, excluded.reason),
      status = 'done',
      ticket_cancellation_request_id = coalesce(
        public.refunds.ticket_cancellation_request_id,
        excluded.ticket_cancellation_request_id
      );

    update public.payments
    set status = 'refunded'
    where id = v_payment_id;
  elsif v_payment_status in ('pending', 'failed') then
    update public.payments
    set status = 'canceled'
    where id = v_payment_id;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.tickets as ticket
    where ticket.ticket_order_id = p_ticket_order_id
      and ticket.status = 'used'
  ) and v_request_status <> 'completed' then
    update public.ticket_cancellation_requests
    set
      status = 'needs_review',
      attempt_token = null,
      last_error_code = 'used_ticket_after_provider_cancellation'
    where id = v_request_id;

    insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
    values (
      null,
      'ticket.cancellation.needs_review',
      'ticket_order:' || p_ticket_order_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'requestId', v_request_id,
        'source', 'provider',
        'to', 'needs_review',
        'errorCode', 'used_ticket_after_provider_cancellation'
      )
    );
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target, diff)
  values (
    null,
    'ticket.cancellation.provider_evidence_recorded',
    'ticket_order:' || p_ticket_order_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'requestId', v_request_id,
      'paymentCount', 1,
      'paymentState', v_payment_status::text
    )
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refund_ticket_order_with_provider_evidence(p_ticket_order_id uuid, p_reason text, p_provider_payment_key text, p_provider_raw jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_refund_confirmed boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_request_id uuid;
  v_actor_id uuid;
begin
  perform public.record_ticket_provider_cancellation_evidence(
    p_ticket_order_id,
    p_reason,
    p_provider_payment_key,
    p_provider_raw,
    p_refund_confirmed
  );

  select request.id, request.requested_by
  into v_request_id, v_actor_id
  from public.ticket_cancellation_requests as request
  where request.ticket_order_id = p_ticket_order_id
  order by
    case when request.status in ('requested', 'processing', 'needs_review') then 0 else 1 end,
    request.requested_at desc,
    request.id
  limit 1;

  if v_request_id is not null then
    perform public.finalize_ticket_cancellation_request(v_request_id, v_actor_id);
  end if;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('source',l.source,'targetId',case l.source when 'home' then 'home' when 'good' then l.good_id when 'story' then l.story_id::text when 'category' then l.category_id::text end)
 from private.marketing_links l where p_token ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' and l.token=p_token and private.marketing_link_available(l);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_faq_entries(target_query text DEFAULT ''::text, target_category text DEFAULT ''::text, page_limit integer DEFAULT 20, page_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with words as (
    select word from unnest(regexp_split_to_array(lower(left(btrim(coalesce(target_query,'')),200)), '[[:space:][:punct:]]+')) word
    where char_length(word) >= 2
  ), matches as (
    select entry.* from public.faq_entries entry
    where entry.is_published
      and (coalesce(target_category,'') = '' or entry.category = target_category)
      and (btrim(coalesce(target_query,'')) = '' or exists (
        select 1 from words where strpos(lower(entry.question || ' ' || entry.answer),word) > 0
      ))
  ), selected as (
    select * from matches order by sort_order, id
    limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(page_limit,20),50)) offset greatest(0,least(coalesce(page_offset,0),200000))
  )
  select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from matches),'entries',coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'category',category,'question',question,'answer',answer,
      'sortOrder',sort_order,'published',is_published,'updatedAt',updated_at) order by sort_order,id) from selected
  ),'[]'::jsonb));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_public_content(search_query text, per_group_limit integer DEFAULT 6)
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, id text, label text, subtitle text, ip_id text, ip_title text, image_path text, bg text, accent text, score real)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with raw_params as (
    select
      nullif(left(btrim(search_query), 80), '') as q,
      greatest(1, least(coalesce(per_group_limit, 6), 20)) as result_limit,
      auth.uid() as actor_id
  ),
  params as (
    select
      raw_params.q,
      case
        when raw_params.q is null then null
        else '%' || replace(replace(replace(raw_params.q, E'\\', E'\\\\'), '%', E'\\%'), '_', E'\\_') || '%'
      end as q_like,
      raw_params.result_limit,
      raw_params.actor_id
    from raw_params
  ),
  visible_posts as (
    select
      posts.id,
      posts.user_id,
      posts.ip_id,
      posts.text,
      posts.tag,
      posts.image_path,
      ips.title as ip_title,
      verticals.color as accent
    from public.posts
    left join public.ips on ips.id = posts.ip_id
    left join public.verticals on verticals.key = ips.vertical_key
    cross join params
    where params.q is not null
      and posts.status = 'visible'
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.blocks
        where blocks.user_id = params.actor_id
          and blocks.blocked_user_id = posts.user_id
      )
  ),
  all_matches as (
    select
      'ip'::text as kind,
      ips.id::text as id,
      ips.title as label,
      concat_ws(' · ', verticals.label, ips.sub) as subtitle,
      ips.id::text as ip_id,
      ips.title as ip_title,
      ips.image_path,
      ips.bg,
      verticals.color as accent,
      greatest(
        extensions.similarity(ips.title, params.q),
        case when ips.title ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 1 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(ips.sub, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.7 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(ips.tagline, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.6 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(ips.synopsis, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.4 else 0 end
      )::real as score,
      params.result_limit
    from params
    join public.ips on params.q is not null
    join public.verticals on verticals.key = ips.vertical_key
    where ips.archived_at is null
      and ips.published_at is not null
      and (
        ips.title ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or coalesce(ips.sub, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or coalesce(ips.tagline, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or coalesce(ips.synopsis, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or extensions.similarity(ips.title, params.q) > 0.15
      )

    union all

    select
      'good'::text as kind,
      goods.id::text as id,
      goods.name as label,
      concat_ws(' · ', ips.title, nullif(good_category.name, '')) as subtitle,
      goods.ip_id::text,
      ips.title as ip_title,
      goods.image_path,
      goods.bg,
      verticals.color as accent,
      greatest(
        extensions.similarity(goods.name, params.q),
        case when goods.name ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 1 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(good_category.name, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.7 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(goods.badge, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.4 else 0 end,
        case when ips.title ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.35 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(goods.name_en, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.8 else 0 end,
        coalesce((
          select max(greatest(
            case when keyword ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 1 else 0 end,
            extensions.similarity(keyword, params.q)
          ))
          from unnest(goods.search_keywords) as keyword
        ), 0)
      )::real as score,
      params.result_limit
    from params
    join public.goods on params.q is not null
    join public.ips on ips.id = goods.ip_id
    left join public.catalog_categories as good_category
      on good_category.id = goods.category_id and good_category.archived_at is null and private.category_customer_enabled()
    join public.verticals on verticals.key = ips.vertical_key
    where goods.archived_at is null
      and goods.published_at is not null
      and ips.archived_at is null
      and ips.published_at is not null
      and private.good_sale_restriction_visible(goods.sale_restriction,params.actor_id)
      and (
        goods.name ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or coalesce(good_category.name, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or coalesce(goods.badge, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or ips.title ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or coalesce(goods.name_en, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or extensions.similarity(goods.name, params.q) > 0.15
        or exists (
          select 1
          from unnest(goods.search_keywords) as keyword
          where keyword ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
            or extensions.similarity(keyword, params.q) > 0.15
        )
      )

    union all

    select
      'card'::text as kind,
      cards.id::text as id,
      cards.name as label,
      concat_ws(' · ', ips.title, cards.rarity::text, cards.no) as subtitle,
      cards.ip_id::text,
      ips.title as ip_title,
      cards.image_path,
      cards.bg,
      verticals.color as accent,
      greatest(
        extensions.similarity(cards.name, params.q),
        case when cards.name ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 1 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(cards.no, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.5 else 0 end,
        case when cards.rarity::text ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.5 else 0 end,
        case when ips.title ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.35 else 0 end
      )::real as score,
      params.result_limit
    from params
    join public.cards on params.q is not null
    join public.ips on ips.id = cards.ip_id
    join public.verticals on verticals.key = ips.vertical_key
    where cards.archived_at is null
      and ips.archived_at is null
      and ips.published_at is not null
      and (
        cards.name ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or coalesce(cards.no, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or cards.rarity::text ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or ips.title ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
        or extensions.similarity(cards.name, params.q) > 0.15
      )

    union all

    select
      'post'::text as kind,
      visible_posts.id::text as id,
      visible_posts.text as label,
      concat_ws(' · ', visible_posts.ip_title, case when visible_posts.tag is null then null else '#' || visible_posts.tag end) as subtitle,
      visible_posts.ip_id::text,
      visible_posts.ip_title,
      null::text as image_path,
      null::text as bg,
      visible_posts.accent,
      greatest(
        extensions.similarity(visible_posts.text, params.q),
        case when visible_posts.text ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 1 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(visible_posts.tag, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.8 else 0 end,
        case when coalesce(visible_posts.ip_title, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 0.35 else 0 end
      )::real as score,
      params.result_limit
    from params
    join visible_posts on true
    where visible_posts.text ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
      or coalesce(visible_posts.tag, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
      or coalesce(visible_posts.ip_title, '') ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
      or extensions.similarity(visible_posts.text, params.q) > 0.15

    union all

    select
      'tag'::text as kind,
      visible_posts.tag as id,
      '#' || visible_posts.tag as label,
      '커뮤니티 태그'::text as subtitle,
      null::text as ip_id,
      null::text as ip_title,
      null::text as image_path,
      null::text as bg,
      max(visible_posts.accent) as accent,
      max(greatest(
        extensions.similarity(visible_posts.tag, params.q),
        case when visible_posts.tag ilike params.q_like escape E'\\' then 1 else 0 end
      ))::real as score,
      params.result_limit
    from params
    join visible_posts on visible_posts.tag is not null
    where visible_posts.tag ilike params.q_like escape E'\\'
      or extensions.similarity(visible_posts.tag, params.q) > 0.15
    group by visible_posts.tag, params.result_limit
  ),
  ranked as (
    select
      all_matches.*,
      row_number() over (
        partition by all_matches.kind
        order by all_matches.score desc, all_matches.label asc, all_matches.id asc
      ) as group_rank
    from all_matches
  )
  select
    ranked.kind,
    ranked.id,
    ranked.label,
    ranked.subtitle,
    ranked.ip_id,
    ranked.ip_title,
    ranked.image_path,
    ranked.bg,
    ranked.accent,
    ranked.score
  from ranked
  where ranked.group_rank <= ranked.result_limit
  order by
    case ranked.kind
      when 'ip' then 1
      when 'good' then 2
      when 'card' then 3
      when 'post' then 4
      when 'tag' then 5
      else 6
    end,
    ranked.score desc,
    ranked.label asc,
    ranked.id asc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_acquire_goods_import_work(target_batch uuid, target_actor uuid, target_token uuid)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_admin_artwork_upload_block_reason(p_actor_id uuid, p_stage text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_actor_id is null or p_stage is null or p_stage not in ('prepare', 'verify') then null
    when p_stage = 'verify' and exists (
      select 1
      from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
      where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
        and claim.status = 'processing'
        and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
    ) then 'verification_in_progress'
    when p_stage = 'verify' and (
      select count(*)
      from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
      where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
        and claim.processing_started_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '1 minute'
    ) >= 22 then 'verification_rate_limited'
    when p_stage = 'prepare' and (
      select count(*)
      from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
      where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
        and claim.status in ('pending', 'processing')
        and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
    ) >= 22 then 'staging_full'
    when p_stage = 'prepare' and (
      select count(*)
      from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
      where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
        and claim.status = 'verified'
        and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.now()
    ) >= 60 then 'unsaved_full'
    else null
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_begin_admin_artwork_verification(p_actor_id uuid, p_path text)
 RETURNS TABLE(kind text, mime_type text, source_size integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_operator_subjects(array[p_actor_id]);
  if not private.has_operator_capability(p_actor_id,private.operator_artwork_capability((select claim.kind from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims claim where claim.actor_id=p_actor_id and claim.path=p_path))) then return; end if;

  if p_actor_id is null
    or p_path is null
    or not exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles as profile
      where profile.id = p_actor_id
        and profile.role in ('staff', 'admin')
        and profile.suspended_at is null
    )
  then
    return;
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended('admin-artwork-upload:' || p_actor_id::text, 0)
  );

  -- actor 별 동시 processing 은 1개다. 이 직렬화는 그대로 유지한다.
  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
    where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
      and claim.status = 'processing'
      and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  ) or (
    -- 남용 억제 창. 굿즈 폼 11칸(대표 1 + 추가 이미지 9 + 상세 1)을 채우고 한 번 갈아끼울 수 있어야 한다.
    select count(*)
    from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
    where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
      and claim.processing_started_at >= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() - interval '1 minute'
  ) >= 22 then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  update public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
  set
    status = 'processing',
    processing_started_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
    and claim.path = p_path
    and claim.status = 'pending'
    and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles as profile
      where profile.id = claim.actor_id
        and profile.role in ('staff', 'admin')
        and profile.suspended_at is null
    )
  returning claim.kind, claim.mime_type, claim.source_size;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_cache_goods_import_images(target_batch uuid, target_actor uuid, target_index integer, target_images jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

 if jsonb_typeof(target_images) is distinct from 'object' or exists(select 1 from jsonb_object_keys(target_images) key where key not in ('image_path','gallery_paths','detail_image_path')) then raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_import_images'; end if;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_cancel_admin_artwork_upload(p_actor_id uuid, p_path text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
  set

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_cancel_goods_media_upload(p_actor_id uuid, p_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_actor_id is null then return false;end if;
 -- A verifier may finish its Storage upload after an expired processing lease
 -- was already cleaned. Re-open that same owned claim for another cleanup.
 -- This is used only after a confirmed rejection, never an unknown receipt.
 update private.goods_media_assets set status='rejected',expires_at=clock_timestamp(),cleanup_claimed_at=null,cleanup_completed_at=null where id=p_id and actor_id=p_actor_id and status in('pending','processing','verified','rejected','cleanup','cleaned')
  and not exists(select 1 from private.goods_media_bindings b where b.video_asset_id=p_id or b.shortclip_asset_id=p_id);
 return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_claim_digital_cleanup(p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare result jsonb;begin
 if p_limit not between 1 and 50 then raise invalid_parameter_value;end if;
 with candidates as(select id from private.goods_digital_assets where state in('pending','verified','retired') and expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
  and(cleanup_claimed_at is null or cleanup_claimed_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '10 minutes') and not private.digital_asset_referenced(id)
  order by expires_at,id for update skip locked limit p_limit), claimed as(
 update private.goods_digital_assets a set state='retired',cleanup_claimed_at=clock_timestamp() from candidates c where a.id=c.id returning a.*)

  and(not in_library or state<>'verified') and not exists(select 1 from public.inquiry_messages where f.id=any(file_ids))
