CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_claim_payment_reconciliation_candidates(p_limit integer, p_providers text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare at timestamptz := clock_timestamp(); result jsonb;
begin
  if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 5 or p_providers is null or cardinality(p_providers) > 4
    or array_position(p_providers, null) is not null or not (p_providers <@ array['toss', 'nicepay']::text[]) then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_reconciliation_candidate_filter';
  end if;
  with picked as (
    select c.id, c.purpose, c.provider, c.ref_id, c.last_checked_at, c.updated_at from (
      select a.id, a.purpose, a.provider, a.ref_id, a.updated_at,
        greatest(
          (select max(g.requested_at) from private.goods_payment_reconciliation_audits g where g.target_id = a.id),
          (select max(t.requested_at) from private.ticket_payment_reconciliation_audits t where t.target_id = a.id),
          (select m.last_picked_at from private.payment_reconciliation_auto_checks m where m.attempt_id = a.id)) as last_checked_at
      from public.payment_attempts a
      where a.state in ('unknown', 'confirming')
        and private.payment_attempt_unresolved(a.state, a.claim_expires_at, at)
        and ((a.purpose = 'order' and a.provider in ('toss', 'nicepay')) or (a.purpose = 'ticket' and a.provider = 'toss'))
        and a.provider::text = any(p_providers)
        and a.updated_at <= at - interval '10 minutes'
        and a.created_at >= at - interval '7 days'
    ) c
    where c.last_checked_at is null or c.last_checked_at <= at - interval '30 minutes'
    order by c.last_checked_at nulls first, c.updated_at, c.id
    limit p_limit
  ), marked as (
    insert into private.payment_reconciliation_auto_checks as m(attempt_id, last_picked_at)
    select id, at from picked
    on conflict (attempt_id) do update set last_picked_at = excluded.last_picked_at, picks = m.picks + 1
    returning m.attempt_id
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('attemptId', p.id, 'purpose', p.purpose, 'provider', p.provider, 'refId', p.ref_id)
    order by p.last_checked_at nulls first, p.updated_at, p.id), '[]'::jsonb)
  into result
  from picked p where p.id in (select attempt_id from marked);
  return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_complete_admin_artwork_cleanup(p_actor_id uuid, p_path text, p_mode text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_mode = 'staging' then
    update public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
    set staging_cleaned_at = clock_timestamp()
    where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
      and claim.path = p_path
      and claim.status in ('verified', 'attached')
      and claim.staging_cleaned_at is null;
  elsif p_mode = 'all' then
    update public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
    set
      status = case
        when claim.status in ('pending', 'processing', 'verified') then 'expired'
        else claim.status
      end,
      resolved_at = coalesce(claim.resolved_at, clock_timestamp()),
      staging_cleaned_at = coalesce(claim.staging_cleaned_at, clock_timestamp()),
      cleanup_completed_at = clock_timestamp()
    where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
      and claim.path = p_path
      and claim.cleanup_completed_at is null
      and (
        claim.status = 'rejected'
        or (
          claim.status in ('pending', 'processing', 'verified')
          and claim.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
        )
      );
  else
    return false;
  end if;

  return found;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_complete_goods_media_cleanup(p_id uuid, p_mode text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_mode='staging' then
  update private.goods_media_assets set staging_cleaned_at=clock_timestamp() where id=p_id and status in('verified','attached','retired');
 elsif p_mode='all' then
  update private.goods_media_assets set status='cleaned',cleanup_completed_at=clock_timestamp(),staging_cleaned_at=coalesce(staging_cleaned_at,clock_timestamp()) where id=p_id and status='cleanup'
   and not exists(select 1 from private.goods_media_bindings b where b.video_asset_id=p_id or b.shortclip_asset_id=p_id);
 else return false;end if;
 return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_erp_note_access(p_outcome text, p_table text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_columns text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_filters text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_count integer DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_outcome = 'denied' then
    insert into private.erp_read_access_rollup (bucket, table_name, outcome, calls, last_at)
    values (date_trunc('minute', clock_timestamp()), '', 'denied', greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_count, 1), 100000)), clock_timestamp())
    on conflict (bucket, table_name, outcome)
    do update set calls = private.erp_read_access_rollup.calls + excluded.calls, last_at = excluded.last_at;
    return;
  end if;
  if p_outcome is null or p_outcome not in ('rejected', 'failed') then
    raise exception 'erp_read_invalid_outcome' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  insert into private.erp_read_access_log (outcome, table_name, column_names, filter_columns)
  values (
    p_outcome,
    case when p_table ~ '^(public|private|auth)\.[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$' then p_table end,
    (select array_agg(u.c order by u.ord) from unnest(p_columns) with ordinality as u(c, ord)
      where u.c ~ '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$' and u.ord <= 400),
    (select array_agg(u.c order by u.ord) from unnest(p_filters) with ordinality as u(c, ord)
      where u.c ~ '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$' and u.ord <= 400)
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_get_checkout_draft(p_user_id uuid, p_draft_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', draft.id,
    'source', draft.source,
    'baseGoodId', draft.base_good_id,
    'expiresAt', draft.expires_at,
    'closed', case when state.live then null else 'expired' end,
    'usedOrderId', case when draft.order_id is not null and private.checkout_draft_order_settled(draft.order_id) then draft.order_id end,
    'lines', case when state.live then (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('goodId', line ->> 'goodId', 'variantId', line ->> 'variantId',
        'qty', (line ->> 'qty')::integer, 'customInputs', line -> 'inputSnapshot') order by position), '[]'::jsonb)
      from jsonb_array_elements(draft.lines) with ordinality as entries(line, position)) else '[]'::jsonb end,
    'stale', state.live and draft.source = 'selection' and exists (
      select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(draft.lines) as line
      where not exists (
        select 1 from public.cart_items as cart
        where cart.user_id = draft.user_id and cart.id = (line ->> 'cartItemId')::uuid
          and cart.good_id = line ->> 'goodId' and cart.variant_id = (line ->> 'variantId')::uuid
          and cart.qty = (line ->> 'qty')::integer and cart.input_revision = (line ->> 'inputRevision')::integer
          and cart.input_values = line -> 'inputValues')))
  from private.checkout_drafts as draft
  cross join lateral (select draft.scrubbed_at is null and draft.expires_at > statement_timestamp() as live) as state
  where draft.id = p_draft_id and draft.user_id = p_user_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_list_admin_artwork_cleanup_candidates(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS TABLE(actor_id uuid, path text, cleanup_mode text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    claim.actor_id,
    claim.path,
    case
      when claim.status = 'attached'
      then 'staging'::text
      when claim.status = 'verified'
        and claim.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
      then 'staging'::text
      else 'all'::text
    end as cleanup_mode
  from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
  where (
      claim.status = 'rejected'
      and claim.cleanup_completed_at is null
    )
    or (
      claim.status in ('pending', 'processing', 'verified')
      and claim.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
      and claim.cleanup_completed_at is null
    )
    or (
      claim.status in ('verified', 'attached')
      and claim.staging_cleaned_at is null
    )
  order by claim.created_at
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 100);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_list_order_retry_sources(p_user_id uuid, p_order_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'orderId', hold.order_id,
      'source', case when hold.source in ('direct_checkout', 'direct_transaction') then 'direct' else 'cart' end,
      'awaitingPayment', hold.state = 'awaiting_payment',
      'paymentUnresolved', hold.state = 'awaiting_payment' and private.checkout_draft_order_payment_unresolved(hold.order_id),
      'baseGoodId', case when hold.source in ('direct_checkout', 'direct_transaction') then hold.base_good_id end,
      'retryOrderId', (
        select draft.order_id from private.checkout_drafts as draft
        where draft.retry_order_id = hold.order_id and draft.user_id = p_user_id and draft.order_id is not null
          and (private.checkout_draft_order_settled(draft.order_id) or private.checkout_draft_order_payment_unresolved(draft.order_id))))
    order by hold.order_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  from private.cart_order_holds as hold
  join public.orders as o on o.id = hold.order_id
  where p_user_id is not null and p_order_ids is not null and pg_catalog.cardinality(p_order_ids) <= 500
    and hold.user_id = p_user_id and o.user_id = p_user_id and hold.order_id = any (p_order_ids)
    and o.payment_method = 'card'
    and ((hold.state = 'awaiting_payment' and o.status = 'pending')
      or (hold.state = 'released' and hold.release_reason is distinct from 'detached' and o.status = 'canceled'
        /* settle_cart_order_hold는 결제 여부와 무관하게 pending→canceled 보류를 released로 바꾼다. 결제가 승인됐다가 취소로 환불된
           주문(payments paid·refunded, 시도 approved)은 '결제 없이 닫힌' 주문이 아니다 — checkout_draft_order_settled와 같은 판정. */
        and not private.checkout_draft_order_settled(hold.order_id)
        and not exists (
          select 1 from public.payment_attempts as attempt
          where attempt.purpose = 'order' and attempt.ref_id = hold.order_id and attempt.state = 'approved')));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_list_unpaid_checkout_orders(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'id', unpaid.id, 'orderNumber', unpaid.order_number, 'total', unpaid.total, 'createdAt', unpaid.created_at,
      'itemName', unpaid.item_name, 'itemCount', unpaid.item_count, 'goodIds', unpaid.good_ids, 'variantIds', unpaid.variant_ids,
      'userCouponIds', unpaid.user_coupon_ids, 'releasable', unpaid.releasable)
    order by unpaid.created_at desc, unpaid.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select o.id, o.order_number, o.total, o.created_at,
      (select item.good_name_snapshot from public.order_items as item where item.order_id = o.id
        order by item.product_order_number nulls last, item.id limit 1) as item_name,
      (select pg_catalog.count(*)::integer from public.order_items as item where item.order_id = o.id) as item_count,
      (select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(distinct item.good_id), '[]'::jsonb) from public.order_items as item where item.order_id = o.id) as good_ids,
      (select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(distinct item.variant_id), '[]'::jsonb) from public.order_items as item
        where item.order_id = o.id and item.variant_id is not null) as variant_ids,
      (select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(distinct used.id), '[]'::jsonb) from (
        select redemption.user_coupon_id as id from public.coupon_redemptions as redemption
        where redemption.order_id = o.id and redemption.status = 'applied'
        union
        select held.id from public.user_coupons as held where held.used_order_id = o.id
      ) as used) as user_coupon_ids,
      not private.checkout_draft_order_payment_unresolved(o.id) as releasable
    from private.cart_order_holds as hold
    join public.orders as o on o.id = hold.order_id
    where p_user_id is not null and hold.user_id = p_user_id and hold.state = 'awaiting_payment'
      and o.user_id = p_user_id and o.status = 'pending' and o.payment_method = 'card'
    order by o.created_at desc, o.id desc
    limit 20
  ) as unpaid;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_log_admin_artwork_cleanup_failure(p_actor_id uuid, p_path text, p_bucket text, p_stage text)

  return true;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_prepare_admin_artwork_upload(p_actor_id uuid, p_path text, p_kind text, p_mime_type text, p_source_size integer, p_expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_operator_subjects(array[p_actor_id]);
  if not private.has_operator_capability(p_actor_id,private.operator_artwork_capability(p_kind)) then return false; end if;

  if p_actor_id is null
    or p_path is null
    or p_kind is null
    or p_kind not in ('ip', 'good', 'card', 'event', 'curation')
    or p_mime_type is null
    or p_mime_type not in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')
    or p_source_size is null
    or p_source_size < 1
    or p_source_size > (case when p_kind = 'good' then 20 * 1024 * 1024 else 5 * 1024 * 1024 end)
    or p_expires_at is null
    or p_expires_at <= pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    or p_expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() + interval '15 minutes'
    or p_path !~ '^catalog/(ip|good|card|event|curation)/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}[.](jpg|png|webp)$'
    or p_path not like 'catalog/' || p_kind || '/%'
    or not (
      (p_mime_type = 'image/jpeg' and p_path like '%.jpg')
      or (p_mime_type = 'image/png' and p_path like '%.png')
      or (p_mime_type = 'image/webp' and p_path like '%.webp')
    )
    or not exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles as profile
      where profile.id = p_actor_id
        and profile.role in ('staff', 'admin')
        and profile.suspended_at is null
    )
  then
    return false;
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended('admin-artwork-upload:' || p_actor_id::text, 0)
  );

  -- staging 에 동시에 쓰고 있는 업로드. 가장 큰 폼(굿즈 11칸: 대표 1 + 추가 이미지 9 + 상세 1)을
  -- 한 번 채우고 한 번 갈아끼울 수 있어야 한다.
  if (
    select count(*)
    from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
    where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
      and claim.status in ('pending', 'processing')
      and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  ) >= 22 then
    return false;
  end if;

  -- 저장을 기다리는 승격본. 폼을 몇 장 열어둬도 걸리지 않되 무한히 쌓이지는 않는다.
  if (
    select count(*)
    from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
    where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
      and claim.status = 'verified'
      and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
  ) >= 60 then
    return false;
  end if;

  insert into public.admin_artwork_upload_claims (
    path, actor_id, kind, mime_type, source_size, expires_at
  )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_record_system_job_run(p_job text, p_label text, p_expected_interval_minutes integer, p_started_at timestamp with time zone, p_finished_at timestamp with time zone, p_ok boolean, p_status_code integer, p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_detail jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare incident boolean := false;
begin
  if p_job is null or p_job !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,62}[a-z0-9]$'
    or p_label is null or char_length(p_label) not between 1 and 60 or p_label <> btrim(p_label)
    or p_expected_interval_minutes is null or p_expected_interval_minutes not between 1 and 10080
    or p_started_at is null or p_finished_at is null or not isfinite(p_started_at) or not isfinite(p_finished_at)
    or p_finished_at < p_started_at or p_finished_at > clock_timestamp() + interval '5 minutes'
    or p_started_at < clock_timestamp() - interval '1 day'
    or p_ok is null or p_status_code is null or p_status_code not between 100 and 599
    or (p_ok and p_error_code is not null)
    or (not p_ok and (p_error_code is null or p_error_code !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$'))
    or p_detail is null or jsonb_typeof(p_detail) <> 'object' or octet_length(p_detail::text) > 2000 then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'invalid_system_job_run';
  end if;
  insert into private.system_job_status as s(job_key, label, expected_interval_minutes, last_started_at, last_finished_at,
    last_success_at, last_failure_at, last_status_code, last_error_code, consecutive_failures)
  values (p_job, p_label, p_expected_interval_minutes, p_started_at, p_finished_at,
    case when p_ok then p_finished_at end, case when not p_ok then p_finished_at end, p_status_code,
    case when not p_ok then p_error_code end, case when p_ok then 0 else 1 end)
  on conflict (job_key) do update set
    label = excluded.label,
    expected_interval_minutes = excluded.expected_interval_minutes,
    last_started_at = greatest(s.last_started_at, excluded.last_started_at),
    last_finished_at = greatest(s.last_finished_at, excluded.last_finished_at),
    last_success_at = greatest(s.last_success_at, excluded.last_success_at),
    last_failure_at = greatest(s.last_failure_at, excluded.last_failure_at),
    -- 늦게 도착한 옛 실행이 최신 상태를 덮지 않는다.
    last_status_code = case when excluded.last_finished_at >= s.last_finished_at then excluded.last_status_code else s.last_status_code end,
    last_error_code = case when excluded.last_finished_at >= s.last_finished_at then excluded.last_error_code else s.last_error_code end,
    -- 연속 실패도 최신 실행만 바꾼다. 늦게 온 옛 성공이 최신 실패를 '정상'으로 되돌리지 않게 한다.
    consecutive_failures = case when excluded.last_finished_at < s.last_finished_at then s.consecutive_failures
      when p_ok then 0 else s.consecutive_failures + 1 end,
    updated_at = clock_timestamp();
  if not p_ok then
    incident := private.record_system_job_failure(p_job, 'vercel_cron', p_label, p_started_at, p_status_code, p_error_code, p_detail);
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('recorded', true, 'incident', incident);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_verify_admin_artwork_upload(p_actor_id uuid, p_path text, p_final_size integer, p_final_width integer, p_final_height integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_final_width is null or p_final_height is null
    or least(p_final_width, p_final_height) < 1
    or greatest(p_final_width, p_final_height) > (case when (
      select claim.kind from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
      where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id and claim.path = p_path
    ) = 'good' then 30000 else 8192 end)
    or p_final_width::bigint*p_final_height::bigint>40000000 then return false; end if;
  if not public.service_verify_admin_artwork_upload(p_actor_id,p_path,p_final_size) then return false; end if;
  update public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
    set final_width=p_final_width,final_height=p_final_height
    where claim.actor_id=p_actor_id and claim.path=p_path and claim.status='verified';
  if not found then raise check_violation using message='artwork_dimensions_not_recorded'; end if;
  return true;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.service_verify_admin_artwork_upload(p_actor_id uuid, p_path text, p_final_size integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform private.lock_operator_subjects(array[p_actor_id]);
  if not private.has_operator_capability(p_actor_id,private.operator_artwork_capability((select claim.kind from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims claim where claim.actor_id=p_actor_id and claim.path=p_path))) then return false; end if;

  if p_final_size is null or p_final_size < 1 or p_final_size > (case when (
      select claim.kind from public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
      where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id and claim.path = p_path
    ) = 'good' then 20 * 1024 * 1024 else 5 * 1024 * 1024 end) then
    return false;
  end if;

  update public.admin_artwork_upload_claims as claim
  set
    status = 'verified',
    final_size = p_final_size,
    verified_at = pg_catalog.clock_timestamp(),
    -- 폼 작성 창. 이미 더 먼 만료가 잡혀 있으면 당기지 않는다.
    -- greatest 는 파서 구문이라 search_path 와 무관하게 스키마 수식이 없다.
    expires_at = greatest(
      claim.expires_at,
      pg_catalog.clock_timestamp() + interval '2 hours'
    )
  where claim.actor_id = p_actor_id
    and claim.path = p_path
    and claim.status = 'processing'
    and claim.expires_at > pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles as profile
      where profile.id = claim.actor_id
        and profile.role in ('staff', 'admin')
        and profile.suspended_at is null
    );

  return found;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_customer_demographic_consent(p_choice text, p_gender text, p_expected_revision bigint, p_expected_actor uuid, p_expected_session uuid, p_notice_version text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare c private.customer_demographic_consents;
begin
 -- The shared identity helper locks the live customer, session and deletion
 -- boundary. It does not read or inherit the member-activity consent.
 perform private.require_member_activity_identity(p_expected_actor,p_expected_session);
 if p_choice is null or p_choice not in ('accepted','declined') or p_expected_revision is null or p_expected_revision<0
  or p_notice_version is distinct from 'customer-demographics-v1'
  or (p_choice='accepted' and (p_gender is null or p_gender not in ('female','male','other')))
  or (p_choice='declined' and p_gender is not null) then
  raise invalid_parameter_value using message='invalid_customer_demographic_choice'; end if;
 select * into c from private.customer_demographic_consents where user_id=p_expected_actor for update;
 if coalesce(c.revision,0)<>p_expected_revision then
  -- An immediate identical retry is safe, but an older accept cannot undo a
  -- later withdrawal/change, including an accept->decline->accept sequence.
  if c.revision=p_expected_revision+1 and c.choice=p_choice and c.gender is not distinct from p_gender then
   return public.customer_demographic_state(); end if;
  raise sqlstate 'PT409' using message='customer_demographic_choice_changed'; end if;
 if c.choice is distinct from p_choice or c.gender is distinct from p_gender then
  insert into private.customer_demographic_consents(user_id,choice,gender,notice_version,revision,accepted_at)
   values(p_expected_actor,p_choice,p_gender,p_notice_version,coalesce(c.revision,0)+1,
    case when p_choice='accepted' then clock_timestamp() end)
   on conflict(user_id) do update set choice=excluded.choice,gender=excluded.gender,notice_version=excluded.notice_version,
    revision=excluded.revision,accepted_at=excluded.accepted_at,updated_at=clock_timestamp();
 end if;
 return public.customer_demographic_state();
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stage_adult_verification_result(p_session_id uuid, p_claim_token uuid, p_outcome text, p_subject_digest text, p_transaction_digest text, p_policy_version text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_now timestamptz := pg_catalog.clock_timestamp();
  v_session private.adult_verification_sessions%rowtype;
begin
  if p_session_id is null
    or p_claim_token is null
    or p_outcome is null or p_outcome not in ('adult', 'underage')
    or p_policy_version is null
    or p_policy_version !~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}@[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
    or (p_subject_digest is not null and p_subject_digest !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
    or (p_transaction_digest is not null and p_transaction_digest !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
    or (p_outcome = 'adult' and (p_subject_digest is null or p_transaction_digest is null))
  then
    raise invalid_parameter_value using message = 'adult_verification_invalid';
  end if;

  select session.*
  into v_session
  from private.adult_verification_sessions as session
  where session.id = p_session_id
  for update;

  if not found
    or v_session.state is distinct from 'confirming'
    or v_session.claim_token is distinct from p_claim_token
  then
    raise object_not_in_prerequisite_state using message = 'adult_verification_claim_lost';
  end if;

  if v_session.expires_at <= v_now then
    perform private.close_adult_verification_session(v_session.id, 'expired', 'session_expired');
    return;
  end if;

  update private.adult_verification_sessions
  set
    state = 'awaiting_owner',
    claim_token = null,
    claim_expires_at = null,
    staged_outcome = p_outcome,
    -- 미성년 판정에는 명의·거래 해시가 필요 없다. 받지도 남기지도 않는다.
    staged_subject_digest = case when p_outcome = 'adult' then p_subject_digest end,
    staged_transaction_digest = case when p_outcome = 'adult' then p_transaction_digest end,
    staged_policy_version = p_policy_version,
    staged_at = v_now
  where id = v_session.id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.allow_any_operation(expected_operations text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH current_operation AS (
    SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation
  ),
  normalized AS (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9)
      ELSE raw_operation
    END AS current_operation
    FROM current_operation
  )
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM normalized n
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(expected_operations) AS expected_operation
    WHERE expected_operation IS NOT NULL
      AND expected_operation <> ''
      AND n.current_operation = CASE
        WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9)
        ELSE expected_operation
      END
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.allow_only_operation(expected_operation text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH current_operation AS (
    SELECT storage.operation() AS raw_operation
  ),
  normalized AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN raw_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(raw_operation, 9)
        ELSE raw_operation
      END AS current_operation,
      CASE
        WHEN expected_operation LIKE 'storage.%' THEN substr(expected_operation, 9)
        ELSE expected_operation
      END AS requested_operation
    FROM current_operation
  )
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN requested_operation IS NULL OR requested_operation = '' THEN FALSE
    ELSE COALESCE(current_operation = requested_operation, FALSE)
  END
  FROM normalized;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.extension(name text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    _parts text[];
    _filename text;
BEGIN
    -- Split on "/" to get path segments
    SELECT string_to_array(name, '/') INTO _parts;
    -- Get the last path segment (the actual filename)
    SELECT _parts[array_length(_parts, 1)] INTO _filename;
    -- Extract extension: reverse, split on '.', then reverse again
    RETURN reverse(split_part(reverse(_filename), '.', 1));
END
$function$

 RETURNS text

_parts text[];
BEGIN

	return _parts[array_length(_parts,1)];
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.list_multipart_uploads_with_delimiter(bucket_id text, prefix_param text, delimiter_param text, max_keys integer DEFAULT 100, next_key_token text DEFAULT ''::text, next_upload_token text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(key text, id text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE
        'SELECT DISTINCT ON(key COLLATE "C") * from (
            SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1)) > 0 THEN
                        substring(key from 1 for length($1) + position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1)))
                    ELSE
                        key
                END AS key, id, created_at
            FROM
                storage.s3_multipart_uploads
            WHERE
                bucket_id = $5 AND
                key ILIKE $1 || ''%'' AND
                CASE
                    WHEN $4 != '''' AND $6 = '''' THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1)) > 0 THEN
                                substring(key from 1 for length($1) + position($2 IN substring(key from length($1) + 1))) COLLATE "C" > $4
                            ELSE
                                key COLLATE "C" > $4
                            END
                    ELSE
                        true
                END AND
                CASE
                    WHEN $6 != '''' THEN
                        id COLLATE "C" > $6
                    ELSE
                        true
                    END
            ORDER BY
                key COLLATE "C" ASC, created_at ASC) as e order by key COLLATE "C" LIMIT $3'
        USING prefix_param, delimiter_param, max_keys, next_key_token, bucket_id, next_upload_token;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.operation()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN current_setting('storage.operation', true);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Check if storage.allow_delete_query is set to 'true'
    IF COALESCE(current_setting('storage.allow_delete_query', true), 'false') != 'true' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Direct deletion from storage tables is not allowed. Use the Storage API instead.'
            USING HINT = 'This prevents accidental data loss from orphaned objects.',
                  ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION storage.search_by_timestamp(p_prefix text, p_bucket_id text, p_limit integer, p_level integer, p_start_after text, p_sort_order text, p_sort_column text, p_sort_column_after text)
 RETURNS TABLE(key text, name text, id uuid, updated_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, last_accessed_at timestamp with time zone, metadata jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_cursor_op text;
    v_query text;
    v_prefix text;
BEGIN
    v_prefix := coalesce(p_prefix, '');

    IF p_sort_order = 'asc' THEN
        v_cursor_op := '>';
    ELSE
        v_cursor_op := '<';
    END IF;

    v_query := format($sql$
        WITH raw_objects AS (
            SELECT
                o.name AS obj_name,
                o.id AS obj_id,
                o.updated_at AS obj_updated_at,
                o.created_at AS obj_created_at,
                o.last_accessed_at AS obj_last_accessed_at,
                o.metadata AS obj_metadata,
                storage.get_common_prefix(o.name, $1, '/') AS common_prefix
            FROM storage.objects o
            WHERE o.bucket_id = $2
              AND o.name COLLATE "C" LIKE $1 || '%%'
        ),
        -- Aggregate common prefixes (folders)
        -- Both created_at and updated_at use MIN(obj_created_at) to match the old prefixes table behavior
        aggregated_prefixes AS (
            SELECT
                rtrim(common_prefix, '/') AS name,
                NULL::uuid AS id,
                MIN(obj_created_at) AS updated_at,
                MIN(obj_created_at) AS created_at,
                NULL::timestamptz AS last_accessed_at,
                NULL::jsonb AS metadata,
                TRUE AS is_prefix
            FROM raw_objects
            WHERE common_prefix IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY common_prefix
        ),
        leaf_objects AS (
            SELECT
                obj_name AS name,
                obj_id AS id,
                obj_updated_at AS updated_at,
                obj_created_at AS created_at,
                obj_last_accessed_at AS last_accessed_at,
                obj_metadata AS metadata,
                FALSE AS is_prefix
            FROM raw_objects
            WHERE common_prefix IS NULL
        ),
        combined AS (
            SELECT * FROM aggregated_prefixes
            UNION ALL
            SELECT * FROM leaf_objects
        ),
        filtered AS (
            SELECT *
            FROM combined
            WHERE (
                $5 = ''
                OR ROW(
                    date_trunc('milliseconds', %I),
                    name COLLATE "C"
                ) %s ROW(
                    COALESCE(NULLIF($6, '')::timestamptz, 'epoch'::timestamptz),
                    $5
                )
            )
        )
        SELECT
            split_part(name, '/', $3) AS key,
            name,
            id,
            updated_at,
            created_at,
            last_accessed_at,
            metadata
        FROM filtered
        ORDER BY
            COALESCE(date_trunc('milliseconds', %I), 'epoch'::timestamptz) %s,
            name COLLATE "C" %s
        LIMIT $4
    $sql$,
        p_sort_column,
        v_cursor_op,
        p_sort_column,
        p_sort_order,
        p_sort_order
    );

    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE v_query
    USING v_prefix, p_bucket_id, p_level, p_limit, p_start_after, p_sort_column_after;
END;
$function$
